223.name: .223 Remington
223.description: .223 Remington ammunition with a 55gr FMJ-BT bullet, patterned after the M193 loading.  The .223 round has been very popular with civilian shooters for almost a century, finding use in a wide variety of weapons.  The combination of high velocity with a thinly-jacketed, cannelured projectile led to unexpected yaw and fragmentation in soft tissue, increasing this round's performance.

308.name: .308 Winchester
308.description: .308 Winchester ammunition with a 168gr hollow point bullet.  The .308 cartridge is one of the most popular hunting cartridges in the world due to its accuracy and power.

545.name: 5.45x39mm FMJ
545.description: Domestically produced 5.45x39mm ammunition with a 56gr FMJ bullet.  The 5.45x39mm round was introduced along with the AK-74 in 1974.  It has superior wounding potential to the older 7.62x39mm round and quickly replaced it in Soviet military use.

556.name: 5.56x45mm NATO M855
556.description: 5.56x45mm ammunition with a 62gr FMJ bullet containing a steel penetrator.  Originally designed for the M249 FN Minimi, M855 was designed to penetrate steel helmets and light cover at range, sacrificing terminal performance and accuracy in the process.  The limited yaw and fragmentation is worsened with shorter-barreled carbines shooting this round, and optimization of barrel twist for stabilization of the tracer variant of M855 has resulted in lackluster accuracy overall.

3006.name: .30-06 FMJ
3006.description: Jacketed .30-06 Springfield M2 Ball ammunition with a 150gr spitzer bullet.  The .30-06 cartridge was adopted in 1906 by the US military, where it served for some 50 years, and it remains popular today among collectors and hunters for its range, versatility, and power.

3030.name: .30-30 Winchester SP
3030.description: A 150 grain Soft Point 30-30 Winchester round.  .30-30 Winchester is a common rifle round, being in use for hunting and recreation for over 100 years.  It holds the title of being the first non-military cartridge designed for smokeless powder, despite still using the old naming scheme for black powder cartridges.

art_helm.description:

art_gloves.description:
A set of worn leather gloves embossed with gold.  The unidentifiable leather it is made from is oddly soft.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_boots.name: ancient leather boots (pair)
art_boots.description:
A pair of ancient leather boots.  Though the flaps of leather are crudely sewn together, the red hue it is dyed with is striking.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_ring.name: amber ring
art_ring.description:
A band of gold with a smooth piece of amber set into it.  A strange worm is encased in the amber, making a perfect spiral with its sealed body.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_staff.name: ancient staff
art_staff.description:
A well-balanced stick of treated wood with metal caps.  A red stone is embedded in the handle.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_sword.name: ancient sword
art_sword.description:
A sword made out of a striking black metal.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_harp.name: ancient harp

player_descriptions: You strum a string and the note hangs in the air far longer than you would expect.
You improvise a tune on the harp.  The sound is beautiful, even if you can't remember what you just played.
You pluck a chord on the harp.  It doesn't sound anything at all like the sounds of the individual strings.
npc_descriptions: plucks a few notes on the harp, though no sound seems to come.

art_harp.description:
A harp made of black wood.  Faint hypnotic notes ring in the air each time you touch it.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_dagger.name: ancient athame
art_dagger.description:
A ritual knife used by some ancient civilization.  Unreadable runes are carved into the handle.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_spear.name: ancient spear
art_spear.description:
A sturdy wooden pole with a sharp metal spike on the end.  The handle has the symbol of a blue sun on it.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_club.name: ancient club
art_club.description:
A misshapen rod of gnarled, knotted wood.  The knots in the wood exhibit a strange fractal pattern.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_bomorrean.name: set of oddly interlocked rings
art_bomorrean.description:
A set of three rings linked together.  There's something about the way the rings connect to each other that gives you a headache.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_penrose.name: strange triangle
art_penrose.description:
A large triangle made out of three thick rectangles that connect to each other in an angle.  No matter how much you turn it around, you can't seem to comprehend how it links together.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_trident.name: impossible trident
art_trident.description:
A large trident made entirely out of an indiscernible material.  The prong in the middle seems to fade away into nothingness when looked at from the top, but you can clearly see the shaft connecting the tip of the weapon from the bottom.  It's giving you a headache.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_klein.name: self-crossing flask
art_klein.description:
A transparent flask with a neck that connects directly to its bottom without overlapping itself, even though it clearly does.  You can put things in it, but attempting to follow their path through the neck is impossible.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_tesseract.name: four-dimensional cube
art_tesseract.description:
It's a cube that constantly shrinks and grows in size.  It's two cubes linked by the vertices, with ever-shifting sides folding onto each other, over and over.  It's four cubes in the exact same position.  It's a cube fading to ash then reverting to pristine form repeatedly.  It's all of these at once, and none of them at all.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_irrational.name: irrational cube
art_irrational.description:
A large wire-frame cube.  The interior wires somehow appear to be over the exterior wires, no matter which angle you look at the cube from.  Trying to trace the lines with your finger is probably not a good idea.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

art_duocylinder.name: wobbly ring
art_duocylinder.description:
A chunky ring that folds onto itself continuously, preventing its use as an esoteric piece of jewelry.  It is the only one of its kind.
It may have unknown powers; try activating them.

architect_cube.name: The Architect's Cube
architect_cube.description: This is a solid cube that is much heavier than its size suggests.  When you look at it, it pulls your gaze inward until you fall through the sky, showing you a top-down view of your position with the surroundings revealed.

DEBUG_stabbing.name: stone of stabbing

10mm_fmj.name: 10mm Auto FMJ
10mm_fmj.description: Jacketed 10mm Auto ammunition with a 180gr bullet.  The 10mm Auto cartridge is a rather powerful handgun round and the progenitor to the more popular .40 S&W.

10mm_jhp.description: Jacketed 10mm Auto ammunition with a 180gr hollow point bullet, intended for use in self-defense, or perhaps hunting.  The 10mm Auto cartridge is a rather powerful handgun round and the progenitor to the more popular .40 S&W.

22_cb.name: .22 CB
22_cb.description: .22 Conical Ball, a variety of .22 ammunition that propels its bullet using a primer instead of gunpowder.  The end result is a subsonic round that is so weak as to be nearly useless given your predicament.

22_fmj.name: .22 LR FMJ
22_fmj.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with a 30gr FMJ bullet.  The .22LR round is extremely weak, with short range and negligible recoil.  This type is marginally better at piercing through targets, but deals even less damage as a result.

22_lr.name: .22 LR
22_lr.description: .22 Long Rifle ammunition with a 40gr unjacketed bullet.  The .22LR round is extremely weak, with short range and negligible recoil.  It is most useful for target practice and hunting small animals.

22_ratshot.name: .22 rat-shot
22_ratshot.description: A .22 caliber cartridge loaded with very small pieces of shot contained within a fragmenting plastic capsule.  It has an extremely short range and poor penetration ability, but the spread of shot can hit targets with greater ease.

556_mk262.name: 5.56x45mm NATO Mk 262
556_mk262.description: 5.56x45mm ammunition, loaded for precision from the Mk 12 SPR rifles, and later used by other SF units looking for more effective loadings for their M4A1 and Mk 18 carbines.  The Mk 262 Mod 1 is loaded with a 77 grain Open Tip Match bullet, enhancing lethality even at longer ranges when compared to older M855 loadings.

556_mk318.name: 5.56x45mm NATO Mk318
556_mk318.description: 5.56x45mm ammunition, developed due to SOF dissatisfaction with the M855 cartridge.  The Mk318 Mod 1 is loaded with a 62 grain Open Tip Match Rear Penetrator bullet, a copper slug enclosed inside an open-tipped brass projectile, providing for consistent loading, enhanced lethality and increased penetration.  When compared to M855, the Mk318 fragments consistently, even out of short-barreled carbines.

556_m855a1.name: 5.56x45mm NATO M855A1
556_m855a1.description: An updated loading of M855 5.56x45mm ammunition, featuring a 62 grain projectile containing an exposed steel penetrator and copper slug.  Designed as a mostly lead-free projectile, the opportunity was further taken to improve upon M855's penetration and lethality characteristics through penetrator design and increased pressure.  Its improved accuracy, penetration and lethality over M855 are appreciated by users of shorter-barreled AR variants.

556_incendiary.name: 5.56x45mm NATO tracer
556_incendiary.description: An M856 tracer round.  Traditional practice is to load one tracer per every four normal rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.  They have the potential to ignite flammable surfaces at their point of impact.

556_m995.name: 5.56x45mm NATO M995
556_m995.description: An armor piercing 5.56x45mm M995 round using a 52gr projectile, featuring a black-tipped, tungsten carbide penetrator over an aluminum slug.  Increased penetration over standard ball rounds at the cost of worse wounding potential in soft tissue.

300blk.name: .300 AAC Blackout
300blk.description: A .300 AAC Blackout round with a 125gr open tip match bullet.  .300 BLK is an intermediate cartridge necked up from 5.56x45mm, designed to achieve similar ballistics to 7.62x39mm.  It is compatible with standard AR-15 lower receivers and will feed from STANAG magazines.

300blk_ss.name: .300 AAC Blackout subsonic
300blk_ss.description: A subsonic .300 AAC Blackout round with a 220gr open tip match bullet.  When fired with a suppressor, it only emits low noise, making it ideal for silently eliminating your enemies.  It is compatible with standard AR-15 lower receivers and will feed from STANAG magazines.

303_fmjbt.name: .303 British FMJ
303_fmjbt.description: Jacketed .303 British ammunition loaded with a 174gr spitzer bullet, similar to the MK VII pattern.  The British Empire's standard combat cartridge from 1888 until the 1950s.

303_sp.name: .303 British JSP
303_sp.description: Jacketed .303 British ammunition loaded with a 180gr soft point bullet, for hunting medium game.  .303 British was the standard caliber for military rifles in the British Empire from 1888 until the 1950s.  This loading allows the round to undergo greater expansion upon striking targets, leading to larger wound channels.

303_bthp.name: .303 British OTM
303_bthp.description: Jacketed .303 British ammunition loaded with a 174gr open tip match bullet, for precision shooting.  .303 British was the standard caliber for military rifles in the British Empire from 1888 until the 1950s.  The projectile's open tip construction offers greater manufacturing precision and a marginal amount of increased expansion over regular full metal jacket bullets.

762_51.description: A 7.62x51mm NATO round with a 147gr FMJ bullet.  It is a powerful rifle cartridge commonly used by hunters and military snipers because of its high accuracy and long range.

762_51_incendiary.name: 7.62x51mm NATO tracer
762_51_incendiary.description: An M62 tracer round.  Traditional practice is to load one of these for every four normal rounds to help keep the weapon they are fired from on target.  They have the potential to ignite flammable surfaces on impact.

762_51_m993.name: 7.62x51mm NATO M993

Along with its elder sibling, the .50-caliber Beowulf cartridge, the .450 Bushmaster is one of a number of such high-caliber rounds and is compatible with appropriately converted AR-15-platform rifles.  This particular cartridge possesses a plastic-tipped projectile, which acts as an improved hollow point bullet with uniform and devastating expansion within wound cavities.

reloaded_450_penetrator.description: .450 Bushmaster ammunition, loaded with a solid-copper 220-grain penetrator bullet.  Born from discontent with the .223 Remington's weak stopping potential, the .450 Bushmaster round was crafted in line with the so-called 'Thumper' concept: an envisioned need for a large-bore, semi-automatic sporting cartridge capable of downing game in one shot.  Along with its elder sibling, the .50-caliber Beowulf cartridge, the .450 Bushmaster is one of a number of such high-caliber rounds and is compatible with appropriately converted AR-15-platform rifles.  This particular cartridge is loaded with a solid-copper projectile: excellent at punching through thick barriers and delivering massive amounts of energy to anything unfortunate enough to be hit.

50beowulf_xtp.description: .50-caliber Beowulf ammunition, loaded with a copper-jacketed 350-grain eXtreme Terminal Performance bullet.  Developed in 2001 as a powerful short- to medium-range chambering for AR-15 style rifles, this stout cartridge had gained some popularity as a hunting round before the Cataclysm.  This particular version of the cartridge is coated in a layer of polymer, encouraging commendable terminal ballistics, penetrative capabilities, and overall expansion from its 12.7x42mm projectile.

50beowulf_penetrator.name: .50 Beowulf Xtreme Penetrator
50beowulf_penetrator.description: .50-caliber Beowulf ammunition, loaded with a solid-copper 420-grain Xtreme Penetrator bullet.  Developed in 2001 as a powerful short- to medium-range chambering for AR-15 style rifles, this stout cartridge had gained some popularity as a hunting round before the Cataclysm.  With a blunt nose construction for better initial energy transfer, this 12.7mm-wide bullet's solid copper design allows it to punch through entry barriers while resulting in a larger wound column.

50_incendiary.name: .50 BMG M17 tracer
50_incendiary.description: A tracer variant of the powerful .50 BMG round.  Tracer rounds help to keep the weapon they are fired from on target, though have the potential to ignite flammable surfaces on impact.

50bmg.name: .50 BMG M33 Ball
50bmg.description: .50 BMG ammunition with a mild steel cored 661gr FMJ bullet.  The .50 BMG is a very powerful rifle round designed for anti-aircraft use, later adapted to anti-vehicular and anti-personnel roles.  Its stupendous energy and armor piercing capabilities make it one of the most deadly rounds available, offset only by its drastic recoil and noise.

50_mk211.name: .50 BMG Raufoss Mk 211
50_mk211.description: This variant of the .50 BMG round makes the most of the caliber's potential payload delivery: The tip is loaded with an incendiary mix, which ignites on impact, detonating the RDX or PETN charge.  This also ignites a secondary zirconium powder incendiary charge that surrounds a tungsten carbide penetrator, both encased by a mild steel cup.  Fragments from the cup and burning metallic powder follow the penetrator through armored targets, increasing lethality.  This rare, complicated, and expensive round is not likely to be manufactured again; use it wisely.

57mm.description: 5.7x28mm ammunition with a 31gr AP FMJ bullet.  The 5.7x28mm cartridge was designed by FN Herstal to replace the 9x19mm round in NATO use.  Although the project to replace 9x19mm Parabellum was effectively canceled, the 5.7x28mm round has seen action in many conflicts and has proven to be reliable.  It has very low recoil and its armor penetration is a defining feature.

84x246mm_he.description: An 84x245mm High Explosive anti-personnel cartridge for the Carl Gustaf M3 and other 84mm recoilless rifles.  Designed to be highly effective against personnel.

84x246mm_hedp.name: 84x245mm HEDP
84x246mm_hedp.description: An 84x245mm High Explosive Dual Purpose anti-materiel cartridge for the Carl Gustaf M3 and other 84mm recoilless rifles.  Designed to be highly effective against vehicles and structures.

84x246mm_smoke.name: 84x245mm SMOKE
84x246mm_smoke.description: An 84x245mm smoke marker cartridge for the Carl Gustaf M3 and other 84mm recoilless rifles.  Commonly used for signaling, target designation, and for screening troop movements.

8mm_caseless.name: 8x40mm FMJ
8mm_caseless.description: An 8x40mm caseless cartridge with a rectangular shape, consisting of a jacketed 127gr bullet housed inside of an advanced propellant body.  Upon firing, the body will be consumed, leaving nothing behind in the chamber.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech 8x40 caseless guns.

8mm_jhp.name: 8x40mm SCX
8mm_jhp.description: An 8x40mm caseless cartridge with a rectangular shape, consisting of a licensed 127gr solid copper expanding bullet housed inside of an advanced propellant body.  Upon firing, the body will be consumed, leaving nothing behind in the chamber.  The monometal construction of the bullet lends itself to greater manufacturing precision, while also offering excellent expansion and penetration.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech 8x40 caseless guns.

9mm.name: 9x19mm JHP
9mm.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a 116gr jacketed hollow point bullet.  JHP rounds have inferior penetration to FMJ rounds, but their expansion slightly increases stopping power against unarmored targets and reduces overpenetration.

9mmfmj.name: 9x19mm FMJ
9mmfmj.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a brass jacketed 115gr bullet.  It has been a popular round for military, law enforcement, and civilian use for over a century.

9mmP.name: 9x19mm +P
9mmP.description: Overpressure 9x19mm ammunition.  The round's increased velocity results in superior accuracy and stopping power at the cost of higher recoil.

9mmP2.name: 9x19mm +P+
9mmP2.description: A step beyond the high-pressure 9x19mm +P round, the +P+ has even higher internal pressure offering superior damage, accuracy, and penetration.

bp_9mmfmj.name: 9x19mm FMJ, black powder
bp_9mmfmj.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a brass jacketed 115gr bullet.  It has been a popular round for military, law enforcement, and civilian use for over a century.

reloaded_9mmfmj.name: 9x19mm FMJ, reloaded
reloaded_9mmfmj.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a brass jacketed 115gr bullet.  It has been a popular round for military, law enforcement, and civilian use for over a century.

matchhead_9mmfmj.name: 9x19mm FMJ, matchhead powder
matchhead_9mmfmj.description: 9x19mm ammunition with a brass jacketed 115gr bullet.  It has been a popular round for military, law enforcement, and civilian use for over a century.

9x18mm.name: 9x18mm Makarov FMJ
9x18mm.description: 9x18mm Makarov ammunition with a 93gr steel core FMJ bullet.  The 9x18mm round was very common in the Eastern Bloc during the 20th century and remained in Russian military service into the 21st.

9x18mmP2.name: 9x18mm Makarov JHP
9x18mmP2.description: 9x18mm Makarov SP-7 ammunition.  The 9x18mm round was very common in the Eastern Bloc during the 20th century and remained in Russian military service into the 21st.

9x18mmfmj.name: 9x18mm Makarov AP
9x18mmfmj.description: 9x18mm Makarov RG028 ammunition.  The RG028 round uses a bullet with a hardened steel core to improve armor penetration.

bp_9x18mm.name: 9x18mm Makarov FMJ, black powder
bp_9x18mm.description: 9x18mm Makarov ammunition with a 93gr steel core FMJ bullet.  The 9x18mm round was very common in the Eastern Bloc during the 20th century and remained in Russian military service into the 21st.

bp_9x18mmfmj.name: 9x18mm Makarov AP, black powder
bp_9x18mmfmj.description: 9x18mm Makarov RG028 ammunition.  The RG028 round uses a bullet with a hardened steel core to improve armor penetration.

reloaded_9x18mm.name: 9x18mm Makarov FMJ, reloaded
reloaded_9x18mm.description: 9x18mm Makarov ammunition with a 93gr steel core FMJ bullet.  The 9x18mm round was very common in the Eastern Bloc during the 20th century and remained in Russian military service into the 21st.

reloaded_9x18mmP2.name: 9x18mm Makarov +P+, reloaded
reloaded_9x18mmP2.description: 9x18 millimeter Makarov, an old Soviet pistol cartridge used mainly by the Makarov PM.  This one has been hand-reloaded to generate higher internal pressure, boosting flight stability and damage.

reloaded_9x18mmfmj.name: 9x18mm Makarov AP, reloaded
reloaded_9x18mmfmj.description: 9x18mm Makarov RG028 ammunition.  The RG028 round uses a bullet with a hardened steel core to improve armor penetration.

matchhead_9x18mmfmj.name: 9x18mm Makarov AP, matchhead powder
matchhead_9x18mmfmj.description: 9x18mm Makarov RG028 ammunition.  The RG028 round uses a bullet with a hardened steel core to improve armor penetration.

matchhead_9x18mm.name: 9x18mm Makarov FMJ, matchhead powder
matchhead_9x18mm.description: 9x18mm Makarov ammunition with a 93gr steel core FMJ bullet.  The 9x18mm round was very common in the Eastern Bloc during the 20th century and remained in Russian military service into the 21st.

atgm_heat.name: 152mm ATGM HEAT
atgm_heat.description: A tube-launched, optically tracked, wire-guided missile contained in a steel tube.  Designed to be highly effective against vehicles and structures.

barb_paralysis.name: paralyzing barb
barb_paralysis.description: Tiny droplets of venom trickle out of the sponge-like tissue of this sharp barb.

gene_sting_barb.name: gene sting barb
gene_sting_barb.description: Tiny droplets of cyan venom trickle out of the sponge-like tissue of this sharp barb.

22_blank.name: .22 blank
22_blank.description: A powder load .22 blank used for powder-actuated tools.

cannon_shot.name: cannon round shot
cannon_shot.description: A bundle of wadding, black gunpowder, and a cannonball, ready to be loaded into a cannon.

gas_chloramine.name: sprayable toxic gas
gas_chloramine.description: A hazardous mixture made from household cleaning chemicals, improvised for use in a chemical thrower.  Best used with some kind of mask or mouth protection.

gas_fungicidal.name: sprayable fungicide
gas_fungicidal.description: Fungicide enhanced with sulfur to create sprayable anti-fungal ammo for the chemical thrower.  Best used with some kind of mask or mouth protection.

gas_insecticidal.name: sprayable insecticide
gas_insecticidal.description: Strong sprayable insecticide ammo for the chemical thrower.  Best used with some kind of mask or mouth protection.

123ln.name: 12.3ln
123ln.description: In some alternate universe, the 12.3ln cartridge was introduced in Romania in the wake of the second Carpathian conflict.  The PA md. 71 rifle, using this ammunition, rapidly gained popularity in the Eastern Union, and from there, the world.  Due to this, the 12.3ln rapidly became the standard combat round in the Eurasian sphere, making it easy for the Exodii to stockpile it in large quantities when they visited that version of Earth.  It looks vaguely like a rimless, .303 British cartridge loaded with a larger, non-spitzer bullet.

reloaded_123ln.name: 12.3ln, reloaded
reloaded_123ln.description: In some alternate universe, the 12.3ln cartridge was introduced in Romania in the wake of the second Carpathian conflict.  The PA md. 71 rifle, using this ammunition, rapidly gained popularity in the Eastern Union, and from there, the world.  Due to this, the 12.3ln rapidly became the standard combat round in the Eurasian sphere, making it easy for the Exodii to stockpile it in large quantities when they visited that version of Earth.  It looks vaguely like a rimless, .303 British cartridge loaded with a larger, non-spitzer bullet.

bp_123ln.name: 12.3ln, black powder
bp_123ln.description: In some alternate universe, the 12.3ln cartridge was introduced in Romania in the wake of the second Carpathian conflict.  The PA md. 71 rifle, using this ammunition, rapidly gained popularity in the Eastern Union, and from there, the world.  Due to this, the 12.3ln rapidly became the standard combat round in the Eurasian sphere, making it easy for the Exodii to stockpile it in large quantities when they visited that version of Earth.  It looks vaguely like a rimless, .303 British cartridge loaded with a larger, non-spitzer bullet.

123ln_ap.name: 12.3ln AP
123ln_ap.description: In some alternate universe, the 12.3ln cartridge was introduced in Romania in the wake of the second Carpathian conflict.  This is the armor piercing variant, and it is the ammo that is preferred by exodii snipers or individuals using the PS md. 71z.

reloaded_123ln_ap.name: 12.3ln AP, reloaded
reloaded_123ln_ap.description: In some alternate universe, the 12.3ln cartridge was introduced in Romania in the wake of the second Carpathian conflict.  This is the armor piercing variant, and it is the ammo that is preferred by exodii snipers or individuals using the PS md. 71z.

bp_123ln_ap.name: 12.3ln AP, black powder
bp_123ln_ap.description: In some alternate universe, the 12.3ln cartridge was introduced in Romania in the wake of the second Carpathian conflict.  This is the armor piercing variant, and it is the ammo that is preferred by exodii snipers or individuals using the PS md. 71z.

273x110sluglight.name: 27.3x110 Diyua light slug
273x110sluglight.description: 27.3x110 Diyua light slug loads were employed by colonists on some alternate Earth to take dangerous game, and later, fend off commonwealth forces from atop palisade walls.

273x110slugmedium.name: 27.3x110 Diyua medium slug
273x110slugmedium.description: 27.3x110 Diyua medium slug loads were employed by colonists on some alternate Earth to take extremely dangerous game, and later, fend off commonwealth forces from atop palisade walls.  Most users of the Brogyaga guns considered these shells too punishing to withstand.

273x110slugheavy.name: 27.3x110 Diyua heavy slug
273x110slugheavy.description: 27.3x110 Diyua slug loads similar to these were employed by colonists on some alternate Earth to take extremely dangerous game.  This heavy slug load, however, was used almost entirely by recoil enthusiasts and braggarts, until the Exodii came upon them.

273x110flock.name: 27.3x110 Diyua flockshot
273x110flock.description: On some alien Earth, scores of flocks were decimated by loads such as this 27.3x110 Diyua shell, loaded with a ludicrous number of tiny pellets.  Though it would still be devastating against more humanoid targets, flockshot like this is more typically employed by the Exodii by the occasional hunting party.

273x110canister.name: 27.3x110 Diyua canister
273x110canister.description: On some alien Earth, these mini-canister loads mimicked much larger artillery shot, and were employed for anti-personnel usage against advancing waves from atop a palisade.  The Exodii would load these in their Brogyeki sidearms for backup usage.

273x44flare.name: 27.3x44 Diyua star
273x44flare.description: These flare cartridges are for use in 27.3x44 Diyua guns, or perhaps in 27.3x110 Diyua guns.  They are employed by the Exodii for emergency signaling when their usual communications systems are suffering interference, breakdown, or are being jammed.

273x44trainer.name: 27.3x44 Diyua practice
273x44trainer.description: A 27.3x44 Diyua cartridge loaded with a large hollow aluminum projectile, painted blue at the tip, for practicing shooting.  If interdimensional total replacement cyborgs have to practice, maybe you should too.

273x44thermobaric.name: 27.3x44 Diyua thermobaric
273x44thermobaric.description: A 27.3x44 Diyua cartridge with a minute amount of liquid fuel encasing a fuel dispersing explosive charge, and a secondary ignition charge.  On impact the fuel is dispersed, creating a fuel air mixture which is ignited a few milliseconds later.  In a cartridge like 27.3x44 Diyua, the pressure wave produced is rather diminutive, yet it makes the most of what little payload is available.

273x44HE.name: 27.3x44 Diyua high explosive
273x44HE.description: A 27.3x44 Diyua cartridge loaded with a high explosive charge and a point-detonating fuze.  Primarily useful for assaulting soft targets, and, in their universe of origin, dispersing crowds.

273x44RG.name: 66/27.3x278 Diyua multipurpose
273x44RG.description: A long 27.3 Diyua cartridge loaded with a propelling charge, attached to a large high explosive shaped charge grenade several times larger in diameter.  It was designed to be muzzle loaded into 27.3x44 Diyua guns.  Though the grenade's penetration and fragmentation were ultimately deemed insufficient, this was of no matter to the Exodii who saw value in the explosive potential the grenade added to the Brogyeki '23.

caotel_cell.name: Caotel cell
caotel_cell.description: This is a small metallic cube of inscrutable construction.  A single groove etched into one side of the object presumably allows it to be mounted into other things, and a small red arrow has been helpfully painted besides it.

khuunaofaai_ammo_firework.name: Khuunäöfaai firework payload
khuunaofaai_ammo_firework.description: Pressurized chemical payload for the Khuunäöfaai.  Highly reactive to oxygen, removing it from the tank would be a bad idea.

khuunaofaai_ammo_incendiary.name: Khuunäöfaai incendiary payload
khuunaofaai_ammo_incendiary.description: Pressurized chemical payload for the Khuunäöfaai.  Highly flammable and reactive to oxygen, removing it from the tank would be a bad idea.

khuunaofaai_ammo_corrosive.name: Khuunäöfaai corrosive payload
khuunaofaai_ammo_corrosive.description: Pressurized chemical payload for the Khuunäöfaai.  Essentially a juiced up version of pirahna solution, removing it from the tank would be a bad idea.

khuunaofaai_ammo_foam.name: Khuunäöfaai foaming payload
khuunaofaai_ammo_foam.description: Pressurized chemical payload for the Khuunäöfaai.  An incredibly powerful binding agent and sealant, removing it from the tank would be a bad idea.

33naval_ball.name: 3.3 naval FMJ
33naval_ball.description: Initially made for marine combat, this hefty projectile is a go-to round for late-stage Exodii fights.

flintlock_ammo.name: paper cartridge
flintlock_ammo.description: A paper cartridge containing black powder and a metallic projectile.  Historically used to reload muzzleloaders in a more reasonable time.

flintlock_shot.name: paper shot cartridge
flintlock_shot.description: A paper cartridge containing black powder and metallic shot.  Historically used to reload muzzleloaders in a more reasonable time.

combatnail.name: flechette
combatnail.description: A tiny steel dart.  Can be fired from a nail gun or similar weapon, or used for crafting ammunition.

bronze_nail.name: bronze nail
bronze_nail.description: A pin-shaped piece of bronze.  It can be used to construct various things with a hammer.

nail.name: nail
nail.description: A pin-shaped piece of steel.  It can be used to construct various things with a hammer.

nuts_bolts.name: nut and bolt
nuts_bolts.description: A matching nut and bolt.  Useful for securing objects together.

rivets.name: rivet
rivets.description: A solid rivet, outdated, unless you plan on doing medieval smithing.

paintball.name: paintball
paintball.description: A small paintball for recreational shooting.  Getting shot with one stings a little, but you'd be hard-pressed to kill anything with it.

reloaded_shot_bird.name: 12 gauge birdshot, reloaded
reloaded_shot_bird.description: Weak shotgun ammunition, filled with tiny pellets and a low powder charge.  Used often for shooting clays or birds, they're a very common commercial round.  Their effectiveness against human targets are quite limited outside of very close ranges, serving more to hurt than kill.

reloaded_shot_dragon.name: 12 gauge dragon's breath, reloaded
reloaded_shot_dragon.description: A shotgun shell filled with magnesium pellets or shards, used mostly as a distress flare or pyrotechnics tool.  When the round is fired, high-temperature sparks and flames shoot out of the barrel.  While looking very impressive, they present more of a fire hazard than an effective tool for lighting up hostiles.  This one was made in somebody's garage.  Are you sure you want to shoot this?

reloaded_shot_00.name: 12 gauge buckshot, reloaded
reloaded_shot_00.description: A 12 gauge shotgun shell, filled with 9 pellets of 00 buck.  A very common and versatile round, they're useful for both self defense and for hunting.  The spread of the shot doesn't just increase your chances to have a projectile hit, it also causes a much larger wound, greatly increasing lethality.  It does struggle with range, and against body armor.

reloaded_shot_flechette.name: 12 gauge flechette, reloaded
reloaded_shot_flechette.description: A shotgun shell filled with tiny steel darts.  While looking quite dangerous, their actual effectiveness is questionable.  Despite being finned, they have a tendency to tumble mid-air, leading to greater spread and reduced damage.

reloaded_shot_slug.name: 12 gauge slug, reloaded
reloaded_shot_slug.description: A 12 gauge slug.  Unlike birdshot or buckshot, slugs are a single large projectile fired from a shotgun.  They're mostly used for hunting bigger game, or for longer range shots where typical buck may spread out more.  Not as lethal as buckshot in certain ranges, but much more accurate and with a longer range, and is more effective against armor.

bp_shot_bird.name: 12 gauge birdshot, black powder
bp_shot_bird.description: Weak shotgun ammunition, filled with tiny pellets and a low powder charge.  Used often for shooting clays or birds, they're a very common commercial round.  Their effectiveness against human targets are quite limited outside of very close ranges, serving more to hurt than kill.

It does struggle with range, and against body armor.

shot_beanbag.name: 12 gauge beanbag
shot_beanbag.description: A beanbag round for shotguns.  Designated 'less-lethal' and intended to disable, but remember that 'less-lethal' does not mean 'non-lethal'.

shot_bird.name: 12 gauge birdshot
shot_bird.description: Weak shotgun ammunition, filled with tiny pellets and a low powder charge.  Used often for shooting clays or birds, they're a very common commercial round.  Their effectiveness against human targets are quite limited outside of very close ranges, serving more to hurt than kill.

shot_dragon.description: A shotgun shell filled with magnesium pellets or shards, used mostly as a distress flare or pyrotechnics tool.  When the round is fired, high-temperature sparks and flames shoot out of the barrel.  While looking very impressive, they present more of a fire hazard than an effective tool for lighting up hostiles.

shot_flechette.description: A shotgun shell filled with tiny steel darts.  While looking quite dangerous, their actual effectiveness is questionable.  Despite being finned, they have a tendency to tumble mid-air, leading to greater spread and reduced damage.

shot_scrap.name: 12 gauge scrap shot, reloaded
shot_scrap.description: A shotgun shell filled with whatever scrap metal was lying around.  More damaging than birdshot, but fairly inaccurate.

bp_shot_scrap.name: 12 gauge scrap shot, black powder
bp_shot_scrap.description: A shotgun shell filled with black gunpowder and whatever scrap metal was lying around.  The logical conclusion of ammunition bootlegging.  It'll kill zombies just fine, but your gun will suffer for it.

shot_slug.name: 12 gauge slug
shot_slug.description: A 12 gauge slug.  Unlike birdshot or buckshot, slugs are a single large projectile fired from a shotgun.  They're mostly used for hunting bigger game, or for longer range shots where typical buck may spread out more.  Not as lethal as buckshot in certain ranges, but much more accurate and with a longer range, and is more effective against armor.

wax_slug.name: wax slug
wax_slug.description: A round of 12 gauge birdshot that has had the crimp opened, and wax poured into the shot to mimic the performance of a proper slug.

signal_flare.name: signal flare
signal_flare.description: A heavy plastic cartridge made for use in flare guns.  It appears to be a modified 12 gauge shotgun shell.

sling-ready_molotov.name: sling-ready Molotov cocktail
sling-ready_molotov.description: A bottle of flammable liquid with a long fuse inserted, ready to be used in a staff sling with a modified cradle.  To throw this item without a sling, use it light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  After lighting it, throw it to cause fires.

sling-ready_grenade.name: sling-ready grenade
sling-ready_grenade.description: A military-grade fragmentary hand grenade, modified with a retaining fuse for use in a staff sling with a modified cradle.  To throw this item without a sling, use it to snap the fuse and activate the grenade.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You snap the retaining fuse on the grenade.

sling-ready_small_homemade_grenade.name: sling-ready small homemade grenade
sling-ready_small_homemade_grenade.description: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from spare parts and modified with a retaining fuse for use in a staff sling.  To throw this item without a sling, use it to snap the fuse and activate the grenade.  You will then have 5 seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the retaining fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows in your face!

sling-ready_homemade_grenade.name: sling-ready homemade grenade
sling-ready_homemade_grenade.description: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from spare parts and modified with a retaining fuse for use in a staff sling with a modified cradle.  To throw this item without a sling, use it to snap the fuse and activate the grenade.  You will then have 5 seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the retaining fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows in your face!

sling-ready_small_homemade_grenade_2.name: sling-ready military explosive small homemade grenade
sling-ready_small_homemade_grenade_2.description: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from parts and modified with a retaining fuse for use in a staff sling.  To throw this item without a sling, use it to snap the fuse and activate the grenade.  You will then have some amount of time before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the retaining fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows in your face!

sling-ready_small_homemade_grenade_2.name_plural: sling-ready military explosive small homemade grenades

sling-ready_homemade_grenade_2.name: sling-ready military explosive homemade grenade
sling-ready_homemade_grenade_2.description: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from parts and modified with a retaining fuse for use in a staff sling with a modified cradle.  To throw this item without a sling, use it to snap the fuse and activate the grenade.  You will then have some amount of time before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the retaining fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows in your face!

oxyacetylene.name: oxyacetylene
oxyacetylene.description: Pressurized, dangerous acetylene gas.  Can be used for welding or cutting with a torch.

welding_rod_steel.name: welding rod
welding_rod_steel.description: A length of coated welding electrode - a 3 mm thick steel rod coated in a special flux.  During the welding process, the hot metal of the electrode fills the seam, jointing parts together while the flux protects the surface of the seam from atmospheric gases and rapid cooling.  Required for arc welding.

welding_rod_alloy.name: aluminum welding rod
welding_rod_alloy.description: A length of coated welding electrode - a 3.2 mm thick aluminum rod coated in a special protective flux.  Required for arc welding aluminum alloys.

welding_wire_steel.name: welding wire
welding_wire_steel.description: A length of 0.8 mm steel wire for MAG welding.

welding_wire_alloy.name: aluminum welding wire
welding_wire_alloy.description: A length of 0.9 mm aluminum wire for MIG welding.

brazing_rod_bronze.name: brazing rod
brazing_rod_bronze.description: A length of 3.2 mm flux-coated bronze rod, for brazing steel.

brazing_rod_alloy.name: aluminum brazing rod
brazing_rod_alloy.description: A length of 3.2 mm aluminum rod, for brazing aluminum alloys.  Also suitable for TIG welding.

battery.name: battery
battery.description: Some free-floating battery charge.  It can be reloaded into rechargeable battery cells, but can never be unloaded.

butane.name: butane
butane.description: A common flammable liquid, used in lighters.

notch.name: notch
notch.description: A notch used with a fire drill to create an ember.

aerosol_paint.name: aerosol paint
aerosol_paint.description: Paint that comes in a sealed, pressurized container and is released in an aerosol spray when a valve button is depressed.

permanent_ink.name: permanent ink
permanent_ink.description: Ink comprised of a main carrier solvent, a glyceride, a pyrrolidone, a resin, and a colorant, making it water resistant.

candle_wax.name: candle wax
candle_wax.description: A solid flammable substance, used to make candles.

flare_nitrate.name: flare pyrotechnic
flare_nitrate.description: A pyrotechnic chemical used in flares.

match.name: match
match.description: A small stick with a red part at the end.  Strike it against a matchbook to light it.

betavoltaic.name: betavoltaic cell
betavoltaic.description: Harness the power of radiation in your own home!  It looks similar to a D-cell battery, but actually contains folded layers of radioactive material inside.  It can produce electricity for several years at a steady voltage… but it's barely enough to power a small LED, and these batteries were worth hundreds of dollars.  Mostly they're a good way to brag to your neighbors that you have a nuclear power source in your house.

RTG_coffee.name: radioisotope thermoelectric generator
RTG_coffee.description: Did your neighbors brag about their cool beta-decay-powered nightlights?  Do them one better!  The CuppaTech 4 radioisotope thermoelectric generator is a three kilogram chunk of metal - mostly lead - with a slug of cerium-244 encased within.  It is capable of generating somewhere between 100-150 Watts of thermal energy, although its electrical generation capacity is minimal at only 2 Watts.  Careful!  Curium is great at making heat, and also releases deadly gamma radiation.  Keep away from cellular life forms.

aluminum_foil.name: aluminum foil
aluminum_foil.description: A sheet of thin foil made of aluminum.  Sometimes called 'tin foil' due to being made of tin in the past.

money.name: cent
money.description: A unit of currency equivalent to 0.01 US dollars.

thread.name: thread
thread.description: A small quantity of thread that could be used for sewing.

sinew.name: sinew
sinew.description: A tough sinew cut from a corpse, usable as thread.

plant_fibre.name: plant fiber
plant_fibre.description: Tough, thin fiber taken from a plant.  Can be used as thread.

yarn.name: yarn
yarn.description: A length of wool yarn that could be used to knit wool clothing.

soap.name: soap bar
soap.description: A cleansing agent shaped into a bar.

moisturizer.name: moisturizer
moisturizer.description: A cosmetic preparation used for protecting, moisturizing, and lubricating the skin.

duct_tape.name: duct tape
duct_tape.description: A roll of incredibly strong tape.  Its uses are innumerable.

rolling_paper.name: rolling paper
rolling_paper.description: A thin paper strip intended for the rolling of cigarettes.

cable.name: copper wire
cable.description: A length of plastic-jacketed copper cable, of the type used in small electronics.

copper_wire.name: raw copper wire
copper_wire.description: A length of copper wire ready to be covered with plastic.

plut_cell.name: plutonium fuel cell
plut_cell.description: This is neither a fuel cell, nor nuclear, but the name stuck.  It uses plutonium-244 as a catalyst to stabilize a complicated nanocompound that can store enormous amounts of power.  Unfortunately, it cannot be recharged by conventional means: expended cells had to be sent to a central reprocessing facility that almost certainly doesn't exist anymore.

uran_cell.name: uranium fuel cell
uran_cell.description: The uranium dioxide (UO2) powder is fired in a high-temperature, sintering furnace to create hard, ceramic pellets of enriched uranium dioxide.

plut_slurry_dense.name: plutonium slurry
plut_slurry_dense.description: Highly-radioactive slurry.  It is probably best to get far away from this.

plut_slurry.name: watery plutonium slurry
plut_slurry.description: Highly-radioactive slurry.  It is probably best to get far away from this.

rock.name: rock
rock.description: A rock the size of a baseball.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is also good for throwing at enemies.

pebble.name: pebble
pebble.description: A small rock, useful as ammunition for a slingshot.

pebble_clay.name: clay pellet
pebble_clay.description: A round projectile made of clay, useful as ammunition for a slingshot.

marble.name: marble
marble.description: A glass marble, useful as ammunition for a slingshot.

bearing.name: ball bearing
bearing.description: A steel ball bearing, useful as ammunition for a slingshot.

bb.name: BB
bb.description: A small steel ball that can be fired from a BB gun.  Deals virtually no damage.

feather.name: feather
feather.description: A feather from a bird.  Useful for fletching arrows.

down_feather.name: handful of down feathers
down_feather.description: A handful of fluffy down feather from a bird.  Useful for making cozy bedclothes.

120mm_HEAT.name: 120mm HEAT
120mm_HEAT.description: A 120mm high-explosive anti-tank round.  It could ruin anyone's whole day.

plasma.name: solid hydrogen canister
plasma.description: A canister of pressurized hydrogen so heavily compressed it has turned solid.  With proper equipment, it could be heated into plasma.

gunpowder.name: mixed smokeless gunpowder
gunpowder.description: Firearm-quality gunpowder, mixed without concern for composition, burn rate, or shape, making it thoroughly useless for reloading ammunition.  It has been slightly ground to make its properties more uniform.

gunpowder_shotgun.name: smokeless shotgun powder
gunpowder_shotgun.description: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in shotgun shells.

gunpowder_pistol.name: smokeless pistol powder
gunpowder_pistol.description: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in pistol ammunition.

gunpowder_magnum_pistol.name: smokeless magnum powder
gunpowder_magnum_pistol.description: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in magnum pistol ammunition.

gunpowder_rifle.name: smokeless rifle powder
gunpowder_rifle.description: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in rifle ammunition.

gunpowder_large_rifle.name: smokeless overbore rifle powder
gunpowder_large_rifle.description: Firearm-quality gunpowder intended for use in large rifle ammunition.

gunpowder_artillery.name: artillery propellant
gunpowder_artillery.description: Single base smokeless gunpowder intended for use in artillery propelling charges.

lye_powder.name: lye powder
lye_powder.description: Powdered caustic soda, also known as sodium hydroxide.

shotgun_primer.name: shotgun primer
shotgun_primer.description: A primer from a shotgun shell.

smpistol_primer.name: small pistol primer
smpistol_primer.description: A primer from a small-caliber pistol round.

lgpistol_primer.name: large pistol primer
lgpistol_primer.description: A primer from a large-caliber pistol round.

smrifle_primer.name: small rifle primer
smrifle_primer.description: A primer from a small-caliber rifle round.

lgrifle_primer.name: large rifle primer
lgrifle_primer.description: A primer from a large-caliber rifle round.

spent_shotgun_primer.name: spent shotgun primer
spent_shotgun_primer.description: A primer from a shotgun shell.  It has been fired, and must be cleaned and reloaded to use again.

spent_smpistol_primer.name: spent small pistol primer
spent_smpistol_primer.description: A primer from a small-caliber pistol round.  It has been fired, and must be cleaned and reloaded to use again.

spent_lgpistol_primer.name: spent large pistol primer
spent_lgpistol_primer.description: A primer from a large-caliber pistol round.  It has been fired, and must be cleaned and reloaded to use again.

spent_smrifle_primer.name: spent small rifle primer
spent_smrifle_primer.description: A primer from a small-caliber rifle round.  It has been fired, and must be cleaned and reloaded to use again.

spent_lgrifle_primer.name: spent large rifle primer
spent_lgrifle_primer.description: A primer from a large-caliber rifle round.  It has been fired, and must be cleaned and reloaded to use again.

rubber_slug.name: rubber slug
rubber_slug.description: A rubber slug from a shotgun beanbag round.  You could use it to make a new beanbag round.

chunk_rubber.name: chunk of rubber
chunk_rubber.description: A chunk of useful rubber that can be molded easily.

copper.name: copper
copper.description: Some scrap bits of copper.  Could be used to craft things, such as makeshift ammunition.

medical_tape.name: medical tape
medical_tape.description: A roll of semi-opaque medical tape, intended to hold bandages in place.  Not as versatile as duct tape.

charcoal.name: charcoal
charcoal.description: A flammable carbon-based material produced by slowly burning wood.  Utilized in recipes requiring a pure, hot flame.  Can also be used in filters to remove contaminants from air and water.

carbon_electrode.name: carbon electrode rod
carbon_electrode.description: This carbon electrode is basically made from wood and sugar, and it actually works.

coal_lump.name: coal
coal_lump.description: Flammable black chunks of carbon-based material, commonly used for cooking and heating.

albuterol.name: albuterol
albuterol.description: A bronchodilator that relaxes muscles in the airways and increases air flow to the lungs.

ampoule.name: RA21E medical ampoule
ampoule.description: A tiny glass vial filled with advanced fast-healing chemicals which can only be activated by a Rivtech jet injector device.  The packaged instructions describe its efficacy in dealing with infections, wounds, intoxications, envenomations, and general tiredness in enthusiastic detail.  A short safety section at the end warns - in much smaller typeface - against using more than two doses per hour.

stimpack_ammo.name: RA10K stimulant module
stimpack_ammo.description: A pressurized multi-chamber glass vial filled with powerful chemical stimulants which can only be activated by a Rivtech stimulant delivery system.

liq_bandage.name: liquid bandage
liq_bandage.description: A polymer dissolved in solvent, with antiseptic added, for topical treatment of minor cuts and scrapes.

rebreather_filler_soda_lime.name: rebreather scrubbing filler
rebreather_filler_soda_lime.description: Granulated mixture of slaked lime, potassium hydroxide and/or sodium hydroxide that is used as CO2 scrubbing agent in rebreathers.

rebreather_filler_ko2.name: rebreather oxygen regenerator filler
rebreather_filler_ko2.description: Potassium superoxide powder, used as oxygen regenerating agent in rebreathers.  Keep away from water.

gasfilter_s.name: filter mask cartridge
gasfilter_s.description: A small, replaceable filter cartridge for an air filtration mask.

gasfilter_m.name: activated carbon
gasfilter_m.description: A small amount of coal-derived carbon material with many small pores, used for the adsorption of harmful chemicals.  Most commonly employed within respirator filters, it traps and retains chemical gases and vapor contaminants while allowing filtered air to pass unhindered.  Once all the carbon has been bonded to intruding chemicals, the filter is expired and must be replaced.

nicotine_liquid.name: nicotine liquid
nicotine_liquid.description: Liquid made up of propylene glycol, vegetable glycerin, flavorings, and nicotine.  Intended for use in an advanced electronic cigarette.

fish_bait.name: fish bait
fish_bait.description: A handful of bait, used in traps to lure fish.

spiked_rocket.name: spiked homemade rocket
spiked_rocket.description: A hand-built rocket, consisting of a spike welded onto a pipe filled with improvised rocket fuel.  Horribly inaccurate, as can be expected of this grade of weapon, but packs a fierce punch… if it hits.

explosive_hm_rocket.name: explosive homemade rocket
explosive_hm_rocket.description: A hand-built rocket, consisting of a simple explosive warhead attached onto a pipe, filled with improvised rocket fuel.  Not very powerful, but can be made from scratch.

incendiary_hm_rocket.name: incendiary homemade rocket
incendiary_hm_rocket.description: A hand-built rocket, consisting of a container of flammable gel attached onto a pipe, filled with improvised rocket fuel.  A short-range incendiary - handle with care!

unfinished_charcoal.name: unfinished charcoal
unfinished_charcoal.description: The result of an interrupted charcoal-making process.  Useless, except as fuel in a charcoal kiln.

lamellae_lc.name: mild steel lamella
lamellae_lc.description: A pile of small 3 cm by 6 cm steel rectangles with a pattern of holes drilled into it.  For use in creating or repairing lamellar armor.

lamellae_ch.name: hardened steel lamella
lamellae_ch.description: A pile of small 3 cm by 6 cm steel rectangles with a pattern of holes drilled into it, then hardened.  For use in creating or repairing hardened lamellar armor.

lc_chain_link.name: mild steel chain link
lc_chain_link.description: A small metal ring, suitable for constructing chainmail.

mc_chain_link.name: medium steel chain link
mc_chain_link.description: A small metal ring, suitable for constructing chainmail.

hc_chain_link.name: high steel chain link
hc_chain_link.description: A small metal ring, suitable for constructing chainmail.

ch_chain_link.name: hardened steel chain link
ch_chain_link.description: A small metal ring, suitable for constructing chainmail.

qt_chain_link.name: tempered steel chain link
qt_chain_link.description: A small metal ring, suitable for constructing chainmail.

nitrox.name: nitrox
nitrox.description: A mixture of oxygen and nitrogen in proportions suitable for sustaining divers.

extinguishing_agent.name: extinguishing agent
extinguishing_agent.description: A dry chemical solution effective at extinguishing fires.

teargas_spray.name: tear gas spray
teargas_spray.description: A noxious aerosolized irritant used to fend off attackers both human and bear alike.

tinder.name: tinder
tinder.description: Flammable material, finely divided for easy combustion.

RPG_die.name: RPG die
RPG_die.description: A plastic die used to play various role-playing games.

metal_RPG_die.name: metal RPG die
metal_RPG_die.description: A metal die used to play various role-playing games.

scrap_bronze.name: chunk of bronze
scrap_bronze.description: Some decent-sized chunks of scrap bronze, for fashioning some old-school items.

glowstick_juice.name: glowstick juice
glowstick_juice.description: A mix of blue dye, base catalyst, and diphenyl oxalate used in glowsticks.

quill_ink.name: quill ink
quill_ink.description: Ink made from a variety of sources for use in quill style pens.

black_pen_ink.name: black pen ink
black_pen_ink.description: Carbon black pigment infused with polymers, stabilizers, and water to help the ink flow properly.

blue_pen_ink.name: blue pen ink
blue_pen_ink.description: Prussian blue, crystal violet, and phthalocyanine blue pigments infused with polymers, stabilizers, and water to help the ink flow properly.

green_pen_ink.name: green pen ink
green_pen_ink.description: Chlorophyll pigment infused with polymers, stabilizers, and water to help the ink flow properly.

red_pen_ink.name: red pen ink
red_pen_ink.description: Eosin dye infused with polymers, stabilizers, and water to help the ink flow properly.

airgun_pellet_target.name: air rifle target pellet
airgun_pellet_target.description: A tin of small cone-shaped pellets meant to be used in an air rifle.  Suitable for plinking.

airgun_pellet_hunting.name: air rifle hunting pellet
airgun_pellet_hunting.description: A tin of small cone-shaped pellets meant to be used in an air rifle.  Suitable for hunting small game.

9x18_steel_core.name: 9x18 steel core
9x18_steel_core.description: A stainless steel core that has been machined on a lathe by a survivor.  This one is meant to be used to reload a 9x18m bullet.

3006_steel_core.name: .30-06 steel core
3006_steel_core.description: A stainless steel core that has been machined on a lathe by a survivor.  This one is meant to be used to reload a .30-06 bullet.

123_steel_core.name: 12.3 steel core
123_steel_core.description: A stainless steel core that has been machined on a lathe by a survivor.  This one is meant to be used to reload a 12.3 bullet.

545_steel_core.name: 5.45 steel core
545_steel_core.description: A stainless steel core that has been machined on a lathe by a survivor.  This one is meant to be used to reload a 5.45 bullet.

50_steel_core.name: .50 BMG steel core
50_steel_core.description: A stainless mild steel core that has been machined on a lathe by a survivor.  This one is meant to be used to reload a .50 BMG bullet.

portable_generator.name: portable gasoline generator
portable_generator.description: Small, portable generator, one that people buy for a camp.  It just needs to be plugged in, fueled up, and then turned on.

diesel_generator.name: diesel generator
diesel_generator.description: Big and powerful generator, used for street works.  It just needs to be plugged in, fueled up, and then turned on.  Has little wheels to make it easier to move.

military_generator.name: military diesel generator
military_generator.description: Big and powerful generator, painted in camo.  It just needs to be plugged in, fueled up, and then turned on.

12000_gasoline_generator.name: powerful gasoline generator
12000_gasoline_generator.description: Still reasonably portable, this 12000 W gasoline generator can power up an entire house.  It just needs to be plugged in, fueled up, and then turned on.

apartment_fridge.name: household fridge
apartment_fridge.description: A disconnected household refrigerator.  General choice to store some perishables for an average family.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

minifridge.name: minifridge
minifridge.description: A disconnected minifridge, similar to ones in some luxury limousines.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

big_portable_fridge.name: food truck fridge
big_portable_fridge.description: A heavy and bulky fridge with little wheels for easier transportation.  Has a bunch of sections and separators, which allow it to be installed in a vehicle with relative assurance that any items inside will stay put.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

glass_fridge.name: single glass door fridge
glass_fridge.description: A disconnected commercial refrigerator with a transparent glass door, designed to show off any cold drinks and similar goods in a grocery store while still keeping them cool.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

glass_fridge_double.name: double glass door fridge
glass_fridge_double.description: A disconnected commercial refrigerator with two transparent glass doors, designed to show off any cold drinks and similar goods in a grocery store while still keeping them cool.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

heavy_duty_fridge.name: heavy-duty fridge
heavy_duty_fridge.description: A disconnected commercial refrigerator, used in many professional kitchens.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

display_fridge.name: display fridge
display_fridge.description: A big glass chamber, designed to display different food in a multiple rows, while cooling it at the same time.  While you might not need to actually display any of your food, it cools the food as good as any another fridge.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

apartment_freezer.name: household freezer
apartment_freezer.description: A disconnected household freezer.  Great choice if you need to freeze some discount meat.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

minifreezer.name: minifreezer
minifreezer.description: A compact version of an upright freezer, designed as a mobile solution for freezing food.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

chest_minifreezer.name: chest minifreezer
chest_minifreezer.description: A compact version of a chest freezer, designed as a mobile solution for freezing food, but it's pretty tricky to pull anything out from the bottom.  Perfect choice to put in your closet and forget for a year.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

big_portable_freezer.name: food truck freezer
big_portable_freezer.description: A heavy and bulky freezer with little wheels for easier transportation.  Has a bunch of sections and separators, which allow it to be installed in a vehicle with relative assurance that any items inside will stay put.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

chest_freezer.name: chest freezer
chest_freezer.description: A hefty chest freezer, designed to store plenty of perishables for a minuscule amount of power.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

heavy_duty_freezer.name: heavy-duty freezer
heavy_duty_freezer.description: A heavy-duty upright freezer.  Big as a closet, heavy as a tank, can probably fit enough meat to feed a little colony for a week, but consumes power like no other.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

glass_freezer.name: glass door freezer
glass_freezer.description: A disconnected commercial freezer with a glass door, used to present different frozen goods.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

display_freezer.name: display freezer
display_freezer.description: A disconnected commercial chest freezer with a glass lid.  Activate to deploy and connect to your electric grid.

oven.description: A disconnected electric convection-based oven, commonly used for heating and cooking food.  Plug it into a vehicle or power grid to get cooking.
oven.name: disconnected oven

stationary_water_purifier.description: A device that effectively sterilizes water, but it doesn't take batteries.  You'll need to connect it to a power source.
stationary_water_purifier.name: disconnected large water purifier

arcade_machine.description: A bulky upright arcade cabinet, brightly painted and slightly worn with age.  Ready to be plugged in and played.
arcade_machine.name: disconnected arcade machine

arc_furnace.description: An arc furnace designed to burn a powdery mix of coke and limestone to create calcium carbide.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
arc_furnace.name: disconnected arc furnace

drill_press.description: A powerful drill mounted on a slide that lets it drop precisely down.  Useful in all kinds of projects, from industrial fabrication to home woodworking.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
drill_press.name: disconnected drill press

power_hammer.description: A self-contained pneumatic power hammer using compressed air from an integrated compressor to strike repeatedly with great force.  Used for efficiently shaping and working metal.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
power_hammer.name: disconnected power hammer

steel_kiln.name: disconnected tempering kiln
steel_kiln.description: A very long electric kiln made for heat treating metal.  Unlike a forge, it can't get extremely hot, but its temperature is completely programmable.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.

tablesaw.description: A rotating sawblade set into a large, flat table.  Used for making straight, measured cuts, it's a key tool in any carpenter's arsenal.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
tablesaw.name: disconnected table saw

mitresaw.description: A circular sawblade on an arm that can slide and rotate in several directions, this is a staple tool for nearly any carpentry.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
mitresaw.name: disconnected mitre saw

bandsaw.description: A ribbonlike sawblade runs in a single direction in this tool, allowing precise cuts at almost any angle.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
bandsaw.name: disconnected band saw

router.description: This table has an inset router, a rotating motor with an exchangeable blade head for cutting specific profiles and grooves.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
router.name: disconnected router table

planer.description: A hefty tool that will take in a board and cut it smooth and flat to a specific width, particularly great if working with raw lumber stock, but also good just for shaving wood down to size.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
planer.name: disconnected planer

jointer.description: A table-shaped tool with a rotating blade that will cut down, smooth out, and square off a board to make it nice and smooth.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
jointer.name: disconnected jointer

hydraulic_press.description: If you really want to squash something a lot, this is exactly the right industrial tool for you.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
hydraulic_press.name: disconnected hydraulic press

air_compressor.description: This durable tank is topped with a motor that will cram as much air into the tank as possible.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.
air_compressor.name: disconnected air compressor

autoclave.name: disconnected autoclave
autoclave.description: An autoclave, used to sterilize equipment with pressurized steam.  It requires a massive amount of power, so it will need to be plugged into a power grid.

wall_light.name: disconnected wall light
wall_light.description: A wall light that provides illumination when plugged into a grid.

standing_lamp.name: disconnected standing lamp
standing_lamp.description: A tall standing lamp that provides illumination when plugged into a power outlet.

exodii_lamp.name: disconnected scavenged utility light
exodii_lamp.description: Some parts of this lamp have a curved appearance as though the metal were grown in a lab, but by and large this isn't a particularly unusual looking area light.  Its bulbs will emit light if connected to power.

standing_floodlight.name: disconnected standing floodlight
standing_floodlight.description: A large, heavy light designed to illuminate wide areas when plugged into a power outlet.

standing_directed_floodlight.name: disconnected standing directed floodlight
standing_directed_floodlight.description: A large, heavy light designed to illuminate a wide semicircle in a chosen direction when plugged into a power outlet.

wall_wiring.name: wall wiring
wall_wiring.description: Electric wires used to run power through walls.

foot_locker_recharge_station.name: disconnected foot locker recharging station
foot_locker_recharge_station.description: A universal recharging station integrated into a steel storage compartment.  When plugged in and powered, it will steadily charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.

box_battery_charger.name: disconnected box battery charger
box_battery_charger.description: A small device for recharging batteries integrated into a small wooden storage compartment.  When plugged in and powered, it will slowly charge all rechargeable batteries (battery cells, lead-acid batteries, etc) placed directly within its storage space.

compact_ASRG_containment.name: disconnected advanced Stirling radioisotope generator
compact_ASRG_containment.description: A rather heavy brick of metal housing an ASRG, formerly designed by NASA and repurposed for terrestrial use.  Will provide about 130 W, basically forever as far as you're concerned.  Even though the alpha radiation these run off of isn't very dangerous in case of a breach, this unit appears to be armored to take a beating and is a good deal heavier owing to its composite plating.

oxygen_concentrator.name: oxygen concentrator
oxygen_concentrator.description: A machine capable of generating pure oxygen from the air.  Can be placed and plugged into a power source.

hd_compressor_unit.name: high pressure compressor unit
hd_compressor_unit.description: A machine designed to compress an input gas to a very high pressure.  Can be placed and plugged into a power source.

glassblowers_crucible.name: disconnected glassblower's crucible
glassblowers_crucible.description: An electric crucible, powered by your electric grid.  Designed for melting large quantities of glass for batch crafting and production of large items, it needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.

lathe.name: disconnected lathe
lathe.description: An industrial-grade lathe, for turning chunks of metal and other hard things into round chunks of metal and other hard things.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.

mill_vertical.name: disconnected vertical mill
mill_vertical.description: A vertical milling machine commonly known as a Bridgeport.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.

deep_fryer.name: disconnected deep fryer
deep_fryer.description: An industrial deep fryer, for frying huge batches of food at once.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.

oil_press_electric.name: disconnected industrial oil press
oil_press_electric.description: A heavy-duty press used to create vegetable oil from nuts or seeds.  Needs to be placed and plugged into a power source.

bulk_liquid_tank.name: disconnected bulk liquid tank
bulk_liquid_tank.description: A heavy rack of ten interconnected steel tanks providing 600 liters of liquid storage.  It is built for stationary use, includes electric heating to keep its contents from freezing, and can accept plumbing equipment once placed as an appliance.

ammo_pouch.name: ammo pouch
ammo_pouch.description: A small pouch that can be used to store most types of small ammunition; rockets, however, will not fit.  Use insert to store ammunition.

ammo_satchel.name: ammo satchel
ammo_satchel.description: A fabric ammo bag worn at the waist.  It is capable of holding a single large magazine close at hand.

chestpouch.name: chest ammo pouch
chestpouch.description: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your chest and hold a single magazine close at hand.

chestrig.name: chest rig
chestrig.description: Popularized during the Vietnam War, chest rigs like these are typically plain, barebones affairs consisting of three or more pouches in a row, with straps to secure them on your chest.  This one can hold four magazines in its pouches.

xl_chestrig.name: chest rig
xl_chestrig.description: Popularized during the Vietnam War, chest rigs like these are typically plain, barebones affairs consisting of three or more pouches in a row, with straps to secure them on your chest.  This one can hold four magazines in its pouches.

xs_chestrig.name: chest rig
xs_chestrig.description: Popularized during the Vietnam War, chest rigs like these are typically plain, barebones affairs consisting of three or more pouches in a row, with straps to secure them on your chest.  This one can hold four magazines in its pouches.

javelin_bag.name: javelin bag
javelin_bag.description: An open medieval-looking bag, designed to store javelins within easy reach.

legpouch.name: ankle ammo pouch
legpouch.description: A small fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your ankle and hold a single small magazine close at hand.

legpouch_large.name: leg ammo pouch
legpouch_large.description: A fabric ammo pouch that can be strapped to your leg and hold two magazines close at hand.

quiver.name: quiver
quiver.description: A leather quiver worn at the waist that can hold 20 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.

nylon_quiver.name: nylon quiver
nylon_quiver.description: A lighter and more durable quiver made of nylon, with straps to attach to a MOLLE system.

quiver_birchbark.name: birchbark quiver
quiver_birchbark.description: A quiver woven from strips of birch bark, worn at the waist, that can hold 20 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.

pipe_quiver.name: pipe quiver
pipe_quiver.description: A makeshift quiver fashioned from a pipe, worn at the waist.  Heavier and thinner than a typical quiver, it can only hold 10 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.

quiver_large.name: large quiver
quiver_large.description: A large leather quiver, worn on the back, that can hold 60 arrows or bolts.  Historically used by horse archers, rather than foot archers, but neither of THEM had to fight zombies.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.

quiver_large_birchbark.name: large birchbark quiver
quiver_large_birchbark.description: A large quiver woven from strips of birchbark, worn on the back, that can hold 60 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.

pipe_quiver_large.name: large pipe quiver
pipe_quiver_large.description: A large makeshift quiver fashioned from 3 pipes, worn on the back.  Heavier and thinner than a typical large quiver, it can only hold 30 arrows or bolts.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts.

quiver_simple_cloth.name: simple cloth quiver
quiver_simple_cloth.description: A simple quiver made out of cloth that can be adjusted to hold various types of arrows, bolts, and spears of different lengths.  Takes slightly longer to pull ammunition from than a regular quiver.  Use insert to store arrows, bolts, fishing spears, or atlatl spears.

quiver_takedown_bow.name: multi-function quiver
quiver_takedown_bow.description: A large cotton quiver capable of easily storing 16 arrows.  It includes a bag and straps to store a takedown bow, as well as a small pouch for archery accessories.  Use insert to store arrows or bolts and activate to holster/draw your bow.

tacvest.name: tac vest
tacvest.description: This light vest is meant to carry your magazines, shells and pistols.  They are popular among law enforcement, but less so than combination tactical vests incorporating Kevlar.

xl_tacvest.name: tac vest

xl_armor_qt_heavyarmguard.name: tempered steel heavy arm guard
xl_armor_qt_heavyarmguard.description: A heavy armguard, 2.25 mm at the thickest.  The medium steel has been quenched and tempered, offering top of the line protection.

survivor_adhoc_leather_sleeves.name: leather-padded sleeves
survivor_adhoc_leather_sleeves.description: Armor made of combined pre-Cataclysm clothing.  Sections from leather clothing are tightened and affixed to the sleeves of a thick cotton shirt, excluding the joints.

armor_riot_arm.name: riot arm guards (pair)
armor_riot_arm.description: Hard arm guards used by riot police.

ballistic_vest_esapi.name: US ballistic vest
ballistic_vest_esapi.description: A ballistic vest with specialized pockets on the front, back, and sides to hold armor plates.  While this plate carrier is still protective even without inserts, it's too soft to effectively stop high-energy projectiles on its own.
