jacket_eod.name: EOD jacket
jacket_eod.description: A thick armored jacket constructed from Kevlar, Nomex, and foam padding, for use by explosive ordnance disposal technicians.  It features a central pocket for a large plate, and near complete coverage in fragmentation resistant materials.  Aside from the plate, it offers insufficient protection from ballistic threats.

pocket_data.description: Pocket for a huge armor plate.

jacket_eod_light.name: tactical EOD jacket
jacket_eod_light.description: An armored jacket constructed from Kevlar, Nomex, and foam padding, for use by explosive ordnance disposal technicians in 'non-permissive environments'.  It is lighter than normal EOD armor to allow for wearing a plate carrier beneath it.  It features two pockets in the arms covering the deltoids for additional optional protection.

pocket_data.description: Pocket for a huge armor plate.
Pockets for deltoid armor plates.

eod_plate.name: EOD fragmentation plate
eod_plate.description: A polygonal fragmentation plate with a slightly concave profile, made of thin layers of steel, UHMW polyethylene, foam, and Kevlar.  Though certified to provide protection from fragmentation, it will not provide much protection from firearms.  This is intended to be inserted into an EOD suit, and can't be worn on its own.

esapi_plate.name: ESAPI ballistic plate
esapi_plate.description: A polygonal ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile, made of ceramic.  Its inner surface is coated with UHMW polyethylene and is labeled "TOP", while the outer surface is labeled "STRIKE FACE".  This is intended to be worn in a ballistic vest, and can withstand several high-energy rifle rounds before breaking.
esapi_plate.damage_verb: makes a crunch, something has shifted

stab_plate.name: soft stab panel
stab_plate.description: A soft armor insert designed to protect against stab wounds.  While it's not great protection, it incurs no additional encumbrance.  This is intended to be inserted into a ballistic vest, and can't be worn on its own.

steel_ballistic_plate.name: steel ballistic plate
steel_ballistic_plate.description: A concave ballistic plate made of hard steel, designed to stop small-caliber rounds.  "NIJ III A PROTECTION" is etched into the back of the plate.  This is intended to be inserted into a ballistic vest, and can't be worn on its own.

heavy_steel_ballistic_plate.name: heavy steel ballistic plate
heavy_steel_ballistic_plate.description: A heavy concave ballistic plate made of tempered steel, designed to stop small-caliber rounds.  "NIJ III PROTECTION" is etched into the back of the plate.  This is intended to be inserted into a ballistic vest, and can't be worn on its own.

scrap_esapi_plate.name: scrap ESAPI plate
scrap_esapi_plate.description: A flat piece of salvaged steel, crudely cut and bent into the shape of an ESAPI ballistic plate.  It's wrapped in rags to cover the sharp edges.  Better than nothing, but it's heavier than the real thing, and not very strong.  This is intended to be inserted into a ballistic vest, and can't be worn on its own.

lc_esapi_plate.name: mild ESAPI plate
lc_esapi_plate.description: Mild steel forged into a ballistic plate.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.

mc_esapi_plate.name: medium ESAPI plate
mc_esapi_plate.description: Medium steel forged into a ballistic plate.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.

hc_esapi_plate.name: high ESAPI plate
hc_esapi_plate.description: High steel forged into a ballistic plate.  While it is more professionally done than most scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.

ch_esapi_plate.name: hard ESAPI plate
ch_esapi_plate.description: Hardened steel forged into a ballistic plate.  While it is more professionally done than most scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.

qt_esapi_plate.name: tempered ESAPI plate
qt_esapi_plate.description: Tempered steel forged into a ballistic plate.  While it is more professionally done than most scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.

deltoid_plates.name: deltoid ballistic plates
deltoid_plates.description: A pair of NIJ Level III ballistic plates with a concave profile, made of UHMW polyethylene.  "STRIKE FACE" is printed on its outer surface.  These plates are designed to be worn in the shoulder pockets of suitable plate carriers or combat shirts, and can resist several high-energy rifle rounds before breaking.  Deltoid plates such as these are very infrequently worn due to their marginal utility in improving survivability.
deltoid_plates.damage_verb: makes a crunch, something has shifted

esbi_plate.name: ESBI ballistic plate
esbi_plate.description: A polygonal ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile, made of ceramic.  "STRIKE FACE" is printed on its outer surface.  This is designed to be worn in the sides of a plate carrier, and can withstand several high-energy rifle rounds before breaking.
esbi_plate.damage_verb: makes a crunch, something has shifted

scrap_esbi_plate.name: scrap ESBI plate

lc_esbi_plate.name: mild ESBI plate
lc_esbi_plate.description: A hexagonal piece of mild steel forged into a side plate and padded with synthetic fabric.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.

mc_esbi_plate.name: medium ESBI plate
mc_esbi_plate.description: A hexagonal piece of medium steel forged into a side plate and padded with synthetic fabric.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.

hc_esbi_plate.name: high ESBI plate
hc_esbi_plate.description: A hexagonal piece of high steel forged into a side plate and padded with synthetic fabric.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.

ch_esbi_plate.name: hard ESBI plate
ch_esbi_plate.description: A hexagonal piece of hardened steel forged into a side plate and padded with synthetic fabric.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.

qt_esbi_plate.name: tempered ESBI plate
qt_esbi_plate.description: A hexagonal piece of tempered steel forged into a side plate and padded with synthetic fabric.  While it is more professionally done than scrap plates, it still has a fair amount of jerry-rigging.

fbi_armor_vest.description: A ranger green soft ballistic vest with MOLLE rigging used by federal law enforcement agencies.  Soft armor plates inside the vest provide solid defense against shrapnel and small-caliber rounds.  "FBI" is emblazoned across the front and back in large, yellow lettering, and it includes a pocket for storing evidence.  Use it to attach or detach pouches.

level_3_vest.name: hard armor vest

xl_ballistic_vest.name: ballistic vest
xl_ballistic_vest.description: An enormous handmade ballistic vest built with of lots of salvaged ballistic Kevlar panels.  It's bulkier than a factory made US Army vest, but it is customized for the benefit of an abnormally large mutant who couldn't wear such armors otherwise.  Coated in MOLLE webbing to support modular loadouts for the tacticool mutant.  It could be outfitted with steel plates for further protection.

xl_ballistic_vest_lc.name: ballistic vest (mild steel plates)
xl_ballistic_vest_lc.description: An enormous handmade ballistic vest built with lots of salvaged ballistic Kevlar panels and homemade "ballistic inserts" made of mild steel.  The thin metal isn't the most protective, but it's probably better than just plain Kevlar.

xl_ballistic_vest_qt.name: ballistic vest (tempered steel plates)
xl_ballistic_vest_qt.description: An enormous handmade ballistic vest made of lots of salvaged ballistic Kevlar panels and ten NIJ IIIA plates inserted into custom-made pockets - four each for your front and back and one each for your sides.  Monstrously heavy but extremely protective.

iotv_shoulder_plate.name: ballistic shoulder protectors (pair)
iotv_shoulder_plate.description: Nylon armor with soft armor inserts protecting the deltoid and upper arm.  Designed to be attached to heavy military body armor.

iotv_groin_plate.name: ballistic groin protector
iotv_groin_plate.description: Front and back nylon armor with soft armor inserts for groin and butt protection.  Designed to be attached to heavy military body armor.

iotv_neck_plate.name: ballistic collar
iotv_neck_plate.description: Front and back nylon collar assemblies with soft armor inserts for neck protection.  Designed to be attached to heavy military body armor.

lead_plate_xedra_mark.name: lead plate
lead_plate_xedra_mark.description: An lead plate like those found in most medical x-ray protection vests, affixed to a steel backing plate.  This is clearly intended to be inserted into the pocket of a protective vest, and can't be worn on its own.

When full, this bandolier is more encumbering than proper kit and slower to reload from, but it at least offers a quick and cheap means of resupplying ammunition.

Its clever construction adds additional core support, helping you to carry more equipment.

helmet_cardboard.name: cardboard 'great' helm
helmet_cardboard.description: A cardboard helmet shaped to look like a medieval great helm.  Very unencumbering in comparison to actual helmets, with rather obvious drawbacks in exchange.  The interior is lined with aluminum, apparently to 'divert the zombie beta rays'.  It sure doesn't help with comfort.

armor_cardboard.name: cardboard 'plate' armor
armor_cardboard.description: A set of cardboard armor that's been duct taped and superglued into place, with paper padding the interior in an unsuccessful attempt to increase comfort.  Despite the triple-layering, tensile and shear strength diagrams, and careful design considerations, there's just no way this is going to hold up to a single attack.

armor_cardboard_cuirass.name: cardboard cuirass
armor_cardboard_cuirass.description: While this isn't quite the 'heavy ballistic vest' the blueprints pretend it is, the layering makes it almost passable as a form of extremely rudimentary armor.  It's still nowhere near as good as basically any other choice, while still being hard to move around in.

cardboard_crown.name: cardboard crown
cardboard_crown.description: A piece of cardboard crudely bent into shape and cut to look like a crown.

cardboard_crown_loose.name: cardboard crown (loosened)
cardboard_crown_loose.description: A piece of cardboard crudely bent into shape and cut to look like a crown.  This one's been loosened up somewhat, allowing it to be worn over some headgear comfortably.

badge_cardboard.name: cardboard badge
badge_cardboard.description: An honorable badge identifying the owner as a "Knight Errant" of "House Da".  The large letters slowly dwindle in size as the badge runs out of space, leaving out the last two letters of Dino Dave's name.

use_action.msg: Your optical cloak flickers as it becomes transparent.
use_action.need_charges_msg: You don't have enough UPS charges.

use_action.msg: Your optical cloak flickers for a moment as it becomes opaque.

migo_plate_overgrown.name: overgrown iridescent carapace plate
migo_plate_overgrown.damage_verb: crumbles as blood oozes from its insides
migo_plate_overgrown.description: A chunk of otherworldly carapace that looks like it was at one point shaped like armor, but is now bulky and overgrown with sharp pieces jutting out haphazardly.  Scarred into the outer surface you can barely make out the label "STRIKE FACE".  It looks like you could force it into a ballistic vest.

migo_plate.name: iridescent carapace plate
migo_plate.damage_verb: crumbles as blood oozes from its insides
migo_plate.description: A chunk of otherworldly carapace that seems to have been forced into the shape of a ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile.  Scarred into the outer surface is the label "STRIKE FACE".  It looks like you could force it into a ballistic vest.

countdown_action.message: The iridescent carapace plate expands as it grows.

migo_plate_undergrown.name: undergrown iridescent carapace plate
migo_plate_undergrown.damage_verb: crumbles as blood oozes from its insides
migo_plate_undergrown.description: A chunk of otherworldly carapace that seems to have been forced into the shape of a ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile.  Scarred into the outer surface is the label "STRIKE FACE".  The armor coverage is spotty and it appears to be oozing and pulsing like it is in pain.

countdown_action.message: The iridescent carapace plate expands as it grows.

migo_plate_naked.name: plate of scarred flesh
migo_plate_naked.damage_verb: crumbles as blood oozes from its insides
migo_plate_naked.description: A chunk of otherworldly flesh that seems to have been forced into the shape of a ballistic plate with a slightly concave profile.  There is no armor left on this plate, just a mass of writhing alien flesh oozing in pain.  However, it looks like it is slowly growing back.

countdown_action.message: The plate of scarred flesh expands as it grows.

migo_skin.name: second skin
migo_skin.description: A slimy layer of liquid has completely engulfed your body from the neck down and seems to move with you - the sensation is uncomfortable.  The liquid appears bound to the resonating collar at your neck; the inside of the collar reads "CAREFUL CHOKING HAZARD!  THIS WAY DOWN".  The ooze flows freely, covering your entire body but never crossing the gorget to get to your head.

use_action.msg: The gorget hums and the liquid gets sucked back into it.

migo_skin_off.name: resonating gorget
migo_skin_off.description: A heavy-duty gorget or collar made from odd materials that hums slightly.  It feels damp to the touch and there is a mechanical button of some kind on the front.  The inside reads "CAREFUL CHOKING HAZARD!  THIS WAY DOWN".

use_action.msg: Murky ooze begins to leak out of the gorget and engulf your body from the neck down!

feeding_kit.name: feeding kit
feeding_kit.description: This is a collection of syringes with nozzles, an aerosol sprayer, and a few other attachments.  It seems designed for looking after some kind of creature that wants to stay wet.

armor_star_samurai.name: ryūsei battle kit
armor_star_samurai.description: A strange belt wrapped with circuitry and hundreds of banded metal discs.  When you touch it, it seems to vibrate slightly.

armor_star_samurai_mask.name: filtering menpo
armor_star_samurai_mask.description: A sealed mask with strange filtering components on the front turned up in the shape of horns.  Inscriptions mark the glass of the lenses creating spiral patterns that blur the vision.

armor_star_samurai_torso.name: ryūsei dō
armor_star_samurai_torso.description: An impossibly large slab of dark reflective material wrapped in bands of multicolored alloy.  It seems shaped to fit over a humanoid torso.

armor_star_samurai_shoulder.name: ryūsei kote
armor_star_samurai_shoulder.description: An impossibly large slab of dark reflective material wrapped in bands of multicolored alloy.  It seems shaped as though it would tie to the upper arms.

armor_star_samurai_legs.name: ryūsei hai-date
armor_star_samurai_legs.description: An impossibly large slab of dark reflective material wrapped in bands of multicolored alloy.  It has been forced into a conical shape as though it could somehow be worn as a skirt.

eclipse_glasses.name: eclipse glasses
eclipse_glasses.description: A pair of cardboard-framed glasses with UV and IR-filtered lenses topped with a layer of aluminum coating.  They allow safe viewing of extremely bright and harmful sources of light, like the sun during a solar eclipse.

eyepatch_leather.name: leather eyepatch
eyepatch_leather.description: A patch of black leather to cover an eye, with a string to keep it from falling off.  If wearing this doesn't make you feel a pirate, nothing will.

fitover_sunglasses.name: fit-over sunglasses
fitover_sunglasses.description: A pair of fit-over sunglasses designed to be worn over a pair of corrective glasses.  Good for keeping the glare out of your eyes.

glasses_bal.name: ballistic glasses
glasses_bal.description: Modern tactical eyewear that protects from small projectiles and fragments.  Provides excellent protection from environmental dangers.

glasses_bifocal.name: bifocal glasses
glasses_bifocal.description: A pair of bifocal glasses for those who are both near-sighted and far-sighted.  You can use them to focus sunlight.

glasses_eye.name: eyeglasses
glasses_eye.description: A pair of glasses for the near-sighted.  The concave lenses diffuse the sunlight, rendering them useless for starting fires.

glasses_monocle.name: monocle
glasses_monocle.description: An essential article of the gentleman's apparel.  Also corrects near-sightedness.  The concave lens diffuses the sunlight, rendering it useless for starting fires.

glasses_reading.name: reading glasses
glasses_reading.description: A pair of glasses for the far-sighted.  Useless for anyone else.  You can use them to focus sunlight.

glasses_safety.name: safety glasses
glasses_safety.description: A pair of plastic glasses, used in workshops, sports, chemistry labs, and many other places.  Provides great protection from damage.

glass_goggles.name: glass goggles
glass_goggles.description: A pair of old-fashioned goggles with thick glass lenses, somewhat similar to those worn by the pilots of open-cockpit aircraft, but more crude looking.  Won't protect your eyes from much physical harm, but can keep some hazardous chemicals out.

goggles_ski.name: ski goggles
goggles_ski.description: A large pair of goggles that completely seal off your eyes.  Provides excellent protection from environmental dangers.

goggles_welding.name: welding goggles
goggles_welding.description: A dark pair of goggles.  They make seeing very difficult, but protect you from bright flashes.

iggaak.name: snow goggles
iggaak.description: Eyewear carved from wood or bone, with only a thin slit to see out of.  Helps reduce glare, traditionally used by the Inuit to protect against snow blindness.

sunglasses.name: sunglasses
sunglasses.description: A pair of sunglasses, good for keeping the glare out of your eyes.

sunglasses_bifocal.name: bifocal sunglasses
sunglasses_bifocal.description: A pair of bifocal sunglasses for keeping the glare out of the eyes of those who are both near-sighted and far-sighted.

sunglasses_eye.name: corrective sunglasses

hat_golf.description: You're not actually sure if this is called a golf cap, but it's the stereotypical cap golfers wear.

wizard_hat_costume.name: wizard hat
wizard_hat_costume.description: A blue pointed hat with stars stitched into it.  Wearing it makes you feel like a powerful wizard.

pointed_hat.name: pointed hat
pointed_hat.description: A pointed hat suitable for a witch.

golden_hat.name: golden hat
golden_hat.description: An incredibly tall hat made from leather covered in gold leaf.  Its crown in divided into several segments, with patterns describing the phases of the moon, the seasons and the movements of strange constellations.

hijab.name: hijab
hijab.description: A headscarf worn by Muslim women which covers most of the head, leaving the face visible.

niqab.name: niqab
niqab.description: A veil worn by Muslim women which covers the face, leaving the eyes visible.

attachable_ear_muffs.name: attachable ear muffs
attachable_ear_muffs.description: A pair of ear muffs attachable to a hard hat or helmet to reduce noise exposures to safe levels.  Activate to put ear muffs into a working position, blocking most sounds.

use_action.msg: You put the ear muffs tightly to your ears.

attachable_ear_muffs_on.name: attachable ear muffs (on)
attachable_ear_muffs_on.description: A pair of ear muffs attachable to a hard hat or helmet to reduce noise exposures to safe levels.  Activate to put ear muffs into a standby position, letting you clearly hear again.

use_action.msg: You put the ear muffs away from your ears.

ballistic_mandible_guard.name: ballistic mandible guard
ballistic_mandible_guard.description: A ballistic jaw guard designed to be attached on a military helmet, but easily adjustable to helmets with any kind of rail system installed.

plastic_mandible_guard.name: plastic mandible guard
plastic_mandible_guard.description: A plastic jaw guard designed to be strapped to any common hard hat or helmet, it was probably part of some costume before the world ended.

plastic_chin_guard.name: plastic chin guard
plastic_chin_guard.description: A common plastic chin guard designed to be attached to the straps of any common hard hat or helmet.

counterweight_pouch.name: counterweight pouch
counterweight_pouch.description: A counterweight pouch attachable to the back of a hard hat or helmet to balance the weight on your head.  You can store batteries or some other very small items in it.

sun_shield.name: sun shield
sun_shield.description: A common sun shield intended to be put over a hard hat to protect the user from the sun.

shield_visor.name: shield visor
shield_visor.description: A common shield visor intended to be attached on a hard hat or helmet.

face_shield.name: face shield
face_shield.description: A thermoplastic face shield with a mounting bracket intended to be attached over a hard hat or helmet.

face_shield_eod.name: EOD face shield
face_shield_eod.description: A thick polycarbonate and plexiglass face shield with a mounting bracket intended to be attached to a ballistic helmet for protection from blast and fragmentation in 'non-permissive environments'.

face_shield_plastic.name: plastic face shield
face_shield_plastic.description: A plastic face shield with a mounting bracket intended to be attached over a hard hat or helmet.  It doesn't protects you as much as one made from thermoplastic, but it's cheaper and more common.

military_nvg.name: night vision goggles
military_nvg.description: Last generation double-tube night vision device, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  Currently raised up and out of the way.

military_nvg_on.name: night vision goggles (on)
military_nvg_on.description: Last generation single-tube night vision device, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  Limited field of view while activated.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

advanced_gpnvg.name: panoramic night vision goggles
advanced_gpnvg.description: Advanced GPNVG with four image intensifier tubes, allowing for a large field of view at night, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  Currently raised up and out of the way.

advanced_gpnvg_on.name: panoramic night vision goggles (on)
advanced_gpnvg_on.description: Advanced GPNVG with four image intensifier tubes, allowing for a large field of view at night, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

enhanced_nvg.name: enhanced night vision goggles
enhanced_nvg.description: New and rare high-resolution thermal NVG device, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  Lets you see in the dark, and detects heat signatures emitted by (un)living organisms.  Currently raised up and out of the way.

enhanced_nvg_on.name: enhanced night vision goggles (on)
enhanced_nvg_on.description: New and rare high-resolution thermal NVG device, designed to be mounted on a compatible helmet.  Lets you see in the dark, and detects heat signatures emitted by (un)living organisms.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

nape_protector.name: nape protector
nape_protector.description: A common nape protector intended to be attached on a hard hat or helmet to protect against the sun and dust.

mesh_nape_protector.name: mesh nape protector
mesh_nape_protector.description: A common mesh nape protector intended to be attached on a hard hat or helmet to protect against the sun while letting the cold wind refresh your nape.

kevlar_nape_protector.name: Kevlar nape protector
kevlar_nape_protector.description: A custom-made Kevlar strengthened nape protector intended to be attached on a hard hat or helmet to protect your nape against cuts and slashing attacks.

outsert_clear.name: clear outsert lens
outsert_clear.description: A simple and flexible transparent lens of plastic that clips into place over a panoramic gas mask's solitary eyepiece, providing extra protection from scratches, abrasions, and ballistic threats.

outsert_sunlight.name: sunlight outsert lens
outsert_sunlight.description: A tinted and flexible plastic outsert intended to be mounted over the eyepiece of a panoramic-view gas mask to protect the wearer from high-level UV light, sudden flashes, and overly bright flares.

outsert_breach.name: breach outsert lens
outsert_breach.description: A specialized lens designed to clip into place over the solitary eyepiece of a panoramic gas mask, providing eye protection to users deploying a cutting torch while also improving impact resistance.

insert_vision_correction.name: vision correction assembly
insert_vision_correction.description: A detachable frame of prescription lenses intended for installation behind a panoramic gas mask's visor, providing an alternative vision-correcting solution to users with inherent eye issues rather than contact lenses.

pot_helmet.name: pot helmet
pot_helmet.description: A helmet made from a soup pot.  It's not very good protection, but it's better than nothing.

stockpot_helmet.name: pot great helm
stockpot_helmet.description: An enclosed helmet made from a stock pot with a 'T' crudely carved into the front and a blanket stuffed inside to cushion it.  There are strings tied to the handles to help fasten it to your body, but it's extremely limiting and smothering.

headgear.name: headgear
headgear.description: Lightweight sports headgear designed to protect the head while sparring.

helmet_army.name: army helmet
helmet_army.description: A heavy helmet that provides excellent protection from all sorts of damage.  It is labeled as the advanced combat helmet.

helmet_army_stripped.description: A heavy helmet that provides excellent protection from all sorts of damage.  It is labeled as the advanced combat helmet.  This one has been stripped of all its mounting points, leaving only the nape and mandible attachment points, and the counterweight pouch.

helmet_army_outdated.name: flak helmet
helmet_army_outdated.description: A simple helmet meant to protect the head from fragmentation and impacts.  Its simple steel construction renders it outdated by modern military standards.

helmet_soviet_tanker.name: Soviet tanker helmet
helmet_soviet_tanker.description: A Soviet era tanker helmet.  It's distinctive foam pads are meant to protect a tank driver from bumps against the cramped interior.

tac_fullhelmet.name: tactical full helmet
tac_fullhelmet.description: An all-encompassing black helmet that covers your entire face and neck, providing excellent protection from all sorts of damage.

firehelmet.description: A distinctive helmet worn by firefighters.  More than just a piece of firefighting equipment, it serves as a badge of honor and respect.

helmet_ball.name: baseball helmet
helmet_ball.description: A hard plastic helmet that covers the head and ears.  Designed to protect against a baseball to the head.

helmet_aztec.name: eagle cuacalalatli
helmet_aztec.description: A hardwood Mesoamerican helmet that resembles the head of an eagle.  It was worn by the renowned eagle warriors of the Aztec, both ceremonially and for protection.  Its inside is lined with cotton, and it is ornamented with many feathers, carvings and colors.

helmet_barbute.name: barbute helm
helmet_barbute.description: A medieval helmet that provides excellent protection for the head, with a Y shaped opening for the face.

helmet_chitin.description: Chitin sections overlapping with each other secured to a leather backing in the shape of a hood.  The odd irregular shapes make full coverage impossible, not helped by how poor of a material chitin is.  Seems to be made more out of desperation than anything, and would benefit greatly from some underlying armor.

helmet_skull.description: The top part of a large wolf skull, equipped with leather straps to secure it on your head.  Every inch of the skull has been carved with a maze of fine, intertwined symbols that make your eyes water.

helmet_liner.name: helmet liner
helmet_liner.description: A cloth liner worn inside a helmet to help keep your head warm in cold climates.

helmet_motor.name: full-face motorcycle helmet
helmet_motor.description: A helmet that covers the entire head along with glareproof visors, offering the best protection for when you ride around on your motorcycle.  Activate to raise the visor.

helmet_motor_raised.description: A helmet that covers the entire head along with glareproof visors, offering the best protection when you ride around on your motorcycle.  The visor is raised.  Activate to put down the visor.

helmet_motor_modified.name: modified full-face motorcycle helmet
helmet_motor_modified.description: A helmet that covers the entire head, designed to protect you from motorcycle crashes.  This one has been modified to hold mounting brackets for stuff such as NV goggles, at the cost of removing the visor.

string_dimension_helmet_conical.name: lamba khud helm
string_dimension_helmet_conical.description: An unusual-looking conical helm.  The perfectly smooth steel cap covers the top of the head and the ears, forming a tall cone with a spike at the top.  Chainmail covers the rest of the head, leaving only the face open.  It is padded with a modern synthetic fabric.

helmet_sci_fi.name: lunar veil
helmet_sci_fi.description: A wide-brimmed helm anchoring a veil of faintly latticed cloth.  The metallic fibers diffuse light in soft gradients, dimming near the crescent-moon eye-slit.

use_action.msg: You lower the veil and bundle it about your throat.

helmet_sci_fi_lowered.name: lunar veil (lowered)
helmet_sci_fi_lowered.description: A wide-brimmed helm; the veil of faintly latticed cloth gathered into a crinkled scarf.  The metallic fibers diffuse light in soft gradients.

back_holster.name: back holster
back_holster.description: A leather holster, big enough for a rifle or other large gun.  Designed to be strapped to the back.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

baldric_holster.name: baldric holster
baldric_holster.description: A leather harness which can hold up to six pistol-sized guns in total, available for quick drawing.  Historically, similar harnesses were used by pirates to carry multiple loaded flintlock pistols at once, as reloading them is a lengthy process.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

bootstrap.name: ankle holster
bootstrap.description: A small concealed holster worn on the ankle.  Activate to holster/draw a small pistol.

bow_sling.name: bow sling
bow_sling.description: A somewhat complicated set of straps and fabric to keep your bow close to hand and (mostly) out of harm's way.  Activate to holster/draw your bow.

single_sling.name: single point sling
single_sling.description: A harness going over your shoulder and across your chest.  Designed to connect to a rifle at a single point with the rifle hanging off your front.  Great for fighting, not great for travel.  Activate to holster/draw your weapon.

holster.name: holster
holster.description: A leather strap worn on the hip for holding pistol-sized guns.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

nylon_holster.name: nylon holster
nylon_holster.description: Holster made from nylon, rather than leather.  A bit stronger and lighter, but not as fashionable.  Activate to draw/holster a gun.

western_holster.name: western gun belt
western_holster.description: A Western-style gun belt as worn by cowboys and gunfighters in the movies and on TV. Has loops across the back to hold spare ammo.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

sholster.name: fast draw holster
sholster.description: A comfortable quick-draw holster for small guns.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

shoulder_holster.name: shoulder holster
shoulder_holster.description: A comfortable quick-draw holster for larger pistols.  One side holsters a gun, and the other side holds two magazines.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

bholster.name: deep concealment holster
bholster.description: An elastic band with numerous provisions for concealing a very small pistol close to the body.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

bbholster.name: belly band holster
bbholster.description: A wide elastic belly belt with a built-in holster for a pistol and a spare magazine.  It is very awkward to use without practice.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

side_double_holster.name: side-by-side double holster
side_double_holster.description: Two holsters attached together by a strap, right next to each other.  The placement means that drawing guns out of either one is slower than a regular holster.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

FB_double_holster.name: front-to-back double holster
FB_double_holster.description: Two holsters attached together by a strap, one in front of the other.  The placement means that drawing a gun out of the front holster is slower than the other holster.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

side_nylon_double_holster.name: nylon side-by-side double holster
side_nylon_double_holster.description: Two nylon holsters attached together by a strap, right next to each other.  The placement means that drawing guns out of either one is slower than a regular holster.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

FB_nylon_double_holster.name: nylon front-to-back double holster
FB_nylon_double_holster.description: Two nylon holsters attached together by a strap, one in front of the other.  The placement means that drawing a gun out of the front holster is slower than the other holster.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

XL_holster.name: large holster
XL_holster.description: A belt holster consisting of a loop and strap intended for use with larger firearms.  Slightly more cumbersome than a standard holster due to the straps that hold it flat against your leg.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

XL_nylon_holster.name: large nylon holster
XL_nylon_holster.description: A belt holster consisting of a loop and strap intended for use with larger firearms, but made with nylon instead of leather.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

XS_holster.name: holster
XS_holster.description: A leather strap worn on the hip for holding pistol-sized guns.  Activate to holster/draw a gun.

XS_nylon_holster.name: nylon holster
XS_nylon_holster.description: Holster made from nylon, rather than leather.  A bit stronger and lighter, but not as fashionable.  Activate to draw/holster a gun.

nomex_hood.name: flame-resistant hood
nomex_hood.description: A snug fitting garment that protects your head and neck, made from lightweight Nomex fire-resistant fabric.  Tough yet breathable, it is light and comfortable to wear under clothing.

hood_gut.name: gutskin hood
hood_gut.description: A hood sewn from treated and split intestines, the perfect companion for a gutskin parka.

hood_ninja.name: ninja hood
hood_ninja.description: A black hood commonly used by ninja.

integrated_plantskin.name: phelloderm
integrated_plantskin.description: A pliable but hefty layer of living plant matter.

integrated_bark.name: protective bark
integrated_bark.description: A powerful layer of bark, thicker in parts.

integrated_bark2_a.name: distributed bark
integrated_bark2_a.description: Your bark is spread evenly across your body.

integrated_bark2_b.name: consolidated bark
integrated_bark2_b.description: Your bark is pulled together to protect your torso.

integrated_bark2_c.name: latticed bark
integrated_bark2_c.description: Your bark is latticed into a larger frame.

integrated_feathers.name: feathers
integrated_feathers.description: Iridescent feathers covering your entire body.  Provides some warmth and protection from the elements, but could be thicker.

integrated_lightfur.name: light fur
integrated_lightfur.description: Thin, patchy fur that clearly needs to grow more.

integrated_fur.name: fur
integrated_fur.description: Though it's quite warm, your fur is also quite protective.

integrated_ursine_fur.name: shaggy fur
integrated_ursine_fur.description: A heavy shag carpet of fur, somewhere between a ballistic vest and attic insulation.

integrated_ursine_fur_summer.name: scruffy fur
integrated_ursine_fur_summer.description: While still formidable, this furry hide has lost a lot of its bulk to better endure the summer months.

integrated_lupine_fur.name: gray fur
integrated_lupine_fur.description: The fur of a strong, wild creature.

integrated_lupine_fur_summer.name: summer coat
integrated_lupine_fur_summer.description: A covering of fur that has thinned out for the summer.

integrated_feline_fur.name: sleek fur
integrated_feline_fur.description: The fur of a proud, wise creature.

integrated_rabbitfur.name: rabbit fur
integrated_rabbitfur.description: Soft, fluffy fur for a soft, fluffy rabbit.

integrated_lynx_fur.name: lynx fur
integrated_lynx_fur.description: A pile of fur around the neck, protecting from foes that go for the throat.

integrated_patchskin1.name: jumbled skin
integrated_patchskin1.description: Skin like a spilled tub of paints, splattered in abstract shapes of chitin, fur, and hide.

integrated_patchskin2.name: patchwork skin
integrated_patchskin2.description: Beauty is only skin deep, but with this skin, a knife might find itself broken in the beauty layer.

integrated_patchskin3.name: patchwork armor
integrated_patchskin3.description: Folks that can't catch bullets with their skin insist that it's what's on the inside that counts.  Those folks don't know anything.

integrated_mandibles.name: mandibles
integrated_mandibles.description: These are much better than puny human mouthparts.

integrated_fangs_spider.name: folding fangs
integrated_fangs_spider.description: Your fangs have properly developed, and are prepared for the kill.

integrated_chitin.name: epicuticle
integrated_chitin.description: Your chitinous skin doesn't sweat so well and it's a bit stiffer than before, but it's far more durable than your old human skin.

integrated_chitin2.name: chitin carapace
integrated_chitin2.description: The skin hardens, develops.  Good, it will be needed.

integrated_chitin2_molted.name: fresh chitin carapace
integrated_chitin2_molted.description: The exoskeleton is soft and vulnerable.  It would be best to hide until it hardens.

integrated_chitin3.name: sclerotin plate
integrated_chitin3.description: When the time comes to prey, this platemail will be ready for any resistance.

integrated_chitin3_molted.name: fresh sclerotin plate
integrated_chitin3_molted.description: The exoskeleton is weak, it will require more time to harden.

integrated_chitin3_claws.name: sclerotin claws
integrated_chitin3_claws.description: Useful for the hunt, suitable for maximum efficiency.

integrated_carapace.name: sclerotin carapace
integrated_carapace.description: When the time comes to prey, this unwavering carapace will keep you safe from everything that could harm you.

integrated_carapace_molted.name: fresh sclerotin carapace
integrated_carapace_molted.description: This recently-molted carapace is still soft, and will need time to harden before it provides proper protection.

integrated_shell.name: shell
integrated_shell.description: You have a large, protective shell on your back, but unfortunately, it doesn't have enough space to fit inside or store anything, makes wearing anything on your torso impossible, and makes backpacks encumbering.

integrated_shell2.name: roomy shell
integrated_shell2.description: Your shell has grown larger and thicker.  You can hide yourself in it, as well as use it as a backpack, but torso armor is still off limits.

integrated_shell3.name: nacreous shell
integrated_shell3.description: Your shell has grown larger and even thicker, and has a pearly sheen to it.  You can hide yourself in it, as well as use it as a backpack, but torso armor is still off limits.

integrated_sparse_scales.name: sparse scales
integrated_sparse_scales.description: Your dermis has toughened and started to grow scales in places.

integrated_scales.name: scales
integrated_scales.description: Your scales have grown thicker and cover most of your body, providing solid armor.

integrated_fishscales.name: sleek scales
integrated_fishscales.description: Your skin has become a smooth and elegant mesh of interlocking scales.

integrated_reptilescales.name: thick scales
integrated_reptilescales.description: Leathery and heavily armored, your lamellar skin has toughened for the fiercest battles ahead.

armor_bio_eyes.name: protective lenses
armor_bio_eyes.description: Highly protective lenses which seal off your eyes from danger, routing your tear ducts to your mouth.

integrated_claws.name: claws
integrated_claws.description: You have long, sharp claws at the tips of your fingers.

integrated_claws_rat.name: gnarled claws
integrated_claws_rat.description: Your fingernails have become gnarled, twisted claws.

integrated_claws_st.name: stainless claws
integrated_claws_st.description: Your claws have toughened to become something akin to miniature butcher knives.

integrated_talons.name: talons
integrated_talons.description: Your index fingers have become talons.  They make for wicked natural daggers.  Unfortunately, they get in the way of everything including gloves.

integrated_fangs.name: fangs
integrated_fangs.description: A pair of fangs sharp and sturdy enough to use in combat.

integrated_saber_teeth.name: saber teeth
integrated_saber_teeth.description: A pair of enormous teeth, hanging over your lip, dagger-sharp and more than sturdy enough to use in combat.

integrated_shark_teeth.name: shark teeth
integrated_shark_teeth.description: A set of razor-sharp shark teeth.

integrated_vampire_fangs.name: vampire fangs
integrated_vampire_fangs.description: A wicked pair of fangs, pointed and surgically sharp.

integrated_toe_talons.name: talons
integrated_toe_talons.description: Your toes have become talons.  They make wicked natural daggers, allowing for damaging kick attacks.  Unfortunately, they get in the way of everything including shoes.

integrated_horns_small.name: horns
integrated_horns_small.description: You have a set of small horns.

integrated_horns_curled.name: curled horns
integrated_horns_curled.description: You have a set of curling horns, like those of a ram.

integrated_horns_pointed.name: pointed horns
integrated_horns_pointed.description: You have a set of long pointed horns, like those of a antelope.

integrated_antlers.name: antlers
integrated_antlers.description: You have a majestic crown of antlers, like those of a deer or moose.

integrated_interstice_aura.name: Penumbral Interstitium
integrated_interstice_aura.description: Your cells operate under different rules.  While you still need to breathe, you are otherwise extremely resistant to the thermal and chemical insults of the so-called universe.

internal_bio_purifier.name: Air Filtration System
internal_bio_purifier.description: Surgically implanted in your trachea is an advanced filtration system.  If toxins or airborne diseases find their way into your windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.

item_portal_storm_dimension_returner.name: fragment of reality
item_portal_storm_dimension_returner.description: You can leave this place, if you want.  Focus on the world you left behind in the storm.

bead_bracelet.name: beaded bracelet
bead_bracelet.description: A simple bracelet of string and wooden beads.  Also doubles as a set of prayer beads, if you're so inclined.

bead_ear.name: beaded earrings (pair)
bead_ear.description: A simple pair of earrings made of string and wooden beads.

bead_necklace.name: beaded necklace
bead_necklace.description: A simple necklace made of string and wooden beads.  Also doubles as a set of prayer beads, if you're so inclined.

bracelet_friendship.name: friendship bracelet
bracelet_friendship.description: A homemade bracelet crafted from colorful knickknacks.  It's not very expensive, but it's the effort that makes it special.

bronze_medal.name: bronze medal
bronze_medal.description: A medal awarded for achieving third place in some event.  It might be worth something if it was made of bronze; this one is made from brass.

cowrie_bracelet.name: cowrie bracelet
cowrie_bracelet.description: A bracelet made of cowrie shells, valued in many African cultures such as the Yoruba.  If you want, you could meditate with this.

cowrie_hair_beads.name: cowrie hair beads
cowrie_hair_beads.description: An assortment of cowrie shells used to decorate locs or braids.

cowrie_necklace.name: cowrie necklace
cowrie_necklace.description: A necklace made of cowrie shells, valued in many African cultures such as the Yoruba.  If you want, you could meditate with this.

diamond_dental_grill.description: Fake teeth inlaid with diamonds, worn over the teeth.  Fits horribly, but looks very shiny.  For that high-class gangsta rap look.

gold_medal.name: gold medal
gold_medal.description: A medal awarded for achieving first place in some event.  Before everything fell apart, this was likely a source of great pride for its owner.  Now it's just another shiny bauble.

service_medal.name: service medal
service_medal.description: A medal awarded to military personnel for heroism, wounds suffered in combat, or distinguished service.

gold_watch.name: gold watch
gold_watch.description: A gold-plated steel self-winding wristwatch, suitable for a retirement present.  Tells the time and looks good.

tieclip.name: tie clip
tieclip.description: A fancy silver tie clip, a great match for a necktie.

silver_watch.name: silver watch
silver_watch.description: An elegant silver watch, crafted from silver-plated stainless steel.  It's much cheaper than other metal watches, but more classy than an ordinary wristwatch.

silver_ear.name: silver earrings (pair)
silver_ear.description: A pair of beautiful silver earrings.

sf_watch.name: fancy watch
sf_watch.description: A rather large and expensively-made wristwatch.  Tells the time in elegantly wrought gold with silver detailing.  It's really the only timepiece suitable for someone of your exquisitely discerning tastes.

small_relic.name: small relic
small_relic.description: A small relic from a forgotten saint.  As extraordinary as the world has become, it may have some power yet.

wooden_hair_beads.name: wooden hair beads
wooden_hair_beads.description: An assortment of wooden beads used to decorate locs or braids.

holy_symbol.name: holy symbol
holy_symbol.description: A necklace made of fine gold chain, bearing the symbol of a forgotten faith.

holy_symbol_wood.name: handmade holy symbol
holy_symbol_wood.description: A simple necklace representing a religious faith.

jade_brooch.name: jade brooch
jade_brooch.description: A hand-crafted jade brooch of Oriental origin.

pearl_collar.name: pearl collar
pearl_collar.description: A collar made from round and lustrous pearls; its former owner must have been a wealthy individual.

platinum_watch.name: platinum watch
platinum_watch.description: Flex on those gold-watch wearers with this rare, expensive, and superior platinum watch.  This one is made from solid platinum.

platinum_dental_grill.name: platinum dental grill
platinum_dental_grill.description: Fake platinum-and-silver teeth.  They may be cheaper than fake gold teeth, but they're much more rare.  Fits horribly, but looks very shiny.

platinum_ear.name: platinum earrings (pair)
platinum_ear.description: A pair of plain platinum earrings - if gold is getting boring, just use another rare metal.

platinum_hairpin.name: platinum hairpin
platinum_hairpin.description: The ultimate in esoteric, metal hair accessories, this hairpin is made from pure platinum.

platinum_locket.name: platinum locket
platinum_locket.description: A small, platinum locket for storing photographs or other small objects.

platinum_necklace.name: platinum necklace
platinum_necklace.description: A platinum necklace, with a small, empty heart-shaped frame hanging from a chain.

platinum_ring.name: platinum ring
platinum_ring.description: A platinum ring, engraved with all manner of swirls and spirals.

ring_engagement.name: engagement ring
ring_engagement.description: This ring is an intricate gold band with a small cluster of diamonds set in the center.  Before the world broke down, this ring would've cost a small fortune.

ring_purity.name: purity ring
ring_purity.description: Also known as a promise ring, this ring is worn as a sign of chastity.  This one bears the inscription, "Love is patient."

ring_signet.name: signet ring
ring_signet.description: A gold and silver ring with a wide stamp attached to the band.  A long time ago, the stamp was legible, but now the pattern is too worn to discern its former use.

ring_wedding.name: wedding ring
ring_wedding.description: A flawless ring, ensnaring a diamond with twists of pure gold.  It's a constant reminder that the wearer is married.

silver_hairpin.name: silver hairpin
silver_hairpin.description: A shiny silver hairpin with a tiny bee engraved onto it.

silver_locket.name: silver locket
silver_locket.description: A small silver locket with a frame inside to store photographs or small objects.

pocket_data.description: Slot for a photograph

silver_medal.name: silver medal
silver_medal.description: A medal awarded for achieving second place in some event.  Before everything fell apart, this was likely a source of pride for its owner.  Now it's just another shiny bauble.

leather_collar.name: leather collar
leather_collar.description: A black leather 'collar' with a bell dangling from the front.  Don't worry, the bell is silent.

priest_collar.name: clerical collar
priest_collar.description: A white plastic collar worn by Christian clergymen (or women).  Although it is most commonly associated with Catholic Priests, it is also worn by Anglicans, Lutherans, Presbyterians, and Methodists.  It represents the belief that the wearer is eternally bound in service to God

wristwatch.name: wrist watch
wristwatch.description: A simple wristwatch on a plastic band.  Tells the time and has an alarm clock feature.

rad_badge.name: radiation badge
rad_badge.description: A plastic badge with an embedded filmstrip.  The text on the badge says the filmstrip changes color as it is exposed to radiation, and never goes back to how it initially looked.  Wear on your lapel so you can notice if it changes.

badge_deputy.name: deputy badge
badge_deputy.description: A tarnished silver star gives an air of authority to the wearer.

badge_detective.name: detective badge
badge_detective.description: A tarnished golden shield gives an air of authority to the wearer.

badge_marshal.name: marshal badge
badge_marshal.description: A bright silver star strikes fear into the eyes of ne'er-do-wells.

badge_swat.name: SWAT badge
badge_swat.description: A matte-finish silver shield identifies the wearer as an authority who goes in when the cops just aren't enough.

badge_fbi.name: FBI badge
badge_fbi.description: A gold-filled brass shield with an eagle perched atop it and Lady Justice emblazoned on its center.  In large, engraved lettering it reads, "FEDERAL BUREAU OF INVESTIGATION-US DEPARTMENT OF JUSTICE".  It identifies the wearer as an agent with federal authority throughout all the United States and her territories; that is, whatever is left of them.

badge_doctor.name: doctor badge
badge_doctor.description: A plastic name tag marking the wearer as a real doctor of the medical kind.

badge_foodkid.name: Foodkid badge
badge_foodkid.description: A star-shaped plastic badge.  "Foodkid" is printed on it in bold letters.  This badge marks its wearer as Foodperson's trusty sidekick, and comes included with every kid's meal at Foodplace.

pin_badge.name: pin
pin_badge.description: A small piece of metal with a pin, meant to affix itself to an article of clothing.  It's mainly used on jackets or backpacks, as a way to show off what bands you listen to, or other things like your pronouns.

simple_pistol_cartridge_necklace.description: A simple, if rather crude, piece of post-Cataclysm jewelry: a solitary bullet casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition strung upon a length of string, cord, or twine to form a makeshift pendant.

snippet_category.text: A simple, if rather crude, piece of post-Cataclysm jewelry: a solitary bullet casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition strung upon a length of string, cord, or twine to form a makeshift pendant.  The shell's neck has been daintily drilled through with two tiny holes on opposite sides, through which the cord has been fed and tied off to form a poor man's excuse for a chain, and from where the cartridge hangs, dimpled primer-down.

A simple, if rather crude, piece of post-Cataclysm jewelry: a solitary bullet casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition strung upon a length of string, cord, or twine to form a makeshift pendant.  The dimpled section of the shell's primer has been punched out, and a second hole has been drilled through the casing's side just shy of the base, with the ballistic accoutrement hanging from a section of tied-off cord that has been threaded through both entry points.

A simple, if rather crude, piece of post-Cataclysm jewelry: a solitary bullet casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition strung upon a length of string, cord, or twine to form a makeshift pendant.  The shell's throat has been twisted closed by a set of pliers, creating a spiraled taper where the neck would be, while a hole has been drilled on opposite hemispheres of the pendant's sides, through which a length of string has been threaded.  The cord's loose ends have been wrapped several times around the casing before being tied off, forming a sort of little bullet cocoon.

fancy_pistol_cartridge_necklace.name: refined pistol-cartridge necklace
fancy_pistol_cartridge_necklace.description: The product of a gun nut and a fashionista proverbially shaking one another's hand, this plain, though elegant, necklace has been strung with a solitary, sparklingly polished casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition.

snippet_category.text: The product of a gun nut and a fashionista proverbially shaking one another's hand, this plain, though elegant, necklace has been strung with a solitary, sparklingly polished casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition.  The shell's primer and rim have been neatly sawed away, and in place of the projectile, a little gemstone has been wrapped with a length of fine-gauge wire and bedded into the casing's throat.  The rest of the wire's length trails back through the cartridge's body, feeding out the base and entwining with a link in the chain.

The product of a gun nut and a fashionista proverbially shaking one another's hand, this plain, though elegant, necklace has been strung with a solitary, sparklingly polished casing from a handgun cartridge or other such form of ammunition.  The teeth of a saw have been put to work upon this shell, whose base and primer have been neatly cut away, and in the throat of which has been seated a small, shining gem.  A length of fine wire has been tightly wrapped around both the cartridge and gemstone in a top-down pattern, with the cord's loose ends eventually tugged through a small drill hole at the cartridge's base and finally wrapped among the neck chain's links.

fancy_rifle_cartridge_necklace.name: refined rifle-cartridge necklace
fancy_rifle_cartridge_necklace.description: A gentlemanly article of craft-produced jewelry for the most spiffy ladies and gentlemen of the post-apocalypse, this plain chain of precious metal has been retrofitted with a fired rifle cartridge that hangs from it as a pendant.

snippet_category.text: A gentlemanly article of craft-produced jewelry for the most spiffy ladies and gentlemen of the post-apocalypse, this plain chain of precious metal has been retrofitted with a fired rifle cartridge that hangs from it as a pendant.  With its brass polished to a mirror-like sheen, the shell's primer and rim have been neatly extricated at the edge of a saw, with a little gemstone peeking out the casing's throat.  The gem's wrapped within the embrace of a length of fine-gauge wire, whose remaining length has been tugged back through the cartridge's body, fed out the base, and entwined with a link in the chain.

A length of wire is tightly wrapped around both cartridge and gemstone in a top-down pattern, forming an X-grid as it wines, with the cord's loose ends trailing through a small drill hole at the cartridge's base and tied to the chain's links.

fancy_ordinance_cartridge_necklace.name: refined ordnance-cartridge necklace
fancy_ordinance_cartridge_necklace.description: An article of hand-produced apparel that George Washington himself could look down upon with an approving smile, the daintiness of this necklace's precious metal chain looks rather comical when compared against the gargantuan pendant that hangs from it: an expended casing from a grenade round, shotgun cartridge, or some other form of sizable munition.

snippet_category.text: An article of hand-produced apparel that George Washington himself could look down upon with an approving smile, the daintiness of this necklace's precious metal chain looks rather comical when compared against the gargantuan pendant that hangs from it: an expended casing from a grenade round, shotgun cartridge, or some other form of sizable munition.  With its brass polished to a mirror-like sheen and its rim cleanly extricated by the saw, a well-sized gemstone peers at the world from out of this shell's throat.  The jewel's wrapped within a length of fine-gauge wire, whose remaining length has been tugged through the cartridge's body, fed out the base, and entwined with a link in the chain.

An article of hand-produced apparel that George Washington himself could look down upon with an approving smile, the daintiness of this necklace's precious metal chain looks rather comical when compared against the gargantuan pendant that hangs from it: an expended casing from a grenade round, shotgun cartridge, or some other form of sizable munition.  The shell has, essentially, been rendered into a tiny brass pipe: its base and primer are neatly sawed off, and its head is capped by a large, glittering gemstone that regards the Cataclysm from its seat within the throat.  A length of wire is tightly wrapped around both the cartridge and jewel, with the cord's loose ends trailing through a small drill hole at the shell's base and linked to the neck chain.

A stylish pair of bleached denim jeans.
A pair of old baggy jeans.  The heels are all ripped up.

jeans_ripped.name: ripped jeans
jeans_ripped.description: A pair of jeans that has been ripped over the knees.  It may have been fashionable before Cataclysm, but it's just a pair of sub-par jeans now.

jeans_vintage.name: vintage jeans
jeans_vintage.description: A pair of vintage jeans that has started to lose its color.  It appears to be slightly heavier and thicker; but hey, don't let that stop you from wearing the fashion of the olden days!

snippet_category.text: A pair of vintage jeans that has been around for so long that very little remains of its once vibrant blue color.  Otherwise it's surprisingly well preserved though.
A very old pair of black vintage jeans.  From paint marks here and there you assume this belonged to a painter.
A groovy pair of stone washed denim jeans from the 80s.  It gets baggy around the ankles.  Perfect for pretending as if Cataclysm never happened and you are on your way to dance floor.

A pair of vintage blue jeans that has been preserved perfectly.  You can see the leather brand on its behind of company that hasn't been around for a long while, even before the Cataclysm.  This would have made a fortune if; well, you know, it wasn't apocalypse.

A few of the fibers are more gold than others, giving it a barely perceptible hex pattern.  The textile bilayer is filled with liquid, giving it a squishy, cool-to-the-touch bodyfeel.

clown_wig.name: clown wig

phase_immersion_suit.name: phase immersion suit
phase_immersion_suit.description: Covered in interlocking plates of reflective metal, this advanced suit resembles both plate armor and an astronaut's spacesuit.  Designed to protect its wearer during extradimensional excursions, it offers unparalleled environmental protection, both in this Earth and beyond.  Use it to turn it on.

phase_immersion_suit_on.description: Covered in interlocking plates of reflective metal, this advanced suit resembles both plate armor and an astronaut's spacesuit.  It is turned on, and continually draining power.  Use it to turn it off.

phase_immersion_helmet.name: phase immersion helmet
phase_immersion_helmet.description: This advanced headpiece resembles an astronaut's helmet.  Designed to protect its wearer during extradimensional excursions, it offers unparalleled environmental protection, both in this Earth and beyond.  It has tubes to connect to a powered air-purifying respirator (PAPR), and a regulator to connect to an external air source (such as a SCUBA tank).

Activate it to lower the face shield.

phase_immersion_helmet_scba_on.name: phase immersion helmet (SCBA)
phase_immersion_helmet_scba_on.description: This advanced headpiece resembles an astronaut's helmet.  Designed to protect its wearer during extradimensional excursions, it offers unparalleled environmental protection, both in this Earth and beyond.  Its SCBA system is currently engaged.  Activate it to turn it off.

phase_immersion_cca.name: phase immersion CCA
phase_immersion_cca.description: A DARPA Communications Carrier Assembly - a bundle of electronics, including a battery, microphone, headphones with active noise suppression, and slimmed down ground panoramic night vision goggles.  The assembly cannot be worn on its own - it must be attached to an appropriate helmet.  Activate it to turn it on.

robofac_armor_rig.name: Hub 01 modular defense system
robofac_armor_rig.description: A custom-designed poncho for the true frontier explorer, made with aramid fibers and robust ripstop nylon.  Striped in brown and blue, the white seal of Hub 01 is emblazoned proudly on the front.  It features several quick access pouches attached to a waist drawstring, and two waterproof dry bags for carrying liquids.  It also features several tight clamps and velcro strips around the waist and shoulders; perhaps something attaches to them.

robofac_armor_anchor.name: Hub 01 modular defense anchor
robofac_armor_anchor.description: A custom-designed poncho for the true frontier explorer, made with aramid fibers and robust ripstop nylon.  This one features a hardened skeleton of ceramic plates running up and over the shoulders, and a portion of the front has been raised upwards from the rest.  Lifting the fabric reveals a large disc-shaped device installed into the garment, featureless except for a prominent switch and Hub 01's logo in LED.  In addition to the poncho's usual complement of storage, a battery compartment has been added that wires into this device, featuring very specialized connectors and, perhaps a little disconcertingly, radiation shielding.

robofac_head_rig.name: Hub 01 modular recon headgear
robofac_head_rig.description: Heavy duty hooded headwear for the true frontier explorer, made with robust Nylon sheeting reinforced with Kevlar fibers.  The top consists of a series of plastic plates with hooks and velcro strips, perhaps for attaching additional parts.  On the forehead of the assembly is a bulky box visor on a mechanism to quickly pull it down over your eyes, with a cover on the side to insert standard batteries.  Activate to lower the visor and use the light amplification functions.

use_action.msg: You lower the visor and flick the control dial to light amplification mode.

robofac_head_rig_nv.name: Hub 01 modular recon headgear (NV+IR)
robofac_head_rig_nv.description: Heavy duty hooded headwear for the true frontier explorer.  The visor has been lowered over the eyes, and is drawing low power to provide light amplification by way of an infrared illuminator and detector.  Lets you see in the dark, and detects heat signatures emitted by (un)living organisms.  Activate again to turn off and stow the visor.

use_action.msg: You flick the visor off, and push it off your face.

robofac_head_rig_ar.name: Hub 01 visual augmentation headgear
robofac_head_rig_ar.description: Heavy duty hooded headwear for the true frontier explorer, made with robust Nylon sheeting reinforced with Kevlar fibers.  The top consists of a series of plastic plates with hooks and velcro strips, perhaps for attaching additional parts, and an integrated camera array.  A multi-faceted augmented reality headset rests of the forehead like a pair of slim, boxy ski goggles, with side plugs for auxiliary devices.  The AR lenses are equipped with adaptive light correction, light amplification and thermal imaging, and an augmented reality overlay equipped with various gadgets, including a rangefinder and adaptive targeting system, making target acquisition quicker.  Activate it to turn on all systems.

robofac_basic_mantle.name: Hub 01 prototype mantle
robofac_basic_mantle.description: 3D printed armor for the upper body, made of thick and pliable polymer with metallic fibers for reinforcement.  Several buckles and straps allow it to be adjusted to fit you comfortably.  Despite its rough finish, it's clear that a lot of thought has gone into the ergonomics and weight.  Designed to clip to the chest and shoulders, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".

robofac_rubber_mantle.name: Hub 01 kinetic mantle
robofac_rubber_mantle.description: 3D printed armor for the upper body, made of thick and pliable polymer with metallic fibers for reinforcement.  This model incorporates a rubber coating that diffuses impacts and provides excellent protection from blunt trauma, even if it does feel a bit like a rain coat.  Designed to clip to the chest and shoulders, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".

robofac_nomex_mantle.name: Hub 01 turnout mantle
robofac_nomex_mantle.description: 3D printed armor for the upper body, made of thick and pliable polymer with metallic fibers for reinforcement.  This model features heat-resistant materials in the construction, providing protection from extreme heat without sacrificing its overall performance.  Designed to clip to the chest and shoulders, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".

robofac_kevlar_mantle.name: Hub 01 ballistic mantle
robofac_kevlar_mantle.description: 3D printed armor for the upper body, made of thick and pliable polymer with metallic fibers for reinforcement.  Thanks to a slim under-layer of synthetic fibers, it provides fantastic defense from small-arms fire, and could take the edge off of a rifle bullet, too.  Designed to clip to the chest and shoulders, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".

robofac_military_mantle.name: Hub 01 soldier mantle
robofac_military_mantle.description: 3D printed armor for the upper body, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  Made of extremely tough UHMW polyethylene combined with treated aramid fabric, it provides military-grade defense against zombies, bullets, zombies with bullets, and plenty of other things that the Cataclysm can throw at you.  Designed to clip to the chest and shoulders, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".

robofac_basic_skirt.name: Hub 01 prototype skirt
robofac_basic_skirt.description: 3D printed armor for the thighs and knees, consisting of a skirt made of segmented armor plates.  It features a simple integrated belt to let it fit any waist size.  Despite its rough finish, it's clear that a lot of thought has gone into the ergonomics and weight.  Designed to clip to the waist, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".

robofac_rubber_skirt.name: Hub 01 kinetic skirt
robofac_rubber_skirt.description: 3D printed armor for the thighs and knees, consisting of a skirt made of segmented armor plates.  This model resembles scale armor, and provides excellent protection from blunt trauma.  Designed to clip to the waist, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".

robofac_nomex_skirt.name: Hub 01 turnout skirt
robofac_nomex_skirt.description: 3D printed armor for the thighs and knees, consisting of a skirt made of segmented armor plates.  This version incorporates tight-fitting leggings that provide some protection from extreme heat.  Designed to clip to the waist, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".

robofac_kevlar_skirt.name: Hub 01 ballistic skirt
robofac_kevlar_skirt.description: 3D printed armor for the thighs and knees, consisting of a skirt made of segmented armor plates.  It includes a reinforcing layer of aramid fabric in addition to leg sleeves made of high-strength material, protecting your sensitive bits from small-arms fire.  Designed to clip to the waist, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".

robofac_military_skirt.name: Hub 01 soldier skirt
robofac_military_skirt.description: 3D printed armor for the thighs and knees, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  Composed of segmented polyethylene armor plates featuring a dense metal core sandwiched between layers of composite-grade aramid fabric, it provides excellent protection for the upper legs to ensure that you'll stay on your feet when it really matters.  Designed to clip to the waist, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR DEFENSE SYSTEM".

robofac_basic_vambraces.name: Hub 01 prototype vambraces (pair)
robofac_basic_vambraces.description: 3D printed arm guards, made of large and flexible polymer sheets wrapped around the forearm.  The end of each sheet features a clip and drawstring, to fit the armor to any size.  Despite the rough finish, it fits securely, and feels quite comfortable.

robofac_rubber_vambraces.name: Hub 01 kinetic vambraces (pair)
robofac_rubber_vambraces.description: 3D printed arm guards, made of large and flexible polymer sheets wrapped around the forearm.  These ones are built in an overlapping pattern that diffuses impacts and provides excellent protection from blunt trauma.

robofac_nomex_vambraces.name: Hub 01 turnout vambraces (pair)
robofac_nomex_vambraces.description: 3D printed arm guards, made of large and flexible polymer sheets wrapped around the forearm.  These ones include Nomex sleeves to protect your arms from extreme heat.

robofac_kevlar_vambraces.name: Hub 01 ballistic vambraces (pair)
robofac_kevlar_vambraces.description: 3D printed arm guards, made of large and flexible polymer sheets wrapped around the forearm.  These ones include aramid arm sleeves that do a great job of slowing down bullets and preventing them from shredding your arms.

robofac_military_vambraces.name: Hub 01 soldier vambraces (pair)
robofac_military_vambraces.description: 3D printed arm guards, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  With thick bullet-resistant arm sleeves, flexible but extremely tough thermoplastic plates, and special attention given to areas reflexively used to protect the face from attacks, it provides first-rate protection against all the horrors that the apocalypse has brought to bear.

robofac_basic_greaves.name: Hub 01 prototype greaves (pair)
robofac_basic_greaves.description: 3D printed leg guards, consisting of thick knee pads and a pair of large, flexible polymer plates for securing around the calves to protect the tibias of each leg.  Two straps on each plate can be tightened or loosened to fit different leg sizes.  Despite the rough finish, it doesn't impede your movement, and fits comfortably against your body.

robofac_rubber_greaves.name: Hub 01 kinetic greaves (pair)
robofac_rubber_greaves.description: 3D printed leg guards, consisting of thick knee pads and a pair of large, flexible polymer plates for securing around the calves to protect the tibias of each leg.  Thick padding and rubber lining provide excellent protection from blunt trauma.

robofac_nomex_greaves.name: Hub 01 turnout greaves (pair)
robofac_nomex_greaves.description: 3D printed leg guards, consisting of thick knee pads and a pair of large, flexible polymer plates for securing around the calves to protect the tibias of each leg.  Heat-resistant leg sleeves and a breathable design provide adequate protection from extreme heat without sacrificing your mobility or core protection.

robofac_kevlar_greaves.name: Hub 01 ballistic greaves (pair)
robofac_kevlar_greaves.description: 3D printed leg guards, consisting of thick knee pads and a pair of large, flexible polymer plates for securing around the calves to protect the tibias of each leg.  This model features leggings made of durable aramid and a reinforced plate design; combined, they do a good job of mitigating damage from small-arms fire.

robofac_military_greaves.name: Hub 01 soldier greaves (pair)
robofac_military_greaves.description: 3D printed leg guards, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  Layered UHMW thermoplastic plates and bullet-resistant aramid padding combine to keep your lower leg bones protected and unbroken, even when knee-deep in the dead.

robofac_basic_helmet.name: Hub 01 prototype helmet
robofac_basic_helmet.description: 3D printed armor for the head, made of thick polymer plates woven with metallic fibers.  Despite its rough finish, it's clear that a lot of thought has gone into the ergonomics and weight.  Designed to clip to some kind of attachment point, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR HEADGEAR".

robofac_rubber_helmet.name: Hub 01 kinetic helmet
robofac_rubber_helmet.description: 3D printed armor for the head, made of thick polymer plates woven with metallic fibers.  This model is covered in countless rubber hexagons, and offers superior protection against blunt trauma.  Designed to clip to some kind of attachment point, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR HEADGEAR".

robofac_nomex_helmet.name: Hub 01 turnout helmet
robofac_nomex_helmet.description: 3D printed armor for the head, made of thick polymer plates woven with metallic fibers.  This version incorporates a tight fitting Nomex layer for some protection against heat.  Designed to clip to some kind of attachment point, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR HEADGEAR".

robofac_kevlar_helmet.name: Hub 01 ballistic helmet
robofac_kevlar_helmet.description: 3D printed armor for the head, made of thick polymer plates woven with metallic fibers.  This one has extra Kevlar and steel layering, to provide superior protection against small arms.  Designed to clip to some kind of attachment point, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR HEADGEAR".

robofac_military_helmet.name: Hub 01 soldier helmet
robofac_military_helmet.description: 3D printed armor for the head, sporting a professional finish and stellar ergonomics.  Composed of a dense metal shell sandwiched between layers of composite-grade aramid fabric, it provides excellent protection, ensuring you'll keep your head against whatever the Cataclysm throws at you.  Designed to clip to some kind of attachment point, its interior reads "ATTACH TO MODULAR HEADGEAR".

hub_meteorology_pack.name: Hub 01 hazardous meteorology pack
hub_meteorology_pack.description: A 3D printed pack frame for the true frontier explorer.  While this resembles a standard military or hiking pack frame, this one appears to be made entirely of lightweight plastics and artificial fabrics.  This cumbersome contraption eschews the modular nature of standard frame packs in favor of ergonomic, pre-fabricated attachment points.  The back of the frame is a thin, solid piece with a slot labeled "SOLAR PANEL".  The base of the frame has two custom-fit slots labeled "UPS" and "WORKSTATION".  Hanging from the bottom are two wide loops labeled "TENT" and "ROLLMAT".  The frame itself has several large clips, each labeled with "HEW SYSTEM" in small text.  The pack is secured by shoulder straps - the left shoulder strap proudly displays the Hub 01 logo, while the right strap has "HE" sewn in bright white letters.

robofac_poncho_liner.name: Hub 01 MPET poncho liner
robofac_poncho_liner.description: Often called a "woobie" by soldiers, this sleeping bag-like poncho liner can be attached under a poncho or used as a blanket.  This one is made of space-age metallized polyethylene terephthalate, or MPET, the same reflective material used on spacecraft, spacesuits, emergency blankets, and mundane food packaging.  The Hub 01 logo is stamped on one corner.  It folds into a very compact form when not in use.

robofac_lens_helmet.name: Hub 01 LENS helmet
robofac_lens_helmet.description: The Low-latency ExoNeural Sensory helmet, also known as the LENS - headgear for the true frontier cyborg.  Somewhat resembling a sleek and reflective fighter pilot's helmet, this combat headgear completely shields the head, eyes, and ears, totally obscuring vision and deafening the wearer.  While the nose and mouth are uncovered, the helmet is mounted with clips for accessory masks.  If powered by batteries and connected to a compatible LENS cybernetic implant, the user's nervous system can directly interface with external cameras dotting the headgear, providing a full field of view, and all of the benefits of more common consumer and military AR systems, including adaptive light correction, light amplification and thermal imaging, and an HUD equipped with various gadgets, including a rangefinder and adaptive targeting system, making target acquisition quicker.  Activate it to toggle power.
