robofac_lens_mask_bal.name: Hub 01 LENS ballistic mask
robofac_lens_mask_bal.description: A ballistic mask with many tiny vents holes, designed to form a tight seal with a Hub 01 LENS helmet.  Warm and cumbersome, but very protective.

robofac_lens_mask_filter.name: Hub 01 LENS filter mask
robofac_lens_mask_filter.description: A ballistic mask with a built-in filter compartment, designed to form a tight seal with a Hub 01 LENS helmet.  Protects from smoke, dust, and other contaminants quite well.  It must be prepared before use.

robofac_lens_mask_gas.name: Hub 01 LENS CBRN mask
robofac_lens_mask_gas.description: A ballistic CBRN gas mask, designed to form a tight seal with a Hub 01 LENS helmet.  While it is warmer and harder to breath in than a standard or filtered LENS mask, if a filter canister's been screwed into the right-side filter port and the respirator's been prepared, it'll do an admirable job at preventing smoke, gas, and airborne contaminants from taking up residence in your organs.  It must be prepared before use.

robofac_lens_mask_papr.name: Hub 01 LENS PAPR mask
robofac_lens_mask_papr.description: A ballistic powered air purifying respirator mask, designed to form a tight seal with a Hub 01 LENS helmet.  Once activated it will comfortably protect against chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear threats.  Like a standard gas mask it must be prepared before use; unlike a standard gas mask, or any other LENS mask, easy airflow keeps it relatively cool and comfortable.  However, it will only function to filter air when paired with an active PAPR blower unit.

integrated_bio_robofac_xmleg.name: Hub 01 LEG exoskeleton
integrated_bio_robofac_xmleg.description: The Hub 01 Lower Extremity Gaitframe, or LEG, a powered exoskeleton for the true frontier cyborg.  A metal frame runs along each of the legs, with clasps for the hips, femurs, and knees, twisting at the lower leg into a metal plate with additional straps for the shin.  The frame covering the knee and lower leg has clips custom-fit for Hub 01 greaves, and there is a hip-mounted battery compartment.  When powered, you can move 15% faster, traverse obstacles with 50% higher efficiency, and carry 20kg of extra weight.  Unpowered, they are a significant burden.  Activate them to toggle power.  Requires an XM-LEG Interface bionic to function.

When powered, you can move 15% faster, traverse obstacles with 50% higher efficiency, and carry 20kg of extra weight.  Unpowered, they are a significant burden.  Activate them to toggle power.  Requires an XM-LEG Interface bionic to function.

integrated_bio_robofac_xmarm.name: Hub 01 ARM exoskeleton
integrated_bio_robofac_xmarm.description: The Hub 01 Arm Reinforcement Motionframe, or ARM, a powered exoskeleton for the true frontier cyborg.  A metal frame runs along each of your arms and hands, with several straps at critical joints, twisting at the wrist into a glove-like matrix of steel.  The frame has a battery compartment and the elbows and lower arms have clips custom-fit for Hub 01 vambraces.  When powered, your arms are exceptionally stable, reducing firearm recoil by 30% and shot dispersion by 10%.  Moreover, you have better control over thrown objects, allowing you to throw objects 50% further and 25% harder.  Unpowered, they are a significant burden.  Activate them to toggle power. slingpack.name: sling pack
slingpack.description: A simple single-sling backpack.  Easier to access than a normal backpack, but can't comfortably hold as much.

straw_basket.name: straw basket
straw_basket.description: A handmade straw basket.  Carry it with you for extra storage.

suitcase_l.name: suitcase
suitcase_l.description: A huge wheeled suitcase used mainly for transporting clothes and other possessions during trips, provides a decent amount of storage but hauling it around is neither fast nor comfortable.

suitcase_m.name: suitcase
suitcase_m.description: A mid-sized wheeled suitcase used mainly for transporting clothes and other possessions during trips, provides a decent amount of storage but hauling it around is not exactly comfortable.

swag_bag.name: swag bag
swag_bag.description: A large canvas sack, re-purposed for makeshift storage.  Goes well with a striped shirt and a domino mask.

travelpack.name: travelpack
travelpack.description: A hiking pack used for short trips.

vest.description: A light vest covered in pockets and straps for storage.

wicker_backpack.name: wicker backpack
wicker_backpack.description: A large handmade straw basket with a lid and shoulder straps to wear it like a backpack.  Less comfortable than a proper backpack, but will do the job.

debug_backpack.name: debug pocket universe
debug_backpack.description: A pocket universe.  Can store approximately 384 * 10^6 bugs.

use_action.description: Seems like it could calm local conditions.

rifle_case_soft.name: rifle case
rifle_case_soft.description: A long soft rifle case.  Provides storage for long arms and rifles.  Includes a small pocket, strap and handle.

rifle_case_soft_leather.name: leather rifle case
rifle_case_soft_leather.description: A long soft leather rifle case.  Provides storage for long arms and rifles.  Includes a small pocket, strap and handle.

rifle_case_soft_2.name: double rifle case
rifle_case_soft_2.description: A long soft rifle case.  Provides storage for 2 long arms and rifles.  Includes 3 accessory pockets and a strap.

rifle_case_soft_leather_2.name: leather double rifle case
rifle_case_soft_leather_2.description: A long soft leather rifle case.  Provides storage for 2 long arms and rifles.  Includes 3 accessory pockets and a strap.

rifle_case_xl_soft_leather.name: long leather rifle case
rifle_case_xl_soft_leather.description: An extra long soft leather rifle case.  Provides storage for long arms and rifles.  Includes a small pocket, strap and handle.

camera_bag.name: camera bag
camera_bag.description: A simple bag used to hold a camera, with a small pocket on the side for accessories.  Comes with a carry strap.

bookstrap.name: bookstrap
bookstrap.description: An old-fashioned book strap carrier.  Guaranteed to make you feel like a proper scholar.

rope_loop.name: loop of rope
rope_loop.description: A length of rope tied with a sliding knot into a loop.  You can slip all sorts of large objects in and carry them as a bundle; if you want to tie a single item more securely you'd have to disassemble this loop.  It takes a while to untie it and get things out, and attackers might pull the whole thing undone if you're not careful.

bigtrapper_pack.name: big trapper pack
bigtrapper_pack.description: A wooden frame with waterproofed cloth stretched around it, and a drawstring at the top to hold things in.  It has straps to wear it on your back.

trapper_pack.name: trapper pack
trapper_pack.description: An L-shaped wooden frame with a waterproofed cloth sack attached to it.  There's a drawstring to hold things in and straps to carry it on your back.

frame_pack.name: pack frame
frame_pack.description: An L-shaped wooden frame with straps to secure a large item to it.

bigframe_pack.name: big pack frame
bigframe_pack.description: A sturdy L-shaped wooden frame with leather straps to secure an oversized item to it.  It has straps to wear it on your back.

seabag.name: military seabag
seabag.description: A massive, watertight, olive drab duffel bag used to move soft goods like uniforms when being redeployed.  While it has straps to be worn like a backpack, it is extremely cumbersome to do so.

pocket_data.description: Tucked between your back and the seabag.

bondage_suit.name: bondage suit
bondage_suit.description: A suit of snug black leather.  Has no pockets, but does feature an abundance of unusually located zippers.

bodysuit_lycra.name: Lycra bodysuit
bodysuit_lycra.description: A tight-fitting bodysuit made of Lycra.  Covers the whole body from neck to toe.

clown_suit.name: clown suit
clown_suit.description: A colorful and ridiculous costume fit for a clown.  Provides decent storage.

denim_overalls.name: denim overalls
denim_overalls.description: The basic denim overalls that is the symbol of the Proletariat (and some hipsters).  It covers the legs and a large portion of the torso, secured around the shoulders with straps.  It has many pockets and is relatively protective.

flag_jumpsuit.name: flag jumpsuit
flag_jumpsuit.description: A jumpsuit embroidered with a pattern of the American flag.  Provides decent storage and is not very encumbering.

jumpsuit_pocketless.name: pocketless jumpsuit
jumpsuit_pocketless.description: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit without pockets, similar to those worn by prisoners.  Not very encumbering.

jumpsuit.name: jumpsuit
jumpsuit.description: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit similar to those worn by prisoners.  Provides decent storage and is not very encumbering.

jumpsuit_xl.name: jumpsuit
jumpsuit_xl.description: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit updated for the trans-human who needs full-body clothing.  Provides some storage and is adjustable to minimize encumbrance.

jumpsuit_xs.name: jumpsuit
jumpsuit_xs.description: A thin, short-sleeved jumpsuit similar to those worn by prisoners.  Provides decent storage and is not very encumbering.

jumpsuit_skeleton.name: skeleton jumpsuit
jumpsuit_skeleton.description: A black jumpsuit with a skeleton pattern printed on it.  It can be zipped all the way up to cover your head and face in a skull pattern too.  Use it to zip the head portion closed.

use_action.msg: You now have a skull as head.

jumpsuit_skeleton_zipped.name: skeleton jumpsuit (zipped)
jumpsuit_skeleton_zipped.description: A black jumpsuit with a skeleton pattern printed on it.  It covers all the way up to your head and displays a skull pattern over your face.  Use it to unzip the head portion.

use_action.msg: You facial skin is now visible.

mummy_jumpsuit.name: mummy jumpsuit
mummy_jumpsuit.description: An off-white jumpsuit printed to look like the tattered wrappings of an ancient mummy.  Very easy to move in, but it doesn't offer any type of protection.

technician_coveralls.name: work coveralls
technician_coveralls.description: A fully covering jumpsuit made of waterproof canvas.  Offers solid protection from everyday dangers on the job and plenty of storage pockets.

technician_coveralls_h.name: heavy work coveralls

union_suit.name: union suit
union_suit.description: A one-piece suit of full-body long underwear that helps to maintain body temperature.  It laces closed in the front.

fursuit.name: fursuit
fursuit.description: A full-body fursuit in the form of an anthropomorphic animal.  It is quite encumbering and has little storage but is very warm.

wool_suit.name: thick wool onesie
wool_suit.description: An encumbering wool suit covered in nice patterns.  It looks like full body armor but it only protects against cold, sadly.

wool_suit_devil.name: devil onesie
wool_suit_devil.description: An encumbering red wool suit with a hood adorned with cartoonish devil horns and a devil's tail on the back.  It's for those who want to feel devilishly warm in their sleep.

zentai.name: zentai
zentai.description: Short for 'zenshin taitsu', a zentai is a form-fitting full-body nylon and spandex garment.  Though it covers your face, you can see through the thin fabric.  With a couple of these and some friends, you could put on some kabuki or harass a rival sports team.

ski_bib.name: ski bib
ski_bib.description: A heavy, waterproof ski bib that covers the legs and torso.  It is made of a thick, durable material and is designed to keep the wearer warm in cold conditions, and includes a boot clip to keep snow out of your feet.  Activate them to unzip the front legs for ventilation and pull up the gaiters.

use_action.msg: You open vents in the legs of the snow bib.

ski_bib_unzipped.name: ski bib (unzipped)
ski_bib_unzipped.description: A heavy, waterproof ski bib that covers the legs and torso.  It is made of a thick, durable material and is designed to keep the wearer warm in cold conditions, and includes a boot clip to keep snow out of your feet.  Activate them to zip up the front legs for ventilation and clip on the gaiters.

use_action.msg: You close vents in the legs of the snow bib.

armor_blarmor.description: Thick leather body armor that has been hardened via chemical treatment.  Light and strong.

armor_chitin.name: chitinous scale mail suit
armor_chitin.description: A full body suit of chitin sections overlapping with each other, secured to a leather backing.  The odd irregular shapes make full coverage impossible, not helped by how poor of a material chitin is.  Seems to be made more out of desperation than anything, and would benefit greatly from some underlying armor.

armor_metal_sheets.name: sheet metal armor
armor_metal_sheets.description: A full set of armor hammered out from sheet metal and tied in place with leather straps and belts.  It's crude, heavy, and uncomfortable, but damn protective.  Now, you're a true Post-Apocalyptic Warrior.

armor_ch_metal_sheets.name: hardened sheet metal armor
armor_ch_metal_sheets.description: A full set of armor hammered out from sheet metal and hardened for added protection.  Perfect for keeping all your fleshy bits safe from zombie teeth.

armor_metal_sheets_heavy.name: heavy sheet metal armor
armor_metal_sheets_heavy.description: A full set of armor hammered out from sheet metal and tied in place with leather straps and belts, with a doubly-thick chest guard to keep all your important organs safe.  You might be as mobile as a refrigerator wearing all this, but that's the price to pay to keep your flesh attached.

armor_ch_metal_sheets_heavy.name: heavy hardened sheet metal armor
armor_ch_metal_sheets_heavy.description: A full set of armor hammered out from sheet metal and hardened for extra protection, with a doubly-thick chest guard.  The Ned Kelly gang would be proud.

armor_metal_sheets_chain.name: junkyard plate armor
armor_metal_sheets_chain.description: A full set of steel armor made from sheet metal hammered into shape and attached with chainmail covering the gaps.  For the modern knight on a budget.

armor_metal_sheets_chain_heavy.name: heavy junkyard plate armor
armor_metal_sheets_chain_heavy.description: A full set of steel armor made from sheet metal hammered into shape and attached with chainmail covering the gaps, with an extra-thick chestpiece.  About as heavy as a car but nowhere near as mobile, this suit is nonetheless quite protective.

armor_ch_metal_sheets_chain.name: hardened junkyard plate armor
armor_ch_metal_sheets_chain.description: A full set of steel armor made from sheet metal hammered into shape, attached with chainmail, and case-hardened for extra strength.  It might be crude and uncomfortably heavy, but it was clearly made by a skilled metalworker and offers excellent protection.

armor_ch_metal_sheets_chain_heavy.name: heavy hardened junkyard plate armor
armor_ch_metal_sheets_chain_heavy.description: A full set of steel armor made from sheet metal hammered into shape, attached with chainmail, with a double-thick chestpiece, and case-hardened for extra strength.  Top-of-the-line in armor that looks like it was made from banged-up lockers, for the skilled metalworker that values protection over being able to move.

cleansuit.name: cleansuit
cleansuit.description: A simple hazardous materials handling suit.  Though somewhat restrictive and fragile, wearing it will provide excellent protection against ambient radiation.

xedra_artifact_cleansuit.name: S02a hazmat suit
xedra_artifact_cleansuit.description: A bulky hazardous materials handling suit.  This one appears outfitted for the highest levels of protection, featuring built in oversized rubber gloves, sealed boot covers with a rubber sole, and an active temperature control system.  It's clearly designed to accommodate additional equipment, including self-contained breathing apparatuses or powered air purifying respirator systems.  Strange wiring snakes the entire garment, connecting to small electronic pads on all of the joints and the head.  A battery compartment marked with "X.E.D.R.A PROTOTYPE S02a" is attached to the back.

use_action.need_charges_msg: It seems like this device needs power.

Strange wiring snakes the entire garment, connecting to small electronic pads on all of the joints and the head.  A battery compartment marked with "X.E.D.R.A PROTOTYPE S02a" is attached to the back.  The device is currently switched on.

bite_suit.name: canine bite suit
bite_suit.description: Designed to stop the injuries of dog bites, this thick, one piece suit is often used in the rehabilitation of abused animals and in training dogs by the police and military.  A base layer of aramid fabric has had strips of soft body armor sewn into it to mimic quilting, and to soften the blunt of animals jumping, slashing, or pouncing on the wearer.

hazmat_suit.description: An impermeable whole-body garment worn as protection against hazardous materials.  Restrictive and fragile, wearing it will provide complete protection against ambient radiation.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.

nomex_suit.name: flame-resistant suit

robofac_resonance_suit.name: Hub 01 hazardous materials suit
robofac_resonance_suit.description: A hefty environmental suit incorporating Kevlar-lined boots and gloves, worn by Hub personnel in their rare forays aboveground.  This one has a large battery pack and otherworldly electronics which snake the entire exterior, making it substantially more cumbersome to wear than its base model.  Colored brown and blue, the white seal of Hub 01 is embroidered on both of its upper arms.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.  Activate it to turn on.

use_action.msg: A tiny green LED on the chest of the %s lights up.
use_action.need_charges_msg: It seems like this device needs power.

robofac_resonance_suit_on.name: Hub 01 hazardous materials suit (on)

Colored brown and blue, the white seal of Hub 01 is embroidered on both of its upper arms.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.  A tiny green LED on the chest is illuminated.

use_action.msg: The LED on the %s flicks off.

xedra_enviro_suit.name: activity suit
xedra_enviro_suit.description: A single-piece brown and orange environmental suit, tailored in a way that slightly recalls a military flight suit.  The letters "X.E.D.R.A" are inscribed on its back, and a white shoulder patch on the right arm shows an arrow reaching within rings of concentric circles.  It requires a separate gas mask for full protection.

use_action.msg: You slip out of the top of the suit and tie the sleeves around your waist.

xedra_enviro_suit_casual.name: activity suit (casual)
xedra_enviro_suit_casual.description: A single-piece brown and orange environmental suit, tailored in a way that slightly recalls a military flight suit.  The upper portion has been tied around the waist casually.

use_action.msg: You untie the sleeves and put back on the top of the suit.

touring_suit.name: track touring suit
touring_suit.description: A leather bodysuit with padding in high-impact areas, meant for motorcyclists out on the track.  The leather is stiff but makes the armor much sturdier and more protective than lighter counterparts.

officer_uniform.name: dress uniform

mil_flight_suit.name: military flight suit

armor_nomad_plate.name: nomad plate armor
armor_nomad_plate.description: A full body multilayered suit of plate armor with a 4 mm thick chest piece.  The medium steel has been quenched, tempered and affixed over a full-body layered suit of weight-distributing straps.  The armor has an integrated breathable Lycra jumpsuit and the torso has a spall liner of aramid panels.  Electronics run below the surface and circulate cool air to the skin, drawing power from your internal CBM reservoir.

armor_lamellar_lc.name: mild steel lamellar cuirass
armor_lamellar_lc.description: A cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  It's less Mad Max and more Garage Mongolian, but the classics are classic for a reason.

xl_armor_lamellar_lc.name: mild steel lamellar cuirass
xl_armor_lamellar_lc.description: A cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  The perfect size for an orc or bipedal grizzly bear.

xs_armor_lamellar_lc.name: mild steel lamellar cuirass
xs_armor_lamellar_lc.description: A cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  Perfectly sized for a particularly angry rat-person, yes-yes.

armor_lamellar_ch.name: hardened steel lamellar cuirass
armor_lamellar_ch.description: A cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  This one has been hardened for extra protection.

xl_armor_lamellar_ch.name: hardened steel lamellar cuirass
xl_armor_lamellar_ch.description: A hardened cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  Built larger for a minotaur guarding their labyrinth.

xs_armor_lamellar_ch.name: hardened steel lamellar cuirass
xs_armor_lamellar_ch.description: A hardened cuirass made of small strips of sheet metal laced together, something of an intermediary between chain mail and plate armor.  Just the right size for a fantasy dwarf.

armor_pipe_vest.name: pipe vest
armor_pipe_vest.description: A cuirass made of pipe sections tied firmly together.  Very ugly, not that protective, but beats having no armor at all.  Probably.

makeshift_metal_plate_vest.name: makeshift metal plate vest
makeshift_metal_plate_vest.description: This very crude armor is made from two pairs of jeans, filled with metal plates that are sewn in place.  One pair wraps around your waist, and the other over your shoulders.  It's very uncomfortable to wear, very ugly, but works kinda.

crude_plastic_vest.name: crude plastic armor vest
crude_plastic_vest.description: This plastic vest is made from pieces of a large trash can, held together with string.

carpet_cuirass.name: carpet cuirass
carpet_cuirass.description: A rectangular length of tough carpet with a hole cut out for your head and tied around the waist.  It's decently protective for its weight and quite the fashion statement.

armor_aztec.name: ichcahuipilli
armor_aztec.description: A Mesoamerican armor of Nahuatl origin, somewhat similar to a European gambeson.  It is made of unspun cotton between two layers of quilted cotton crystallized by brine, edged with leather around its holes.  It is extremely thick and offers superb protection, but is also heavy.  This bad boy once stopped Spanish bullets and Aztec missiles alike, now its time has come to stop zombie bites.

armor_lorica.name: lorica segmentata
armor_lorica.description: An ancient Roman laminar armor, made of overlapping metal strips connected to internal leather straps.

xl_armor_lorica.name: lorica segmentata
xl_armor_lorica.description: An ancient Roman laminar armor, made of overlapping metal strips connected to internal leather straps.

xs_armor_lorica.name: lorica segmentata
xs_armor_lorica.description: An ancient Roman laminar armor, made of overlapping metal strips connected to internal leather straps.

armor_thessalonian.name: cataphract armor
armor_thessalonian.description: This armor, made of interlocking plates of burnished bronze, appears to be either a high-quality recreation or a genuine artifact.  Despite having an ancient design, it is in mint condition aside from some battle damage.  It covers from the shoulders to the hips and is of extremely high quality.

chestguard_metal_sheets.name: sheet metal chest guard
chestguard_metal_sheets.description: Two sheets of metal hammered to fit your torso and riveted to leather belts to act as straps.  Heavy, uncomfortable, and difficult to move in, but it should help keep your blood inside your body.

ch_chestguard_metal_sheets.name: hardened sheet metal chest guard
ch_chestguard_metal_sheets.description: A chest guard made of hammered sheet metal, hardened for added protection.  It's not any easier to move in, but it is much sturdier now.

chestguard_metal_sheets_heavy.name: heavy sheet metal chest guard
chestguard_metal_sheets_heavy.description: A double-decker chest guard made from two sheets of metal layered over each other and hammered to fit your torso.  Monstrously heavy, but it's quite protective and the thicker material makes it sturdier.

light_battery_cell.name: light battery (disposable)

medium_battery_cell.name: medium battery

heavy_plus_battery_cell.name: big tool battery
heavy_plus_battery_cell.description: A heavy battery cell, universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and portable tools - drills, angle grinders, chainsaws.

heavy_atomic_battery_cell.name: heavy plutonium fuel battery (disposable)
heavy_atomic_battery_cell.description: A battery that uses a thin plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound.  It is universally compatible with all kinds of industrial-grade equipment and large tools.  Although it stores a huge amount of power, it cannot be recharged.

huge_atomic_battery_cell.name: military plutonium fuel cell (disposable)
huge_atomic_battery_cell.description: A battery that uses a huge plutonium-244 rod to stabilize an exotic nanocompound.  It was used in military mech-suits, was highly experimental, and had no civilian applications.  Although it stores a stupendous amount of power, it cannot be recharged.

bio_adrenaline.name: Adrenaline Pump CBM
bio_adrenaline.description: A stimulator system that is implanted alongside the adrenal glands, allowing the user to trigger their body's adrenaline response at the cost of some bionic power.

bio_ads.name: Active Defense System CBM
bio_ads.description: A bionic that projects a thin forcefield around the user's body.  Everything loses velocity when penetrating this field, which results in a reduced amount of dealt damage at the cost of user's bionic energy.  Bullets and stabbing attacks will lose more velocity than cutting attacks, and those in turn more than bashing attacks.

bio_alarm.name: Alarm System CBM
bio_alarm.description: A motion-detecting alarm system will notice almost all movement within a fifteen-foot radius, and will silently alert the user.  This is very useful during sleep, or if the user suspects a cloaked pursuer.

bio_ar.name: Integrated AR System CBM
bio_ar.description: This bionic module integrates augmented reality interface into user's eyes.

bio_armor_arms.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Arms CBM
bio_armor_arms.description: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh.  Provides passive protection at the cost of mild encumbrance, and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.

bio_armor_eyes.name: Protective Lenses CBM
bio_armor_eyes.description: A bionic package that seals the user's eye sockets with highly-protective mirrored lenses and re-routes their tear ducts to their mouth.  When the user cries, they must spit out or swallow their tears.

bio_armor_head.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Head CBM
bio_armor_head.description: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh, protecting both their head and jaw regions at the cost of mild encumbrance.

bio_armor_legs.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Legs CBM
bio_armor_legs.description: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh.  Provides passive protection at the cost of mild encumbrance, and can be used in conjunction with bionic martial arts.

bio_armor_torso.name: Subcutaneous Protective Mesh - Torso CBM
bio_armor_torso.description: An advanced protective mesh that weaves into the user's flesh, protecting it from physical trauma at the cost of mild encumbrance.

bio_batteries.name: Battery System CBM
bio_batteries.description: A battery draining attachment to make use of the energy contained in normal, everyday batteries.

bio_blade.name: Monomolecular Blade CBM
bio_blade.description: A deadly foot-long blade made of advanced material that is installed inside the forearm, capable of being extended through the back of the user's wrist at the cost of a small amount of power.  Though exceptionally sharp, it will prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.

bio_shotgun.name: Shotgun Arm CBM
bio_shotgun.description: A concealed, single shot 12 gauge shotgun that is implanted inside the left forearm.  Perfect in a pinch.

bio_blood_anal.name: Blood Analysis CBM
bio_blood_anal.description: Small sensors that are implanted in the user's heart, allowing them to analyze their blood.  This will detect many illnesses, drugs, and other conditions.

bio_blood_filter.name: Blood Filter CBM
bio_blood_filter.description: A filtration system that is installed in the heart and can actively filter out chemical impurities, primarily drugs, with limited impact on viruses.  Note that it is not a targeted filter; ALL drugs in the system will be affected.

bio_cable.name: Cable Charger System CBM
bio_cable.description: A complex port that is mounted above the hip.  While active, it will recharge bionic power when connected to a battery via jumper cable.

bio_carbon.name: Subdermal Carbon Filament CBM
bio_carbon.description: Thin armor made of carbon nanotubes, implanted just beneath the skin.  It reduces cutting, stabbing and ballistic damage.

bio_chain_lightning.name: Chain Lightning CBM
bio_chain_lightning.description: A chain lightning generator that emits a blast of lightning at a target, leaving a trail of lightning in its wake and jumping to additional targets within 4 tiles of the previous target.

bio_claws.name: Bionic Claws CBM
bio_claws.description: A set of vicious, retractable claws that are implanted inside the user's fingers.  They do considerable cutting damage, but prevent the user from holding anything else while extended.

bio_climate.name: Internal Climate Control CBM
bio_climate.description: A network of thermal piping which eases the effects of high and low ambient temperatures once activated.

bio_cloak.name: Cloaking System CBM
bio_cloak.description: A high-power system that uses a set of cameras and LEDs to make the user blend into their surroundings, rendering them fully invisible to eyes and optical sensors.  However, this doesn't prevent detection from other means such as infrared, sonar, etc.

bio_cqb.name: Close Quarters Battle CBM
bio_cqb.description: A set of bionic processors and databanks, loaded with martial arts combat programs.  While active, the CQB module will improve the user's hand-to-hand combat skills, but prevents them from improving them through combat experience.

bio_dex_enhancer.name: Wired Reflexes CBM
bio_dex_enhancer.description: A set of bionic nerve stimulators that greatly enhance reaction times, granting a +2 bonus to dexterity while powered.  However, user will suffer penalties if unpowered.

bio_digestion.name: Expanded Digestive System CBM
bio_digestion.description: This module contains three synthetic stomachs and industrial-grade intestines which replace the user's corresponding organs.  Not only will these extract much more nutrition from food, but also increase the user's resistance to foodborne illness, and occasionally allow the digestion of rotten food.  Installing this CBM will correct any abnormalities in the user's digestive system.

bio_ears.name: Enhanced Hearing CBM
bio_ears.description: While this bionic is active, the user's hearing will be drastically improved, allowing them to hear over three times better than the average person.  Additionally, high-intensity sounds will be automatically dampened before they can damage the user's hearing.

bio_voice_b.name: AudioVox CBM
bio_voice_b.description: An implanted set of vocal cords and speakers allowing the user to remodulate and project their voice at will.

bio_mp3.name: WearMan CBM
bio_mp3.description: A set of speakers implanted into the skull, able to pick up local radiowaves and play downloaded music.

bio_sonar.name: Subaquatic Navigation System CBM
bio_sonar.description: A tiny device implanted in the inner ear.  When active, it will periodically generate ultrasonic pulses which aid in navigation, provided the user is underwater and able to hear.

bio_emp.name: Directional EMP CBM
bio_emp.description: A set of small parabolic EMP field generators that are mounted in the palm of the user's right hand.  They can be used to instantly fire a wide, but short-ranged blast which will disable electronics and robots.

bio_emp_armgun.name: EMP Projector CBM
bio_emp_armgun.description: A ranged EMP generator system that is implanted in the user's right arm and hand.  The system fires precise, single-target pulses that require time to aim.  Extremely effective against electronic targets, but mostly useless otherwise.

bio_ethanol.name: Ethanol Burner CBM
bio_ethanol.description: A reactor that burns alcohol as fuel in an extremely efficient reaction.  It can store up to 500 mL and accepts ethanol, methanol and denatured alcohol as fuel.

bio_evap.name: Aero-Evaporator CBM
bio_evap.description: This unit draws moisture from the surrounding air, which slowly trickles directly into the user's blood stream.  It may fail in very dry environments.

bio_eye_enhancer.name: Ocular Amplifiers CBM
bio_eye_enhancer.description: A set of ocular amplifiers which greatly enhance the user's vision, granting a +2 bonus to perception while powered.  However, user will suffer penalties if unpowered.

bio_eye_optic.name: Telescopic Eyes CBM
bio_eye_optic.description: An array of high-powered, auto-focusing lenses that replaces much of the material in the user's inner eye.  This fixes any vision problems and allows for an increased vision range akin to binoculars.

bio_face_mask.name: Facial Distortion CBM
bio_face_mask.description: Through controlled application of electrochemical impulses, this bionic module lets the user alter their facial structure so as to subtly affect the reactions of others.  This grants a bonus to all social interactions.

bio_faraday.name: Dielectric Capacitance System CBM
bio_faraday.description: A network of miniature piezoelectric capacitors, implanted throughout the user's body to protect from external electrical discharge.

bio_fingerhack.name: Fingerhack CBM
bio_fingerhack.description: A miniature electrohack, surgically embedded in a finger of the user's right hand.  This is an all-purpose hacking unit used to override control panels and the like, but not computers.  Computer proficiency is important, and a failed use may cause damage.

bio_fitnessband.name: Calorie Tracker CBM
bio_fitnessband.description: A small medical implant that passively tracks your calorie expenditure and consumption.

bio_flashbang.name: Flashbang Generator CBM
bio_flashbang.description: A combination of LEDs and speakers that create a flash and sound comparable to a flashbang grenade, deafening and blinding nearby enemies.

bio_flashlight.name: Cranial Flashlight CBM
bio_flashlight.description: A small, but powerful LED flashlight that is mounted between the user's eyes.

bio_tattoo_led.name: LED Tattoo CBM
bio_tattoo_led.description: An LED display implanted beneath the epidermis that can display patterns or pictures through the skin.  When active it glows dimly, providing a very small amount of light.

bio_geiger.name: Integrated Dosimeter CBM
bio_geiger.description: A set of small radiation sensors that are implanted throughout the body, allowing the user to analyze their level of absorbed radiation.  They will also alert the user whenever exposed to environmental radiation.

bio_gills.name: Respirator CBM
bio_gills.description: A complex respiration augmentation system that increases the user's maximal oxygen uptake and allows for underwater breathing akin to gills.  Will automatically activate if the user is drowning.

bio_ground_sonar.name: Terranian Sonar CBM
bio_ground_sonar.description: A set of precision sonar equipment, implanted in the user's feet to allow the detection of below-ground movement, buried traps, and unstable terrain.

bio_heat_absorb.name: Heat Drain CBM
bio_heat_absorb.description: While fighting unarmed against a warm-blooded opponent, there is a chance that a successful hit will drain body heat, inflicting a small amount of extra damage and recharging the user's bionic power reserves slightly.

bio_heatsink.name: Thermal Dissipation CBM
bio_heatsink.description: A set of powerful heatsinks and supermaterials woven into the user's flesh.  While powered, this system will prevent external heat damage up to 2000 degrees Fahrenheit.  Note that this does not affect the internal body temperature.

bio_hydraulics.name: Hydraulic Muscles CBM
bio_hydraulics.description: A hydraulic muscle support system that, when active, sets the user's strength to 20.

bio_infrared.name: Infrared Vision CBM
bio_infrared.description: A bionic module that extends the user's range of vision into the infrared, allowing them to see warm-blooded creatures in the dark and through smoke.

bio_int_enhancer.name: Cerebral Booster CBM
bio_int_enhancer.description: A set of bionic coprocessors that are implanted in the user's brain, granting a +2 bonus to intelligence while powered.  However, user will suffer penalties if unpowered.  It takes over and replaces numerous cognitive functions once installed and cannot be removed.

bio_laser.name: Finger-Mounted Laser CBM
bio_laser.description: A small, high-powered laser that is embedded in the user's fingertip.  This long-range weapon is not incredibly damaging, but is very accurate, and has the potential to start fires.

bio_leukocyte.name: Leukocyte Breeder System CBM
bio_leukocyte.description: A set of bionic stimulators which augment the user's haematopoiesis system, allowing them to accelerate white blood cell production using bionic power.  It is designed for continuous use and may cause unpleasant side effects when turned off.

bio_lighter.name: Finger Lighter CBM
bio_lighter.description: A pair of powerful fire starters which extend from the tip of both hands' index fingers.

bio_lockpick.name: Fingerpick CBM
bio_lockpick.description: An electronic lockpick that is embedded in a fingertip.  This automatic system will quickly unlock all but the most advanced key locks without any skill required on the part of the user.

bio_magnet.name: Electromagnetic Unit CBM
bio_magnet.description: A powerful electromagnet that is implanted into the user's right hand, allowing them to indiscriminately pull all nearby magnetic objects towards them.  Unlucky bystanders might be injured or killed by flying objects.

bio_membrane.name: Nictitating Membrane CBM
bio_membrane.description: Thin membranes that cover the user's eyes while underwater, negating any vision penalties.

bio_memory.name: Enhanced Memory Banks CBM
bio_memory.description: A set of highly-advanced quantum storage drives used to enhance memory.  While active, they increase the rate that the user learns skills.  Once it is installed, it will partially replace the functionality of the hippocampus, and thus cannot be removed without risk of severe permanent amnesia and difficulty forming new memories.

bio_metabolics.name: Metabolic Interchange CBM
bio_metabolics.description: This module interconnects the user's digestive system and power supply, letting them replenish bionic energy by burning calories.

bio_meteorologist.name: Weather Reader CBM
bio_meteorologist.description: A multitude of scientific instruments and sensors collects environmental data.  The data are compiled and presented as a simple readout of the current weather.  It also passively tells the user their external temperature.

bio_nanobots.name: Repair Nanobots CBM
bio_nanobots.description: A fleet of tiny, dormant robots.  While activated, they will flit about the user's body, repairing damage and stopping bleeding at the cost of power.

bio_night.name: Artificial Night Generator CBM
bio_night.description: When active, this bionic eliminates all light within a 2 tile radius of the user through destructive interference.

bio_night_vision.name: Implanted Night Vision CBM
bio_night_vision.description: This bionic module modifies the user's eyes to amplify existing light, allowing them to see in the dark.

bio_ods.name: Offensive Defense System CBM
bio_ods.description: A thin forcefield gets projected around the user's body, continually draining power.  This field does not deflect attacks, but rather delivers a strong shock, damaging unarmed attackers and those with a conductive weapon.

bio_painkiller.name: Sensory Dulling CBM
bio_painkiller.description: This module lets the user's nervous system inhibit pain signals, allowing them to dull their senses at will.  However, the use of this system may cause delayed reaction times and drowsiness.

bio_power_storage.name: Power Storage CBM
bio_power_storage.description:
A Compact Bionic Module, its shiny metallic casing is covered in stamped markings.  One end has interface ports for connecting other bionics.  Multiple Power Storage units can be implanted - their side connectors allow them to link together into a single power network.

This module upgrades the user's bionic power capacity by 100 kJ, which is required to use any powered bionics.  It can be recharged via other CBMs that function as power supplies.

bio_power_storage_mkII.name: Power Storage Mk. II CBM
bio_power_storage_mkII.description:
A Compact Bionic Module, its shiny metallic casing is covered in stamped markings.  One end has interface ports for connecting other bionics.  Multiple Power Storage units can be implanted - their side connectors allow them to link together into a single power network.

This enhanced version upgrades the user's bionic power capacity by 250 kJ, which is required to use any powered bionics.  It can be recharged via other CBMs that function as power supplies.

bio_probability_travel.name: Probability Travel CBM
bio_probability_travel.description: Increases the body's wavelength, allowing the user to quantum tunnel through walls, reappearing on the other side.  Power drain in standby is minimal, but each tile tunneled through costs 250 bionic power.

bio_purifier.name: Air Filtration System CBM
bio_purifier.description: An advanced filtration system that is implanted in the user's trachea.  If toxins or airborne diseases find their way into the windpipe, the filter will attempt to remove them.

bio_radio.name: Infolink CBM
bio_radio.description: A wireless communications device that integrates with the ear canal to enable hands-free communication over radio waves.

bio_radio_pat.name: Modified Infolink CBM
bio_radio_pat.description: A wireless communications device that integrates with the ear canal to enable hands-free communication over radio waves.  This one has custom software for communicating with your pal Pat.

bio_radscrubber.name: Radiation Scrubber System CBM
bio_radscrubber.description: A system of advanced piezomechanical blood filters that are implanted throughout the body, allowing the user to purge themself of absorbed radiation at the cost of some bionic power.

bio_razors.name: Fingertip Razors CBM
bio_razors.description: A set of ten double-edged, four centimeter long razor-sharp claws that are implanted underneath the fingernails.  They deal a small amount of unarmed slashing damage whenever the user's fingertips are uncovered.

bio_fuel_cell_gasoline.name: Gasoline Fuel Cell CBM
bio_fuel_cell_gasoline.description: A small gasoline fuel cell able to convert gasoline to bionic power.  It's connected to a heat exhaust and a diffuse network of bio-plastic bladders able to hold up to 500 mL of gasoline.  When implanted, the system incurs a moderate amount of torso encumbrance.

bio_recycler.name: Recycler Unit CBM
bio_recycler.description: A series of filters and processors that is implanted in the user's digestive system, allowing them to reclaim waste liquid and, to a lesser degree, nutrients.  The net effect is a greatly reduced need to eat and drink.

bio_remote.name: Remote Controller CBM
bio_remote.description: A small module that connects to the user's brain and allows them to interface with nearby devices with wireless capabilities.

bio_resonator.name: Sonic Resonator CBM
bio_resonator.description: A bionic module that allows the user's entire body to resonate at very high power, creating a short-range shockwave.  While it will not do much damage to creatures, solid objects such as walls and doors will be damaged.

bio_scent_mask.name: Olfactory Mask CBM
bio_scent_mask.description: While this system is powered, the user's body will produce very little odor, making it nearly impossible for creatures to track them by scent.

bio_shock.name: Electroshock Unit CBM
bio_shock.description: While fighting unarmed, or with a weapon that conducts electricity, there is a chance that a successful hit will shock the user's opponent, inflicting extra damage and disabling them temporarily at the cost of some energy.

bio_shockwave.name: Shockwave Generator CBM
bio_shockwave.description: A bionic module that generates a powerful shockwave, knocking back all nearby creatures.  Targets are stunned briefly, take damage and additional stun upon impact with impassable terrain, and knock back any creatures they collide with.

bio_speed.name: Synaptic Accelerator CBM
bio_speed.description: A set of bionic stimulators that enhance the user's nervous system, granting a 10% boost to speed.

bio_str_enhancer.name: Muscle Augmentation CBM
bio_str_enhancer.description: A set of myomer fibers that enhance the user's muscular system, granting a +2 bonus to strength while powered.  However, user will suffer penalties if unpowered.

bio_surgical_razor.name: Autonomous Surgical Scalpels CBM
bio_surgical_razor.description: A system of surgical-grade scalpels that is implanted in the user's fingers.  They allow for automated precise cuts and can be used as a high-quality butchering tool.

bio_sunglasses.name: Anti-Glare Compensators CBM
bio_sunglasses.description: A set of quick-reacting transition lenses that are installed over the user's eyes.  They negate glare penalties, partially protect from bright flashes, and protect the eyes when welding.

bio_synlungs.name: Synthetic Lungs CBM
bio_synlungs.description: Highly efficient synthetic lungs which replace the user's own.  After installation the user's cardio fitness will be greatly increased and will not need regular exercise to maintain but the user will need continuous power to remain breathing.  Further, they will weaken the user's immune system somewhat.

bio_targeting.name: Targeting System CBM
bio_targeting.description: A bionic module that contains rangefinders and synchronizes the movement of the user's eyes with their arms, to a degree.  Shots they fire will be much more accurate, particularly at long ranges.

bio_taser.name: Super Stun Gun CBM
bio_taser.description: A bionic stun gun which implants into the hand.  It is highly powerful, able to easily cause electrical burns and cardiac arrest in targets.  The electricity it generates arcs through the air over short distances, making it nearly impossible to miss, but it still requires the user to be nearly adjacent to their target.

bio_teleport.name: Teleportation Unit CBM
bio_teleport.description: A highly experimental unit that folds space over short distances, instantly transporting the user's body up to 25 feet in a random direction at the cost of much power.  Note that prolonged or frequent use may have dangerous side effects.

bio_time_freeze.name: Time Dilation CBM
bio_time_freeze.description: At the cost of all stored bionic power, the user may increase their body speed and reactions dramatically, essentially freezing time.  Violent or rapid movements may cause damage due to friction.

bio_tools.name: Integrated Multitool CBM
bio_tools.description: A surgically-implanted set of compact tools and a welder which runs off the user's power banks.  Includes screwdriving heads, a multi-purpose knife, a low-power impact wrench and a nail prying tool.

bio_multimeter.name: Integrated Multimeter CBM
bio_multimeter.description: A set of electrical leads to be embedded in the user's fingers, connected to a multimeter unit in their hand.  Allows the user to measure voltage, resistance, and current using their fingertips, and provides slight protection against electric shocks.

bio_electrokit.name: Integrated Circuitry Toolset CBM
bio_electrokit.description: A soldering iron, multimeter, and set of fine screwdrivers implanted in the user's hands.  Contains all the tools required for manipulating bench-scale electrical circuits, and provides slight protection against electric shocks.

bio_torsionratchet.name: Joint Torsion Ratchet CBM
bio_torsionratchet.description: A set of torsion ratchets that replace the user's joints to slowly generate power when they move.  These can be toggled to generate more power, but movement will require more effort.  This system is actively detrimental to fully mechanical limbs; the additional joint resistance it relies on causes a net loss of bionic power.

bio_jointservo.name: Joint Servo CBM
bio_jointservo.description: A set of servomotors installed on the leg joints to provide power-assisted movement.  They are optimized for running, but walking also requires less effort while this bionic is active.  However, when it's offline it will hamper the user's movement.

bio_uncanny_dodge.name: Uncanny Dodge CBM
bio_uncanny_dodge.description: A set of bionic processors that augment the user's nervous system, allowing them to dodge attacks beyond normal human capability.

bio_ups.name: Unified Power System CBM
bio_ups.description: A Unified Power System that is wired into the user's bionic power banks.  Objects that run on a UPS can now directly draw power from the bionic power supply.

bio_watch.name: Internal Chronometer CBM
bio_watch.description: A bionic module containing an atomic clock, complete with a silent alarm clock function.

bio_water_extractor.name: Water Extraction Unit CBM
bio_water_extractor.description: A module containing nanotubes that are embedded in the palm of the user's hand to pump any available fluid out of a dead body, cleanse it of impurities, and convert it into potable water.  Water container not included.

bio_syringe.name: Intravenous Needletip CBM
bio_syringe.description: A small tube with a retractable needle that terminates in a net of tiny hoses instead of a plunger.  When installed, it allows the user to draw substances directly into their bloodstream akin to a regular syringe.

bio_weight.name: Titanium Skeletal Bracing CBM
bio_weight.description: A set of hinges, springs, and other synthetic augments for the skeletal structure.  These artificial enhancers strengthen the knees and elbows, allowing the user to carry more weight.  The reinforcement also provides 2 bashing armor to the torso, legs and arms.

bio_taste_blocker.name: Taste Modifier CBM
bio_taste_blocker.description: A set of highly-sensitive sensors implanted in the user's mouth, combined with a sophisticated analyzer.  While active, it will block all unpleasant taste and texture at the cost of bionic energy.

bio_soporific.name: Soporific Induction CBM
bio_soporific.description: A microscopic electrode designed to gently stimulate a particular cluster of neurons in the hypothalamus, helping the user to fall asleep.

bio_ankles.name: Squeaky Ankles CBM
bio_ankles.description: A pair of defective bionics that make squeaking noises.

bio_deformity.name: Bionic-Induced Deformity CBM
bio_deformity.description: A jumble of broken metal pieces that were removed during reconstructive surgery.

bio_dis_acid.name: Acidic Discharge CBM
bio_dis_acid.description: A CBM that has been breached in several places.  Some acid is leaking from it.

bio_dis_shock.name: Electrical Discharge CBM
bio_dis_shock.description: A formerly-functional CBM that is now a mess of naked wires and burnt resistors.

bio_drain.name: Electrical Drain CBM
bio_drain.description: This CBM was wired incorrectly and would drain power from any system connected to it.

bio_itchy.name: Itchy Metal Thing CBM
bio_itchy.description: You can't recognize what this is supposed to be, but you imagine it'd be a very awkward thing to have in one's body.

bio_glowy.name: Glowy Thing CBM
bio_glowy.description: It's a… thing?  And it glows, at least it did when it was installed.

bio_leaky.name: Leaky Bionic CBM
bio_leaky.description: A mess of pierced pipes and broken seals, something unpleasant is leaking from it.

bio_noise.name: Noisemaker CBM
bio_noise.description: A malfunctioning bionic.  When installed, it occasionally emits a loud burst of noise.

bio_nostril.name: Bionic Nostril CBM
bio_nostril.description: This thing was up someone's nose, they're probably glad to be rid of it.

bio_pokedeye.name: Bionic Visual Impairment CBM
bio_pokedeye.description: A defective bionic that impairs vision.

bio_power_weakness.name: Power Overload CBM
bio_power_weakness.description: A bunch of defective power circuits that are prone to short-circuiting.

bio_shakes.name: Bionic Short Circuit CBM
bio_shakes.description: This bionic is poorly wired and occasionally short-circuits.

bio_sleepy.name: Endocrine Enervator CBM
bio_sleepy.description: A malfunctioning bionic that causes sleepiness by altering the unfortunate user's brain chemistry.

bio_synaptic_regen.name: Synaptic Regeneration System CBM
bio_synaptic_regen.description: An electromagnetic stimulator surgically implanted on the back of the head and along the spine, continually draining power.  As long as it's active, the user will not suffer from sleep deprivation, although they may still feel sleepy; if activated by a user that is already sleep-deprived, it will gradually reduce the symptoms of lacking sleep.

bio_spasm.name: Motor Control Overstimulator CBM
bio_spasm.description: The result of poor configuration, this bionic module frequently causes debilitating muscle spasms.

bio_stiff.name: Wire-Induced Stiffness CBM
bio_stiff.description: A length of poorly installed wiring that would cause stiffness.

bio_thumbs.name: Self-Locking Thumbs CBM
bio_thumbs.description: A pair of faulty, self-locking thumb bionics.

bio_trip.name: Visual Disruptor CBM
bio_trip.description: A pair of defective ocular bionics that cause visual distortion and pixelation.

bio_voice.name: Voice Remodulator CBM
bio_voice.description: Part of the Autodoc's 'Cyborg Identity Package', this bionic gives the user a creepy robot voice.

bio_faulty_electromagnetic_leak.name: Electromagnetic Leak CBM
bio_faulty_electromagnetic_leak.description: A broken implant that sends electromagnetic impulses that reduce other implants' capacity to store charge.

bio_lampoil.name: Oil Generator CBM
bio_lampoil.description: A CBM that generates power out of kerosene or motor oil.  It is fairly efficient and can store up to 750 mL of fuel, but works somewhat slowly.

bio_faulty_grossfood.name: Taste Fouler CBM
bio_faulty_grossfood.description: A broken and mis-wired module that would cause food and drink to taste terrible if installed.

bio_radleak.name: Radioactive Leak CBM
bio_radleak.description: A broken CBM that has been leaking radiation into its user.  The danger seems to have been sealed off during the removal process, but you definitely shouldn't put it back.

bio_recoil.name: Recoil Compensators CBM
bio_recoil.description: A CBM that contains shock absorbers and kinetic braces which greatly reduce the recoil of guns.

bio_sleep_shutdown.name: Sleep Mode Shutdown CBM
bio_sleep_shutdown.description: A CBM that completely shuts down all communication between the user's brain and the rest of their body when they fall asleep, preventing them from waking up under any circumstance until their natural sleep cycle completes.  An inability to trigger its effects manually makes it useless as an anesthesia substitute.

bio_pitch_perfect.name: Throwing Assist CBM
bio_pitch_perfect.description: The culmination of decades of research into hominid palaeoanthropology and biomechanical modeling, the throwing assist CBM was brought to market to revolutionize Beqball tournaments, soon becoming exhibitions of cybernetic human effort and engineering.  A network of neurostimulators and sensors, mostly in the arms and hands, work in tandem with the eyes for a significant increase in throwing accuracy and precision.  When the Exodii came upon this cybernetic enhancement suite, they found it to be an economical way to ensure precise grenade placement in partial cyborgs.

bio_robofac_xmleg.name: Hub 01 XM-LEG Interface
bio_robofac_xmleg.description: Body area sensor networks were developed as unobtrusive, chip-free personalized medical devices, typically in the form of thin adhesive pads.  Hub 01 has adapted this technology into cybernetic implants that allow a neurobionic interface to communicate with external devices.  These implants will allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Lower Extremity Gaitframes.

bio_robofac_xmarm.name: Hub 01 XM-ARM Interface
bio_robofac_xmarm.description: Body area sensor networks were developed as unobtrusive, chip-free personalized medical devices, typically in the form of thin adhesive pads.  Hub 01 has adapted this technology into cybernetic implants that allow a neurobionic interface to communicate with external devices.  These implants will allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Arm Reinforcement Motionframes.

bio_robofac_xmback.name: Hub 01 XM-BACK Interface
bio_robofac_xmback.description: Body area sensor networks were developed as unobtrusive, chip-free personalized medical devices, typically in the form of thin adhesive pads.  Hub 01 has adapted this technology into cybernetic implants that allow a neurobionic interface to communicate with external devices.  These implants will allow your neurobionic interface to communicate with Hub 01 Biomechanical Assisted Carrying Kinetoframes.

bio_robofac_xmlens.name: Hub 01 XM-LENS Interface
bio_robofac_xmlens.description: Body area sensor networks were developed as unobtrusive, chip-free personalized medical devices, typically in the form of thin adhesive pads.  Installing this cybernetic will remove all of the hair on your head, but you'll have the benefit of being able to directly couple your brain to Hub 01 Low-latency ExoNeural Sensory system headgear.

bio_nl_dimensional_anchor.name: Dimensional Anchor CBM
bio_nl_dimensional_anchor.description: Advanced technology that locks the body into its native dimensionality, protecting from unwanted teleportation and some other phase altering effects.

bio_nl_laser_reader.name: Laser-Assisted Reading Device CBM
bio_nl_laser_reader.description: This implant serves as a reading light and a short-distance laser scanner, allowing one to upload digital images of books straight into the brain's optic lobe and language centers.  When active, one can read slightly faster, and can read in the dark.

bio_nl_psyshield.name: Cranial EMF Shielding CBM
bio_nl_psyshield.description: A microscopically thin layer of some non-newtonian fluid for skull application.  It can protect from some types of electromagnetic fields.  Is it useful?  Maybe.

bio_nl_hair.name: Artificial Hair CBM
bio_nl_hair.description: Synthetic sphincters that control the extrusion and retraction of advanced nanotube hair technology, made to replace hair follicles, allowing one to control their hair length at will.

bio_nl_blood_factory.name: Bone Marrow Bio-Factory CBM
bio_nl_blood_factory.description: Specialized nanorobots that increase blood cell production at the cost of stored calories and bionic energy.

bio_nl_antigravity_jump.name: Antigravity Leap Assist CBM
bio_nl_antigravity_jump.description: An antigravity device designed to be implanted into the legs.  While it doesn't allow for real floating or flying, it does facilitate superhuman long jumps.

bio_exodii_cyberframe_1a.name: Exodii Cyberframe 1a
bio_exodii_cyberframe_1a.description: A bulky Exodii Cyberframe.  Your important internal organs, including much of your core skeleton and musculature, will be encased in a solid metal core.  While there is clearly a head and torso, it is difficult to tell where one starts and the other ends.  It will be difficult or impossible to squeeze through tight spaces, or to wear normal-sized clothing and armor.  The frame greatly increases your physical dexterity and strength, and is highly protective, but the internal parts of your head and torso will still be affected by temperature, you will still feel pain, and internal bleeding can occur with sufficient damage.

bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_armored_left.name: Bionic Left Leg (Cyberframe 1a)
bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_armored_left.description: A bionic left leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_armored_righ.name: Bionic Right Leg (Cyberframe 1a)
bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_armored_righ.description: A bionic right leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

bio_exodii_leg_bionic_treads.name: Bionic Treads (Cyberframe 1a)
bio_exodii_leg_bionic_treads.description: Sturdy treads for replacing legs and feet on an Exodii Cyberframe.  They are in fact two side-by-size triangular mechanisms, split in the middle, and independently operated by telescoping knees, to facilitate lifting one tread at a time for carefully passing over obstacles, or climbing stairs or ladders.  One's former ankles and associated anatomy will be integrated into the servomotors.  Unlike bipedal human legs, these move faster over most terrain, but will severely hinder travel over obstacles and through water.  They are immune to temperature and pain and don't bleed.  While they are highly resistant to damage, their external moving parts are less well protected than a standard bionic leg with similar plate thickness.  Due to their size and heft, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_armored_left.name: Bionic Left Arm (Cyberframe 1a)
bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_armored_left.description: A bionic right arm and hand fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_armored_righ.name: Bionic Right Arm (Cyberframe 1a)
bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_armored_righ.description: A bionic right arm and hand fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are highly resistant to damage.  Due to their size and armored plating, a heavy-duty 1a-style Cyberframe is necessary for operation.

bio_exodii_cyberframe_1b.name: Exodii Cyberframe 1b
bio_exodii_cyberframe_1b.description: A very human-like Exodii Cyberframe.  Your important internal organs, including much of your core skeleton and musculature, will be encased in a frame that resembles a robotic human.  The frame increases your physical dexterity and strength, and is modestly protective, but the internal parts of your head and torso will still be affected by temperature and feel pain.  Internal bleeding can still occur with sufficient damage.

bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_left.name: Bionic Left Leg (Cyberframe 1b)
bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_left.description: A bionic left leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are modestly more sturdy.

bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_right.name: Bionic Right Leg (Cyberframe 1b)
bio_exodii_leg_bionic_basic_right.description: A bionic right leg and foot fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are modestly more sturdy.

bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_left.name: Bionic Left Arm (Cyberframe 1b)
bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_left.description: A bionic right arm and hand fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are modestly more sturdy.

bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_right.name: Bionic Right Arm (Cyberframe 1b)
bio_exodii_arm_bionic_basic_right.description: A bionic right arm and hand fit for an Exodii Cyberframe.  These bionics mimic the dynamics of normal human limbs, but are immune to temperature and pain, don't bleed, and are modestly more sturdy.

bio_nl_collar.name: Cyberbone Collar CBM
bio_nl_collar.description: A subdermal bone-like implant fit for the nape of the neck, with a mysterious nanotube sheet that ensheaths the throat.

bio_nl_collar_deactivated.name: Cyberbone Collar CBM
bio_nl_collar_deactivated.description: A subdermal bone-like implant fit for the nape of the neck, with a mysterious nanotube sheet that ensheaths the throat.

feces_bird.name: bird litter
feces_bird.description: Bird droppings, feathers, and soiled bits of rubbish.

feces_cow.name: cow pie
feces_cow.description: A fresh cow pie; this could probably be used to make some great fertilizer.

feces_manure.name: manure
feces_manure.description: Common manure, could probably be used to make some great fertilizer.

feces_roach.name: roach dirt
feces_roach.description: Large black pellets of rotting material.

fetid_goop.name: fetid goop
fetid_goop.description: A foul-smelling goop.  It has a disgusting texture and a powerful smell that overwhelms every other smell around it.

insect_dust.name: chitin dust
insect_dust.description: The dust left over by winged insects such as butterflies or moths.  It's mostly chitin but may also contain dirt and other gross materials.

shed_snakeskin_little.name: shed snakeskin
shed_snakeskin_little.description: A small length of shed snakeskin.  It's thin and translucent but still bears the distinct pattern of scales.

shed_snakeskin.name: shed snakeskin
shed_snakeskin.description: The molted dermis of an adult snake.  This one is in one piece.  You can even see the individual eyes.

shed_snakeskin_big.name: big shed snakeskin
shed_snakeskin_big.description: A very large shed snakeskin.  This didn't come from anything native, or natural, to New England.

shed_snakeskin_giant.name: gigantic shed snakeskin
shed_snakeskin_giant.description: A complete shed snakeskin of tremendous size.  Whatever left it must be getting even bigger.  You should not be, or return to, wherever you found this.

shed_snakeskin_scales.name: gigantic snake scales

book_anthology_moataatgb.name: The Museum of All Things Awesome and That Go Boom

book_anthology_sunvault.name: Sunvault: Stories of Solarpunk & Eco-Speculation
book_anthology_sunvault.description: Sunvault is the first English-language anthology to broadly collect solarpunk short fiction, artwork, and poetry.  A new genre for the 21st Century, solarpunk is a revolution against despair.  Focusing on solutions to environmental disasters, solarpunk envisions a future of green, sustainable energy used by societies that value inclusiveness, cooperation, and personal freedom.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.

book_anthology_sst.name: Sharp & Sugar Tooth
book_anthology_sst.description: Sharp & Sugar Tooth: Women Up To No Good is a horror anthology of dark fiction and darker appetites, edited by Octavia Cade.  Containing 22 stories of "bad" women, and "good" women who just haven't been caught yet, it features 22 fearless writers who identify as female, non-binary, or a marginalized sex or gender identity.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.

book_anthology_bk.name: Broad Knowledge
book_anthology_bk.description: Broad Knowledge: 35 Women Up To No Good is a feminist anthology of dark fiction and darker knowledge, edited by Joanne Merriam.  Containing 35 stories of "bad" women, and "good" women who just haven't been caught yet.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.

book_anthology_cw.name: Choose Wisely
book_anthology_cw.description: Choose Wisely: 35 Women Up To No Good is a feminist anthology of dark fiction, co-edited by H. L. Nelson and Joanne Merriam.  Containing 35 stories of "bad" women, and "good" women who just haven't been caught yet, it features Joyce Carol Oates, Aimee Bender, Diane Cook, and 33 other fearless women writers.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.

book_anthology_an.name: Apocalypse Now
book_anthology_an.description: Every society and every generation has its version of the apocalypse: swine flu, genetic mutation, global warming, nuclear fallout, the second coming, peak oil, mass extinction, giant irradiated ants, zombies… Apocalypse Now: Poems and Prose from the End of Days is the first anthology of its kind to bring together the poetry and prose of some of America's finest (though not always most well-known) literary voices with an eye for the literary and the popular, for story and lyric, for the past and the future, for the psychological and the physical, for the real and the fantastic.  Published by Upper Rubber Boot Books.

book_anthology_htloop.name: How to Live on Other Planets: A Handbook for Aspiring Aliens

recipe_melee.name: The Streetfighter's Sidekick
recipe_melee.description: A sizable how-to guide for making hand-to-hand combat weapons.  Though the processes are thoroughly detailed and several illustrations are provided, they rely heavily on technical jargon.  More for machinists-turned-weaponsmiths than streetfighters, really.
