chem_ferric_chloride.description: A handful of dark green crystalline powder, with a weak pungent smell similar to that of hydrochloric acid.  Commonly used as a Lewis acid for catalyzing various chemical reactions.

chem_antimony_trichloride.name: antimony trichloride powder
chem_antimony_trichloride.description: A handful of soft, colorless powder with a sharp pungent odor, also known as butter of antimony.  It's a catalyst for polymerization, hydrocracking, and chlorination reactions, and has some other niche uses.

chem_potassium_chloride.name: potassium chloride powder
chem_potassium_chloride.description: A handful of potassium chloride powder.  Although it occurs naturally in the mineral sylvite, it can be produced as a byproduct of the reaction of saltpeter and hydrochloric acid.  It can be used for making fertilizer, or potassium hydroxide by way of electrolysis.

chem_potassium_hydroxide.name: potassium hydroxide powder
chem_potassium_hydroxide.description: A handful of potassium hydroxide powder.  Commonly called caustic potash, it was mainly used industrially for its caustic nature.  It can be used as an electrolyte in alkaline batteries, among other applications.

chem_sulphuric_acid.name: sulfuric acid
chem_sulphuric_acid.description: Sulfuric acid: viscous, foul-smelling and extremely corrosive, particularly to organic matter and evil clowns.  Although used to prepare a number of chemicals, it is mostly known as battery acid, due to its widest commercial application.

chem_muriatic_acid.name: hydrochloric acid
chem_muriatic_acid.description: Hydrochloric acid, also known as muriatic acid.  It is a strong acid that has a distinctive smell, important and frequently used ever since its discovery.  It still has a vast multitude of uses.

chem_acetone.name: acetone
chem_acetone.description: Acetone, best known as the primary constituent of most nail polish removers.  Flammable, and can be easily used for potent homemade explosives, as demonstrated by the terrorist attacks of 2016.

chem_nitric_acid.name: nitric acid
chem_nitric_acid.description: Nitric acid, a strong oxidant and an extremely corrosive material.  Mainly used in the production of synthetic fertilizers, for the etching of circuit boards, and in woodworking.  Remains quite useful both for making a vast array of pyrotechnic and explosive agents and as a direct weapon: not many beings enjoy being doused in nitric acid.

chem_chromium_oxide.name: chromium oxide powder
chem_chromium_oxide.description: A handful of chromium oxide.  This substance, typically known as the only stable green pigment for paints, is also a mild oxidizer, which can be mixed with aluminum powder to make thermite for welding.  If one had access to a CVD machine and a laboratory worth of reagents, they might be able to produce very durable ceramic layers.

cac2powder.name: calcium carbide premix powder
cac2powder.description: A powdered mixture of coke and lime ready to be smelted into usable calcium carbide in an arc furnace.

chem_carbide.name: calcium carbide powder
chem_carbide.description: A handful of calcium carbide, giving off a faint, garlic-like smell.  Commercially, calcium carbide was used for on-the-spot manufacture of acetylene and historically to power acetylene lamps.  If mixed with water and sealed, it will explode with little strength, but with a relatively loud noise that might be useful as a distraction.

chem_caco3.name: calcium carbonate powder
chem_caco3.description: A handful of calcium carbonate powder, typically derived from lime or shells.  Useful for a number of roles, such as sugar production, fracking, construction, paint additives and antacid medicine.

chem_hexamine.name: hexamine wax
chem_hexamine.description: A handful of waxy hexamine tablets which could be broken up into smaller crumbs if needed.  This ubiquitous fuel was used to start up almost every garden grill, and no 'real' camping trip could do its cooking without it, until the Cataclysm.  Nowadays, it is even more valuable than before, being the key component in the preparation of several military-grade explosives.

chem_hydrogen_peroxide_conc.name: liquid hydrogen peroxide (concentrated)
chem_hydrogen_peroxide_conc.description: Concentrated hydrogen peroxide is a powerful oxidant, violently decomposing in contact with most reducing agents.  Can be used as rocket fuel or to make high explosives.  Causes severe burns to any organic matter and may ignite it on contact.

plutonium.name: chunk of plutonium
plutonium.description: A chunk of unshielded plutonium.  You should probably get very far away from this, if you enjoy not being irradiated.

uranium.name: chunk of uranium
uranium.description: Some uranium.  You should probably get very far away from this, if you enjoy not being irradiated.

chem_ammonium_nitrate.name: ammonium nitrate powder
chem_ammonium_nitrate.description: A handful of ammonium nitrate powder.  This white, crystalline powder is commonly used as a component of fertilizers and explosives.  Could also be dissolved in water to sharply lower its temperature, but is there any use for this quality in this new world?

chem_ammonium_nitrate_pellets.name: ammonium nitrate pellets
chem_ammonium_nitrate_pellets.description: A handful of ammonium nitrate pellets.  These pellets are commonly used as a component of fertilizers and explosives.  Could also be dissolved in water to sharply lower its temperature, but is there any use for this quality in this new world?

chem_saltpetre.name: saltpeter powder
chem_saltpetre.description: A handful of saltpeter powder.  Sometimes used as a fertilizer, this ubiquitous nitrate is the principal constituent of black gunpowder and simple rocket propellants, such as rocket candy.

material_niter.name: niter crystal
material_niter.description: A large crystal of niter, the mineral form of potassium nitrate.  It can be processed into saltpeter.

chem_aluminium_sulphate.name: aluminum sulfate crystal
chem_aluminium_sulphate.description: Several crystals of aluminum sulfate.  Historically, an agent for purifying water and as molluscicide, due to the fact that it degenerates their slime.  Just before the Cataclysm, its main uses were for adjusting the acidity of soil and as an additive to baking powder.  If mixed with a strong acid, it could be used to saturate soil with aluminum, causing all but the most resistant of plants to wither and die.

chem_acetic_acid.name: acetic acid
chem_acetic_acid.description: Concentrated acetic acid, typically used as a chemical reagent and antifungal agent.  Despite its horrid smell, it was used to prepare several types of perfumes, but would making perfume not be too fancy for post-apocalyptic New England?

chem_formaldehyde.name: formaldehyde
chem_formaldehyde.description: Formaldehyde, here dissolved in water, was widely used before the Cataclysm as a precursor to production of many chemicals and materials and as an embalming agent.  Easily identifiable by its pungent odor.  Terribly toxic, carcinogenic, and volatile.

chem_thermite.name: thermite powder
chem_thermite.description: A handful of silvery-greenish powder, produced by mixing aluminum and chromium oxide.  This mixture, burning at a constant pace and at extremely high temperature, was once used for on-the-spot welding.  Can be used as an incendiary material in a pinch.

chem_anfo.name: ANFO pellets
chem_anfo.description: A handful of brownish pellets, made by allowing ammonium nitrate to absorb an organic fuel.  This ammonium nitrate/fuel oil mixture, or ANFO, is a common industrial explosive due to its stability and low price.  Burns fast, but needs an explosive primer to detonate.

chem_black_powder.name: black gunpowder
chem_black_powder.description: A handful of black gunpowder, a mix of saltpeter, charcoal, and sulfur.  Pretty useless for making modern cartridges, as the soot produced when it burns will quickly clog any firearm, but it could be used to make some vicious bombs.

chem_rdx.name: Hexogen/RDX powder
chem_rdx.description: A handful of Hexogen powder or RDX, commonly known as cyclonite: a military-grade, shelf-stable high explosive white, crystalline powder.  Can be cast into shaped charges, or mixed with scrap to pepper the blast area with high-velocity shrapnel.

chem_compositionb.name: composition B
chem_compositionb.description: Composition B is an explosive consisting of castable mixtures of Hexogen/RDX and TNT.  It is used as the main explosive filling in artillery projectiles, rockets, land mines, hand grenades, and various other munitions.

chem_hmtd.name: HMTD powder
chem_hmtd.description: Hexamine peroxide: this fine, yellowish powder is a powerful primary explosive, used to initiate detonation of more stable explosives, such as RDX.  Relatively stable, but best not store it for too long.  Widely used pre-Cataclysm in amateur-made blasting caps.

chem_apex.name: Acetone Peroxide/APEX powder
chem_apex.description: Acetone peroxide, also called APEX or Mother of Satan: this fine, white crystalline powder is a powerful primary explosive, used to initiate detonation of more stable explosives, such as RDX.  Relatively stable, with a fruit-like smell when pure.

chem_rocket_fuel.name: chunk of improvised rocket fuel
chem_rocket_fuel.description: A chunk of a zinc powder-and-sulfur mixture, mixed with superglue to form a solid, that can be used as an impromptu rocket fuel.

pur_tablets.name: water purification tablet
pur_tablets.description: Intended for the clarification and disinfection of unsafe drinking water while camping or traveling, this sodium dichloroisocyanurate-based purification tablet removes dangerous contaminants using powerful chemicals.  The label says to use one tablet per liter (4 units of water).

hickory_root.name: hickory root
hickory_root.description: A root from a hickory tree.  It has an earthy smell.

hickory_nut.name: hickory nuts
hickory_nut.description: A handful of hard nuts from a hickory tree, still in their shells.

pecan.name: pecans
pecan.description: A handful of hard nuts from a pecan tree, still in their shells.

pistachio.name: pistachios
pistachio.description: A handful of hard nuts from a pistachio tree, still in their shells.

almond.name: almonds
almond.description: A handful of hard nuts from an almond tree, still in their shells.

peanut.name: peanuts
peanut.description: A handful of hard nuts from a peanut bush, still in their shells.

hazelnut.name: hazelnuts
hazelnut.description: A handful of hard nuts from a hazelnut tree, still in their shells.

chestnut.name: chestnuts
chestnut.description: A handful of hard nuts from a chestnut tree, still in their shells.

walnut.name: walnuts
walnut.description: A handful of hard nuts from a walnut tree, still in their shells.

butternut.name: butternuts
butternut.description: A handful of nuts from a butternut tree, still in their shell.

butternut_husk.name: butternut husks
butternut_husk.description: A handful of husks from a butternuts, emptied of their meat.

water_sewage.name: sewage water
water_sewage.description: Turbid liquid from the sewers with an awful stench.

soap_flakes.name: soap flakes
soap_flakes.description: A handful of flakes shaved off a bar of soap, suitable for use in a washing machine.

lye.name: lye
lye.description: A liquid form of sodium hydroxide.  It is highly corrosive; handle with care.

lye_potassium.name: potassium lye
lye_potassium.description: A liquid form of potassium hydroxide.  It is highly corrosive; handle with care.

nanomaterial.name: nanomaterial canister
nanomaterial.description: A steel canister containing carbon, iron, titanium, copper, and other elements in specifically engineered atomic-scale configurations.  A nanofabricator can assemble them into usable items.

ash.name: wood ashes
ash.description: A handful of almost-weightless residue left after the burning of some substance.

corpse_ash.name: corpse ashes
corpse_ash.description: The burnt remains of a person or animal.

ether.name: ether
ether.description: A useful industrial solvent, and the first inhalative anesthetic in widespread use.  Its uncomfortable side effects and tendency to explode caused it to fall out of favor decades ago in the developed world.  If you can't get the good stuff, however, it might make a passable substitute.

chem_DMSO.name: dimethyl sulfoxide
chem_DMSO.description: Dimethyl sulfoxide, or DMSO, is a common and important aprotic solvent, capable of dissolving a huge range of things.  It has the unusual property of being absorbed very quickly through the skin, causing a garlic flavor in the mouth, even if it touched your arm.

chem_chloroform.name: chloroform
chem_chloroform.description: Famous for its properties as an illicit sedative, this substance is also a very good solvent.  In particular, it's used a lot in nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy.

chem_phenol.name: phenol
chem_phenol.description: A useful and potent solvent with a wide range of reactive applications.  It can be used to make a huge number of plastics and polymers, it can be an antiseptic, it can strip paint and break down epoxy, and it can burn your skin away like tissue paper under a heat gun.  Wear gloves.

chem_benzene.name: benzene
chem_benzene.description: A colorless, highly flammable liquid with a sweet odor, one of the elementary petrochemicals.  Being used primarily as a precursor to the manufacture of chemicals with more complex structure, it's a major industrial chemical, but finds limited use in consumer items because of its toxicity.

chem_toluene.name: toluene
chem_toluene.description: A colorless, toxic, and highly flammable liquid which smells like paint thinner.  It's predominantly used as an industrial feedstock and a solvent, and is also used as an intoxicative inhalant in a manner unintended by manufacturers.

chem_glycerol.name: glycerol
chem_glycerol.description: Also called glycerin, this clear, odorless liquid is both a handy skin moisturizer and an ingredient necessary to make dynamite.

chem_peptone_broth.name: peptone water powder
chem_peptone_broth.description: A pre-mixed salty solution of protein and sugar meant for bacteria to eat.

chem_agar.name: agar flake
chem_agar.description: Clear flakes of processed seaweed that can be dissolved in boiling water to create a very sturdy, temperature-resistant gel.  Not only is it good for making gels to separate molecules by size, but it's a great cheat ingredient to make sure your jellies set properly.

chem_acrylamide.name: acrylamide powder
chem_acrylamide.description: A handful of highly carcinogenic white powder that can be readily polymerized into a whole bunch of useful water-soluble gels.

steel_grille.name: steel grille
steel_grille.description: A metal grille.  It can be used as a framework for making a chemical catalyst.

cobalt_60.name: cobalt-60 pellet
cobalt_60.description: A piece of unshielded radioactive material that used to be a part of some nuclear industry equipment.  You have yet to find some use for it, and you probably shouldn't stand near it.

wooden_bead.name: wooden bead
wooden_bead.description: A wooden bead.  It can be used to craft inscribable jewelry or create a beaded curtain door.

rosin.name: rosin
rosin.description: A chunk of yellowish rosin, usable as a flux for soldering.

acetylene.name: acetylene
acetylene.description: A flammable gas that explodes under pressure.  Combined with oxygen, acetylene makes a great welding gas.

formic_acid.name: formic acid
formic_acid.description: Common in nature as an insect venom, this substance has a number of industrial uses such as preservation and manufacturing.

latex.name: latex
latex.description: A liquid precursor to rubber found in some plants.

chem_citric_acid.name: citric acid powder
chem_citric_acid.description: A manufactured form of citric acid that is commonly used as an additive in food, cleaning agents, and nutritional supplements.

venom_wasp.name: wasp venom gland
venom_wasp.description: A fragile, slightly quivering organ for the production and storage of wasp venom.  You could extract some very useful chemicals from it with the right know-how, but only if you hurry.

venom_bee.name: bee venom gland
venom_bee.description: A fragile, slightly quivering organ for the production and storage of honeybee venom.  You could extract some very useful chemicals from it with the right know-how, but only if you hurry.

venom_paralytic.name: sac of paralytic venom
venom_paralytic.description: A grayish, flexible vesicle filled to the brim with the potent paralytic agent the triffids use to subdue still-moving fertilizer such as yourself.  If you know your way around poisons you might be able to find a use for it.

triffid_fungicide.name: sac of triffid fungicide
triffid_fungicide.description: A triffid sac filled with what appears to be a triffid-produced antifungal agent.  It will likely already work as an antifungal compound for more offensive applications, but requires further refining before it can be used as a medical drug.

conc_venom.name: concentrated venom
conc_venom.description: A transparent, lightly greenish liquid, refined from the venom of bees and wasps.  Active ingredients include (nor-)adrenaline, dopamine, histamine, and protein toxins.  It is now relatively stable, but will require further separation to be useful for anything other than killing you.

conc_paralytic.name: concentrated paralytic
conc_paralytic.description: A concentrated paralytic agent, originally from a triffid.  Given your experience with its effects (chiefly gathered while sourcing this batch) and their striking similarity to earthly flora, you figure it's related to curarines.  Might come in handy in crafting more useful things.

rocuronium.name: rocuronium
rocuronium.description: Rocuronium bromide, a fast-acting muscle relaxant.  Used primarily in emergency medicine because of its relative stability, it can serve as a component of a balanced anesthesia in a pinch.

red_phosphorous.name: red phosphorous powder
red_phosphorous.description: An allotrope of the element phosphorous.  It's what you use to light matches, but can also be used in the synthesis of methamphetamine.  You could use it to make bombs, and if you were truly desperate you might even be able to use it in small portions as a propellant for bullets.

red_phosphorous_small.name: scrapings of red phosphorous powder
red_phosphorous_small.description: A small collection of red phosphorous scrapings, scavenged from match heads.  An allotrope of the element phosphorous.  It's what you use to light matches, but can also be used in the synthesis of methamphetamine.  You could use it to make bombs, and if you were truly desperate you might even be able to use it as a propellant for bullets.

white_phosphorous.name: white phosphorous powder
white_phosphorous.description: An allotrope of the element phosphorous.  Extremely flammable, produces toxic smoke, you can use it to make smoke bombs.

acetic_anhydride.name: acetic anhydride
acetic_anhydride.description: A colorless liquid that smells strongly of vinegar.  If you have enough chemical knowledge, you could use it to easily convert morphine into heroin.

iodine_crystal.name: iodine crystals
iodine_crystal.description: A handful of resublimed crystals of the element iodine, they can be used as an antiseptic, but are also used in the making of methamphetamine.

liquid_soap.name: liquid soap
liquid_soap.description: Standard skin-safe liquid soap, the type you might see on a kitchen sink, shower shelf, or bathroom soap dispenser, but it should work reasonably well for cleaning anything that's filthy.

pine_resin.name: pine resin
pine_resin.description: A sticky, sludgy mass of sap harvested from a pine tree.

silicone.name: silicone caulk
silicone.description: A thick gray paste used as a sealant in many construction projects.

blood_acid.name: toxic acidic blood
blood_acid.description: Blood mixed with acidic compounds, extremely corrosive, a means of refining this could net some useful chemicals.

blood_acid_insect.name: virulent acidic blood
blood_acid_insect.description: Blood mixed with acidic compounds, extremely corrosive, a means of refining this could net some useful chemicals.

blood_acid_plant.name: putrid acidic blood
blood_acid_plant.description: Blood mixed with acidic compounds, smells putrid, a means of refining this could net some useful chemicals.

blood_acid_underground.name: foul acidic blood
blood_acid_underground.description: Blood mixed with acidic compounds, foul-smelling and extremely corrosive, a means of refining this could net some useful chemicals.

exodii_ceramic_patch.name: exodii ceramic patch
exodii_ceramic_patch.description: A patch kit produced by the Exodii for repairing their nanotube-infused ceramics.  Requires a kiln.

material_styrofoam_sheet.name: styrofoam sheet
material_styrofoam_sheet.description: Bulky, but extremely light sheet of styrofoam, designed to be used in building insulation.

glue_weak.name: weak glue
glue_weak.description: A weak adhesive to use in arts & crafts or other low stress applications.  You can't eat it.

glue_strong.name: strong glue
glue_strong.description: A strong adhesive to use for structural repairs or other high stress applications.  You can't sniff it, but you can use it to close up wounds in a pinch.

wine_mycus.name: Mycus wine
wine_mycus.description: Goopy white wine, made of the Mycus fruit.

wine_marloss.name: Marloss wine
wine_marloss.description: A viscous, soft pink wine, made from the fruit of the Marloss.

wine_riesling.name: Riesling
wine_riesling.description: Sparkling white wine, made from the world's noblest grape.

wine_chardonnay.name: Chardonnay
wine_chardonnay.description: America's most popular wine, and for good reason.

wine_cabernet.name: Cabernet Sauvignon
wine_cabernet.description: The heavily disputed king of red wines.  Pairs well with red meats and pasta.

wine_noir.name: Pinot noir
wine_noir.description: Prized by collectors and adored by critics, this is one of the rarer and more elegant wines.

wine_marsala.name: marsala
wine_marsala.description: A wine popularly used in dishes served in Italian restaurants.

wine_vermouth.name: vermouth
wine_vermouth.description: A soft wine with a pleasant herbal flavor and aroma.  It is a common cocktail ingredient, and can be used as a substitute for white wine.

wine_barley.name: barley wine
wine_barley.description: Despite the name, this is technically a strong beer and not wine, but there's no need to be pedantic about it.

whiskey.name: whiskey
whiskey.description: A distilled grain alcohol, made from, by, and for real Southern colonels!

vodka.name: vodka
vodka.description: A beverage of alcohol, water, and not much else.  In America, men make vodka, but in Soviet Russia, vodka makes the man.

gin.name: gin
gin.description: An alcoholic beverage flavored with juniper berries.  It smells faintly of berries, but mostly booze.

rum.name: rum
rum.description: A distilled alcoholic beverage made from fermenting molasses.  Drinking it might make you feel like a pirate.  Or not.

tequila.name: tequila
tequila.description: A distilled alcoholic beverage made from a succulent plant with spiky leaves.  Don't eat the worm!  Wait, there's no worm in this bottle.

triple_sec.name: triple sec
triple_sec.description: An orange-flavored liquor used in many mixed drinks.

sake_filtered.name: sake
sake_filtered.description: A Japanese alcoholic beverage made by fermenting rice with the use of yeast and koji mold.  This one is mostly clear, as it has been filtered.

sake_unfiltered.name: nigori sake
sake_unfiltered.description: A Japanese alcoholic beverage made by fermenting rice with the use of yeast and koji mold.  This one has a cloudy white color because of fine rice particles in it, as it has not been filtered.

mixed_alcohol_strong.name: strong mixed alcohol
mixed_alcohol_strong.description: Strong alcoholic drinks, mixed with no regard for taste.

mixed_alcohol_weak.name: weak mixed alcohol
mixed_alcohol_weak.description: Weak alcoholic drinks, mixed with no regard for taste.

fruit_wine.name: fruit wine
fruit_wine.description: Cheap booze made from fermented fruit juice.  Tastes as good as it sounds.

brandy.name: brandy
brandy.description: Wine that has been distilled to a higher proof.  Great as an after-dinner drink, but packs a punch.

drink_queenmary.name: Queen Mary cocktail
drink_queenmary.description: A cocktail made by mixing beer and grenadine syrup.  It's quite sweet.

irish_coffee.name: Irish coffee
irish_coffee.description: Sweetened coffee and whiskey topped with milk.  Start your day the closeted alcoholic way!

drink_karsk.name: karsk
drink_karsk.description: A cocktail made by mixing coffee and pure alcohol, typically moonshine, originating from Scandinavia.  Sometimes sugar is also added.

drink_gunfire.name: gunfire cocktail
drink_gunfire.description: A cocktail made by mixing black tea and rum, which has its origins in the British Army.

long_island.name: Long Island iced tea
long_island.description: A blend of incredibly strong-flavored liquors that somehow tastes like none of them.  It contains no tea, but the inclusion of cola gives it a tea-like color.

drink_screwdriver.name: screwdriver cocktail
drink_screwdriver.description: A mix of orange juice and vodka.  It's the surreptitious drunkard mechanic's drink of choice.  A similar drink may be made by substituting cranberry juice for orange juice.

drink_wild_apple.name: wild apple
drink_wild_apple.description: Like apple cider, only with vodka.

drink_rumcola.name: rum & cola
drink_rumcola.description: Suitable for tropical retreats and Canadian artists alike.  In certain variants, whiskey or sake is substituted for rum.

drink_grog.name: grog
drink_grog.description: An early 17th century drink eventually popularized by sailors as a easy ration that contained alcohol and often a dash of sugar.  Though it barely contains any alcohol, it's probably better tasting than water, probably.

drink_gintonic.name: gin and tonic
drink_gintonic.description: A mixed alcoholic drink consisting of gin and tonic water, created in the 19th century as a way to make tonic water (a malaria prophylactic) more palatable, but still popular to this day.  In certain variants, vodka is substituted for gin.

drink_pinacolada.name: piña colada
drink_pinacolada.description: A cocktail consisting of pineapple juice, coconut milk, and rum, originating in Puerto Rico.  In certain variants, vodka, whiskey, or tequila are substituted for rum.

drink_tequilasunrise.name: tequila sunrise
drink_tequilasunrise.description: A cocktail consisting of tequila, orange juice, and grenadine syrup, originating from California.  In certain variants, vodka or rum may be substituted for tequila, and pineapple juice may be substituted for orange juice.

beer.name: beer
beer.description: A generic-brand grain alcohol flavored with hops.  It's best served cold, in a glass, and with a lime - but you're not that lucky.

mead.name: hops spiced mead
mead.description: Well-aged honey wine, spiced with a hint of hops.  Goes down bittersweet.

hopped_mead.name: hopped mead
hopped_mead.description: Homebrewed honey wine, spiced with a bit of hops.  Goes down bittersweet.

plain_mead.name: mead
plain_mead.description: Homebrewed honey wine, a smooth and silky golden beverage.

spiced_mead.name: spiced mead
spiced_mead.description: Homebrewed spiced honey wine, a tasty beverage that can be served hot or cold.

dandelion_wine.name: dandelion wine
dandelion_wine.description: A light and delicious wine made from dandelion flowers.  Slightly effervescent, it is smooth and crisp.

burdock_wine.name: burdock wine
burdock_wine.description: A light and delicious wine made from burdock roots.  Somewhat sweet.

pine_wine.name: pine wine
pine_wine.description: A potent wine flavored with pine resin.  Bold and pungent, its biting taste and strong aroma takes some getting used to.

hb_beer.name: homebrew beer
hb_beer.description: Not the finest drink you've had, but hey, it's alcohol by the gallon.

moonshine.name: moonshine
moonshine.description: Only the strongest, purest, good ol' fashioned hooch, distilled from corn (or pumpkin) and sugar.  Guaranteed to make you forget about the whole Cataclysm thing, or you get your vision back.

european_pilsner.name: European pilsner
european_pilsner.description: A lager beer imported from Europe.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.

pale_ale.name: American pale ale
pale_ale.description: A tasty domestic craft beer.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.

india_pale_ale.name: India pale ale
india_pale_ale.description: A very flavorful microbrewed beer.  Best served cold, in a glass - but you're not that lucky.

stout.name: stout
stout.description: A tasty craft beer, as dark in color as the days ahead.

belgian_ale.name: Belgian ale
belgian_ale.description: A flavorful and filling beer brewed by monks in Belgium.  Best served in a goblet.

imperial_stout.name: imperial stout
imperial_stout.description: A very flavorful beer that has been aged in bourbon barrels.  It is as black as midnight on a moonless night and has the viscosity of oil.  While very tasty, it also has an alcohol content on par with wine.

drink_strawberry_surprise.name: strawberry surprise
drink_strawberry_surprise.description: Strawberries left to ferment with a few other choice ingredients offer up a surprisingly palatable mixture; you barely even have to force yourself to drink it after the first few gulps.

drink_boozeberry.name: boozeberry
drink_boozeberry.description: This fermented blueberry mixture is surprisingly hearty, though the soup-like consistency is slightly unsettling no matter how much you drink.

single_malt_whiskey.name: single malt whiskey
single_malt_whiskey.description: Only the finest whiskey straight from the bung.

single_pot_whiskey.name: single pot still Irish whiskey
single_pot_whiskey.description: A whiskey made from a mixed mash of malted and unmalted barley.

canadian_whiskey.name: Canadian whiskey
canadian_whiskey.description: A multi-grain liquor made from a mash of corn and rye.

sherry.name: sherry
sherry.description: East India Solera.  A true drink of a British gentleman.  Sherry, Niles?

bristol_sherry.name: Bristol Cream
bristol_sherry.description: A fine sherry that has been aged in American oak casks and bottled in Bristol, England.

madeira.name: Madeira wine
madeira.description: Fortified wine from Madeira.  A true Royal Navy drink.

drink_hobo.name: fancy hobo
drink_hobo.description: This definitely tastes like a hobo drink.

drink_kalimotxo.name: kalimotxo
drink_kalimotxo.description: A mix of equal parts wine and cola, originating in Spain in the 1920s.  Tastes better than it sounds.

drink_beeknees.name: bee's knees
drink_beeknees.description: This cocktail dates from the Prohibition era.  Gin, honey, and lemon in a delightful mix.

drink_wsour.name: whiskey sour
drink_wsour.description: A mixed drink made of whiskey and lemon juice, with sugar added.  In certain variants, gin is substituted for whiskey.

honey_gold.name: honeygold brew
honey_gold.description: A mixed drink combining bee and ant honey.  It tastes great, and it's a good source of nourishment.

honey_ant.name: honey ball
honey_ant.description: Droplet-shaped ant food.  It's like a thick balloon the size of a baseball, filled with sticky liquid.  Unlike bee honey, this has mostly a sour taste, probably because ants feed upon a variety of things.

eggnog_spiked.name: spiked eggnog
eggnog_spiked.description: Smooth and rich, this spoon-coating mixture of milk, cream, eggs, and booze is a popular traditional holiday drink.  Having been fortified with alcohol, it will keep for a long time.

drink_martini.name: martini
drink_martini.description: A popular cocktail made with gin and dry vermouth, dating from the Prohibition era.  In certain variants, vodka or tequila is substituted for gin.

drink_bloody_mary.name: Bloody Mary cocktail
drink_bloody_mary.description: Tomato juice mixed with vodka and some spices.  A hangover cure of choice for many.

drink_bloody_mary_blood.name: 'very' Bloody Mary cocktail
drink_bloody_mary_blood.description: This is definitely not tomato juice.

drink_hard_seltzer.name: hard seltzer
drink_hard_seltzer.description: Alcoholic sparkling water infused with delicious fruit.  Perfect for a hot summer day.

hb_seltzer.name: homebrew hard seltzer
hb_seltzer.description: Alcoholic sparkling water infused with delicious fruit.  Perfect for a hot summer day.  Tastes nearly as good as the one in the market.

alien_meadow_bush_2_fruit.name: handful of alien berries
alien_meadow_bush_2_fruit.description: A handful of white berries plucked from an otherworldly bush.  You're not sure if eating them is a good idea, but they sure look tasty.

alien_meadow_tree_3_fruit.name: alien fruit
alien_meadow_tree_3_fruit.description: A large fruit pulled from an alien tree.  The rind is extremely hard and you'll need to cut into it to eat it.

pumpkin_muffins.name: pumpkin muffin
pumpkin_muffins.description: A baked pumpkin-apple muffin.  Perfect for a fall feast.

hazelnut_cake.name: slice of hazelnut cake
hazelnut_cake.description: This traditional hazelnut cake (or Bagȣnizabȣnak cake in Abenaki) is a nice, protein-rich treat for cold days.

baklava.name: baklava
baklava.description: A layered pastry dessert made of filo pastry, filled with chopped nuts, and sweetened with syrup or honey.

religieuse_au_chocolat.name: religieuse au chocolat
religieuse_au_chocolat.description: A a French pastry made of a small choux pastry case stacked on top of a larger one, both filled with crème pâtissière, flavored with chocolate.  Each case is topped with a ganache of chocolate, then attached to each other using piped buttercream icing.  Named the religieuse because when made properly, the pastries look like nuns in habits.

gateau_st_honore.name: slice of gateau St. Honore
gateau_st_honore.description: A gâteau St. Honoré is a French cake that incorporates layers of classic puff pastry, balls of choux pastry, and pastry cream.  This cake originated in nineteenth-century France and was named after Saint Honoré, the French patron saint of bakers and pastry chefs.

donut_holes.name: donut hole
donut_holes.description: These balls of dough have been cut into shape, covered with sugar, and cooked to a crisp.  A staple of fairgrounds everywhere.

sourdough_young_uncovered_active.name: juvenile sourdough starter
sourdough_young_uncovered_active.description: A floury paste that is slowly going bad.  Someday it will be sourdough.

sourdough_split_uncovered_active.name: freshly fed sourdough starter
sourdough_split_uncovered_active.description: A floury paste with sourdough starter mixed in.  It needs a day to recover its strength before it can be used again.

sourdough_starter_uncovered.name: sourdough starter
sourdough_starter_uncovered.description: A precious mix of flour, water, molds, and bacteria from the air.  When you add flour and water to it, after a few hours it froths and rises.

sourdough_bread.name: sourdough bread
sourdough_bread.description: Healthy and filling, with a sharper taste and thicker crust than yeast-only bread.

frybread.name: frybread
frybread.description: Delicious fried flatbread.  While it's not pre-contact food, it's a popular treat in many Native American households, especially as an ingredient for Indian tacos at Powwows or for Thanksgiving.

bread.name: bread
bread.description: A humble piece of bread, one of the single most important staple foods of human civilization since the dawn of agriculture.

bread_garlic.name: garlic bread
bread_garlic.description: Bread cooked with garlic, oil, and seasonings.

toast.name: toast
toast.description: A slice of bread with heat applied to crisp it up.  It's a bit dry and would likely go better with some toppings.

buttered_toast.name: buttered toast
buttered_toast.description: A slice of toast with butter spread on top to make it taste better.

jam_toast.name: jam toast
jam_toast.description: A slice of toast with jam added, to make it less dry and to add more flavor.

peanut_butter_toast.name: peanut butter toast
peanut_butter_toast.description: A slathering of peanut butter gives more heartiness and calories to a slice of toast.

toad_in_a_hole.name: toad in a hole
toad_in_a_hole.description: A cooked egg served inside a piece of toast, not to be confused with the English recipe of the same name.

PBJ_Toast.name: PBJ toast
PBJ_Toast.description: A slice of toast with peanut butter and jelly on top, with added butter for flavor.

cornbread.name: cornbread
cornbread.description: Healthy and filling cornbread, a Native American recipe that quickly became a staple of U.S. cuisine.

johnnycake.name: johnnycake
johnnycake.description: A dense and tasty fried bread treat.

tortilla_corn.name: corn tortilla
tortilla_corn.description: A round, thin flatbread made from finely ground corn flour.

tortilla_flour.name: flour tortilla
tortilla_flour.description: A round, thin flatbread made from finely ground wheat flour.

hardtack_cracker.name: hardtack cracker
hardtack_cracker.description: A dry, virtually tasteless bread cracker capable of remaining edible without spoilage for vast lengths of time.  So hard it is inedible by itself.  Usually broken into smaller pieces for consumption.

hardtack.name: hardtack
hardtack.description: A dry, virtually tasteless bread product capable of remaining edible without spoilage for vast lengths of time.  So hard it is inedible by itself.

soggy_hardtack.name: soggy hardtack
soggy_hardtack.description: A soggy, virtually tasteless bread product that has soaked up enough water that it won't hurt your teeth when you chew it.

biscuit.name: biscuit
biscuit.description: Hardtack's much more palatable descendant, thanks in large part to the addition of milk in the recipe.  Crumbly on the outside, soft on the inside, and delicious all the way through.

wastebread.name: wastebread
wastebread.description: Flour is a commodity these days and to deal with that, most survivors resort to mixing it with leftovers of other ingredients and baking it all into bread.  It's filling, and that's what matters.

brown_bread.name: brown bread
brown_bread.description: Sweet bread made with molasses, with a consistency closer to cake.

hallula.name: hallula
hallula.description: A type of bread popular in Chile and Bolivia.  Prepared using animal tallow or oil, it resembles a large, round scone.  In the pre-Cataclysm world, it would usually be filled with savory ingredients.

brew_mycus_wine.name: Mycus wine must
brew_mycus_wine.description: Unfermented Mycus wine.  A goopy white mess, made from Mycus fruit.  It smells sweetly of mushrooms.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_marloss_wine.name: Marloss wine must
brew_marloss_wine.description: Unfermented Marloss wine.  A soft pinkish mess, made from Marloss berries.  It has a strong aroma, but you're not quite sure if it's a good or bad one.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_whiskey.name: whiskey wort
brew_whiskey.description: Unfermented whiskey.  The base of a fine drink.  Not the traditional preparation, but you don't have the time.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

wash_whiskey.name: whiskey wash
wash_whiskey.description: Fermented, but not distilled whiskey.  No longer tastes sweet.  You may want to distill it before drinking.

brew_gin.name: gin mash
brew_gin.description: Unfermented gin mash.  Fermenting it will produce gin.

gin_mash.name: gin wash
gin_mash.description: Gin wash, after the junipers have had time to add flavor.  Ready to be distilled or drunk as is.

brew_sake.name: sake mash
brew_sake.description: A fine mix of water, koji rice, and yeast, ready to be fermented into sake once set in a fermenting vat.

brew_soy_sauce.name: unfermented soy sauce
brew_soy_sauce.description: Brine with mashed soybeans, wheat flour, and koji mold added to it.  If you want to make soy sauce from this, the next step would be to let it ferment.

soy_sauce_unstrained.name: unstrained soy sauce
soy_sauce_unstrained.description: Nearly-finished soy sauce that still has some solid particles floating in it.  Still needs to be strained, and also pasteurized to get rid of harmful bacteria.

brew_vodka.name: vodka wort
brew_vodka.description: Unfermented vodka.  Water with sugar from the enzymatic breakdown of malted grains, or just added in pure form.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

wash_vodka.name: vodka wash
wash_vodka.description: Fermented, but not distilled vodka.  No longer tastes sweet.  You may want to distill it before drinking.

brew_rum.name: rum wort
brew_rum.description: Unfermented rum.  Sugar, caramel, or molasses brewed into sweet water.  Basically a saccharine soup.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

wash_rum.name: rum wash
wash_rum.description: Fermented, but not distilled rum.  No longer tastes sweet.  You may want to distill it before drinking.

brew_fruit_wine.name: fruit wine must
brew_fruit_wine.description: Unfermented fruit wine.  A sweet, boiled juice made from berries or fruit.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_mead.name: mead must
brew_mead.description: Unfermented plain mead.  Diluted honey and yeast.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_hopped_mead.name: hopped mead must
brew_hopped_mead.description: Unfermented hopped mead.  Diluted honey cooked with hops for a bitter note, then cooled down and infused with yeast.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_spiced_mead.name: spiced mead must
brew_spiced_mead.description: Unfermented spiced mead.  Diluted honey infused with spices and yeast.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_dandelion_wine.name: dandelion wine must
brew_dandelion_wine.description: Unfermented dandelion wine.  A sticky mixture of water, sugar, yeast, and dandelion petals.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_burdock_wine.name: burdock wine must
brew_burdock_wine.description: Unfermented burdock wine.  A sticky mixture of water, sugar, yeast, and burdock roots.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_pine_wine.name: pine wine must
brew_pine_wine.description: Unfermented pine wine.  A sticky mixture of water, sugar, yeast, and pine resin.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_hb_beer.name: beer wort
brew_hb_beer.description: Unfermented homebrew beer.  A boiled and chilled mash of malted barley, spiced with some fine hops.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_hb_seltzer.name: seltzer wort
brew_hb_seltzer.description: Unfermented seltzer.  A boiled and chilled mash of refined sugar and fruit.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

brew_moonshine.name: moonshine mash
brew_moonshine.description: Unfermented moonshine.  Just some water, sugar, and corn, like good ol' auntie's recipe.  Using pumpkin instead of corn would reduce the amount of extra sugar you need to add.  You need to put it in a fermenting vat to brew it.

wash_moonshine.name: moonshine wash
wash_moonshine.description: Fermented, but not distilled moonshine.  Contains all the contaminants you don't want in your moonshine, so you may want to distill it first.

brew_milk_curdled.name: curdling milk
brew_milk_curdled.description: Milk with vinegar and natural rennet added.  Used for making cheese if left in a fermenting vat for some time.

brew_vinegar.name: unfermented vinegar
brew_vinegar.description: A mixture of water, alcohol, and fruit juice that will eventually become vinegar when fermented in a vat.

young_yeast.name: growing wild yeast
young_yeast.description: A sugary solution with some naturally occurring yeast.  If placed in a fermenting vat and given time, it will eventually produce a more sizeable yeast culture.

malting_grain_active.name: malting grain
malting_grain_active.description: Malting grain that can be used for brewing.

malted_grain.name: malted grain
malted_grain.description: Grainy cereal used for malting.  A staple of brewing everywhere.  It can also be ground into flour.

soaking_dandelion_active.name: soaking dandelion
soaking_dandelion_active.description: Soaked dandelions that can be used for brewing.

soaked_dandelion.name: soaked dandelion
soaked_dandelion.description: Dandelions soaked in hot water, used for making dandelion wine.

fermenting_yogurt_active.name: fermenting yogurt
fermenting_yogurt_active.description: Milk inoculated with lactobacillus.  It requires some time fermenting to hopefully end up as delicious yogurt.

brew_rootbeer.name: unfermented root beer
brew_rootbeer.description: A mixture of water, sugar, yeast, and sassafras roots that will eventually become root beer, if brewed in a fermenting vat.

froglegs.name: frog legs (pair)
froglegs.description: A raw pair of frog legs.  Tastes like chicken when cooked or smoked.

froglegs_cooked.name: cooked frog legs (pair)
froglegs_cooked.description: A raw pair of frog legs.  Tastes like chicken when cooked or smoked.

froglegs_smoked.name: smoked frog legs (pair)
froglegs_smoked.description: A raw pair of frog legs.  Tastes like chicken when cooked or smoked.

fish.name: fillet of fish
fish.description: An uncooked fish fillet.  Makes a passable meal raw.

fish_scrap.name: scrap of fish
fish_scrap.description: A tiny scrap of edible fish.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.

fish_scrap_cooked.name: cooked scrap of fish
fish_scrap_cooked.description: A tiny scrap of edible fish.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.

fish_cooked.name: cooked fish
fish_cooked.description: A cooked fish fillet.  Very nutritious.

lobster.name: chunk of lobster meat
lobster.description: A chunk of uncooked lobster meat.

lobster_cooked.name: cooked lobster
lobster_cooked.description: A chunk of delicious cooked lobster meat.

mollusk.name: fillet of mollusk
mollusk.description: The raw flesh of a mollusk.  Must be cleaned and cooked before eating.

mollusk_cooked.name: cooked mollusk
mollusk_cooked.description: Cooked mollusk meat.  Devoid of any parasites or bacteria due to heat, the only thing left to do is add sauce.

gastropod_purged.name: purged gastropods
gastropod_purged.description: A handful of lucky gastropods that have been prepared for cooking by repeatedly boiling and washing them to remove their mucus and pathogens.

gastropod_cooked.name: cooked gastropods
gastropod_cooked.description: Cooked gastropods.  A bit low on calories, but high in protein.

oyster.name: oyster in shell
oyster.description: A medium-sized oyster.  Delicious served raw on the half-shell.  You'll need to shuck it to eat it.

oyster_shucked.name: shucked oyster
oyster_shucked.description: A live oyster floating in its liquor.

hstomach.name: human stomach
hstomach.description: The stomach of a human.  It is surprisingly durable.

hstomach_large.name: large human stomach
hstomach_large.description: The stomach of a large humanoid creature.  It is surprisingly durable.

human_fat.name: chunk of human fat
human_fat.description: A chunk of raw fat, harvested from a human body.

human_tallow.name: human tallow
human_tallow.description: A smooth, white block of cleaned and rendered human fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

human_flesh.name: human flesh
human_flesh.description: A chunk of raw meat, butchered from a human body.

human_cooked.name: cooked creep
human_cooked.description: A cooked slice of 'long pig'.  Tastes vary from person to person.

meat.name: chunk of meat
meat.description: A chunk of raw meat.  You could eat it as-is, but cooking it is better.

animal_blood.name: animal blood
animal_blood.description: Blood extracted from a living creature.

porkbelly.name: chunk of porkbelly
porkbelly.description: A fatty cut of pork from the belly, popular in some cuisine.  With proper technique, it can be used to create bacon.  Not safe to consume in its current raw form.

raw_cured_fatty_meat.name: slab of raw cured porkbelly
raw_cured_fatty_meat.description: Porkbelly that has been preserved and flavored with salt and sugar to draw out the moisture from the first layer.  Still raw, it is ready for smoking into bacon.

bacon_uncut.name: large slab of uncut bacon
bacon_uncut.description: A huge slab of uncut smoked bacon.  You can eat it as is, but it would be more efficient to cut it into smaller portions with a knife.

bacon_uncooked.name: uncooked bacon
bacon_uncooked.description: A thick slab of salty cured bacon.

raw_curing_fatty_meat_active.name: slab of raw curing porkbelly
raw_curing_fatty_meat_active.description: Porkbelly in the process of becoming fully cured with salt and sugar, capable of becoming bacon.  The flavor is slowly developing at this stage, and is significantly unpleasant due to the residual salt.  Activate it once completed to make use of the final product.

meat_scrap.name: scrap of meat
meat_scrap.description: A tiny scrap of raw meat.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.

human_meat_scrap.name: scrap of human flesh
human_meat_scrap.description: A tiny scrap of raw human flesh.

demihuman_meat_scrap.name: scrap of demihuman flesh
demihuman_meat_scrap.description: A tiny scrap of raw demihuman flesh.

mutant_meat.name: chunk of mutant meat
mutant_meat.description: Raw meat from a heavily mutated animal.

mutant_blood.name: mutant blood
mutant_blood.description: Blood extracted from a heavily mutated creature.

mutant_meat_scrap.name: scrap of mutant meat
mutant_meat_scrap.description: A tiny scrap of raw meat from a heavily mutated animal.  It smells unappealing, to say the least.

mutant_human_flesh.name: mutant humanoid meat
mutant_human_flesh.description: Raw meat butchered from the body of a heavily mutated creature that was unsettlingly humanoid in appearance.  It has odd bits of fur and other tissue lodged in it that clearly don't belong.  You'd have to be crazy or starving to eat this.

mutant_human_blood.name: mutant human blood
mutant_human_blood.description: Blood extracted from a heavily mutated human.

mutant_human_cooked.name: cooked cretin
mutant_human_cooked.description: Cooked meat from a heavily mutated humanoid.  Now that the worst bits have been picked out, it's probably digestible, if not very appetizing.

meat_mutant_tainted.name: chunk of tainted mutant meat
meat_mutant_tainted.description: Raw meat from a heavily mutated animal.

meat_mutant_tainted_cooked.name: cooked tainted mutant meat
meat_mutant_tainted_cooked.description: Raw meat from a heavily mutated animal.

meat_mutant_tainted_smoked.name: smoked tainted mutant meat
meat_mutant_tainted_smoked.description: Rotten mutant meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.

ruined_chunks.name: butchery refuse
ruined_chunks.description: Eugh.  This is a mess of dirt, excreta, connective tissue, and bits of matter like hair and claws, leftover from the butchering process.  Eating it isn't even worth thinking about.

meat_cooked.name: cooked meat
meat_cooked.description: A chunk of cooked meat.  It's filling and nutritious, but unseasoned and a bit bland.

meat_fatty_cooked.name: cooked fatty meat
meat_fatty_cooked.description: A chunk of cooked fatty meat.  Although absent of vitamins, it is very filling and delightfully greasy.

meat_scrap_cooked.name: cooked scrap of meat
meat_scrap_cooked.description: A tiny scrap of raw meat.  It's not much, but it'll do in a pinch.

mutant_meat_cooked.name: cooked mutant meat
mutant_meat_cooked.description: A cooked chunk of meat from a mutated animal.

mutant_meat_scrap_cooked.name: cooked scrap of mutant meat
mutant_meat_scrap_cooked.description: A tiny scrap of cooked mutant meat.  It is small enough that it's hard to tell how disgusting it is.

cooked_marrow.name: roasted bone marrow
cooked_marrow.description: Bone marrow, fully cooked to eliminate any parasites.  Tasty!

offal.name: raw offal
offal.description: A selection of uncooked internal organs and entrails.  Filled with essential vitamins, but most people consider it a bit gross unless it's very carefully prepared.

offal_cooked.name: cooked offal
offal_cooked.description: A selection of cooked organs and entrails.  Filled with essential vitamins, but pretty unappetizing in this form.

tainted_innards.name: tainted innards
tainted_innards.description: An unidentifiable selection of rotted innards that barely hold their form.  It is revolting and certainly no longer healthy to eat.

tainted_innards_human.name: tainted innards
tainted_innards_human.description: An unidentifiable selection of rotted human innards that barely hold their form.  It is revolting and certainly no longer healthy to eat.

mutant_bug_organs.name: mutant organs
mutant_bug_organs.description: Raw organs from a giant mutant bug.

mutant_bug_organs_cooked.name: cooked mutant bug organs
mutant_bug_organs_cooked.description: A selection of cooked mutant bug organs.  Looks awful, but if you give it a try, you'll find -- that it's worse than it looks.

offal_pickled.name: pickled offal
offal_pickled.description: A mass of entrails and organ meat, preserved in brine.  Packed with essential vitamins, and although it looks like a lab specimen, it actually tastes pretty palatable.

offal_canned.name: canned offal
offal_canned.description: Cooked organ meat and entrails, preserved by canning.  Unappetizing, but filled with essential vitamins.

stomach.name: stomach
stomach.description: The stomach of a woodland creature.  It is surprisingly durable.

stomach_large.name: large stomach
stomach_large.description: The stomach of a large woodland creature.  It is surprisingly durable.

jerky.name: meat jerky
jerky.description: Salty dried meat that lasts for a long time, but will make you thirsty.

salted_fish.name: salted fish
salted_fish.description: Salty dried fish that lasts for a long time, but will make you thirsty.

salted_mollusk.name: salted mollusk
salted_mollusk.description: Salty dried mollusk that lasts for a long time, but will make you thirsty.

meat_smoked.name: smoked meat
meat_smoked.description: Tasty meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.  It could be further smoked until complete dehydration.

fish_smoked.name: smoked fish
fish_smoked.description: Tasty fish that has been heavily smoked for long term preservation.  It could be further smoked until complete dehydration.

lobster_smoked.name: smoked lobster
lobster_smoked.description: Tasty lobster that has been heavily smoked for long term preservation.  It could be further smoked until complete dehydration.

mollusk_smoked.name: smoked mollusk
mollusk_smoked.description: Tasty mollusk that has been heavily smoked for long term preservation.  It could be further smoked until complete dehydration.

lung.name: piece of raw lung
lung.description: A portion of lung from an animal.  It's spongy and pink, and spoils very quickly.  It can be a delicacy if properly prepared - but if improperly prepared, it's a chewy lump of flavorless connective tissue.

human_lung.name: piece of raw human lung
human_lung.description: A portion of lung from a human.  It's spongy and pink, and spoils very quickly.  It appears to have been extracted too crudely to ever be useful as a transplant.

demihuman_lung.name: piece of raw demihuman lung
demihuman_lung.description: A portion of lung from a demihuman being.  It's spongy and pink, and spoils very quickly.

lung_cooked.name: cooked piece of lung
lung_cooked.description: A chewy, grayish lump of flavorless connective tissue.  It doesn't look any tastier than it did raw, but any parasites are all cooked out.

mutant_lung.name: piece of raw mutant lung
mutant_lung.description: A portion of lung from an animal.  It's spongy and pink, and spoils very quickly.  It can be a delicacy if properly prepared - but if improperly prepared, it's a chewy lump of flavorless connective tissue.

mutant_lung_cooked.name: cooked piece of mutant lung
mutant_lung_cooked.description: A chewy, grayish lump of flavorless connective tissue.  It doesn't look any tastier than it did raw, but any parasites are all cooked out.

heart.name: piece of raw heart
heart.description: A portion of an animal's heart.  It's tough but not that chewy, and it spoils very quickly.

human_heart.name: piece of raw human heart
human_heart.description: A portion of heart from a human.  It's tough but not that chewy, and it spoils very quickly.  It appears to have been extracted too crudely to ever be useful as a transplant.

demihuman_heart.name: piece of raw demihuman heart
demihuman_heart.description: A portion of heart from a demihuman being.  It's tough but not that chewy, and it spoils very quickly.

heart_cooked.name: cooked piece of heart
heart_cooked.description: A roasted piece of heart.  It doesn't look any tastier than it did raw, but any parasites are all cooked out.

mutant_heart.name: piece of raw mutant heart
mutant_heart.description: A portion of an animal's heart.  It's tough but not that chewy, and it spoils very quickly.

mutant_human_heart.name: piece of raw mutant humanoid heart
mutant_human_heart.description: A portion of an animal's heart.  It's tough but not that chewy, and it spoils very quickly.
mutant_human_heart.name_plural: of raw mutant humanoid heart pieces

mutant_heart_cooked.name: cooked piece of mutant heart
mutant_heart_cooked.description: A roasted piece of heart.  It doesn't look any tastier than it did raw, but any parasites are all cooked out.

mutant_bug_lungs.name: piece of raw mutant lung
mutant_bug_lungs.description: You're pretty sure this is lung tissue.

liver.name: piece of raw liver
liver.description: A piece of liver from an animal.  Although many dislike its texture, it's one of the more vitamin-rich parts of the animal.  It is very good in sausages, but maybe a little less appetizing when cooked on its own.

human_liver.name: piece of raw human liver
human_liver.description: A piece of liver from a human, which appears to have been extracted too crudely to ever be useful as a transplant.

demihuman_liver.name: piece of raw demihuman liver
demihuman_liver.description: A chunk of liver from a demihuman being.

liver_cooked.name: cooked piece of liver
liver_cooked.description: Chock-full of A- and B-Vitamins!  Cooked liver isn't all that bad, depending on how you feel about the texture, but this is probably the least fancy way to do it.

mutant_liver.name: piece of raw mutant liver
mutant_liver.description: A piece of liver from an animal.  Although many dislike its texture, it's one of the more vitamin-rich parts of the animal.  It is very good in sausages, but maybe a little less appetizing when cooked on its own.

mutant_liver_cooked.name: cooked piece of mutant liver
mutant_liver_cooked.description: Chock-full of A- and B-Vitamins!  Cooked liver isn't all that bad, depending on how you feel about the texture, but this is probably the least fancy way to do it.

bone_marrow.name: portion of raw bone marrow
bone_marrow.description: A soft, spongy substance found in bones, rich in fat.  Chock-full of good stuff and doesn't taste too bad even raw, but beware of parasites.

human_marrow.name: portion of raw human bone marrow
human_marrow.description: Soft, spongy marrow tissue from a human bone.
human_marrow.name_plural: of raw human bone marrow portions

demihuman_marrow.name: portion of raw demihuman bone marrow
demihuman_marrow.description: Soft, spongy marrow tissue from a demihuman bone.
demihuman_marrow.name_plural: of raw demihuman bone marrow portions

mutant_marrow.name: portion of raw mutant bone marrow
mutant_marrow.description: Soft, spongy, and oddly-colored marrow tissue from the bone of a heavily mutated animal.
mutant_marrow.name_plural: of raw mutant bone marrow portions

mutant_human_marrow.name: portion of raw mutant human bone marrow
mutant_human_marrow.description: Soft, spongy, and oddly-colored marrow tissue from the bone of a heavily mutated creature that was unsettlingly humanoid in appearance.
mutant_human_marrow.name_plural: of raw mutant human bone marrow portions

brain.name: piece of raw brain
brain.description: A chunk of brain from an animal.  You wouldn't want to eat this raw…

human_brain.name: piece of raw human brain
human_brain.description: A chunk of brain from a human.  Eating this may cause kuru, but you probably won't live long enough to care about that anyway.

demihuman_brain.name: piece of raw demihuman brain
demihuman_brain.description: A chunk of brain from a demihuman being.  Don't prion diseases cross species barriers?

brain_cooked.name: cooked piece of brain
brain_cooked.description: Now you can emulate those zombies you love so much!  Preparing brain for eating is challenging, and this doesn't seem to be the best way to do it.

mutant_brain.name: piece of raw mutant brain
mutant_brain.description: A chunk of brain from an animal.  You wouldn't want to eat this raw…

mutant_brain_cooked.name: cooked piece of mutant brain
mutant_brain_cooked.description: Now you can emulate those zombies you love so much!  Preparing brain for eating is challenging, and this doesn't seem to be the best way to do it.

kidney.name: piece of raw kidney
kidney.description: A chunk of kidney from an animal.  Preparing it for cooking is a challenge unless you want the kitchen to smell strongly of urine.

human_kidney.name: piece of raw human kidney
human_kidney.description: A chunk of kidney from a human, which appears to have been extracted too crudely to ever be useful as a transplant.

demihuman_kidney.name: piece of raw demihuman kidney
demihuman_kidney.description: This is probably a piece of kidney extracted from a demihuman being.

mutant_kidney.name: piece of raw mutant kidney
mutant_kidney.description: A chunk of kidney from an animal.  Preparing it for cooking is a challenge unless you want the kitchen to smell strongly of urine.

sweetbread.name: piece of raw sweetbread
sweetbread.description: A piece of the thymus or pancreas of an animal.  These are a delicacy, if prepared properly.

human_sweetbread.name: piece of raw human sweetbread
human_sweetbread.description: A piece of the thymus or pancreas of a human, which appears to have been extracted too crudely to ever be useful as a transplant.

demihuman_sweetbread.name: piece of raw demihuman sweetbread
demihuman_sweetbread.description: The consistency of this chunk of organ suggests possibly a thymus or pancreas equivalent.

sweetbread_cooked.name: cooked piece of sweetbread
sweetbread_cooked.description: Normally a delicacy, but this style of preparation is missing something.

blood.name: blood
blood.description: Blood extracted from a human being.

fat.name: chunk of fat
fat.description: A chunk of raw fat.  You could eat it as-is, but it is better used as an ingredient in other foods or projects.

tallow.name: tallow
tallow.description: A smooth, white block of cleaned and rendered animal fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

mutant_fat.name: chunk of mutant fat
mutant_fat.description: A chunk of raw fat butchered from a heavily-mutated animal.  It smells, if anything, even more disgusting than the rest of the mutant.  There are little puddles of unidentified oils dripping from it.

mutant_tallow.name: mutant tallow
mutant_tallow.description: A smooth, white block of cleaned and rendered fat, sourced from a mutant animal.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

mutant_human_fat.name: chunk of mutant humanoid fat
mutant_human_fat.description: Raw fat butchered from a heavily-mutated humanoid.

mutant_human_tallow.name: mutant humanoid tallow
mutant_human_tallow.description: A smooth, white block of cleaned and rendered fat, sourced from a mutant humanoid.  It won't rot for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

meat_tainted.name: chunk of tainted meat
meat_tainted.description: A piece of meat that's obviously unhealthy.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

meat_tainted_human.name: chunk of tainted human meat
meat_tainted_human.description: A piece of rotted meat that has been harvested from something human, or at the very least something once human, as if cannibalism wasn't abhorrent enough.

arm_zed.name: tainted limb
arm_zed.description: A rotted and then shredded arm.  Not much use unless you want to scrape the meat from the bones.

leg_zed.name: tainted limb
leg_zed.description: What's left of some zombie's limb.  Most likely a leg based on the proportions.  Though it's rotted, there is quite a bit of meat still on it.

blood_tainted.name: tainted blood
blood_tainted.description: Blood that's obviously unhealthy.  You could drink it, but it will poison you.

blood_tainted_human.name: tainted human blood
blood_tainted_human.description: Blood that's obviously unhealthy, and from a human to boot.  You could drink it, but it will poison you.

tainted_marrow.name: portion of tainted bone marrow
tainted_marrow.description: A wet, green chunk of spongy goop extracted from a rotten bone.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.

tainted_marrow_human.name: portion of tainted human bone marrow
tainted_marrow_human.description: A wet, green chunk of spongy goop extracted from a rotten human bone.  You could eat it, but it will poison you.
tainted_marrow_human.name_plural: of tainted human bone marrow portions

fat_tainted.name: chunk of tainted fat
fat_tainted.description: A watery yellow glob of fat from some unnatural creature or other.  Something is… wrong with it.  It doesn't seem like normal fat.

fat_tainted_human.name: chunk of tainted human fat
fat_tainted_human.description: A watery yellow glob of fat from some zombified human.  Something is… wrong with it.  It doesn't seem like normal fat.

stomach_boiled.name: large boiled stomach
stomach_boiled.description: A boiled stomach from an animal, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

hstomach_boiled.name: boiled large human stomach
hstomach_boiled.description: A boiled stomach from a large humanoid creature, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

small_stomach_boiled.name: boiled stomach
small_stomach_boiled.description: A small boiled stomach from an animal, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

small_hstomach_boiled.name: boiled human stomach
small_hstomach_boiled.description: A small boiled stomach from a human, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

raw_leather.name: raw hide
raw_leather.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from an animal.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

raw_tainted_leather.name: tainted hide
raw_tainted_leather.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from an unnatural creature.  The smell of rot is overwhelming, and it has an ghastly unnatural feeling with a wide variety of cuts, divots, and malformed lumps covering the sickly green-gray skin.  This can't be used for anything useful.

raw_tainted_leather_scraps.name: tainted skin scraps
raw_tainted_leather_scraps.description: Shredded scraps of raw skin from an unnatural creature.  It can't have much use.

raw_hleather.name: raw human skin
raw_hleather.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a human.  Despite some dubious historical accounts, the usefulness of human skin is limited, and can't be made into leather.  The skin is still edible, if you're that desperate.

raw_demihumanleather.name: raw demihuman skin
raw_demihumanleather.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a demihuman.  Despite being from a human-enough body, the leather has this distinct unnatural and alien feeling to it, and would be a very poor substitute for leather.  The skin is still edible, if you're that desperate.

raw_fur.name: raw pelt
raw_fur.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing animal.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

raw_tainted_fur.name: tainted pelt
raw_tainted_fur.description: A carefully folded raw pelt harvested from an unnatural creature.  The smell of rot is overwhelming, with bits of flesh cling to the mangy, sickly patches of fur still present on the pelt.  This can't be used for anything useful.

raw_hfur.name: raw human pelt
raw_hfur.description: A carefully folded raw skin harvested from a fur-bearing mutant human.  It still has the fur attached.  You can cure it for storage and tanning, or eat it if you're desperate enough.

flesh_golem_heart.name: seeping heart
flesh_golem_heart.description: A thick mass of flesh superficially resembling a mammalian heart.  It's the size of your fist and covered in dimpled grooves.

jabberwock_heart.name: putrid heart
jabberwock_heart.description: A thick, hulking mass of flesh that's easily the size of your head, superficially resembling a mammalian heart and covered in ribbed grooves.  It's still full of whatever passes for blood in jabberwocks, and is heavy in your hands.  After everything you've seen lately, you can't help but remember old sayings about eating the hearts of your enemies…

jabberwock_heart_desiccated.name: desiccated putrid heart
jabberwock_heart_desiccated.description: A huge strip of muscle - all that remains of a putrid heart that has been sliced open and drained of blood.  It could be eaten if you're hungry, but looks *disgusting*.

nether_huntsman_organ.name: reverberating organ
nether_huntsman_organ.description: A tubular leathery organ of an alien creature, comprised of tough muscle tissue.  Dozens of deep ridges make up the slimy surface, like a disgusting rendition of an accordion.

nether_grub.name: alien grub
nether_grub.description: A segmented chitinous shell with curious markings is sheltering a weird alien larva, squirming and wiggling around.  Theorizing what it could eventually turn into, you're unsure if it is safe to keep around.

meat_frond.name: alien fronds
meat_frond.description: The fleshy fronds harvested from an alien plant.  Eating these membranous leaves and gut-like stems is likely a terrible idea, and yet they have a paradoxically pleasant and inviting sweet smell.  Might be non-vegan.

leech_flower.name: leech flower
leech_flower.description: The alien beauty of this indigo flower is betrayed by its disgustingly fleshy composition.  What from afar appear to be petals are but layered membranes of transparent veiny flesh, given color by a covering of blue iridescent ichor.  Even if it is certainly poisonous, it has a pleasant medicinal smell to it.

use_action.activation_message: Even a close smell of this alien flower feels deeply intoxicating.

meat_bark.name: leech bark
meat_bark.description: Dry and tough bark matter harvested from an alien plant.  It is slightly translucent, and if placed against the light you can distinguish glistening blue veins running through it.

demihuman_stomach.name: demihuman stomach
demihuman_stomach.description: The stomach of an intelligent demihuman.  It is surprisingly durable.

demihuman_stomach_large.name: large demihuman stomach
demihuman_stomach_large.description: The stomach of a large humanoid creature.  It is surprisingly durable.

demihuman_fat.name: chunk of demihuman fat
demihuman_fat.description: Raw fat harvested from a demihuman body.

demihuman_tallow.name: demihuman tallow
demihuman_tallow.description: A smooth, white block of cleaned and rendered demihuman fat.  It will remain edible for a very long time, and can be used as an ingredient in many foods and projects.

demihuman_flesh.name: demihuman flesh
demihuman_flesh.description: Raw meat butchered from a demihuman body.

demihuman_cooked.name: cooked mongrel
demihuman_cooked.description: A cooked slice of something close to being a real person.  Tastes like long pig.

demihuman_stomach_boiled.name: boiled demihuman stomach
demihuman_stomach_boiled.description: A boiled stomach from a demihuman, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

small_demihuman_stomach_boiled.name: boiled demihuman stomach
small_demihuman_stomach_boiled.description: A small boiled stomach from a demihuman, nothing else.  It looks all but appetizing.

meat_mi-go.name: chunk of mi-go meat
meat_mi-go.description: A piece of mi-go meat that's obviously alien, given its pink color, odd odor, and strange texture.  It would not be advisable to try to eat it.

blood_mi-go.name: mi-go ichor
blood_mi-go.description: Goo from inside a mi-go, perhaps some kind of blood?  It's obviously alien, given its pink color and strange, nostril-stinging odor.  It would not be advisable to try to eat it.

bone_mi-go.name: mi-go bone
bone_mi-go.description: An unrecognized structural element from inside a mi-go.  It's strong and springy, somewhat like cartilage, but a bit stiffer.  It's also a deep green color, and might possibly serve a scaffolding role, like bone.

poultry.name: chunk of poultry meat
poultry.description: A chunk of raw meat from a bird.  Dangerous to eat as-is.

poultry_scrap.name: scrap of poultry meat
poultry_scrap.description: A tiny scrap of raw meat from a bird.  You figure that one of these should be about one fifth of a portion.  Dangerous to eat as-is.

poultry_cooked.name: cooked poultry
poultry_cooked.description: A chunk of bird meat that has been cooked.  Nutritious and safe to eat, but a bit bland.

poultry_scrap_cooked.name: cooked scrap of poultry
poultry_scrap_cooked.description: A tiny scrap of cooked meat from a bird.  Not very filling, and a bit bland.

poultry_smoked.name: chicken jerky
poultry_smoked.description: Strip of bird meat that has been heavily smoked for preservation.  It could be further smoked to dehydrate it completely.

mutflesh.name: chunk of mutagenic flesh
mutflesh.description: A chunk of raw meat with a weirdly off-green coloration.  You could eat it as-is, but are you sure you want to?

hot_corn_casserole.name: piece of hot corn casserole
hot_corn_casserole.description: It's cheesy and indulgent, although the mix of tender kernels of corn, veggies, fresh herbs, and a pop of heat keep it in check so it's not too heavy for the apocalypse.

cheesy_spinach_casserole.name: piece of cheesy spinach casserole
cheesy_spinach_casserole.description: This cheesy spinach casserole is cheesy, packed with hearty spinach, and totally delicious.

tuna_noodle_casserole.name: piece of fish noodle casserole
tuna_noodle_casserole.description: Fish noodle casserole is a casserole primarily made with pasta and canned tuna, with canned peas and corn sometimes added.

lazy_lobster_casserole.name: lazy lobster casserole
lazy_lobster_casserole.description: A classic New England casserole made with butter, lobster, and crackers, in roughly that order.

eggplant_parmigiana.name: eggplant parmigiana
eggplant_parmigiana.description: A good portion of tasty eggplant parmigiana.

cereal.name: sugary cereal
cereal.description: Sugary breakfast cereal.  It takes you back to your childhood.

cereal2.name: whole-grain cereal
cereal2.description: Whole-grain wheat cereal.  It's surprisingly good, and for your heart too, allegedly.

cereal3.name: corn flakes
cereal3.description: Plain cornflake cereal.  They're not that good, but it beats nothing.

cereal_fp1.name: Foodplace cereal
cereal_fp1.description: A generic box of Foodplace brand sugary cereal, you shouldn't see this.

cereal_fp2.name: Carpenter Crunch cereal
cereal_fp2.description: This is Foodplace brand "Carpenter Crunch" cereal with the iconic "Breakfast Beaver" mascot on the box.  It tastes kind of like nails.

cereal_fp4.name: Sugar Chomps cereal
cereal_fp4.description: Foodplace brand "Sugar Chomps" cereal.  "Chocolate Frosted Crunchy Sugar Chomps: 8 essential vitamins packed into that rich, fudgy taste!"

milk.name: milk
milk.description: Baby cow food, appropriated for human consumption.  Spoils rapidly.

milk_choc.name: chocolate milk
milk_choc.description: Baby cow food, with chocolate added for human enjoyment.  Spoils rapidly.

milk_reconstituted.name: reconstituted milk
milk_reconstituted.description: Baby cow food, appropriated for adult humans.  This milk has been reconstituted from powder.  Spoils rapidly.

milk_raw.name: raw milk
milk_raw.description: This is raw, unhomogenized and unpasteurized milk from a cow.  It couldn't be any fresher unless you drank it straight from the cow, which might upset it.  Depending on your dietary sensibilities, you might want to pasteurize or even boil this before drinking.

milk_UHT.name: shelf stable milk
milk_UHT.description: This is milk that has been pasteurized at much higher temperatures than normal.  It tastes slightly different, but, unopened, will last far longer than regular milk.

milk_evap.name: evaporated milk
milk_evap.description: Milk that's had about 60% of its water removed prior to canning.

buttermilk.name: buttermilk
buttermilk.description: This is cultured milk defatted either due to churning or curdling.  Spoils quickly.

yoghurt.name: yogurt
yoghurt.description: Delicious fermented dairy.  It tastes of vanilla.

butter.name: butter
butter.description: A yellow stick of milkfat and milk solids, usually made from cow's milk.

effect.u_message: Ugh, you've been eating too much butter…

raw_butter.name: raw butter
raw_butter.description: A white stick of raw milkfat and milk solids, made directly from cow's milk.

effect.u_message: Ugh, you've been eating too much butter…

ghee.name: ghee
ghee.description: Clarified butter, free from milk solids and water.  Will last a very long time.

effect.u_message: Ugh, you've been eating too much butter…

pudding.name: pudding
pudding.description: Sugary, fermented dairy.  A wonderful treat.

milk_curdled.name: curdled milk
milk_curdled.description: Milk that has been curdled with vinegar and rennet.  It still needs to be salted and drained of whey.

cheese_hard.name: hard cheese
cheese_hard.description: Hard, dry cheese made to last, unlike modern processed cheese.  Will make you thirsty though.

cheese.name: cheese
cheese.description: A block of yellow processed cheese.

cottage_cheese.name: cottage cheese
cottage_cheese.description: Unaged curdled milk and whey, made by draining cheese rather than pressing like cheese curds.  The retained whey keeps the curds loose and soft, giving a somewhat soupy texture to this lower calorie variety of cheese.

cottage_cheese_with_fruit.name: cottage cheese with fruit
cottage_cheese_with_fruit.description: Unaged curdled milk and whey, made by draining cheese rather than pressing like cheese curds.  The retained whey keeps the curds loose and soft, giving a somewhat soupy texture to this lower calorie variety of cheese.  By adding fruits to it you've made what might be a full meal.

cottage_cheese_with_savory_veg.name: cottage cheese with savory vegetables
cottage_cheese_with_savory_veg.description: Unaged curdled milk and whey, made by draining cheese rather than pressing like cheese curds.  The retained whey keeps the curds loose and soft, giving a somewhat soupy texture to this lower calorie variety of cheese.  By adding savory vegetables to it you've made what might be a full meal.

mozzarella_cheese.name: mozzarella cheese
mozzarella_cheese.description: A ball of white mozzarella cheese.

mozzarella_cheese_smoked.name: smoked mozzarella cheese
mozzarella_cheese_smoked.description: Smoked mozzarella cheese.  Has a longer shelf life than fresh mozzarella and a more savory taste.
