fried_mozzarella_sticks.name: fried mozzarella sticks
fried_mozzarella_sticks.description: Fried mozzarella cheese sticks, yum.  They lack sauce though.

cheese_powder.name: powdered cheese
cheese_powder.description: Dehydrated cheese powder, the kind found in mac & cheese boxes or bulk foods products.  Will keep for an extremely long time.

cheese_rehydrated.name: rehydrated cheese
cheese_rehydrated.description: Goopy cheese sauce made by rehydrating cheese powder.

quesadilla_cheese.name: quesadilla
quesadilla_cheese.description: A tortilla filled with cheese and lightly grilled.

milk_powder.name: powdered milk
milk_powder.description: Dehydrated milk powder.  Mix with water to make drinkable milk.

con_milk.name: condensed milk
con_milk.description: Cow's milk that has been partly dehydrated and sweetened.  A key ingredient in many sweets.

milk_cream_whipped.name: whipped cream
milk_cream_whipped.description: Cream that has been whipped, perfect for frosting cakes and pies.

milk_cream.name: heavy cream
milk_cream.description: Cream that has been skimmed from the top of raw milk left to sit.

tiramisu.name: tiramisù
tiramisu.description: It is an Italian spoon dessert based on savoiardi soaked in coffee and covered with a cream composed of mascarpone and eggs.

mascarpone.name: mascarpone
mascarpone.description: A portion of mascarpone, a dairy product obtained from the processing of cream and citric acid, a typical Italian spreadable cheese.

pecorino_cheese.name: pecorino
pecorino_cheese.description: A slice of pecorino, famous Italian hard cheese used in pasta carbonara.

sauce_red.name: tomato sauce
sauce_red.description: A minimally seasoned sauce of cooked tomatoes.

maple_sap.name: maple sap
maple_sap.description: A water and sugar solution that has been extracted from a maple tree.

mayonnaise.name: mayonnaise
mayonnaise.description: A gloppy mix of egg, oil, and salt that is traditionally used to moisten sandwiches.

ketchup.name: ketchup
ketchup.description: A viscous paste of tomato, salt, and vinegar.

barbecue_sauce.name: barbecue sauce
barbecue_sauce.description: Invented in the American south, barbecue sauce is sweet, dark, and full of spices like garlic, pepper, and cayenne.  It's often used in meat dishes as a marinade or condiment.

honey_mustard.name: honey mustard
honey_mustard.description: A tangy, sweet, and creamy sauce that perfectly complements salads and fried food.

mustard.name: mustard
mustard.description: A condiment made from the seeds of a mustard plant ("Brassica" or "Sinapis"), vinegar, salt, and spices.

honey_bottled.name: forest honey
honey_bottled.description: Honey, that stuff bees make.  This one is "forest honey", a liquid form.  It never spoils, and is good for your digestion.

vinegar.name: vinegar
vinegar.description: Shockingly tart white vinegar.  This is what you get when you let your booze ferment too long.

cooking_oil.name: vegetable cooking oil
cooking_oil.description: Thin yellow vegetable oil used for cooking.

molasses.name: molasses
molasses.description: An extremely sugary tar-like syrup, produced by repeatedly boiling the juice of sugarcane or sugar beets.  It has a slightly bitter aftertaste.

grenadine_syrup.name: grenadine syrup
grenadine_syrup.description: Extremely sweet syrup made from sugar and pomegranate juice.  It's meant to be mixed with other drinks, rather than drink it as is.

horseradish.name: horseradish
horseradish.description: A spicy grated root vegetable packed in vinegared brine.

coffee_syrup.name: coffee syrup
coffee_syrup.description: A thick syrup made of water and sugar strained through coffee grounds.  Can be used to flavor many foods and beverages.

coconut_water.name: coconut water
coconut_water.description: Sweet-tasting cloudy liquid extracted from a coconut.

salca.name: salca
salca.description: Tomato paste of Turkish origin made from pureed in-season tomatoes reduced over the sun or heat.

pekmez.name: pekmez
pekmez.description: A molasses-like syrup obtained after condensing juices of grape must.

apple_cider.name: apple cider
apple_cider.description: Pressed from fresh apples, tasty and nutritious.  This is a non-alcoholic beverage, which sometimes confuses foreigners.  It's instead called 'hard cider' when alcohol is involved.

almond_milk.name: almond milk
almond_milk.description: Wait, you can milk almonds?  Not quite, but you can blend them with water!  A dairy-free alternative high in calcium, and one of the big three.

hazelnut_milk.name: hazelnut milk
hazelnut_milk.description: Wait, you can milk hazelnuts?  Not quite, but you can blend them with water!  A dairy-free alternative high in calcium, and rival to walnut milk.

walnut_milk.name: walnut milk
walnut_milk.description: Wait, you can milk walnuts?  Not quite, but you can blend them with water!  A dairy-free alternative high in calcium, and rival to hazelnut milk.

soy_milk.name: soy milk
soy_milk.description: Wait, you can milk soybeans?  Not quite, but you can blend them with water!  A dairy-free alternative high in protein, and one of the big three.

oat_milk.name: oat milk
oat_milk.description: Wait, you can milk oats?  Not quite, but you can blend them with water!  A dairy-free alternative high in calcium, and one of the big three.

atomic_coffee.name: atomic coffee
atomic_coffee.description: This serving of coffee has twice as much coffee as black coffee, as well as some caffeine pills and sugar for good measure.  You didn't plan to sleep this week anyway, right?

tea_wild_sarsaparilla.name: wild sarsaparilla tea
tea_wild_sarsaparilla.description: Some wild sarsaparilla root steeped in boiling water.  Energizing.

bee_balm_tea.name: bee balm tea
bee_balm_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from bee balm steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to reduce negative effects of common cold or flu.

can_coconut.name: coconut milk
can_coconut.description: A dense, sweet, creamy sauce, often used in curries.

chai_tea.name: chai tea
chai_tea.description: A traditional south Asian mixed-spice tea with milk.

chamomile_tea.name: chamomile tea
chamomile_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from chamomile flowers steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to treat insomnia.

choc_drink.name: chocolate drink
choc_drink.description: A chocolate-flavored beverage made of artificial flavoring and milk byproducts.  Shelf stable and vaguely appetizing even when lukewarm.

coffee.name: black coffee
coffee.description: The morning ritual of the pre-apocalyptic world, created from coffee cherries through a complex process of seed removal, roasting, grinding, and brewing.  Coffee is substantially richer in caffeine than its rival tea.

coffee_substitute.name: coffee substitute
coffee_substitute.description: Homemade not-coffee created from the Kentucky coffeetree, just like the Meskwaki tribe!  Doesn't actually have any caffeine, and is very bitter, but it'll pass in a pinch.

milk_coffee_substitute.name: coffee substitute with milk
milk_coffee_substitute.description: Imitation coffee brewed from Kentucky coffeetree, this drink has no caffeine, no sweetener, and is still unpleasantly bitter even with the added milk.

milk_coffee_substitute_sweetened.name: sweetened coffee substitute with milk
milk_coffee_substitute_sweetened.description: The morning ritual of the post-apocalyptic world.  Brewed from the Kentucky coffeetree, this drink has no actual caffeine, but serves as a replacement for those who dearly miss the aroma of real coffee.  Can also be served cold.

sweet_milk.name: sweetened milk
sweet_milk.description: Some milk with sugar added.  Tastes slightly better.

sweet_milk_fortified.name: sweetened fortified milk
sweet_milk_fortified.description: Milk enriched with protein powder, it's extra healthy and doesn't taste too bad.  It has sugar added, for those who like it sweeter.

chicory_coffee.name: chicory brew
chicory_coffee.description: Toasted, ground chicory root steeped in boiling water.  This bitter brew is used as a coffee substitute, though it tastes nothing like coffee.

cola.name: dark cola
cola.description: Things go better with cola.  Sugar water with caffeine added.

colamdew.name: energy cola
colamdew.description: It tastes and looks like windshield wiper fluid, but it's loaded to the brim with sugar and caffeine.

creamsoda.name: cream soda
creamsoda.description: A caffeinated, carbonated drink, flavored with vanilla.

cranberry_juice.name: cranberry juice
cranberry_juice.description: Made from real Massachusetts cranberries.  Quite sour, but nutritious.

crispycran.name: crispy cranberry
crispycran.description: Mixing cranberry juice and lemon-lime soda works out quite well.

dandelion_tea.name: dandelion tea
dandelion_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from dandelion roots steeped in boiling water.

dandelionburdock_tea.name: dandelion and burdock tea
dandelionburdock_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from dandelion and burdock roots steeped in boiling water.  The addition of burdock makes it more nourishing and slightly tastier.

eggnog.name: eggnog
eggnog.description: Smooth and rich, this spoon-coating mixture of milk, eggs, and cinnamon sugar is a popular traditional holiday drink.  This type isn't spiked with alcohol, but it is still delicious.  Meant to be stored cold, it will spoil rapidly.

energy_drink.name: energy drink
energy_drink.description: A heavily-caffeinated soft drink.  Popular among those who need to stay up late working.

energy_drink_atomic.name: atomic energy drink
energy_drink_atomic.description: According to the label, this loathsome-tasting beverage is called ATOMIC POWER THIRST.  Alongside the lengthy health warning, it promises to make the consumer UNCOMFORTABLY ENERGETIC using ELECTROLYTES and THE POWER OF THE ATOM.

herbal_tea.name: herbal tea
herbal_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from herbs steeped in boiling water.

hot_chocolate.name: hot chocolate
hot_chocolate.description: Also known as hot cocoa, this heated chocolate beverage is perfect for a cold winter day.

horchata.name: horchata
horchata.description: A sugary drink from Central America infused with rice, milk, and cinnamon.

juice_pasteurized.name: pasteurized fruit juice
juice_pasteurized.description: A sweet liquid with a vaguely fruity taste.  Having been pasteurized, it will last for a long time.

juice.name: fruit juice
juice.description: Freshly-squeezed from real fruit!  Tasty and nutritious.

pineapple_juice.name: pineapple juice
pineapple_juice.description: Freshly-squeezed from real pineapples!  Tasty and nutritious.

drink_pinitacolada.name: piñita colada
drink_pinitacolada.description: An alcohol-free variant of the piña colada cocktail, consisting of pineapple juice and coconut milk.

drink_virgin_mary.name: Virgin Mary cocktail
drink_virgin_mary.description: An alcohol-free variant of the Bloody Mary cocktail; basically tomato juice mixed with some spices.

drink_shirleytemple.name: Shirley Temple drink
drink_shirleytemple.description: An alcohol-free mixed drink made from grenadine syrup and lemon-lime soda, lemonade or orange juice.

drink_royrogers.name: Roy Rogers drink
drink_royrogers.description: An alcohol-free mixed drink made from grenadine syrup and cola.

kompot.name: kompot
kompot.description: Clear juice obtained by cooking fruit in a large volume of water.

lemonade.name: lemonade
lemonade.description: Lemon juice mixed with water and sugar to dull the sourness.  Delicious and refreshing.

orangeade.name: orangeade
orangeade.description: Cheap orange flavored beverage with limited vitamins.

grapeade.name: grapeade
grapeade.description: Cheap grape flavored beverage with limited vitamins.

lemonlime.name: lemon-lime soda
lemonlime.description: Unlike cola this is caffeine free, however it is still carbonated and has plenty of sugar and a lemon-lime taste.

lotus_tea.name: lotus tea
lotus_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from lotus flowers steeped in boiling water.

mex_chocolate.name: Mexican hot chocolate
mex_chocolate.description: This semi-bitter chocolate drink made from cocoa, cinnamon, and chilies traces its history to the Maya and Aztecs.  Perfect for a cold winter day.

milk_coffee.name: coffee milk
milk_coffee.description: Coffee syrup or black coffee mixed into milk.  It's been the state drink of Rhode Island since 1993.

oj.name: orange juice
oj.description: Store-bought orange juice.  Refreshing, tasty, and a great source of Vitamin C.

oj_fresh.name: fresh orange juice
oj_fresh.description: Freshly-squeezed from real oranges!  Tasty and nutritious.

orangesoda.name: orange soda
orangesoda.description: Unlike cola this is caffeine free, however it is still carbonated, sweet, and tastes vaguely orange-like.

pine_tea.name: pine needle tea
pine_tea.description: A fragrant and healthy beverage made from pine needles steeped in boiling water.

purple_drink.name: grape drink
purple_drink.description: A mass-produced grape flavored beverage of artificial origin.  Good for when you want something that tastes like fruit, but still don't care about your health.

mycus_juice.name: Mycus juice
mycus_juice.description: Freshly-squeezed from the fruit of the Mycus.

rootbeer.name: root beer
rootbeer.description: Like cola, but without caffeine.  Still not that healthy.

rootbeer_brewed.name: root beer
rootbeer_brewed.description: Like cola, but without caffeine.  Still not that healthy, but better than the canned stuff.

tonic_water.name: tonic water
tonic_water.description: A carbonated soft drink which contains quinine, giving it a bitter flavor.  Originally used as a prophylactic against malaria, this modern variant is unsuitable for this purpose as it contains much less quinine and is also sweetened.

spezi.name: spezi
spezi.description: Originating in Germany almost a century ago, this mix of cola and orange soda tastes great.

sports_drink.name: sports drink
sports_drink.description: A flavored drink consisting of a special blend of electrolytes and simple sugars.  It tastes vaguely like fruit with a slight chemical aftertaste.

spurge_tea.name: spurge tea
spurge_tea.description: A healthy beverage made from spurge flowers steeped in boiling water.  Can be used to prevent asthma attacks.

use_action.activation_message: You no longer need to worry about asthma attacks, at least for a while.

rehydration_drink.name: rehydration drink
rehydration_drink.description: A basic oral rehydration therapy drink.  It will rehydrate you faster than water, but tastes like bottled sweat.

sweet_water.name: sweet water
sweet_water.description: Water with sugar or honey added.  Tastes okay.

tea.name: black tea
tea.description: The beverage of gentlemen everywhere, made from applying hot water to oxidized leaves of the tea plant "Camellia sinensis".

tea_willowbark.name: willowbark tea
tea_willowbark.description: A bitter tea made by boiling willow bark in water, used since ancient times as a mild painkiller.

tea_bark.name: bark tea
tea_bark.description: Often regarded as folk medicine in some countries, bark tea tastes awful and tends to dry you out, but can help flush out stomach or other gut bugs.

V8.name: V8
V8.description: Contains up to eight vegetables!  Nutritious and tasty.

water.name: water
water.description: Water, the stuff of life, necessary for all kinds of crafting, cleaning, and avoiding an agonizing death by dehydration.  You should boil or purify it before using it as drinking water.

water_murky.name: murky water
water_murky.description: Water, the stuff of life.  This water looks like it has quite a bit of life in it in fact, and not the good kind.  You should filter and sterilize it if you want to drink it.

water_clean.name: clean water
water_clean.description: Fresh, clean water.  Truly the best thing to quench your thirst.

water_clean_scarlet.name: acrid water
water_clean_scarlet.description: This looks very much like water, and you think it would quench your thirst.  Now that it's been removed from the large, scarlet body of water, you see that it's in fact slightly yellow.  It smells like a forgotten swimming pool.

water_spring.name: spring water
water_spring.description: Natural alpine spring water, bottled at the source.

water_mineral.name: mineral water
water_mineral.description: Fancy mineral water, so fancy it makes you feel fancy just holding it.

tea_green.name: green tea
tea_green.description: Made from applying hot water to leaves of the tea plant "Camellia sinensis".  Green tea has a lighter, fresher taste than black and is traditionally preferred in Asian cultures.

tea_fruit.name: fruit tea
tea_fruit.description: A tasty beverage made with herbs and dried fruit from plants other than the tea plant.  While colloquially called 'tea', technically it's an infusion.

coffee_sweetened.name: sweetened coffee
coffee_sweetened.description: The morning ritual of the pre-apocalyptic world, created from coffee cherries through a complex process of seed removal, roasting, grinding, and brewing.  Coffee is substantially richer in caffeine than its rival tea.  With added sweetener for better taste.

tea_sweetened.name: sweetened tea
tea_sweetened.description: The beverage of gentlemen everywhere, made from applying hot water to leaves of the tea plant "Camellia sinensis".  With added sweetener for a better taste.  Can also be served cold as iced tea.

milk_tea_sweetened.name: sweetened milk tea
milk_tea_sweetened.description: Hot tea with cold milk and added sweetener.

coffee_substitute_sweetened.name: sweetened coffee substitute
coffee_substitute_sweetened.description: Homemade not-coffee created from the Kentucky coffeetree, just like the Meskwaki tribe!  Doesn't actually have any caffeine, but it'll pass in a pinch.  The added sweetener neutralizes the bitterness somewhat.

milk_coffee_sweetened.name: sweetened coffee milk
milk_coffee_sweetened.description: Coffee syrup mixed into milk.  It's been the state drink of Rhode Island since 1993.  With added sweetener for those who like it even sweeter.  Can also be served cold.

tomato_juice.name: tomato juice
tomato_juice.description: A thick red liquid, made from tomatoes.  Not to everyone's taste, it is a healthy and refreshing drink when chilled.

ayran.name: ayran

egg_spade_frog.name: cluster of frog's eggs
egg_spade_frog.description: Several short strands of tightly clustered black eggs connected together by their viscous coverings.

egg_proxy_bigfrog.name: cluster of giant frog's eggs
egg_proxy_bigfrog.description: A large clump of very large frog eggs.  They're gelatinous, transparent and larger than even chicken's eggs.

egg_pattern_bigfrog.name: cluster of giant frog's eggs
egg_pattern_bigfrog.description: From a distance you could mistake it for a cluster of gigantic caviar.  It is only on close inspection that you can make out the faint translucence of these softball-sized frog eggs.

egg_strange_bigfrog.name: cluster of giant frog's eggs
egg_strange_bigfrog.description: A thick flotilla of enormous frog eggs floats together atop the water in a roughly circular mass.

egg_foul_bigfrog.name: cluster of giant frog's eggs
egg_foul_bigfrog.description: Looking like a submerged buoy-line, this long strand of softball-sized, gelatinous eggs floats gently in the still water.

egg_odd_bigfrog.name: cluster of giant frog's eggs
egg_odd_bigfrog.description: This is a spiral strand of giant frog eggs.  Its increased weight and size nearly smothers the submerged vegetation it clings to.

egg_vocal_bigfrog.name: cluster of giant frog's eggs
egg_vocal_bigfrog.description: A patch of giant frog's eggs resembling a very thick, clear sack of oranges.

egg_shift_bigfrog.name: cluster of giant frog's eggs
egg_shift_bigfrog.description: These golfball-sized frog eggs cling together by their sticky membranes.

The hardtack is crushed and combined with water and flour to make dough, followed by kneading in pieces of fruit.  The dough is then boiled into bread pudding chunks and topped with sweeteners.  Soldiers would call this a dessert.

choco_coffee_beans.name: chocolate-covered coffee beans

sugar_fried.name: caramel
sugar_fried.description: Some caramel.  Sticky and sweet, but not very exciting by itself.

caramel_apple.name: caramel apple
caramel_apple.description: A caramel-covered apple.  Best served on an autumn day, at a harvest fair, on a stick - but those days are long gone.

nachos.name: tortilla chips
nachos.description: Salted chips made from corn tortillas.  They're not bad on their own, but they could really use some cheese, maybe some meat.

cooked_dinner.description: Now with ONE POUND of meat and ONE POUND of carbs!  Now that it's been heated up, it's much tastier but will also spoil more quickly.

chilidogs.name: chili dog

chicken_rice_hianese.description: This delicious serving of poached chicken with rice is one of the national dishes of Singapore.

chicken_parm.name: chicken parmesan
chicken_parm.description: A classic Italian-American dish of breaded and fried chicken atop a bed of pasta, enrobed with tomato sauce and cheese.

scrapple.name: scrapple
scrapple.description: A dry mush of meat scraps and grain, sliced and pan-fried; better than it sounds and looks.  A staple food of the Mid-Atlantic United States.

meat_dolmas.name: dolmas
meat_dolmas.description: Grape leaves stuffed with rice, meat, vegetables, and spices.  A popular dish in Mediterranean and Middle Eastern cuisines.

melatonin_tablet.name: melatonin tablet
melatonin_tablet.description: An over-the-counter sleep hormone.  Melatonin can help you fall asleep faster and stay asleep longer.  Using it may help restore your sleep schedule, but you might wake up feeling groggy.

adderall.name: prescription stimulant
adderall.description: Medical-grade amphetamine salts mixed with dextroamphetamine salts, commonly prescribed to treat hyperactive attention deficits.  It suppresses the appetite, and is quite addictive.

adrenaline_injector.name: epinephrine autoinjector
adrenaline_injector.description: A syringe filled with a shot of epinephrine, also called adrenalin.  It serves as a powerful stimulant when you inject yourself with it.  Asthmatics can use it in an emergency to clear an asthma attack.

use_action.activation_message: You inject yourself with the injector.

antibiotics.name: antibiotics
antibiotics.description: Antibacterial medication designed to prevent or stop the spread of infection.  It's the safest way to cure any infections you might have.  One dose lasts twelve hours.

antifungal.name: antifungal drug
antifungal.description: A powerful chemical tablet designed to eliminate fungal infections in living creatures.  One dose lasts four hours.

antiparasitic.name: antiparasitic drug
antiparasitic.description: A broad-spectrum chemical tablet designed to eliminate parasitic infestations in living creatures.  Though designed for use on pets and livestock, it will likely work on humans as well.

aspirin.name: aspirin
aspirin.description: Acetylsalicylic acid, a mild anti-inflammatory and blood thinner.  Take to relieve pain and swelling.  Careful - it can increase bleeding.

ibuprofen.name: ibuprofen
ibuprofen.description: Ibuprofen, a mild NSAID-based painkiller.  Take to relieve pain and swelling.

naproxen.name: naproxen
naproxen.description: Naproxen, a mild long-lasting NSAID-based painkiller.  Take to relieve pain and swelling.

acetaminophen.name: acetaminophen
acetaminophen.description: Acetaminophen, a mild painkiller that works well in conjunction with NSAID-based painkillers like aspirin.  Take to relieve pain and swelling.

metaprolol.name: metaprolol
metaprolol.description: Metaprolol, a classic beta blocker.  It lowers blood pressure and decouples heart rate from stressful events such as anxiety or pain.

bfipowder.name: antiseptic powder
bfipowder.description: A powdered form of chemical antiseptic, this bismuth formic iodide cleans wounds quickly and painlessly.

caff_gum.name: caffeinated chewing gum
caff_gum.description: Sugar-free chewing gum with added caffeine.  It's a nice pick-me-up, one stick is equivalent to a strong cup of tea.

caffeine.name: caffeine pill
caffeine.description: A No-doz brand caffeine pill, maximum strength.  Useful in pulling an all-nighter, one pill is equivalent to a strong cup of coffee.

chaw.name: chewing tobacco
chaw.description: Mint-flavored chewing tobacco.  While absolutely terrible for your health, it was once a favorite among baseball players, cowboys, and other macho types.

chem_hydrogen_peroxide.name: hydrogen peroxide
chem_hydrogen_peroxide.description: Dilute hydrogen peroxide, for use as an antiseptic and for bleaching hair or textiles.  Foams a little when in contact with organic matter, but otherwise harmless.

skunk_spray_neutralizing_solution.name: skunk spray neutralizing solution
skunk_spray_neutralizing_solution.description: A combination of hydrogen peroxide, baking soda, and dish soap that works together to transform skunk spray thiocetates into odorless acids.

use_action.activation_message: You cover yourself in the solution everywhere the spray touched your body.

cig.name: cigarette
cig.description: A mixture of dried tobacco leaf, pesticides, and chemical additives, rolled into a filtered paper tube.  Stimulates mental acuity and reduces appetite.  Highly addictive and hazardous to health, but lung cancer is kind of the least of your concerns at this point.

cigar.name: cigar
cigar.description: Rolled, cured tobacco leaf, addictive and hazardous to health.

debug_chloroform_rag.name: debug chloroform soaked rag
debug_chloroform_rag.description: A debug item that lets you put NPCs (or yourself) to sleep.

codeine.name: codeine
codeine.description: A mild opiate used in the suppression of pain, cough, and other ailments.  While relatively weak for a narcotic, it is still addictive, with a potential for overdose.

coke.name: cocaine
coke.description: Crystalline extract of the coca leaf, or at least, a white powder with some of that in it.  A topical analgesic, it is more commonly used for its stimulatory properties.  Highly addictive.

cola_meth.name: methacola
cola_meth.description: A potent cocktail of amphetamines, caffeine and corn syrup, this stuff puts a spring in your step, a fire in your eye, and a bad case of tachycardia tremors in your somersaulting heart.

myopia_contacts_weekly.name: myopia contact lenses (weekly)
myopia_contacts_weekly.description: Small plastic case with two extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  They are a great replacement for wearing glasses and sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>nearsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.

use_action.description: You can use this to mitigate your nearsightedness.

myopia_transition_contacts_weekly.name: myopia transition contact lenses (weekly)
myopia_transition_contacts_weekly.description: Small plastic case with two extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  This high-tech pair darkens in response to light, making it easier to see in bright environments.  They sit comfortably on the surface of the eye.  The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>nearsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.

use_action.description: You can use this to mitigate your nearsightedness.

bifocal_contacts_weekly.description: Small plastic case with two extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution. The lenses are designed to help anyone with <color_light_blue>both nearsightedness and farsightedness</color>, and should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.

use_action.description: You can use this to mitigate your nearsightedness or farsightedness.

plano_transition_contacts_weekly.description: Small plastic case with two transition extended-wear soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  This high-tech pair darkens in response to light, making it easier to see in bright environments, but it doesn't help with any sight issues.  Essentially a pair of temporary sunglasses, this lenses should be discarded after <color_light_blue>a week</color> of use.

use_action.description: You can use this to mitigate your the bright light discomfort.

plano_transition_contacts_daily.name: plano transition contact lenses (daily)
plano_transition_contacts_daily.description: Small plastic case with two transition daily-use soft contact lenses, buffered in saline solution.  This high-tech pair darkens in response to light, making it easier to see in bright environments, but it doesn't help with any sight issues.  Essentially a pair of temporary sunglasses, this lenses should be discarded after <color_light_blue>16 hours</color> of use.

use_action.description: You can use this to mitigate the bright light discomfort.

crack.name: crack
crack.description: Deprotonated cocaine crystals, incredibly addictive and deleterious to brain chemistry.

use_action.activation_message: You smoke your crack rocks.  Mother would be proud.

dayquil.name: non-drowsy cough syrup
dayquil.description: Daytime cold and flu medication, non-drowsy formula.  Will suppress coughing, aching, headaches and runny noses, but you'll still need lots of fluids and rest.

disinfectant.name: antiseptic
disinfectant.description: A powerful antiseptic commonly used to disinfect wounds.

disinfectant_makeshift.name: makeshift antiseptic
disinfectant_makeshift.description: Makeshift antiseptic made from ethanol.  Can be used to disinfect wounds.

diazepam.name: prescription sedative
diazepam.description: A strong benzodiazepine drug used to treat muscle spasms, anxiety, seizures, and panic attacks.

hi_q_shatter.name: cannabis shatter
hi_q_shatter.description: Concentrated cannabis extract, commonly known as dabs.  This particular style of concentrate is in a thin sheet and shatters like glass at room temperature.  Arguably one of the better styles of concentrate compared to wax, crumble, or distillate.  Normal cannabis contains around 20% THC; this shatter should be around 55% THC.

use_action.activation_message: You take a dab.  Wow, that's got some killer terpenes!

hi_q_wax.name: cannabis wax
hi_q_wax.description: Concentrated cannabis extract, commonly known as dabs.  This particular style of concentrate is yellow and waxy at room temperature.  Normal cannabis contains around 20% THC; this wax should be around 45% THC.

use_action.activation_message: You take a dab of wax.  *cough cough* Good stuff!

hi_q_distillate.name: cannabis distillate
hi_q_distillate.description: Concentrated cannabis extract.  This style of extract goes through the most processing, eliminating most if not all harmful ingredients.  Normal cannabis contains around 20% THC; this distillate should be around 88% THC.  Can be smoked using a refillable electronic cigarette.

use_action.activation_message: You take a dab of distillate.  Sooooo smooth…

ecig.name: electronic cigarette
ecig.description: This battery-operated device vaporizes a liquid that contains flavorings and nicotine.  A less harmful alternative to traditional cigarettes, but it's still addictive.  It can't be reused once it's empty.

eyedrops.name: saline eye drops
eyedrops.description: Sterile saline eye drops.  Can be used to treat dry eyes, or to wash out contaminants.

steroid_eyedrops.name: steroid eyedrops
steroid_eyedrops.description: A topical corticosteroid in the form of eye drops.  Can be used to treat irritation and inflammation of the eyes.

use_action.activation_message: You put the anti-inflammatory eyedrops into your eyes.

flu_shot.name: flu shot
flu_shot.description: A pharmaceutical flu shot designed for mass vaccinations, still in its packaging.  Purported to provide immunity to influenza, for the flu season for which it was developed.

handrolled_cig.name: hand-rolled cigarette
handrolled_cig.description: A roll-your-own cigarette.  Stimulates mental acuity and reduces appetite.  Despite being hand crafted, it's still highly addictive and hazardous to health.

heroin.name: heroin
heroin.description: An extremely strong opioid narcotic derived from morphine.  Incredibly addictive, the risk of overdose is extreme, and the drug is contraindicated for nearly all medical purposes.

iodine.name: potassium iodide tablet
iodine.description: A potassium iodide tablet.  If taken prior to exposure, they help to mitigate injury caused by radiation absorption.

joint.name: joint
joint.description: Marijuana, cannabis, pot.  Whatever you want to call it, it's rolled up in a piece of paper and ready for smokin'.

lsd.name: pink tab
lsd.description: A tiny pink tabs resembling a postage stamp, dosed with some sort of drug.  Really only useful for entertainment.  Will cause hallucinations.

meth.name: low-grade methamphetamine
meth.description: A profoundly addictive and powerful stimulant.  While extremely effective at enhancing alertness, it is hazardous to health and the risk of an adverse reaction is great.

pure_meth.name: high-grade methamphetamine
pure_meth.description: A profoundly addictive and powerful stimulant.  While extremely effective at enhancing alertness, it is hazardous to health and the risk of an adverse reaction is great.  This one could have only been made by a great chemist.

morphine.name: morphine
morphine.description: A very strong, naturally-occurring narcotic used to treat intense pain in hospital settings.  You'll need a syringe to inject it, and it's very addictive, so be careful.

wintergreen_oil.name: wintergreen oil
wintergreen_oil.description: An ointment infused with wintergreen oil.  Has mild antiseptic properties, and can ease the pain caused by wounds.

mugwort_oil.name: mugwort oil
mugwort_oil.description: Some essential oil made from mugwort, which may kill parasites when ingested.  Consume it with water!

nic_gum.name: nicotine gum
nic_gum.description: Mint flavored sugar-free nicotine chewing gum.  For smokers who desire to quit.

nyquil.name: cough syrup
nyquil.description: Nighttime cold and flu medication.  Useful when trying to sleep with a head full of virions.  Will cause drowsiness.

antihistamine.name: antihistamine pill
antihistamine.description: Over-the-counter allergy medication.  These are meant to be taken once a day and can cause drowsiness.

oxycodone.name: oxycodone
oxycodone.description: A strong semi-synthetic narcotic used in the treatment of intense pain.  Highly addictive.

pills_sleep.name: sleeping pill
pills_sleep.description: A habit-forming tranquilizer with a variety of psychoactive side effects.  Used in the treatment of insomnia.

poppy_pain.name: poppy painkiller
poppy_pain.description: A potent opioid palliative produced by the refining of the mutated poppy.  Notably devoid of euphoric or sedative effects, but as an opiate it can still be addictive.

poppy_sleep.name: poppy sleep
poppy_sleep.description: A potent sleep aid extracted from mutated poppy seeds.  Effective, but as an opiate it can be addictive.

poppysyrup.name: poppy cough syrup
poppysyrup.description: Cough syrup made from mutated poppy.  Will make you sleepy.

prophylactic_antivenom.name: injectable prophylactic antivenom
prophylactic_antivenom.description: An experimental, cutting-edge antivenom in the form of a small amber vial, designed to be injected a few hours before venom exposure.  It was developed in top secret by the military in response to increasing biological/chemical warfare.

use_action.activation_message: You inject a vial of prophylactic antivenom into your arm.  You feel a bit queasy.

prozac.name: antidepressant
prozac.description: A common and popular antidepressant.  It will elevate mood, and can profoundly alter the effects of other drugs.  It is only rarely habit-forming, though adverse reactions are not uncommon.

prussian_blue.name: Prussian blue tablet
prussian_blue.description: A tablet containing oxidized ferrous ferrocyanide salts.  Capable of purging nuclear contaminants from the body if taken after radiation exposure.

quikclot.name: hemostatic powder
quikclot.description: A powdered antihemorrhagic compound that reacts with blood to immediately form a gel-like substance that stops bleeding.

saline.name: saline solution
saline.description: A solution of sterilized water and salt for intravenous infusion or washing contaminants from one's eyes.

thorazine.name: antipsychotic
thorazine.description: Anti-psychotic medication.  Used to stabilize brain chemistry, it can arrest hallucinations and other symptoms of psychosis.  Carries a sedative effect.

thyme_oil.name: thyme oil
thyme_oil.description: Some essential oil made from thyme, which can act as a mildly irritating antiseptic.

tobacco.name: rolling tobacco
tobacco.description:
Loose, fine-cut tobacco leaves.  Popular in Europe and among hipsters.  Highly addictive and hazardous to health.
Can either be rolled into a cigarette with some rolling papers or smoked through a pipe.

tramadol.name: tramadol
tramadol.description: A painkiller used to manage moderate pain.  The effects last for several hours, but are relatively subdued for an opioid.

vitamins.name: multivitamin
vitamins.description: Essential dietary nutrients conveniently packaged in pill form.  An option of last resort when a balanced diet is not possible.  Excess use can cause hypervitaminosis.

calcium_tablet.name: calcium tablet
calcium_tablet.description: A white calcium tablet.  Widely used by elderly people with osteoporosis as a method to supplement calcium before the apocalypse.

bonemeal_tablet.name: bone meal tablet
bonemeal_tablet.description: A homemade calcium supplement made out of bone meal.  Tastes horrible and is hard to swallow but it does its job.

flavored_bonemeal_tablet.name: flavored bone meal tablet
flavored_bonemeal_tablet.description: A homemade calcium supplement made out of bone meal.  Due to some sweeteners mixed in to counteract the powdery texture and the taste of ash, it's almost as palatable as the pre-Cataclysm tablets.

vitc_tablet.name: vitamin C supplement
vitc_tablet.description: A small white tablet promising more vitamin C than a human can conceivably absorb.

vitc_fragment.name: vitamin C supplement fragment
vitc_fragment.description: a small slice of a vitamin C supplement, providing as much vitamin C as a human can conceivably absorb.

gummy_vitamins.name: gummy vitamin
gummy_vitamins.description: Essential dietary nutrients conveniently packaged in a fruit-flavored chewy candy form.  An option of last resort when a balanced diet is not possible.  Excess use can cause hypervitaminosis.

homeopathic_pills.name: homeopathic pill
homeopathic_pills.description: A homeopathic pill, prepared through the repeated dilution of an active ingredient with water.  The label purports that these pills are able to maintain general wellness.

use_action.activation_message: You swallow the %s.  You wait in anticipation of its effects.

inj_iron.name: injectable iron
inj_iron.description: A small vial of dark yellow liquid containing soluble iron for injection.

weed.name: marijuana
weed.description: The dried flower buds and leaves harvested from a psychoactive variety of hemp plant.  Used to reduce nausea, stimulate appetite and elevate mood.  It can be habit-forming, and adverse reactions are possible.

use_action.activation_message: You smoke some weed.  Good stuff, man!

xanax.name: fast-acting sedative
xanax.description: An anti-anxiety agent with a powerful sedative effect.  May cause dissociation and loss of memory.  It is dangerously addictive, and withdrawal from regular use should be gradual.

weak_antibiotic.name: narrow-spectrum antibiotics
weak_antibiotic.description: A narrow-spectrum antibiotic used to suppress infections and prevent them from spreading.  It isn't broad enough to purge most infections outright, but it boosts the body's resistance against them.  One dose lasts twelve hours.

pepto.name: heartburn medicine
pepto.description: Creamy pink heartburn syrup that soothes upset stomachs and quells vomitous urges.

tums.name: antacid tablet
tums.description: A common stomach soother in flavored tablet form.  Makes you less likely to vomit.

panacea.name: Panaceus
panacea.description: An apple-red gel capsule the size of your thumbnail, filled with a thick, oily liquid that shifts from black to purple at unpredictable intervals, flecked with tiny gray dots.  Given the place you got it from, it's either very potent, or highly experimental.  Holding it, all the little aches and pains seem to fade, just for a moment…

cattail_jelly.name: cattail jelly
cattail_jelly.description: Clear jelly harvested from cattails.  Can be used to protect a wound from contamination, and works as a painkiller.

strong_antibiotic.name: broad-spectrum antibiotics
strong_antibiotic.description: A broad-spectrum antibacterial medication designed to prevent or stop the spread of infection.  It contains nearly toxic levels of antibiotics, but can treat any bacterial infections you may encounter.  One dose lasts twelve hours.

cocaine_topical.name: cocaine topical cream
cocaine_topical.description: A medical cream that provides both vascular restriction and anesthetic properties.

birth_control.name: birth control pill
birth_control.description: A pill meant to regulate hormones to reduce the chance of a pregnancy.  It also has the fortunate side effect of reducing or even stopping menstruation.  As the factories producing these have died down, these have become a valuable good.

estrogen.name: estrogen pill
estrogen.description: A sublingual tablet of estradiol, meant to increase the level of estrogen in the body.  It's a lifesaving medicine for some transgender individuals.

use_action.activation_message: You set the pill under your tongue and let it dissolve.

sunscreen.name: sunscreen
sunscreen.description: Carcinoma may not be such a concern anymore, but sunburns are as painful as ever.

mre_lemontuna.description: The lemon pepper tuna entree from an MRE.

mre_lobstermedley.description: The lobster seafood medley entree from an MRE.

mre_chickenpesto.description: The chicken pesto & pasta entree from an MRE.

mre_southwestbeef.description: The southwest beef & beans entree from an MRE.

mre_hotdog.name: frankfurters & beans entree
mre_hotdog.description: The dreaded four fingers of death.  It seems to be several decades old.

mre_cheesepizza.name: cheese pizza entree
mre_cheesepizza.description: The pizza entree from an MRE, now in vegetarian form.

mre_pizza.name: pepperoni pizza entree
mre_pizza.description: The pizza entree from an MRE, featuring pepperoni slices and cheese.

mre_fried_rice.name: fried rice (small portion)
mre_fried_rice.description: Fried rice, a simple dish made by stir-frying rice with other ingredients.

mre_zapplesauce.name: zapplesauce
mre_zapplesauce.description: Golden, jelly-like food with the flavor of apples.

mre_blackbeans.name: black beans in sauce
mre_blackbeans.description: A savory and flavorful combination of black beans and sauce.

mre_carrot_cake.name: carrot pound cake
mre_carrot_cake.description: Delicious cake with carrots blended seamlessly.

mre_poppyseed_cake.name: lemon poppy seed pound cake
mre_poppyseed_cake.description: Cake filled with the goodness of lemon and poppy seeds.

mre_chocolate_cake.name: MRE toaster pastry
mre_chocolate_cake.description: A toaster pastry that has been specially sterilized to last longer.

mushroom_ketchup.name: mushroom ketchup
mushroom_ketchup.description: A savory condiment made from mushrooms.

mushroom_morel.name: morel mushroom
mushroom_morel.description: Prized by chefs and woodsmen alike, morel mushrooms are delicious but must be cooked before they are safe to eat.

morel_fried.name: fried morel mushroom
morel_fried.description: A delicious serving of fried morsels of morel mushroom.

dry_mushroom.name: dried mushroom
dry_mushroom.description: Dried mushrooms are a tasty and healthy addition to many meals.

mushroom.name: mushroom
mushroom.description: Mushrooms are tasty, but be careful.  Some can poison you, while others are hallucinogenic.

iv_mutagen.name: mutagenic catalyst
iv_mutagen.description: A processed, purified, and condensed dose of mutagenic drugs.  When combined with mutagenic primer, this will cause mutations over time.

iv_mutagen_alpha.name: alpha mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_alpha.description: A processed mutagenic primer strongly resembling blood.

iv_mutagen_beast.name: beast mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_beast.description: A processed mutagenic primer as red as a matador's cape.

iv_mutagen_bird.name: bird mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_bird.description: A processed mutagenic primer the color of the pre-Cataclysmic skies.

iv_mutagen_cattle.name: cattle mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_cattle.description: A processed mutagenic primer the color of grass.

iv_mutagen_cephalopod.name: cephalopod mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_cephalopod.description: A processed mutagenic primer as black as ink.

iv_mutagen_chimera.name: chimera mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_chimera.description: A processed mutagenic primer that churns with iridescence.

iv_mutagen_elfa.name: Elf-A mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_elfa.description: A processed mutagenic primer that's a striking sylvan green.

iv_mutagen_feline.name: feline mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_feline.description: A processed mutagenic primer, yellow and highly reflective.

iv_mutagen_fish.name: fish mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_fish.description: A processed mutagenic primer the color of the ocean, with white foam at the top.

iv_mutagen_insect.name: insect mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_insect.description: A processed mutagenic primer that's a beautiful amber color.

iv_mutagen_lizard.name: lizard mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_lizard.description: A processed mutagenic primer that shifts between various shades of green.

iv_mutagen_lupine.name: lupine mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_lupine.description: A processed mutagenic primer as white as a full moon.

iv_mutagen_medical.name: medical mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_medical.description: A processed mutagenic primer that looks like a mixture of bodily fluids.

iv_mutagen_plant.name: plant mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_plant.description: A processed mutagenic primer that looks like pureed spinach.

iv_mutagen_raptor.name: raptor mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_raptor.description: A processed mutagenic primer that seems to shift slightly whenever you look at it.

iv_mutagen_rat.name: rat mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_rat.description: A processed mutagenic primer that's a rather unappealing beige.

iv_mutagen_chiropteran.name: chiropteran mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_chiropteran.description: A processed mutagenic primer, black as night.

iv_mutagen_slime.name: slime mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_slime.description: A processed mutagenic primer, oily and viscous.

iv_mutagen_spider.name: spider mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_spider.description: A processed mutagenic primer with pale filaments suspended in it.

iv_mutagen_snail.name: snail mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_snail.description: A processed mutagenic primer with the consistency of snot.

iv_mutagen_batrachian.name: batrachian mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_batrachian.description: A processed mutagenic primer that looks like pond water… are the shadows in it moving?

iv_mutagen_troglobite.name: troglobite mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_troglobite.description: A processed mutagenic primer that seems to recoil from the light.

iv_mutagen_ursine.name: ursine mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_ursine.description: A processed mutagenic primer that's the color of honey, and is just as thick.

iv_mutagen_mouse.name: mouse mutagenic primer
iv_mutagen_mouse.description: A processed mutagenic primer resembling liquefied metal.

mutagen.name: mutagenic slurry
mutagen.description: A slurry of organic chemicals and compounds, used as the foundation for making primers and mutagenic catalyst.  In this baseline form, it is highly toxic, and dangerous to consume on its own.

mutagen_jabberblood.name: congealed blood
mutagen_jabberblood.description: A thick, soupy red liquid.  It looks and smells disgusting, and seems to bubble with an intelligence of its own…

use_action.activation_message: You choke down the congealed blood.

mutagen_beast.name: beast mutagen
mutagen_beast.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

mutagen_bird.name: bird mutagen
mutagen_bird.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.
