mutagen_chiropteran.name: chiropteran mutagen
mutagen_chiropteran.description: A murky black liquid that smells of blood.

mutagen_slime.name: slime mutagen
mutagen_slime.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

mutagen_spider.name: spider mutagen
mutagen_spider.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

mutagen_batrachian.name: batrachian mutagen
mutagen_batrachian.description: A shadowy mutagen that looks like it might be full of tiny swimming tadpoles.

mutagen_interstice.name: perfectly clear water
mutagen_interstice.description: Everything about this liquid screams that it's water.  However, it's so clear that you can barely perceive it unless in motion.

mutagen_snail.name: snail mutagen
mutagen_snail.description: A mutagen that looks awfully like the slime from an old children's network.

mutagen_troglobite.name: troglobite mutagen
mutagen_troglobite.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

mutagen_ursine.name: ursine mutagen
mutagen_ursine.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

mutagen_mouse.name: mouse mutagen
mutagen_mouse.description: A rare substance of uncertain origins.  Causes you to mutate.

mutagen_rabbit.name: rabbit mutagen
mutagen_rabbit.description: A white, clear colored mutagen.  You can drink it… if you really want to?

purifier.name: purifier
purifier.description: This thick, flesh-hued liquid helps revert the mutated to baseline humanity, but cannot remove mutagen present in the bloodstream.  Not for use on animals.

iv_purifier.name: purifier primer
iv_purifier.description: This chunky, flesh-hued injection does wonders for returning mutants to humanity, but perhaps counter-intuitively, it requires regular mutagen to function.  Do not use on animals.

mutagen_chelator.name: mutagen chelator
mutagen_chelator.description: A dangerous treatment that binds to mutagen present in the bloodstream and allows it to be excreted.

purifier_smart_shot.name: purifier smart shot
purifier_smart_shot.description: An experimental stem cell treatment, offering limited control over which mutations are purified.  The liquid sloshes strangely inside of this syringe.

fetus.name: misshapen fetus
fetus.description: A deformed human fetus.  Eating this would be the most vile thing you can think of, and just might cause you to mutate.

arm.name: mutated arm
arm.description: A misshapen human arm.  Eating this would be incredibly disgusting and probably cause you to mutate.

leg.name: mutated leg
leg.description: A malformed human leg.  This would be gross to eat, and probably cause mutations.

nl_shrub_glowberries.name: bunch of glowberries
nl_shrub_glowberries.description: A handful of strange berries picked from a plastic plant.  You're not sure if they're edible.  Nevertheless, they smell extremely pleasant.

pine_nuts.name: Handful of pine nuts
pine_nuts.description: A handful of tasty, crunchy nuts from a pinecone.

juniper.name: Handful of junipers
juniper.description: A handful of female juniper cones, for making gin and adding earthy flavors to food.  Spicy, tastes similar to rosemary.

pistachio_shelled.name: Handful of shelled pistachios
pistachio_shelled.description: A handful of nuts from a pistachio tree, with the shells removed.

pistachio_roasted.name: Handful of roasted pistachios
pistachio_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a pistachio tree.

almond_shelled.name: Handful of shelled almonds
almond_shelled.description: A handful of nuts from an almond tree, with the shells removed.

almond_pulp.name: Almond pulp
almond_pulp.description: Pulp left over after making almond milk.  It's gritty and incredibly bland.

almond_roasted.name: Handful of roasted almonds
almond_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from an almond tree.

pecan_shelled.name: Handful of shelled pecans
pecan_shelled.description: A handful of pecans, a sub-species of hickory nuts, with the shells removed.

pecan_roasted.name: Handful of roasted pecans
pecan_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a pecan tree.

peanut_shelled.name: Handful of shelled peanuts
peanut_shelled.description: Salty peanuts with the shells removed.

beech_nuts.name: Handful of beechnuts
beech_nuts.description: A handful of hard, pointy nuts from a beech tree.

walnut_shelled.name: Handful of shelled walnuts
walnut_shelled.description: A handful of raw, hard nuts from a walnut tree, with the shells removed.

walnut_pulp.name: Walnut pulp
walnut_pulp.description: Pulp left over after making walnut milk.  It's gritty and incredibly bland.

butternut_shelled.name: Handful of shelled butternuts
butternut_shelled.description: A handful of raw nuts from a butternut tree, with the shells removed.

walnut_roasted.name: Handful of roasted walnuts
walnut_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a walnut tree.

butternut_roasted.name: Handful of roasted butternuts
butternut_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a butternut tree.

chestnut_shelled.name: Handful of shelled chestnuts
chestnut_shelled.description: A handful of raw, hard nuts from a chestnut tree, with the shells removed.

chestnut_roasted.name: Handful of roasted chestnuts
chestnut_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a chestnut tree.

hazelnut_shelled.name: Handful of shelled hazelnuts
hazelnut_shelled.description: A handful of raw, hard nuts from a hazelnut tree, with the shells removed.

edamame_roasted.name: Handful of roasted edamame
edamame_roasted.description: A handful of roasted edamame, a hearty and healthy snack.

soy_nuts.name: Handful of roasted soy nuts
soy_nuts.description: A handful of roasted soybeans, often called soy nuts.

hazelnut_roasted.name: Handful of roasted hazelnuts
hazelnut_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a hazelnut tree.

hazelnut_pulp.name: Hazelnut pulp
hazelnut_pulp.description: Pulp left over after making hazelnut milk.  It's gritty and incredibly bland.

hickory_nut_shelled.name: Handful of shelled hickory nuts
hickory_nut_shelled.description: A handful of raw, hard nuts from a hickory tree, with the shells removed.

hickory_nut_roasted.name: Handful of roasted hickory nuts
hickory_nut_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from a hickory tree.

hickory_nut_ambrosia.name: hickory nut ambrosia
hickory_nut_ambrosia.description: Delicious hickory nut ambrosia.  A drink worthy of the gods.

peanutbutter.name: nut butter
peanutbutter.description: A brown goo that tastes very little like its namesake.  It's not bad, but it'll stick to the roof of your mouth.

acorns.name: Handful of acorns
acorns.description: A handful of acorns, still in their shells.  Squirrels like them, but they taste terribly bitter and can upset your stomach.

acorns_cooked.name: Handful of cooked acorns
acorns_cooked.description: A serving of acorns that have been hulled, chopped, and boiled in water before being thoroughly toasted until dry.  Filling and nutritious.

acorn_roasted.name: Handful of roasted acorns
acorn_roasted.description: A handful of roasted nuts from an oak tree.

acorns_blanched.name: Handful of blanched acorns
acorns_blanched.description: A handful of mushy blanched acorns.  No longer bitter, but not pleasant to eat in this state.

acorns_blanching_active.name: Blanching acorns
acorns_blanching_active.description: A mix of water and hulled acorns, slowly leaching the tannins.  It'll take about a week before they're palatable.

vegan_butter.name: vegan butter
vegan_butter.description: A light brown butter substitute made from nuts.  Differs from other nut butters in that the fats are removed from the meat and only the fats retained.

foie_gras.name: faux gras
foie_gras.description: Though this meal is technically not foie gras, you have a feeling neither the French nor animal rights groups are likely to criticize it now.

liver_onion.name: liver & onions
liver_onion.description: A classic way to serve liver.

fried_livers.name: fried liver
fried_livers.description: Tasty deep-fried liver, a Southern delicacy.

fried_heart.name: fried heart
fried_heart.description: Tasty deep-fried heart, retaining most of its texture and gaining that delicious fried taste.

stuffed_heart.name: stuffed heart
stuffed_heart.description: Chunks of heart filled with vegetables and spices.

humble_pie.name: humble pie
humble_pie.description: Also known as 'Umble' pie, made with chopped organ meats.  Not half bad, and full of vitamins!

stewed_tripe.name: stewed tripe
stewed_tripe.description: Stomach lining, cut up and stewed for an hour in broth.  Better than it sounds.

fried_tripe.name: deep-fried tripe
fried_tripe.description: Some people don't enjoy the taste or texture of organ meat, so deep-frying is a great way to disguise both.

leverpostej.name: leverpostej
leverpostej.description: A traditional Danish pate.  Probably better if you spread it on some bread.

fried_brain.name: fried brain
fried_brain.description: I don't know what you were expecting.  It's brain.  It's deep-fried.  Enjoy!

deviled_kidney.name: deviled kidney
deviled_kidney.description: A delicious way to prepare kidneys, originating from Victorian England.  You had to make some substitutions in the devilling sauce, but it still came out damn good.

grilled_sweetbread.name: grilled sweetbread
grilled_sweetbread.description: Not sweet like the name would suggest, but delicious all the same!

canned_liver.name: canned liver
canned_liver.description: Livers preserved in a can.  Chock-full of B vitamins!

canned_heart.name: canned heart
canned_heart.description: Chunks of heart preserved in a can.

lung_provence.name: lung provence
lung_provence.description: A French lung dish, made by poaching the lungs before pan-frying them with onion, tomato, seasonings, and a generous amount of wine.

tÖttchen.name: töttchen
tÖttchen.description: A German peasant dish that converts many less-desirable meat cuts and organs into a palatable meal with the liberal application of butter, sugar, and wine.

scrambledeggsandbrain.name: scrambled eggs and brain
scrambledeggsandbrain.description: Brain and eggs, why didn't you ever think to put these together?

sausage_casings.name: sausage casing
sausage_casings.description: Sausage casings made from animal intestines.  Ready to be used for forming meat products.

sausage_casings_artificial.name: artificial sausage casing
sausage_casings_artificial.description: Sausage casings made from plastic bags.  Ready to be used for forming meat products.

homemade_hotdogs.name: homemade hot dog
homemade_hotdogs.description: A heavily processed sausage, commonplace at baseball games before the Cataclysm.  It would taste much better cooked.

dry_bottle_gourd.name: dried bottle gourd
dry_bottle_gourd.description: A vegetable from the gourd family, bottle gourds were brought to the Americas by the first Native American settlers crossing the Bering strait.  This one has been dried for processing into a watertight container.

slime_scrap.name: slime glob
slime_scrap.description: A little hunk of glop that fell off a slime monster.  It doesn't seem hostile, but it does wiggle occasionally.

honeycomb.name: honey comb
honeycomb.description: A large chunk of wax filled with honey.  Very tasty.

wax.name: chunk of beeswax
wax.description: A large chunk of beeswax.  Despite being used in some cooking recipes, beeswax in itself is indigestible to humans.

royal_jelly.name: royal jelly
royal_jelly.description: A translucent hexagonal chunk of wax, filled with dense, milky, bitter and acidic-tasting jelly.  Though some hold it as a panacea, it doesn't have any medical benefit.  Still it is rich with the most beneficial substances the hive can produce.

honeydew.name: honeydew
honeydew.description: A sugar-rich sticky substance, produced by aphids from plant sap.  Ants and bees love it.

marloss_berry.name: Marloss berry
marloss_berry.description: This looks like a blueberry the size of your fist, but pinkish in color.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.

marloss_gel.name: Marloss gelatin
marloss_gel.description: This looks like a handful of lemon-colored liquid which has taken a set, much like pre-Cataclysm Jello.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.

mycus_fruit.name: Mycus fruit
mycus_fruit.description: Humans might call this a Gray Delicious apple: large, gray, and smells even better than the Marloss.  If they didn't reject it for its alien origins.  But we know better.

yeast.name: yeast
yeast.description: A powder-like mix of cultured yeast, good for baking and brewing alike.

yogurt_starter_culture.name: yogurt starter culture
yogurt_starter_culture.description: A powder-like mix of cultured yogurt bacteria, good for fermenting yogurt.

koji.name: koji
koji.description: Some ground rice covered with a special kind of mold used for saccharification and fermentation in Japanese cuisine.

gelatin_powder.name: powdered gelatin
gelatin_powder.description: Dried and powdered gelatin, used as a gelling agent when mixed with water.

meal_chitin_piece.name: chitin powder
meal_chitin_piece.description: This chitin powder can be used to craft fertilizer and some other things.

napkin.name: napkin
napkin.description: A napkin.  Can be used for fires.

can_beans.name: canned beans
can_beans.description: Canned beans.  A staple among canned goods, these are reputedly good for one's coronary health.

dry_beans.name: dried beans
dry_beans.description: Dehydrated great northern beans.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, virtually inedible when dry.

beans_cooked.name: cooked beans
beans_cooked.description: A hearty serving of cooked great northern beans.

tofu.name: tofu
tofu.description: Tofu, a soy protein crucial to East Asian cuisine.  It absorbs flavors very well and can be used as a meat alternative in many dishes.

tofu_fried.name: fried tofu
tofu_fried.description: Tofu, a soy protein crucial to East Asian cuisine.  It absorbs flavors very well and can be used as a meat alternative in many dishes.

dry_tofu.name: dehydrated tofu
dry_tofu.description: Dehydrated tofu, sealed and still extra firm to last a long time.

soybean.name: raw soybeans
soybean.description: Beige colored beans.  They have many uses, but in their raw form are fairly poisonous to humans.

dry_soybean.name: dried soybeans
dry_soybean.description: Beige colored beans, dried until rock hard.  They'll need to be cooked or processed before use.

raw_edamame.name: raw edamame
raw_edamame.description: Raw soybeans still in their pod.  They can be cooked as-is or shelled for further processing, but in their raw form, they're toxic to humans.

blood_rice_pudding.name: blood rice pudding
blood_rice_pudding.description: Blood rice pudding is a pastry made from blood and rice grains.  Best with chopped peanuts, but also good to eat with various seasonings.

foodplace_food.name: Foodplace's delicious food™
foodplace_food.description: The best-seller from Foodplace, delicious food™, is made with real foodstuff and is guaranteed 100% edible!

foodplace_snack_bar.name: Foodplace's appropriate snack™
foodplace_snack_bar.description: Real foodstuff now in a pocket size format!

lentils_cooked.name: cooked lentils
lentils_cooked.description: Wet, cooked lentils.  Humble and nutrient-rich, but pretty bland.

coffee_raw.name: coffee powder
coffee_raw.description: Ground coffee beans.  You can boil it into a mediocre stimulant, or something better if you had an atomic coffee pot.

coffee_raw_kentucky.name: Kentucky coffee grounds
coffee_raw_kentucky.description: Coffee grounds created through washing, cleaning, and roasting the pods from a Kentucky coffeetree.  They can be used to create coffee.

honey_glassed.name: candied honey
honey_glassed.description: Honey, that stuff the bees make.  This variant is "candied honey", a variant of very thick consistence.  This honey won't spoil and is good for your digestion.

can_tomato.name: canned tomato
can_tomato.description: Canned tomato.  A staple in many pantries, and useful for many recipes.

human_brain_embalmed.name: embalmed human brain
human_brain_embalmed.description: This is a human brain soaked in a solution of highly toxic formaldehyde.  Eating this would be a terrible idea.

cattlefodder.name: cattle fodder
cattlefodder.description: What cattle eat.  Mainly made of grass, silage or legumes.  It's perfect for ruminants.

cattlefodder_medium.name: cattle fodder bundle
cattlefodder_medium.description: A pile of cattle fodder, about enough to feed a goat or a sheep for a day.

cattlefodder_large.name: large cattle fodder bundle
cattlefodder_large.description: A big heap of cattle fodder, enough to feed a cow for a day.

birdfood.name: bird food
birdfood.description: What birds eat.  Mainly made of seeds, silage or legumes.  It's perfect for small birds.

dogfood_raw.name: raw dog food
dogfood_raw.description: Minced meat mixed with some greens to be presented to a dog or something with a omnivorous diet.

dogfood.name: wet dog food
dogfood.description: This is wet food for dogs, made from canned fresh meats.  It smells strange, but dogs seem to love it.

dogfood_dry.name: dry dog food
dogfood_dry.description: Dry morsels of dog food with a long shelf life.  Made from dried processed meats and grains, and enriched with vitamins and minerals.

catfood_raw.name: raw cat food
catfood_raw.description: Minced meat to be presented to a cat or something with a strict meat diet.

catfood.name: wet cat food
catfood.description: This is wet food for cats, made from canned fresh meats.  It has a pungent aroma that cats seem to love.

catfood_dry.name: dry cat food
catfood_dry.description: Dry kibbles of cat food with a long shelf life.  Made from dried processed meats and grains, and enriched with vitamins and minerals.

grass.name: grass
grass.description: Some grass, edible by grazers and ruminants only.  Seeing this item is a bug.

small_plant.name: small plant
small_plant.description: A small plant or flower, edible by grazers and ruminants only.  Seeing this item is a bug.

underbrush.name: underbrush
underbrush.description: Some underbrush, edible by ruminants only.  Seeing this item is a bug.

nectar.name: nectar
nectar.description: Some nectar.  Seeing this item is a bug.

tea_bag.name: black tea bag
tea_bag.description: A paper sachet with tea leaves inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of black tea.

tea_green_bag.name: green tea bag
tea_green_bag.description: A paper sachet with tea leaves inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of green tea.

tea_fruit_bag.name: fruit tea bag
tea_fruit_bag.description: A paper sachet with leaves and fruit parts inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of fruit tea.

herbal_tea_bag.name: herbal tea bag
herbal_tea_bag.description: A paper sachet with dried wild herbs inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of herbal tea.

tea_bag_dandelion.name: dandelion tea bag
tea_bag_dandelion.description: A paper sachet with dried dandelion roots inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of dandelion tea.

tea_bag_chamomile.name: chamomile tea bag
tea_bag_chamomile.description: A paper sachet with dried chamomile inside.  Put it into boiling water to make a cup of chamomile tea.

instant_coffee.name: instant coffee mix
instant_coffee.description: A small packet of commercial instant coffee powder.  No creamer or sweetener added.

cocoa_powder.name: cocoa powder
cocoa_powder.description: A сocoa powder.  No milk or sweetener added.  Bitter, used on baking.

cocoa_powder_milk.name: instant cocoa
cocoa_powder_milk.description: A сocoa powder, with some milk powder and sugar added.  Sweet with a bitter aftertaste, water or milk will made it very tasty.

acid_soaked_hide.name: acid soaked hide
acid_soaked_hide.description: Raw hide soaking in a dilute acid solution to extract collagen.  After 24 hours the solution can be strained to extract fresh gelatin.

gelatin_extracted.name: extracted gelatin
gelatin_extracted.description: Freshly extracted gelatin in a dilute acid solution.  It needs to be strained to separate the gelatin from the acid.

camp_meal_small.name: prepared meal (small)
camp_meal_small.description: I am an item used in faction camps.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

camp_meal_medium.name: prepared meal (medium)
camp_meal_medium.description: I am an item used in faction camps.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

camp_meal_large.name: prepared meal (large)
camp_meal_large.description: I am an item used in faction camps.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

press_cake.name: press cake
press_cake.description: Dry leftovers that remain after extracting the oil from nuts or seeds.

earthworm_fried.name: fried earthworms
earthworm_fried.description: A handful of fried earthworms, cooked in salt.

earthworm_boiled.name: boiled earthworms
earthworm_boiled.description: A handful of common earthworms, boiled to remove impurities.

snail_garden.name: snail
snail_garden.description: A small gastropod harvested from the bushes.  Dangerous to consume raw but can be prepared if you get enough of them.

paste_seed.name: seed paste
paste_seed.description: A mass of ground seeds that are ready to be pressed into oil.

paste_nut.name: nut paste
paste_nut.description: A thick mass of ground nuts that are ready to be pressed into oil.

swarm_bees.name: swarm of bees
swarm_bees.description: A swarm of honey bees, displaced from the hive.  Without the support and nutrients of an apiary, or taking root somewhere, they will die in a few days.

gravy_mix.name: instant gravy mix
gravy_mix.description: Instant gravy mix, used for making gravy, instantly.  Not very appetizing in its current form.

vegan_gravy_mix.name: instant vegan gravy mix
vegan_gravy_mix.description: Instant gravy mix, used for making gravy, instantly.  Not very appetizing in its current form.  This one has been made with mushrooms, and as such is vegan friendly.

protein_drink.name: protein drink
protein_drink.description: A thin slurry of refined protein mixed with water.  While quite nutritious, it is not particularly tasty.

protein_powder.name: protein powder
protein_powder.description: Raw, refined protein.  While quite nutritious, it is impossible to enjoy in its pure form, try adding water.

protein_bar_evac.name: protein ration
protein_bar_evac.description:
SoyPelusa ran a highly successful crowdfunding campaign for their signature protein bar, dubbed "DaiZoom."

A person can live on one of these bars, three times a day, presumably forever.  After backers received their product, a single flaw was found: most consumers found starvation preferable to the flavor.  Warehouses of the product went unsold as the company went bankrupt, providing the perfect opportunity for FEMA to scoop them up and stock the evac shelters.

Now, you hold a piece of famous crowdfunding history in your hands.  How exciting.

protein_shake.name: protein shake
protein_shake.description: A thick and tasty beverage made from pure refined protein and nutritious fruit.

protein_shake_fortified.name: fortified protein shake
protein_shake_fortified.description: A thick and tasty beverage made from pure refined protein and nutritious fruit.  It has been supplemented with extra vitamins and minerals.

milk_fortified.name: fortified milk
milk_fortified.description: Milk enriched with protein powder, it's extra healthy and doesn't taste too bad.

protein_smoothie.name: protein smoothie
protein_smoothie.description: A thick and tasty smoothie made from pure refined protein and nutritious fruit mixed into milk.

protein_bar_zero.name: protein bar
protein_bar_zero.description: A dairy-free, nut-free, zero-allergen protein bar.

protein_bar_peanut.name: protein bar
protein_bar_peanut.description: A dairy-free protein bar.  Contains peanuts.

protein_bar_milk.name: protein bar
protein_bar_milk.description: A nut-free protein bar.  Contains whey.

apple.name: apple
apple.description: An iconic and delicious fruit grown and enjoyed across the world, used for generations in folk medicine as doctor repellant.

crabapple.name: crabapple
crabapple.description: A term used to describe both wild apples native to North America as well as less appetizing feral varieties, these are rather small and far too sour.

banana.name: banana
banana.description: A long, curved yellow fruit in a peel.  Some people like using them in desserts.  Those people are probably dead.

orange.name: orange
orange.description: A sweet citrus fruit.  Also comes in juice form.  In case you were wondering, the color is named after the fruit, not the other way around.

lemon.name: lemon
lemon.description: A very sour citrus fruit.  Can be eaten if you're desperate, but you should probably look for some other cooking application for this.

blueberries.name: handful of blueberries
blueberries.description: A handful of tasty sweet-tart berries.  They're blue, but that doesn't mean they're sad.

hobbleberries.name: handful of hobbleberries
hobbleberries.description: Some black hobbleberries.  They are quite sweet.  Before they ripened, they were deceptively red and utterly bitter.

autumn_olive.name: handful of autumn olives
autumn_olive.description: Not tasting anything like olives, this sweet, red and very nutritious fruit can also be used as a tomato-substitute in some cases.

strawberries.name: handful of strawberries
strawberries.description: A handful of tasty, juicy red berries with visible seeds on the outside of the skin.  Often found growing wild in fields.

cranberries.name: handful of cranberries
cranberries.description: A handful of very bitter red berries, probably grown locally in Massachusetts.  Good for urinary tract health.

raspberries.name: handful of raspberries
raspberries.description: A handful of sweet red berries, each with a hollow core.

huckleberries.name: handful of huckleberries
huckleberries.description: A handful of huckleberries, often times confused for blueberries.

m_stellatum_berries.name: starry false Solomon's seal berries
m_stellatum_berries.description: A bunch of deep red berries with a pleasant bittersweet flavor.  Can have a laxative effect if eaten in large quantities.

mayapple.name: mayapple
mayapple.description: A small, edible fruit of an otherwise toxic plant.  You should not eat too many of them.

wintergreen_berry.name: wintergreen berries
wintergreen_berry.description: A handful of sweet, brilliant red berries of the wintergreen shrub.

mulberries.name: handful of mulberries
mulberries.description: This red variety of mulberries is unique to eastern North America, and is said to have the strongest flavor of any variety in the world.

elderberries.name: handful of elderberries
elderberries.description: A handful of elderberries, toxic when eaten raw but great when cooked.

nannyberries.name: handful of nannyberries
nannyberries.description: Some dark blue nannyberries, tasting like prunes mixed with banana.

tupelo_fruit.name: handful of tupelo fruits
tupelo_fruit.description: Some dark blue tupelo fruits.  They are tart and feature a hard seed but are still enjoyable.

chokeberries.name: handful of chokeberries
chokeberries.description: A handful of black chokeberries.  They look similar to blackcurrant.  Big and juicy but actually exceedingly sour.

rose_hips.name: handful of rose hips
rose_hips.description: A handful of fruits grown from pollinated rose flowers.  Full of irritating hairs and hard seeds, they'll need to be disassembled before eating.

rose_hips_cut.name: cut rose hips
rose_hips_cut.description: Tart little fruits grown from a rose bush, now separated from their inedible seeds and spines.

juice_pulp.name: juice pulp
juice_pulp.description: A handful of stringy pulp, left-over from juicing some kind of fruit.  It's not very tasty, but contains a lot of healthy fiber.

guayaba.name: guava
guayaba.description: A sweet, sandy-textured fruit with pink flesh native to the Caribbean, Central America, and South America.  Great for making milkshakes.

maracuya.name: handful of passionfruit
maracuya.description: A sweet, acidic fruit originating from South America.  It grows on vines and is filled with seeds like a pomegranate.  Also known as the maracuya.

lulo.name: lulo
lulo.description: An acidic fruit found in South America and the Caribbean, it looks like a hairy orange and is used mainly for juice and desserts.  Also known as the naranjilla.

grapefruit.name: grapefruit
grapefruit.description: A hybrid citrus fruit descended from the orange, whose taste ranges from sour to semi-sweet, and a little bitter.

cherries.name: handful of cherries
cherries.description: A sweet red fruit that grows on trees.  If you have some time on your hands, maybe you could figure out how to do that trick where you tie a knot in the stem with your tongue.

plums.name: plum
plums.description: A large purple plum.  Tasty and good for your digestion.

grapes.name: handful of grapes
grapes.description: A handful of juicy grapes.  Quite calorie-dense compared to most fruit, and you might be able to make them into wine if you're ambitious enough.

pineapple.name: pineapple
pineapple.description: A large, spiky tropical fruit.  A tough rind protects the tasty flesh inside, and digging into it as-is would be pretty inefficient and messy.  You should find a knife or something vaguely knife-like to cut it up with.

pineapple_chunks.name: handful of pineapple chunks
pineapple_chunks.description: A handful of pineapple chunks.  Delicious and a great source of Vitamin C, though a bit sour.

coconut.name: coconut
coconut.description: A tropical fruit with a hard, hairy shell and a hollow inside full of liquid and edible flesh.  If you want to eat it, you'll have to find something heavy to crack open the shell and something sharp to remove the 'meat'.

coconut_flesh.name: handful of coconut flesh
coconut_flesh.description: A handful of coconut flesh.  It's surprisingly calorie-dense.

peach.name: peach
peach.description: This fruit's large pit is surrounded by its tasty flesh.

watermelon.name: watermelon
watermelon.description: A deep green melon, bigger than your head.  It is very juicy!  You should be able to take it apart with a knife.

watermelon_wedge.name: watermelon wedge
watermelon_wedge.description: A yummy wedge of watermelon.  A handheld snack that tastes like summer.

melon.name: cantaloupe melon
melon.description: A large and very sweet orange fruit.  Technically a berry, like all melons are.  You should be able to take it apart with a knife.

melon_chunks.name: handful of cantaloupe melon chunks
melon_chunks.description: A handful of cantaloupe melon chunks.  A great snack by itself or in a fruit salad.

blackberries.name: handful of blackberries
blackberries.description: A darker cousin of the raspberry.  The color isn't actually what sets them apart - the identifying characteristic is whether the stem stays connected to the fruit when it's first picked.

mango.name: mango
mango.description: A fleshy tropical fruit with a large pit.  Better enjoy it soon, you're pretty sure more of these aren't going to be imported for a long time.

pomegranate.name: pomegranate
pomegranate.description: Under this pomegranate's spongy skin lie hundreds of fleshy seeds.

papaya.name: papaya
papaya.description: A very sweet and soft tropical fruit.

kiwi.name: kiwi
kiwi.description: A large, brown, and fuzzy-skinned berry.  Its delicious insides are green.

apricot.name: handful of apricots
apricot.description: A handful of smooth-skinned fruits related to the peach.

cholla_bud.name: cholla bud
cholla_bud.description: The edible bud of a cholla cactus, with its spines removed; the candy of the Mojave indigenous peoples.  Tastes similar to asparagus.

cactus_pad.name: handful of nopales
cactus_pad.description: A handful of edible pads from a cactus.

corn.name: corn cob
corn.description: A corn cob full of delicious golden kernels.  You can eat them on the cob or shell it for cooking.

empty_corn_cob.name: empty corn cob
empty_corn_cob.description: An empty corn cob.  No longer contains any edible kernels, but it can be used to make stock or as fuel.

popcorn_cob.name: popcorn cob
popcorn_cob.description: A popcorn cob full of popcorn kernels.  You can eat them on the cob or shell it for cooking.

popcorn_raw.name: raw popcorn
popcorn_raw.description: A special variety of corn which could be used for making popcorn, after it's dried.  Unlike normal corn, it's not sweet and is more dry.

kernels.name: popcorn kernels
kernels.description: Dried kernels from a particular type of corn.  Inedible raw, they can be cooked to make a tasty snack.

popcorn.name: popcorn
popcorn.description: Plain, unseasoned popcorn.  Not as tasty as other kinds, but healthier as a result.

popcorn2.name: salted popcorn
popcorn2.description: Popcorn with salt added for extra flavor.

popcorn3.name: buttered popcorn
popcorn3.description: Popcorn with a light covering of butter for extra flavor.

wheat_stalks.name: wheat stalks
wheat_stalks.description: A sheaf of freshly-cut wheat, now ready for drying in a stook or smoker.

red_winter_wheat_stalks.name: red winter wheat stalks
red_winter_wheat_stalks.description: A sheaf of freshly-cut winter wheat, now ready for drying in a stook or smoker.
red_winter_wheat_stalks.name_plural: sheaves of red winter wheat stalks

dry_wheat_stalks.name: dried wheat stalks
dry_wheat_stalks.description: A sheaf of dried wheat stalks.  These will require threshing before anything can be done with them.

dry_winter_wheat_stalks.name: dried winter wheat stalks
dry_winter_wheat_stalks.description: A sheaf of dried winter wheat stalks.  These will require threshing before anything can be done with them.
dry_winter_wheat_stalks.name_plural: sheaves of dried winter wheat stalks

threshed_wheat.name: threshed wheat
threshed_wheat.description: Wheat with the chaff still mixed in.  It will have to be winnowed before it's usable.

threshed_winter_wheat.name: threshed winter wheat
threshed_winter_wheat.description: Wheat with the chaff still mixed in.  It will have to be winnowed before it's usable.

chaff.name: chaff
chaff.description: Loose bits of dried straw and seed casings from winnowed grain.  There are a few fragments of seeds still mixed in, a big enough pile of this stuff could be made into bird food or cattle fodder.

wheat.name: wheat
wheat.description: A heap of dried wheatberries, ready for planting.  They're hard as gravel, but could be boiled for food or ground into flour.

winter_wheat.name: winter wheat
winter_wheat.description: A heap of dried wheatberries.  They're hard as gravel, but could be boiled for food or ground into flour.

barley_stalks.name: barley stalks
barley_stalks.description: A sheaf of freshly-cut barley, now ready for drying in a stook or smoker.

dry_barley_stalks.name: dried barley stalks
dry_barley_stalks.description: A sheaf of dried barley stalks.  These will require threshing before anything can be done with them.

threshed_barley.name: threshed barley
threshed_barley.description: Barley with the chaff still mixed in.  It will have to be winnowed before it's usable.

barley.name: barley
barley.description: A pile of dried barleycorn, a staple of brewing everywhere.  It can be planted, boiled, or ground into flour.

oat_stalks.name: oat stalks
oat_stalks.description: A sheaf of freshly-cut oats, now ready for drying in a stook or smoker.

dry_oat_stalks.name: dried oat stalks
dry_oat_stalks.description: A sheaf of dried oat stalks.  These will require threshing before anything can be done with them.

threshed_oats.name: threshed oats
threshed_oats.description: Oats with the chaff still mixed in.  They will have to be winnowed before they're usable.

wild_rice_stalks.name: wild rice stalks
wild_rice_stalks.description: A sheaf of wild rice stalks, ready for drying.

dry_wild_rice_stalks.name: dried wild rice stalks
dry_wild_rice_stalks.description: A bunch of dry wild rice stalks.  Threshing these would knock the grains loose.
dry_wild_rice_stalks.name_plural: sheaves of dried wild rice stalks

wild_rice.name: wild rice
wild_rice.description: Raw wild rice, still in its fibrous shell.  It'll need to be milled before it's edible for humans.

buckwheat.name: buckwheat
buckwheat.description: Dry seeds from a wild buckwheat plant.  Inedible in their present state, they are commonly cooked or ground into flour.

canola_stalks.name: canola stalks
canola_stalks.description: A sheaf of tall grass with slender little seed pods, now ready for drying.

dry_canola_stalks.name: dried canola stalks
dry_canola_stalks.description: A sheaf of dry grass, it must be threshed to separate out the seeds.

threshed_canola.name: threshed canola
threshed_canola.description: Round black seeds mixed in with dry chaff.

seed_canola.name: canola seeds
seed_canola.description: A heap of round black seeds, typically milled and pressed for their oil.

dry_lentil_stalks.name: dried lentil stalks
dry_lentil_stalks.description: A pile of short stalks with lentils rattling in their pods.  These plants dried in the field and didn't need a tool to harvest, but they'll still need to be threshed and winnowed.

threshed_lentils.name: threshed lentils
threshed_lentils.description: Lentils with chaff mixed in.  These will have to be winnowed before they're usable.

dry_lentils.name: dried lentils
dry_lentils.description: A humble but nutrient-rich legume.  They should be cooked prior to consumption, unless you're planning to plant them.

buckwheat_stalks.name: buckwheat stalks
buckwheat_stalks.description: These leafy stalks only get about waist-high and technically aren't a grass, but thanks to their long stems and nutritious seeds, they can still be farmed like any other cereal crop.

dry_buckwheat_stalks.name: dried buckwheat stalks
dry_buckwheat_stalks.description: A heap of dried buckwheat.  It'll need to be threshed before eating, unless you're a cow.

threshed_buckwheat.name: threshed buckwheat
threshed_buckwheat.description: A pile of buckwheat seeds with some chaff still mixed in.  Once it's winnowed, it'll be ready for use.

bee_balm.name: bee balm
bee_balm.description: A snow-white flower also known as wild bergamot.  Smells faintly of mint.

groundnut.name: handful of ground nuts
groundnut.description: An almost forgotten staple of the native tribes, called the Indian potato by some.  Very nutritious, but mildly toxic unless cooked.

wild_sarsaparilla_root.name: wild sarsaparilla root
wild_sarsaparilla_root.description: This aromatic rhizome can be eaten as is in an emergency, but it is much better used for making beverages.  Its taste is pleasant but it is also tough and stringy.

jerusalem_artichoke.name: Jerusalem artichoke
jerusalem_artichoke.description: A slightly sweet tuber.  Contains much inulin which may cause some minor issues with your digestive tract, so it should be cooked.

wild_garlic.name: wild garlic
wild_garlic.description: Also called ramps, this delicate leafy vegetable is healthy and a tasty ingredient for many dishes.

broccoli.name: broccoli
broccoli.description: A big stalk of broccoli.  It's a bit tough, but rich in Vitamin C and quite delicious when properly cooked.

cabbage_head.name: cabbage head
cabbage_head.description: A head of crisp white cabbage.  You should probably prepare it before eating.

grape_leaves.name: grape leaves
grape_leaves.description: Edible leaves of the grape vine.  Typically used in salads or as a food wrapping.

radish_taproot.name: handful of radish taproots
radish_taproot.description: A handful of crunchy red radish taproots.

spinach.name: handful of spinach
spinach.description: A bunch of spinach leaves.  Their ability to provide one with superhuman strength has been greatly exaggerated by popular media.

carrot.name: carrot
carrot.description: A healthy root vegetable.  Rich in vitamin A!

cattail_rhizome.name: cattail rhizome
cattail_rhizome.description: A stout, branching rhizome from a cattail plant.  Its crisp white flesh is very starchy and fibrous, but you really ought to cook it before you attempt to eat it.

lotus_rhizome.name: lotus root
lotus_rhizome.description: The rhizome of the lotus, which has many tubular cavities inside, can be eaten both raw and cooked.

cattail_stalk.name: cattail stalk
cattail_stalk.description: A stiff, green stalk from a cattail plant.  It is starchy and fibrous, but it would be much better if you cooked it.

plant_stalk.name: plant stalk
plant_stalk.description: A stiff, green stalk from a plant.  It is starchy and fibrous, but it would be much better if you cooked it.

celery.name: celery
celery.description: A single stalk of celery.  Neither tasty nor very nutritious, but it goes well with salad.

cotton_boll.name: cotton boll
cotton_boll.description: A tough protective capsule bulging with densely-packed fibers and seeds, this cotton boll can be processed into usable material with the right tools.

chili_pepper.name: chili pepper
chili_pepper.description: A spicy chili pepper.  Not the best on its own, but adds great flavor when used in cooking.

chili_pepper_cut.name: cut chili pepper
chili_pepper_cut.description: A chili pepper that's been cut into pieces.  The seeds have been removed.

cucumber.name: salad cucumber
cucumber.description: The larger cousin of a pickle.  A vegetable from the gourd family.  Not especially flavorful, but very refreshing.

gherkin.name: gherkin cucumber
gherkin.description: A pickle before it becomes a pickle.  Gherkins are smaller cucumbers that - you guessed it - are used to make pickles.

dahlia_root.name: dahlia root
dahlia_root.description: The large, tuberous root of a dahlia flower.  It smells spicy, but is too starchy to eat without cooking.

salsify_raw.name: salsify root
salsify_raw.description: A highly nutritious root, it is tough and bland until cooked, at which point it tastes strangely similar to oysters.

chicory_raw.name: chicory root
chicory_raw.description: A very bitter root, not meant to be eaten raw.

carrot_wild.name: wild root
carrot_wild.description: These are often wild carrots, but beware of poisonous lookalikes.  In any case, the root is tough and is not as tasty as a real raw carrot.

dogbane.name: dogbane
dogbane.description: A stalk of dogbane.  It has very fibrous stems and is mildly poisonous.

garlic.name: garlic bulb
garlic.description: A pungent garlic bulb.  Popular as a seasoning for its strong flavor.  Can be disassembled into cloves.

garlic_clove.name: garlic clove
garlic_clove.description: Cloves of garlic.  Useful as a seasoning.

hops.name: hops flower
hops.description: A cluster of small cone-like flowers, indispensable for brewing beer.

horseradish_root.name: horseradish root
horseradish_root.description: A large white tapered root of a horseradish plant.  Way too spicy to eat in this form, but can be used for making condiments.

lettuce_head.name: lettuce head
lettuce_head.description: A crisp head of iceberg lettuce.  You should probably prepare it before eating.

lettuce.name: handful of shredded lettuce
lettuce.description: A handful of shredded iceberg lettuce.

mugwort.name: mugwort
mugwort.description: A stalk of mugwort.  Smells wonderful.

onion.name: onion
onion.description: An aromatic onion used in cooking.  Cutting these up can make your eyes sting!

plant_sac.name: fungal fluid sac
plant_sac.description: A fluid bladder from a fungus-based lifeform.  The membrane is tough and nearly indigestible.  It doesn't seem to contain anything deliberately toxic to you, but the alien biology and sharp, earthy, rotting scent suggests it still wouldn't be wise to ingest regardless of the fluid's purpose to its original owner.

potato.name: raw potato
potato.description: A potato, mildly toxic and not very tasty raw.  Delicious and filling when properly cooked.

plantain.name: cooking banana
plantain.description: A much less sweet and more starchy relative of the banana; unlike dessert bananas, they usually are eaten cooked rather than raw, and can be processed into flour.  They are a staple food in tropical regions of the world.  Also known as plantains.

pumpkin.name: pumpkin
pumpkin.description: A large gourd, about the size of a person's head.  It'll require some disassembly before use.

pumpkin_cut.name: cut pumpkin
pumpkin_cut.description: A quarter section of a pumpkin.  The seeds and stringy inner pulp have been removed.

horseradish_greens.name: horseradish greens
horseradish_greens.description: Leaves of a horseradish plant with a sharp, bitter and peppery taste.  They're edible, but not commonly eaten.

raw_dandelion.name: dandelion
raw_dandelion.description: A handful of freshly-picked yellow dandelions.  In their current raw state they are quite bitter.

raw_burdock.name: burdock
raw_burdock.description: Burdock, a bitter thistle-like vegetable.  Can be eaten raw or cooked.

raw_bamboo.name: handful of bamboo shoots
raw_bamboo.description: Raw woody bamboo shoots, they require some preparation before they can be eaten safely.

rhubarb.name: rhubarb
rhubarb.description: A sour stalk of the rhubarb plant, often used in baking pies.

sugar_beet.name: sugar beet
sugar_beet.description: This fleshy root is ripe and flowing with sugars; it'll just take some processing to extract them.

tea_raw.name: black tea leaves
tea_raw.description: Dried leaves of a tropical plant.  You can boil them into tea, or you can just eat them raw.  They're pretty gross and not too filling that way, though.

wintergreen_leaves.name: pile of wintergreen leaves
wintergreen_leaves.description: These leaves smell strongly medicinal.  When chewed, they first taste sweet but the aftertaste is incredibly bitter.  These leaves contain good amounts of methyl salicylate and merely chewing them may have a similar effect to aspirin.

tea_green_raw.name: green tea leaves
tea_green_raw.description: Dried leaves of a tropical plant.  You can boil them into green tea, or you can just eat them raw.  They're pretty gross and not too filling that way, though.

tomato.name: tomato
tomato.description: A juicy red tomato.  It gained popularity in Italy after being brought back from the New World.

tomato_cut.name: cut tomato
tomato_cut.description: A cut-up tomato with the seeds removed.

veggy.name: triffid flesh
veggy.description: An weird looking chunk of plant matter that's a shade of yellow and green, with oddly thick fibers.  It smells like a mix of rotted wood and dirt, and it leaks a clear fluid.

veggy_tainted.name: alien fungus chunk
veggy_tainted.description: A chunk of fungal matter from some sort of alien mushroom creature.  Eating unfamiliar mushrooms is a bad idea.

veggy_wild.name: wild vegetables
veggy_wild.description: An assortment of edible-looking wild plants.  Most are quite bitter-tasting.  Some are inedible until cooked.

zucchini_cut.name: cut zucchini
zucchini_cut.description: A chopped-up summer squash.  The seeds have been removed.

raw_beans.name: handful of raw beans
raw_beans.description: Raw, uncooked kidney beans.  They are mildly toxic to humans in this form, but you could cook them to make them tasty.

fiddlehead_raw.name: fiddleheads
fiddlehead_raw.description: A handful of immature fern fronds, still curled up like the head of a fiddle.  Delicious when cooked, but consuming them raw can cause food poisoning.

young_leaves.name: handful of young leaves
young_leaves.description: Some young leaves from miscellaneous plants.  They're tender enough to eat, but not very tasty on their own.

chicory_leaves.name: handful of chicory greens
chicory_leaves.description: Some chicory greens.  They are quite bitter but high in calcium.

japanese_knotweed_stem.name: Japanese knotweed stems
japanese_knotweed_stem.description: Some young Japanese knotweed stems.  They taste a bit like rhubarb and contain good amounts of vitamin A.  Refreshing.

bell_pepper.name: bell pepper
bell_pepper.description: A green bell pepper.  Eating it whole and raw would be kind of a hassle, considering all the seeds.

bell_pepper_cut.name: cut bell pepper
bell_pepper_cut.description: A chopped up bell pepper with the seeds removed.

flour_wheat_free.name: wheat-free flour
flour_wheat_free.description: This wheat-free white flour is useful for baking items for those with grain intolerances.

raw_bottle_gourd.name: raw bottle gourd
raw_bottle_gourd.description: A vegetable from the gourd family, bottle gourds were brought to the Americas by the first Native American settlers crossing the Bering strait.  It can be further prepared to produce a hard, watertight shell, usable as a biodegradable liquid container.  Eating it doesn't look worth it.

eggplant.name: eggplant
eggplant.description: A normal and healthy purple eggplant.  Needs to be disassembled before being useful for cooking.

eggplant_cut.name: cut eggplant
eggplant_cut.description: A cut-up eggplant with many of the seeds picked out.

seaweed.name: seaweed
seaweed.description: A handful of slimy seaweed.  It doesn't look edible, but properly dried, it might make for decent kindling.

seaweed_pile.name: pile of seaweed
seaweed_pile.description: A slimy heap of seaweed.  It doesn't look edible, but properly dried, it might make for decent kindling.

sea_lettuce.name: sea lettuce
sea_lettuce.description: A handful of edible green seaweed.  It makes a good snack as-is, but can be dried or prepared in a number of ways.

kelp_sugar.name: sugar kelp
kelp_sugar.description: A sizable strip of new growth harvested from a sugar kelp.  While these are most often dried, it seems edible enough as is.

bladderwrack.name: bladderwrack
bladderwrack.description: A leafy bunch of seaweed covered in air bladders.  Many claims are made about its health benefits, but at least as a foodstuff, it's no better or worse than other edible seaweed.

raw_artichoke.name: raw artichoke
raw_artichoke.description: The immature flower bud of a large thistle plant.  If left to grow, it blooms into a vibrant purple flower.  Needs to be disassembled before being useful for cooking.

artichoke_heart.name: artichoke heart
artichoke_heart.description: The soft inside of a raw artichoke.

raw_asparagus.name: raw asparagus
raw_asparagus.description: A green spring vegetable known for its long, slender stalks and tender tips.

brussels_sprout_stalk.name: brussels sprout stalk
brussels_sprout_stalk.description: A green stalk with many brussels sprout.

brussels_sprout.name: brussels sprout
brussels_sprout.description: A small green vegetable that resembles a miniature cabbage.  It grows in clusters along a thick stalk.

cauliflower_head.name: cauliflower head
cauliflower_head.description: A cruciferous vegetable grown for its large edible flower head.  It belongs to the same plant family as broccoli, cabbage, and Brussels sprouts.

kale_head.name: kale head
kale_head.description: A leafy green vegetable belonging to the cabbage family.  It is known for its dark green, curly or flat leaves and its high nutritional value.

sandwich_cheese_grilled.name: grilled cheese sandwich
sandwich_cheese_grilled.description: A delicious grilled cheese sandwich, because everything is better with melted cheese.

sandwich_deluxe.name: deluxe sandwich
sandwich_deluxe.description: A sandwich of meat, vegetables, and cheese with condiments.  Tasty and nutritious!

sandwich_reuben.name: reuben sandwich
sandwich_reuben.description: A pre-Cataclysm classic, probably made with significant substitutions.  Key components are the special sauce and sauerkraut, with bread, meat, and cheese fried in a pan.

sandwich_cucumber.name: cucumber sandwich
sandwich_cucumber.description: A refreshing cucumber sandwich.  Not very filling, but quite tasty.

sandwich_jam_cheese.name: jam and cheese sandwich
sandwich_jam_cheese.description: A delicious jam and cheese sandwich.

sandwich_jam_butter.name: jam and butter sandwich
sandwich_jam_butter.description: A delicious jam and butter sandwich.

sandwich_fairy.name: fairy bread
sandwich_fairy.description: An 'open-faced sandwich' consisting of sliced white bread, a healthy crust-to-crust slathering of butter, and sprinkles.  Supposedly a staple of birthday parties in Australia.

sandwich_sauce.name: boring sandwich
sandwich_sauce.description: A simple sauce sandwich.  Not very filling, but it beats eating just the bread.

sandwich_veggy_cheese.name: vegetable sandwich with cheese
sandwich_veggy_cheese.description: A vegetarian combination of cheese and vegetable on bread, simple yet satisfying.

sandwich_pb.name: peanut butter sandwich
sandwich_pb.description: Some peanut butter smothered between two pieces of bread.  Not very filling, and will stick to the roof of your mouth like glue.

sandwich_pbj.name: PB&J sandwich
sandwich_pbj.description: A delicious peanut butter and jelly sandwich.  It reminds you of the times your mother would make you lunch.

sandwich_pbh.name: PB&H sandwich
sandwich_pbh.description: Some damned fool put honey on this peanut butter sandwich, who in their right mind- oh wait, this is pretty good.

sandwich_pbm.name: PB&M sandwich
sandwich_pbm.description: Who knew you could mix maple syrup and peanut butter to create yet another tasty sandwich?

fish_bagel.name: fish and spinach bagel
fish_bagel.description: A delicious fish bagel with spinach and eggs.

blt.name: BLT
blt.description: A bacon, lettuce, and tomato sandwich on toasted bread.

chicken_sandwich.name: chicken sandwich
chicken_sandwich.description: A sandwich of crispy fried chicken topped with condiments and veggies.  Also called chicken burger, or chicken on a bun.

sandwich_pbf.name: fluffernutter sandwich
sandwich_pbf.description: A delicious peanut butter and marshmallow fluff sandwich.  More commonly referred to as a fluffernutter.

seed_hops.name: hop rhizomes
seed_hops.description: Roots of a hop plant, for growing your own.

seed_barley.name: barley seeds
seed_barley.description: This pile of dried barley is earmarked for planting.

seed_cotton_boll.name: cotton seeds
seed_cotton_boll.description: Some cotton seeds.  Can be processed to produce an edible oil.

seed_cattail.name: cattail seeds
seed_cattail.description: Some cattail seeds.  Must be planted in shallow water.

seed_lotus.name: lotus seeds
seed_lotus.description: Some lotus seeds, which can be used for planting, or cooked and eaten after picking off the bitter internal ingredients.  Must be planted in shallow water.

seed_lotus_boiled.name: boiled lotus seeds
seed_lotus_boiled.description: Boiled lotus seeds, with a soft taste.

seed_wildcarrot.name: wild root seeds
seed_wildcarrot.description: Some seeds from a white flower.

seed_flower.name: decorative plant seeds
seed_flower.description: Some small decorative plant seeds, likely grass or flower.  Don't expect them to be useful for anything other than dry plant material.

seed_corn.name: corn seeds
seed_corn.description: A pile of dried corn, designated for planting.  It could just as easily become food.

seed_potato_raw.name: potato section
seed_potato_raw.description: A quarter section of a potato, cut up for planting.

seed_poppy_bud.name: poppy seeds
seed_poppy_bud.description: Some poppy seeds.  Could be pressed into oil.

seed_weed.name: cannabis seeds
seed_weed.description: Seeds of the cannabis plant.  Filled with vitamins, they can be roasted or eaten raw.

marloss_seed.name: Marloss seed
marloss_seed.description: This looks like a sunflower seed the size of your palm.  It has a strong but delicious aroma, but is clearly either mutated or of alien origin.  You could probably plant it.

soybean_seed.name: soybean seeds
soybean_seed.description: A pile of dry soybeans.  These are intended for planting, but there's no reason they couldn't be made into food.

seed_pumpkin.name: pumpkin seeds
seed_pumpkin.description: Some raw pumpkin seeds with the shells on.  Could be fried and eaten.

seed_sunflower.name: sunflower seeds
seed_sunflower.description: Some raw sunflower seeds with the shells on.  Could be pressed into oil.

seed_buckwheat.name: buckwheat seeds
seed_buckwheat.description: A pile of buckwheat, ready to be planted.

seed_wild_herbs.name: wild herb seeds
seed_wild_herbs.description: Some seeds harvested from wild herbs.

seed_japanese_knotweed.name: Japanese knotweed stems
seed_japanese_knotweed.description: Some Japanese knotweed stems, prepared for planting.

seed_wild_rice.name: wild rice seeds
seed_wild_rice.description: Some wild rice seeds, prepared for planting.

seed_maianthemum_stellatum.name: starry false Solomon's seal seeds
seed_maianthemum_stellatum.description: Some starry false Solomon's seal seeds.

datura_seed.name: datura seeds
datura_seed.description: Small, dark seeds from the spiny pods of a datura plant.  Full of powerful psychoactive chemicals, these tiny seeds are a potent analgesic and deliriant, and can be deadly in cases of overdose.

seed_oats.name: oat seeds
seed_oats.description: A pile of dried whole oats, ready for planting.

seed_garlic_clove.name: seed garlic
seed_garlic_clove.description: Several cloves of garlic, ready for planting.

seed_wheat.name: wheat seeds
seed_wheat.description: A pile of dry wheatberries, designated for planting.

seed_red_winter_wheat.name: red winter wheat seeds
seed_red_winter_wheat.description: A pile of dry wheatberries, designated for planting.  This variety is meant to grow over winter, ready for harvest in the Spring.

fried_seeds.name: fried seeds
fried_seeds.description: Some fried seeds of a sunflower, pumpkin or other plant.  Quite nutritious and tasty.

coffee_pod.name: Kentucky coffee pod
coffee_pod.description: Coffee pods taken from a Kentucky coffeetree.  If washed thoroughly and roasted, you could use them to make a dark and bitter brew much like coffee.

coffee_bean.name: coffee beans
coffee_bean.description: Some coffee beans, can be roasted.

roasted_coffee_bean.name: roasted coffee beans
roasted_coffee_bean.description: Some roasted coffee beans, can be ground into powder.

seed_popcorn.name: seed popcorn
seed_popcorn.description: A bunch of dry unpopped corn.  It's intended for planting, but could be put to other uses.

seed_mustard.name: mustard seeds
seed_mustard.description: Some mustard seeds.  Could be ground into mustard powder.

seed_pea.name: pea seeds
seed_pea.description: Some fresh peas, ready for planting.

serum_regen.name: 48x-"Locutus"
serum_regen.description: A little, sealed ampule with some white, semi-transparent liquid of unknown origin.  The label on it says "48x-"Locutus"", whatever that means.

serum_super_soldier.name: 29x-"Noonien"
serum_super_soldier.description: A little, sealed ampule with some reddish, semi-transparent liquid of unknown origin.  The label on it says "29x-"Noonien"", whatever that means.

serum_resilience.name: 16x-"Armus"
serum_resilience.description: A little, sealed ampule with some grayish, semi-transparent liquid of unknown origin.  The label on it says "16x-"Armus"", whatever that means.

serum_learning.name: 76x-"Lore"
serum_learning.description: A little, sealed ampule with some blue, semi-transparent liquid of unknown origin.  The label on it says "76x-"Lore"", whatever that means.

serum_speed.name: 51x-"Landru"
serum_speed.description: A little, sealed ampule with some yellow, semi-transparent liquid of unknown origin.  The label on it says "51x-"Landru"", whatever that means.

serum_night_operations.name: 09x-"Anaximander"
serum_night_operations.description: A little, sealed ampule with some black, semi-transparent liquid of unknown origin.  The label on it says "09x-"Anaximander"", whatever that means.

broth.name: vegetable broth
broth.description: Vegetable stock.  Tasty and fairly nutritious.

broth_meat.name: meat broth
broth_meat.description: Meat stock.  Tasty and fairly nutritious.

broth_bone.name: bone broth
broth_bone.description: A tasty and nutritious broth made from bones.

soup_veggy.name: vegetable soup
soup_veggy.description: A nutritious and delicious hearty vegetable soup.

soup_three_sisters.name: three sisters stew
soup_three_sisters.description: A hearty stew made of the traditional 'three sisters' plants corn, beans, and pumpkins.  Variations of this dish were a staple of many Native American cultures through the centuries up until current times.  This Abenaki recipe has wild rice added to it.

soup_meat.name: meat soup
soup_meat.description: A nutritious and delicious hearty meat soup.

soup_fish.name: fish soup
soup_fish.description: A nutritious and delicious hearty fish soup.

curry_veggy.name: curry
curry_veggy.description: A spicy South Indian dish filled with vegetables.

curry_meat.name: curry with meat
curry_meat.description: A spicy South Asian dish filled with chunks of meat and vegetables.

soup_woods.name: woods meat soup
soup_woods.description: A nutritious and delicious soup packed with meat and vegetables.

soup_woods_egg.name: woods egg soup
soup_woods_egg.description: A nutritious and delicious soup packed with eggs and vegetables.

hellfire_stew.name: hellfire stew
hellfire_stew.description: An old recipe from the American Civil War, designed to make hardtack more palatable.  The hardtack is crushed and combined with water to make it soggy, then fried up with melted chunks of fat until browned, and seasoned with salt and pepper.  Surprisingly edible, considering its ingredients.

soup_chicken.name: chicken noodle soup
soup_chicken.description: Chicken chunks and noodles swimming in a salty broth.  Rumored to help cure colds.

soup_mushroom.name: mushroom soup
soup_mushroom.description: A mushy, gray semi-liquid soup made from mushrooms.

soup_blood.name: blood soup
soup_blood.description: A mushy, brown semi-liquid soup made from blood and flour.

soup_tomato.name: tomato soup
soup_tomato.description: Condensed tomato soup.  Not very filling, but it goes well with grilled cheese.

soup_dumplings.name: chicken and dumplings
soup_dumplings.description: A soup with chicken chunks and balls of dough.  Not bad.

soup_cullenskink.name: Cullen skink
soup_cullenskink.description: A rich and tasty fish chowder from Scotland, made with preserved fish and creamy milk.

soup_lobsterstew.name: lobster stew
soup_lobsterstew.description: A rich and tasty lobster stew from New England, made with fresh lobster, milk, cream, and butter.

soup_instant_chicken_noodle_prepared.name: instant chicken noodle soup
soup_instant_chicken_noodle_prepared.description: Instant chicken noodle soup made from dehydrated noodles and chicken reconstituted with water.  Not the most exciting meal but better than plain water.

soup_instant_chicken_noodle_powder.name: instant chicken noodle soup powder
soup_instant_chicken_noodle_powder.description: Instant chicken noodle soup powder made from dehydrated noodles and chicken.  Mix with water to create a mildly improved meal.

soup_instant_vegetable_prepared.name: instant spring vegetable soup
soup_instant_vegetable_prepared.description: Instant spring vegetable soup made from dehydrated noodles and vegetables reconstituted with water.  Not the most exciting meal but better than plain water.

soup_instant_vegetable_powder.name: instant spring vegetable soup powder
soup_instant_vegetable_powder.description: Instant spring vegetable soup powder made from dehydrated noodles and vegetables.  Mix with water to create a mildly improved meal.

coqauvin.name: coq au vin
coqauvin.description: French chicken stew braised with red wine.

chilly-p.name: chili powder
chilly-p.description: Chili P, yo!  Not edible on its own, but it could be used to make seasoning.

garlic_powder.name: garlic powder
garlic_powder.description: Garlic that has been dehydrated and ground into a powder.  A must-have seasoning in any pantry.

hot_sauce.name: hot sauce
hot_sauce.description: Flamin' hot sauce.  It'd be a bad idea to drink it on its own.  You should probably wash your hands after handling it, too.

cinnamon.name: cinnamon
cinnamon.description: Ground cinnamon bark with a sweet but slightly spicy aroma.

curry_powder.name: curry powder
curry_powder.description: A blend of spices meant to be used in some South Asian dishes.  Can't be eaten raw, why would you even try that?

pepper.name: black pepper
pepper.description: Ground black spice berries with a pungent aroma.

spicebush_berries.name: spicebush berries
spicebush_berries.description: Small, red berries with a pungent aroma.  It is said they are comparable to allspice, but also boasting their own flavor profile.

spicebush_berries_smoked.name: dry spicebush berries
spicebush_berries_smoked.description: These formerly red berries now have a stronger aroma after being dehydrated.

salt.name: salt
salt.description: Yuck!  You surely wouldn't want to eat this.  It's good for preserving meat and cooking, though.

seasoning_italian.name: Italian seasoning
seasoning_italian.description: A fragrant mix of dried oregano, basil, thyme and other spices.

seasoning_salt.name: seasoned salt
seasoning_salt.description: Salt mixed with a fragrant blend of secret herbs and spices.

sugar.name: sugar
sugar.description: Sweet, sweet sugar.  Bad for your teeth and surprisingly not very tasty on its own.

sprinkles.name: sprinkles
sprinkles.description: Known as nonpareils, sprinkles, jimmies, sugar strands or 'hundreds-and-thousands', these colorful balls, rods or flakes of sugar and starch are intended for use decorating soft surfaces of sweets.  Like sugar, they are bad for your teeth and surprisingly not very tasty on their own.

wild_herbs.name: wild herbs
wild_herbs.description: A tasty collection of wild herbs including violet, sassafras, mint, clover, purslane, and fireweed.

thyme.name: thyme
thyme.description: A stalk of thyme.  Smells delicious.

mustard_powder.name: mustard powder
mustard_powder.description: A fragrant yellow powder.  Not edible in this form.

artificial_sweetener.name: artificial sweetener
artificial_sweetener.description: Sweet, sweet sugar?  No, it is bitter-sweet artificial sweetener.  No calories, no worries.

cooked_cattail_stalk.name: cooked cattail stalk
cooked_cattail_stalk.description: A cooked stalk from a cattail plant.  Its fibrous outer leaves have been stripped away, and now it is quite delicious.

cooked_burdock_stalk.name: cooked plant stalk
cooked_burdock_stalk.description: A cooked stalk from a plant.  Its fibrous outer leaves have been stripped away, and now it is quite delicious.

roasted_cattail_rhizome.name: roasted cattail rhizome
roasted_cattail_rhizome.description: A roasted root from a cattail plant.  Its fibrous outer core is charred black, so you can remove it and chew on the dry inside.

starch.name: starch
starch.description: Sticky, gooey carbohydrate paste extracted from plants.  Spoils rather quickly if not prepared for storage.

garlic_roasted.name: roasted garlic
garlic_roasted.description: Exposed cloves of garlic that have been coated in oil and then roasted.  Much better than eating them raw.

chili_pepper_roasted.name: roasted chili pepper
chili_pepper_roasted.description: A chili pepper that has been roasted on high heat, with the skin removed.  This has taken out most of the spice, and it's much better than eating it raw.

dandelion_cooked.name: cooked dandelion greens
dandelion_cooked.description: Cooked leaves from wild dandelions.  Tasty and nutritious.

dandelion_fried.name: fried dandelions
dandelion_fried.description: Wild dandelion flowers that have been pan fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.

burdock_cooked.name: cooked burdock greens
burdock_cooked.description: Cooked burdock leaves.  Tasty and nutritious.

burdock_fried.name: fried burdocks
burdock_fried.description: Wild burdocks that have been battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.

dandelionburdock_fried.name: fried dandelions and burdocks
dandelionburdock_fried.description: Wild dandelions and burdocks that have been battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.

bamboo_cooked.name: cooked bamboo shoots
bamboo_cooked.description: Peeled and cooked bamboo shoots.  Tasty and nutritious.

bamboo_fried.name: fried bamboo shoots
bamboo_fried.description: Raw bamboo shoots that have been peeled, battered and deep-fried.  Very tasty and nutritious.

veggy_cooked.name: cooked plant marrow
veggy_cooked.description: A freshly-cooked chunk of plant matter, tasty and nutritious.

veggy_wild_cooked.name: cooked wild vegetables
veggy_wild_cooked.description: Cooked wild edible plants.  An interesting mix of flavors.

veggy_aspic.name: vegetable aspic
veggy_aspic.description: A dish in which vegetables are set into a gelatin made from a plant stock.

buckwheat_cooked.name: cooked buckwheat
buckwheat_cooked.description: A serving of cooked buckwheat porridge.  Healthy and nutritious but bland.

can_corn.name: canned corn
can_corn.description: Canned corn in water.  Eat up!

corn_on_cob.name: corn on the cob
corn_on_cob.description: An ear of corn cooked in foil.

pan_roasted_corn.name: pan roasted corn
pan_roasted_corn.description: Corn roasted in a frying pan with herbs and spices.

hominy.name: hominy
hominy.description: Popcorn kernels which have been cooked in an alkaline solution and then rinsed, making them better suited for eating or cooking.

cornmeal.name: cornmeal
cornmeal.description: This yellow cornmeal is useful for baking.

deluxe_veggy_beans.name: vegetarian baked beans
deluxe_veggy_beans.description: Slow-cooked beans with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.

dry_rice.name: dried rice
dry_rice.description: Dehydrated long-grain rice.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, virtually inedible when dry.

dry_wild_rice.name: dry wild rice
dry_wild_rice.description: Raw, milled wild rice.  Tasty and nutritious when cooked, virtually inedible when dry.

rice_cooked.name: cooked rice
rice_cooked.description: A hearty serving of cooked long-grain white rice.

wild_rice_cooked.name: cooked wild rice
wild_rice_cooked.description: A hearty serving of cooked wild rice.

deluxe_veggy_rice.name: fried rice
deluxe_veggy_rice.description: Delicious fried rice with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.

beansnrice.name: beans and rice
beansnrice.description: A serving of beans and rice that has been cooked together.  Delicious and healthy!

succotash.name: succotash
succotash.description: Coming from a word meaning "broken corn kernels" in the language of the Narragansett, it is a popular dish during hard times and Thanksgiving in New England.  Incorporating maize and beans (or a similar legume), it is cheap and made from common ingredients.

succotash_deluxe.name: succotash deluxe
succotash_deluxe.description: Succotash, but made more modern and tasty by adding some flavorful ingredients.

tofu_rice.name: tofu fried rice
tofu_rice.description: Delicious tofu fried rice with vegetables.  Tasty and very filling.

tofu_stirfry.name: tofu stirfry
tofu_stirfry.description: A tofu stirfry with rice and a sweet, bold flavor sure to stay on your mind through these dark days.

deluxe_veggy_beansnrice.name: deluxe vegetarian beans and rice
deluxe_veggy_beansnrice.description: Slow-cooked beans and rice with vegetables and seasonings.  Tasty and very filling.

potato_baked.name: baked potato
potato_baked.description: A delicious baked potato or other tuber.  Got any sour cream?

potato_boiled.name: boiled potato
potato_boiled.description: A boiled potato or other tuber, the keystone of comfort food.

lotus_rhizome_boiled.name: boiled lotus root
lotus_rhizome_boiled.description: A boiled lotus rhizome, with a soft taste.

plantain_cooked.name: roasted cooking banana
plantain_cooked.description: The much less sweet and more starchy relative of the banana, that has been cooked to make it better suited for eating.

carrot_glazed.name: glazed carrot
carrot_glazed.description: A grilled glazed carrot, topped with some aromatic herbs.  Simply divine.

cooked_pumpkin.name: mashed pumpkin
cooked_pumpkin.description: A simple dish made by cooking pumpkin pulp and then mashing.

pie_veggy.name: slice of vegetable pie
pie_veggy.description: A delicious baked pie with a tasty vegetable filling.

samosa_veggy.name: vegetable samosa
samosa_veggy.description: A crispy, savory pastry filled with spicy potatoes and vegetables, popular in Indian cuisine.

pizza_veggy.name: vegetable pizza
pizza_veggy.description: A vegetarian pizza, with delicious tomato sauce and a fluffy crust.  Its smell brings back great memories.

sauce_pesto.name: pesto
sauce_pesto.description: Olive oil, basil, garlic, and pine nuts.  Simple and delicious.

veggy_canned.name: canned veggy
veggy_canned.description: This mushy pile of vegetable matter was boiled and canned in an earlier life.  Better eat it before it oozes through your fingers.

veggy_salted.name: salted veggy chunk
veggy_salted.description: Vegetable chunks pickled in a salt bath.  Goes well with burgers, if you can find one.

spaghetti_pesto.name: spaghetti al pesto
spaghetti_pesto.description: Spaghetti with a generous helping of pesto on top.  Yum!

pickle.name: pickle
pickle.description: A small pickled cucumber.  Rather sour, but tastes good and lasts for a long time.

sauerkraut_onions.name: sauerkraut w/ sauteed onions
sauerkraut_onions.description: A delicious sautee of lovely diced onions and sauerkraut.  The smell alone is enough to make your mouth water.

veggy_pickled.name: pickled veggy
veggy_pickled.description: A serving of crisply brined and canned vegetable matter.  Tasty and nutritious.

veggy_pickled_fried.name: fried pickled veggy
veggy_pickled_fried.description: A serving of fried pickled vegetables, tangy with a crunchy golden-brown coating.

dry_veggy.name: dehydrated vegetable
dry_veggy.description: Dehydrated vegetable flakes.  With proper storage, this dried food will remain edible for an incredibly long time.

dry_chili.name: dehydrated chili pepper
dry_chili.description: A dehydrated chili pepper.  Still not great, but you can easily ground or mill it into powder.

dry_garlic.name: dehydrated garlic clove
dry_garlic.description: Dehydrated garlic.  You definitely don't want to eat these like this, but they can be milled or grounded into garlic powder.

dry_corn.name: dehydrated corn kernels
dry_corn.description: A handful of dried corn kernels.

rehydrated_veggy.name: rehydrated vegetable
rehydrated_veggy.description: Reconstituted vegetable flakes, which are much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.

rehydrated_chili.name: rehydrated chili pepper
rehydrated_chili.description: Reconstituted chili pepper.  It isn't less spicy after dehydrating and rehydrating but it can be used to flavor your dishes again.

rehydrated_garlic.name: rehydrated garlic clove
rehydrated_garlic.description: Reconstituted garlic cloves, much more edible than its dehydrated state, although the flavor and texture has changed in the process.  Can be used for recipes, albeit its shelf life is shortened by a great margin.

rehydrated_corn_kernels.name: rehydrated corn kernels
rehydrated_corn_kernels.description: Reconstituted corn kernels, much more enjoyable to eat now that they have been rehydrated.

veggy_salad.name: vegetable salad
veggy_salad.description: A salad made with all kind of vegetables.

dried_salad.name: dried salad
dried_salad.description: A dried salad packed in a box with mayonnaise and ketchup.  Add water to enjoy.

insta_salad.name: insta-salad
insta_salad.description: A dried salad with water added, not very tasty but still a decent substitution for real salad.

dahlia_baked.name: baked dahlia root
dahlia_baked.description: Baking this dahlia root has broken down the starch, making it softer and sweeter.

salsify_baked.name: roasted salsify
salsify_baked.description: Now that it's been properly cooked, this salsify tastes vaguely like oysters.  Makes a great side dish.

sushi_rice.name: sushi rice
sushi_rice.description: A serving of sticky vinegared rice, commonly used in sushi.

onigiri.name: onigiri
onigiri.description: A triangular block of tasty sushi rice with a healthy green vegetable folded around it.

sushi_veggyroll.name: vegetable hosomaki
sushi_veggyroll.description: Delicious chopped vegetables wrapped in tasty sushi rice and rolled up in a healthy green vegetable.

dry_veggy_tainted.name: dehydrated alien fungus chunk
dry_veggy_tainted.description: Pieces of alien mushroom that have been dried to prevent them from rotting away.  They will still poison you if you eat them.

sauerkraut.name: sauerkraut
sauerkraut.description: This crunchy, sour topping made from lettuce or cabbage is perfect for your hot dogs and hamburgers, or, if you're desperate, straight to your stomach.

nopalitos.name: nopalito
nopalitos.description: A less prickly version of cactus pads.

fiddlehead_boiled.name: boiled fiddleheads
fiddlehead_boiled.description: Boiled fiddleheads.  Not bad, but would be better sauteed in butter.

fiddlehead_sauteed.name: sauteed fiddleheads
fiddlehead_sauteed.description: Fiddleheads sauteed in fat.  Tender and delicious.

jerusalem_artichoke_sauteed.name: sauteed Jerusalem artichoke
jerusalem_artichoke_sauteed.description: Most of this artichoke's inulin has been converted into fructose after cooking, and it now tastes pleasantly sweet.

jerusalem_artichoke_boiled.name: boiled Jerusalem artichoke
jerusalem_artichoke_boiled.description: Still crunchy but much more palatable than raw, with a slight nutty taste.

cooked_bell_pepper.name: cooked bell pepper
