box_small_plastic.name: secured plastic box
box_small_plastic.description: A small plastic box with a rugged exterior, the cover securely held by several small latches.

30gal_barrel_mutagen.name: 30 gallon barrel
30gal_barrel_mutagen.description: A huge plastic barrel with a watertight lid.  It's surface is completely covered with hazard warning labels and, most importantly, a giant red tape, that reads "IMPURE CATALYST, DO NOT USE, FAILED SAMPLE, DO NOT USE, IMPURE CATALYST…"

ammunition_can_30.name: small ammo can
ammunition_can_30.description: A solid metal ammo box with a small handle on top and shabby yellow text printed on the side.

ammunition_can_50.name: ammo can
ammunition_can_50.description: A solid metal ammo box with a small handle on top and shabby yellow text printed on the side.

ammunition_can_fat_50.name: big ammo can
ammunition_can_fat_50.description: A solid metal ammo box with a small handle on top and shabby yellow text printed on the side.

ammunition_can_pa120.name: heavy-duty ammo can
ammunition_can_pa120.description: A huge metal box with handles on each end.  It is almost inconveniently big, but can hold a lot of heavy items inside.

ammunition_can_pa124.name: heavy-duty ammo can
ammunition_can_pa124.description: A huge metal box with handles on each end.  It is almost inconveniently big, but can hold a lot of heavy items inside.

ammunition_tube_mortar.name: mortar container
ammunition_tube_mortar.description: A small, thick cylindrical container.  Designed to store a single mortar round.

ammunition_box_grenade.name: grenade container
ammunition_box_grenade.description: A small, thick cylindrical container.  Designed to store a single grenade, it seems.

ammunition_can_carlgustav.name: double 84mm HEDP container
ammunition_can_carlgustav.description: Huge metal container, in a shape of two massive rockets.

ammunition_box_carlgustav.name: 84mm HE crate
ammunition_box_carlgustav.description: Relatively small metal box.  On one side it has label "EXPLOSIVE"

ammunition_crate_40x46_72.name: wooden crate
ammunition_crate_40x46_72.description: Huge wooden crate, closed with metal wire.

ammo_box_army_3_clips.name: cardboard ammo box
ammo_box_army_3_clips.description: A small brown box without a cover.

55gal_drum_rubber.name: collapsible drum
55gal_drum_rubber.description: A beige collapsible drum with a water valve and D-Rings.  Text on its top clearly says "POTABLE WATER ONLY".

432gal_drum_rubber.name: big collapsible drum
432gal_drum_rubber.description: A black collapsible drum with a valve and D-Rings.  Yellow text on its top clearly says "FLAMMABLE".  Empty and collapsed, it could be moved elsewhere.

rmi2_corpse.name: desiccated corpse
rmi2_corpse.description: A badly mangled human body.  A giant puncture wound is visible on its upper chest, and something has drained most of the moisture from the carcass, leaving it desiccated and making it impossible to determine the body's age.

corpse_generic_male.name: corpse
corpse_generic_male.description: A dead body of a middle-aged man.

corpse_generic_female.name: corpse
corpse_generic_female.description: A dead body of a young woman.

corpse_generic_boy.name: corpse
corpse_generic_boy.description: A dead body of a little boy.

corpse_generic_girl.name: corpse
corpse_generic_girl.description: A dead body of a little girl.

corpse_child_calm.name: corpse
corpse_child_calm.description: The dead body of a small child.  Their corpse bears a calm facial expression, as if they died instantly.

corpse_child_gunned.name: corpse
corpse_child_gunned.description: The dead body of a child, riddled by bullets to the extent that you can no longer tell their gender.

snippet_category.text: The dead body of a child, riddled by bullets to the extent that you can no longer tell their gender.
The corpse of an infant.  A single small-caliber bullet has been put through its skull.

corpse_oldwoman_jewelry.name: corpse
corpse_oldwoman_jewelry.description: A dead body of an old woman.  Both of her earlobes are torn, several of her fingers have been chopped off, and several of her teeth have been knocked out.

corpse_bloody.name: corpse
corpse_bloody.description: A dead body, coated in congealed blood.

corpse_painful.name: corpse
corpse_painful.description: A dead body with a frightful grimace on its face.  He appears to have been horribly mangled prior to his death.

corpse_scorched.name: corpse
corpse_scorched.description: An awful, almost unidentifiable mass of charred flesh.

corpse_stabbed.name: corpse
corpse_stabbed.description: A dead body with a gaping stab wound in its back.

snippet_category.text: A dead body with a gaping stab wound in its back.
The bloody corpse of a young man.  He has been stabbed repeatedly in the jugular and throat with a small blade.
The dead body of a person.  They look to have been skewered with a large, sharp implement.
The corpse of a tall middle-aged woman.  She appears to have many stab wounds up her legs and thighs.
The corpse of a small old lady, her face caked in blood and missing an eye.

corpse_gunned.name: corpse
corpse_gunned.description: The dead body of a person.  Their forehead bears a large bullet entrance wound.  An even larger exit wound is present on the back of their head.

corpse_halved_upper.name: corpse
corpse_halved_upper.description: The upper half of a dead body, as if it was torn apart with enormous force.  Some organs are hanging out.

corpse_half_beheaded.name: corpse
corpse_half_beheaded.description: A half-decapitated dead body.  It is unclear what could have caused such a wound.

corpse_generic_gunned.name: corpse
corpse_generic_gunned.description: The dead body of a person.  Their forehead bears a large bullet entrance wound.  An even larger exit wound is present on the back of their head.

snippet_category.text: The dead body of a person.  Their forehead bears a large bullet entrance wound.  An even larger exit wound is present on the back of their head.
The corpse of a young blonde woman shot several times in the back with a low-caliber weapon.
An androgynous-looking corpse gored by bullet wounds from chest to thighs, leaving the face eerily pristine.
The corpse of a seemingly older man.  He appears to have been shot in the forehead at very close range, leaving you a good view of his brain matter.
The corpse of a middle-aged woman, her legs and arms covered in blood.  She appears to have been shot in the thigh.
The corpse of a young man who appears to have been shot to death.  His right arm is only barely still attached to his shoulder.
The corpse of a tall woman unblemished but for the bloody hole atop her head, her thick black hair intermixed now with brain, viscera and shotgun pellets.

corpse_generic_infected.name: corpse
corpse_generic_infected.description: The dead body of a person.  There is a bloody bite wound on their forearm.  Dry filth surrounds it.

snippet_category.text: The dead body of a person.  There is a bloody bite wound on their forearm.  Dry filth surrounds it but the body seems otherwise unharmed.
One of this deceased persons shoulders is disfigured by a deep bite wound with a distinct shape, obviously caused by a human.
This unlucky fellow has a deep, straight cut wound on their hand.  The blackened veins suggest it got infected.
This lifeless body is covered in myriads of uneven scratches.  Some of them look pretty swollen.

corpse_dermatik_victim.name: strange corpse
corpse_dermatik_victim.description: This face of this corpse is locked in an agonized scream.  Through the large round holes in the skin, you can see that most of the flesh below is missing, leaving the skin and clothes draped over little more than bare bones.

corpse_void_mummified.name: mummified corpse
corpse_void_mummified.description: Waxen skin drapes the remnants of an unknowable death.

broken_exodii_worker.name: broken Exodii worker
broken_exodii_worker.description: A broken Exodii worker.  It's possible it could be gutted for parts.

broken_exodii_quad.name: broken Exodii quadruped
broken_exodii_quad.description: A broken Exodii walker.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_exodii_turret.name: broken Exodii turret
broken_exodii_turret.description: A broken Exodii turret.  Still looks intimidating despite being permanently inoperative, possibly due to the sheer size and mass.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_exodii_sniper_drone.name: broken Exodii balloon-drone
broken_exodii_sniper_drone.description: A broken balloon drone.  The balloon has been shredded, but most of the chassis is still intact.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_yrax_trifacet.name: trifacet remains
broken_yrax_trifacet.description: A split-open facet reveals an interior full of closely-fit geometric primitives among chipped strips of milk-white quartz.  The composition of parts lends you no clues as to how this machine ever functioned.

broken_yrax_triakis.name: triakis remains
broken_yrax_triakis.description: Its broken shell reveals an interior made from a single piece of quartz, intricately carved into a series of nested tetrahedra.

broken_golden_monolith.name: golden monolith
broken_golden_monolith.description: A large golden monolith.  Carefully carved asymmetric edges betray its artificial origin.

broken_yrax_delta.name: inert delta
broken_yrax_delta.description: A small piece of inscrutable alloy shaped like an arrow's broadhead.  It doesn't look like much of a robot once dead.

broken_yrax_quadraphract_leg.name: inert quadraphract leg
broken_yrax_quadraphract_leg.description: A great sickle-shaped leg, slumped and lifeless.  The metal is cold to the touch, and its near invisible joints are locked in place.

broken_yrax_quadraphract.name: inert quadraphract
broken_yrax_quadraphract.description: A great carved piece of gold and crystal, slumped in the form of an unearthly arachnid.

bot_EMP_hack.name: inactive EMP hack
bot_EMP_hack.description: An inactive EMP hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains an EMP grenade and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to reprogram and release the EMP hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The EMP hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the EMP hack; take cover!

bot_c4_hack.name: inactive C-4 hack
bot_c4_hack.description: An inactive C-4 hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a C-4 demolition charge and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the C-4 hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The C-4 hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the C-4 hack; take cover!

bot_flashbang_hack.name: inactive flashbang hack
bot_flashbang_hack.description: An inactive flashbang hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a flashbang and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the flashbang hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The flashbang hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the flashbang hack; take cover!

bot_gasbomb_hack.name: inactive tear gas hack
bot_gasbomb_hack.description: An inactive tear gas hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a tear gas canister and attacks by flying at its target and releasing the gas.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the tear gas hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The tear gas hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the tear gas hack; take cover!

bot_grenade_hack.name: inactive grenade hack
bot_grenade_hack.description: An inactive grenade hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one contains a grenade and attacks by flying at its target and detonating.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the grenade hack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The grenade hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the grenade hack; take cover!

bot_antimateriel.name: inactive M2HB autonomous CROWS II
bot_antimateriel.description: An inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded .50 BMG rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever .50 BMG rounds you do NOT want to give the turret), turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully, the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its M2HB.
bot_antimateriel.name_plural: inactive M2HB autonomous CROWS II turrets

bot_manhack.name: inactive manhack
bot_manhack.description: An inactive manhack, a fist-sized robot that flies through the air.  This one is covered with whirring blades and attacks by throwing itself against its target.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the manhack.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The manhack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the manhack; it's hostile!

bot_rifleturret.name: inactive autonomous M249 CROWS II
bot_rifleturret.description: An inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56x45mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 5.56x45mm rounds you do NOT want to give the turret), turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully, the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its M249.
bot_rifleturret.name_plural: inactive autonomous M249 CROWS II turrets

bot_crows_m240.name: inactive autonomous M240 CROWS II
bot_crows_m240.description: An inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 7.62x51mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 7.62x51mm rounds you do NOT want to give the turret), turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully, the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its M240.
bot_crows_m240.name_plural: inactive autonomous M240 CROWS II turrets

bot_turret_riot.name: inactive riot control turret
bot_turret_riot.description: An inactive riot control turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the 40x46mm M1006 sponge rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever beanbag rounds you do NOT want to give the turret), turning it on, and placing it on the ground, where it will attach itself.  If programmed successfully, the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its riot control gun.

bot_turret.name: inactive turret
bot_turret.description: An inactive turret.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 9x19mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 9x19mm you do NOT want to give the turret), turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the turret will then identify you as a friendly, and attack all enemies with its SMG.

bot_secubot.name: inactive TALON UGV
bot_secubot.description: An inactive TALON UGV equipped with an M16A4.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the factory-loaded 5.56x45mm rounds in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever 5.56x45mm you do NOT want to give the robot), turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the security bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with its rifle.

use_action.friendly_msg: The security bot beeps affirmatively and begins scanning for hostiles.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the security bot and it trains its gun on you.  RUN!

bot_talon_m202a1.name: inactive M202A1 TALON UGV
bot_talon_m202a1.description: An inactive TALON UGV equipped with an M202A1.  Using this item involves loading the unit with the M235 rockets in your inventory (if you wish to divide your ammunition, set aside whatever M235 rockets you do NOT want to give the robot), turning it on, and placing it on the ground.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the security bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and attack all enemies with its M202A1.

use_action.friendly_msg: The security bot beeps affirmatively and begins scanning for hostiles.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the security bot and it trains its gun on you.  RUN!

bot_secubot_liberty.name: inactive TALON UGV Liberty Edition
bot_secubot_liberty.description: This bot has had tubes welded above the original guns that allow it to shoot fireworks in order to blind and stun attackers.  With fireworks being harder to come by then the ammo for the original weapons, the best option would be to convert it back to it's original guns.  It should be easy enough to give it back the use of the original M16A4.

use_action.friendly_msg: The security bot beeps affirmatively and begins scanning for hostiles.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the security bot and it trains its gun on you.  RUN!

bot_nursebot.name: inactive nurse bot
bot_nursebot.description: An inactive nurse bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the nurse bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and assist you in surgeries.

use_action.friendly_msg: The nurse bot beeps affirmatively and awaits orders.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the nurse bot.  It's looking at you funny.

bot_grocerybot.name: inactive grocery bot
bot_grocerybot.description: An inactive grocery bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the grocery bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you.

use_action.friendly_msg: The grocery bot beeps affirmatively and awaits orders.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the grocery bot.  It's looking at you funny.

bot_grocerybot_busted.name: inactive busted grocery bot
bot_grocerybot_busted.description: An inactive grocery bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the grocery bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you.

use_action.friendly_msg: The grocery bot beeps affirmatively and awaits orders.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the grocery bot.  It's looking at you funny.

bot_broken_cyborg.name: inactive broken cyborg
bot_broken_cyborg.description: A deactivated broken cyborg, the last shreds of its humanity still rotting away.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the cyborg will then follow you and attack enemies.  You monster.

use_action.friendly_msg: The broken cyborg rises to the sound of screeching metal and peers around for hostiles.
use_action.hostile_msg: The broken cyborg lets out a howl of agony and attacks you!

bot_prototype_cyborg.name: inactive prototype cyborg
bot_prototype_cyborg.description: A deactivated prototype cyborg, glimpses of humanity can still be seen in its empty eyes.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and reactivating its mechanical body.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the cyborg will then follow you and attack enemies.  You monster.

use_action.friendly_msg: The prototype cyborg rises to the sound of screeching metal and peers around for hostiles.
use_action.hostile_msg: The prototype cyborg lets out a howl of agony and attacks you!

bot_hazmatbot.name: inactive cleaner bot
bot_hazmatbot.description: An inactive cleaner bot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the cleaner bot will respond to future commands.

use_action.friendly_msg: The cleaner bot emits a friendly beep and starts scrubbing.
use_action.hostile_msg: The cleaner bot plays an error sound, but starts cleaning anyway.

bot_skitterbot.name: inactive skitterbot
bot_skitterbot.description: An inactive skitterbot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the robot will race towards enemies and shock them.

use_action.friendly_msg: The skitterbot gives a quick bow and scurries away.
use_action.hostile_msg: The skitterbot darts around you and menacingly clicks its tasers.

bot_robofac_skittergun.name: inactive exterminatron
bot_robofac_skittergun.description: An inactive Hub 01 exterminatron.  If programmed and reloaded successfully, the robot will track you while providing fire-support.  Activate it while carrying 7.62x51mm NATO M80 to turn it on and reload it.

use_action.friendly_msg: The exterminatron gives a quick bow and starts scanning the horizon for threats.
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the exterminatron and it trains its gun on you.  RUN!

bot_robofac_hound.name: inactive Hub 01 HOUND
bot_robofac_hound.description: A Hub 01 Hostile Overstimulation & Unmanned Neutralization Drone.  If programmed successfully, this quadrupedal robot will closely track you, using a taser and noise-generator to distract, disorient, and ultimately neutralize nearby enemies.  Activate it to turn it on.

use_action.friendly_msg: The HOUND gives a quick bow and falls in at your side.
use_action.hostile_msg: The HOUND darts around you and menacingly clicks its tasers.  RUN!

bot_science_bot.name: inactive lab defense bot
bot_science_bot.description: An inactive experimental robot plundered from a science lab.  It resembles a human-sized spider and was designed to deploy manhacks.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the robot will race towards enemies and deploy a variety of experimental devices.

use_action.friendly_msg: The lab defense bot shudders briefly and skitters away.
use_action.hostile_msg: The lab defense bot raises its front legs and shines a multitude of colored lights in your face!

bot_turret_searchlight.name: inactive milspec searchlight
bot_turret_searchlight.description: An inactive military-grade automated searchlight.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the searchlight will then identify you as an ally, survey the area, and illuminate approaching hostiles.  Seems to have an unhealthy fascination with you.

use_action.friendly_msg: The searchlight flares up and establishes a perimeter.
use_action.hostile_msg: A bright light blinds you as the searchlight refuses to turn away from you.

bot_dispatch.name: inactive dispatch
bot_dispatch.description: An inactive Northrop Dispatch, guard model, serving as a mobile assembler and deployer of kamikaze manhacks for defense.  Activate it to place it onto the ground; due to a one-way switch triggered during deactivation, however, it will be nonaggressive, and serves only as a distraction.

use_action.friendly_msg: The dispatch whirs onto its legs and searches for a target.
use_action.hostile_msg: The dispatch turns on you, whacking at you with its arms!

bot_dispatch_military.name: inactive military dispatch
bot_dispatch_military.description: An inactive Northrop Dispatch, military model, serving as a mobile assembler and deployer of lethal manhacks for combat situations.  Activate it to place it onto the ground; due to a one-way switch triggered during deactivation, however, it will be nonaggressive, and serves only as a distraction.

use_action.friendly_msg: The dispatch whirs onto its legs and searches for a target.
use_action.hostile_msg: The dispatch turns on you, slashing at you with its arms!

bot_turret_speaker.name: inactive loudspeaker
bot_turret_speaker.description: An inactive automated loudspeaker.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and turning it on.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the loudspeaker will continuously shout pre-recorded messages.

use_action.friendly_msg: The loudspeaker activates and begins its nonstop shouts.
use_action.hostile_msg: The loudspeaker activates and begins its nonstop shouts.

bot_tazer_hack.name: inactive taser hack
bot_tazer_hack.description: An inactive taser hack.  Manhacks are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  This one has a taser and attacks by flying at its target and delivering an electric shock.  Use this item to reprogram and release the taser hack.  Electronics and computer skills determine if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The taser hack flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the taser hack; run!

bot_yrax_trifacet.name: inactive trifacet
bot_yrax_trifacet.description: A featureless quartz pyramid that, although obviously artificial, shows no real indication of ever having been an advanced robot.  Perhaps you could try reactivating it?

use_action.hostile_msg: The hostile trifacet violently unfolds just clear of your hand!

bot_yrax_triakis.name: inactive triakis
bot_yrax_triakis.description: You know this artfully craved piece of gold hued ceramics to be a robot of some kind, but it seems impossible to interact with it.

use_action.hostile_msg: The hostile triakis violently unfolds just clear of your hand!

bot_golden_monolith.name: inactive golden monolith
bot_golden_monolith.description: A large golden monolith.  Carefully carved asymmetric edges betray its artificial origin.

use_action.hostile_msg: You notice a brief lull in the ambient noise around you, but its otherwise impossible to know if you allowed something to happen.

bot_yrax_delta.name: inactive delta
bot_yrax_delta.description: A small piece of inscrutable alloy shaped like an arrow's broadhead.  It looks like a robot boomerang.

use_action.hostile_msg: The hostile delta starts flying just as you release it!

bot_lab_security_drone_GR.name: inactive security drone
bot_lab_security_drone_GR.description: An inactive security drone.  They are fist-sized robots that fly through the air.  They have a scanner, lens and speaker.  Use this item to reprogram and activate the security drone.  Electronics and computer skill determines if the targeting matrix is reprogrammed successfully.

use_action.friendly_msg: The security drone flies from your hand and surveys the area!
use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the drone; it's hostile!

use_action.hostile_msg: You misprogram the drone; it's hostile!

bot_robofac_camspy.name: inactive camspy
bot_robofac_camspy.description: An inactive camspy.  Using this item involves turning it on and launching it.  If reprogrammed and rewired successfully, the camspy will then keep watch for intruders.

use_action.friendly_msg: The camspy hums and takes to the sky.
use_action.hostile_msg: The camspy hums and appears to reconnect to whoever was piloting it before.

corpse_yugg_rubber.name: rubber yugg corpse
corpse_yugg_rubber.description: An oversized hollow tube made of black semi-liquid rubbery substance.  It is vaguely shaped like a yugg.

corpse_yugg_mutflesh.name: massive fleshy tube
corpse_yugg_mutflesh.description: An oversized tube of faintly green raw flesh of nondescript origin.  It is vaguely shaped like a yugg.

corpse_yugg_jade.name: jade yugg statue
corpse_yugg_jade.description: A statue of a yugg, made entire out of jade.  If jade was still worth anything this could fetch a fortune.  A shame the world ended.

broken_flailer_radiosphere.name: torn flailer
broken_flailer_radiosphere.description: A torn up cloth facsimile of a bird, you could tear it up even further for materials.

breadboard.name: breadboard
breadboard.description: Commonly used in electronics prototyping, this solderless breadboard is a small brick of plastic filled with hundreds of holes connected by internal electrical busses.  With a few components and scraps of wire, you could quickly build a circuit on this, if you know what you're doing.

melchior_platter.description: A hefty and expensive-looking golden dish engraved with concentric circuitry.  You felt the urge to rip it from a supercomputer.

hoof_pick.description: A simple brush and pick combination tool for a farrier to clean up the horse's hoof before working on it.

horseshoe_pliers.name: horseshoe puller
horseshoe_pliers.description: A large pliers used by farrier to take off horseshoes off horse's hooves.

nail_puller.name: nail puller
nail_puller.description: A tool used for pulling nails out of a surface.  While it is usually used by farriers to pull nails off horse's hooves, it can pull nails on other surface as well.

hoof_tester.name: hoof tester
hoof_tester.description: A two-pronged tool used by farriers to check if a horse's foot is sore.  It is used by putting some pressure on the horse's sole or heel and see how the horse react.

hoof_nippers.name: pair of nippers
hoof_nippers.description: A tool used for trimming around the hoof wall until the foot is in the right height, like a giant pair of nail clippers.

hoof_rasp.name: rasp
hoof_rasp.description: A large nail file used to trim and smoothen horse hoof edges.

pritchel.name: pritchel
pritchel.description: A punch used in creating nail holes for horseshoes.

clinch_block.name: clinch block
clinch_block.description: A simple metal block with angled edge used to help with clinching the nails.

clinch_pliers.name: pair of clinchers
clinch_pliers.description: A plier-like tool used to lightly bend and flatten the nail down against the hoof wall to keep it in place.

clinch_cutter.name: clinch cutter
clinch_cutter.description: A small hatchet looking tool used for cutting excess nail points once the nail has been clinched.

hoof_stand.name: hoof stand
hoof_stand.description: A small stand for supporting the horse's foot in the final stages of the shoe job.

horseshoe.name: horseshoe
horseshoe.description: An U-shaped band of iron fitted onto the horse's hoof to protect it from wear.

magic_8_ball.name: Magic 8-Ball
magic_8_ball.description: A fortune-telling device from the 1950s.  The kind of moral support you didn't know you needed.

deck_of_cards.name: deck of cards
deck_of_cards.description: A fairly new, glossy deck of 52 playing cards.

deck_of_tarot_cards.name: deck of tarot cards
deck_of_tarot_cards.description: A fairly new, glossy deck of tarot cards, commonly used for the practice of divination.  Each card has a unique and highly symbolic picture.

family_photo.name: family photo
family_photo.description: A photo of a smiling family on a camping trip.  One of the parents looks like a cleaner, happier version of a zombie you've seen.

pom_poms.name: pom poms (pair)

player_descriptions: You make a skillful routine with the pom poms.
You move with refinement while using the pom poms.

moves with refinement while using the pom poms.

pom_poms.description: A pair of red and silver pom poms with plastic handles.  Using them will make you start a cheerleading routine.

polaroid_photo.name: polaroid photo
polaroid_photo.description: A poorly-taken polaroid photo of a young man wearing bell-bottoms and a fedora.  It's pretty blurry.

jigsaw.name: Jigsaw puzzle
jigsaw.description: A jigsaw puzzle cardboard box containing 1000 cardboard pieces that when connected together properly forms a image of something, somewhere.

variants.name: Great Wall of China jigsaw puzzle
Hanging Gardens of Babylon jigsaw puzzle
The Statue of Liberty jigsaw puzzle

tic_tac.name: tic-tac-toe set
tic_tac.description: Not really a set, just a sheet of paper with a big '#' drawn at the center, alongside three buttons of a specific color, three others from a different color and a proper container for storing it properly.  You can play tic tac toe indefinitely with that!

makeshift_dominoes.name: makeshift dominoes set
makeshift_dominoes.description: Twenty eight rectangular pieces of cardboard, with dots on them so you can use it to play dominoes.  It has also a proper container for storing them all in place.

small_checkboard.name: compact checkerboard
small_checkboard.description: A pair of smaller checkered wooden boards that together form a compact checkerboard.  Useful as timber or for crafting a smaller chess or checkers board.

chess.name: chess set
chess.description: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of chess.

small_chess.name: compact chess set
small_chess.description: A smaller and compact counterpart of the standard chess set, perfect for casual play and travel.  It contains all the pieces needed to play a game of chess.

checkers.name: checkers set
checkers.description: A wooden box containing a set of round tokens used to play checkers.

tangram.name: tangram set
tangram.description: A modest wooden box containing a square base, two small triangles, two large triangles, a parallelogram, and a rhombus, all painted in different colors to play the traditional Chinese puzzle of tangram.  At the box, there are several figures that you can make with the pieces.

chinese_checkers.name: Chinese checkers set
chinese_checkers.description: A wooden box containing a wooden board with a star-shaped pattern, ten holes in each of its six arms, and a set of round pegs used to play Chinese checkers.  In the box, there's a comprehensible explanation of how to play the game.

mancala.name: mancala set
mancala.description: A somewhat large wooden box containing a rectangular wooden board with a series of small pits, as well as a number of game pieces that look like different colored beads.  The board features two rows of pits, with each player controlling the row of pits closest to them.  The game pieces are distributed evenly among the pits at the beginning of the game, and players take turns picking up and redistributing the pieces according to the rules.  In the box, there's a comprehensible step-by-step guide on how to play.

connect_four.name: Four in a Row set
connect_four.description: A cardboard box containing a plastic grid with seven columns and six rows, and 42 colored discs, alongside a small booklet explaining how to play Four in a Row.

rummy.name: Rummy-o set
rummy.description: A cardboard box containing a grid, and various tiles akin to a classic deck of cards, alongside a booklet explaining how to play Rummy-o.

othello.name: Reversi set
othello.description: A cardboard box containing a grid, and various round black and white pieces, alongside a booklet explaining how to play Reversi.

scrabble.name: Scrabble Letters set
scrabble.description: A board game cardboard box containing a proper board, and various letter tiles, meant to play Scrabble Letters alone or with friends.

small_checkers.name: compact checkers set
small_checkers.description: A small and compact wooden box containing a set of round tokens used to play checkers.  Perfect for casual play and travel.

makeshift_checkers.name: makeshift checkers set
makeshift_checkers.description: A piece of paper scribbled with a pattern identical to the checkerboard on a, well, checkerboard, along with all the necessary pieces and a container to store everything properly inside.

pictionary.name: Picturesque
pictionary.description: A game where one player draws an image, and the others attempt to guess what it is.

monopoly.name: Capitalism
monopoly.description: A game where players traverse around the board, buying property and swindling their friends.

ouija.name: Ouija board
ouija.description: A wooden board with the alphabet and numbers on its face.  Commonly used for communing with spirits of the dead.  A planchette is included in the set.

dnd.name: Blobs and Bandits
dnd.description: A roleplaying game set in the post-apocalypse, so you can pretend to survive the apocalypse while surviving the apocalypse.

dnd_2.name: Wayfinder
dnd_2.description: A roleplaying game set in the a fantasy medieval world with goblins and orcs.  You can be a mage, a warrior, or a barbarian and go on epic adventures.

dnd_3.name: Dawn of Man
dnd_3.description: A roleplaying game set in the Stone Age.  There, you can choose different places in the world to start, select many different classes, and different species of hominids to survive the primitive world.

g_warhammer.name: Battlehammer
g_warhammer.description: A strategy game featuring a set of tiny figurines of fantasy creatures.

g_warhammer40k.name: Battlehammer 20k
g_warhammer40k.description: A strategy game featuring a set of tiny figurines of space aliens and grotesque space marines.

catan.name: Settlers of the Ranch
catan.description: A strategy game where players build settlements and trade for supplies.
catan.name_plural: sets of Settlers of the Ranch

agricola.name: Farmland
agricola.description: A fun strategy board game where players (or just a player, since you can play this alone as a solitaire board game) attempt to improve their farms by plowing fields, sowing crops, raising livestock, and expanding their families.  The game is set in the European farming community during the 17th century.

soyang.name: Soyang Farmers
soyang.description: A interesting strategy board game where players (or just a player, since you can play this alone as a solitaire board game) take roles of farmers in Ancient China, attempting to sell their crops at the market.  The game revolves around managing resources, fulfilling orders, and expanding the farm to become the most successful farmer.

friday.name: Survival Island
friday.description: A fun solo deck-building board game where a player takes on the role of Robinson Crusoe's mentor, trying to help him survive and escape from a deserted island.  This game is played in rounds, with the player using their deck-building skills to improve Robinson's abilities and combat various challenges that arise during his time on the island.

nemo.name: Nemo's Sea
nemo.description: A thematic adventure board game designed for solo play.  It is based on Jules Verne's classic novel '20,000 Leagues Under the Sea' and allows players to step into the role of Captain Nemo as they navigate the oceans, encounter various challenges, and make critical decisions that impact their journey.

knight_mage.name: Knight Mage
knight_mage.description: A highly strategic board game that combines elements of role-playing games with deck-building and traditional board game mechanics.  Players (or a solo player) take on the roles of powerful Knights Mages who explore the land, conquer cities, and engage in epic battles against various enemies.  The game features an intricate leveling system where players can enhance their characters' abilities and acquire new skills as they progress through the game.

pandemic.name: Pathogen
pandemic.description: A intriguing and critically acclaimed cooperative board game where players (or just the player, as it can be played alone as a solitaire board game) take on different roles with unique abilities as members of a disease control team.  Their objective is to prevent global outbreaks and find cures for four deadly diseases before they escalate out of control.

scythe_game.name: Steam Gears
scythe_game.description: A strategy board game set in an alternate history, steampunk-themed world, where players assume the roles of workers, engineers, and factory owners in a fictional 1920's Eastern European country.  This game focuses on area control, engine building, and resource management, as players aim to achieve victory through various paths, such as military conquest, building up their factories, or completing secret objectives.  The best part?  You can play it alone too.

spirit_island.name: Deity Island
spirit_island.description: A cooperative board game designed for 1-4 players, where each player takes on the role of a powerful deity defending an island from colonizing invaders.  Before the Cataclysm, inside the board gaming community, it was known for its deep strategic gameplay, thematic richness, and intricate mechanics.

terraforming_mercury.name: Terraforming - Mercury
terraforming_mercury.description: This board game is set in the 4300s, where corporations are working together to terraform the planet Mercury, the smallest and innermost planet in our solar system.  Each player (or just the player) will have unique abilities and resources at their disposal, and they will need to strategize and cooperate with one another to achieve their goals.

viticulture.name: Vigneto
viticulture.description: A fun strategy board game that simulates the experience of running a vineyard in Tuscany, Italy.  Players take on the roles of vineyard owners who must plant vines, harvest grapes, produce wine, and fulfill orders to earn victory points.  The game is played over several seasons, with players making strategic decisions about which actions to take each season to maximize their vineyard's productivity and efficiency.

feast_for_odin.name: For Odin
feast_for_odin.description: In this great strategy board game, players (or the player) assume the role of a Viking chieftain, aiming to expand their territory, amass wealth, and gain favor with the Norse gods.  Players take turns performing actions, such as exploring new territories, constructing buildings, raiding settlements, and trading goods.

fields_of_arle.name: Arle Lands
fields_of_arle.description: A great strategy board game set in the 18th century in the East Frisia region of Germany, where players (or the player) take on the roles of farmers who are developing their farms and expanding their resources.

gloomhaven.name: Enigma Emporium
gloomhaven.description: A great cooperation-focused fantasy board game set in a dark and evolving fantasy world where players take on the roles of mercenaries seeking fortune and glory in the city of Emporium and its surrounding areas.  This game is characterized by its legacy-style gameplay, which means that decisions made during one play session can have lasting effects on future sessions.  Players must work together to explore dungeons, battle monsters, complete quests, and make choices that shape the narrative and outcome of their campaign.

le_havre.name: Le Pourt: The Inland Port
le_havre.description: A strategy board game where players (or the player) aim to amass wealth and construct buildings to expand their harbors while carefully managing their resources in the fictitious French region of Le Pourt.  This game involves strategic decision-making as players must balance their investments in buildings, ships, and resources to maximize their profits.
le_havre.name_plural: sets of Le Pourt: The Inland Port

mansions_of_madness.name: Crazy Mansions
mansions_of_madness.description: A cooperative horror board game set in the Lovecraftian Universe.  It offers an immersive gameplay experience where players work together to solve mysteries and confront otherworldly horrors.  This game is scenario-based, with each scenario presenting a unique narrative and set of challenges for the players to overcome.  Players must explore the game board, gather clues, solve puzzles, and engage in combat encounters while uncovering the secrets hidden within the mansion or other eerie locations.

world_nations.name: World Nations
world_nations.description: A strategic board game that simulates the rise and fall of nations.  A great civilization-building game designed for 1-4 players.  Each player takes on the role of leading an ancient civilization, making strategic decisions to develop their nation over the course of several ages.  This game involves managing resources, constructing buildings, and competing with other players to achieve dominance in various aspects such as military strength, culture, and economy.

senet.name: senet set
senet.description: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of senet, along with a rule booklet.  A board game from ancient Egypt, Senet plays like modern chess with a 3x10 grid and a smaller amount of pieces.

mahjong.name: mahjong set
mahjong.description: A very beautiful, and really huge plastic box, containing all the pieces needed to play a game of mahjong, along with a poorly-translated but comprehensible rule booklet.  Mahjong is a tile-based game where you need to match pieces into winning hands to earn points.

chaturanga.name: chaturanga chess set
chaturanga.description: A polished wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of chaturanga chess, along with a rule booklet.  Chaturanga is an ancient Indian strategy game, the ancestor of many other chess variations - European, Chinese, Japanese, and other regional variants of chess owe it their origin.

backgammon.name: backgammon set
backgammon.description: A very nice dark wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of backgammon, along with a handwritten set of rules.  The objective of the game is to be the first to remove all fifteen of your own pieces from the board.

latrunculi.name: latrunculi set
latrunculi.description: A small wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of latrunculi, along with a rule booklet.  Latrunculi was played throughout the Roman Empire, and requires a lot of tactics and strategy.

go.name: go set
go.description: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of go, along with a bilingual English/Mandarin rule booklet.  Go is a two-player game where each player tries to grab more territory than their opponent.

shogi.name: shogi set
shogi.description: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of shogi, along with a bilingual English/Japanese rule booklet.  Also known as Japanese chess, shogi was one of the most popular board games in Japan before the Cataclysm.  The main objective is to tsumi (checkmate) the opponent's osho (king).

hnefatafl.name: hnefatafl set
hnefatafl.description: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of hnefatafl, along with a rule booklet that features heavy use of Norse runes.  Also called 'Viking Chess', it was a popular game in medieval Scandinavia.  The player controlling the attackers (located on the sides of the board), wins by capturing the defender's king, while the defender wins by getting the king to one of the four corners of the board.

alquerque.name: alquerque set
alquerque.description: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of alquerque, along with a rule booklet.  Alquerque is of Middle Eastern origin, and is an ancestor to checkers and Fanorona.

domino.name: dominoes set
domino.description: A wooden box containing all the pieces needed to play a game of dominoes.  The pieces of this one are perfectly handmade in light wood.

jackstraws.name: jackstraws set
jackstraws.description: A cardboard tube containing 60 pieces in various colors for playing a casual pick-up sticks game alone or with friends.  The rules and different values of each color are printed on the tube.

snakesnladders.name: Snakes and Ladders
snakesnladders.description: A board game for two or more players, regarded before the Cataclysm as a worldwide classic.  The objective of the game is to navigate one's game piece to the goal on the board, helped by climbing ladders but hindered by sliding down snakes.

ludo.name: Ludo
ludo.description: A strategy board game for two to four players, in which the players race their four tokens from start to finish according to the rolls of a single die.

poppirate.name: Pop-up Pirate
poppirate.description: A game of chance featuring a silly-looking pirate inside a spring-loaded barrel.  Players take turns inserting plastic swords into slots in the barrel, hoping to avoid the trigger slot that causes the pirate to be launched out of the barrel.

ambush.name: Ambuscade!
ambush.description: A board wargame that can be played alone or with friends.  When playing alone, the opponent's actions are chosen via tables, charts, and a 'paragraph book'.

ranger.name: Patrol Leader
ranger.description: A tactical solitaire board game.  The player is put in the role of a patrol leader in different modern battlefield scenarios, performing missions, capturing or killing enemies, protecting their teammates, and advancing on the map.

openfire.name: War Tanks
openfire.description: A tactical solitaire board game.  The player controls a platoon of tanks in six different scenarios with various victory conditions.  The player travels across the map, entering combat when an 'event marker' comes into their line of sight.

battleship.name: Warships
battleship.description: A game where players try to guess where the opponent placed their ships on the board.

clue.name: Murder Mystery
clue.description: A game where players try to figure out who murdered the butler.

old_key.name: key
old_key.description: An old, nondescript North American Cylinder key.  Lord knows what lock it goes to; best not to bother with it.

cigar_cutter.name: cigar cutter
cigar_cutter.description: A set of small blades that pinch together to cut the end off of a cigar.

cigar_punch.name: cigar punch
cigar_punch.description: A small tube meant to cut a hole in the end of a cigar.

xedra_seismograph.name: portable seismograph
xedra_seismograph.description:
A sturdy steel briefcase, containing what appears to be an old-fashioned drum seismograph.  The stenciled acronyms of its outer case imply it was used by XEDRA as some sort of recording device.

Thin parallel lines cover both ends of the drum, but as they approach the middle their vibrations intensify, until the ink fuses into a thick red stain.

xedra_microphone.name: NRE microphone
xedra_microphone.description: A squat tripod supports what appears to be a rather long microphone encased within a glass ampoule.  You can't tell whether it's meant to record audio, or something else entirely.

incense.name: incense
incense.description: A small rod giving off a nice smell.

trade_writ.name: writ of trade
trade_writ.description: A short writ featuring the signed agreement of establishing a trade route.

ruler.name: ruler
ruler.description: A plastic ruler used to measure lengths of smaller objects.  This one measures 15 cm.

eraser.name: eraser
eraser.description: A small eraser used to clear up unwanted pencil handwriting.

sharpener.name: pencil sharpener
sharpener.description: A small sharpener used to keep pencils in working order.

doormat.name: doormat
doormat.description: A non-slip mat with a welcoming message.  Once used to keep a house clean and inviting.

LIXA_lab_file.name: LIXA on-site staff notice
LIXA_lab_file.description: A brief with the word LIXA on the official letterhead, for distribution to the onsite staff.

LIXA_generic_file.name: LIXA data file
LIXA_generic_file.description: A sheaf of papers containing a truly dizzying assortment of graphs, diagrams, and equations, on LIXA letterhead.

LIXA_mil_file.name: LIXA military notice
LIXA_mil_file.description: A signed and serialed notice distributed to LIXA's onsite military police.

glass_book.name: battered glass storybook
glass_book.description: A black glass model of an old, tattered little book with a broken spine.  To your surprise, it can be opened to a place in the middle.  Inside, the pages are blank and perfectly reflective.

glass_apple.name: withered glass apple
glass_apple.description: A glass model of an apple that has begun to rot.  In places, it sags away from the core.  Inside, the seeds are still pristine.

glass_boat.name: broken glass boat
glass_boat.description: A black glass model of an old sailing ship, with a gaping hole smashed in the side of the hull.  It's certainly no longer suited for long voyages.

black_glass_shard.name: black glass shard
black_glass_shard.description: A shard of black glass that is almost impossible to touch without cutting yourself.  It doesn't reflect anything, but sometimes you think you catch a glimpse of something in it anyway.

sketch.name: sketch
sketch.description: A piece of graphite-based artwork someone has drawn on a spare sheet of paper.

painting.name: painting
painting.description: A painting that someone has made.

butterfly_net_collapsible.name: collapsible butterfly net
butterfly_net_collapsible.description: A piece of canvas on a collapsible aluminum frame.  Used to catch bugs or fish, but might not be as useful for the mutated ones.  It must be extended to use.

use_action.msg: You snap open your butterfly net.

butterfly_net_collapsible_extended.name: collapsible butterfly net (extended)
butterfly_net_collapsible_extended.description: A piece of canvas on a collapsible aluminum frame.  Used to catch bugs or fish, but might not be as useful for the mutated ones.

butterfly_net_makeshift.name: butterfly net
butterfly_net_makeshift.description: A piece of canvas stretched over a stick.  Used to catch bugs or fish, but might not be as useful for the mutated ones.

gun_lock.name: gun cable lock
gun_lock.description: A set with a key and a small lock, resembling a padlock if the shackle was replaced by a steel cable.  This design allows the cable to fit into the chamber of a firearm and lock, preventing the firearm from functioning.  An important part of gun safety, it is required by law to be sold with any firearm.

alien_leaves.name: handful of alien leaves
alien_leaves.description: A handful of dry leaves(?) from an alien plant.  Despite their otherworldly origin, they have very few uses and are thus (almost) only good for burning.

waste_electrolyte_slurry.name: Electrolyte Slurry
waste_electrolyte_slurry.description: The leftover remnants of what was inside of a lithium-ion battery.  It has a rainbow sheen, almost like oil resting on water.

chem_ethanol.name: ethanol
chem_ethanol.description: Extremely pure alcohol suitable for use as a component in chemical reactions.  You could also water it down and drink it, or use it as fuel in an alcohol-burning stove.

methed_alcohol.name: methylated spirits
methed_alcohol.description: A high-strength ethanol solution mixed with methanol to make it toxic to drink, so as to avoid pre-apocalyptic regulations on ethanol.  Intended for use in alcohol-burning stoves and as a solvent.

denat_alcohol.name: denatured alcohol
denat_alcohol.description: A high-strength ethanol solution mixed with denatonium benzoate to make it impossibly bitter to drink, so as to avoid pre-apocalyptic regulations on ethanol.  Intended for use in alcohol-burning stoves and as a solvent.

chem_methanol.name: methanol
chem_methanol.description: High-purity methanol suitable for use in chemical reactions.  Could also be used as fuel in an alcohol-burning stove.  Very toxic.

chem_methanol_fuelcell.name: methanol
chem_methanol_fuelcell.description: High-purity methanol suitable for use in chemical reactions.  Could also be used as fuel in an alcohol-burning stove.  Very toxic.

diesel.name: diesel
diesel.description: A petroleum-based fuel made from a byproduct of the gasoline making process.

jp8.name: JP8 fuel
jp8.description: A kerosene-based fuel used mainly by US military vehicles as a replacement for diesel and jet fuel, to simplify logistics.

avgas.name: avgas fuel
avgas.description: A specialized type of petroleum-based fuel used to power aircraft.

biodiesel.name: biodiesel
biodiesel.description: Vegetable oil- or animal fat-based diesel fuel consisting of long-chain alkyl (methyl, ethyl, or propyl) esters.

gasoline.name: gasoline
gasoline.description: A highly flammable liquid fuel.  When under pressure, it has the potential for violent explosion.

lamp_oil.name: kerosene
lamp_oil.description: A thin and clean-burning oil made for use in oil lamps.

motor_oil.name: motor oil
motor_oil.description: An oil made for use in car engines.

crude_oil.name: crude oil
crude_oil.description: A thick black slurry that can be refined to produce usable products including gasoline or diesel.

napalm.name: napalm
napalm.description: Gasoline mixed with some other components to make it stick to surfaces and increase burning temperature, meant to be used as flamethrower fuel.

gelled_gasoline.name: gelled gasoline
gelled_gasoline.description: A flammable gel composed of gasoline and different thickening agents.  It works as a great improvement for a Molotov cocktail.

flamethrower_fuel.name: flamethrower fuel
flamethrower_fuel.description: A mixture of gasoline and diesel oil in equal parts.  Its combustion properties make it unfit for applications where you would use any of them separately, but it can be used to feed a flamethrower.

propane.name: propane
propane.description: Propane gas, useful for everything from torches to barbeque grills to metalworking.

biogas.name: biogas
biogas.description: Biogas gathered from an anaerobic digester system, can be used in a biogas cooker.

chem_turpentine.name: turpentine
chem_turpentine.description: Oil of turpentine, distilled from pine resin or crude oil.

camphine.name: camphine
camphine.description: A blend of turpentine and ethanol, historically used as the successor to whale oil for lamps before kerosene.

crude_lamp_oil.name: crude lamp oil
crude_lamp_oil.description: A crude, natural oil made for use in pre-modern oil lamps.

bigmirror.name: standing mirror
bigmirror.description: A full-length mirror mounted in a sleek aluminum frame.  Metal stand is currently folded.

piano.name: piano
piano.description: An elegant piano, capable of producing beautiful music if used by a skilled player.  A set of off-white and black keys are linked to a set of hammers, which strike their corresponding tightly-coiled wire to produce sound.

chair_wood.name: wooden chair
chair_wood.description: A simple wooden chair, with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.

armchair.name: armchair
armchair.description: A simple upholstered chair with armrests.  Soft and fairly warm, it definitely beats the ground for sleeping on, though not by much.

stool_wood.name: wooden stool
stool_wood.description: A simple stool, with four legs and a seat.  While it's a touch more maneuverable to sit on, the lack of back support means it's significantly less comfortable than a normal chair.

stool_log.name: log stool
stool_log.description: A short section from a tree trunk with one of the flat ends smoothed down.  Makes for a decent place to sit, but not quite a real chair.

barstool.name: bar stool
barstool.description: A bar stool with a leather seat on a steel support.  Not practical for sleeping at all, but it does feel nicer than sitting on the ground.

chair_plywood.name: plywood chair
chair_plywood.description: A simple chair made of plywood on a steel frame.  Quite uncomfortable but works for sleeping if it's the only option available.

chair_wood_black.name: black wooden chair
chair_wood_black.description: A simple wooden chair, with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.  This particular chair was painted black.

chair_wood_white.name: white wooden chair
chair_wood_white.description: A simple wooden chair, with four legs, a seat, and a back.  It's nice to rest your feet for once, and if coupled with a suitable table, you could eat a meal properly and almost pretend that things were normal again.  This particular chair was painted white.

beanbag.name: bean bag
beanbag.description: A large cushion filled with beads often used as a seat.

foot_locker_aluminum.name: aluminum foot locker
foot_locker_aluminum.description: An aluminum storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has a small lock.

foot_locker.name: steel foot locker
foot_locker.description: A steel storage box, capable of holding any number of things.  The lid has a small lock.

ammolink223.name: .223 ammo belt linkage
ammolink223.description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.

ammolink308.name: .308 ammo belt linkage
ammolink308.description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.

ammolink40mm.name: 40mm grenade belt linkage
ammolink40mm.description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.

ammolink50.name: .50 ammo belt linkage
ammolink50.description: A small metal linkage from a disintegrating ammo belt.

soap_holder.name: soap dish
soap_holder.description: A shallow dish for holding a bar of soap.  It has ridges to help drain water away from the dish.  Not the most exciting of items.

razor_shaving.name: shaving razor
razor_shaving.description: A razor blade on a comfortable handle.  Much easier to shave with than a loose razor.

toothbrush_plain.name: toothbrush
toothbrush_plain.description: A plastic brush with soft bristles for cleaning your teeth.

snippet_category.text: A plastic brush with soft bristles for cleaning your teeth.  It has a cheap, blocky handle and is likely meant to be disposable.
A combination toothbrush and gum massager.  It has an ergonomic silicone grip.  Luxurious!
A plastic brush with soft bristles for cleaning your teeth.  The blue and white pattern on the handle implies cleanliness.
A short toothbrush designed for children.  It has a wide-eyed cartoon pony on the handle.
A short toothbrush designed for children.  It has a grinning red racecar on the handle.

tampon.name: tampon
tampon.description: A small cotton tampon with a plastic applicator.

snippet_category.text: A small cotton tampon with a plastic applicator.  Useless for some, an invaluable commodity for others.
A 'light' cotton tampon with a plastic applicator rated for light flows.
A 'super' cotton tampon with a plastic applicator rated for heavy flows.
A small, lavender-scented cotton tampon with a plastic applicator.
A small cotton tampon with a plastic applicator proudly claiming to be anti-microbial.  Ultra-fine print indicates that this tampon has no noticeable health benefits compared to others.
An expensive-looking tampon with a fancy, smooth plastic applicator.  The ultra-soft cotton has the appearance of a fluffy cloud.
A cheap-looking tampon.  The cotton looks rough, the plastic applicator has a few sharp edges, and the string is somehow already knotted.
An absorbent menstrual pad.  Unfortunately, not as useful as a bandage as you'd think.  The adhesive is on the side opposite of the absorbent part.
A small panty-liner only meant for the lightest flows.
A large menstrual pad meant for use overnight.
An absorbent menstrual pad with racing stripes, for the fastest flows.  Probably.
An absorbent menstrual pad that smells strongly of essential oils.
A pride-themed menstrual pad in trans flag coloring.  'Men can bleed too!' is proudly written on the packaging.
A cheap menstrual pad.  The cotton somehow looks like sandpaper and is almost see-through thin.

menstrual_cup.name: menstrual cup
menstrual_cup.description: A tiny, washable, flexible plastic cup about the size of a medicine cup for catching menstrual flow.

snippet_category.text: An instrument of hair torture.  There are round safety tips on the bristles.
An old-fashioned hair-straightening device with a faux-wood handle.
A soft, cushioned hairbrush.  The shiny chrome design appears modern.
A tacky kid's hairbrush.  The cartoon whale on the handle seems friendly enough.

curler_hair.name: hair curler
curler_hair.description: A soft plastic cylinder you can wrap a lock of your hair around to curl it.

string_floss.name: dental floss
string_floss.description: Twenty-five yards of finely waxed thread wound up inside a plastic container.  Perfect for picking bits of smoked meat out of your teeth.  Disassemble to use the thread for something else.

comb_pocket.name: comb
comb_pocket.description: A grooming tool with teeth for straightening your hair.

snippet_category.text: Somehow, a few teeth have already broken off the end of this otherwise pristine comb.
A grooming tool with teeth for straightening your hair.  This one is narrow, black and austere.
A comb made of soft plastic.  Its tortoiseshell pattern makes it seem antique.
A comb which folds on a hinge, in case you want to look like a greaser.

plunger_toilet.name: toilet plunger
plunger_toilet.description: A rubber-tipped tool for unclogging pipes, or a club for an immature survivor.

plunger_futuristic.name: professional plunger
plunger_futuristic.description: This hollow plastic toilet plunger's bell compresses like an accordion.  It is efficient at its intended purpose, and complete rubbish as a weapon.

snippet_category.text: Imagine the thinnest, most disposable paper you could possibly make.  Now imagine something thinner than that.
This roll of toilet paper is two-ply and quilted, for vandalizing houses more comfortably than ever.
This brand of toilet paper is designed to dissolve completely in water!
Images of your least favorite politician are printed on each individual sheet.
A luxurious remnant of civilization.  The splinters of unprocessed wood visible in this one make it seem less luxurious, though.

hair_dryer.name: hair dryer
hair_dryer.description: This tool dries your hair by pushing air through a coil of hot wires.  The heat can be toggled on and off.

curling_iron.name: curling iron
curling_iron.description: A wand made of heat-resistant ceramics.  When plugged into an outlet, it is hot enough to shape your hair into curls.  Too bad the power's out.

brush_toilet.name: toilet brush
brush_toilet.description: Zombies cannot be intimidated or humiliated, so this stiff brush is only useful for scouring toilet bowls.

comb_lice.name: lice comb
comb_lice.description: A stainless-steel comb with spiral grooved teeth designed to remove pesky parasites from hair.  Even just thinking about it makes you itch.

snippet_category.text: A plastic floating bath toy.
A yellow rubber duck.  Designed to dropped in the bath.
A black rubber duck with large white eyes.  Designed to be dropped in the bath.
A small green dinosaur with a wide grin.  Designed for bath time.

bottle_bathroom.name: plastic soap bottle
bottle_bathroom.description: A squeezable bottle used to hold various liquid soaps.

snippet_category.text: A bottle for special shampoo for dyed hair.
A plain white bottle made to contain the cheapest shampoo.
A bottle for body wash.  This one is called 'Afrika'.
A bottle for hair conditioner.
A colorful bottle of body and hair wash marketed for children.
A plain white bottle made to contain the cheapest hair conditioner.
A plain white bottle made to contain the cheapest shower gel.

dentures.name: set of dentures
dentures.description: A standard set of prosthetic teeth.  Pretty useless to anyone aside from its owner.

hammock.name: hammock
hammock.description: A large sheet of cloth with ropes on two sides.  Could be tied to something and then used as a sleeping place that is comfortable, but lacks warmth.

hammock_net.name: net hammock
hammock_net.description: A large net with ropes on two sides.  Could be tied to something and then used as a sleeping place that is comfortable, but lacks warmth.

sheet.name: sheet
sheet.description: A 72 by 24 inch two-layer-thick fabric sheet.  It could be used as a curtain or bedsheet, or cut up for a bunch of smaller sheets.

blanket.name: blanket
blanket.description: Hiding under here will not protect you from the monsters.

blanket_weighted.name: weighted blanket
blanket_weighted.description: A thick, layered blanket with glass microbeads added to increase the weight.

down_blanket.name: down-filled blanket
down_blanket.description: Hiding under here will not protect you from the monsters, but it'll keep you warm.

fur_blanket.name: fur blanket
fur_blanket.description: A heavy fur blanket that covers most of your body.

quilt.name: quilt
quilt.description: A big, comfy quilt made of thick wool in a triangle pattern.  Extremely cozy!

quilt_patchwork.name: patchwork quilt
quilt_patchwork.description: A huge, patchwork wool quilt.  Very, very warm.

emer_blanket.name: emergency blanket
emer_blanket.description: A blanket made of space-age material that covers your most important body parts.  It folds into a very compact form when not in use.

sleeping_bag.name: sleeping bag
sleeping_bag.description: A large sleeping bag that covers you head to toe, with a strap for carrying it on your back when not in use.  This one is medium weight.  It is currently unrolled; activate it to roll it up for easy storage.

use_action.msg: You roll up the sleeping bag, preparing it for transport.

sleeping_bag_improvised.name: improvised sleeping bag
sleeping_bag_improvised.description: You might think it is bizarre to sleep in a body bag stuffed with dead plants.  However, the thought of sleeping in the cold is far more uncomfortable.

grass_sheet.name: grass sheet
grass_sheet.description: Some grass yarn woven into a crude sheet.

grass_blanket.name: grass blanket
grass_blanket.description: Some grass sheets sewn together.  Itchy, but more comfortable than the cold.

223_casing.name: .223 casing
223_casing.description: An empty casing from a .223 round.

unprimed_223_casing.name: primerless .223 casing
unprimed_223_casing.description: An empty casing from a .223 round, with its primer removed.

22_casing.name: .22 LR casing
22_casing.description: An empty casing from a .22 LR round.  These can't be hand-reloaded.

22_casing_new.name: unused .22 casing
22_casing_new.description: An unfired, like-new .22 round casing, with the primer still intact.

22_casing_new_short.name: unused .22 short casing
22_casing_new_short.description: An unfired, like-new .22 short casing, with the priming compound still intact.

3006_casing.name: .30-06 casing
3006_casing.description: An empty casing from a .30-06 round.

unprimed_3006_casing.name: primerless .30-06 casing
unprimed_3006_casing.description: An empty casing from a .30-06 round, with its primer removed.

3030_casing.name: .30-30 Winchester casing
3030_casing.description: An empty casing from a .30-30 Winchester round.

unprimed_3030_casing.name: primerless .30-30 Winchester casing
unprimed_3030_casing.description: An empty casing from a .30-30 Winchester round.

123ln_casing.name: 12.3ln casing
123ln_casing.description: An empty casing from a 12.3ln round.  It looks deceptively like a .303 British casing, if those were rimless.

unprimed_123ln_casing.name: primerless 12.3ln casing
unprimed_123ln_casing.description: An empty casing from a 12.3ln round.  It looks deceptively like a .303 British casing, if those were rimless.  This one has had its primer removed.

33_naval_casing.name: 3.3 naval casing
33_naval_casing.description: An empty casing from a 3.3 naval round.  If it wasn't for burns and soot, it could be used as a cup.

caotel_cell_spent.name: spent Caotel cell
caotel_cell_spent.description: This is a small metallic cube of inscrutable construction.  You think it might feel slightly lighter when compared to the fresh ones.

270win_casing.name: .270 Winchester casing
270win_casing.description: An empty casing from a .270 Winchester round.

unprimed_270win_casing.name: primerless .270 Winchester casing
unprimed_270win_casing.description: An empty casing from a .270 Winchester round, with its primer removed.

303_casing.name: .303 British casing
303_casing.description: An empty casing from a .303 British round.

unprimed_303_casing.name: primerless .303 British casing
unprimed_303_casing.description: An empty casing from a .303 British round, with its primer removed.

300_casing.name: .300 Winchester Magnum casing
300_casing.description: An empty casing from a .300 Winchester Magnum round.

unprimed_300_casing.name: primerless .300 Winchester Magnum casing
unprimed_300_casing.description: An empty casing from a .300 Winchester Magnum round, with its primer removed.

308_casing.name: .308 Winchester casing
308_casing.description: An empty casing from a .308 Winchester round.

unprimed_308_casing.name: primerless .308 Winchester casing
unprimed_308_casing.description: An empty casing from a .308 Winchester round, with its primer removed.

762_51_casing.name: 7.62x51mm NATO casing
762_51_casing.description: An empty casing from a 7.62x51mm NATO round.

unprimed_762_51_casing.name: primerless 7.62x51mm NATO casing
unprimed_762_51_casing.description: An empty casing from a 7.62x51mm NATO round, with its primer removed.

32_casing.name: .32 ACP casing
32_casing.description: An empty casing from a .32 ACP round.

unprimed_32_casing.name: primerless .32 ACP casing
unprimed_32_casing.description: An empty casing from a .32 ACP round, with its primer removed.

38_casing.name: .38 Special casing
38_casing.description: An empty casing from a .38 Special round.

unprimed_38_casing.name: primerless .38 Special casing
unprimed_38_casing.description: An empty casing from a .38 Special round, with its primer removed.

38super_casing.name: .38 Super casing
38super_casing.description: An empty casing from a .38 Super round.

unprimed_38super_casing.name: primerless .38 Super casing
unprimed_38super_casing.description: An empty casing from a .38 Super round, with its primer removed.

40_casing.name: .40 S&W casing
40_casing.description: An empty casing from a .40 S&W round.

unprimed_40_casing.name: primerless .40 S&W casing
unprimed_40_casing.description: An empty casing from a .40 S&W round, with its primer removed.

10mm_casing.name: 10mm Auto casing
10mm_casing.description: An empty casing from a 10mm Auto round.

unprimed_10mm_casing.name: primerless 10mm Auto casing
unprimed_10mm_casing.description: An empty casing from a 10mm Auto round, with its primer removed.

40x46mm_m212_casing.name: 40x46mm M212 casing
40x46mm_m212_casing.description: A large casing from a spent 40x46mm cartridge, which used to hold a less-lethal projectile.

40x46mm_m118_casing.name: 40x46mm M118 casing
40x46mm_m118_casing.description: A large casing from a spent 40x46mm cartridge, which used to hold an HEDP grenade.  Suitable for reloading with buckshot, slug or flechette loads.

40x46mm_m199_casing.name: 40x46mm M199 casing
40x46mm_m199_casing.description: A large casing from a spent 40x46mm cartridge, which used to hold a buckshot load.  Suitable for reloading with buckshot, slug or flechette loads.

40x46mm_m195_casing.name: 40x46mm M195 casing
40x46mm_m195_casing.description: A large casing from a spent 40x46mm cartridge, which used to hold a tear gas canister.

40x46mm_hornets_nest_22lr_casing.name: 40x46mm .22 LR hornet's nest casing
40x46mm_hornets_nest_22lr_casing.description: An empty 40x46mm hornet's nest casing, able to be reloaded with ten .22 LR bullets to fire them simultaneously.

40x46mm_hornets_nest_410_casing.name: 40x46mm .410 hornet's nest casing

FMCNote.name: merch
FMCNote.description: The Free Merchant Certified Note, also known by names such as a 'c-note' or 'merch', is a currency based on old American bills.  Fifty dollar bills and larger are printed with a promissory note signed by the treasurer of the Free Merchants, along with a complex design. foon.description: Clearly the superior instrument.  Sporks are just imitators.

casserole.description: A ceramic pot made for both cooking and serving, particularly one-pot dinners.

stock_pot.name: stock pot
stock_pot.description: A large pot with 20 gauge walls and a thick aluminum bottom, used for making soup stocks.  You could fit a whole turkey in there, with a bit of shoving.

pot_canning.description: A very large 20 liter pot, primarily meant for canning food in glass jars via the water bath method, though it can cook normal foods just as well.  Canning foods with it will require a lot of water.  If you're only canning a couple of jars at a time, you'd fill it up with rocks or something to displace the water above the lids.

pot_canning_clay.name: clay canning pot
pot_canning_clay.description: A very large 25 liter earthenware pot, primarily meant for canning food via the water bath method, though it can cook normal foods just as well.
