cable_instrument.description: Known as an instrument cable because it is usually used to connect a guitar to a powered amp, it is an unbalanced cable with 1/4" male connectors on each side.

headphones_circumaural.name: headphones
headphones_circumaural.description: A pair of headphones that cover your ears for improved sound quality and private listening.  This pair is from a well-known brand that is very high quality, with a detachable 1/8" cable.  Comes with a 1/8" to 1/4" adapter.

microphone_xlr_generic.name: XLR microphone
microphone_xlr_generic.description: A microphone used to record or amplify sound.  Comes with a clip.  Has a 3-pin XLR connector on the bottom in order to connect to an amp.

mic_stand_tall.name: microphone stand
mic_stand_tall.description: A lightweight telescoping boom stand made of aluminum and painted black.  About 6' tall when full extended, or 3' when closed fully.  Has threads for a mic clip on one end.

guitar_stand.name: guitar stand
guitar_stand.description: A small, oddly-shaped piece of aluminum hardware with three legs.  When placed on the ground, this can support one guitar in an upright position.

plectrum.name: plectrum
plectrum.description: A flat piece of plastic with a pointed tip, designed for plucking the strings of an instrument.

mixer_music.name: mixer
mixer_music.description: A device with faders, switches, and knobs that mixes input signal and sends it to two output XLR cables, a left one and a right one.

drivebelt.name: drive belt
drivebelt.description: A synthetic rubber V-belt with steel reinforcement fibers.  Commonly fitted to engines or other industrial equipment.

drivebelt_makeshift.name: makeshift drive belt
drivebelt_makeshift.description: An improvised belt useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.

five-point_harness.name: 5-point harness
five-point_harness.description: A harness made of five belts meant to be mounted on vehicle to fasten a passenger securely to their seat.

filter_air.name: air filter
filter_air.description: A plastic box containing creped paper used to filter the air supply for combustion engines or other industrial equipment.

filter_air_makeshift.name: makeshift air filter
filter_air_makeshift.description: An improvised air filter useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.

filter_liquid.name: automotive filter
filter_liquid.description: A steel can containing filter paper designed for automotive use.

filter_liquid_makeshift.name: makeshift automotive filter
filter_liquid_makeshift.description: An improvised automotive filter useful for repairing engines or other industrial equipment when no better alternative is available.

glowplug.name: glow plug
glowplug.description: A cylindrical heating device designed to be screwed in to a diesel engine to aid starting in cold weather.

pump_complex.name: high-pressure pump
pump_complex.description: A complex mechanical pump capable of achieving high pressures.  Far beyond anything you could reasonably improvise.

well_pump.name: mechanical pump
well_pump.description: A simple cast iron mechanical impeller pump.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

compressor.name: compressor
compressor.description: An electrically-powered device which compresses gas to increase pressure.  Used in fridges, air conditioners and many other appliances.

nitrogen_membrane_filter.name: nitrogen membrane filter
nitrogen_membrane_filter.description: A straight pipe with high-tech membrane filter inside it, designed to separate nitrogen from compressed air that is pumped through it.

magnet.name: magnet
magnet.description: A small but strong permanent magnet made from alnico alloy, which produces a magnetic field that attracts ferromagnetic materials such as steel.  Useful for crafting.

hd_pipe.name: heavy duty pipe
hd_pipe.description: A section of steel pipe with very thick walls built to contain very high pressure, probably intended to be a part of industrial equipment.

hd_pipe_fittings.name: set of heavy duty pipe fittings
hd_pipe_fittings.description: A loose assortment of very thick-walled steel pipe fittings - end caps, pipe junctions, and similar items.  Probably intended to be a part of industrial equipment.
hd_pipe_fittings.name_plural: sets of heavy duty pipe fittings

hd_valve.name: heavy duty valve
hd_valve.description: A short section of thick-walled pipe with a valve integrated into it, allowing an operator to regulate the flow of gas or liquid through it.

pressure_gauge.name: pressure gauge
pressure_gauge.description: A short section of thick-walled pipe with a device which shows the internal pressure built into it.

pyrometer.name: pyrometer
pyrometer.description: A small electronic device used for measuring high temperatures.

hd_compressor.name: industrial compressor
hd_compressor.description: A bulky and very powerful compressor which can produce very high pressure if fitted to a pipe.  Much more powerful than whatever you'd find in common household appliances.

large_pressure_vessel.name: large pressure vessel
large_pressure_vessel.description: An enormously bulky and heavy steel vessel with thick walls.  Likely meant to be a reaction chamber for industrial processes requiring high pressure.

small_pressure_vessel.name: small pressure vessel
small_pressure_vessel.description: A rather small steel vessel with thick walls designed to contain high pressure.  Quite heavy for its size.

pipe_fittings.name: set of pipe fittings
pipe_fittings.description: A loose assortment of metal pipe fittings - end caps, pipe junctions, and similar items.  They can be used in a variety of projects.

simple_crank.name: simple crank mechanism
simple_crank.description: A simple cranking mechanism, consisting of a bent metal arm attached at a right angle to a rotating shaft.  It can be used to convert circular motion into reciprocating motion, or vice versa, by means of muscle power.

tire_repair_kit.name: tire repair kit
tire_repair_kit.description: A set of tools, multiple cords, and a glue, all designed to save your punctured tire and make it back on track.  It supposed to last only for a day or two, and change of the tire is strongly advised by the manufacturer.

clothes_hanger.name: clothes hanger
clothes_hanger.description: A plastic clothes hanger with a metal hook to hang something on a rail.

storage_line.name: storage line
storage_line.description: A four foot long collection of carabiners for hanging items while camping.

pocket_data.description: Small carabiner.
Small carabiner.
Small carabiner.
Large carabiner.
Large carabiner.

cordage_6.name: short cordage piece
cordage_6.description: A 6-inch (or about 15 cm) long piece of natural cordage.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper string.

cordage_36.name: long cordage piece
cordage_36.description: A 3-foot (or about 90 cm) long piece of natural cordage.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper string.

string_6.name: short string
string_6.description: A 6-inch (or about 15 cm) long piece of cotton string.

string_36.name: long string
string_36.description: A 3-foot (or about 90 cm) long piece of cotton string.

cordage_6_leather.name: short leather lace
cordage_6_leather.description: A 6-inch (or about 15 cm) long piece of leather lace.  Useful for some purposes, but not as flexible as proper string.

cordage_36_leather.name: long leather lace
cordage_36_leather.description: A 3-foot (or about 90 cm) long piece of leather lace, made from smaller pieces that are tied together.  Useful for some purposes, but not as flexible as proper string.

rope_6.name: short rope
rope_6.description: A 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long piece of rope.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.

use_action.holster_msg: You use an elaborate knot to tie your %s to your %s

rope_30.name: long rope
rope_30.description: A 30-foot (or about 9 m) long rope.  Useful for keeping yourself safe from falls.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.

use_action.holster_msg: You use an elaborate knot to tie your %s to your %s

vine_6.name: short vine
vine_6.description: A sturdy 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long vine.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.

use_action.holster_msg: You use an elaborate knot to tie your %s to your %s

vine_30.name: long vine
vine_30.description: A sturdy 30-foot (or about 9 m) long vine.  Could easily be used as a rope.  Strong enough to suspend a large corpse for butchering.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.

use_action.holster_msg: You use an elaborate knot to tie your %s to your %s

rope_makeshift_6.name: short cordage rope
rope_makeshift_6.description: A 6-foot (or about 180 cm) long piece of rough rope, woven from natural cordage.  Useful for some purposes, but not as strong or flexible as proper rope.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.

use_action.holster_msg: You use an elaborate knot to tie your %s to your %s

rope_makeshift_30.name: long cordage rope
rope_makeshift_30.description: A 30-foot (or about 9 m) long rough rope, woven from natural cordage.  Not strong enough to hold up to falls, but still useful for some things, such as suspending large corpses for butchering.  Wear it over a shoulder and tie items to it as a temporary carrying solution.

use_action.holster_msg: You use an elaborate knot to tie your %s to your %s

seatbelt.name: seat belt
seatbelt.description: A length of synthetic fiber weaved into a flat band, usually used to securely fasten passenger inside vehicles.

use_action.holster_msg: You use an elaborate knot to tie your %s to your %s

stick_fiber.name: fibrous stalk
stick_fiber.description: A rather green stick.  Very fibrous.

rubber_band.name: rubber band
rubber_band.description: An elastic loop of rubber commonly used to hold multiple objects together.

talking_doll.name: talking doll
talking_doll.description: This is a talking doll, meant for children.  Fortunately it still works, and you could unload the batteries out of it.

creepy_doll.name: talking doll
creepy_doll.description: This is a talking doll, meant for children.  Fortunately it still works, and you could unload the batteries out of it.

swimming_kickboard.name: swimming kickboard
swimming_kickboard.description: A swimming kickboard, would be a great training aid for the beach or the pool, if only they weren't full of zombies and mutant fish.

shuttlecock.name: badminton shuttlecock
shuttlecock.description: A high-drag projectile used in the sport of badminton.

golf_tee.name: golf tee
golf_tee.description: A pin-shaped piece of wood meant for holding a golf ball slightly off the ground.

golf_ball.name: golf ball
golf_ball.description: A small, hard plastic ball with round indentations on it.

pool_ball.name: pool ball
pool_ball.description: A colorful, hard plastic ball for playing games on a pool table.  Essentially a rock.

bowling_ball.name: bowling ball
bowling_ball.description: A large, heavy ball with finger holes for better grip.  Before the apocalypse, its main purpose was to be rolled along waxed floors.

baseball.name: baseball
baseball.description: A baseball, good for throwing at enemies.  Getting hit with one of these hurts a lot more than you might think.

football.name: football
football.description: An oval-shaped ball made of leather and string, it's easily thrown but does little damage.  You could take it apart into leather if you wanted.

aim_game.name: aim game target practice kit
aim_game.description: A collection of laser guns and targets designed to help you practice shooting.  The spot you 'hit' is displayed on the targets.

beach_volleyball.name: beach volleyball
beach_volleyball.description: A brightly colored beach volleyball.  It is slightly larger than a regular white one.

puck.name: hockey puck
puck.description: A heavy circular block of solid rubber, normally used for playing hockey.  You can throw it to cause some serious harm.

mannequin.name: mannequin
mannequin.description: A figure of an adult human, as seen in the display case at the mall.

cottonwood_tree_boll.name: cottonwood tree boll
cottonwood_tree_boll.description: A fluffy white seed.  While it looks like the common cotton, it is too weak and short to be turned into clothing.

apparatus.name: a smoking device and a source of flame
apparatus.name_plural: a smoking device and a source of flame

file.name: file
file.description: Several documents containing all kinds of information, customer data, and charts, kept together in a manila folder.  Pretty useless now.

log_immersion27.name: INCIDENT REPORT: IMMERSION-27A
log_immersion27.description: A white piece of paper, with the logo of XEDRA printed on its upper left corner.  It seems to be an internal report of some kind.

report_t_substrate.name: MATERIAL: T-SUBSTRATE
report_t_substrate.description: A white piece of paper, with the logo of XEDRA printed on its upper left corner.  It seems to be an internal report of some kind.

HAADF_t_substrate.name: HAADF MICROGRAPH: T-SUBSTRATE
HAADF_t_substrate.description: A white piece of paper, with the logo of XEDRA printed on its upper left corner.  It seems to be an internal report of some kind.

monitoring_equipment_doc.name: XEDRA document
monitoring_equipment_doc.description: A white piece of paper, with the logo of XEDRA printed on its upper left corner.  It seems to be an internal report of some kind.

artifact_scp_doc.name: ANOMALOUS ARTIFACT REPORT
artifact_scp_doc.description: A white piece of paper, with the logo of XEDRA printed on its upper left corner.  It seems to be an internal report of some kind.

melchior_science_doc.name: MELCHIOR report
melchior_science_doc.description: A white piece of paper, with the logo of XEDRA printed on its upper left corner.  It seems to be an internal report of some kind.

msu14_password.name: annotated paper scrap
msu14_password.description: A small scrap of paper with two long character sequences scribbled on it.

small_printout_portal_storm_data.name: short NRE printout
small_printout_portal_storm_data.description: A sequence of overlapping numbers plotted in thermal paper, at times so densely-packed that they disappear into thick blots of oxide-colored ink.  A few number sequences repeat in an almost orderly fashion, but you can't tell whether that means anything.

medium_printout_portal_storm_data.name: NRE printout
medium_printout_portal_storm_data.description: A long sequence of overlapping numbers plotted in thermal paper, at times so densely-packed that they disappear into thick blots of oxide-colored ink.  The blots and numbers are arranged in a strangely pleasing pattern.

large_printout_portal_storm_data.name: long NRE printout
large_printout_portal_storm_data.description: A very, very long sequence of overlapping numbers plotted in thermal paper.  It is almost 15 feet long.

nre_anomaly_printout_data.name: NRE anomaly printout
nre_anomaly_printout_data.description: A long sequence of overlapping numbers plotted in thermal paper, at times so densely-packed that they disappear into thick blots of oxide-colored ink.  The printed values increased along rhythmical waves, but the number 5 is always skipped.

fp_loyalty_card.name: Foodplace loyalty card
fp_loyalty_card.description: A bright pink loyalty card, all the points are stamped.  This would definitely prove your fidelity to Foodplace, if that still meant anything…

twig.name: twig
twig.description: A small, slender branch.  Makes passable firewood but is not useful for much else.

leaves.name: handful of leaves
leaves.description: Some ordinary, mostly dry leaves.  They have very few uses and are thus (almost) only good for burning.

withered.name: withered plant
withered.description: A dead plant.  Good for starting fires or making crude tailoring crafts.

dry_seaweed.name: dried seaweed
dry_seaweed.description: A bit of dried seaweed.  It's tough, inedible, and possibly poisonous, but it could be burned or used for crafts.

dry_seaweed_pile.name: pile of dried seaweed
dry_seaweed_pile.description: A big heap of dried seaweed.  It's tough, inedible, and possibly poisonous, but it could be burned or used for crafts.

fertilizer.name: fertilizer
fertilizer.description: A token representing fertilization of a plant.

chain.name: steel chain
chain.description: A heavy steel chain.  Useful as a weapon, or for crafting.  It has a chance to wrap around your target, allowing for a bonus unarmed attack.

chitin_piece.name: chunk of chitin
chitin_piece.description: A piece of an insect's exoskeleton.  It is light and very durable.

endochitin.name: strand of endochitin
endochitin.description: A piece of an insect's endoskeleton.

mutant_bug_hydrogen_sacs.name: cluster of gas sacs
mutant_bug_hydrogen_sacs.description: A cluster of membranous bubbles, each about the size of a grape, retrieved from inside a mutant insect.  They float like tiny helium balloons - perhaps they are full of a lighter-than-air gas.

ballast.name: ballast organs
ballast.description: A cluster of hydrostatic organs, each about the size of a baseball, retrieved from inside a kraken mutant.  Some of them seem to be lighter than air, and some seem to weigh as much as air.

acidchitin_piece.name: chunk of biosilicified chitin
acidchitin_piece.description: A lump of exoskeleton that has undergone biosilicification.  It is acid-resistant but rather brittle.

sample_t_substrate.name: t-substrate sample
sample_t_substrate.description: An acrylic cube cast around a small black crystal.  It's tepid to the touch.

biollante_bud.name: biollante bud
biollante_bud.description: An unopened biollante flower, brilliant purple in color.  It may still have its sap-producing organ intact.

canister_empty.name: empty canister
canister_empty.description: An empty canister, which may have once held tear gas or other substances.

petrified_eye.name: petrified eye
petrified_eye.description: A fist-sized eyeball with a cross-shaped pupil.  It seems to be made of stone, but doesn't look like it was carved.

spiral_stone.name: spiral stone
spiral_stone.description: A rock the size of your fist.  It is covered with intricate spirals; it is impossible to tell whether they are carved, naturally formed, or some kind of fossil.

usb_drive_nano.name: secured USB drive
usb_drive_nano.description: A USB thumb drive.  Useful for holding software.  This one seems like it could get run over by a truck and be fine.

nano_fabricator_encryption_code.name: nano-fabricator licensing USB
nano_fabricator_encryption_code.description: Some type of advanced data storage device, filled with credentials and licenses to operate the nano-fabricator.

lixa_data.name: LIXA research archive backup
lixa_data.description: A secured USB thumb drive, containing a copy of the LIXA facility's research archives.

robofac_hardcase.name: DARPA hard case
robofac_hardcase.description: A heavy and very durable protective case made of steel and thick plastic, locked with a six-dial combination.  A sticker with the logo of DARPA is attached to the front, but looking at the surface, you can see that another marking - formerly stenciled into the material - was recently and hastily destroyed.

fema_data.name: FEMA data
fema_data.description: Evacuation plans, disaster risk projections, personnel lists, and last-minute communications from just before the end, all scrubbed from FEMA servers and stored in an external HDD.

godcotrader_accounting_records_dirty.name: accounting records
godcotrader_accounting_records_dirty.description: A stack of various forms and papers with credits and debits listed all over them, detailing transactions and purchases.  Reading over them, all of the balances are mismatched, and a significant amount of money is missing.

godcotrader_accounting_records_clean.name: accounting records
godcotrader_accounting_records_clean.description: A stack of various forms and papers with credits and debits listed all over them, detailing transactions and purchases.  Reading over them, everything is in good order, whoever did these is skilled at their job.

candlestick.name: candlestick
candlestick.description: A brass candlestick with a gold finish.

blade.name: blade
blade.description: A large, relatively sharp blade.  Could be used to make bladed weaponry, or attached to a car.

blade_scythe.name: scythe blade
blade_scythe.description: A large, curved blade.  Could be used to assemble a scythe, or make an improvised polearm.

circsaw_blade.name: circular sawblade
circsaw_blade.description: An 8" circular sawblade.  You could make a saw with it, or throw it.  Wielding it without sturdy gloves is a bad idea.

tree_spile.name: tree spile
tree_spile.description: A hollow metal cylinder which is inserted in a tree crust in order to slowly harvest its sap.  Can be used on a maple tree between late winter and early spring to harvest maple sap.

makeshift_tree_spile.name: makeshift tree spile
makeshift_tree_spile.description: A carved piece of wood which is inserted in a tree crust in order to slowly harvest its sap.  Can be used on a maple tree in between late winter and early spring to harvest maple sap.

egg_void_spider.name: luminescent bead
egg_void_spider.description: Strange lights perpetually glimmer within the sharpened internals of this glass globule.

tattered_garment.name: tattered garments
tattered_garment.description: Time and the elements have reduced them to a mound of filthy ribbons.

wire.name: wire
wire.description: A length of thin, relatively stiff steel wire.  Like the sort you find in chain link fences.

piano_wire.name: piano wire
piano_wire.description: A length of thin, relatively stretchy coiled steel wire.  Used to produce musical notes in instruments.

lc_wire.name: steel wire
lc_wire.description: A length of thin, relatively stiff wire made of mild steel.  Ubiquitously found in everyday applications such as chain link fences.

mc_wire.name: medium steel wire
mc_wire.description: A length of thin, stiff wire made of medium steel.  Its balance between strength and flexibility makes it suitable for steel ropes and cables.

hc_wire.name: high steel wire
hc_wire.description: A length of strong wire made of high carbon steel.  Often used in industrial machinery and springs.

ch_wire.name: hardened steel wire
ch_wire.description: A length of thin, relatively stiff steel wire, made of hardened steel.

qt_wire.name: tempered steel wire
qt_wire.description: A length of flexible and durable steel wire, made of tempered spring steel.  Often used in industrial and automotive springs, and the wire in musical instruments.

wire_barbed.name: barbed wire
wire_barbed.description: A length of stiff wire, covered in sharp barbs.

wire_mesh.name: steel mesh
wire_mesh.description: A 6-inch square piece of finely-woven steel wire, useful for dryer lint traps and reusable coffee filter baskets.  You could put this on a window to keep mosquitoes and other bugs out if it was larger, but chain link fencing will do these days.

rebar.name: rebar
rebar.description: A rod of rebar, makes a nice melee weapon, and could be handy in constructing tougher walls and such.

railroad_track_small.name: small railroad track
railroad_track_small.description: A length of track, made from some planks and rails.

concrete.name: dry concrete mix
concrete.description: Some mixed cement, sand and aggregates, precombined and ready to be used in a construction project.

drum_skin.name: drum skin
drum_skin.description: The tanned hide of an animal repurposed to become the head on a percussion drum.

torch_done.name: burnt out torch
torch_done.description: A torch that has consumed all its fuel; it can be recrafted into another torch.

handflare_dead.name: dead flare
handflare_dead.description: A spent magnesium flare.  It is essentially trash.

spring.name: large spring
spring.description: A large, heavy-duty spring.  Expands with significant force when compressed.

spring_medium.name: medium spring
spring_medium.description: A medium spring wound from tempered steel wire.  Resists corrosion and expands consistently when compressed.

spring_small.name: small spring
spring_small.description: A small spring wound from tempered steel wire.  Resists corrosion and expands consistently when compressed.

lawnmower.name: lawnmower
lawnmower.description: A motorized pushmower that seems to be broken.  You could take it apart if you had a wrench.

broketent.name: damaged tent
broketent.description: A small tent, just big enough to fit one person comfortably.  This tent is broken and cannot be deployed.

largebroketent.name: large damaged tent
largebroketent.description: A family-sized tent, very bulky but with plenty of space.  This tent is broken and cannot be deployed.

element.name: heating element
element.description: A heating element, like the ones used in hotplates or kettles.  Consists of nichrome wire surrounded by electrical insulator and placed inside a steel casing.

crude_heating_element.name: crude heating element
crude_heating_element.description: A primitive heating element made from thin coiled steel wire.  It will degrade much quicker with use than normal heating elements, but it'll do for some applications.

thermostat.name: bimetal thermostat
thermostat.description: A simple thermostat controlled by thermal expansion of a bimetal strip.

household_water_heater.name: household water heater
household_water_heater.description: A large metal tank with a water faucet attached to it, primarily used to store and heat water.

household_water_heater_family.name: family–sized household water heater
household_water_heater_family.description: A large metal tank with a water faucet attached to it, primarily used to store and heat water.  Large enough for a whole family.

television.name: television
television.description: A large LCD television, full of delicious electronics.

household_washing_machine.name: household washing machine
household_washing_machine.description: An appliance used to wash laundry, not of much use without power and water.  Can be placed as an appliance.

household_dishwasher.name: household dishwasher
household_dishwasher.description: An appliance used to clean dishes, not of much use without power and water.  Can be placed as an appliance.

pilot_light.name: pilot light
pilot_light.description: A pilot light from a gas-burning device, this particular one is a simple piezoelectric igniter.

delay_fuze.name: delayed fuze
delay_fuze.description: A complex mechanical fuze.  It seems it can be used to detonate stable explosives after a short time by triggering it.

impact_fuze.name: impact fuze
impact_fuze.description: A complex mechanical fuze.  It seems it can be used to detonate stable explosives upon a solid impact.

broken_kord.name: Kord AK rifle (Demilled)
broken_kord.description: A special forces Russian rifle chambered in 5.45 that someone has taken a plasma cutter to, cutting it in three places to comply with import restrictions.  This thing would have been hard to source, and thankfully its unique complex recoil balance system remains intact, unlike the receiver and barrel.  The telltale rainbow patterns of torch cuts mar the otherwise beautiful receiver.  A well-equipped gunsmith with time and materials could probably build a new one out of this…

broken_robofac_camspy.name: broken camspy
broken_robofac_camspy.description: A broken camspy.  It probably won't spy on anything ever again.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_skitterbot.name: broken skitterbot
broken_skitterbot.description: A broken skitterbot.  Much less threatening now that it lies limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_robofac_skittergun.name: broken exterminatron
broken_robofac_skittergun.description: A broken Hub 01 exterminatron.  Much less threatening now that it lies limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_robofac_hound.name: broken Hub 01 HOUND
broken_robofac_hound.description: A broken Hub 01 Hostile Overstimulation & Unmanned Neutralization Drone.  Much less threatening now that it lies limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_science_bot.name: broken lab defense bot
broken_science_bot.description: A broken lab defense bot, with its casing broken and fluid drained.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_nursebot.name: broken nurse bot
broken_nursebot.description: A broken nurse bot.  Its smooth face stares vacantly into empty space.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_grocerybot.name: broken grocery bot
broken_grocerybot.description: A broken grocery bot.  Its smiling face stares vacantly into empty space.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_grocerybot_busted.name: broken grocery bot
broken_grocerybot_busted.description: The body of a busted grocery bot.  Its tarnished face is still smiling.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_nursebot_defective.name: broken nurse bot
broken_nursebot_defective.description: A broken nurse bot.  Its smooth face stares vacantly into empty space.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_robofac_prototype.name: broken prototype robot
broken_robofac_prototype.description: A broken prototype robot--well, more broken than before.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_mech_recon.name: broken recon mech
broken_mech_recon.description: A broken mech exoskeleton suit, it looks beyond repair.

broken_mech_lifter.name: broken mech lifter
broken_mech_lifter.description: A broken mech exoskeleton suit, it looks beyond repair.

broken_mech_combat.name: broken combat mech
broken_mech_combat.description: A broken mech exoskeleton suit, it looks beyond repair.

broken_dispatch.name: broken riot dispatch
broken_dispatch.description: A broken riot dispatch, with its mesh midsection filled with fried manhacks and its motor limp and still.  Could be gutted for parts.

paper.name: paper
paper.description: A piece of paper.  Can be used to start fires.

book_binder.name: book binder
book_binder.description: A book binder.  With a pen and some paper you could copy some recipes from books into it.

broken_dispatch_military.name: broken military dispatch
broken_dispatch_military.description: A broken military dispatch.  Though the scratched manhacks visible in its belly are disarmed, their destructive potential still inspires a spark of fear in you, even now.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_manhack.name: broken manhack
broken_manhack.description: A broken manhack.  Much less threatening now that it lies limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_grenade_hack.name: broken grenade hack
broken_grenade_hack.description: A broken grenade hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_gasbomb_hack.name: broken tear gas hack
broken_gasbomb_hack.description: A broken tear gas hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_EMP_hack.name: broken EMP hack
broken_EMP_hack.description: A broken EMP hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_flashbang_hack.name: broken flashbang hack
broken_flashbang_hack.description: A broken flashbang hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_c4_hack.name: broken C-4 hack
broken_c4_hack.description: A broken C-4 hack.  Much less threatening now that it lies quiet on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_turret_speaker.name: broken loudspeaker
broken_turret_speaker.description: A broken loudspeaker.  It's so unusually quiet now…  Could be gutted for parts.

processor.name: processor board
processor.description: A central processor unit, useful in advanced electronics crafting.

RAM.name: RAM
RAM.description: A stick of memory.  Useful in advanced electronics crafting.

power_supply.name: power converter
power_supply.description: A power supply unit.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.

amplifier.name: amplifier circuit
amplifier.description: A circuit designed to amplify the strength of a signal.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.

transponder.name: transponder circuit
transponder.description: A circuit designed to repeat a signal.  Useful for crafting communications equipment.

receiver.name: signal receiver
receiver.description: A module designed to receive many forms of signals.  Useful for crafting communications equipment.

large_lcd_screen.name: large LCD screen
large_lcd_screen.description: A large backlit screen, used for displaying images.  Useful in some electronics recipes.

small_lcd_screen.name: small LCD screen
small_lcd_screen.description: A small backlit screen, used for displaying images.  Useful in some electronics recipes.

lens.name: high-quality lens
lens.description: A high-quality glass lens, useful for focusing or diffusing light.  Might be useful for starting a fire.

lens_small.name: small high-quality lens
lens_small.description: A small, high-quality glass lens, useful for focusing or diffusing light.  Might be useful for crafting.

glass_tinted.name: tinted glass lenses (pair)
glass_tinted.description: A pair of small, darkened glass lenses, like the ones used in sunglasses.

burnt_out_bionic.name: burnt out bionic
burnt_out_bionic.description: Once a valuable bionic implant, it has not held up well under repeated use.  It has been destroyed by excessive electric current and is now useless.

standard_template_construct.name: nanofabricator template
standard_template_construct.description: A state-of-the-art optical storage system.  This small slate of transparent glass holds, inscribed as a miniature pattern, the instructions required to create an item through a nanofabricator.

standard_template_construct_combat_exosk.name: nanofabricator exoskeleton template
standard_template_construct_combat_exosk.description: A state-of-the-art optical storage system.  This small slate of transparent glass holds, inscribed as a miniature pattern, the instructions required to create an item through a nanofabricator.  A small text at the bottom indicates that this one is specifically used to create combat exoskeletons.

debug_template.name: nanofabricator template
debug_template.description: A state-of-the-art optical storage system, containing the instruction set to replicate itself.

template_photonics.name: nanofabricator template (silicon photonics)
template_photonics.description: A state-of-the-art optical storage system, containing the instruction set required for the fabrication of complex silicon photonic circuitry.  The data within was once clearly worth millions, but now, you are not sure if it's anything more than a fancy, high-tech paperweight.

template_armor.name: nanofabricator template (UHMWPE)
template_armor.description: A state-of-the-art optical storage system, containing the instruction set required for the fabrication of advanced armor materials.  This seems to just be routines for working with the materials, not actual armor schematics.

antenna.name: antenna
antenna.description: A simple thin copper shaft.  Useful in lots of electronics recipes.

motor_micro.name: micro electric motor
motor_micro.description: A very small electric motor like those used in RC cars or electric hair trimmers.

circuit.name: circuit board
circuit.description: A printed card that supports and electrically connects electronic components on a non-conductive substrate.

e_scrap.name: electronic scrap
e_scrap.description: A random collection of resistors, capacitors, and diodes which have been stripped from printed circuits.

radio_repeater_mod.name: radio repeater mod
radio_repeater_mod.description: A system designed to convert a radio station into an autonomous repeater.

fan.name: desk fan
fan.description: A small fan, used to propel air around a room.

ceramic_armor.name: ceramic armor plate
ceramic_armor.description: A ceramic armor plate, specifically engineered for use as armor.  Not suitable for human use.

fish_bowl.name: fishbowl
fish_bowl.description: A filled fishbowl, the tag says 'to Ed' and the fish's name, 'Hoss'.  The fish appears to have tiny antlers.

pipe_cleaner.name: pipe cleaner
pipe_cleaner.description: A tool designed to clean the interior surface of pipes, bottles, and similar objects.  This one is thin enough to be used for cleaning firearm barrels from dirt and fouling.

clock.name: clock
clock.description: A small mechanical clock, it's stopped at 10:10.

clockworks.name: clockworks
clockworks.description: A small assortment of gears and other clockwork gubbins.

manhole_cover.name: manhole cover
manhole_cover.description: A heavy iron disc that typically covers a ladder into the sewers.  Lifting it from the manhole is impossible without a crowbar.

pine_bough.name: pine bough
pine_bough.description: A branch from a pine tree, oozing sticky sap and bristling with prickly needles.

pinecone.name: pinecone
pinecone.description: A spiny pod from a pine tree.

brew_sake_koji_active.name: unfinished koji rice
brew_sake_koji_active.description: Some cooked rice mixed with yeast and koji mold fragments, set aside to let koji mold grow on it so that it can make a passable sake base.

sake_koji_rice.name: koji rice
sake_koji_rice.description: Some rice covered in koji mold, mixed in with yeast.  Useful for making sake, but not really tasty on its own.  Smells vaguely of chestnuts.

young_koji_active.name: growing wild koji mold
young_koji_active.description: Some cooked rice sprinkled with ash and wrapped into a corn husk.  If left alone for a while, it will most likely grow koji mold.

young_koji_done.name: grown wild koji mold
young_koji_done.description: Some cooked rice sprinkled with ash and wrapped into a corn husk.  It has grown patches of koji mold inside; disassemble this item to extract it.

soy_wheat_dough_active.name: soy and wheat dough
soy_wheat_dough_active.description: Dough made from cooked and mashed soybeans and wheat flour, wrapped in wet paper.  If left to dry for some time, it'll grow koji mold, as necessary for making soy sauce.

soy_wheat_dough_done.name: soy and wheat dough with koji
soy_wheat_dough_done.description: A block of dried dough made from cooked and mashed soybeans and wheat flour, covered with koji mold.  Usable for making soy sauce.
soy_wheat_dough_done.name_plural: soy and wheat dough with koji

poppy_bud.name: poppy bud
poppy_bud.description: A poppy bud.  Contains some substances commonly produced by a mutated poppy flower.

sunflower.name: sunflower
sunflower.description: The top of a sunflower, with yellow petals and some seeds that have yet to be eaten by animals.

chamomile.name: chamomile flowers
chamomile.description: A handful of white chamomile flowers, used as an herbal remedy since ancient times.

lotus.name: lotus flower
lotus.description: A lovely flower that grows on the surface of bodies of fresh water.  Traditionally connected with many Eastern cultures.

spurge.name: spurge flowers
spurge.description: A handful of yellow-green flowers.  Can be brewed into a tea that prevents asthma attacks.

bouquet.name: withered bouquet
bouquet.description: A mixed collection of flowers.  Unfortunately, they have all withered with time.

dog_tag_dog.name: dog tag
dog_tag_dog.description: An identification tag for a pet, engraved with their name and their owner's address and phone number.  It says "<dog_name>".

clay_lump.name: lump of clay
clay_lump.description: A fresh piece of clay.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

clay_kaolin.name: lump of kaolin clay
clay_kaolin.description: A fresh soft lump of kaolin.  Useful for making ceramics like porcelain, or for high temperature applications as refractory.

brick.name: brick
brick.description: A fire-hardened building block used in masonry construction.

mortar_build.name: mortar
mortar_build.description: Some mortar, ready to be used in building projects.

mortar_lime.name: lime mortar
mortar_lime.description: Some lime mortar, made from quicklime and aggregate and ready for building.

soft_adobe_brick_active.name: soft adobe brick
soft_adobe_brick_active.description: A compacted mass of soil and natural fibers, still too wet to build with.  Load it onto a pallet and leave it to dry.

adobe_brick.name: adobe brick
adobe_brick.description: A compacted mass of soil and natural fibers, baked dry enough to harden into a brick.

mortar_adobe.name: adobe mortar
mortar_adobe.description: A thick, pasty mud, low in sand content to reduce crumbling once dry.  Used to glue larger, heavier pieces of mud and clay together.

tanbark.name: piece of tanbark
tanbark.description: A sheet of tannin-rich bark from a tree, useful for tanning leather.

birchbark.name: piece of birchbark
birchbark.description: A sheet of tough, water-resistant bark taken from a birch tree.

willowbark.name: piece of willowbark
willowbark.description: A sheet of bark taken from a willow tree.  Used in the production of aspirin.

sassafras_root.name: sassafras root
sassafras_root.description: A root taken from a sassafras tree.  Used in the production of certain sweet beverages.

straw_pile.name: pile of straw
straw_pile.description: A pile of dry grass.  Can be used to craft a straw bed if there is nothing else to sleep on.

straw_doll.name: straw doll
straw_doll.description: An old straw doll, made to look like a woman in a dress.

pillow.name: pillow
pillow.description: A pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.

makeshift_pillow.name: makeshift pillow
makeshift_pillow.description: A pillowcase with straw and other dead plants as filling.  It's better than nothing…  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.

bodypillow.name: body pillow
bodypillow.description: A big, body-sized pillow with a print of an anime character on the front and their scantily-clad version on the back.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.

down_pillow.name: down-filled pillow
down_pillow.description: A fluffy pillow to rest your head on when sleeping.  It is rolled for compact storage and transportation.  You will automatically unroll it when you place it for sleeping.

pouch_autoclave.name: autoclave pouch
pouch_autoclave.description: A medical device that bears the approval of the FDA (Food and Drug Administration).  If used properly, this pouch can keep things sterile indefinitely.

cigar_lit.name: cigar
cigar_lit.description: The smoke billowing from this cigar has a sweet, musty odor.

cigar_butt.name: cigar butt
cigar_butt.description: A true gentleman always finishes his cigars.

cig_lit.name: cigarette
cig_lit.description: Smoke swirls from the lit end of this cigarette, filling the air with the thrilling smell of burning chemicals.

cig_butt.name: cigarette butt
cig_butt.description:
What was once a wonderfully addictive tube of dried tobacco leaf is now just a smelly piece of trash.  What a tragedy!
The leftover tobacco in a few of these could probably be used to roll another cigarette.  If you're willing to go that far…

joint_lit.name: joint
joint_lit.description: The smell of skunk permeates the air as a thin trail of smoke floats off of this joint.

joint_roach.name: joint roach
joint_roach.description:
The smoked-down butt of a joint, a reminder of some good times.  Pretty much trash now.  Bummer, man.
A few of these could probably be used to roll another joint.

cannabis.name: cannabis plant
cannabis.description: A psychoactive plant indigenous to Central Asia and the Indian subcontinent traditionally cultivated for its fiber, oil, for medicinal purposes, and for use as a recreational drug.  It requires further processing to be useful.

tobacco_raw.name: raw tobacco
tobacco_raw.description: Various parts of a tobacco plant, full of nicotine.  They need to be dried to become smokable.

cash_card.name: cash card
cash_card.description: A yellow plastic card used to electronically store money.  It holds up to 2 million dollars.

credit_card.name: credit card
credit_card.description: A plastic card used to purchase goods and services.  It's useless now.

robofac_test_data.name: prototype I/O recorder
robofac_test_data.description: A small, transparent card that was attached to the prototype robot's CPU.  It might contain the data the intercom spoke of.

module_meteorologist.name: drone memory bank
module_meteorologist.description: A memory bank containing the information collected by the meteorologist drone.

gasdiscount_silver.name: silver gas discount card
gasdiscount_silver.description: This card gives you a little discount on the purchase of gasoline.

gasdiscount_gold.name: gold gas discount card
gasdiscount_gold.description: This card gives you a good discount on the purchase of gasoline.

gasdiscount_platinum.name: platinum gas discount card
gasdiscount_platinum.description: This card gives you a splendid discount on the purchase of gasoline.

neoprene.name: neoprene patch
neoprene.description: A small neoprene patch.  Can be used to repair neoprene clothing.

light_bulb.name: light bulb
light_bulb.description: A rather outdated light bulb used in all sorts of lighting equipment.

shrapnel.name: shrapnel
shrapnel.description: A twisted shard of jagged metal.

clay_pot_flower.name: clay flower pot
clay_pot_flower.description: A nice-looking clay pot used for planting.

plastic_pot_flower.name: plastic flower pot
plastic_pot_flower.description: A cheap plastic pot used for planting.

fluid_preserved_brain.name: fluid-preserved brain
fluid_preserved_brain.description: This 3 L jar contains a human brain preserved in a formaldehyde solution.

evaporator_coil.name: evaporator coil
evaporator_coil.description: A set of long, snakelike tubes for evaporating refrigerant.

condensor_coil.name: condensor coil
condensor_coil.description: A compressor and fan that work together to cool down refrigerant.

refrigerant_tank.name: refrigerant tank
refrigerant_tank.description: A small tank containing some sort of refrigerant often used in devices such as freezers.  Hermetically sealed to prevent evaporation - cannot be opened without prior connection to a compatible valve.

hard_steel_armor.name: hard steel plate
hard_steel_armor.description: An armor plate made of very thick steel, specifically engineered for use in a bullet-resistant vest.

steel_armor.name: steel plate
steel_armor.description: A steel armor plate, specifically engineered for use in a bullet-resistant vest.

lock.name: small lock and key
lock.description: A small lock, with its key still inserted.

spare_tire_carrier.name: spare tire carrier
spare_tire_carrier.description: A bumper-mounted rig for attaching and storing a spare tire on the back of a vehicle.  Combine it with a wheel to get a mountable piece.

amplifier_head.name: amplifier head
amplifier_head.description: An amplifier head.  Typically paired with a speaker cabinet for amplifying musical instruments.  Basically only good for spare parts now.

broken_turret.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_secubot_balthazar.name: broken secubot
broken_secubot_balthazar.description: A broken secubot, with its casing broken and fluid drained.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_talon_m202a1.name: broken M202A1 TALON
broken_talon_m202a1.description: A broken TALON UGV, with its casing broken and fluid drained.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_robofac_laserturret_mk1.name: broken laser turret
broken_robofac_laserturret_mk1.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_turret_searchlight.name: broken milspec searchlight
broken_turret_searchlight.description: A broken turret.  Much less threatening now that it's laid limp on solid ground.  Could be gutted for parts.

fire_brick.name: fire brick
fire_brick.description: A reinforced brick designed to withstand intense heat.

salt_lick.name: salt lick
salt_lick.description: A heavy cube-shaped block of salt for livestock.  Don't lick it, it's gross.

alder_bark.name: piece of alder bark
alder_bark.description: A strip of bark pulled from an alder tree.  Used in the production of topical hemostatics.

wallet.name: wallet
wallet.description: A small, flat case used to carry items such as currency, identification documents, and laminated cards.

wallet_duct_tape.name: duct tape wallet
wallet_duct_tape.description: A wallet made entirely out of duct tape.

wallet_large.name: large wallet
wallet_large.description: A flat case used to carry items such as currency, identification documents, laminated cards, and other small items.

wallet_stylish.name: stylish wallet
wallet_stylish.description: A stylish flat case used to carry items such as currency, identification documents, laminated cards, and other small items.

wallet_travel.name: travel wallet
wallet_travel.description: A flat case with a neck strap, used to carry items such as currency, identification documents, laminated cards, and other small items.

lanyard.name: lanyard
lanyard.description: A flat, clear plastic sleeve for identification documents, laminated cards, and other small items.  It has a neck strap attached.

broken_tazer_hack.name: broken taser hack
broken_tazer_hack.description: A broken taser hack, with its propellers still and taser inert.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_lab_security_drone_GM.name: broken green maintenance security drone
broken_lab_security_drone_GM.description: A broken security drone, with its propellers still and camera inert.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_lab_security_drone_YM.name: broken yellow maintenance security drone
broken_lab_security_drone_YM.description: A broken security drone, with its propellers still and camera inert.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_lab_security_drone_BM.name: broken blue maintenance security drone
broken_lab_security_drone_BM.description: A broken security drone, with its propellers still and camera inert.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_lab_security_drone_BM2.name: broken blue maintenance security drone
broken_lab_security_drone_BM2.description: A broken security drone, with its propellers still and camera inert.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_lab_security_drone_GR.name: broken green research security drone
broken_lab_security_drone_GR.description: A broken security drone, with its propellers still and camera inert.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_lab_security_drone_BS.name: broken black security drone
broken_lab_security_drone_BS.description: A broken security drone, with its propellers still and camera inert.  Could be gutted for parts.

parachute_mil.name: military parachute
parachute_mil.description: This is a big, bulky military-level parachute, designed to slow the fall of up to a thousand kilograms of cargo dropped from an aircraft.  You have no clue how to put all the straps back in their place.

pallet.name: wooden pallet
pallet.description: This is a heavy and bulky 40x48 inch pallet.

training_dummy_light.name: training dummy
training_dummy_light.description: A hand-made humanoid figure, useful for training in close quarters combat.  This one is made from wood and has some duct tape to mark the striking points.  Use the construction menu (* by default) to embed it into the ground for training.

training_dummy_heavy.name: armored training dummy
training_dummy_heavy.description: A hand-made humanoid figure, useful for training in close quarters combat.  This one is covered in scrap armor and looks on guard.  Use the construction menu (* by default) to embed it into the ground for training.

archery_target_box.name: box archery target
archery_target_box.description: A soft target for archery, consisting of tightly-packed cloth stuffed into a cardboard box, with a bullseye marked on the front.  Must be set up in the construction menu (* by default) to use.

cash_register.name: cash register
cash_register.description: An electronic device for registering and calculating sales transactions.  It doesn't seem to be working.

helmet_mounting_brackets.name: helmet mounting brackets
helmet_mounting_brackets.description: An assortment of mounting brackets designed to allow stuff such as NV goggles or flashlights to be mounted to army helmets.  These can be attached to other types of helmets, providing it's properly modified.

exodii_chop_shop_head.name: broken red robotic head
exodii_chop_shop_head.description: The broken metal head and partial neck of some sort of robot.  It would almost resemble a helmet, as several parts of the "face" are open, allowing one to glance inside, only to find a hollow shell, stained by blood and oil.  A frayed metal spinal cord of wires and tubes hangs from the "neck."

glock_29.name: compact Glock pistol
glock_29.description: A small pistol accepting Glock magazines and chambered in 10mm.  Because of its size, it is easy to carry, but it has rather fierce recoil.

glock_20.name: Glock pistol
glock_20.description: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm which accepts Glock magazines.

glock_40.name: hunter Glock pistol
glock_40.description: A full-sized, long-slide version of the highly successful Glock, chambered in hard-hitting 10mm Auto.  The extra barrel length makes for slightly more accurate and powerful shots, and the extra slide length means the sights are a little easier to use.  It also features Glock's Modular Optic System, making aftermarket optics much easier to mount.

m1911_10.name: Colt Delta Elite pistol
m1911_10.description: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm.  It accepts Colt Delta Elite magazines.

witness_10.name: EAA Witness pistol
witness_10.description: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm and accepting EAA Witness magazines.

p220_10.name: SIG pistol
p220_10.description: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm and accepting SIG magazines.

xd_10.name: XD-M pistol
xd_10.description: A semi-automatic pistol chambered in 10mm and accepting XD-M magazines.

hk_g80.name: H&K G80 railgun
hk_g80.description: A highly advanced infantry weapon that magnetically propels a ferromagnetic projectile using an alternating current.  Markings and serials imply it was manufactured by Heckler & Koch, but the maturity of the implemented technologies makes such a claim suspect.  Powered by UPS.

mossberg_500_20.name: 5-round hunting shotgun, 20 gauge
mossberg_500_20.description: Classic all-purpose shotgun, adapted to use 20 bore shells.  While being somewhat weaker than classic 12 bore, 26 inch of barrel length allow it to kick reasonable punch, without being as heavy as it's bigger brothers.

remington_870_20.name: 4-round hunting shotgun, 20 gauge
remington_870_20.description: The most widely recognizable pump shotgun frame ever created.  When tv shows or movies picked a shotgun for civilian use, this or a replica like it were the most commonly used.  It comes in many shell sizes, this one is for 20 bore shells.

savage_model_220.name: bolt-action shotgun, 20 gauge
savage_model_220.description: Child of Massachusetts gunmakers, this is a rifled bolt-action shotgun, designed mainly to be used with slugs, with two round detachable magazine.  Using it for anything but a casual hunting would be a challenge of it's own.

browning_citori_20.name: double-barreled shotgun, 20 gauge
browning_citori_20.description: Manufactured in Japan, this 28 inch over-under double-barreled shotgun, loaded with 20 bore shells, is a classy tool to hunt a deer and to kill a man.

marlin_9a.name: high capacity small game lever-action rifle
marlin_9a.description: A venerable .22 caliber lever-action rifle, with a 19-round tube magazine and a classic design that dates back over a century.  Generally used for the hunting of small game like rabbits, the strict taxonomic classification of zombies as 'small game' is debatable, but this decades-old weapon can still be counted upon to help manage the undead population.
marlin_9a.name_plural: high capacity small game lever-action rifles

rifle_22.name: .22 pipe rifle
rifle_22.description: A homemade rifle.  While it is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds, this single-shot rifle can still kill.

ruger_1022.name: varmint rifle
ruger_1022.description: A lightweight and modular pistol caliber hunting carbine, firing the low power .22 LR cartridge.  Before the Cataclysm, a mix of high customizability, cheap ammunition, and low recoil made this a very popular rifle among civilian shooters.

ruger_1022_auto.name: full-auto varmint rifle
ruger_1022_auto.description: A handy and lightweight rifle, modified to fire semi and full auto.

ruger_lcr_22.name: .22 caliber revolver
ruger_lcr_22.description: A comparatively dainty revolver, chambered for 8 tiny rounds of .22 LR.

sig_mosquito.name: Firefly training pistol
sig_mosquito.description: A medium sized, .22 caliber semi-automatic pistol, for training with a pistol similar to more powerful pistols.  Built from aluminum and polymer components, the weapon is lightweight and concealable, but its chambering is not very powerful.

walther_p22.name: Walther training pistol
walther_p22.description: A dainty training pistol offered by the Walther Arms company, making use of the .22 LR cartridge, for training on a pistol very similar to more powerful pistols.

ruger_mk4.name: Ruger target pistol
ruger_mk4.description: A light and handy .22 LR handgun from Ruger, this handgun is one of the most popular .22 handguns ever created.

rossi_gallery.name: pump action varmint rifle
rossi_gallery.description: A lightweight, wood framed pump action rifle, holding 15 rounds of .22 with an 18 inch barrel.  While pump actions tend to be largely shotguns, they can be made in calibers such as .22 LR.

rough_rider_pistol.name: .22 six-shooter
rough_rider_pistol.description: A revolver chambered in .22 LR, with 6 shots and a 6.5 inch barrel.

rough_rider_pistol_9.name: large .22 six-shooter
rough_rider_pistol_9.description: A revolver chambered in .22 LR, with 6 shots and a 9 inch barrel.

1911_22.name: .22 1911 pistol
1911_22.description: A 1911 in .22 LR, with a 4 1/4" barrel, and feeding from 10 round magazines.

rio_bravo.name: small game lever-action rifle
rio_bravo.description: A .22 Long Rifle lever-action rifle, which holds 15 rounds of ammo.  While quite useful against small game, its effectiveness isn't as great against the undead.

henry_golden_boy.name: small game lever-action rifle
henry_golden_boy.description: A .22 Long Rifle lever-action rifle, which holds 16 rounds of ammo.  While quite useful against small game, its effectiveness isn't as great against the undead.

marlin60.name: tube fed varmint rifle
marlin60.description: A lightweight and modular pistol caliber hunting carbine, firing the low power .22 LR cartridge.  Before the Cataclysm, a mix of high customizability, cheap ammunition, and low recoil made this a very popular varmint rifle among civilian shooters.

sw617.name: high capacity revolver
sw617.description: A revolver chambered in .22 LR, with 10 shots and a 6 inch barrel.

sr22.name: .22 plinking handgun
sr22.description: A small handgun with a short barrel.  Feeds from 10 round magazines.

glock_44.name: Glock 44 pistol
glock_44.description: A Glock chambered in .22 LR.  While effective against paper targets and rodents, it will struggle against the walking dead.

savage_rascal.name: small game single shot rifle
savage_rascal.description: A .22 Long Rifle rifle that chambers just one shot.  Its main use is for the youth, and not much else.  God help you if you hope to use this thing to a meaningful effect.

mp_15_22.name: modern varmint rifle
mp_15_22.description: Resembling a military rifle, this firearm is made from polymer.  Despite its looks, it only shoots .22 LR in a semi-automatic fashion.

modular_ar15.name: AR-15
modular_ar15.description: This ubiquitous rifle is the forefather of the M16 rifle series.  It is lightweight and accurate, but will malfunction if not properly maintained.  This one is a semi-automatic civilian version.

modular_ar_pistol.name: AR "pistol"
modular_ar_pistol.description: The common AR-15 platform, with its stock removed and buffer tube covered by a thick, padded sleeve that allows the user to brace it like a rifle.  AR pistols lack stocks, or have arm braces due to restrictions on short barreled rifles, and so without a stock, they're legally classified as a pistol.

modular_m27_assault_rifle.name: M27 assault rifle
modular_m27_assault_rifle.description: Designed to replace the M4 Carbine, the M27 assault rifle features most of the former's strengths, while being considerably more durable.  It is chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO and accepts STANAG magazines.

scar_l.name: FN SCAR-L
scar_l.description: A highly accurate and modular assault rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  The 'L' in its name stands for light, as it uses the lightweight 5.56 NATO round.

scar_16s.name: civilian FN SCAR-L rifle
scar_16s.description: A highly accurate and modular rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command, in semi-auto only to be sold on the civilian market.

sl8.name: SL8 civilian rifle
sl8.description: A semi-automatic clone of an older German assault rifle.  Due to importation bans, it is semi-auto and can only feed from 10 round magazines.

m249.name: M249 machine gun
m249.description: The M249 is a mountable machine gun used by the US military and SWAT teams.  While quite inaccurate and difficult to control, the M249 is designed to fire many rounds very quickly.

m249_semi.name: M249S machine gun
m249_semi.description: This is a semi-automatic civilian variant of the M249 machine gun, manufactured for sport shooting and collectors market.  Notably, it retains the ability to be belt fed, an uncommon feature in civilian firearms.

modular_m4_carbine.name: M4 carbine
modular_m4_carbine.description: A popular carbine, long used by the US military.  Although accurate, small and lightweight, it is infamous for its unreliability when not properly maintained.  It is chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO and accepts STANAG magazines.

modular_m16a4.name: M16 burst rifle
modular_m16a4.description: The M16 is a common assault rifle descended from the AR-15, used by militaries across the world for over 50 years.  It fires in three round bursts, ensuring the rifle is more accurate, but at the cost of being slower than other assault rifles.  It is chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO rounds, and accepts STANAG magazines.

modular_m16_auto_rifle.name: M16 auto rifle
modular_m16_auto_rifle.description: The M16 is a very common assault rifle descended from the AR-15, used by militaries across the world for over 50 years.  Unlike its more common brother, the M16 burst rifle, this one has full-auto capabilities.  It is chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO and accepts STANAG magazines.

ruger_mini.name: Ruger Mini-14 carbine
ruger_mini.description: A small, lightweight semi-auto carbine designed for civilian and police use.  Its superb accuracy and low recoil makes it more suitable than full-auto rifles for some situations.

sig_assault_rifle.name: SIG civilian rifle
sig_assault_rifle.description: A civilian variant of an automatic Swiss rifle for military service.  Accepts 5.56x45mm NATO STANAG magazines.

steyr_aug.name: AUG assault rifle
steyr_aug.description: An assault rifle chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO and accepting AUG magazines

ak556.name: ZPAP AK-style rifle
ak556.description: A civilian AK pattern rifle, chambered in 5.56x45 NATO.

mdrx.name: Desert Tech bullpup carbine
mdrx.description: Produced by the Desert Tech gun company, this is a highly modular, semi-automatic rifle of remarkably modest dimensions.  The weapon is notable for the simplicity of converting it to fire a wide number of different cartridges, with retool kits for .223 Remington, .308 Winchester, and .300 AAC Blackout being available.

bren2_556.name: Bren 5.56x45mm carbine
bren2_556.description: A semi-automatic clone of the Czech Republic's standard infantry carbine, sold for civilian sport shooting and recreational use, this modular rifle makes use of the standard magazines of the AR-15 platform and a 5.56x45mm NATO cartridge.

rdb_223.name: 5.56x45mm bullpup rifle
rdb_223.description: This is a semi-automatic bullpup rifle with a lightened body due to the use of polymers and aluminum, using standard magazines of the AR-15 platform and a 5.56x45mm NATO cartridge.

iwi_tavor_x95_300blk.name: IWI Tavor X95
iwi_tavor_x95_300blk.description: The Tavor is an Israeli series of bullpup rifles designed and produced by Israel Weapon Industries.  This is the Tavor X95, a civilian-legal rifle lacking any full-auto capability, and sporting a 16.5" barrel.  Chambered in 5.56x45mm NATO, this rifle feeds from STANAG magazines.

mp_15.name: sporter AR rifle
mp_15.description: A lightweight AR-15 platform rifle, capable of feeding standard AR magazines.  Unlike the military versions, it has no threaded barrel or collapsing stock.

remington700_270.name: bolt-action hunting rifle
remington700_270.description: Featuring a handsome set of wooden furnishings, a classic design, and a no nonsense .270 caliber chambering, this is a powerful hunting rifle.  With a tried and proven pedigree dating back over 60 years, millions of such rugged arms have been made, exported, and used throughout the United States and the world at large.  Where hunting is concerned, this is a highly capable and well proven weapon in all respects.  Fortunate, given that your prey in these dark days may turn out to be a little bit more feisty than typical White-Tailed deer, moose, and black bears.

m2010.name: M2010 ESR
m2010.description: A bolt-action, box-magazine-fed sniper rifle chambered in the powerful .300 Winchester Magnum round.  The M2010 had completely replaced the M24 rifle series by 2017.

weatherby_5.name: Weatherby Mark V
weatherby_5.description: The Weatherby Mark V is one of the world's finest bolt-action rifles.  Designed in 1955 by Roy Weatherby and Fred Jennie, it has a strong action designed to safely fire high-pressure cartridges.  These rifles were presented to celebrities as part of a marketing campaign.

win70.name: Winchester Model 70
win70.description: The Winchester Model 70 is a bolt-action sporting rifle.  It has an iconic place in American sporting culture and has been held in high regard by shooters since it was introduced in 1936.

ruger_pr.name: Ruger Precision Rifle
ruger_pr.description: Originally introduced to the Ruger gun corporation's family of high-end marksman rifles in 2015, the Ruger Precision Rifle is a modern and highly modular long-range bolt-action weapon.  By incorporating a unique in-line recoil path that manages recoil from the rear of the receiver to the buttstock, as opposed to traditional bedding, the rifle offers maximal accuracy potential, while the arm's additional bells and whistles, an incorporated marksman's trigger, muzzle brake, and this particular rifle's powerhouse chambering of .300 Win Mag, help to make the most from any long-range engagement.

browning_blr.name: BLR lever-action hunting rifle
browning_blr.description: A highly accurate lever-action hunting rifle chambered for the powerful .30-06 round.  Notable for using a detachable magazine instead of a traditional tube.

garand.name: Garand battle rifle
garand.description: A semi-automatic .30-06 battle rifle, developed to replace the M1903 Springfield.  It didn't completely supplant the older bolt-action until after World War II.

m1903.name: Springfield rifle
m1903.description: A powerful military rifle chambered in .30-06, developed to replace the US Army's older Krag rifle.  It served as the main American rifle in World War I, was used alongside the M1 Garand in World War II, and was used as a sniper rifle as late as the Vietnam War.

m1918.name: BAR rifle
m1918.description: This heavy rifle was designed near the end of World War I, and provided fire support for the US Army from World War II all the way to the Vietnam War.  Too much firepower to serve as a battle rifle, but not enough to be an ideal light machine gun, it still found a niche on the battlefield.

remington_700.name: Remington 700 .30-06 rifle
remington_700.description: A very popular and durable hunting or sniping rifle.  Popular among SWAT and US Marine snipers.  Highly damaging, but perhaps not as accurate as the competing Browning BLR.

ruger_m77.name: Ruger Guide rifle
ruger_m77.description: This is a popular and sturdy long-range rifle that has been in production by the Ruger gun company for several decades.  Using a bolt-action feed system, the rifle features a four round capacity of .30-06 cartridges and has the capability to dispatch said rounds with a level of accuracy that would make comparable hunting rifles blush.

sig_mcx_rattler_sbr.name: SIG MCX Rattler SBR
sig_mcx_rattler_sbr.description: A gas-operated rifle, with a short 5.5 inch barrel, built-in thin folding stock, and full rail mount on the upper receiver.  This particular one is a select-fire military version.

smle_mk3.name: Enfield battle rifle
smle_mk3.description: An iconic weapon of both the First and Second World Wars, this bolt-action rifle has seen deployment in the hands of Commonwealth troops across Europe and beyond.  Firing the .303-caliber cartridge and making use of 10-round Enfield magazines, the firearm's reputation precedes it.

number4_mki.name: updated Enfield rifle
number4_mki.description: An evolution of Britain's First World War battle rifle, this bolt-action firearm uses the same .303-caliber cartridge as its forerunner.  Much beloved across the globe by collectors, rifles like this served as England's infantry rifle well into the 1950s, with a specialized sniper variant remaining in service until the early nineties.

winchester_94_3030.name: 8-shot lever-action rifle
winchester_94_3030.description: A lever action rifle, chambered for 8 rounds of 30-30 Winchester.  Ideally used with a cowboy hat and six-shooter.

marlin_336_3030.name: 6-shot lever-action rifle
marlin_336_3030.description: A lever action rifle, chambered for 6 rounds of 30-30 Winchester.  Ideally used with a cowboy hat and six-shooter.

fn_fal_semi.name: Belgian battle rifle
fn_fal_semi.description: Originally designed during the Cold War, this gun is probably the most successful battle rifle ever designed.  Despite being labeled as obsolete, its tunable gas system ensures both reliability and low recoil, allowing it to keep up even among modern competitors.  This is a semi-automatic clone built by a domestic manufacturer.

hk_g3.name: G3 battle rifle
hk_g3.description: A semi-automatic, domestically produced clone of an early battle rifle developed after the end of WWII.  Known as the PTR 91, it is a fantastically reliable, cheap to produce rifle that continues to serve in conflict regions.  Though the action is legendary, its handling characteristics and harsher recoil leave something to be desired.

m134.name: M134D-H Minigun
m134.description: The M134D-H Minigun is a (relatively) lightweight heavy rotary machine gun.  Its six barrels are rotated by an electric motor, powered by UPS or vehicle.  If you could find enough ammo for it, it would become a devastating weapon.  It must be mounted on a vehicle before use.

m14ebr.name: M14 EBR-RI rifle
m14ebr.description: A highly modified version of the M14 rifle designed to cover both CQB and designated marksman roles.  A very powerful and versatile rifle, if somewhat heavy.

m1a.name: American battle rifle
m1a.description: This civilian variant of an American battle rifle is essentially a rifle from World War 2 with a detachable magazine stuck in it that was sold to the military as a cheap, do-all rifle that could replace many other weapon systems.  While it delivered none of those things, it was an acceptable rifle, if marginally inferior to its contemporaries.

m240.name: M240 machine gun
m240.description: The M240 is a medium machine gun used by the US military, replacing the older M60.  Quite inaccurate and difficult to control, the M240 is designed to fire many rounds very quickly.

m60.name: M60 machine gun
m60.description: The M60 is a general-purpose machine gun developed to replace the .30-caliber M1918 and M1919.  Heavy and difficult to handle fired from the shoulder, as most people aren't action-movie heroes.

m60_semi.name: M60 semi auto machine gun
m60_semi.description: A semi-automatic civilian variant of the M60 machine gun, retaining the ability to be belt fed, an uncommon feature in civilian firearms.

scar_h.name: FN SCAR-H rifle
scar_h.description: A highly accurate and modular battle rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  The 'H' in its name stands for heavy, as it uses the powerful .308 round.

scar_h_mk20.name: FN SCAR-H sniper rifle
scar_h_mk20.description: Sniper Support Rifle, this semi-auto variant of SCAR-H is designed for a long-range precision application, to be used by dedicated marksman.  Includes extended barrel, bipod, and a few additional attachment for greater comfort of a user.

scar_17s.name: civilian FN SCAR-H rifle
scar_17s.description: A highly accurate and modular battle rifle specially designed for the United States Special Operations Command.  This one is a civilian model, limited to semi-auto.

M24.name: M24 rifle
M24.description: The M24 Sniper is the military and police version of the Remington Model 700 rifle, M24 being the model name assigned by the United States Army after adoption as their standard sniper rifle in 1988.  The M24 is referred to as a 'weapon system' because it consists of not only a rifle, but also a detachable telescopic sight and other accessories.

hk417_13.name: HK417 rifle
hk417_13.description: A German battle rifle with a 13" barrel and telescopic stock.  It is a gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle with a short-stroke piston design similar to that of the G36.

m110a1.name: HK417 marksman's rifle
m110a1.description: A gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle accurate to 1.5 MOA with standard ammunition, and featuring an aluminum upper receiver for reduced weight.

ak308.name: PAP AK-style rifle
ak308.description: A civilian AK pattern rifle, chambered in 7.62x51mm NATO.

ar10.name: AR-10 rifle
ar10.description: Somewhat similar to the later AR-15, the AR-10 is a gas-operated, rotating bolt rifle chambered for 7.62x51mm rounds.

rfb_308.name: 7.62x51mm bullpup rifle
rfb_308.description: This is a semi-automatic bullpup rifle with a lightened body due to the use of polymers and aluminum, using standard magazines of the heavy automatic rifle and a 7.62x51mm cartridge.

steyr_scout.name: scout rifle
steyr_scout.description: This is a versatile, all-purpose hunting rifle.  To this end, it is exceedingly lightweight, contains an inbuilt polymer bipod, and fits a spare magazine inside the stock for fast reloading.  While these features made for a hunting rifle too universal for widespread adoption, they might yet fulfill a vital scouting niche for survivors in the post-Cataclysm world.

remington_700_308.name: hunting rifle
remington_700_308.description: A very accurate rifle chambered for the powerful .308 round.

m1carbine.name: M1 carbine
m1carbine.description: A light rifle developed during the Second World War to provide a less cumbersome weapon for soldiers that didn't need the firepower of the M1 Garand.  Firing the .30 Carbine cartridge, it provides more firepower than a pistol and is easier to carry than most other rifles.

m2carbine.name: M2 carbine
m2carbine.description: An improved version of the M1 carbine offering full-auto capability, the M2 carbine was rare and coveted among collectors even before the world ended.  Takes M1 carbine magazines.

walther_ppk.name: Walther PPK pistol
walther_ppk.description: One of the most famous handguns of the 20th century.  Your name is not Bond, but you might find this little gun still useful.

lws32.name: micro conceal carry pistol
lws32.description: A very small pistol chambered in .32 ACP.  Due to its intended role, it lacks any sights.

tac338.name: AI bolt-action sniper rifle
tac338.description: A high-precision bolt-action sniper rifle, in service with special operations members of the US Navy prior to the Cataclysm.  Firing the powerful .338 Lapua cartridge, the weapon feeds from detachable five round Accuracy International magazines.

savage112.name: single-shot target rifle
savage112.description: A bolt-action precision rifle with the potential for impressive accuracy, this particular weapon makes use of the powerful .338 Lapua cartridge and is decked in a handsome set of wooden furniture, providing the rifle with a classical mystique.  Unfortunately, the weapon's single-round magazine and a lack of factory iron sights, which makes target acquisition an exercise in futility unless a gunsight is installed, make the rifle limited in its post-Cataclysm utility.

mrad_smr.name: Barrett precision rifle
mrad_smr.description: A box magazine-fed bolt-action precision rifle developed by the Barrett Arms Company, firing the .338 Lapua cartridge.  A civilian copy of more versatile military weapons, this rifle is a remarkably well-crafted piece of anti-personnel engineering despite lacking the sheer modularity of its Marshal sister, and is still capable of engaging targets at extreme distances.

axmc.name: modular sniper rifle
axmc.description: A weapon platform that prides itself on modularity and customizability, this highly accurate precision rifle may be configured with various caliber conversion kits that can allow it to fire either the .338 Lapua, .300 Win Mag, or .308 Winchester cartridges.  The rifle's size prevents it from being a particularly mobile piece of equipment, but the weapon's folding buttstock aids in portability.

p226_357sig.name: SIG P226
p226_357sig.description: A SIG Sauer P226 chambered for .357 SIG.  The P226 is a DA/SA, short-recoil operated semi-automatic pistol.

p320_357sig.name: SIG P320 Compact
p320_357sig.description: The P320 Compact is a semi-automatic, short recoil operated pistol.  This one is chambered for .357 SIG.

colt_navy.name: civil war six-shooter
colt_navy.description: The Colt Model 1861 Navy cap & ball .36-caliber revolver was a six-shot, single-action percussion weapon produced by Colt's Manufacturing Company from 1861 until 1873.

2_shot_special.name: double barrel .38 pistol
2_shot_special.description: A crudely made double barrel pistol firing .38 Special ammo.  Unfortunately, the name is less about the double barrels and more about the number of shots you'll get before it breaks down on you.

model_10_revolver.name: six-shooter
model_10_revolver.description: A six-shot revolver, produced since 1899 and known as the most popular handgun of the 20th century.  It has a swing-out cylinder for ease of reloading.

rifle_38.name: .38 Special pipe rifle
rifle_38.description: A home-made rifle.  It is simply a pipe attached to a stock, with a hammer to strike the single round it holds.

ruger_lcr_38.name: conceal-carry five-shooter
ruger_lcr_38.description: A compact, double-action-only revolver designed for easy concealment, with a stainless steel cylinder and aluminum frame.

colt_python.name: classic .357 revolver
