retool_ar15_50beowulf_medium.description: This is a complete upper receiver assembly containing a barrel, handguard, and bolt carrier group that is installable upon an AR-15-style rifle's lower frame.  Swappable uppers enable compatible firearms to be retooled for different cartridges and barrel lengths, with this kit furnishing a weapon with a big-bore 16-inch barrel chambered for .50 Beowulf rounds.  Specialized or modified STANAG-style magazines are required to properly feed the much larger cartridges.

retool_ar15_50beowulf_short.name: SBR 12.7x42mm upper receiver
retool_ar15_50beowulf_short.description: This is a complete upper receiver assembly containing a barrel, handguard, and bolt carrier group that is installable upon an AR-15-style rifle's lower frame.  Swappable uppers enable compatible firearms to be retooled for different cartridges and barrel lengths, with this kit furnishing a weapon with a big-bore 7.5-inch barrel chambered for .50 Beowulf rounds.  Specialized or modified STANAG-style magazines are required to properly feed the much larger cartridges.

retool_ar15_450.name: rifle .450 upper receiver
retool_ar15_450.description: This is a complete upper receiver assembly containing a barrel, handguard, and bolt carrier group that is installable upon an AR-15-style rifle's lower frame.  Swappable uppers enable compatible firearms to be retooled for different cartridges and barrel lengths, with this kit furnishing a weapon with a high-caliber 18-inch barrel chambered for .450 Bushmaster cartridges.  Special-purpose low-capacity magazines are required to feed the large rounds, but the upper turns any AR-15 into a short-range powerhouse.

retool_ar15_450_medium.name: CQB .450 upper receiver
retool_ar15_450_medium.description: This is a complete upper receiver assembly containing a barrel, handguard, and bolt carrier group that, given the right knowledge, is installable upon an AR-15-style rifle's lower frame.  Swappable uppers enable compatible firearms to be retooled for different cartridges and barrel lengths, with this kit furnishing a weapon with a high-caliber 10.5-inch barrel chambered for .450 Bushmaster cartridges.  Special-purpose low-capacity magazines are required to feed the large rounds, but the upper turns any AR-15 into a short-range powerhouse.

retool_ar15_450_short.name: SBR .450 upper receiver
retool_ar15_450_short.description: This is a complete upper receiver assembly containing a barrel, handguard, and bolt carrier group that, given the right knowledge, is installable upon an AR-15-style rifle's lower frame.  Swappable uppers enable compatible firearms to be retooled for different cartridges and barrel lengths, with this kit furnishing a weapon with a high-caliber 7.5-inch barrel chambered for .450 Bushmaster cartridges.  Special-purpose low-capacity magazines are required to feed the large rounds, but the upper turns any AR-15 into a short-range powerhouse.

retool_ar15_762.name: 7.62x39mm upper receiver
retool_ar15_762.description: This is a complete upper receiver assembly containing a 16-inch barrel, handguard, and bolt carrier group that, given the right knowledge, is installable upon an AR-15-style rifle's lower frame.  Swappable uppers allow compatible firearms to be retooled for different cartridges and barrel lengths, with this kit bringing to life the dreams of users wishing to feed capitalism's rifle with communist lead.  Necessitating a proprietary magazine to cycle the hefty munitions, you're honestly unsure if this constitutes a brilliant idea, a bastard, or just a paradox.

retool_ar15_22.name: .22 upper receiver
retool_ar15_22.description: This is a complete upper receiver assembly containing a barrel, handguard, and bolt carrier group that, given the right knowledge, is installable upon an AR-15-style rifle's lower frame.  Swappable uppers enable compatible firearms to be retooled for different cartridges and barrel lengths, with this kit furnishing a weapon with a 16-inch barrel chambered for .22 rounds.

retool_mdrx_223rem.name: MDRX .223 extended-assembly
retool_mdrx_223rem.description: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  Bored for .223-caliber munitions and requiring STANAG magazines for feeding, the assembly makes the most from the weapon's bullpup design with a 20-inch barrel configuration, coaxing increased terminal performance from fired rounds.

retool_mdrx_223rem_medium.name: MDRX .223 standard-assembly
retool_mdrx_223rem_medium.description: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  Bored for .223-caliber munitions, the assembly requires STANAG magazines for feeding.

retool_mdrx_223rem_short.name: MDRX .223 MICRON assembly
retool_mdrx_223rem_short.description: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  Bored for .223-caliber munitions and requiring STANAG magazines for feeding, the assembly renders the MDRX into a compact CQB carbine, with an 11.5-inch barrel recessed into the weapon's bullpup layout.

retool_mdrx_300blk.name: MDRX .300BLK standard-assembly
retool_mdrx_300blk.description: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  Bored for .300 AAC Blackout munitions, the assembly requires STANAG magazines for feeding.

retool_mdrx_308win.name: MDRX .308 extended-assembly
retool_mdrx_308win.description: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach, 20-inch barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  chambered for long-range .308 Winchester munitions and requiring AR-10 magazines for feeding, the assembly essentially retools the weapon into a designated marksman's rifle.

retool_mdrx_308win_medium.name: MDRX .308 standard-assembly
retool_mdrx_308win_medium.description: Crowned with a proprietary gas compensator and complemented by a compatible bolt assembly, this is a quick-detach, 16-inch barrel installable within the chassis of a Desert Tech MDRX rifle.  Chambered for long-range .308 Winchester munitions and requiring AR-10 magazines for feeding, the assembly essentially retools the weapon into a designated marksman's rifle.

retool_axmc_338lapua.name: AXMC .338 barrel-assembly
retool_axmc_338lapua.description: This is a specialized 27-inch .338-caliber barrel and bolt face that is installable within the main chassis of an Accuracy International AXMC rifle, converting it to fire the .338 Lapua cartridge.

retool_axmc_300win.name: AXMC .300 barrel-assembly
retool_axmc_300win.description: This is a specialized 24-inch .300-caliber barrel and bolt face that is installable within the main chassis of an Accuracy International AXMC rifle, converting it to fire the .300 Winchester Magnum cartridge.

retool_axmc_308win.name: AXMC .308 barrel-assembly
retool_axmc_308win.description: This is a specialized 24-inch .308-caliber barrel and bolt face that is installable within the main chassis of an Accuracy International AXMC rifle, converting it to fire the .308 Winchester cartridge.

retool_deagle_357.name: Desert Eagle .357 conversion kit
retool_deagle_357.description: This is a caliber conversion for a Desert Eagle pistol, allowing it to shoot .357 Magnum ammunition.  It includes the barrel and the reduced-diameter bolt.  Don't forget the .357 magazine!

retool_deagle_44.name: Desert Eagle .44 conversion kit
retool_deagle_44.description: This is a caliber conversion for a Desert Eagle pistol, allowing it to shoot .44 Magnum ammunition.  It includes the barrel, sporting an integral muzzle brake, and the standard-diameter bolt.  Don't forget the .44 magazine!

retool_deagle_50.name: Desert Eagle .50 conversion kit
retool_deagle_50.description: This is a caliber conversion for a Desert Eagle pistol, allowing it to shoot the infamous .50 Action Express round.  It includes the barrel, sporting an integral muzzle brake, and the standard-diameter bolt.  Don't forget the .50 magazine!

retool_ump_9.name: UMP 9x19mm conversion kit
retool_ump_9.description: This is a caliber conversion for a UMP sub-machine gun allowing it to shoot 9x19mm ammo.  It includes the barrel and the bolt.  Don't forget the 9mm UMP magazine!

retool_ump_40.name: UMP .40 S&W conversion kit
retool_ump_40.description: This is a caliber conversion for a UMP sub-machine gun allowing it to shoot .40 S&W ammo.  It includes the barrel and the bolt.  Don't forget the .40 UMP magazine!

retool_ump_45.name: UMP .45 ACP conversion kit
retool_ump_45.description: This is a caliber conversion for a UMP sub-machine gun allowing it to shoot .45 ACP ammo.  It includes the barrel and the bolt.  Don't forget the .45 UMP magazine!

staff_sling_grenade_cradle.name: grenade cradle for staff sling
staff_sling_grenade_cradle.description: A larger cradle with a longer sling for fitting to a staff sling to enable it to throw grenades.

beam_scatterer.name: beam scatterer
beam_scatterer.description: A set of optics made to fit on laser weapons, which will diffract the laser beam into several lower powered beams.  This increases point-blank damage, but greatly reduces range.

focusing_lens.name: focusing lens
focusing_lens.description: A set of optics to concentrate the laser beam on a smaller focus point.  This increases range and damage output, but complicates targeting.

electrolaser_conversion.name: electrolaser conversion
electrolaser_conversion.description: A set of high-tech electronics and optics.  Converts a laser pistol into a less-lethal electrolaser capable of stunning targets, at the cost of a decreased damage output and increased power consumption.

effective_emitter.name: effective emitter
effective_emitter.description: A set of electronics to optimize emitter workcycle and increase overall energy efficiency.  Decreases power consumption.

high_density_capacitor.name: high density capacitor
high_density_capacitor.description: A capacitor with a higher energy density.  Increases range and damage at the cost of markedly increased power consumption.

arredondo_chute.name: speedloader chute
arredondo_chute.description: A metal ramp that can be installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  Need modification before attaching.

arredondo_chute_benelli_sa.name: speedloader chute, 4-round waterfowl shotgun
arredondo_chute_benelli_sa.description: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 4-round waterfowl shotgun.

arredondo_chute_remington_870_breacher.name: speedloader chute, 4-round breaching shotgun
arredondo_chute_remington_870_breacher.description: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 4-round breaching shotgun.

arredondo_chute_remington_870.name: speedloader chute, 5-round hunting shotgun
arredondo_chute_remington_870.description: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 5-round hunting shotgun.

arredondo_chute_mossberg_500.name: speedloader chute, 6-round combat shotgun
arredondo_chute_mossberg_500.description: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 6-round combat shotgun.

arredondo_chute_mossberg_930.name: speedloader chute, 8-round auto-loading shotgun
arredondo_chute_mossberg_930.description: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 8-round auto-loading shotgun.

arredondo_chute_mossberg_590.name: speedloader chute, 9-round combat shotgun
arredondo_chute_mossberg_590.description: A metal ramp that is installed near a shotgun's feeding port to index speedloader tubes.  This one is for 9-round combat shotgun.

match_trigger.name: match trigger
match_trigger.description: A precision weighted trigger assembly that slightly improves a firearm's accuracy.

dias.name: drop-in auto sear
dias.description: A vaguely 'U'-shaped piece of metal with a vaguely 'T'-shaped flapper on a pin.  Once tucked into an AR-15's lower receiver, the rifle will become selective fire-capable.  The handcrafted-sear surface isn't as good as actual full-auto parts, so precision and reliability suffer slightly.

llink.name: lightning link
llink.description: Originally designed for the Colt SP-1, this 'reproduction' is intended to convert an AR-15 into a full-auto only rifle.  Once the necessary modifications are made and the link is in place, semi-auto is disabled and full-auto is enabled.  Reliability and precision suffer greatly due to questionable craftsmanship and lack of unobtainium SP-1 parts.

glocksear.name: Glock auto sear plate
glocksear.description: A relatively simple switch or button mechanism that replaces the back plate of a Glock slide, allowing it to function as a select-fire machine pistol.  A highly illegal modification, but the feds are zombie food anyway.  This will fit any standard Glock pistol in 9mm, .40, .45, 10mm, or .357 caliber.

bars.name: balanced recoil system
bars.description: A complex set of parts designed to minimize recoil using a reciprocating counterweight.

m249semi.name: M249 select fire trigger
m249semi.description: A trigger modification that allows the M249 to switch between semi and full automatic modes.

condenser_pristine.name: pristine condenser
condenser_pristine.description: A condenser unit for the Caotel Sr2.2, seemingly in perfect condition.

m240semi.name: M240 select fire trigger
m240semi.description: A trigger modification that allows the M240 to switch between semi and full automatic modes.

rail_mount.name: side mount
rail_mount.description: A plastic mount for attaching a rail accessory, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.

sights_mount.name: sights mount
sights_mount.description: A plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon other than launchers and pistols, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.

sights_mount_launcher.name: launcher sights mount
sights_mount_launcher.description: A plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any launcher, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on rocket launchers.

sights_mount_pistol.name: pistol sights mount
sights_mount_pistol.description: A plastic mount for attaching a sight, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any pistol, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on pocket pistols.

stock_mount.name: replaceable stock kit
stock_mount.description: A kit consisting of various steel parts.  When installed, it will remove the weapon's original fixed stock, install a new stock mount in its place, modify the original stock to fit it and then reattach it to the gun, or simply attach a stock mount if the gun had no stock to start with.  This allows easy installation of any kind of more advanced stocks.

underbarrel_mount.name: bottom mount
underbarrel_mount.description: A plastic mount for attaching an underbarrel accessory, designed to be permanently installed onto almost any weapon, along with some fasteners.  Ideal for bringing out your inner tacticool on older guns.

rail_bayonet_lug.name: rail bayonet mount
rail_bayonet_lug.description: A one-piece mount for attaching a bayonet to a firearm's accessory rail, in case that was a thing you wanted.  Ideal for making newer guns pointier.

compensator.name: compensator
compensator.description: A compensator contains a number of holes or slits to vent some of the exhaust gasses of a gun upwards to reduce muzzle climb, while also increasing noise and bulk slightly.

muzzle_brake.name: muzzle brake
muzzle_brake.description: A muzzle brake redirects exhaust gases to reduce recoil, at the cost of increasing bulk, noise, and reducing accuracy slightly.

crafted_suppressor.name: homemade suppressor
crafted_suppressor.description: A homemade suppressor made from a pipe and improvised wipe media.  For as long as the wipes hold up, it will reduce the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels, as well as slightly reducing recoil and muzzle velocity.  This simple suppressor is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun.

filter_suppressor.name: 'solvent trap' suppressor
filter_suppressor.description: An automotive filter crudely adapted to mate up with a firearm's barrel, creating an illegal, unregistered suppressor.  Good thing there don't seem to be any ATF agents around to arrest you.  While close in design to a real suppressor, it was not designed for the high pressures involved in gunfire and will eventually lose effectiveness.  The filter is large and, when attached, will interfere with your ability to aim down the base sights of the gun.

shot_suppressor.name: shotgun suppressor
shot_suppressor.description: A large suppressor designed to work with shotguns.  It's a lot more complex than a suppressor for a pistol or rifle.

suppressor.name: suppressor
suppressor.description: A suppressor reduces the amount of noise and muzzle flash generated by the report of a firearm.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels.

mp5sd_suppressor.name: MP5SD integral suppressor
mp5sd_suppressor.description: The integrated suppressor for the H&K MP5SD.  Its large expansion chamber decelerates ammunition via several ports in the barrel, rendering most ammo subsonic at the cost of terminal performance.  It is not as effective as modern designs.

suppressor_compact.name: pistol suppressor
suppressor_compact.description: A suppressor designed for pistols, submachine guns, and pistol caliber carbines.  Gunfire is extremely loud and can damage your hearing without protection; a suppressor will bring the loudness of a report down to generally safe levels.

choke.name: choke
choke.description: A choke shapes the spread of a shot cloud to give a shotgun better range and accuracy.

offset_sights.name: offset iron sights
offset_sights.description: An alternative set of iron sights mounted at 45° for use when a scope or other modification prevents use of the primary sights.

offset_sight_rail.name: offset sight rail
offset_sight_rail.description: An additional rail set at 45° for attaching a secondary optic.

rail_laser_sight.name: rail laser sight
rail_laser_sight.description: A small visible-light laser that mounts on a firearm's accessory rail to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.

mipim.name: army flashlight-laser module
mipim.description: Officially designated as Mini Integrated Pointing Illumination Module (MIPIM), also known as AN/PEQ-16, it is a little squarey box, mounted on a firearm side rail, that combines both laser sight and flashlight.

use_action.msg: You turn the module's flashlight on.

mipim_on.name: army flashlight-laser module (on)
mipim_on.description: Officially designated as Mini Integrated Pointing Illumination Module (MIPIM), also known as AN/PEQ-16, it is a little squarey box, mounted on a firearm side rail, that combines both laser sight and flashlight.

use_action.msg: You turn the module's flashlight off.

offset_grip.name: offset grip
offset_grip.description: An angled grip set at 45° that attaches to a side rail, allowing for a grip while leaving the underbarrel rail free, or on guns that have integral bipods.

bow_sight.name: five pin bow sight
bow_sight.description: A set of adjustable optic fiber aiming pins with a bracket to mount on modern bows.  It takes more time to calibrate but can improve accuracy more effectively.

bow_sight_pin.name: single pin bow sight
bow_sight_pin.description: A single aluminum pin with a bracket to mount on modern bows.  Quick to use.

bow_scope.name: bow scope
bow_scope.description: A single magnifying scope mounted on an adjustable bracket, with accompanying clarifier peep sight.  Designed for extra long shots, but easily adjusted for short range.  Spectacularly accurate.

holo_sight.name: holographic sight
holo_sight.description: An advanced optic with an adjustable circular hologram reticle superimposed on the field of view.  Used extensively by military forces, it increases accuracy and weight.  This is a step up from a red dot sight.

improve_sights.name: iron sights
improve_sights.description: A basic set of iron sights.

pistol_scope.name: pistol scope
pistol_scope.description: A small scope intended for use on a handgun.  Increases weight but improves accuracy greatly.

red_dot_sight.name: red dot sight
red_dot_sight.description: A red dot optic meant to be attached to the top of the weapon, replacing the iron sights.  Increases accuracy and weight.

rifle_scope.name: rifle scope
rifle_scope.description: A 3-18x44 rifle scope.  It is adjustable for windage and elevation in 1/10th mrad increments and is remarkably small and light for its magnification.

rifle_scope_high_end_mount.name: high end rifle scope
rifle_scope_high_end_mount.description: A 3-18x44 rifle scope.  It is adjustable for windage and elevation in 1/10th mrad increments and is remarkably small and light for its magnification.  This one has an additional rail on the top of its ring mounts for an additional backup optic.

acog_scope.name: ACOG scope
acog_scope.description: A 4x32 TA01 Advanced Combat Optical Gunsight with a tritium-illuminated crosshair.

holo_magnifier.name: sight magnifier
holo_magnifier.description: A sleek compact 3x magnifier designed to sit behind a modern holographic sight.  Mounted on a lever to quickly flip in and out of the sights picture, the magnifier allows the full functionality of a high end close quarters sight while also allowing you to engage targets at range.

hybrid_sight_4x.name: hybrid ACOG scope
hybrid_sight_4x.description: A high end 4x32 military grade ACOG scope.  This one has additional mounting brackets on top for another sight.

riv_scope.name: RS1219 scope
riv_scope.description: An integral component of the RM11B rifle system, the RS1219 Accipiter digital scope provides auto-adjusting focal length, a user-selectable reticle, and an offset reflex sight for close objectives.

tele_sight.name: telescopic sight
tele_sight.description: A simple hand-crafted telescopic sight, essentially a small telescope with crosshairs.  Not as good as the ones made before the Cataclysm.  Increases weight but improves accuracy.

tele_sight_pistol.name: telescopic pistol sight
tele_sight_pistol.description: A simple telescopic sight intended for use on a handgun.  Increases weight but improves accuracy greatly.

type99_scope.name: Nagoya 99 gun scope
type99_scope.description: A basic and antique 4x rifle optic: essentially a non-adjustable telescopic sight built by the Nagoya Arsenal during the Second World War and issued for mounting on Type 99 sniper rifles.

shoulder_strap_simple.name: two point sling
shoulder_strap_simple.description: A shoulder strap allows the rifle to be worn over a shoulder like a piece of clothing.  However, it offers no protection.

shoulder_strap.name: adjustable sling
shoulder_strap.description: An adjustable strap that allows the rifle to be worn over your shoulders like a piece of clothing.  However, it offers no protection.

use_action.msg: You shift the weapon to the front of your body.

shoulder_strap_front.name: adjustable sling (front)
shoulder_strap_front.description: A shoulder strap allows the rifle to be worn over your shoulders like a piece of clothing.  Currently adjusted so the weapon hangs off your front.

use_action.msg: You shift the weapon to the back of your body.

adjustable_stock.name: adjustable stock
adjustable_stock.description: An adjustable replacement stock improving both recoil and accuracy.

folding_stock.name: folding stock
folding_stock.description: A folding stock which reduces length when folded.  Currently unfolded and ready to shoot.

use_action.msg: You fold the stock for transport.

folding_stock_folded.name: folding stock (folded)
folding_stock_folded.description: A folding stock which reduces length.  Currently folded, making shooting this gun difficult.

use_action.msg: You unfold the stock for combat.

high_end_folding_stock.name: adjustable folding stock
high_end_folding_stock.description: A multi position, high-end folding stock which reduces length when folded.  Currently unfolded and ready to shoot.

use_action.msg: You fold the stock for transport.

high_end_folding_stock_folded.name: adjustable folding stock (folded)
high_end_folding_stock_folded.description: A multi position, high-end folding stock which reduces length when folded.  Currently folded, making shooting this gun hard.

use_action.msg: You unfold the stock for combat.

wire_stock.name: collapsing wire stock
wire_stock.description: A collapsing wire stock which folds closely against the body of the weapon, reducing length and volume.

use_action.msg: You push the stock in for storage.

wire_stock_folded.name: collapsing wire stock (collapsed)
wire_stock_folded.description: A collapsing wire stock which folds closely against the body of the weapon, reducing length and volume.  Currently collapsed, making shooting difficult.

use_action.msg: You pull the stock out for combat.

stock_mauser.name: Mauser C96 stock
stock_mauser.description: The hollow removable wooden pistol stock of the C96 Mauser pistol, which doubles as a holster.  It fits both the original clip-loaded C96 and later magazine-fed reproductions, but a gun with an extended magazine won't fit without modification.

stock_none.name: sawn-off stock
stock_none.description: A quick saw cut removed the original stock from this weapon.  It is now much harder to handle, but much smaller.

pistol_stock.name: pistol stock
pistol_stock.description: An add-on stock for handguns, this considerably improves control of recoil.

recoil_stock.name: recoil stock
recoil_stock.description: A replacement stock designed to absorb perceived recoil.

cheek_pad.name: cheek pad
cheek_pad.description: A stock accessory for sniper rifles and DMRs, this considerably improves eye relief efficiency, prevents slipping, and reduces recoil to the neck and cheek.

butt_hook.name: butt hook
butt_hook.description: An attachment to the butt of the gun that is held under the armpit, improving stability.

tail_hook_stock.name: tail hook stock
tail_hook_stock.description: A foldable add-on stock for handguns and submachine guns with a pivoting hook that latches onto the forearm, allowing for greater stability.

under_folding_stock.name: under folding stock
under_folding_stock.description: A light wire-framed stock with a push button release catch on the side, which allows it to fold and be stored away under the weapon's receiver.  The wire construction means that it's less comfortable to shoulder than a regular fixed attachment.  The stock is currently locked in the open position.

use_action.msg: You push in the release catch on the side and fold away the stock.

under_folding_stock_folded.name: under-folding stock (folded)
under_folding_stock_folded.description: A light wire-framed stock with a push button release catch on the side which allows it to fold and be stored away under the weapon's receiver.  It is currently folded underneath the weapon's chassis, making it more difficult to control.

use_action.msg: You unfold the stock for combat.

sub2000_folding_mechanism.name: integral folding mechanism
sub2000_folding_mechanism.description: The integral series of hinges and pivots which allow the SUB-2000 to fold in half and be stored for transport.  The firearm is currently locked in the unfolded position and is ready for use.

use_action.msg: You tug down on the trigger guard whilst swinging the barrel assembly up and over onto the receiver, locking it into place by the buttplate.

sub2000_folding_mechanism_folded.name: integral folding mechanism (folded))
sub2000_folding_mechanism_folded.description: The integral series of hinges and pivots which allow the SUB-2000 to fold in half and be stored for transport.  Shooting this firearm would be particularly tricky given that the barrel assembly is folded and locked backwards for storage, rendering the weapon inoperable.

use_action.msg: You release the barrel and pivot it forwards, locking it in the open firing position.

m26_mass_stock.name: MASS compatible stock
m26_mass_stock.description: A specially designed adjustable stock with an integrated grip to convert the M26-MASS to a standalone configuration.

scout_stock.name: hollow polymer stock
scout_stock.description: An extremely lightweight stock.  There's a hollow cavity at the bottom where a spare magazine can be stored.

bipod.name: bipod
bipod.description: Bipods are commonly used on rifles and machine guns to provide a forward rest and reduce motion.  Although they greatly improve handling of recoil, they are usable only on certain surfaces (or from the prone position), and are slow to equip.

bipod_handguard.name: bipod hand guard
bipod_handguard.description: Bipods are commonly used on rifles and machine guns to provide a forward rest and reduce motion.  Although they greatly improve handling of recoil, they are usable only on certain surfaces (or from the prone position).  This one is integrated into a high end hand guard, replacing the factory hand guard of your weapon, allowing for comfortable shooting with or without the bipod deployed.  Currently the bipod legs are stowed.

bipod_handguard_deployed.name: bipod hand guard (deployed)
bipod_handguard_deployed.description: Bipods are commonly used on rifles and machine guns to provide a forward rest and reduce motion.  Although they greatly improve handling of recoil, they are usable only on certain surfaces (or from the prone position).  This one is integrated into a high end hand guard, replacing the factory hand guard of your weapon, allowing for comfortable shooting with or without the bipod deployed.  Currently the bipod legs are out and are ready for use.

use_action.msg: You collapse and fold the bipod legs.

modern_handguard.name: high end hand guard
modern_handguard.description: A comfortable, high end hand guard with a set of optional mounts for accessories and equipment.  When installed, this replaces the original factory hand guard for the weapon, cutting down on excessive rails and weight.  This allows for comfortable, controlled firing of the weapon while keeping a sleek profile and avoiding bulky foregrips.

combination_gun_shotgun.name: combination gun shotgun
combination_gun_shotgun.description: The integrated underbarrel shotgun of a combination gun which holds two shots.  It's irremovable.

grip.name: forward grip
grip.description: A grip placed forward on the barrel allows for greater control.  Not as effective as a bipod but usable under all conditions.

grip_mod.name: modified forward grip
grip_mod.description: A grip placed forward on the barrel allows for greater control.  Not as effective as a bipod but usable under all conditions.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon, if you so want.

wooden_grip.name: wood forward grip
wooden_grip.description: A wooden grip placed forward on the barrel allows for greater control.  Not as effective as a bipod but usable under all conditions.  This one was cleverly handmade by a desperate survivor or miserly enthusiast, it cannot be removed after installation.

use_action.msg: You fold in the bayonet.  It can no longer be used.

inter_bayonet_folded.name: integrated bayonet (folded)
inter_bayonet_folded.description: The weapon's integrated bayonet has been folded for storage.

use_action.msg: You fold out the bayonet.  It can be used.

laser_sight.name: underbarrel laser sight
laser_sight.description: A visible-light laser that mounts under a firearm's barrel to enhance ease and speed of target acquisition.  Aside from increased weight, there are no drawbacks.

m203.name: M203A1
m203.description: The M203 was originally designed for use with M16 variants but today can be attached to almost any rifle.  It allows a single 40mm grenade to be loaded and fired.

m203_mod.name: modified M203
m203_mod.description: The M203 was originally designed for use with M16 variants but today can be attached to almost any rifle.  It allows a single 40mm grenade to be loaded and fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns, if you so want.

m320_mod.name: M320 GLM
m320_mod.description: The M320 Grenade Launcher Module offers the functionality of larger launchers in a very small package at the cost of decreased accuracy.  It can be either attached to a rifle or combined with a buttstock for standalone use.

m320_mod_mod.name: modified M320 GLM
m320_mod_mod.description: The M320 Grenade Launcher Module offers the functionality of larger launchers in a very small package at the cost of decreased accuracy.  It can be either attached to a rifle or combined with a buttstock for standalone use.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns, if you so want.

masterkey.name: masterkey shotgun
masterkey.description: A minimalist pump-action shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows a total of four shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.

masterkey_mod.name: modified masterkey shotgun
masterkey_mod.description: A minimalist pump-action shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows a total of four shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns, if you so want.

m26_mass.name: M26-MASS shotgun
m26_mass.description: The Modular Accessory Shotgun System is an underbarrel bolt-action shotgun that was inspired by the "Masterkey" and fixed most of its predecessor's problems.  It can be mounted under the barrel of a rifle, or used as a standalone weapon by attaching a pistol grip or collapsible buttstock module.  It feeds from three- or five-shot detachable magazines.

m26_mass_mod.name: modified M26-MASS
m26_mass_mod.description: The Modular Accessory Shotgun System is an underbarrel bolt-action shotgun that was inspired by the "Masterkey" and fixed most of its predecessor's problems.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols and pump-action guns.

pistol_bayonet.name: pistol bayonet
pistol_bayonet.description: A pistol bayonet is a stabbing weapon that can be attached to the front of a handgun, allowing a melee attack to deal piercing damage.

u_shotgun.name: underslung shotgun
u_shotgun.description: A short shotgun with 2 barrels, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  It allows two shotgun shells to be loaded and fired.

arisaka_monopod.name: wire monopod, collapsed
arisaka_monopod.description: A folding wire monopod designed to attach to a Type 99 Arisaka's front barrel band, intended to give soldiers a stabler platform from which to shoot while prone.  Less effective than an actual bipod and ungainly long, it was largely cut from active issue relatively soon into the Second World War.  This one is currently stowed in the folded position and cannot aid you while firing.

use_action.msg: You flip out the monopod and lock it into position.

arisaka_monopod_deployed.name: wire monopod, deployed
arisaka_monopod_deployed.description: A folding wire monopod designed to attach to a Type 99 Arisaka's front barrel band, intended to give soldiers a stabler platform from which to shoot while prone.  Less effective than an actual bipod and ungainly long, it was largely cut from active issue relatively soon into the Second World War.  This one is currently locked in the unfolded position and will provide a measure of stability while firing.

use_action.msg: You unlock the monopod and stow it in its folded position.

scout_bipod.name: integral polymer bipod
scout_bipod.description: The Steyr Scout's integral bipod is effectively part of the rifle's housing, causing its added weight to practically be zero.  However, the polymer construction and awkward design prevent it from being as useful as a normal bipod.

use_action.msg: You flip the bipod out from the rifle housing and lock it into position.

scout_bipod_deployed.name: integral polymer bipod, deployed
scout_bipod_deployed.description: The Steyr Scout's integral bipod is effectively part of the rifle's housing, causing its added weight to practically be zero.  However, the polymer construction and awkward design prevent it from being as useful as a normal bipod.

use_action.msg: With an ugly snap, you crack the bipod legs back into the rifle.

muzzle_weight.name: muzzle weight
muzzle_weight.description: A small weight attached below the barrel of a firearm to reduce muzzle climb, increasing bulk but allowing for faster follow-up shots.  Mainly used on competition handguns, but it can be added to combat pistols, too.

ree_33_tripod.name: heavy-duty tripod
ree_33_tripod.description: Massive tripod, used by Exodii naval rifle so it can be used by lightweight units, providing firearm support.  Allows using naval rifle while prone.

mounted_flashlight.name: mounted flashlight
mounted_flashlight.description: Precisely manufactured flashlight that can be mounted on any modern gun.  You still can use it without attaching it to anything if you happen to never find a handheld one.

mounted_flashlight_on.name: mounted flashlight (on)
mounted_flashlight_on.description: Precisely manufactured flashlight that can be mounted on any modern gun.  You still can use it without attaching it to anything if you happen to never find a handheld one.

blun_slug.name: blunderbuss slug
blun_slug.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot comprised of a large hunk of metal.  Better for distance than scattershot.

blun_shot.name: blunderbuss scrap shot
blun_shot.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot comprised of miscellaneous metal or stone bits.

blun_lead_shot.name: blunderbuss shot
blun_lead_shot.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot comprised of lead pellets.

blun_flechette.name: blunderbuss flechette
blun_flechette.description: A prepared blunderbuss shot comprised of flechettes or nails.

id_science.name: science ID card
id_science.description: An ID card that once belonged to a scientist.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

id_military.name: military ID card
id_military.description: An ID card that once belonged to a military officer.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

id_industrial.name: industrial ID card
id_industrial.description: An ID card that once belonged to a high-level technician.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at one control panel, if you can find one.

id_artisan_member.name: co-op badge
id_artisan_member.description: A manually-encoded badge giving you access to the artisans' workshop.  It even has your name written on the back.

id_science_visitor_1.name: visitor's pass
id_science_visitor_1.description: A visitor's pass to some sort of facility.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at a card reader, if you can find one.  It also lists the addresses of nearby facilities; activate it to add their locations to your map.

use_action.message: You add the facilities to your map.

id_science_maintenance_green.name: Maintenance: green zone badge
id_science_maintenance_green.description: An employee badge for a maintenance worker.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at green zone card readers.

id_science_maintenance_yellow.name: Maintenance: ocher zone badge
id_science_maintenance_yellow.description: An employee badge for a maintenance worker.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at ocher zone card readers.

id_science_maintenance_blue.name: Maintenance: blue zone badge
id_science_maintenance_blue.description: An employee badge for a maintenance worker.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at blue zone card readers.

id_science_transport_1.name: transport freight employee badge
id_science_transport_1.description: An employee badge for a freight hauler.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at transport freight card readers.  It also lists the addresses of nearby facilities; activate it to add their locations to your map.

use_action.message: You add the facilities to your map.

id_science_security_yellow.name: Security: yellow zone badge
id_science_security_yellow.description: An employee badge for a security officer.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at yellow zone card readers.

id_science_security_magenta.name: Security: magenta zone badge
id_science_security_magenta.description: An employee badge for a security officer.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at magenta zone card readers.

id_science_security_black.name: Security: black zone badge
id_science_security_black.description: An employee badge for a security officer.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at black zone card readers.

id_science_mutagen_green.name: Researcher: light green zone badge
id_science_mutagen_green.description: An employee badge for a research scientist.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at light green zone card readers.

id_science_mutagen_pink.name: Researcher: pink zone badge
id_science_mutagen_pink.description: An employee badge for a research scientist.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at pink zone card readers.

id_science_mutagen_cyan.name: Researcher: cyan zone badge
id_science_mutagen_cyan.description: An employee badge for a research scientist.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at cyan zone card readers.

id_science_medical_red.name: Doctor: red zone badge
id_science_medical_red.description: An employee badge for a medical doctor.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access at red zone card readers.

id_science_mu.name: System supervisor: slate zone badge
id_science_mu.description: An employee badge for a system's supervisor.  The reverse side describes the protocol for using it; this could grant access through white zone card readers.

id_LIXA.name: LIXA ID badge
id_LIXA.description: An ID badge for the LIXA facility, with a photo of an awkwardly smiling scientist on the front.  Instructions on the back explain that this will grant you access to the LIXA experiment floor.

id_LIXA_2.name: defaced LIXA ID badge
id_LIXA_2.description: An ID badge for the LIXA facility, with a photo of an awkwardly smiling scientist on the front.  It is heavily scratched, and there is a line on the back in black marker.

id_LIXA_najma.name: LIXA ID badge: Dr. Najma Saed
id_LIXA_najma.description: An ID badge for the LIXA facility.  The photo is of a pleasantly smiling woman in a hijab.
id_LIXA_najma.name_plural: LIXA ID badges: Dr. Najma Saed

id_LIXA_jason.name: LIXA ID badge: Dr. Jason Mitchell
id_LIXA_jason.description: An ID badge for the LIXA facility.  The photo is of a confidently smiling young man.
id_LIXA_jason.name_plural: LIXA ID badges: Dr. Jason Mitchell

id_LIXA_kai_mei.name: LIXA ID badge: Dr. Kai-Mei Luo
id_LIXA_kai_mei.description: An ID badge for the LIXA facility.  The photo is of an awkwardly smiling woman, who blinked during the picture.
id_LIXA_kai_mei.name_plural: LIXA ID badges: Dr. Kai-Mei Luo

id_LIXA_rich.name: LIXA ID badge: Dr. Richard Raimes
id_LIXA_rich.description: An ID badge for the LIXA facility.  The photo is of a gently smiling older man, with kind eyes.
id_LIXA_rich.name_plural: LIXA ID badges: Dr. Richard Raimes

id_LIXA_mil.name: LIXA military police badge
id_LIXA_mil.description: An id card bearing the name, rank, and serial number of a soldier stationed at LIXA.

warehouse_rebooter.name: Exodii comm rebooter
warehouse_rebooter.description: A small rectangular device that Rubik gave you.  It is meant to be plugged in a locator antenna to reactivate it.

id_anduril_ar.name: Anduril Industries ID card
id_anduril_ar.description: An ID card for an Anduril Industries software engineer.

id_exodii_string_dimension.name: strange plastic key
id_exodii_string_dimension.description: A thick plastic key with an archaic-looking, angled bit.

plastic_jack_o_lantern.name: plastic jack o'lantern
plastic_jack_o_lantern.description: A plastic lantern that is painted to look like a pumpkin with a face.  It has a tiny LED light inside, which is currently off.  It's mostly for seasonal decoration and doesn't provide very much light.

use_action.msg: You flip the switch in the jack-o'-lantern.

plastic_jack_o_lantern_lit.name: spooky plastic jack o'lantern
plastic_jack_o_lantern_lit.description: A plastic lantern that is painted to look like a pumpkin with a face.  It has a tiny LED light inside which is currently on, to delightfully spooky effect.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can stay lit for a very long time.

use_action.msg: The LED winks out inside the lantern.

jackolantern.name: jack-o'-lantern
jackolantern.description: A carved pumpkin with a candle inside it.  You could light it to really set the spooky mood.

jackolantern_lit.name: lit jack-o'-lantern
jackolantern_lit.description: A carved pumpkin with a lit candle inside.  Spooky and festive!

decorative_wreath.name: yule wreath
decorative_wreath.description: A decorative wreath that can be deployed as furniture to celebrate the winter holidays.

inflatable_dragon.name: inflatable dragon
inflatable_dragon.description: A battery-powered inflatable dragon from the Halloween before the end.  It might be fun to display it somewhere.

inflatable_ghost.name: inflatable ghost
inflatable_ghost.description: A battery-powered inflatable ghost from the Halloween before the end.  It might be fun to display it somewhere.

fog_machine.name: fog machine
fog_machine.description: A battery-powered fog machine.  It would be great for setting ambience.

glock_20mag.name: Glock 10mm 15-round magazine
glock_20mag.description: A compact light-weight steel and polymer magazine for use with Glock pistols chambered for 10mm Auto.

glock_20mag_10.name: Glock 10mm 10-round magazine
glock_20mag_10.description: A compact light-weight steel and polymer magazine for use with Glock pistols chambered for 10mm Auto, limited to 10 rounds.

glock_29mag.name: Glock 10mm 10-round carry magazine
glock_29mag.description: A stubby steel and polymer magazine for use with the compact Glock pistol.  It is too short to insert into most other 10mm Glock pattern magwells.

m1911_10mag.name: Colt Delta Elite 8-round magazine
m1911_10mag.description: An 8-round single stack steel box magazine for use in the Colt Delta Elite pistol.

p220_10_mag.name: SIG pistol 10mm 8-round magazine
p220_10_mag.description: An 8-round steel box magazine for the SIG pistol.

tdi_10mm_mag.name: Glock 10mm 30-round magazine
tdi_10mm_mag.description: A 30-round plastic and steel box 10mm Auto magazine for use with Glock pistols and submachine guns chambered in 10mm.

witness_mag_10.name: EAA Witness 15-round magazine
witness_mag_10.description: A 15-round steel box magazine for 10mm Auto EAA Witness pistols.

xd_10_mag.name: XD-M 15-round magazine
xd_10_mag.description: A 15-round steel box magazine for 10mm Auto XD-M pistols.

hk_g80mag.name: H&K G80 20-round magazine
hk_g80mag.description: A magazine for the H&K G80 railgun which can hold up to 20 ferromagnetic projectiles.

22_speedloader8.name: .22 8-round speedloader
22_speedloader8.description: This speedloader can hold 8 rounds of .22 and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

marlin_tubeloader.name: high capacity lever-action rifle tube loader
marlin_tubeloader.description: A tube which holds 19 rounds of .22, designed for quick reloading of a compatible rifle with a tubular magazine.
marlin_tubeloader.name_plural: high capacity lever-action rifle tube loaders

22_ar15mag_10.name: .22 10-round conversion magazine
22_ar15mag_10.description: A black, 10-round polymer magazine for AR-platform rifles converted to fire .22 Long Rifle ammunition.

22_ar15mag_28.name: .22 28-round conversion magazine
22_ar15mag_28.description: A black, 28-round polymer magazine for AR-platform rifles converted to fire .22 Long Rifle ammunition.

mosquitomag.name: Firefly 10-round magazine
mosquitomag.description: A factory specification 10-round magazine for the Firefly pistol.

ruger1022bigmag.name: 25-round varmint magazine
ruger1022bigmag.description: An extended capacity 25-round magazine, for use with .22 caliber varmint rifles.

ruger1022mag.name: 10-round varmint magazine
ruger1022mag.description: A flush fitting 10-round rotary magazine, for use with .22 caliber varmint rifles.

ruger1022mag_15.name: 15-round varmint magazine
ruger1022mag_15.description: An extended capacity 15-round magazine, for use with .22 caliber varmint rifles.

ruger1022mag_30.name: 30-round varmint drum magazine
ruger1022mag_30.description: A 30-round capacity drum magazine for use in varmint rifles.  While the capacity is nothing to scoff at, it is less reliable than stick magazines.

ruger1022mag_32.name: 32-round varmint magazine
ruger1022mag_32.description: An extended capacity 32-round magazine, for use with .22 caliber varmint rifles.

ruger1022mag_55.name: 55-round varmint drum magazine
ruger1022mag_55.description: A 55-round capacity drum magazine for use in varmint rifles.  While the capacity is nothing to scoff at, it is less reliable than stick magazines.

ruger1022mag_70.name: 70-round varmint drum magazine
ruger1022mag_70.description: A 70-round capacity drum magazine for use in varmint rifles.  While the capacity is nothing to scoff at, it is less reliable than stick magazines.

ruger1022mag_110.name: 110-round varmint drum magazine
ruger1022mag_110.description: An 110-round capacity drum magazine for use in varmint rifles.  While the capacity is nothing to scoff at, it is less reliable than stick magazines.

wp22mag.name: .22 10-round Walther magazine
wp22mag.description: A 10-round handgun magazine for use with Walther's .22 caliber pocket pistol.

ruger_mk4_mag.name: Ruger target pistol magazine
ruger_mk4_mag.description: A 10-round magazine for a Ruger target pistol.

sr22_mag.name: .22 plinking handgun magazine
sr22_mag.description: A 10-round magazine for the plinking handgun.

glock44_mag.name: Glock 44 10 round magazine
glock44_mag.description: A compact, light-weight polymer magazine for use with the Glock 44.

mp1522_mag.name: .22 10-round modern varmint rifle magazine
mp1522_mag.description: A black, 10-round polymer magazine for the modern varmint rifle.  It unfortunately is not compatible with AR-15 .22 conversion magazines.

belt223.name: 5.56x45mm ammo belt
belt223.description: An ammo belt consisting of metal linkages which disintegrate upon firing.

ruger5.name: Mini-14 5-round magazine
ruger5.description: A 10-round Mini-14 magazine that has been modified to only hold 5 rounds, commonly used to comply with hunting regulations.

stanag10.name: STANAG 10-round magazine
stanag10.description: A compact 10-round box magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.

stanag10ranger.name: STANAG 10-round magazine with ranger plate
stanag10ranger.description: A compact 10-round box magazine for use with STANAG compatible rifles.  The bottom has been modified with a ranger plate attachment to allow it to clip to carabiners.

ruger10.name: Mini-14 10-round magazine
ruger10.description: A compact 10-round box magazine used with the Ruger Mini-14 rifle.

ruger20.name: Mini-14 20-round magazine
ruger20.description: A 20-round box magazine used with the Ruger Mini-14 rifle.

ruger30.name: Mini-14 30-round magazine

exodiiminimag.name: Exodii zombie hunting rifle magazine
exodiiminimag.description: A small, sleek magazine based on a classic PA md. 71 clip, with some redesigns by the Exodii for better use in lighter-than-air drones.  Its small size is less appropriate for ground-fighting of hordes of zombies, as it is a bit inconvenient to reload.

exodiiBRmag.name: Exodii battle rifle pan magazine
exodiiBRmag.description: An unreasonably large pan magazine for the already heavy PA md. 68 battle rifle.  While the original magazines were double stack box magazines, the PA md. 68 started being pushed into aircraft and vehicle support roles, necessitating a larger pan magazine.

exodiiBRmag_153.name: Exodii battle rifle large pan magazine
exodiiBRmag_153.description: An even more enormous magazine than the 60-round magazine, this beast of a pan magazine boasts a capacity of 153 rounds.  While impressive in capacity, it's reliability is questionable and its portability is nonexistent.  It saw some vehicle use near the end of the 3rd Carpathian war and was a bit further refined after that, but never saw much widescale adoption.  The Exodii however care little about portability, and scraped up every last one they could find.
exodiiBRmag_153.name_plural: Exodii battle rifle large pan magazines

exodiiBRmag_26.name: Exodii battle rifle box magazine
exodiiBRmag_26.description: The original PA md. 68 magazine, a simple straight box magazine.  While usable, the weight of the rifle made it quite unpopular for ground troops, and the low capacity made it not very useful for mounted use.  Large stockpiles of surplus magazines sat around in warehouses before the Exodii scooped them up.  Still not commonly used by the Exodii, but still plentiful and low cost.

exodiisapramag5.name: Sapra '36 magazine
exodiisapramag5.description: A large, five round single stack magazine for the Sapra '36.

exodii_khuunaofaai_mag_firework.name: ordnance cannon celebration canister
exodii_khuunaofaai_mag_firework.description: A pressurized tank containing the original firework payload of the Exodii's own ordnance cannon.  This chemical payload contains two different compounds of copper, so that the projectiles burn a sharp blue and green to represent the united Earth it came from.  It isn't intended for combat, but getting hit by a massive firework is dangerous enough that it was brought along.  The tank capacity is larger than the other loads the Exodii created for it.

exodii_khuunaofaai_mag_incendiary.name: ordnance cannon incendiary canister
exodii_khuunaofaai_mag_incendiary.description: A pressurized tank containing one of the special payloads the Exodii made for their ordnance cannon, something akin to white phosphorous on your Earth.  Its simplicity and effectiveness against targets big and small makes it the cannon's most popular ammunition by far.

exodii_khuunaofaai_mag_corrosive.name: ordnance cannon corrosive canister
exodii_khuunaofaai_mag_corrosive.description: A pressurized tank containing one of the special payloads the Exodii made for their ordnance cannon, a mixture of several acids and peroxides capable of rapidly breaking down the organic tissues of zombies and mutants alike.  Apparently developed for cases where the incendiary payload would fail, like low to zero oxygen environments and targets capable of self-extinguishing - It's somewhat alarming the Exodii run into those scenarios frequently enough to justify producing this.

exodii_khuunaofaai_mag_adhesive.name: ordnance cannon adhesive canister
exodii_khuunaofaai_mag_adhesive.description: A pressurized tank containing one of the special payloads the Exodii made for their ordnance cannon, an industrial grade chemical that adheres to anything it touches and hardens into a concrete-like resin.  Invented on some alternate Earth for quickly fixing holes in Zeppelin and high-altitude craft, the Exodii found the substance useful for area denial, cover creation, or encasing nasty things in when they couldn't be bothered to waste bullets on them.

ree_33_4_mag.name: 3.3 naval 4-round magazine
ree_33_4_mag.description: A bulky 4-round magazine for the Exodii naval rifle.  Grants some amount of portability, if the gun itself can be named portable.

ree_33_53_mag.name: 3.3 naval 53-round box magazine
ree_33_53_mag.description: Giant metal box with a belt, which allows it to be used as a high-capacity magazine for the Exodii naval rifle.

caotel_plasma_ring.name: Caotel plasma condenser
caotel_plasma_ring.description: A strange annular device analogous to a magazine, automatically ejected whenever the last of its mounted power cells are depleted.  In fact, you are not sure whether its meant to be reusable or not.

That is, though, only if you screw it into an appropriate respirator before hand and the charcoal isn't expired.
