mka_1919_20.description: 20-round drum magazine for rifle-like magazine-fed shotguns.

tinyweldtank.name: tiny welding tank
tinyweldtank.description: A tiny acetylene tank.  It can pressurize up to 1 liter of welding gas.

smallweldtank.name: small welding tank
smallweldtank.description: A compact MC size acetylene tank.  It can pressurize up to 10 cubic feet of welding gas.

weldtank.name: welding tank
weldtank.description: A bulky B size acetylene tank.  It can pressurize up to 40 cubic feet of welding gas.

2h_flail_steel.name: war flail
2h_flail_steel.description: A stout pole with a large flanged mace head attached to the end with a short chain, a purpose-made combat version of the peasant flail.  It specializes in threshing people in metal armor, rather than grain.

2h_flail_wood.name: peasant flail
2h_flail_wood.description: A stout pole with a wooden club attached to the end with a leather cord.  This farming tool was historically used to thresh wheat and occasionally people when the peasants got angry at their feudal lords.

2h_club_kanabo_studded.name: studded kanabō
2h_club_kanabo_studded.description: A two-handed war club used in feudal Japan by samurai against armored opponents.  Made from hardwood with metal stud inlays.

2h_club_kanabo_spiked.name: spiked kanabō
2h_club_kanabo_spiked.description: A two-handed war club used in feudal Japan by samurai against armored opponents.  Made from hardwood with metal spike inlays.

bat.name: baseball bat
bat.description: A sturdy wooden bat used to play the great American pastime.  Makes for a great melee weapon too.

goedendag_bat.name: goedendag bat
goedendag_bat.description: A weaponized baseball bat with a metal cap and a spike protruding straight up from the top.

bat_metal.name: aluminum bat
bat_metal.description: An aluminum baseball bat with a plastic handle, lighter than a wooden bat and a little easier to swing as a result.

bat_metal_bolt.name: bolt studded aluminum bat
bat_metal_bolt.description: An aluminum baseball bat with a selection of bolts threaded through the barrel.  Helps to concentrate the force of a blow, without adding much weight.

bat_nerf.name: foam rubber bat
bat_nerf.description: A baseball bat made of foam rubber with a plastic handle.  Light and easy to wield, but almost completely ineffective if your goal is to hurt someone.

baton.name: expandable baton
baton.description: A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Right now, it's collapsed.  Activate to expand.

baton-extended.name: expandable baton (extended)
baton-extended.description: A telescoping baton that collapses for easy storage.  Makes a good melee weapon.  Activate to collapse.

battleaxe.name: battle axe
battleaxe.description: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Though intended for use as a weapon, it can also be pressed into service as a rather clumsy woodcutting tool.

battleaxe_fake.name: battle axe
battleaxe_fake.description: A dull, cheaply-made replica of a huge axe designed for warfare.

battleaxe_inferior.name: battle axe
battleaxe_inferior.description: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Or it would be, but the axe heads aren't seated properly at all.

lc_battleaxe.name: mild steel battle axe
lc_battleaxe.description: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Made of mild steel, it's passable as a weapon, but lacking a proper grip or a razor sharp edge leaves it somewhat lacking.

mc_battleaxe.name: medium steel battle axe
mc_battleaxe.description: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Made of medium steel, this isn't the greatest weapon ever forged but it has a decent edge and a real handle.

hc_battleaxe.name: high steel battle axe
hc_battleaxe.description: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Made of high steel, this is a solid, dependable weapon.

ch_battleaxe.name: hardened steel battle axe
ch_battleaxe.description: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Made of hardened steel, this would be the envy of any Viking raider.

qt_battleaxe.name: tempered steel battle axe
qt_battleaxe.description: A huge axe designed for warfare.  Made of tempered steel, this is a weapon that could fell a jötunn.

blackjack.name: blackjack
blackjack.description: A short, easily concealed bludgeoning weapon consisting of a weight embedded at the end of a short leather shaft.  Formerly used by law enforcement, this weapon is meant to stun or knock out the subject, although head strikes have a high risk of causing a permanent, disabling brain injury or being fatal.

bokken.name: bokken
bokken.description: A solid wood 'training' katana, exactingly crafted to mimic the weight and balance of the real thing.  Despite its lack of a sharp metal edge, it's still quite capable of inflicting deadly wounds.

bokken_fake.name: bokken
bokken_fake.description: A solid wood 'training' katana.  It feels far too light to make an effective weapon.

bokken_inferior.name: bokken
bokken_inferior.description: A solid wood 'training' katana.  It looks to be mass-produced, and not quite as effective as the real deal.

bowling_pin.name: bowling pin
bowling_pin.description: A standard bowling pin.  Makes a decent melee weapon, if somewhat short.

bwirebat.name: barbed wire bat
bwirebat.description: A baseball bat wrapped with barbed wire.  A brutal melee weapon.

nutboltbat.name: bolt studded bat
nutboltbat.description: A baseball bat with bolts drilled into it, concentrating the force of an impact onto a smaller point like a real mace.

cane.name: walking cane
cane.description: Handicapped or not, you always walk in style.  Consisting of a metal headpiece and a wooden body, this makes a great bashing weapon in a pinch.

sinister_cane.name: sinister cane
sinister_cane.description: A sinister looking cane made of plastic.  It has a shiny red orb gripped by claws at the handle.

wizard_cane_cheap.name: cheap wizard cane (off)
wizard_cane_cheap.description: An arcane but cheap-looking cane made of plastic.  It has a white light-up orb on the end.  Using it will turn it on and provide a weak light.

wizard_cane_cheap_on.name: cheap wizard cane (on)
wizard_cane_cheap_on.description: An arcane but cheap-looking cane made of plastic.  It has a white light-up orb on the end.  Using it will turn it on and provide a weak light.

wizard_cane.name: wizard cane (off)
wizard_cane.description: An arcane-looking cane made of wood and aluminum.  It has a white light-up orb on the end.  Using it will turn it on and illuminate the area around you.

wizard_cane_on.name: wizard cane (on)
wizard_cane_on.description: An arcane-looking cane made of wood and aluminum.  It has a white light-up orb on the end.  Using it will turn it on and illuminate the area around you.

makeshift_cane.name: makeshift walking cane
makeshift_cane.description: An improvised cane.  It also works as a basic bashing weapon in a pinch.

club_wooden.name: wooden club
club_wooden.description: A plank of wood that's been snapped in half, with a crude handle whittled into one end.  It looks like a poorly-made cricket bat.

club_wooden_nails.name: wooden club with nails
club_wooden_nails.description: A wooden club, carved out of a 2x4 plank of wood, with a bunch of nails driven into it.  The additional weight in the end and sharp spikes contribute to the increased damage, but the structural integrity of the wood is degraded, making this weapon live a very short life.

club_wooden_bolted.name: wooden club with bolts
club_wooden_bolted.description: A wooden club, carved out of a 2x4 plank of wood, with a bunch of bolts drilled into it, distributing its weight and balance closer to the head, like proper maces do.

club_wooden_large.name: large wooden club
club_wooden_large.description: A long plank of wood with a crude handle whittled into one end.  It's barely an improvement, but at least it is slightly easier to wield than just the plank on its own.

club_wooden_large_nails.name: large wooden club with nails
club_wooden_large_nails.description: A large wooden club, carved out of a 2x4 plank of wood, with a bunch of nails driven into it.  The additional weight in the end and sharp spikes contribute to the increased damage, but the structural integrity of the wood is degraded, making this weapon live a very short life.

club_wooden_large_bolted.name: large wooden club with bolts
club_wooden_large_bolted.description: A large wooden club, carved out of a 2x4 plank of wood, with a bunch of bolts drilled into it, concentrating the force of an impact onto a smaller point like a real mace.

makeshift_crutches.name: makeshift crutches (pair)
makeshift_crutches.description: A pair of wooden makeshift crutches.

cudgel.name: cudgel
cudgel.description: A long, slender wooden rod.  While traditionally intended as a training tool, it still makes a good melee weapon in a pinch.

golf_club.name: golf club
golf_club.description: A long handle with a big metal head, flat on one side, for driving golf balls.  Fore!

hammer_sledge.name: sledge hammer
hammer_sledge.description: A large, heavy hammer.  A very hard-hitting melee weapon, but it's slow to swing and will probably exhaust you quickly.

hammer_sledge_short.name: short sledge hammer
hammer_sledge_short.description: A sledge hammer with a notably shorter handle.  This makes it worse as a melee weapon, but a more portable tool.

hammer_sledge_engineer.name: engineer's hammer
hammer_sledge_engineer.description: A stout and hefty hammer, more akin to a sledge than a typical ball-peen.  Useful for portable demolition work, but very unwieldy as a weapon.

hammer_sledge_heavy.name: heavy sledge hammer
hammer_sledge_heavy.description: A large sledge hammer with a massive, heavy head.  This unwieldy tool is meant to break concrete, rock, brick, anything really.

hammer_sledge_crude.name: homewrecker
hammer_sledge_crude.description: Chunks of steel welded together affixed to a wooden handle.  Not the most elegant and ugly as all hell, but still mostly works.

hockey_stick.name: hockey stick
hockey_stick.description: A curved wooden stick with a wide and flat end.  Commonly used by hockey players.

glass_macuahuitl.name: glass bladed macuahuitl
glass_macuahuitl.description: A flat wooden club with sharpened pieces of glass stuck to both sides.  Somewhat accurate to the actual thing.

teeth_macuahuitl.name: teeth-bladed macuahuitl
teeth_macuahuitl.description: A flat wooden club with impossibly-sharp teeth stuck to both sides.  Fragile yet very sharp.

aztec_sword_stone.name: stone lined macuahuitl
aztec_sword_stone.description: An improvised version of the close combat weapon that was mainly used by Aztecs.  It's not very sturdy, but it will break someone's skull open and give them a good cut.

aztec_sword_scrap.name: makeshift macuahuitl
aztec_sword_scrap.description: A poor imitation of the close combat weapon affiliated with Aztec warriors, made with a large wooden club and carefully hammered razors.  Although not very sturdy, it delivers some nasty cuts and bruises.

lc_aztec_sword.name: mild steel bladed macuahuitl
lc_aztec_sword.description: A modern reimagining of the large close combat weapon affiliated with Aztec warriors, made of a sturdy wooden club and sharp blades forged from mild steel.  Blades are definitely sturdier than obsidian ones.  Not great, not terrible.

mc_aztec_sword.name: medium steel bladed macuahuitl
mc_aztec_sword.description: A modern reimagining of the large close combat weapon affiliated with Aztec warriors, made of a sturdy wooden club and sharp blades forged from medium steel.  Blades are definitely sturdier than obsidian ones.

hc_aztec_sword.name: high steel bladed macuahuitl
hc_aztec_sword.description: A modern reimagining of the large close combat weapon affiliated with Aztec warriors, made of a sturdy wooden club and sharp blades forged from high steel.  Blades are definitely sturdier than obsidian ones.

ch_aztec_sword.name: hardened steel bladed macuahuitl
ch_aztec_sword.description: A modern reimagining of the large close combat weapon affiliated with Aztec warriors, made of a sturdy wooden club and sharp blades forged from hardened steel.  Blades are definitely sturdier than obsidian ones.

qt_aztec_sword.name: tempered steel bladed macuahuitl
qt_aztec_sword.description: A modern reimagining of the large close combat weapon affiliated with Aztec warriors, made of a sturdy wooden club and sharp blades forged from tempered steel.  You can single-handedly avenge the fallen nations of Mesoamerica with this one.

i_staff.name: ironshod quarterstaff
i_staff.description: A long wooden staff reinforced with metal bands and caps.

lc_steel_staff.name: mild steelshod quarterstaff
lc_steel_staff.description: A long wooden staff reinforced with metal bands and caps.  This one has been forged with mild steel rather than the traditional iron, and so hits just that little bit harder.

mc_steel_staff.name: medium steelshod quarterstaff
mc_steel_staff.description: A long wooden staff reinforced with metal bands and caps.  This one has been forged with medium steel rather than the traditional iron, and so hits just that little bit harder.

hc_steel_staff.name: high steelshod quarterstaff
hc_steel_staff.description: A long wooden staff reinforced with metal bands and caps.  This one has been forged with high steel rather than the traditional iron, and so hits just that little bit harder.

ch_steel_staff.name: hardened steelshod quarterstaff
ch_steel_staff.description: A long wooden staff reinforced with metal bands and caps.  This one has been forged with hardened steel rather than the traditional iron, and so hits just that little bit harder.

qt_steel_staff.name: tempered steelshod quarterstaff
qt_steel_staff.description: A long wooden staff reinforced with metal bands and caps.  This one has been forged with tempered steel rather than the traditional iron, and so hits just that little bit harder.

lucern_hammer.name: lucerne hammer
lucern_hammer.description: A versatile polearm with a spiked hammer head, a spike, and a hook attached to a beefy wooden pole.

lucern_hammerfake.name: lucerne hammer
lucern_hammerfake.description: A cheap piece of crap imitation of a versatile polearm with a spiked hammer head, probably meant to be used for LARPing.

crowbar_warhammer.name: bec de crowbar
crowbar_warhammer.description: This weapon appears to be a warhammer, but instead of one end of the head being a spike, it's the flats of a crowbar.  While not as good of a weapon as a more traditional warhammer, and not as good as prying as a crowbar, it still does both jobs decently well.

homemade_polehammer.name: homemade polehammer
homemade_polehammer.description: A standard hammerhead solidly mounted at the end of a proper spear shaft.  The long leverage provides surprising balance and impact force.  Simple and effective.

homemade_polehammer_makeshift.name: makeshift homemade polehammer
homemade_polehammer_makeshift.description: A standard hammerhead mounted at the end of a long stick.  It is far from being a proper weapon, but it allows you to bash zombie heads from a safe distance.

mace.name: medium steel mace
mace.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy metal head.  It is heavy and slow to swing, but its crushing damage is devastating.

mace_fake.name: mace
mace_fake.description: A light, cheaply-made replica of a medieval weapon that would normally consist of a wood handle with a heavy metal head.

mace_inferior.name: mace
mace_inferior.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy metal head.  The head feels a bit loose.

lc_mace.name: mild steel mace
lc_mace.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy metal head.  It is heavy and slow to swing, but its crushing damage is devastating.  This one is custom-made with mild steel, which technically still works fine but tends to blunt more easily, and the grip is kind of bad.

hc_mace.name: high steel mace
hc_mace.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy metal head.  It is heavy and slow to swing, but its crushing damage is devastating.  This one is custom-made with high steel and is a solid, dependable weapon.

ch_mace.name: hardened steel mace
ch_mace.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy metal head.  It is heavy and slow to swing, but its crushing damage is devastating.  This one is custom-made with hardened steel and can pulverize bones.

qt_mace.name: tempered steel mace
qt_mace.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy metal head.  It is heavy and slow to swing, but its crushing damage is devastating.  This one is custom-made with tempered steel and will crack skulls like watermelons.

mace_simple.name: simple mace
mace_simple.description: A stick with a circular lump of metal tied to it in a facsimile of a mace.  You could probably improve it by finding a way to pin the head to the handle.

mace_trench.name: trench mace
mace_trench.description: A mace made from a circular chunk of steel pinned to the end of a stick.  You can feel your inner Trench Raider come alive when you wield it.

mace_pipe.name: pipe mace
mace_pipe.description: A pipe with a handful of pipe fittings screwed onto the end to give it a weighty head for bashing.

mace_pipe_large.name: great pipe mace
mace_pipe_large.description: Two pipes fitted end-to-end with more pipe fittings screwed onto the far end.  The result is a large, but awkward bludgeon.

staff_pipe.name: pipe staff
staff_pipe.description: Three pipes fitted end-to-end in a heavy facsimile of a quarterstaff.

mace_bronze.name: bronze mace
mace_bronze.description: While nothing more than a bronze sphere on a stick, it is still surprisingly effective.

makeshift_sap.name: makeshift sap
makeshift_sap.description: An improvised sap, also known as a cosh, slapjack, and slapper.  A short, flat bludgeoning weapon consisting of a weight embedded between two patches of leather.

mjolnir.name: Mjölnir
mjolnir.description:
A large hammer, forged from the heart of a dying star.  It bears the inscription:

Whosoever holds this hammer,
If he be worthy,
Shall possess the power to…
CRUSH!'

morningstar.name: morningstar
morningstar.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked metal ball on the end.  It deals devastating crushing damage, and the spikes easily puncture soft targets.

morningstar_fake.name: morningstar
morningstar_fake.description: A light, cheaply-made replica of a medieval weapon that would normally consist of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked metal ball on the end.

morningstar_inferior.name: morningstar
morningstar_inferior.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a wood handle with a heavy, spiked metal ball on the end.  The weight feels off on this one, and the spikes are blunted.

nailbat.name: nail bat
nailbat.description: A baseball bat with several nails driven through it, a popular choice for all sorts of doomsday larpers.  The additional weight in the end and sharp spikes contribute to the increased damage, but the structural integrity of the wood is degraded, making this weapon live a very short life.

nailboard.name: nailboard
nailboard.description: A plank of wood with several nails through one end; essentially a simple mace.  Makes an acceptable melee weapon.

pool_cue.name: pool cue
pool_cue.description: A hardwood stick designed for hitting colorful balls around a felt table.  Truly, the coolest of sports.

PR24-extended.name: PR-24 baton (extended)
PR24-extended.description: The Monadnock PR-24 baton is a collapsible, lightweight, side-handle baton used by law enforcement all over the world.  The PR designation is rumored to mean Public Relations.  Activate to retract.

PR24-retracted.name: PR-24 baton (retracted)
PR24-retracted.description: The Monadnock PR-24 baton is a collapsible, lightweight, side-handle baton used by law enforcement all over the world.  The PR designation is rumored to mean Public Relations.  Activate to extend.

q_staff.name: quarterstaff
q_staff.description: A sturdy staff carved out of wood.  Lightweight and long, it is surprisingly easy to handle.

bo.name: bō
bo.description: A wooden staff weapon used in Okinawan martial arts.  Finely sanded and treated with oil for integrity.

rock_sock.name: rock in a sock
rock_sock.description: A pair of nested socks with a stone tied inside.  A true weapon of desperation.

sharp_toothbrush.name: plastic shank
sharp_toothbrush.description: An oblong plastic object with the far end ground down into a stabbing point.

shillelagh.name: shillelagh
shillelagh.description: A stout, knotty stick with a large knob at the top that has been left to cure in a chimney.  A traditional Irish weapon, the shillelagh was originally used for settling disputes in a gentlemanly manner.

shillelagh_weighted.name: loaded stick
shillelagh_weighted.description: A stout knotty stick with a large knob at the top that has been left to cure in a chimney.  A traditional Irish weapon, the shillelagh was originally used for settling disputes in a gentlemanly manner.  The knob has been hollowed and filled with molten heavy metal to pack more of a punch.

shillelagh_fake.name: shillelagh
shillelagh_fake.description: A fake shillelagh massproduced as a souvenir for tourists.  This knotty stick has not been cured in a chimney like a traditional shillelagh, but instead has had fake black soot painted on.

shock_staff.name: powered quarterstaff
shock_staff.description: An ironshod quarterstaff that has a high-voltage stun gun built into the handle.  The stun guns prongs are extended by a wire and stick out from the tip of the shaft, allowing you to zap a dangerous opponent should beating them senseless with it prove too hazardous.

shocktonfa_off.name: tactical tonfa (off)
shocktonfa_off.description: A reinforced plastic tonfa; the core is filled with capacitors and a high-yield rechargeable storage battery.  When a switch on the handle is pressed, a high-voltage current is transmitted to the two electrodes mounted in the end of the tonfa, and by extension to anyone unfortunate enough to be in contact with them.  It also has a nifty flashlight, which is off at the moment.

shocktonfa_on.name: tactical tonfa (on)
shocktonfa_on.description: A reinforced plastic tonfa; the core is filled with capacitors and a high-yield rechargeable storage battery.  When a switch on the handle is pressed, a high-voltage current is transmitted to the two electrodes mounted in the end of the weapon, and by extension to anyone unfortunate enough to be in contact with them.  The integral flashlight is turned on, continually draining power and lighting the surrounding area.

tonfa.name: tonfa
tonfa.description: A hard plastic truncheon commonly employed by police.  Originally an Okinawan weapon, it consists of a stick with a perpendicular handle attached a third of the way down its length.

tonfa_wood.name: wooden tonfa
tonfa_wood.description: A stout wooden truncheon of the sort commonly employed by police.  Originally an Okinawan weapon, it consists of a stick with a perpendicular handle attached a third of the way down its length.

ax_sheets_welded.name: welded battle axe
ax_sheets_welded.description: A savage-looking battle axe made out of layered sheet metal welded into two pipes held together with fittings, vaguely forming a upside-down L shape.  This should be structurally stable.  Hopefully.

ax_sheets_bolted.name: bolted battle axe
ax_sheets_bolted.description: A savage-looking battle axe made out of layered sheet metal bolted to two pipes held together with fittings, vaguely forming a upside-down L shape.  Swing it with all your might.

warhammer.name: war hammer
warhammer.description: A medieval hammer with a spike on one end, made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.  This one is custom-made with medium steel which is passable, but hardly the pinnacle of weapon making.

warhammer_fake.name: war hammer
warhammer_fake.description: A light, cheaply-made replica of a medieval hammer with a spike on one end.

warhammer_inferior.name: war hammer
warhammer_inferior.description: A medieval hammer with a spike on one end, made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.  The head is deformed and the spike is dull.

lc_warhammer.name: mild steel war hammer
lc_warhammer.description: A medieval hammer with a spike on one end, made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.  This one is custom-made with mild steel, which technically still works fine but tends to blunt more easily, and the grip is kind of bad.

hc_warhammer.name: high steel war hammer
hc_warhammer.description: A medieval hammer with a spike on one end, made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.  This one is custom-made with high steel and is a solid, dependable weapon.

ch_warhammer.name: hardened steel war hammer
ch_warhammer.description: A medieval hammer with a spike on one end, made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.  This one is custom-made with hardened steel and can pulverize bones.

qt_warhammer.name: tempered steel war hammer
qt_warhammer.description: A medieval hammer with a spike on one end, made for battle.  Its odd shape and balance make it an excellent weapon, but an ineffective tool.  This one is custom-made with tempered steel and will crack skulls like watermelons.

exodii_prybar.name: breacher
exodii_prybar.description: Some sort of large prybar of a make and manufacturer you've never seen before.  On the heavier end is a set of thick, crabclaw like shears connected to a hydraulic piston, capable of cutting or prying through metal with great force.  The Exodii use these for general purpose breaching and scrapping heavy machines, and it's been retrofitted to run on their bionic power.

exodii_digger.name: sapper
exodii_digger.description: A metal pole saw covered in faded orange paint and warning labels written in an unknown language.  The circular blade at the end is over an inch thick, its deeply dished grooves suggesting its purpose as a digging implement rather than a cutter.  The Exodii use these to chew through reinforced walls like concrete or solid steel, and it's been retrofitted to run on their bionic power.

bio_claws_weapon.name: bionic claws
bio_claws_weapon.description: Short, sharp claws made from a high-tech metal.

bio_blade_weapon.name: monomolecular blade
bio_blade_weapon.description: A foot-long blade made from high-tech alloy and edged with bonded nanocrystals.

bullwhip.name: bullwhip
bullwhip.description: A long strip of braided leather with a handle on one end.  Originally developed to settle disagreements with cattle, it's better used now for flaying the rotten flesh off of walking corpses.  Great for when a problem comes along.

bullwhip_razor.name: scourge
bullwhip_razor.description: The "cat 'o nine tails", a handle with nine short leather whips, each sporting a razor-sharp metal tip.  This ancient instrument of torture causes massive bleeding, but by design is inefficient as a weapon.

tazer.name: stun gun
tazer.description: A high-powered stun gun.  Use this item to attempt to electrocute an adjacent enemy, temporarily paralyzing them.

pitchfork.name: pitchfork
pitchfork.description: An agricultural tool with a long wooden shaft and four spikes.  Normally used to lift hay.

pointy_stick.name: pointy stick
pointy_stick.description: A simple wooden pole with one end sharpened to a point.

pointy_stick_long.name: long pointy stick
pointy_stick_long.description: A stout pole with one end sharpened to a point.

spear_wood.name: fire-hardened wooden spear
spear_wood.description: A stout wooden pole with a fire-hardened point.

spear_wood_simple.name: wooden spear
spear_wood_simple.description: A stout wooden pole with a whittled point.

spear_shaft_sharpened.name: sharpened spear shaft
spear_shaft_sharpened.description: You've gone through the effort of making a proper spear shaft, but instead of attaching something sharp to the end you just whittled a point into the wood.  The peak of pointy stick technology.

makeshift_scythe_war.name: makeshift war scythe
makeshift_scythe_war.description: This farming tool has been modified into an improvised weapon by rotating its blade 90 degrees, transforming it into a deadly giant blade on the end of a stick.  It's quite fragile, however.

makeshift_halberd.name: simple makeshift glaive
makeshift_halberd.description: A large blade attached to a stout section of tree branch.  It could do a considerable amount of damage, but the blade isn't secured very well and could easily break off.

makeshift_glaive.name: makeshift glaive
makeshift_glaive.description: A stout tree branch that has been carefully split and reinforced.  At the split point, a sharp blade has been bolted into place and reinforced with layers of sturdy wrapped bindings.

spear_spike.name: spike on a stick
spear_spike.description: A flimsy pole made of wood with a basic metal spike tied to it.  It's barely sharp, and crudely constructed, but it will keep the zombies out of arm's reach until you can find something better.

spear_knife.name: simple knife spear
spear_knife.description: A flimsy pole made of wood with a knife bound to the end.  It's long enough to slice from a distance, but the knife isn't that well attached.  You could take a bit more time to carefully split the shaft and attach the knife blade more permanently.

spear_knife_superior.name: makeshift knife spear
spear_knife_superior.description: A long stick that has been carefully split and reinforced.  At the split point, a sharp blade has been bolted into place and reinforced with layers of sturdy wrapped bindings.

spear_knife_proper.name: knife spear
spear_knife_proper.description: A stout wooden pole with the blade of a knife bolted into place at the end.  The shape of a knife blade isn't ideal for a spear, but it's still very sharp and effective.

spear_homemade_halfpike.name: homemade halfpike
spear_homemade_halfpike.description: A short do-it-yourself spear made out of a long stick with a metal spike seated and bound into place at its tip.

spear_steel_crude.name: crude steel spear
spear_steel_crude.description: A stout wooden pole with a misshapen metal spike seated into the end and bolted into place.

crude_goedendag.name: crude goedendag
crude_goedendag.description: A stout wooden pole, slightly thicker at the end, with a metal cap and a spike protruding straight up from the top.

spear_copper.name: copper spear
spear_copper.description: A stout wooden pole with a spearhead worked from copper.

spear_steel.name: medium steel spear
spear_steel.description: A stout wooden pole with a hand-forged medium steel spearhead.

lc_spear_steel.name: mild steel spear
lc_spear_steel.description: A stout wooden pole with a mild steel spearhead.  Although made of low quality steel, it is still reasonably effective, if not very durable.

hc_spear_steel.name: high steel spear
hc_spear_steel.description: A stout wooden pole with a hand-forged high steel spearhead.  The high steel offers superior sharpness and penetrating power.

ch_spear_steel.name: hardened steel spear
ch_spear_steel.description: A stout wooden pole tipped with a hand-forged hardened steel spearhead.  The case-hardened and carefully slack quenched tip offers superior killing power, making this a spear fit for a medieval lord.

qt_spear_steel.name: tempered steel spear
qt_spear_steel.description: A stout wooden pole tipped with a hand-forged tempered steel spearhead.  Masterfully tempered and quenched, the bluish steel coalesces in a needle-fine point.  The shaft has been lined with a spiraling leather riser, improving control during deadly thrusts.  The king of all weapons.

sharpened_pipe.name: sharpened pipe
sharpened_pipe.description: A pipe with one end cut off at an angle.

simple_spear_pipe.name: basic pipe spear
simple_spear_pipe.description: Three pipes tightly fit together with one end cut down to a point.

spear_pipe.name: pipe spear
spear_pipe.description: Three pipes tightly fit together with some wrappings for a handle around one end and a sharp tip on the other.

simple_pike_pipe.name: basic pipe pike
simple_pike_pipe.description: Five pipes threaded together to form a very crude pike.  Heavy, slow, and all around cumbersome to carry and fight with.

pike_pipe.name: pipe pike
pike_pipe.description: Five pipes welded together to form a very crude pike.  Heavy, slow, and all around cumbersome to carry and fight with.

pointed_rebar.name: pointed rebar
pointed_rebar.description: A rod of rebar that's been crudely hammered into a point.

sharp_rebar.name: sharpened rebar
sharp_rebar.description: A rod of rebar that's been cut and sharpened to a point.

spear_rebar.name: rebar spear
spear_rebar.description: Two rods of rebar welded together with a pointed tip.

qiang.name: qiang
qiang.description: An ancient Chinese spear, typically with a tassel just below the spearhead and larger than most European spears.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao saber, jian sword, and gun staff.

halberd.name: halberd
halberd.description: A versatile polearm with an axe blade, a spike, and other fun things attached to a long, sturdy stick.

halberd_fake.name: halberd
halberd_fake.description: A dull, cheaply made replica of a polearm with an axe blade, a spike, and other fun things attached to a thick pole.

halberd_crude.name: crude halberd
halberd_crude.description: A homemade halberd, made by attaching an axe head to a spear shaft.  Not as good as the real thing, but a whole heck of a lot cheaper and easier.

bill_hook.name: bill-hook
bill_hook.description: A nasty set of hooks and spikes set upon a shaft, with a metal endcap.  This ain't no gardening tool, and it'll hook someone very easily.

glaive.name: glaive
glaive.description: A sturdy polearm with a sizable single-edged blade on the end.

naginata.name: naginata
naginata.description: A sturdy polearm with a curved blade, made in the same manner as the katana and other Japanese blades.  Occasionally used by samurai in early periods, or by their wives in defense of the household.

naginata_inferior.name: naginata
naginata_inferior.description: A sturdy polearm with a curved blade, made in the same manner as the katana and other Japanese blades.  This one has a bit of wiggle to its blade and feels a bit shoddily made.

naginata_fake.name: naginata
naginata_fake.description: A dull, slightly floppy replica of a Japanese polearm with a curved blade.  With a little difficulty, you could use it administer a solid slap from a distance.

naginata_machete.name: machete naginata
naginata_machete.description: This crude facsimile of a naginata was made by attaching a machete to the end of a spear.

naginata_machete_temp.name: tempered machete naginata
naginata_machete_temp.description: This crude facsimile of a naginata was made by attaching a machete to the end of a spear.  This one uses a tempered machete, making it a bit more sharp and durable.

javelin.name: wooden javelin
javelin.description: A fire-hardened wooden spear honed to a sharper point.

pike_wood.name: wooden pike
pike_wood.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a very long wooden shaft with a fire-hardened point.

pike_copper.name: copper pike
pike_copper.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a very long wooden shaft tipped with a copper spearhead.

pike_bronze.name: bronze pike
pike_bronze.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a very long wooden shaft tipped with a bronze spearhead.

pike.name: medium steel pike
pike.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a very long wooden shaft tipped with a steel spearhead.

lc_pike.name: mild steel pike
lc_pike.description: A very long wooden shaft with a mild steel pike head.  Although made of low quality steel, it remains a formidable reach weapon, if somewhat less durable.

hc_pike.name: high steel pike
hc_pike.description: A very long wooden shaft with a hand-forged high steel pike head.  The improved steel offers better sharpness and penetration.

ch_pike.name: hardened steel pike
ch_pike.description: A very long wooden shaft tipped with a case-hardened steel pike head.  Its refined edge and hardened tip make it deadly in combat.

qt_pike.name: tempered steel pike
qt_pike.description: A very long wooden shaft tipped with a masterfully tempered steel pike head.  The blade is razor-sharp and perfectly tapered.  The pinnacle of polearm craftsmanship.

pike_fake.name: pike
pike_fake.description: A dull, cheaply made replica of a medieval weapon consisting of a very long wooden shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.

pike_inferior.name: pike
pike_inferior.description: A medieval weapon consisting of a very long wooden shaft tipped with an iron spearhead.  The head seems to be pretty dull, and the whole thing feels poorly made.

scythe_war.name: war scythe
scythe_war.description: A pole weapon with a curving single-edged blade.  Its blade bears some superficial resemblance to that of an agricultural scythe from which it likely evolved.

spear_dory.name: dory
spear_dory.description: A well-made spear with a bronze head, Greek in origin.  Despite its large size, it was frequently used one-handed.

string_dimension_partigiana_ixwa.name: partigiana-ixwa
string_dimension_partigiana_ixwa.description: A steel shortspear from an alien world, made of a single, continuous piece of tempered steel.  The head is a broad cutting-stabbing implement with small hooks on either side.

spear_bronze.name: bronze spear
spear_bronze.description: A forged spear with a bronze head.

poleaxe.name: poleaxe
poleaxe.description: A polearm with an axe head, a small hammer on the back, and a short dagger-like spike on top.  It's less heavy than most polearms and has a smaller head, making it slightly quicker.

ji.name: ji
ji.description: A bronze polearm that originated in the Shang dynasty of China, if not earlier.  It combines a spear head with the perpendicular blade of the earlier ge or dagger-axe.

spear_stone.name: stone spear
spear_stone.description: A stout wooden pole with a sharp stone spearhead.

spear_stone_simple.name: simple stone spear
spear_stone_simple.description: A long stick with a sharp stone spearhead.

aztec_spear_scrap.name: makeshift tepoztopili
aztec_spear_scrap.description: This is a long polearm with an oar-like oval head covered with razors.  Its shape make it suitable for both thrusting and slashing.  It resembles the Mesoamerican Tepoztopili, though the shaft is not very sturdy.

aztec_spear_glass.name: glass bladed tepoztopili
aztec_spear_glass.description: This is a long polearm with an oar-like oval head covered with glass.  Its shape make it suitable for both thrusting and slashing.  It resembles the Mesoamerican Tepoztopili, though the shaft is not very sturdy.

aztec_spear_stone.name: stone bladed tepoztopili
aztec_spear_stone.description: This is a long polearm with an oar-like oval head covered with stones.  Its shape make it suitable for both thrusting and slashing.  It resembles the Mesoamerican Tepoztopili, though the shaft is not very sturdy.

lc_aztec_spear.name: mild steel bladed tepoztopili
lc_aztec_spear.description: This is a redesigned version of the Mesoamerican tepoztopili.  It's an elliptical piece of carved wood lined with sharp mild steel blades, firmly attached to a stout spear shaft.

mc_aztec_spear.name: medium steel bladed tepoztopili
mc_aztec_spear.description: This is a redesigned version of the Mesoamerican tepoztopili.  It has an elliptical piece of carved wood lined with sharp medium steel blades, firmly attached to a stout spear shaft.

hc_aztec_spear.name: high steel bladed tepoztopili
hc_aztec_spear.description: This is a redesigned version of the Mesoamerican tepoztopili.  It has an elliptical piece of carved wood lined with sharp high steel blades, firmly attached to a stout spear shaft.

ch_aztec_spear.name: hardened steel bladed tepoztopili
ch_aztec_spear.description: This is a redesigned version of the Mesoamerican tepoztopili.  It has an elliptical piece of carved wood lined with sharp hardened steel blades, firmly attached to a stout spear shaft.

qt_aztec_spear.name: tempered steel bladed tepoztopili
qt_aztec_spear.description: This is a redesigned version of the Mesoamerican tepoztopili.  It has an elliptical piece of carved wood lined with sharp tempered steel blades, firmly attached to a stout spear shaft.  It's a weapon worthy of being wielded by Huitzilopochtli himself.

sword_wood.name: 2-by-sword
sword_wood.description: A plank with a handle and a whittled-down point.  Not much good for slashing, but much better than your bare hands.

sword_wood_large.name: zweitimber
sword_wood_large.description: A plank with a handle and a whittled-down point, left large enough to require two hands.  Still not much good for slashing, but far better than the plank on its own.

sword_nail.name: nord
sword_nail.description: A nail sword, or nord for short.  This wooden sword has a dozen nails sticking out at jagged angles from the edge of the blade, making it much better at chopping than slashing.

sword_crude.name: scrap sword
sword_crude.description: Several bits of thin scrap metal crudely beat into the semblance of an edge over a wooden sword.  The added weight is unbalanced, but the jagged edge offers a good bit of slashing power.

sword_crude_large.name: scrap greatsword
sword_crude_large.description: A large wooden sword with scrap metal hammered over it into something pretending to be an edge.  The extra weight almost completely front-loads the balance, and it hurts your wrists just to wield.

sword_sheets_welded.name: welded sword
sword_sheets_welded.description: A vicious single-edged sword made out of sheet metal layered twice over itself then welded together.  It's not as robust as a proper forged sword, but the edge is wickedly sharp.

sword_sheets_welded_large.name: welded greatsword
sword_sheets_welded_large.description: A long-handled single-edged sword made out of sheet metal layered thrice over itself then welded together.  The extra length and weight makes it a tad awkward, but gives it a lot of slashing power.

sword_metal.name: metal sword
sword_metal.description: An imitation of a true sword forged by someone who knows what swords look like, at least.  Made from whatever scrap metal was on hand, it has the general shape of a sword, and it is sharp, but it is a bit heavier than it should be and the balance isn't quite right.

sword_metal_large.name: metal greatsword
sword_metal_large.description: A large, crudely-forged blade.  It's too big to be called a sword.  Too massive, too thick, too heavy, and far too rough.

sword_metal_fencing.name: metal fencing sword
sword_metal_fencing.description: Calling this a rapier is a stretch.  It's robust and very pointy, but more akin to a long metal spike with a handguard than the elegant swords of the Renaissance.

switchblade.name: switchblade
switchblade.description: A long, thin knife with a spring-loaded blade that rests inside the handle while not in use.

knife_folding.name: folding knife
knife_folding.description: A small folding knife with a locking blade and a pocket clip.  Not as good a weapon as a solid fixed-blade knife, but better than a penknife.

utility_knife_folding.name: utility folding knife
utility_knife_folding.description: A 'Hideman' brand folding knife, this model includes extra utility options such as a screwdriver, awl, and small pry bar.

knife_combat_marine.name: USMC bayonet
knife_combat_marine.description: A modern bayonet in use with the US Marine Corps, adopted in an effort to improve USMC hand-to-hand fighting capabilities.  The bayonet is optimized to function as a fighting knife, sporting an ergonomic handle that will minimize hand fatigue during combat.  The blade tip is sharper in profile than other bayonets to assist in penetrating body armor, and also features a small serrated section to provide for some utility.

knife_combat_army.name: Bayonet
knife_combat_army.description: The current issue Army bayonet, before the Cataclysm anyways.  It is thick, heavy, and surprisingly sharp.  This bayonet also functions as a wire cutter, and a mediocre saw for cutting through aircraft fuselage.  That the handle and tang can be completely disassembled from the blade is surely a fact of great comfort to the soldier, survivalist, and you.

knife_combat.name: National Guard bayonet
knife_combat.description: A Cold War era Army bayonet that has only partially been replaced by newer models.  It has an apocalypse-proof full-tang, double-edged high steel blade terminating in a spear point.  The no-frills design makes for both a good fighting knife and bayonet, a fact that was appreciated when reserve stocks of these were issued out to National Guardsmen.

knife_hunting.name: hunting knife
knife_hunting.description: Commonly used by hunters, this single-edged sheath knife is designed for cutting and skinning game rather than combat.

knife_KABAR.name: KA-BAR knife
knife_KABAR.description: The KA-BAR was developed by the United States Marine Corps in 1942 by modifying hunting knife designs to be more soldier-proof.  The handle is made of stacked leather washers, and the blade is made of easy to sharpen high steel, making for a popular fighting, hunting and utility knife.  The blade is marked 'USMC'.

lc_knife_rambo.name: mild steel survival knife
lc_knife_rambo.description: This massive knife features a hollow handle with a compass built into the pommel and a row of fearsome-looking saw teeth along the back of its blade.  It's custom-made of mild steel, you could probably find better in a hunting store.

pocket_data.description: A hidden handle compartment.  Unscrew the compass to access.

knife_rambo.name: medium steel survival knife
knife_rambo.description: This massive knife features a hollow handle with a compass built into the pommel and a row of fearsome-looking saw teeth along the back of its blade.

pocket_data.description: A hidden handle compartment.  Unscrew the compass to access.

hc_knife_rambo.name: high steel survival knife
hc_knife_rambo.description: This massive knife features a hollow handle with a compass built into the pommel and a row of fearsome-looking saw teeth along the back of its blade.  A competent weapon and tool, if not the best at any of them.

pocket_data.description: A hidden handle compartment.  Unscrew the compass to access.

ch_knife_rambo.name: hardened steel survival knife
ch_knife_rambo.description: This massive knife features a hollow handle with a compass built into the pommel and a row of fearsome-looking saw teeth along the back of its blade.  Now this, this is a knife.

pocket_data.description: A hidden handle compartment.  Unscrew the compass to access.

qt_knife_rambo.name: tempered steel survival knife
qt_knife_rambo.description: This massive knife features a hollow handle with a compass built into the pommel and a row of fearsome-looking saw teeth along the back of its blade.  Time to go Rambo on this apocalypse.

pocket_data.description: A hidden handle compartment.  Unscrew the compass to access.

knife_rm42.name: F-S fighting knife
knife_rm42.description: Arguably the most famous combat knife in military history, this blackened double-edged knife is made of drop-forged steel and knurled brass.  The balance of the knife is such that it can be tossed from one hand to the other instinctively, and the spear point allows for easy insertion into an unsuspecting foe's heart.  While this knife is great in a fight, it's not very good as a tool.  The ricasso declares this to be a 'Fairbairn-Sykes knife', with a National Stocking Number of '1095-99-963-2037'.

knife_swissarmy.name: Swiss Army knife
knife_swissarmy.description: An iconic pocket knife imported from Europe.  Its red plastic handle conceals many small tools.

lc_knife_trench.name: mild steel trench knife
lc_knife_trench.description: This stout combat knife features a steel guard to protect the user's knuckles.  The guard can also be used for striking or blocking.  This one is poorly made of mild steel with barely a proper grip.

knife_trench.name: medium steel trench knife
knife_trench.description: This stout combat knife features a steel guard to protect the user's knuckles.  The guard can also be used for striking or blocking.  This one is made of medium steel and is about shop quality.

hc_knife_trench.name: high steel trench knife
hc_knife_trench.description: This stout combat knife features a steel guard to protect the user's knuckles.  The guard can also be used for striking or blocking.  This one is made of high steel and is probably as good as a WWI trench knife.

ch_knife_trench.name: hardened steel trench knife
ch_knife_trench.description: This stout combat knife features a steel guard to protect the user's knuckles.  The guard can also be used for striking or blocking.  This one is made of hardened steel, an officer's weapon if ever there was one.

qt_knife_trench.name: tempered steel trench knife
qt_knife_trench.description: This stout combat knife features a steel guard to protect the user's knuckles.  The guard can also be used for striking or blocking.  This one is made of tempered steel, and you feel you could hold a trench against an army of zombies with it.

makeshift_knife.name: makeshift knife
makeshift_knife.description: A knife consisting of a long, somewhat sharpened spike and a tightly-wrapped rag as a handle.  Not as good as a real knife, but it'll do in a pinch.

glass_shiv.name: glass shiv
glass_shiv.description: A glass shard with wrapping at one end so it can be safely wielded.

bone_knife.name: bone shiv
bone_knife.description: A femur or other bone, about 20 cm long, which has been broken at one end and sharpened into a cutting tool.  Its jagged edge is wicked but fragile.

knife_baselard.name: baselard
knife_baselard.description: A medieval dagger forged from rough iron.  It is not the sharpest tool in the shed, but it is certainly one of the largest.

makeshift_machete.name: makeshift machete
makeshift_machete.description: A large blade with one end wrapped in duct tape to make a crude handle, making it easier to wield as a rough machete.

machete.name: machete
machete.description: This huge steel knife makes an excellent tool for cutting down large vegetation or other 'obstacles.'

survivor_machete_qt.name: tempered steel combat machete
survivor_machete_qt.description: This common gardening tool has been tempered to dramatically improve its performance as a weapon.

machete_gimmick.name: machete multitool
machete_gimmick.description: A thin, wobbly steel blade with sawteeth on one side and a flat chisel tip for digging.  More of a jackass of all trades than a jack of them.

cavalry_sabre.name: cavalry saber
cavalry_sabre.description: A curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onward.  Lightweight, but a deadly slashing weapon.

lc_cavalry_sabre.name: mild steel cavalry saber
lc_cavalry_sabre.description:
A curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onwards.  Lightweight, but a deadly slashing weapon.

Made with mild steel and lacking a proper grip, this is better than the sticks you swung around as a kid, but you know you can do better.

mc_cavalry_sabre.name: medium steel cavalry saber
mc_cavalry_sabre.description:
A curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onwards.  Lightweight, but a deadly slashing weapon.

Made with medium steel and with a grip made of leather wrapped in steel wire, this weapon is comfortable in your hand, though the balance isn't perfect and the edge could be sharper.

hc_cavalry_sabre.name: high steel cavalry saber
hc_cavalry_sabre.description:
A curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onwards.  Lightweight, but a deadly slashing weapon.

Made with high steel and featuring a sturdy grip, this feels like a proper weapon.  The balance feels right and the blade is quite sharp.

ch_cavalry_sabre.name: hardened steel cavalry saber
ch_cavalry_sabre.description:
A curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onwards.  Lightweight, but a deadly slashing weapon.

Made of hardened steel and with a molded grip that fits your hand perfectly, this weapon looks as good as any you might find in a museum.  The balance is perfect and the edge is as sharp as a razor.

qt_cavalry_sabre.name: tempered steel cavalry saber
qt_cavalry_sabre.description:
A curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onwards.  Lightweight, but a deadly slashing weapon.

Made of tempered steel, this is a masterpiece.  The grip, the balance, the blade, all perfect.  This is the peak of the swordsmith's craft.

cavalry_sabre_fake.name: cavalry saber
cavalry_sabre_fake.description: A dull, cheaply-made replica of a curved sword associated with cavalry from the Early Modern period onwards.

kris.name: kris
kris.description: This wavy-bladed dagger is from Southeast Asia.  The design of the blade causes it to make broad, painful wounds.

kris_fake.name: kris
kris_fake.description: A dull, cheap replica of a wavy-bladed dagger from Southeast Asia.

lc_kukri.name: mild steel kukri
lc_kukri.description: This versatile implement is a custom-forged version of a traditional weapon that originated in Nepal.  Featuring a heavy blade with an inwardly-curved edge, this one is made of mild steel, and barely has a proper handle.  You'd probably find a better version in a store somewhere.

kukri.name: medium steel kukri
kukri.description: This versatile implement is a custom-forged version of a traditional weapon that originated in Nepal.  Featuring a heavy blade with an inwardly-curved edge, this one is made of medium steel, and is about what you'd expect to see in a hunting shop.

hc_kukri.name: high steel kukri
hc_kukri.description: This versatile implement is a custom-forged version of a traditional weapon that originated in Nepal.  Featuring a heavy blade with an inwardly-curved edge, this one is made of high steel and is a well-made piece.

ch_kukri.name: hardened steel kukri
ch_kukri.description: This versatile implement is a custom-forged version of a traditional weapon that originated in Nepal.  Featuring a heavy blade with an inwardly-curved edge, this one is made of hardened steel and is a fine tool and weapon.

qt_kukri.name: tempered steel kukri
qt_kukri.description: This versatile implement is a custom-forged version of a traditional weapon that originated in Nepal.  Featuring a heavy blade with an inwardly-curved edge, this one is made of tempered steel and truly a weapon worthy of a post apocalyptic gurkha.

jian.name: jian
jian.description: An ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard and a tassel attached to the pommel.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao saber, qiang spear, and gun staff.

lc_jian.name: mild steel jian
lc_jian.description:
An ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard and a tassel attached to the pommel.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao saber, qiang spear, and gun staff.

Made with mild steel and lacking a proper grip, this is better than the sticks you swung around as a kid, but you know you can do better.

mc_jian.name: medium steel jian
mc_jian.description:
An ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard and a tassel attached to the pommel.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao saber, qiang spear, and gun staff.

Made with medium steel and with a grip made of leather wrapped in steel wire, this weapon is comfortable in your hand, though the balance isn't perfect and the edge could be sharper.

hc_jian.name: high steel jian
hc_jian.description:
An ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard and a tassel attached to the pommel.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao saber, qiang spear, and gun staff.

Made with high steel and featuring a sturdy grip, this feels like a proper weapon.  The balance feels right and the blade is quite sharp.

ch_jian.name: hardened steel jian
ch_jian.description:
An ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard and a tassel attached to the pommel.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao saber, qiang spear, and gun staff.

Made of hardened steel and with a molded grip that fits your hand perfectly, this weapon looks as good as any you might find in a museum.  The balance is perfect and the edge is as sharp as a razor.

qt_jian.name: tempered steel jian
qt_jian.description:
An ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard and a tassel attached to the pommel.  One of the four major weapons in folklore, alongside the dao saber, qiang spear, and gun staff.

Made of tempered steel, this is a masterpiece.  The grip, the balance, the blade, all perfect.  This is the peak of the swordsmith's craft.

jian_inferior.name: jian
jian_inferior.description: An ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword.  The sword is quite worn, and bent at an odd angle.

jian_fake.name: jian
jian_fake.description: A dull, cheaply-made replica of an ancient Chinese doubled-edged straight sword, with an ornate guard.

scimitar.name: shamshir
scimitar.description: A curved sword associated with various Middle Eastern and Central Asian countries.  Designed for slashing, and quite deadly against unarmored targets.

lc_scimitar.name: mild steel shamshir
lc_scimitar.description:
A curved sword associated with various Middle Eastern and Central Asian countries.  Designed for slashing, and quite deadly against unarmored targets.

Made with mild steel and lacking a proper grip, this is better than the sticks you swung around as a kid, but you know you can do better.

mc_scimitar.description:

Made with medium steel and with a grip made of leather wrapped in steel wire, this weapon is comfortable in your hand, though the balance isn't perfect and the edge could be sharper.

hc_scimitar.description:
A curved sword associated with various Middle Eastern and Central Asian countries.  Designed for slashing, and quite deadly against unarmored targets.

qt_scimitar.description:

butterfly_swords.description: A Shaolin butterfly sword, about the same size as a machete but with hand guards and wider blades.  Traditionally used in pairs, but just one is more than enough.

cutlass.name: cutlass
cutlass.description: A broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates, as its short blade is easy to handle in close quarters.

lc_cutlass.name: mild steel cutlass
lc_cutlass.description:
A broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates, as its short blade is easy to handle in close quarters.

Made with mild steel and lacking a proper grip, this is better than the sticks you swung around as a kid, but you know you can do better.

mc_cutlass.name: medium steel cutlass
mc_cutlass.description:
A broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates, as its short blade is easy to handle in close quarters.

Made with medium steel and with a grip made of leather wrapped in steel wire, this weapon is comfortable in your hand, though the balance isn't perfect and the edge could be sharper.

hc_cutlass.name: high steel cutlass
hc_cutlass.description:
A broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates, as its short blade is easy to handle in close quarters.

Made with high steel and featuring a sturdy grip, this feels like a proper weapon.  The balance feels right and the blade is quite sharp.

ch_cutlass.name: hardened steel cutlass
ch_cutlass.description:
A broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates, as its short blade is easy to handle in close quarters.

Made of hardened steel and with a molded grip that fits your hand perfectly, this weapon looks as good as any you might find in a museum.  The balance is perfect and the edge is as sharp as a razor.

qt_cutlass.name: tempered steel cutlass
qt_cutlass.description:
A broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates, as its short blade is easy to handle in close quarters.

Made of tempered steel, this is a masterpiece.  The grip, the balance, the blade, all perfect.  This is the peak of the swordsmith's craft.

cutlass_inferior.name: cutlass
cutlass_inferior.description: A broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates.  This sword appears to be made very poorly, but it should still stand up to a few swings.

cutlass_fake.name: cutlass
cutlass_fake.description: A dull, cheaply-made replica of a broad saber known for its use by sailors and pirates.

kriegsmesser.name: kriegsmesser
kriegsmesser.description: A single-edged two-handed sword of German design, with a long, curved blade.  It became popular across Europe due to its low cost while maintaining strong cutting power in comparison to the more sophisticated longsword.

lc_kriegsmesser.name: mild steel kriegsmesser
lc_kriegsmesser.description:
A single-edged hand-and-a-half-sword of German design, with a long, curved blade.  It became popular across Europe due to its low cost while maintaining strong cutting power in comparison to the more sophisticated longsword.

Made with mild steel and lacking a proper grip, this is better than the sticks you swung around as a kid, but you know you can do better.

mc_kriegsmesser.name: medium steel kriegsmesser
mc_kriegsmesser.description:

falx.name: falx
falx.description: A distinct Dacian sword that curves forward, allowing you to bypass shields or hook and pull enemies, while delivering decent chopping damage.

lajatang.name: lajatang
lajatang.description: An impractical exotic weapon comprised of a long pole of wood with curved blades on each end.

punch_dagger.name: punch dagger
punch_dagger.description: A short, sharp double-edged dagger made to be gripped in the palm, with the blade protruding between the fingers.

knuckle_katar.name: razorbar katar
knuckle_katar.description: Five pieces of rebar sharpened to cruel points and strapped to a brace fastened at the wrist and forearm on both arms.  The next bub better watch out.

bagh_nakha.name: tiger claws
bagh_nakha.description: Also called bagh nakha or iron paw, this small claw-like bladed weapon from India is designed to be concealed under and against the palm.

enfield_bayonet.name: Enfield No. 4 bayonet
enfield_bayonet.description: This is a vintage spike bayonet for the British Lee Enfield No. 4 rifle, featuring a distinct cruciform blade and socket-based mounting system.

arisaka_bayonet.name: Type 30 bayonet
arisaka_bayonet.description: An essential tool within any 20th-century Japanese soldier's toolbox, the Type 30 is a massive, single-edged sword-style bayonet intended for use with Arisaka rifles and even light machineguns.  Possessing a J-shaped quillon guard for hooking an opponent's weapon during combat, the bayonet, when dismounted, acts like a particularly sizable machete.

lc_talwar.name: mild steel talwar
lc_talwar.description:
A curved sword used by the Raj of India in the 16th century, a talwar is usually impeccably decorated and able to take off a limb with a single swipe.

This one however is made of mild steel and lacks even a proper grip, you can definitely do better.

mc_talwar.name: medium steel talwar
mc_talwar.description:
A curved sword used by the Raj of India in the 16th century, a talwar is usually impeccably decorated and able to take off a limb with a single swipe.

This one has a proper grip and is made of medium steel, but doesn't have the distinctive circular pommel yet.

hc_talwar.name: high steel talwar
hc_talwar.description:
A curved sword used by the Raj of India in the 16th century, a talwar is usually impeccably decorated and able to take off a limb with a single swipe.

This one has a proper grip and is made of high steel, you've even gotten the circular pommel right!

ch_talwar.name: hardened steel talwar
ch_talwar.description:
A curved sword used by the Raj of India in the 16th century, a talwar is usually impeccably decorated and able to take off a limb with a single swipe.

This one has a proper grip and is made of hardened steel and is otherwise a fine weapon.

qt_talwar.name: tempered steel talwar
qt_talwar.description:
A curved sword used by the Raj of India in the 16th century, a talwar is usually impeccably decorated and able to take off a limb with a single swipe.

This one has a proper grip and is made of tempered steel, and pre-apocalypse a Raj could have used it.

lc_kilij.name: mild steel kilij
lc_kilij.description:
A Turkish saber, the kilij is quite a bit heavier than most Middle Eastern sabers and has a distinctive wide tip called a yelman, which gives it vicious cutting power but means it requires a special scabbard.

This one has been made of mild steel, and doesn't even have a proper grip or truly sharp edge.

mc_kilij.name: medium steel kilij
mc_kilij.description:
A Turkish saber, the kilij is quite a bit heavier than most Middle Eastern sabers and has a distinctive wide tip called a yelman, which gives it vicious cutting power but means it requires a special scabbard.

This one has a proper grip and is made of medium steel.

hc_kilij.name: high steel kilij
hc_kilij.description:
A Turkish saber, the kilij is quite a bit heavier than most Middle Eastern sabers and has a distinctive wide tip called a yelman, which gives it vicious cutting power but means it requires a special scabbard.

This one has a proper grip and is made of high steel.

ch_kilij.name: hardened steel kilij
ch_kilij.description:

This one has a proper grip and is made of hardened steel.

qt_kilij.name: tempered steel kilij
qt_kilij.description:
A Turkish saber, the kilij is quite a bit heavier than most Middle Eastern sabers and has a distinctive wide tip called a yelman, which gives it vicious cutting power but means it requires a special scabbard.

This one is made of tempered steel, and has a razor's edge and is impeccably balanced.

cestus.name: cestus
cestus.description: A leather hand and arm wrap incorporating metal plates over the knuckles to improve punching power and defense.

xl_cestus.name: cestus
xl_cestus.description: A leather hand and arm wrap incorporating metal plates over the knuckles to improve punching power and defense.

xs_cestus.name: cestus
xs_cestus.description: A leather hand and arm wrap incorporating metal plates over the knuckles to improve punching power and defense.

knuckle_brass.name: brass knuckles (pair)
knuckle_brass.description: A metal weapon made of brass, designed to be gripped in the palm to cause punches to do extra damage.  A good, quick weapon - but you have to get within punching range to use it.

xl_knuckle_brass.name: brass knuckles (pair)
xl_knuckle_brass.description: A metal weapon made of brass, designed to be gripped in the palm to cause punches to do extra damage.  A good, quick weapon - but you have to get within punching range to use it.

xs_knuckle_brass.name: brass knuckles (pair)
xs_knuckle_brass.description: A metal weapon made of brass, designed to be gripped in the palm to cause punches to do extra damage.  A good, quick weapon - but you have to get within punching range to use it.

knuckle_nail.name: nail knuckles (pair)
knuckle_nail.description: A pair of knuckles consisting of two small squares of wood with several nails sticking through them.  Useful in nasty street fights.

xl_knuckle_nail.name: nail knuckles (pair)
xl_knuckle_nail.description: A pair of knuckles consisting of two small squares of wood with several nails sticking through them.  Useful in nasty street fights.

xs_knuckle_nail.description: A pair of knuckles consisting of two small squares of wood with several nails sticking through them.  Useful in nasty street fights.

knuckle_steel.name: scrap knuckles (pair)
knuckle_steel.description: A mass of scrap metal crudely beat into shape, with folded rags underneath to protect the wearer's knuckles.  A good, quick weapon - but you have to get within punching range to use it.

xl_knuckle_steel.name: scrap knuckles (pair)

xl_knuckle_steel_forged.name: steel knuckles (pair)

gloves_studded.name: studded gloves (pair)
gloves_studded.description: A pair of gloves with studded metal knuckles and a thin back plating.

xl_gloves_studded.name: studded gloves (pair)
xl_gloves_studded.description: A pair of gloves with studded metal knuckles and a thin back plating.

xs_gloves_studded.name: studded gloves (pair)
xs_gloves_studded.description: A pair of gloves with studded metal knuckles and a thin back plating.

knuckle_impact.name: impact knuckles (pair)
knuckle_impact.description: A pair of thick steel plates covering your proximal phalange.  They are strapped to your hands with metal braces.

knuckle_skewer.name: skewer knuckles (pair)
knuckle_skewer.description: A pair of metal braces, each with a single sturdy spike attached.  When strapped to your hands, the spikes protrude 5 centimeters past your clenched fists.

xl_knuckle_skewer.name: skewer knuckles (pair)
xl_knuckle_skewer.description: A pair of metal braces, each with a single sturdy spike attached.  When strapped to your hands, the spikes protrude 5 centimeters past your clenched fists.

xs_knuckle_skewer.name: skewer knuckles (pair)
