escape_stone.name: portable portal

use_action.description: Seems like a targeted spatial distortion.

escape_stone.description: This defies easy description, it feels solid but the surface is yielding.  Looking at it you have a strange desire to call it a shelter.

unstable_rift.name: unstable rift

use_action.description: Seems like a random spatial distortion.

unstable_rift.description: This defies easy description, it feels solid but the surface is yielding.  Looking at it you have a strange desire to call it a door.

abyss_teleport_orb.name: black glass orb
abyss_teleport_orb.description: A mysterious black glass orb.  It seems to have endless depths hidden in it.

default_dimension_teleport_orb.name: dull brown orb
default_dimension_teleport_orb.description: A dull brown orb.  The surface has the texture of dried earth.

calming_stone.name: calming anomaly

use_action.description: Seems like it could calm local conditions.

calming_stone.description: This defies easy description, it feels solid but the surface is yielding.  Looking at it you are reminded of the calm at the end of a portal storm.

nl_overgrown_halligan.name: petrified prybar
nl_overgrown_halligan.description: While this hefty-looking implement looks like a halligan prybar, it appears as if it it were grown rather than fabricated.  It's color is that of metal and natural stone, but it's surprisingly light in the hand, and bares the striations of old, dense wood.

nl_exodii_lamp.name: disconnected strange utility light
nl_exodii_lamp.description: Parts of this utility light have a curved appearance, as though the metal were grown in a lab.  Its single, round bulb will emit light if connected to power.

nl_safehouse_boiler.name: disconnected otherworldly boiler
nl_safehouse_boiler.description: A huge, pot-bellied device that resembles something between a coal-burning stove and a boiler, with a wide, hinged cage covering the combustion chamber.  Three unmarked gauges sit like alien eyes upon its face.  A side-mounted crank is its only visible control.  In defiance of its apparent function, it has no exhaust vent; in its place is a hose twisted on itself several times, coiled in copper, and terminating in a bulbous back-mounted battery pack.

nl_safehouse_boiler_plans.name: graven slab
nl_safehouse_boiler_plans.description: A thin sheet of otherworldly material etched with crude pictographs.  Upon closer inspection, the pictographs are slowly moving - animated grooves carved into the strange metal.  They show a squat, round vessel with its front opening like a jaw as a faceless humanoid places various objects, including a leaf, a wrench, and a dead animal, inside it.  Above it, three circular eyes sit empty, then begin to radiate jagged lines as a side crank is turned.  The contents of the chamber are reduced to a scribbled, lightning-bolt haze.  In the final image, the humanoid figure stands smaller than before, as the three darkened eyes focus into pupils, chasing the figure's descent.

kipple_wrapper.name: paper wrapper
kipple_wrapper.description: A strange wrapper for candy or gum.  It crinkles like foil but feels similar to a blade of grass.  It reads "<made_up_colors> <meta_ownership_noun>".

nl_kipple_scrap_steel.name: odd steel device
nl_kipple_scrap_steel.description: The original purpose of this <meta_adjective> <nl_scrap_object> is unknown to you, if it ever had one.

nl_kipple_scrap_alu.name: odd aluminum device
nl_kipple_scrap_alu.description: The original purpose of this <meta_adjective> <nl_scrap_object> is unknown to you, if it ever had one.

nl_kipple_scrap_copper.name: odd copper device
nl_kipple_scrap_copper.description: The original purpose of this <meta_adjective> <nl_scrap_object> is unknown to you, if it ever had one.

nl_kipple_scrap_unob.name: strange metal device
nl_kipple_scrap_unob.description: The original purpose of this <meta_adjective> <nl_scrap_object> is unknown to you, if it ever had one.

nl_kipple_scrap_plastic.name: odd plastic device
nl_kipple_scrap_plastic.description: The original purpose of this <meta_adjective> <nl_scrap_object> is unknown to you, if it ever had one.

nl_kipple_scrap_nanotubes.name: odd metallic device
nl_kipple_scrap_nanotubes.description: The original purpose of this <meta_adjective> <nl_scrap_object> is unknown to you, if it ever had one.

nl_water_bottle.name: strange plastic bottle
nl_water_bottle.description: A slim, one-and-a-half-liter plastic bottle, made of a metalized plastic.  It has a label, but the characters upon it are unintelligible.

broken_stiltwalker_1_1.name: broken stiltwalker
broken_stiltwalker_1_1.description: A broken stiltwalker.  You think it might be possible to disassemble it into parts, someday, but not now.

ls_sd_passcode.name: holographic shard
ls_sd_passcode.description: A palm-sized shard of alien glass, reflecting light in holographic prisms.  You think you can see something in its depths.  Activate it to look closer.

effect.u_message: You glance into the depths of the shard and there is a strange sensation, as if you were experiencing someone's memories, forcing their way into your mind.  They are too foreign for you to comprehend, and they quickly pass from your own memory.  But, you realize you now possess a Passcode.  You fail for a moment to reconcile this understanding, because it's no password as you previously understood it.  It is, in fact, the sound of KÁ!

false_effect.u_message: You glance into the depths of the shard.  You don't see anything.

ls_sd_passcode_used.name: holographic shard (used)
ls_sd_passcode_used.description: A palm-sized shard of alien glass, reflecting light in holographic prisms.

bot_nl_surgicalbot.name: inactive surgical bonebot
bot_nl_surgicalbot.description: An inactive surgical bonebot.  Using this item involves placing it on the ground and activating it.  If reprogrammed successfully, the nurse bot will then identify you as a friendly, roam around or follow you, and assist you in surgeries.  That is, if you can figure out how to reprogram this thing in the first place.

use_action.friendly_msg: The bonebot slowly rises to its full height, each movement accompanied by the sound of snapping sinew.
use_action.hostile_msg: The bonebot slowly rises to its full height, each movement accompanied by the sound of snapping sinew.

broken_nl_surgicalbot_1_1.name: broken surgical bonebot
broken_nl_surgicalbot_1_1.description: A broken surgical bonebot.  Could be gutted for parts.

broken_nl_surgicalbot_assist.name: broken surgical bonebot
broken_nl_surgicalbot_assist.description: A broken surgical bonebot.  Could be gutted for parts.

nl_grav_aware_jig.name: otherworldly clamp-set
nl_grav_aware_jig.description: A set of 7 small clamps set upon a metal guide-board, each capable of rotating around in a circular configuration.  The board itself has several depressed marks, as if they're made to guide cuts, but they don't span any obvious units you're aware of.  The clamps slide in and out, toward each other, with unnatural ease.  You don't know this tool's original purpose, but you think it could clamp things quite efficiently.

nl_laser_mass_indexer.name: laser-guided measurement device
nl_laser_mass_indexer.description: At first glance this appears to be a set of calipers, with the ability to open and close via a spring-loaded handle.  The tips of the pincers each emit a laser that always meet in the center.  On one side of the handle is a small screen that displays various numbers; while you don't recognize most of them, you do notice grams and pounds are displayed, albeit not next to each other.

nl_robo_surg_app.name: mass of robotic arms
nl_robo_surg_app.description: A set 6 robotic arms, folded in on themselves like a dead spider.  There are two large arms.  One ends in a human-like hand with 7 fingers, and the other in what appears to be a dome-like security camera.  The smaller arms are capped with a mix of surgical and construction tools, including a scalpel, a circular saw, some sort of suction device, and a soldering iron.

nl_surg_int_unit.name: surgical bonebot brain
nl_surg_int_unit.description: The core of a surgical bonebot, dug out of its head capsule.  Its shape very much resembles a human brain, but is made of what appears to be hard, dark glass.  It looks a bit like a fancy, and creepy, decoration.

valentine_card.name: valentine card
valentine_card.description: A creased holiday card.  It appears to be a Valentine's Day card from before the Cataclysm.

survnote.name: survivor's note
survnote.description: A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.

childnote.name: child's note
childnote.description: A piece of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in simple, messy handwriting.

note_mutant_alpha_boss.name: child's drawing
note_mutant_alpha_boss.description: A scrap of paper with a faded drawing on it.

toxic_waste_labnote.name: forgotten note
toxic_waste_labnote.description: This grimy note seems out of place, as if someone lost it.

lab_file_bio.name: biology protocol
lab_file_bio.description: A sheet of paper adorned with an atom-and-flask symbol, detailing some questionable biological research.

lab_file_psych.name: psychotherapy protocol
lab_file_psych.description: A sheet of paper bearing an atom-and-cross symbol, pertaining to the mental wellbeing of science staff.

lab_file_portal.name: metatopography protocol
lab_file_portal.description: A sheet of paper bearing an atom-and-flask symbol, filled with incoherent ramblings about alien geometries and how to get to them.

lab_file_mutagen_guide.name: production notes
lab_file_mutagen_guide.description: A collection of documents attesting to the purity of this batch, the performance of instrumentation during its production, and a list of materials used during its production and analysis.  It includes a Certificate of Analysis, each line listing a test method, result, and reviewer's signature, all in service of… something.  On one distinctive page a series of checkmarks slowly appear and fade around <color_yellow>"500 units of catalyst per 500 units of primer"</color> ratio.

lab_file_mutation_testing.name: production tests
lab_file_mutation_testing.description: Accompanying document, that describes tests performed on different subjects.

lab_file_serum_testing.name: production tests
lab_file_serum_testing.description: Accompanying document, that describes tests performed on different subjects.

lab_file_sec.name: security protocol
lab_file_sec.description: A sheet of paper bearing an atom-and-rifle symbol, detailing some very particular security protocols.

bio_file.name: lab report (biology)
bio_file.description: A manila folder containing top-secret test data.  Most of it is unintelligible without knowing the jargon, and the contents have obviously suffered from the chaos in this place, but there are some intact pages you can make sense of.

effect.u_message: log_mutagen_animal

psych_file.name: lab report (psychology)
psych_file.description: A folder full of what appear to be transcripts of confidential psychotherapy sessions.  Most of it is rather trivial, but certain passages catch your eye…

effect.u_message: log_psych

security_file.name: lab report (security)
security_file.description: A manila folder bearing an atom-and-rifle insignia.  Most of it is concerned with shipping logs and personnel rotations, but there is a single page that feels out of place.

effect.u_message: log_sec

newspaper_memorial.name: newspaper page
newspaper_memorial.description: A snippet from a newspaper, celebrating the achievements of the one enshrined.

newest_newspaper.name: newspaper page
newest_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It is possibly one of the last issues printed before New England was overwhelmed.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.

many_years_old_newspaper.name: newspaper page
many_years_old_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It seems to date from several years ago, and you have NO idea how it lasted this long.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.

years_old_newspaper.name: newspaper page
years_old_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It seems to date from a few years ago--amazing it has lasted this long.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.

one_year_old_newspaper.name: newspaper page
one_year_old_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed more than a year ago.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.

months_old_newspaper.name: newspaper page
months_old_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed in the months leading up to the Cataclysm.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.

weeks_old_newspaper.name: newspaper page
weeks_old_newspaper.description: A single sheet of newspaper broadsheet.  It was printed in the weeks leading up to the Cataclysm.  Most of the information is terribly trivial or out of date, but one thing catches your eye briefly.

death_note.name: note
death_note.description: A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.

evac_pamphlet.name: FEMA evacuation pamphlet
evac_pamphlet.description:
Welcome to your Emergency Survival Shelter.  We hope your stay here will be short and comfortable.  Provided are an emergency blanket, high-visibility jacket, gas mask, and food and water rations for one day, as well as an emergency lighter and flashlight.  There are further supplies in the communal cabinets should the facility be over its intended capacity.  These resources are checked and updated by FEMA on a regular basis, but if you find some items missing, please contact a FEMA supervisor at your earliest convenience.

Please wait in the shelter until an official evacuation transport arrives to take you to your homes or, in the event of a major disaster, to the nearest evacuation gathering point.

In the event that you have been evacuated under violent circumstances, FEMA recommends taking cover in the shelter's basement until help arrives.  Remember: if you leave the shelter, we cannot find you to take you to safety.

missing_poster_adult.name: missing person poster
missing_poster_adult.description: An official poster notifying the public of a missing person, and requesting that anyone with information contact the listed phone number.

missing_poster_child.name: missing child poster
missing_poster_child.description: An official poster notifying the public of a missing child, and requesting that anyone with information contact the listed phone number.

missing_poster_dog.name: missing dog poster
missing_poster_dog.description: A handmade poster notifying passersby about someone's missing dog, and requesting that anyone with information contact the listed phone number.

missing_poster_cat.name: missing cat poster
missing_poster_cat.description: A handmade poster notifying passersby about someone's missing cat, and requesting that anyone with information contact the listed phone number.

movie_poster.name: movie poster
movie_poster.description: Posters promoting movies that were in theaters when the Cataclysm hit.

variants.name: Last Stand 2: Still Standing movie poster
Fyreguard: A Tale as Old as Time movie poster

wallet_photo.name: photograph
wallet_photo.description: A small picture of something or somebody important to the owner, designed to be safely tucked into a wallet.

home_picture.name: picture
home_picture.description: A medium picture of something that the owner wished to decorate their house with.

xedra_shack_checklist.name: incomplete checklist
xedra_shack_checklist.description:
A sheet of paper with a checklist titled "TO DO BEFORE JULY RESIGNATION":
 [X] Acquire activity suit
 [X] Acquire respirator
 [X] Shield gear against THEM
 [ ] Shield walls against THEM
 [X] Install security door
 [ ] 6 months food, water
 [X] Order appliances, panels, radio
 [ ] Install solar panels
 [X] Install radio gear
 [X] Install air purifiers
 [ ] Fix the old boat
 [ ] Buy a gun
 [ ] Finish research statement for faculty apps

arrow_fire_hardened_fletched.name: crude wooden arrow
arrow_fire_hardened_fletched.description: A crude pointed wooden shaft with a notch at the back.

arrow_field_point_fletched.name: wooden bodkin arrow
arrow_field_point_fletched.description: A fletched wooden arrow shaft with a pointed tip.

arrow_plastic.name: wooden rubber blunt arrow
arrow_plastic.description: A fletched wooden arrow shaft with a blunt rubber tip.  Can stun weaker enemies.

arrow_small_game_fletched.name: simple wooden small game arrow
arrow_small_game_fletched.description: A simple fletched wooden arrow shaft with a blunted tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.

arrow_wood.name: wooden broadhead arrow
arrow_wood.description: A fletched wooden arrow shaft with a bladed tip.

arrow_heavy_fire_hardened_fletched.name: simple wooden arrow
arrow_heavy_fire_hardened_fletched.description: A simple fletched wooden arrow shaft with a fire-hardened and sharpened tip.

arrow_heavy_field_point_fletched.name: wooden small game arrow
arrow_heavy_field_point_fletched.description: A fletched wooden arrow shaft with a blunt tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.

arrow_wood_heavy.name: makeshift wooden arrow
arrow_wood_heavy.description: A simple fletched wooden arrow shaft with a makeshift arrowhead.

arrow_metal_sharpened_fletched.name: makeshift metal arrow
arrow_metal_sharpened_fletched.description: A simple fletched wooden arrow shaft with a sharpened makeshift tip.

arrow_metal.name: aluminum broadhead arrow
arrow_metal.description: A fletched aluminum arrow shaft with a bladed tip.  Useful for maximizing damage to the target.

arrow_metal_bodkin.name: aluminum field point arrow
arrow_metal_bodkin.description: A fletched aluminum arrow shaft with a pointed tip.  Useful for piercing armor.

arrow_metal_target.name: aluminum small game arrow
arrow_metal_target.description: A fletched aluminum arrow shaft with a blunt tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.

arrow_cf.name: carbon fiber hunting arrow
arrow_cf.description: A fletched carbon fiber arrow shaft with an expanding broadhead tip.  Deals impressive damage to targets.

arrow_meteor.name: emerald arrow
arrow_meteor.description: A fletched lance carved from inscrutable green stone.  Impractically heavy, its difficult to imagine who or what could have fired it from a bow.

flamable_arrow.name: flammable arrow
flamable_arrow.description: This arrow has a rag soaked in a flammable liquid wrapped around the shaft near the head.  You need to light it before shooting.

arrow_flamming.name: flaming arrow
arrow_flamming.description: This arrow has a flaming rag wrapped around the shaft near the head.  You should shoot it soon before it burns through the rag and fuel.

selfbow.name: survival bow
selfbow.description: A weak bow crudely crafted from a single uncured wood stave.  Weak and wildly inaccurate, but easy to make.

shortbow.name: short bow
shortbow.description: Emphasizing portability and agility over power, this all-wood bow is suitable for small game and harassing enemies.

compbow.name: compound hunting bow
compbow.description: A high-powered bow with shaped cams and extra cables for high-velocity shots that can be used effectively by fairly strong archers.  Currently set to a medium weight.

use_action.msg: You tighten the limbs, increasing the strength of the bow.

compbow_high.name: compound hunting bow (high)
compbow_high.description: A high-powered bow with shaped cams and extra cables for high-velocity shots that can be used effectively by very strong archers.  Currently set to a high weight, and ready to cause some real damage - if you can draw it.

use_action.msg: You loosen the limbs, decreasing the strength of the bow.

compbow_low.name: compound hunting bow (low)
compbow_low.description: A high-powered bow with shaped cams and extra cables for high-velocity shots that can be used effectively by average archers.  Currently set to a low weight, making it much easier to draw.

use_action.msg: You tighten the limbs, increasing the strength of the bow.

compositebow.name: composite bow (heavy)
compositebow.description: A traditionally-constructed bow made from wood, bone, and sinew.  It has a rather high draw weight.

reflexbow.name: composite bow (light)
reflexbow.description: A traditionally-constructed bow made from wood, horn and sinew.  It has a moderate draw weight.

recurbow.name: modern recurve bow
recurbow.description: A modern fiberglass bow that can be used effectively by those of somewhat above-average strength.

takedown_recurbow.name: takedown recurve bow
takedown_recurbow.description: A modern fiberglass bow that can be taken down for storage.  For use by those of somewhat above-average strength.  Use it to disassemble it for storage.

takedown_recurbow_folded.name: takedown recurve bow (folded)
takedown_recurbow_folded.description: A modern fiberglass bow that has been taken down for storage.  For use by those of somewhat above-average strength.  Use it to assemble it into shape.

longbow.name: longbow
longbow.description: A six-foot wooden hunting bow in the English style.  It can be used effectively by those of above-average strength.

woodgreatbow.name: wooden greatbow
woodgreatbow.description: An extremely large, stiff longbow, made with enormous limbs and a thick string to take an immense amount of energy.  Takes incredible strength to draw.

greatbow_meteor.name: blackwood greatbow
greatbow_meteor.description: A tall bow made from very finely grained black wood.  Its large asymmetrical limbs are improperly shaped to fire arrows of regular length, and they require incredible strength to pull back.

compgreatbow.name: compound greatbow
compgreatbow.description: An extremely large, powerful compound bow, made with enormous limbs and a thick string to take an immense amount of energy.  Takes incredible strength to draw.

reflexrecurvebow.name: Olympic style target bow
reflexrecurvebow.description: A highly refined, modern bow, but not all that useful, as the draw weight is very low.

atlatl.name: atlatl
atlatl.description: Although spear throwing contraptions were used throughout the entire world, this design in particular hails from Mesoamericas.  It was especially popular among Peruvian natives, despite the Nahuatl origin of the name.  It is essentially a carved piece of wooden shaft with a hollowed space to place the projectile of the same name.  It'll also do well as a melee weapon in a pinch.

steel_atlatl_spear.name: steel tipped atlatl spear
steel_atlatl_spear.description: A steal tipped and fletched atlatl spear, ready to throw with an atlatl.  Not suitable for close combat.

bronze_atlatl_spear.name: bronze tipped atlatl spear
bronze_atlatl_spear.description: A bronze tipped and fletched atlatl spear, ready to throw with an atlatl.  Not suitable for close combat.

wood_atlatl_spear.name: wooden atlatl spear
wood_atlatl_spear.description: A fletched atlatl spear with a sharpened wooden tip.  Not suitable for close combat.

ballista.name: carroballista
ballista.description: A smaller, mounted version of the Greco-Roman ballista, for those situations where the crossbow just isn't enough.  Unlike crossbows, it is powered by a torsion spring that is wound by a hand crank and uses two prods instead of one bow.  Its size and design make it unfeasible to be used by hand, requiring it to be set down or mounted to a vehicle.

bolt_ballista_steel.name: ballista bolt
bolt_ballista_steel.description: A big, steel tipped projectile, twice the size of a normal bolt and much heavier than one.  It gets thicker towards the base, and is fletched there with the protrusions of the shaft itself.

bolt_crude.name: crude wooden bolt
bolt_crude.description: A crude pointed wooden crossbow bolt with a notch at the back.

bolt_simple_wood.name: simple wooden bolt
bolt_simple_wood.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a fire-hardened and sharpened tip.

bolt_simple_small_game.name: simple wooden small game bolt
bolt_simple_small_game.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a blunted tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.

bolt_makeshift.name: makeshift wooden bolt
bolt_makeshift.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a makeshift head.

bolt_wood.name: wooden broadhead bolt
bolt_wood.description: A fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a bladed tip.  Useful for maximizing damage to the target.

bolt_wood_bodkin.name: wooden bodkin bolt
bolt_wood_bodkin.description: A fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a pointed tip.  Useful for piercing armor.

bolt_wood_small_game.name: wooden small game bolt
bolt_wood_small_game.description: A fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a blunt tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.

bolt_metal.name: makeshift metal bolt
bolt_metal.description: A simple fletched wooden crossbow bolt with a sharpened makeshift tip.

bolt_steel.name: aluminum broadhead bolt
bolt_steel.description: A fletched aluminum crossbow bolt with a bladed tip.  Useful for maximizing damage to the target.

bolt_steel_bodkin.name: aluminum field point bolt
bolt_steel_bodkin.description: A fletched aluminum crossbow bolt with a pointed tip.  Useful for piercing armor.

bolt_steel_target.name: aluminum small game bolt
bolt_steel_target.description: A fletched aluminum crossbow bolt with a blunt tip.  Useful for hunting small woodland creatures without splattering them all over the ground.

bolt_cf.name: carbon fiber hunting bolt
bolt_cf.description: A fletched carbon fiber crossbow bolt shaft with an expanding broadhead tip.  Deals impressive damage to targets.

bullet_crossbow.name: bullet crossbow
bullet_crossbow.description: A modified version of the classic crossbow which utilizes stones as projectiles instead of the traditional quarrel.  Primarily intended for hunting small game.

hand_crossbow.name: pistol crossbow
hand_crossbow.description: A small, concealable, pistol-like crossbow.  It's weak due to its small size and draw, so it is best suited for hunting small game.

crossbow.name: wood crossbow
crossbow.description: An all-wood hunting crossbow.  It is not powerful enough to deal with zombies, but it may still be used for hunting.

compositecrossbow.name: composite crossbow
compositecrossbow.description: A traditionally-constructed crossbow made from wood, bone, and sinew.

compcrossbow.name: compound crossbow
compcrossbow.description: A high-power crossbow with shaped cams and extra cables for high-power shots.  An integrated cocking rope assists the user with string pulling.

huge_crossbow.name: heavy crossbow
huge_crossbow.description: A HUGE medieval crossbow from Germany with a very slow, difficult reloading process.  Its tension is so powerful that you feel it shake after firing.

rep_crossbow.name: repeating crossbow
rep_crossbow.description: A custom-made crossbow with a clever mechanism that loads and fires bolts in a single motion.  It has a wooden magazine that holds up to 10 bolts.

LAW.name: disposable rocket launcher
LAW.description: A disposable light anti-tank rocket launcher.  Once fired, it cannot be reloaded and must be disposed of.

surv_rocket_launcher.name: crude rocket launcher
surv_rocket_launcher.description: An improvised, direct ignition launcher for home-made rockets.  Essentially, a thick-walled steel pipe, equipped with a pilot light, several batteries and a simple circuit board.  Effective only at medium range, barely.

watercannon.name: water cannon
watercannon.description: A water cannon from a fire truck.  Mounted on a vehicle, it could be used to stop fires or "protesters".

bbgun.name: BB gun
bbgun.description: An air gun modeled to look like a small lever-action rifle.  Designed for young shooters and low-risk target practice, it's fairly accurate, but the BBs it fires deal nearly no damage.

varmint_airgun.name: varmint air rifle
varmint_airgun.description: A cheap varmint air rifle chambered in .177, suitable for hunting small game.

sling.name: sling
sling.description: A leather sling, easy to use and accurate.  It uses pebbles as ammunition.

slingshot.name: slingshot
slingshot.description: A forked piece of wood with an elastic band stretched between two of its tips.  Can launch tiny pebbles and similar things at high speeds.

staff_sling.name: staff sling
staff_sling.description: This staff can launch rocks with a whipping motion that sends them flying much further and faster than throwing them.

wristrocket.name: brace slingshot
wristrocket.description: A modern slingshot with a wrist brace, allowing it to fire tiny objects slightly more forcefully than a simple wooden slingshot.

sling_long.name: long sling
sling_long.description: A long sling, still easy to use and accurate.  It's length allows the user to launch pebbles with great force and range

fishspear.name: wooden fishing spear
fishspear.description: An underwater fishing spear made from wood tipped with steel.  It's very light, but doesn't have much range.

c_fishspear.name: carbon fiber fishing spear
c_fishspear.description: An underwater fishing spear made from carbon fiber.  It's very light, but doesn't have much range.

m_fishspear.name: metal fishing spear
m_fishspear.description: An underwater fishing spear made from metal.  It's light, but doesn't have much range.

airspeargun.name: pneumatic speargun
airspeargun.description: A sophisticated underwater fishing implement designed to fire a specialized type of spear, with a dedicated hand pump to use with it.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

doublespeargun.name: double roller speargun
doublespeargun.description: Underwater fishing device, this speargun has set of two rubber bands.  It doesn't make you able to load two spears, but it can put a bit more power into shot.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

long_speargun.name: long speargun
long_speargun.description: A long underwater fishing implement designed to fire a specialized type of spear using tension in a rubber band.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

speargun.name: speargun
speargun.description: An underwater fishing implement designed to fire a specialized type of spear using tension in a rubber band.  While highly effective when used underwater, it is nearly useless on dry land.

bolas.name: bolas
bolas.description: Some ropes with weights, designed to tangle the legs of a target when thrown, usually at an animal.  Used by the Gauchos of Argentina.

disc_golf.name: disc
disc_golf.description: A plastic disc made for playing disc golf.  It is smaller and denser than a normal frisbee.

frisbee.name: frisbee
frisbee.description: A plastic frisbee made for outdoor games.

net.name: net
net.description: A mesh of string and weights, traditionally used to catch fish and to entangle opponents in combat.

lawn_dart.name: lawn dart
lawn_dart.description: A large plastic dart made for outdoor games.

weighted_dart.name: weighted dart
weighted_dart.description: A lead weighted dart for throwing at enemies, like the Romans used.

throwing_axe.name: throwing axe
throwing_axe.description: A lightweight hatchet made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and light weight make it unsuitable for use as a tool.

throwing_knife.name: throwing knife
throwing_knife.description: A thin, flat knife made for throwing.  Its ineffective cutting edge and odd shape make it unsuitable for use as a tool.

throwing_stick.name: throwing stick
throwing_stick.description: A stick carved into a shape suitable for throwing at a target.  It's not a boomerang, so don't expect it to return to your hand.

javelin_fletched.name: iron war dart
javelin_fletched.description: An iron-tipped fletched throwing spear with a throwing loop for extra range.

javelin_fletched_bronze.name: bronze war dart
javelin_fletched_bronze.description: A bronze-tipped fletched throwing spear with a throwing loop for extra range.

nether_huntsman_javelin.name: huntsman outgrowth
nether_huntsman_javelin.description: A wet alien rod with a sharp point at the end, vaguely shaped like a javelin of sorts.  It is heavier than what you expected, and gives off a weird acidic smell you can't quite describe.

yrax_metaljet_cannon.name: ferro-hydraulic cannon
yrax_metaljet_cannon.description: The V29 laser pistol was one of the first handheld laser weapons.  It is larger than most traditional handguns, but has no recoil whatsoever.

altered_exposed_wiring_prototype.name: exposed-wiring prototype
altered_exposed_wiring_prototype.description: Some kind of prototypical electronic device with exposed wiring.  Some of the wires have bare ends that could be connected together.

altered_phone.name: Bakelite phone
altered_phone.description: A vintage, bright-red Bakelite phone of famous Swedish design.  It would look almost normal, if not for the fact that its rotary dial has been replaced with a doorknob.

altered_comb.name: golden comb
altered_comb.description: A small, delicate golden comb.  It was once carefully engraved, but time has smoothed its designs to illegibility.

altered_keyring.name: shifting keyring
altered_keyring.description: A smooth ring of steel, heavy under the weight of numerous keys.  The designs of the keys change over time, but none will fit any keyhole you have ever found.

altered_rubicks_cube.name: engraved cube
altered_rubicks_cube.description: A small cube of smooth rock.  A uniform grid of nine squares is engraved in each of its faces.

altered_teapot.name: Utah teapot
altered_teapot.description: A squat teapot with a minimalist design.  Its surface shines under the glow of unseen light sources.

altered_stopwatch.name: glitching stopwatch
altered_stopwatch.description: A small digital stopwatch, looking slightly old by today's standards.  Its digital display prints ever-changing gibberish.

altered_shirt.name: Hawaiian shirt
altered_shirt.description: A slightly worn button-down shirt with a tropical pattern, straight out of the 80's.  You swear that every time you look away and look back, the pattern changes subtly.

altered_badge.name: defaced badge
altered_badge.description: A strange golden badge in the shape of a shield with scratched out lettering.  The faceless figures decorating the badge seem taller and thinner than ordinary humans.

altered_sunglasses.name: strange sunglasses
altered_sunglasses.description: A pair of thin, round sunglasses.  The tinted glass seems to reflect the same shade of baleful orange light no matter what light it reflects.

altered_scissors.name: antique scissors
altered_scissors.description: A pair of ornately decorated steel scissors.  The handle is decorated with vicious-looking birds.

altered_necklace.name: antique silver locket
altered_necklace.description: A heart-shaped silver locket with an black-and-white image of a smiling woman in it.  Her eyes seem to follow you whenever you look at it.

altered_jacket.name: varsity jacket
altered_jacket.description: A jacket traditionally worn by school athletes.  The logo of the school has an oddly detailed fractal pattern that draws your eye in whenever you look at it.

altered_apron.name: ambiguous apron
altered_apron.description: A long apron with a plain pattern on it.  Your eyes can't seem to decide what color it is.

mp3_reverberation.name: red mp3 player (off)
mp3_reverberation.description:
A light-red mp3 player, you feel the text on the screen says "TRAVEL // JOURNEY".  Under that, "Let's go on an adventure!"
The screen is dark, it's powered off.

use_action.message: You put in the earbuds and turn on the device.

mp3_on_reverberation.name: red mp3 player (on)
mp3_on_reverberation.description:
A light-red mp3 player, you feel the text on the screen says "TRAVEL // JOURNEY".  Under that, "Let's go on an adventure!"
The screen is blank, it's powered on.

use_action.message: You turn off the device.

inert_glowing_string.name: glowing string
inert_glowing_string.description: A plastic test-tube housing a fluorescent purple string of unknown material.  The string gently flickers and twitches on its own.

string_dimension_hypercube.name: transparent hypercube
string_dimension_hypercube.description: A transparent cube within a cube.  It seems to be made of clear plastic or glass, but it feels quite solid, despite also seeming weightless.  Impossibly, the inside seems larger than the outside - as you tilt it here and there, you can peer into its depths.  It's full of stars.

higlands_teleport.name: landscape miniature
higlands_teleport.description: A desolate scene depicts a sea of fog broken by great mountains and jagged ruins.  The painting seems to shift ever so slightly, as if the winds depicted within were real.

higlands_funeral_crown.name: funeral crown
higlands_funeral_crown.description: A golden circlet adorned with filigree leaves and pearls.  The remnants of a white silk veil remain attached to the crown.

highland_funeral_mask.name: funeral mask
highland_funeral_mask.description: A serene visage carved from a large piece of ivory.  Its internal surface is completely smooth, and adorned with a a series of concentric bronze rings and grooves.  You could wear it over your face, but it lacks any way to see or comfortably breathe through it.

coin_highlands.name: silver obol
coin_highlands.description: A small silver coin, looted from the dead.  Its face shows the faded profile of a man, the reverse depicts a tree crowned by three starlike eyes.

highland_shroud.name: burial shroud
highland_shroud.description: A cloak of thin, faded cloth that was used to wrap a corpse.  Its deep blue, and embroidered has been embroidered with a starmap in silver thread.

highland_censer.name: censer
highland_censer.description: A small bronze vessel used to burn incense and other aromatic substances.  Its adorned with a variety of natural and knotwork designs.

highland_purple_incense.name: purple incense
highland_purple_incense.description: Small shards of a crystalline substance.  It has a strange smell, mostly of ozone.

highland_yellow_incense.name: yellow incense
highland_yellow_incense.description: Small stones of fragrant resin.  They still maintain a faint scent of citrus and pine.

highland_green_incense.name: green incense
highland_green_incense.description: Pearls of glossy green resin are mixed with small leaves and wood chips.  They have a fresh, herbal scent.

highland_black_incense.name: black incense
highland_black_incense.description: A very fine and smooth powder.  It smells like it has already been burnt.

highland_red_incense.name: red incense
highland_red_incense.description: Small branches and dried red flowers.  They have a weak acrid scent, like burnt coffee grounds.

highland_blue_incense.name: blue incense
highland_blue_incense.description: Dead grubs float in some foul smelling blue gel.  They have an unnerving number of legs.

highland_white_incense.name: white incense
highland_white_incense.description: Milk-white spiral shells of some kind of mollusk.  The dead creatures inside still have a faint salty scent.

highland_golden_incense.name: golden incense
highland_golden_incense.description: The dried remnants of a strange flower that was parasitized by golden mold.  It has a strange chemical scent, like honey mixed with gasoline.

monolith_disc.name: inscribed disc
monolith_disc.description: A thin, palm-sized disc of incredibly dense stone, engraved with meaningless swirls.  Its surface seems to repel grime and debris, and it refuses to tarnish or scratch.

monolith_brick.name: warped brick
monolith_brick.description: This brick of too-dense stone is warped in a way that just barely makes it worthless as a building material.  Its smooth surface is unmarred by texture, dirt, or color.

resin_chunk.name: alien resin chunk
resin_chunk.description: A shattered fragment of alien resin.  It looks a bit like a large piece of sea glass, frosted and gritty with the edges rounded off.  It is somewhat warm to the touch.

alien_pod_resin.name: alien resin pod
alien_pod_resin.description: A large pod the size of a beer keg, filled with gooey alien resin.  Squeezing it firmly causes resin to squirt from the broken stalk at the end, hardening within a few seconds of being exposed to the air.

alien_fern.name: alien fern branch
alien_fern.description: A branching trunk of leaves from a massive fern, about two feet long and a couple of feet across in diameter when including the leaves.  Maybe one day you'll think of something to make with a giant fern.

exodii_chassis.name: Exodii chassis
exodii_chassis.description: This roughly hexagonal frame and associated bodywork looks like it was constructed as a single piece.  The fitting holes and attachments are extremely durable, despite showing signs of heavy wear and repair.  The structure is versatile, and could probably be engineered to serve a number of different heavy combat roles.

exodii_drone_chassis.name: Exodii drone chassis
exodii_drone_chassis.description: This small, roughly hexagonal frame and associated bodywork looks like it was constructed as a single piece.  The fitting holes and attachments are extremely durable, despite showing signs of heavy wear and repair.  The structure is versatile, and could probably be engineered to serve a number of different heavy combat roles.

cyborg_matrix.name: cybernetic neural matrix
cyborg_matrix.description: A series of tanks and tubes with ports for fluids, electricity, and input and output, this complex arrangement is made to house a brain and spine, and the most difficult to replace organs for keeping them alive.

exodii_computer.name: unfamiliar electronic thingy
exodii_computer.description: The wiring and general shape suggest to you that this is a computer, or at least some sort of electronic device, but what it is and what role it serves is lost on you.  It's heavy and sturdy in construction.

exodii_module.name: inscribed metal plates
exodii_module.description: This device looks electronic, but is unfamiliar.  It is a series of tightly fitted coppery-looking rings, set concentrically.  Wires run from each ring to an axis in the middle.

exodii_micro_computer.name: small unfamiliar electronic thingy
exodii_micro_computer.description: The wiring and general shape suggest to you that this is a tiny computer, or at least some sort of electronic device, but what it is and what role it serves is lost on you.  It's small enough to fit into your palm.

exodii_micro_module.name: inscribed metal rings
exodii_micro_module.description: This device looks electronic, but is unfamiliar.  It is a series of tightly fitted coppery-looking nuts, set concentrically.  Wires run from each nut to an axis in the middle.

exodii_sensor.name: cybernetic sensor
exodii_sensor.description: From the large glassy eye - the size of a small dinner plate - in the front, you deduce this is some sort of camera.  None of the inner workings make any sense to you nor resemble any camera you've seen before.

exodii_motor.name: rotary device
exodii_motor.description: You assume from the coils of coppery wire and the protruding piston that this is some sort of motor or generator, but the design doesn't look similar to anything you've seen before, and you can't figure out how to get it to work.

exodii_scanner_dish.name: engraved parabolic dish
exodii_scanner_dish.description: This hefty parabolic dish is engraved with an unrecognizable pattern of symbols that might, at a guess, be some sort of circuitry pattern - or maybe a religious incantation.

exodii_portalizer.name: oblong device
exodii_portalizer.description: Perfectly smooth, cool to the touch, and a dull blue-gray color, this looks almost like a perfect riverstone at first glance.  Its artificial nature is betrayed upon closer inspection by a network of intricate patterns visible as a slight difference in the reflection of light off its surface.

exodii_ingot_aluminum.name: enormous aluminum ingot
exodii_ingot_aluminum.description: A block of pure aluminum at least as big as a dishwasher.

exodii_ingot_plastic.name: enormous plastic block
exodii_ingot_plastic.description: A single enormous brick of plastic, big enough for you to curl up inside if it were hollow.

exodii_ingot_lc_steel.name: enormous steel ingot
exodii_ingot_lc_steel.description: A monolithic block of low carbon steel.

exodii_ingot_tin.name: enormous tin ingot
exodii_ingot_tin.description: An enormous ingot of pure tin.

exodii_ingot_copper.name: enormous copper ingot
exodii_ingot_copper.description: A massive solid piece of copper, covered by a blue-green patina.

exodii_ingot_zinc.name: enormous zinc ingot
exodii_ingot_zinc.description: An absolutely massive block of pure zinc.  Bet you didn't expect that - nobody expects zinc.

exodii_ingot_lead.name: enormous lead ingot
exodii_ingot_lead.description: A block of lead so huge you don't even want to think about how heavy it is.

exodii_wire_kit.name: CBM interface wire kit
exodii_wire_kit.description: A collection of hand-soldered wires leading to plugs and what looks like an exotic micro controller.  The plugs look like they could be attached to you, assuming you have an SNI (Standard Neurobionic Interface).

exodii_ac_kit.name: external climate control kit
exodii_ac_kit.description: A collection of mismatched pipes, wires, and a central device that looks like an exotic micro controller.  Almost looks like it could be used for some form of central cooling.

yrax_electronics.name: woven metallics
yrax_electronics.description: Thin metallic strips with an ochre sheen, interlaid together into a flexible mesh.  You can't tell whether it's a circuit, a heat dissipation component, or a mechanical actuator.

yrax_metal.name: alien metal plating
yrax_metal.description: A slightly curved plate of white metal.  It readily collects low amounts of static charge.

yrax_scrap.name: alien metal scrap
yrax_scrap.description: A collection of tiny metal strips, spheres, and other geometric primitives taken from a disassembled alien machine.

yrax_computer.name: monolithic machine
yrax_computer.description: A very heavy sphere, presumably made almost entirely of gold.  The complex pattern etched across its surface implies that it might serve some exotic function.

yrax_robotics.name: robotic innards
yrax_robotics.description: A robotic assembly of unknown function.  Entirely made from tight-fitting metal plates, it somewhat resembles the interior of a mechanical clock.

yrax_sensor.name: sensor assembly
yrax_sensor.description: A carved sphere embedded with small black glass screens.  It's probably a sensor of some kind.

nether_huntsman_spike.name: undergrown alien spike
nether_huntsman_spike.description: A flexible and sharp elongated rod that gets thinner on one end, weak and clearly underdeveloped.  It has been harvested from a dead alien creature.

nether_huntsman_armorpiece_small.name: alien armor fragment
nether_huntsman_armorpiece_small.description: A small chunk of alien armor, made of material that resembles bone.  Once being a part of a bigger structure, now crumbling in your hands.

nether_huntsman_armorpiece_big.name: alien armor plate
nether_huntsman_armorpiece_big.description: A big piece of alien armor plating, made of bone-like material.  The outer part is perforated with countless holes, reminiscent of some sort of twisted coral.  It has barbed hooks growing on the inner side.

nether_huntsman_statuette.name: strange statuette
nether_huntsman_statuette.description: A small statuette of some kind of fantastical creature is carved out of a rough, unnatural material.  It seems remarkably well made.

ephemeral_gem.name: ephemeral gemstone
ephemeral_gem.description: You know it as a mesmerizing black gem with beautifully etched surfaces, despite only being able to see a pure void in its place when looked at.  You cannot gauge its weight or even feel it in your hands, but it's yours now.

yrax_trinket.name: tiny golden plate
yrax_trinket.description: A very small rectangular strip of metal, presumably made of gold.  One side is etched with some barely noticeable but incredibly detailed artwork of something you don't recognize, possibly a diagram of sorts.  Sometimes you feel it resonating gently.

string_dimension_computer.name: otherworldly box
string_dimension_computer.description: An extremely heavy cube with rounded edges, made of a very dense metal.  It has a swing-open door that hides neatly packaged electronics of some unknown design.

oven_stovetop.name: dismantled stovetop
oven_stovetop.description: The dismantled stovetop of an electric oven.  Some electric components are still attached, but the heating elements have been pulled off.

oven_cabinet.name: stripped oven cabinet
oven_cabinet.description: A large, hefty steel box that was once the main body of an electric oven.  Most of the parts have been stripped.  It could be further disassembled into base materials.

oven_controls.name: oven control panel
oven_controls.description: The control panel and LCD from a dismantled electric oven.

oven_door.name: oven door
oven_door.description: The removed glass and steel door of an electric oven.

oven_broiler_pan.name: broiler pan
oven_broiler_pan.description: A simple sheet metal drawer that goes in the bottom of an electric oven.

bone.name: bone
bone.description: A bone from some creature or other.  Could be used in cooking and crafting.

large_bone.name: large bone
large_bone.description: A huge bone of a large creature.

bone_tainted.name: tainted bone
bone_tainted.description: A rotten, brittle bone from some unnatural creature or other.  Could be used to make some stuff, like glue, but it's useless as a fuel and eating it will poison you.

bone_human.name: human bone
bone_human.description: A bone from a human being.  Could be used to make some stuff, if you're feeling sufficiently ghoulish.

bone_demihuman.name: demihuman bone
bone_demihuman.description: A bone from a demihuman being.  Could be used to make some stuff, if you're feeling sufficiently ghoulish.

meal_bone.name: bone meal
meal_bone.description: This bone meal can be used to craft fertilizer and some other things.

meal_bone_tainted.name: tainted bone meal
meal_bone_tainted.description: This is a grayish bone meal made from rotten bones.

skewer_bone.name: bone skewer
skewer_bone.description: A thin skewer carved from bone.  Sadly, it won't make squirrel on a stick taste better.

skull_human.name: human skull
skull_human.description: The skull of a human being.  Carrying this around probably isn't going to win you any friends.

skull_human_tainted.name: tainted human skull
skull_human_tainted.description: The stained skull of what was once a human being.  It is rotted and noticeably warped from its lively form.  Carrying this around probably isn't going to win you any friends.

skull_canis_small.name: tiny canine skull
skull_canis_small.description: The skull of a tiny canine, likely a Chihuahua or another similarly sized dog breed.

skull_canis_medium.name: small canine skull
skull_canis_medium.description: The skull of a small canine, likely a small dog breed.

skull_canis.name: large canine skull
skull_canis.description: The skull of a wolf or a dog.  Essential material for building an articulated wolf skeleton.

skull_canis_triclopean.name: triclopean canine skull
skull_canis_triclopean.description: The skull of a what looks like a dog, although it has an extra eye socket.

skull_feline_small.name: small feline skull
skull_feline_small.description: The skull of a small feline, likely a house cat.

skull_feline_medium.name: medium feline skull
skull_feline_medium.description: The skull of a medium-sized feline, likely a bobcat.

skull_rodent.name: rodent skull
skull_rodent.description: The skull of a small rodent, most likely a rat.

skull_rabbit.name: rabbit skull
skull_rabbit.description: The skull of a rabbit or a hare.

skull_beaver_huge.name: dambreaker skull
skull_beaver_huge.description: A skull of an abnormally large mutant beaver.

skull_pig.name: pig skull
skull_pig.description: The skull of a pig, either a domestic or a wild one.

skull_sheep.name: sheep skull
skull_sheep.description: The skull of a domestic sheep.

skull_goat.name: goat skull
skull_goat.description: The skull of a goat with the horns still attached.

skull_bovine.name: cow skull
skull_bovine.description: The skull of a bovine, likely a domestic cow, with the horns still attached.

skull_equine.name: horse skull
skull_equine.description: The skull of a horse.  Given the circumstances you can be pretty sure it was a domestic horse.

skull_cervine.name: deer skull
skull_cervine.description: The skull of a cervine, either a deer or a reindeer, with the antlers still attached.

skull_cervine_spideer.name: spideer skull
skull_cervine_spideer.description: The skull of a cervine, with the antlers still attached…  But why does it have eight eye sockets?

skull_moose.name: moose skull
skull_moose.description: The skull of a moose, unmistakable thanks to the antler shape.

skull_moose_tusked.name: tusked moose skull
skull_moose_tusked.description: The skull of a moose, unmistakable thanks to the antler shape and… tusks?  Okay, maybe this did not belong to a normal moose after all.

chem_potassium_alum.name: potassium alum
chem_potassium_alum.description: A handful of small, water-soluble white crystals with a watery metallic odor, historically used for many different purposes.  Also known as potash alum and potassium aluminum sulfate; often called simply alum, as it's the most important member of the generic class of compounds called alums.

dye_powder.name: cloth dye powder
dye_powder.description: A handful of powdered colorful cloth dye, which can be used to dye many fabrics if combined with water and some mordant.

chem_calcium_chloride.name: calcium chloride
chem_calcium_chloride.description: A handful of white, odorless, strongly hygroscopic powder with an extremely salty taste.  Often used as a de-icing agent or as desiccant.

chem_washing_soda.name: washing soda
chem_washing_soda.description: A handful of white, odorless, hygroscopic powder.  Often used as a cleansing agent and for glass manufacturing, among other things.  Also known as sodium carbonate or soda ash.

chem_baking_soda.name: baking soda
chem_baking_soda.description: A handful of white, odorless powder with a slightly salty alkaline taste.  Often used in baking as a leavening agent, and has many other niche uses.  Also known as sodium bicarbonate.

mercury.name: mercury
mercury.description: Elemental mercury, unique in that it is a liquid under normal temperatures and pressures.  Known for its use in thermometers.

chem_mercury_fulminate.name: mercury fulminate
chem_mercury_fulminate.description: A handful of gray powder that is highly sensitive to friction, heat, and shock.  Often used as a primary explosive, and historically in percussion caps and primers for self-contained firearm ammunition.

chem_sodium.name: sodium
chem_sodium.description: A chunk of sodium, a highly reactive soft gray metal, immersed in anhydrous mineral oil to prevent it from oxidizing in the air during storage.

chem_potassium.name: potassium
chem_potassium.description: A chunk of potassium, a highly reactive soft gray metal, immersed in anhydrous mineral oil to prevent it from oxidizing in the air during storage.

chem_lead_azide.name: lead azide
chem_lead_azide.description: A handful of white powder that is used in detonators to detonate secondary explosives.  It replaced mercury fulminate in modern ammunition primers.

buckle_steel.name: steel buckle
buckle_steel.description: A steel buckle, like the kind usually found on belts.

button_plastic.name: button
button_plastic.description: A button, usually found on clothing.

snapfastener_steel.name: steel snap fastener
snapfastener_steel.description: A steel snap fastener, usually found on clothing.

touch_fastener.name: touch fastener
touch_fastener.description: A pair of cloth strips, one of which has tiny hooks and another with tiny loops.  Useful as a fastener for clothing and footwear.

zipper_long_plastic.name: long plastic zipper
zipper_long_plastic.description: A long zipper made from plastic, usually found on clothing.

zipper_short_plastic.name: short plastic zipper
zipper_short_plastic.description: A short zipper made from plastic, usually found on footwear or clothing pockets.

glass_shard.name: glass shard
glass_shard.description: A broken shard of glass covered in sharp edges.  You could use it as a weapon, but you might want to wear gloves.

use_action.done_message: You carefully place the shards on the ground, ready to be cracked by something passing by.

glass_sheet.name: sheet of glass
glass_sheet.description: A large sheet of glass, around three by four feet.  Easily shattered.  Useful for repairing windows.

use_action.done_message: You break the pane and place the shards on the ground, ready to be cracked by something passing by.

reinforced_glass_sheet.name: sheet of reinforced glass
reinforced_glass_sheet.description: A large sheet of bulletproof glass, it looks to a little over two inches thick.

reinforced_glass_pane.name: pane of reinforced glass
reinforced_glass_pane.description: A small pane of bulletproof glass, it looks to be a little over two inches thick.

tempered_glass_sheet.name: sheet of tempered glass
tempered_glass_sheet.description: A large, durable sheet of tempered glass, approximately six millimeters thick.  A common type of safety glass with the curious property of breaking into small, non-lethal pieces upon shattering.

peephole.name: peephole
peephole.description: A metal cylinder with a small lens inside intended to be installed on a door.

screen_mesh.name: mesh screen
screen_mesh.description: A roll of fine mesh screen for bug barriers on porches.

pipe_cpvc.name: PVC pipe
pipe_cpvc.description: White polyvinyl chloride pipe, commonly used for household plumbing, but also in many another applications.

pipe.name: pipe
pipe.description: A steel pipe; makes a good melee weapon.  Useful in a bunch of crafting recipes.

scrap.name: scrap metal
scrap.description: A bulky assortment of small bits of scrap steel useful in all kinds of crafting.

spike.name: spike
spike.description: A large and slightly misshapen metal spike, could do some damage mounted on a vehicle.

cu_pipe.name: copper tubing
cu_pipe.description: A copper tube; too thin to be much use as a melee weapon, but will do if nothing else is available.  Useful in a few crafting recipes.

material_aluminium_ingot.name: chunk of aluminum
material_aluminium_ingot.description: A small chunk of aluminum; light but durable, this could be cast into various shapes for construction or ground down to a powder, for more… high-profile applications.

bismuth.name: bismuth
bismuth.description: A dense but brittle metal often used as an alternative to lead.

gold_small.name: gold
gold_small.description: A soft, shiny metal.  Before the apocalypse this would've been worth a small fortune, but now its value is greatly diminished.

platinum_small.name: platinum
platinum_small.description: A soft, shiny metal.  Before the apocalypse this would've been worth a small fortune, but now its value is greatly diminished.

zinc_metal.name: zinc
zinc_metal.description: A slightly brittle metal.  Apart from being an essential mineral that the body needs, it reacts readily with acids, alkalis, and other non-metals.  It can be crushed to make zinc powder and used in the production of batteries, among other things.

scrap_brass.name: chunk of brass
scrap_brass.description: Some decent-sized chunks of scrap brass.

lead.name: lead
lead.description: A soft, dull metal used since ancient times.  Due to its malleability, it has a wide variety of uses including the manufacture of ammunition.

magnesium.name: magnesium powder
magnesium.description: A handful of powdered magnesium, a highly flammable alkaline earth metal.  Useful for constructing flares and similar items.

silver_small.name: silver
silver_small.description: A soft, shiny metal.  Before the Cataclysm it was worth quite a bit, but its value is now greatly diminished.

sheet_metal_small.name: small mild steel sheet
sheet_metal_small.description: A small sheet of mild steel.

mc_sheet_metal_small.name: small medium steel sheet
mc_sheet_metal_small.description: A small sheet of medium steel.

hc_sheet_metal_small.name: small high steel sheet
hc_sheet_metal_small.description: A small sheet of high steel.

ch_sheet_metal_small.name: small hardened steel sheet
ch_sheet_metal_small.description: A small sheet of hardened steel.

qt_sheet_metal_small.name: small tempered steel sheet
qt_sheet_metal_small.description: A small sheet of tempered steel.

steel_chunk.name: chunk of steel
steel_chunk.description: A misshapen chunk of steel.  Makes a decent weapon in a pinch, and is also useful for some crafting recipes.

steel_lump.name: lump of steel
steel_lump.description: A heavy, formed piece of steel.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

lc_steel_lump.name: lump of mild steel
lc_steel_lump.description: A heavy, formed piece of mild steel.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

mc_steel_lump.name: lump of medium steel
mc_steel_lump.description: A heavy, formed piece of medium steel.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

hc_steel_lump.name: lump of high steel
hc_steel_lump.description: A heavy, formed piece of high steel.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

ch_steel_lump.name: lump of hardened steel
ch_steel_lump.description: A heavy, formed piece of hardened steel.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

qt_steel_lump.name: lump of tempered steel
qt_steel_lump.description: A heavy, formed piece of tempered steel.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

hinge.name: hinge
hinge.description: A small metal hinge with two metal plates with screw holes.  Useful for making doors or chests.

scrap_copper.name: chunk of copper
scrap_copper.description: A small chunk of copper, usable for crafting or repairs.

scrap_tin.name: scrap tin
scrap_tin.description: Some small pieces of scrap tin, usable for crafting or repairs.

tin.name: tin powder
tin.description: A handful of fine gray tin powder, usable for making solder and lining containers to prevent corrosion.

solder_wire.name: solder
solder_wire.description: A small spool of solder, useful for electronics crafting.

copper_rod.name: copper rod
copper_rod.description: A thin copper rod, ready to be made into copper wire.

fanblade_metal.name: metal fan blade assembly
fanblade_metal.description: A multi-bladed metal fan, like you'd find on a larger desk fan or inside a convection oven.

heavy_wire_rack.name: heavy wire rack
heavy_wire_rack.description: A durable steel rack, the sort you might find in an oven or on a barbecue.

lc_steel_chunk.name: chunk of mild steel
lc_steel_chunk.description: A misshapen chunk of mild steel.  Makes a decent weapon in a pinch, and is also useful for some crafting recipes.

mc_steel_chunk.name: chunk of medium steel
mc_steel_chunk.description: A misshapen chunk of medium steel.  Makes a decent weapon in a pinch, and is also useful for some crafting recipes.

hc_steel_chunk.name: chunk of high steel
hc_steel_chunk.description: A misshapen chunk of high steel.  Makes a decent weapon in a pinch, and is also useful for some crafting recipes.

ch_steel_chunk.name: chunk of hardened steel
ch_steel_chunk.description: A misshapen chunk of hardened steel.  Makes a decent weapon in a pinch, and is also useful for some crafting recipes.

qt_steel_chunk.name: chunk of tempered steel
qt_steel_chunk.description: A misshapen chunk of tempered steel.  Makes a decent weapon in a pinch, and is also useful for some crafting recipes.

budget_steel_chunk.name: chunk of budget steel
budget_steel_chunk.description: A misshapen chunk of budget steel.  Makes a decent weapon in a pinch, and is also useful for some crafting recipes.

budget_steel_lump.name: lump of budget steel
budget_steel_lump.description: A heavy, formed piece of budget steel.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

slag.name: slag
slag.description: A chunk of slag, leftover from smelting ore.

railroad_track_item.name: length of railroad track
railroad_track_item.description: A heavy one-meter length of railroad track with a smooth top, liberated from a now-defunct rail line.  Far too heavy to be useful for much as-is, but perhaps could be shaped into something with some metalworking skill, or cut down into an anvil if sawed in half first.

railroad_track_item_half.name: half-meter length of railroad track
railroad_track_item_half.description: A heavy half-meter length of railroad track with a smooth top, liberated from a now-defunct rail line.  Could be used as a makeshift anvil, especially with some modifications, or as spare steel.

scrap_aluminum.name: scrap aluminum
scrap_aluminum.description: A handful of small pieces of aluminum, usable for crafting or repairs.

scrap_cast_iron.name: scrap cast iron
scrap_cast_iron.description: A handful of small pieces of scrap cast iron, usable for crafting or repairs.

chunk_cast_iron.name: cast iron chunk
chunk_cast_iron.description: A misshapen chunk of cast iron.  Makes a decent weapon in a pinch, and is also useful for some crafting recipes.

lump_cast_iron.name: cast iron lump
lump_cast_iron.description: A heavy piece of cast iron.  Useful for some crafting recipes.

aluminum_bar_round.description: A round bar of aluminum.  Ready to be turned on the lathe.

small_aluminum_bar_round.description: A small round bar of aluminum.  Ready to be turned on the lathe.

small_mc_steel_bar_round.description: A small round bar of steel.  Ready to be turned on the lathe.

small_hc_steel_bar_round.name: small high steel bar stock
small_hc_steel_bar_round.description: A small round bar of steel.  Ready to be turned on the lathe.

aluminum_bar_flat.name: aluminum flat bar stock
aluminum_bar_flat.description: A rectangular bar of aluminum.  Ready to be milled on a milling machine.

small_aluminum_bar_flat.name: aluminum flat bar stock
small_aluminum_bar_flat.description: A rectangular bar of aluminum.  Ready to be milled on a milling machine.

steel_bar_flat.name: steel flat bar stock
steel_bar_flat.description: A rectangular bar of steel.  Ready to be milled on a milling machine.

small_steel_bar_flat.name: steel flat bar stock
small_steel_bar_flat.description: A small rectangular bar of steel.  Ready to be milled on a milling machine.

hc_steel_bar_flat.name: high steel flat bar stock
hc_steel_bar_flat.description: A rectangular bar of steel.  Ready to be milled on a milling machine.

mc_steel_bar_flat.name: medium steel flat bar stock
mc_steel_bar_flat.description: A rectangular bar of steel.  Ready to be milled on a milling machine.

lc_steel_bar_flat.name: low steel flat bar stock
lc_steel_bar_flat.description: A rectangular bar of steel.  Ready to be milled on a milling machine.

small_hc_steel_bar_flat.name: small high steel flat bar stock
small_hc_steel_bar_flat.description: A small rectangular bar of steel.  Ready to be milled on a milling machine.
small_hc_steel_bar_flat.name_plural: small high steel flat bar stock

small_mc_steel_bar_flat.name: small medium steel flat bar stock
small_mc_steel_bar_flat.description: A small rectangular bar of steel.  Ready to be milled on a milling machine.
small_mc_steel_bar_flat.name_plural: small medium steel flat bar stock

small_lc_steel_bar_flat.name: small low steel flat bar stock
small_lc_steel_bar_flat.description: A small rectangular bar of steel.  Ready to be milled on a milling machine.
small_lc_steel_bar_flat.name_plural: small low steel flat bar stock

bee_sting.name: bee stinger
bee_sting.description: A six-inch stinger from a giant bee.  Makes a poor melee weapon.

broom.name: broom
broom.description: A long-handled broom.  Makes a terrible weapon unless you're chasing cats.

ceramic_shard.name: ceramic shard
ceramic_shard.description: A broken ceramic shard.  It is relatively heavy for its size and has a somewhat sharp edge, but it's too irregular to cut properly.

fighter_sting.name: fungal fighter stinger
fighter_sting.description: A short dart from a fungal fighter.  Makes a poor melee weapon.

incendiary.name: incendiary
incendiary.description: Material from an incendiary round, useful in constructing incendiary ammunition.

mattress.name: mattress
mattress.description: A single, or twin, sized mattress.

use_action.done_message: You lay the mattress flat on the ground.

down_mattress.name: down mattress
down_mattress.description: A single, or twin, sized down-filled mattress.

use_action.done_message: You lay the mattress flat on the ground.

fuse.name: fuse
fuse.description: A piece of fuse, long enough to give you enough time to get away from most explosions.

sharp_rock.name: sharp rock
sharp_rock.description: A baseball-sized rock with a somewhat sharp edge that also chips in a semi-predictable way if struck.  With the right skills, you could give it a better edge.

sole_rubber.name: rubber sole
sole_rubber.description: A sole made from rubber, usually found on the bottoms of boots.  Can be used for making actual boots.

rubber_tire_chunk.name: thick rubber chunk
rubber_tire_chunk.description: A chunk of thick, semi-rigid rubber, similar to what tires are made from.

rubber_tire_strip.name: rubber tire strip
rubber_tire_strip.description: A long, curled strip of thick, semi-rigid rubber cut from a tire.

ugl_buttstock.name: grenade launcher buttstock
ugl_buttstock.description: A collapsible buttstock designed for the M320 grenade launcher.  When combined with this stock, the M320 can be used as a standalone weapon.

wasp_sting.name: wasp stinger
wasp_sting.description: A six-inch stinger from a giant wasp.  Makes a poor melee weapon.

cannonball_4lb.name: cannonball
cannonball_4lb.description: A four-pound cannonball.  With some gunpowder, wadding, and a fuse, it could be prepared to load into a cannon.

radio_car_wheel.name: RC car wheel set
radio_car_wheel.description: A small set of wheels for a radio-controlled car.  Could be improvised with caster wheels if given rubber treads for grip.

armor_star_samurai_helmet_destroyed.name: destroyed ryūsei kabuto
armor_star_samurai_helmet_destroyed.description: A conical shaped massive slab of inscrutable rock now in two pieces, strange metallic tubes visibly on display.  Something seems to have cracked it from the inside out.

wax_paraffin.name: chunk of paraffin wax
wax_paraffin.description: A large chunk of paraffin wax.

discharging_battery.name: discharging lithium-ion battery
discharging_battery.description: A lithium-ion battery that is soaking in saltwater.  After about a day, it should have short-circuited and discharged its energy, leaving it safe to handle… ideally.

use_action.msg: You dump the colorful saltwater and dry the battery.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The battery is still discharging.

discharged_storage_battery.name: discharged lithium-ion battery
discharged_storage_battery.description: A lithium-ion battery that has been shorted and discharged using saltwater.  At least, you hope it is.

thermo_resin_chunk.name: thermoplastic resin chunk
thermo_resin_chunk.description: A piece of tough thermoplastic resin that could be used to craft, repair, or reinforce items.

epoxy_chunk.name: epoxy chunk
epoxy_chunk.description: A hardy and durable piece of epoxy.  You could potentially craft items with it.

polycarbonate_chunk.name: polycarbonate chunk
polycarbonate_chunk.description: A hardy and durable piece of polycarbonate.  You could potentially craft items with it.

10l_plastic.name: 10 L plastic block
10l_plastic.description: A ten-liter block of solid plastic.

5l_plastic.name: 5 L plastic block
5l_plastic.description: A five-liter block of solid plastic.

plastic_chunk.name: plastic chunk
plastic_chunk.description: A piece of plastic.  It could be used to fabricate, repair, or reinforce plastic items.

nylon.name: synthetic fabric patch
nylon.description: A six-inch square patch of synthetic fabric.  Unlike you and other natural materials, it won't degrade much with age.  Maybe that's less of a bad thing now.

lycra_patch.name: Lycra patch
lycra_patch.description: A six-inch square patch of synthetic fabric blended with stretchy Lycra fibers.  It could be used to make flexible yet strong clothing.  Stylish, but bad for the environment; at least you're recycling it.

plastic_sheet.name: large plastic sheet
plastic_sheet.description: A large sheet of flexible plastic, the sort that might have been used for commercial wrapping or for weather-sealing a home.

plastic_sheet_small.name: plastic sheet
plastic_sheet_small.description: A small sheet of flexible plastic, like a cut-up garbage bag.  It might be useful for waterproofing clothes.

polycarbonate_sheet.name: polycarbonate sheet
polycarbonate_sheet.description: A polycarbonate sheet that can be used for, among other things, vacuum molding.

rigid_plastic_sheet.name: rigid plastic sheet
rigid_plastic_sheet.description: A large, rigid sheet of transparent polycarbonate, useful for all manner of things; from construction to art, or even amateur snowboarding.

panoramic_eyepiece.name: panoramic lens
panoramic_eyepiece.description: A relatively broad strip of chemical and impact-resistant polycarbonate plastic, most commonly used for the construction of wide-view visors and single-element eye pieces that offer maximal vision.

inhalation_valve.name: inhalation valve
inhalation_valve.description: An essential component of any gas mask, this is a small one-way valve that allows purified air to pass from a gas respirator's filter element to the mask's interior, delivering safe, breathable air to one's lungs.

filter_port_40mm.name: 40mm filter port
filter_port_40mm.description: A compact plastic and metal housing with a threaded exterior, designed to retain a screwed-on 40-mm canister filter and allow the airtight passage of air from the filter media to a gas mask's inhalation valve.

rock_flaking.name: flaking rock
rock_flaking.description: A rock the size of a baseball which chips in a semi-predictable way if struck, leaving a sharp edge.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and is also good for throwing at enemies.

flint.name: flint
flint.description: A chunk of flint, the kind of rock that can make sparks if stuck against high-carbon steel.  It also chips in a semi-predictable way if struck, leaving a sharp edge.

field_stone.name: field stone
field_stone.description: A medium, flattish, heavy rock, big enough and flat enough to be used as a block in field stone walls.

rock_large.name: large rock
rock_large.description: A large, heavy rock, big enough to be used as a primitive anvil or shaped into larger stone items.

rock_wool_bat.name: fiber insulation batt
rock_wool_bat.description: A foil-wrapped batt of fibrous insulation; fire- and moisture-resistant, it's used for hot appliances like dishwashers and ovens.

bone_plaster.name: bone replica
bone_plaster.description: A plaster replica of a bone.

large_bone_plaster.name: large bone replica
large_bone_plaster.description: A plaster replica of a huge bone.

bone_fossil.name: bone fossil
bone_fossil.description: A fossilized bone.  Not good to eat.

large_bone_fossil.name: large bone replica
large_bone_fossil.description: A huge fossilized bone.  Not good to eat.

grass_yarn.name: grass yarn
grass_yarn.description: Primitive yarn made from coarse plant fibers like straw or grass.  Too thick to sew with, but could be woven into a crude sheet of fabric.

scrap_cotton.name: cotton scraps
scrap_cotton.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of cotton, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of, but they can be recycled into some thread if you really want.

scrap_faux_fur.name: faux fur scraps
scrap_faux_fur.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of faux fur, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.

scrap_felt.name: felt scraps
scrap_felt.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of felt, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of, but they can be recycled into some wool fiber if you really want.

scrap_fur.name: fur scraps
scrap_fur.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of fur, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.

scrap_kevlar.name: Kevlar scraps
scrap_kevlar.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of Kevlar fabric, waste material from tailoring projects.  Normally it would be disposed of, but since Kevlar is very difficult to make in a post-apocalyptic world, it might be worth recycling it for Kevlar thread.

tainted_kevlar.name: tainted kevlar
tainted_kevlar.description: A disgusting fusion of rotten flesh and what appears to have been Kevlar.  It doesn't seem like you'll be able to use this.

scrap_leather.name: leather scraps
scrap_leather.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of leather, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.

scrap_lycra.name: Lycra scraps
scrap_lycra.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of Lycra, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.

scrap_neoprene.name: neoprene scraps
scrap_neoprene.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of neoprene, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.

scrap_nylon.name: synthetic fabric scraps
scrap_nylon.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of synthetic fabric, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of.

scrap_nomex.name: Nomex scraps
scrap_nomex.description: A handful of oddly-shaped smallish bits of heat-resistant Nomex fabric, waste material from tailoring projects.  Normally it would be disposed of, but since Nomex is very difficult to make in a post-apocalyptic world, it might be worth recycling it for Nomex thread.

tainted_nomex.name: tainted nomex
tainted_nomex.description: A disgusting fusion of rotten flesh and what appears to have been Nomex.  It doesn't seem like you'll be able to use this.

scrap_carpet.name: scraps of carpet
scrap_carpet.description: A misshapen section of loose carpet.  Not useful for much on its own and can be discarded.

wool_staple.name: wool staple
wool_staple.description: A natural cluster of wool fibers.  Could be processed into felt patches or yarn.

fur.name: fur patch
fur.description: A small bolt of fur from an animal, roughly six inches square.  Can be made into patchwork fur sheets or used to repair fur fabric.

faux_fur.name: faux fur patch
faux_fur.description: A small bolt of garishly-colored faux fur, roughly six inches square.  Can be made into patchwork faux fur sheets or used to repair faux fur fabric.

leather.name: leather patch
