leather.description: A roughly six-inch square patch of leather, could be used to repair clothing and make smaller leather crafts.

felt_patch.name: felt patch
felt_patch.description: A small, six-inch square patch of felt.

nomex.name: Nomex patch
nomex.description: A six-inch square patch of Nomex fire-resistant fabric.

cured_hide.name: cured hide
cured_hide.description: A rolled-up animal hide which has been scraped of extraneous hair and flesh and treated to prevent decay.  It still requires tanning to become usable leather.

tanned_hide.name: tanned hide
tanned_hide.description: A folded 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of leather made from carefully tanned animal hide.  Can be cut up or used as is.

sheet_leather.name: leather sheet
sheet_leather.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of leather.  Can be cut up or used as is.

sheet_leather_patchwork.name: patchwork leather sheet
sheet_leather_patchwork.description: A folded 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of leather sewn together from patches.  Can be cut up or used as is.

cured_pelt.name: cured pelt
cured_pelt.description: A rolled-up animal hide which has been scraped of extraneous hair and flesh and treated to prevent decay.  It still requires tanning to become usable fur.

tanned_pelt.name: tanned pelt
tanned_pelt.description: A folded sheet of fur made from carefully tanned animal pelt.  Can be cut up or used as is.

sheet_fur_patchwork.name: patchwork fur sheet
sheet_fur_patchwork.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of fur sewn together from patches.  Can be cut up or used as is.

sheet_cotton.name: cotton sheet
sheet_cotton.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of cotton fabric, suitable for making clothing.  You can use it to stop bleeding, but it is very wasteful.

sheet_cotton_patchwork.name: patchwork cotton sheet
sheet_cotton_patchwork.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of cotton sewn together from patches of various clothing parts.  Suitable for making clothing if you lack proper material sheets.

sheet_faux_fur.name: faux fur sheet
sheet_faux_fur.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of colorful faux fur, suitable for making clothing.

sheet_faux_fur_patchwork.name: patchwork faux fur sheet
sheet_faux_fur_patchwork.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of faux fur sewn together from mismatched patches.  Suitable for making clothing if you lack proper material sheets, but the bright, clashing colors might end up making you look like a diseased Muppet.

sheet_felt.name: felt sheet
sheet_felt.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of felt, suitable for making clothing.

sheet_felt_patchwork.name: patchwork felt sheet
sheet_felt_patchwork.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of felt sewn together from patches.  Suitable for making clothing if you lack proper material sheets.

sheet_kevlar.name: Kevlar sheet
sheet_kevlar.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of loose-woven Kevlar synthetic fabric, suitable for making durable cut and stab resistant clothing.  While protective, this kind of Kevlar is not suitable for making ballistic gear due to the difference in weave tightness.

sheet_kevlar_patchwork.name: patchwork Kevlar sheet
sheet_kevlar_patchwork.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of fabric sewn together from Kevlar patches, suitable for making durable cut and stab resistant clothing.  This would be out of the question for ballistic Kevlar but the simpler, looser weave of this variety means it is fine to use if you lack proper material sheets.

kevlar_patch.name: Kevlar patch
kevlar_patch.description: A 6-inch square patch of loose-woven Kevlar, suitable for repairing cut and stab resistant clothing or reassembling into a patchwork sheet for sewing.

sheet_lycra.name: Lycra sheet
sheet_lycra.description: A sheet of synthetic fabric blended with stretchy Lycra fibers, suitable for making flexible, yet strong clothing.

sheet_kevlar_layered.name: ballistic Kevlar panel
sheet_kevlar_layered.description: A small, 16-layer thick ballistic Kevlar panel.  This kind of Kevlar is precision-made by machine and features an extremely tight weave which cannot be replicated by hand.  Due to this, any damage incurred to your ballistic armor will necessitate complete replacement with a new panel.  It is not as effective as loose-woven Kevlar at stopping stab wounds, but it has no equal against the threat posed by firearms.

rigid_kevlar_plate.name: rigid Kevlar plate
rigid_kevlar_plate.description: A compressed panel of Kevlar treated with epoxy or other adhesive.  It could be used to repair items made of rigid Kevlar, and makes a decent substitute for damaged carbon fiber and the like even if it isn't exactly the same.

sheet_lycra_patchwork.name: patchwork Lycra sheet
sheet_lycra_patchwork.description: A 12-inch by 24-inch sheet of fabric sewn together from Lycra patches.  Suitable for making flexible, yet strong clothing if you lack proper material sheets.

sheet_neoprene.name: neoprene sheet
sheet_neoprene.description: A sheet of neoprene, a synthetic rubber, suitable for making underwater gear.

sheet_neoprene_patchwork.name: patchwork neoprene sheet
sheet_neoprene_patchwork.description: A sheet of neoprene sewn together from patches, with waterproofed seams.  Suitable for making underwater gear if you lack proper material sheets.

sheet_nomex.name: Nomex sheet
sheet_nomex.description: A sheet of Nomex synthetic fabric, suitable for making heat-resistant clothing.

sheet_nomex_patchwork.name: patchwork Nomex sheet
sheet_nomex_patchwork.description: A sheet of Nomex synthetic fabric, sewn together from patches using Nomex thread.  Suitable for making heat-resistant clothing if you lack proper material sheets.

sheet_nylon.name: synthetic fabric sheet
sheet_nylon.description: A sheet of synthetic fabric, suitable for making clothing.

sheet_nylon_patchwork.name: patchwork synthetic fabric sheet
sheet_nylon_patchwork.description: A sheet of fabric, sewn together from synthetic fabric patches in a patchwork fashion.  Suitable for making most clothing, though it's much less time-efficient than if using proper material sheets.

gambeson_batting.name: gambeson batting
gambeson_batting.description: A pile of shredded fabric, dry grass, hair or other cheap materials which could be used to stuff the fabric layers of a gambeson to create armor more cheaply and easily than properly layering and quilting the entire product.

thread_kevlar.name: Kevlar thread
thread_kevlar.description: Very durable Kevlar thread that would be particularly useful for making ballistic armor, though it's fine to use in place of normal thread too, in most cases.  Making armor-grade Kevlar sheets from this would need a particularly tight weave, and so would require some specialized machinery.

thread_nomex.name: Nomex thread
thread_nomex.description: Heat-resistant Nomex thread that would be particularly useful for making heat protection gear, though it's fine to use in place of normal thread too, in most cases.

sheet_denim.name: denim sheet
sheet_denim.description: A 12 inch by 24 inch sheet of durable blue denim, suitable for making jeans, jorts, or jirts.

scrap_denim.name: denim scraps
scrap_denim.description: Oddly-shaped smallish denim patches, waste material from tailoring projects.

denim_patch.name: denim patch
denim_patch.description: A small, 6 inch square patch of blue denim.  It could be used to repair items made of denim or stitched into patchwork sheets for tailoring projects.

sheet_denim_patchwork.name: patchwork denim sheet
sheet_denim_patchwork.description: A selection of various sections of denim, sewn together in a patchwork fashion.  Suitable for tailoring, though it's much less time-efficient than if using proper material sheets.

sheet_canvas.name: canvas sheet
sheet_canvas.description: A 12 inch by 24 inch sheet of durable and waterproof waxed canvas fabric, suitable for making tough bags and clothing.

thread_canvas.name: heavy duty thread
thread_canvas.description: Some tough canvas-weight thread, sturdier than ordinary thread.  You could meticulously weave this into a sheet of canvas cloth.  It would also be useful for stitching such sheets together, though it's fine to use for normal tailoring projects too.

scrap_canvas.name: canvas scraps
scrap_canvas.description: Oddly-shaped smallish bits of canvas, waste material from tailoring projects.  Not useful for much and usually disposed of, but can be recycled into some tough thread.

canvas_patch.name: canvas patch
canvas_patch.description: A small, 6 inch square patch of tough canvas.  It could be used to repair items made of canvas or stitched into patchwork sheets for tailoring projects.

sheet_canvas_patchwork.name: patchwork canvas sheet
sheet_canvas_patchwork.description: A selection of various sections of canvas, sewn together in a patchwork fashion.  Suitable for tailoring, though it's much less time-efficient than if using proper material sheets.

strap_cotton.name: fabric strap
strap_cotton.description: A strip of broad, flat cotton, 42 inches in length, with a metal adjustment buckle threaded in the center.  Normally used as a shoulder strap for bags, its ends are usually sown about a corresponding container's D-rings.

log.name: log
log.description: A large log of wood, cut from a tree.  (a)ctivate a wood axe or wood saw to cut it into planks.

splinter.name: splintered wood
splinter.description: A splintered piece of wood, could be used as a skewer or for kindling.

stick.name: straight stick
stick.description: A respectable length of wood, just big enough to wrap your hand around.  Relatively straight and makes a decent melee weapon.

stick_common.name: stick
stick_common.description: A respectable length of wood, just big enough to wrap your hand around.  It's a little bent, and that makes it useless for most things you'd want to make with it.  Also makes it a little harder to hit things with it.

stick_long.name: long stick
stick_long.description: A straight section of wood, about eight feet long and a couple of inches in diameter.  Makes a decent melee weapon, and can be broken into shorter pieces for crafting.

soaking_long_pole.name: soaking long pole
soaking_long_pole.description: A stout, ten-foot pole.  Could be used similarly to a spear.  It's currently soaked with oil and quite slippery.  Once the oil penetrates the wood it can be wiped down and used for further projects.

use_action.msg: You wipe down the long pole.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The long pole is still soaking.

long_pole.name: long pole
long_pole.description: A stout, ten-foot pole.  Could be used similarly to a spear.  The Cataclysm gives fresh meaning to walking softly and carrying a big stick.

soaking_spear_shaft.name: soaking spear shaft
soaking_spear_shaft.description: A long stick carved and sanded into a smooth staff with a slight taper, for use in making spears.  It's currently soaked with oil and quite slippery.  Once the oil penetrates the wood it can be wiped down and used for further projects.

use_action.msg: You wipe down the spear shaft.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The spear shaft is still soaking.

spear_shaft.name: spear shaft
spear_shaft.description: A long stick, sanded and treated with oil for integrity and carved into a smooth staff with a slight taper, for use in making spears.  It can also be used as a makeshift quarterstaff as-is, but is too thin to be very effective for just hitting people.

2x4.name: plank
2x4.description: A flat, thick plank of wood, like a 2 by 4 or similar piece of dimensional lumber.  Makes a decent melee weapon if you're desperate, and can be used for all kinds of construction projects.

firewood.name: piece of firewood
firewood.description: A part of a log rough-chopped into firewood, burned for heat for longer than recorded history.

tonewood.name: tonewood
tonewood.description: A block of tonally appropriate wood that has been air dried for a year in preparation for being turned into a musical instrument.

tuning_pegs.name: tuning peg
tuning_pegs.description: Tuning pegs go on stringed instruments to both provide an anchor for the strings and to control the tightness of the wire which in turn controls the tune of the notes produced.

plank_short.name: short plank
plank_short.description: A short 2 by 4 plank of wood.  While less common and smaller than its 4 foot cousin it can still be very useful in carpentry.

plank_long.name: long plank
plank_long.description: A long 2 by 4 plank of wood.  While not as common as the 4 foot variant, still makes a decent melee weapon, and can be used for all kinds construction.

wood_beam.name: heavy wooden beam
wood_beam.description: An enormous beam of solid wood, very heavy and hard to lug around, but also very sturdy for construction.  You could saw or chop it into smaller pieces, like planks or panels.

wooden_post.name: wooden post
wooden_post.description: A wooden post with a 4 by 4 square base.  Posts with a length similar to this are commonly used in mailboxes or as table legs.

wooden_post_short.name: short wooden post
wooden_post_short.description: A wooden post with a 4 by 4 square base.  Posts with a length similar to this are commonly used as chair legs.

wooden_post_long.name: long wooden post
wooden_post_long.description: A wooden post with a 4 by 4 square base.  Posts with a length similar to this are commonly used in the construction of walls and floors.

wood_block.name: small wood block
wood_block.description: A small 2x2x5 inches block of wood, primarily used for carving out small wooden objects.

wood_panel.name: wooden panel
wood_panel.description: A wide, thin wooden board - plywood, OSB, MDF, tongue-in-groove boards, or similar, already cut to shape.  Good for all kinds of construction, but for really big projects you'd need a proper sheet of uncut plywood or the like.

wood_sheet.name: large wooden sheet
wood_sheet.description: A standard 4 by 8 sheet of flat wood - usually plywood, OSB, or MDF.  Heavy and bulky, it is extremely useful for all manner of construction, but you might have to cut it to size before doing smaller projects.

giant_wood_screw.name: giant wooden screw
giant_wood_screw.description: A giant screw carved out of solid wood, a simple component used to convert rotational energy into a downward movement of greater force.

targeting_module.name: targeting module
targeting_module.description: A module that integrates visual and proprioceptive information from peripheric sensors and outputs information necessary for accurate aiming.

identification_module.name: identification module
identification_module.description: A module that continuously runs image recognition algorithms to differentiate friend from foe.

pathfinding_module.name: pathfinding module
pathfinding_module.description: A module that uses a combination of vector integration and egocentric mapping to find the best path available.

memory_module.name: memory banks module
memory_module.description: A module that allows for the storage and recovery of information.

sensor_module.name: sensor array
sensor_module.description: A wide range of sensors meant to give the ability to perceive the surrounding world.

self_monitoring_module.name: self monitoring sensors
self_monitoring_module.description: An array of sensors and diagnostic modules allowing a robot to perceive itself.

ai_module.name: AI core
ai_module.description: A module that is responsible for decision-making, it basically runs the AI of a robot.

ai_module_basic.name: basic AI core
ai_module_basic.description: A very basic AI core with minimal cognitive abilities.

ai_module_advanced.name: advanced AI core
ai_module_advanced.description: An advanced AI core with impressive cognitive abilities.

gun_module.name: gun operating system
gun_module.description: A system that can operate most conventional weapons.

spidery_legs_small.name: set of tiny spidery legs
spidery_legs_small.description: A set of tiny, pointy legs, like the ones found under a skitterbot.

omni_wheel.name: set of omni wheels
omni_wheel.description: A set of omni wheels, like the ones found under a police bot.

quad_rotors.name: set of rotors
quad_rotors.description: A set of rotors able to lift a small drone.

tank_tread.name: set of small tank treads
tank_tread.description: A set of small tank treads, like the ones used by the "Beagle" mini-tank.

turret_chassis.name: turret interior chassis
turret_chassis.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton of a turret.

copbot_chassis.name: police bot chassis
copbot_chassis.description: What's left when you remove all moving parts and electronics.  It's the skeleton and armor of a police bot.

spidery_legs_big.name: set of spidery legs
spidery_legs_big.description: A set of big pointy legs, like the ones found under a tripod.

android_chassis.name: android skeleton
android_chassis.description: What's left when you strip an android body from its components.

abstract_software.name: abstract software
abstract_software.description: Copy from this for any software.

software_useless.name: misc software
software_useless.description: A miscellaneous piece of hobby software.  Probably useless.

software_lab_data.name: lab data
software_lab_data.description: Research archives from a government laboratory.

software_encryption_codes.name: encryption codes
software_encryption_codes.description: There are numerous security keys with dates for potential future access to encrypted archived data.

software_archived_data.name: archive data
software_archived_data.description: Extremely compressed research data, observation and experiment statistics.  The only pattern you manage to recognize is an increase in the amount of report closer to the Cataclysm, but also a reduction in the number of facilities still submitting reports.

train_data.name: laboratory shipping records
train_data.description: Records of logistical data on subterranean train routes and schedules.

software_electronics_reference.name: integrated circuit datasheet archives
software_electronics_reference.description: Huge archives of numerous IC circuit datasheets from several major manufacturers.  Probably valuable to the right person, as it would be hard to salvage and reuse these components without them.

efile_junk.name: junk file
efile_junk.description: A useless piece of electronic data.

efile_lore.name: questionable media file
efile_lore.description: You kept this file on the off-chance that it might be interesting, but you need to take a more thorough look to find out what's inside.

efile_map.name: map cache
efile_map.description: Information about nearby locations stored from previous use.

efile_recipes.name: recipe catalog
efile_recipes.description: This is a filtered collection of PDFs, images, and texts that contains instructions for making useful items.  Any electronic recipe catalogs will be added to this one.

efile_photos.name: photo gallery
efile_photos.description: A varied collection of detailed photos.  Any collections of this kind will be added to this one.

scuba_tank.name: diving cylinder
scuba_tank.description: A high-pressure 232 bar diving tank that can contain up to 12 L of a compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  Activate it to open it.

scuba_tank_on.name: diving cylinder (open)
scuba_tank_on.description: A high-pressure 232 bar diving tank that can contain up to 12 L of a compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  It is currently open.  Activate it to close it.

use_action.msg: You close the valve on the tank.

small_scuba_tank.name: small diving cylinder
small_scuba_tank.description: A small, high-pressure 200 bar diving tank that can contain 4 L of a compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  Activate it to open it.

small_scuba_tank_on.name: small diving cylinder (open)
small_scuba_tank_on.description: A small, high-pressure 200 bar backup diving tank that can contain 4 L of a compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  It is currently open.  Activate it to close it.

use_action.msg: You close the valve on the tank.

firefighter_scba_tank.name: firefighter SCBA cylinder
firefighter_scba_tank.description: A lightweight aluminum cylinder wrapped in carbon fiber, holding a highly compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  Activate it to open it.

firefighter_scba_tank_on.name: firefighter SCBA cylinder (open)
firefighter_scba_tank_on.description: A lightweight aluminum cylinder wrapped in carbon fiber, holding a highly compressed mixture of oxygen and nitrogen.  It is currently open.  Activate it to close it.

use_action.msg: You close the valve on the tank.

power_cord.name: power cord
power_cord.description: A power cord, like you've seen many times before: it's a short multi-stranded copper cord with a power outlet at the end.

jumper_cable.name: jumper cable
jumper_cable.description: A 3-foot (or about 1 m) jumper cable: a short multi-stranded copper cable with power leads on either end.  Attach one end to one vehicle and the other to another, and you can transfer electrical power between the two.  Can also link power grids.

jumper_cable_heavy.name: heavy-duty jumper cable
jumper_cable_heavy.description: A long, thick, heavy-duty jumper cable with power leads on either end.  Attach one end to one vehicle and the other to another, and you can transfer electrical power between the two, though you expect the power loss would be noticeable.  Can also link power grids.

extension_cable.name: extension cord
extension_cable.description: A long 30-foot (or about 10 m) orange extension cord for extending cables or connecting appliances.  Could be used on any appliance or other household electrical system.

long_extension_cable.name: outdoor extension cord
long_extension_cable.description: An extra-long 100-foot (or about 30 m) orange extension cord for extending cables or connecting outdoor appliances.  Could be used on any appliance or other household electrical system.

hd_tow_cable.name: heavy-duty tow cable
hd_tow_cable.description: An extremely heavy-duty 30-foot (or about 9 m) tow cable made from thick steel wire coated in plastic.  If attached to a vehicle, it could be used to pull another vehicle of any weight.

jumper_cable_debug.name: shiny debug cable
jumper_cable_debug.description: This is the cable of the gods: 100 meters long, no power loss, light as a feather, and fits in a matchbook.  You're sure this wasn't supposed to exist, and the way it shimmers makes you uneasy.

bottle_metal.name: steel bottle
bottle_metal.description: A stainless steel water bottle, holds 750 mL of liquid.

bottle_folding.name: foldable plastic bottle
bottle_folding.description: A non-rigid plastic bottle for easy storage, holds 500 mL of liquid.

butchering_kit.name: butchering kit
butchering_kit.description: A kit containing all the specialized knives you need to debone, skin, and prepare cuts of meat from an animal.

screw_press.name: screw press
screw_press.description: This is a crafting_pseudo_item if you have it something is wrong.

can_sealer.name: can sealer
can_sealer.description: A hand-crank-powered cast steel machine designed to automatically seal tin cans.

carver_off.name: electric carver (off)
carver_off.description: An electric meat carver powered by cord.  It has two serrated blades that vibrate together to slice just about anything from turkey to ham… even zombies!

use_action.msg: The electric carver's serrated blades start buzzing!

carver_on.name: electric carver (on)
carver_on.description: This carver is on and the blades are buzzing.  Use it to turn it off.

char_purifier.name: charcoal water purifier
char_purifier.description: Using this item on a container full of water will purify the water using layered charcoal.  Once the charcoal has purified enough water, it will become unusable and can be disassembled and recycled.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.

char_purifier_clay.name: large charcoal water purifier
char_purifier_clay.description: Using this item on a container full of water will purify the water using layered charcoal.  Once the charcoal has purified enough water, it will become unusable and can be disassembled and recycled.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.

char_smoker.name: charcoal smoker
char_smoker.description: A portable charcoal smoker.  Good for weekend barbecuing and preserving meat with smoke.  Cannot be used with coal; the toxic fumes would ruin the meat.

charcoal_cooker.name: coal/charcoal cooker
charcoal_cooker.description: A little metal tank for holding coal or charcoal, with a pilot light attached and a pipe to vent toxic coal fumes.  You could use it for cooking food.

clay_pot.name: clay pot
clay_pot.description: A crude clay pot used for cooking.

clay_teapot.name: clay teapot
clay_teapot.description: A clay teapot.  Now all you need is tea and water.

coffeemaker.name: coffeemaker
coffeemaker.description: A heating element with a pot and a frame for holding coffee or other powders.  You can use it to make coffee, or other drinks if you so choose.

dehydrator.name: food dehydrator
dehydrator.description: An electric food dehydrator, invaluable in preserving food.  Can be connected to the electric grid using cord.

eggs_ferment_active.name: fermenting eggs jar
eggs_ferment_active.description: This jar contains a batch of eggs in a pickling solution.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

esbit_stove.name: hexamine stove
esbit_stove.description: A lightweight, folding stove designed to use small hexamine tablets for cooking.  Also known as an Esbit stove.

flask_yeast_active.name: sealed yeast culture
flask_yeast_active.description: A sealed jar holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.

food_processor.name: food processor
food_processor.description: A kitchen appliance capable of slicing, chopping, shredding, grinding, pureeing, and mixing.

gasoline_cooker.name: gasoline cooker
gasoline_cooker.description: A simple heater powered by gasoline.  It is designed for cooking food.

heatpack.name: heat pack
heatpack.description: A chemical heat pack, used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  It is usable only once.

heatpack_used.name: used heat pack
heatpack_used.description: A chemical heat pack, used to treat sports injuries and heat food.  This one has been used up and is chemically inert, rendering it useless.

hotplate.name: hotplate
hotplate.description: A small heating element on a stand, powered by your electric grid.  It is indispensable for cooking and chemistry.  Try not to burn yourself.

hotplate_induction.name: induction hotplate
hotplate_induction.description: A high end hotplate that utilizes magnetic induction coils to heat ferrous cookware directly.  It is far more efficient than a standard hotplate.

makeshift_sealer.name: makeshift vacuum sealer
makeshift_sealer.description: A homemade heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.

mess_kit.name: mess kit
mess_kit.description: A self-contained camping mess kit, containing everything you might need for wilderness cooking.

milk_cream_jar.name: milk cream jar
milk_cream_jar.description: This jar contains raw milk separated into cream.  It is sealed until you are ready to use it.

milk_cream_rising_active.name: rising cream jar
milk_cream_rising_active.description: This jar contains raw milk separating into cream.  It transforms into a milk cream jar after 6 hours.

mortar_pestle.name: mortar and pestle
mortar_pestle.description: A simple combination of a small grindstone and a bowl-shaped stone.  Used for grinding grain, but time-consuming compared to more complex methods.

oil_cooker.name: kerosene cooker
oil_cooker.description: A simple heater powered by kerosene.  It is designed for cooking food.

oil_press_manual.name: manual oil press
oil_press_manual.description: A hand-cranked press for creating vegetable oil.  A hotplate heats the raw material to increase extraction efficiency.

oil_press_primitive.name: oil-powered manual oil press
oil_press_primitive.description: A barrel with a large screw press for creating vegetable oil.  A kerosene cooker heats the raw material to increase extraction efficiency.

pastaextruder.name: pasta extruder
pastaextruder.description: A pasta extruder powered by a hand crank.  Useful in making pasta.  It comes with various heads to make various kinds of pasta.

pickles_ferment_active.name: fermenting pickle jar
pickles_ferment_active.description: This jar contains a batch of pickles set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

popcan_stove.name: soda can stove kit
popcan_stove.description: An ultra-light alcohol-burning stove with a simmer ring, crafted by hand from a couple of aluminum soda cans.  It comes with a 500 mL plastic bottle to hold concentrated alcohol fuel.

pressure_cooker.name: pressure cooker
pressure_cooker.description: A sealable pot, designed to cook food at higher pressures and temperatures.  Useful for all kinds of cooking, and it can also be used for pressure-sensitive chemical reactions.

rock_quern.name: stone quern
rock_quern.description: A simple hand-powered stone quern with a wooden handle, for grinding grain.

sauerkraut_ferment_active.name: fermenting sauerkraut jar
sauerkraut_ferment_active.description: This jar contains a batch of sauerkraut set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

snow_machine_home.name: home snow machine
snow_machine_home.description: A snow machine, which freezes water and shreds it into "snow", designed to be used from the comfort of your own home!  Useful for making snow cones.

sieve_primitive.name: wicker sieve
sieve_primitive.description: A primitive sieve constructed from woven strips of plant material.  Early sieves like this were used to sift grain, though the openings on this one are too small for that.

sieve_steel.name: sieve
sieve_steel.description: This is no mere strainer for noodles; it's a laboratory-grade sieve used to separate particles of certain sizes.  You could use this to do a really good job sifting flour, remove dust and soil from grain, or perhaps conduct gradation tests for any civil engineers you might know.  This one has been constructed from steel mesh.

sieve_steel_makeshift.name: makeshift sieve
sieve_steel_makeshift.description: Some fine steel mesh attached to a length of thicker steel wire, forming a rigid frame.  Useful for sieving.

still.name: still
still.description: A large still, useful for creating distillations of alcohol and other, more curious substances.  Features a slot for a thermometer.

teapot.name: teapot
teapot.description: A small metal teapot.  Teatime wouldn't be complete without one.

vac_sealer.name: vacuum sealer
vac_sealer.description: A portable heat sealer unit with an air pump.  It's used for vacuum packing food to preserve it.

waffleiron.name: waffle iron
waffleiron.description: A waffle iron, generally used for making waffles.

water_purifier.name: water purifier
water_purifier.description: A battery-powered device designed to purify drinking water.  Using this item on a container full of water will purify the contents.  It could be useful for water taken from uncertain sources like a river, as it may be non-potable.

water_filter_sand.name: slow-sand water filter
water_filter_sand.description: An improvised water filter made from a plastic bucket filled with a layer of sand and a layer of gravel.  It can be used to remove particulates and some pathogens from water, but it is not 100% effective.

propane_cooker.name: propane cooker
propane_cooker.description: A simple heater powered by propane.  It is designed for cooking food.

biogas_cooker.name: biogas cooker
biogas_cooker.description: A simple heater powered by biogas.  It is designed for cooking food.

acetylene_cooker.name: acetylene cooker
acetylene_cooker.description: A simple heater powered by acetylene welding gas.  It is designed for cooking food.

microwave.name: microwave
microwave.description: A home microwave, has probably seen its share of baked beans.

makeshift_pressure_cooker.name: makeshift pressure cooker
makeshift_pressure_cooker.description: A large pot with 20 gauge walls and a thick aluminum bottom, modified to serve as a bulky but passable pressure cooker.

toaster.name: toaster
toaster.description: A small two-slice toaster, can be used to toast toast and few other things.

crystallizing_sugar_active.name: crystallizing sugar
crystallizing_sugar_active.description: Sweet, sweet sugar in the process of crystallizing.  It needs two weeks to form solid crystals.

metal_honing_rod.name: honing rod
metal_honing_rod.description: A steel rod with fine grit used to hone the edge of knives.

knife_sharpener_handheld.name: handheld knife sharpener
knife_sharpener_handheld.description: A tool with slots of grits for sharpening knives.

debug_lux_meter.name: debug lux meter
debug_lux_meter.description: This debug tool will tell you about light.

debug_item_damager.name: debug item damager (simple)
debug_item_damager.description: Deals 1 full bar of damage to an item you wield.

effect.u_message: <npc_name> have had <context_val:hp_before> hp, now has <context_val:hp_after> hp.

debug_item_damager_adv.name: debug item damager (advanced)
debug_item_damager_adv.description: Deals damage to items you pick.

math: n_hp('ALL') -= num_input('Amount of damage, 1000 is one bar of damage.', 1000)

effect.u_message: Dealt damage to all items.

debug_mortar.name: debug explosion generator
debug_mortar.description: Causes explosion at overmap you pick.

debug_apply_fault.name: debug fault applier
debug_apply_fault.description: Applies the fault on item by id.

if.u_query: Provided id is fault_type or fault?  "Yes" for fault_type, "No" for fault_id

then.u_message: <npc_name> has random fault from fault_type "<context_val:str>" added, if such group exists.

else.u_message: <npc_name> has "<context_val:str>" fault added, if such id exists.

debug_dimension_traveller.name: debug dimension traveller
debug_dimension_traveller.description: Allows you to pick a dimension to teleport to.  Travellers are adviced to use Debug Phase Movement.  To teleport back to main dimension, just leave both empty.

debug_timer.name: debug timer
debug_timer.description: Start before performing some action.  Activate again to see the amount of in-game time that passed.

brazier.name: brazier
brazier.description: A large metal stand used to contain a fire.  Fires set in a brazier will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

makeshift_brazier.name: makeshift brazier
makeshift_brazier.description: A portable brazier fashioned from a steel bucket by punching small holes on the sides to improve the air supply.  It is too small to fit any fuel item larger than some splintered wood.  Fires set in this bucket will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

hobo_stove.name: hobo stove
hobo_stove.description: A small, improvised wood stove, made from a metal can or similar container of the right size.  It's too small to fit anything much larger than splintered wood.  Activate it to deploy.

portable_stove.name: portable stove
portable_stove.description: A foldable wood stove to safely lit fires while camping in the wilderness.  Activate it to deploy.

55gal_firebarrel.name: fire barrel (200 L)
55gal_firebarrel.description: A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

30gal_firebarrel.name: fire barrel (100 L)
30gal_firebarrel.description: A large metal barrel used to contain a fire.  It has multiple holes punched in its walls for air supply.  Fires set in a fire barrel will not spread to surrounding flammable objects.

camp_chair.name: camp chair
camp_chair.description: A folded chair for camping.  Activate it to set it down for a place to sit.

deck_chair.name: deck chair
deck_chair.description: Folded deck chair, deploy to sit down.

chair_folding.name: folding chair
chair_folding.description: Folded plastic chair on a metal frame, deploy to sit down.

xedra_antenna.name: deployable antenna
xedra_antenna.description: A directional antenna and accompanying tripod, folded into a shape vaguely resembling an umbrella.

cot.name: cot
cot.description: A military-style folding cot.  While it may not be quite as comfortable as a bed, it's better than slumming it on the ground.

use_action.done_message: You unfold the cot and place it on the ground.

metal_butcher_rack.name: metal butchering rack
metal_butcher_rack.description: A metal butchering rack designed to hang a carcass in the air.  It is folded for easy transportation.

metal_smoking_rack.name: metal smoking rack
metal_smoking_rack.description: A metal rack designed to smoke food for better preservation and taste.  It is folded for easy transportation.  As a deployable item, it's smaller than a stationary version.

tourist_table.name: folding table
tourist_table.description: A metal folding table for off-road trips.  It is currently folded for easy transportation.

leather_tarp.name: leather tarp
leather_tarp.description: A large sheet of leather.  You could use it as a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a surface for butchering as it does not soak up blood.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.

fiber_mat.name: fiber mat
fiber_mat.description: A large mat woven from fibrous material.  You could use it as a picnic blanket, but it's more valuable as a surface for butchering.  Too thin to be used as a comfortable sleeping mat.  It's rolled and ready for carrying.

churn.name: folded butter churn
churn.description: A large wooden container used to turn raw milk into butter and buttermilk.  This model uses a foot crank and holds three gallons of raw milk.

water_mill.name: water mill
water_mill.description: A small water-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Needs to be placed via the construction menu.

wind_mill.name: wind mill
wind_mill.description: A small wind-powered mill that can convert starchy products into flour.  Needs to be placed via the construction menu.

screw_press_tool.name: screw press
screw_press_tool.description: A large screw press for manually pressing oil out of fruit or seed paste.  Needs to be placed via the construction menu.

beverly_shear.name: Beverly shear
beverly_shear.description: A massive bench-mounted device with a short guillotine blade mounted to a long lever.  Designed for making straight or curved cuts through sheet metal up to 3 millimeters thick.

manual_tire_changer.name: manual tire changer
manual_tire_changer.description: A floor-mounted machine containing all the levers, clamps, and mounts required to remove or fit a tire, plus an integrated foot pump to inflate it.

solar_cooker.name: parabolic solar cooker
solar_cooker.description: A portable faceted reflector dish on a tripod, made of shaped metal panels that concentrate sunlight into a focal point for cooking.  Requires some assembly to set up and only works outdoors in strong direct sunlight.

target_spinner.name: spinner target
target_spinner.description: Two steel plates mounted on a pipe in a double-sided oar design, installed in a sturdy frame with a rotating mechanism.  It spins when struck, eventually returning to vertical alignment due to one plate being heavier than the other.  You can use it for target practice when stationary targets become too easy.

use_action.done_message: You set up the spinner target, time to shoot!

camera.name: camera
camera.description: A point-and-shoot digital camera with a digital viewfinder, a backup 'iron-sight', and flash.  You can look at your photos on the digital screen, or transfer them with any standard electronic device.

camera_pro.name: professional camera
camera_pro.description: A 35 mm digital SLR (single-lens reflex) camera with optical and digital viewfinders, a zoom lens with auto-focus and stabilizer, and flash.  You can look at your photos on the digital screen or transfer them with any standard electronic device.  Before the Cataclysm, you could have taken professional-grade photos using this.

cell_phone.name: cellphone
cell_phone.description: A cellphone, an older cousin of the smartphone that is still popular in certain circles due to its reliability and sturdiness.  Using the phone will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is sufficiently charged.  It also tells the time and has an alarm feature.

cell_phone_flashlight.name: cellphone - Flashlight
cell_phone_flashlight.description: A cellphone, an older cousin of the smartphone that is still popular in certain circles due to its reliability and sturdiness.  Using the phone will turn it on and provide light, assuming it is sufficiently charged.  It also tells the time and has an alarm feature.

directional_antenna.name: directional antenna
directional_antenna.description: An antenna designed to pick up signals better when pointed at the source.  You could use this with a radio to receive faint signals.

e_handcuffs.name: electronic handcuffs
e_handcuffs.description:
A pair of electronic handcuffs, used by police and riot bots to detain captives.  Their continuous siren clearly identifies the wearer as an arrested criminal and alerts human police.  Wait for their arrival, don't try to escape or to remove the cuffs - they will administer an electric shock.
However, since the only police likely to respond are undead, you may have a long wait ahead, unless you get creative…

eink_tablet_pc.name: e-ink tablet PC
eink_tablet_pc.description: A tablet PC using an efficient color e-ink display.  Before the Cataclysm, these were nifty gadgets; now, they are extremely useful tools.  Runs on conventional batteries.

eink_tablet_pc_on.name: e-ink tablet PC (on)
eink_tablet_pc_on.description: A tablet PC using an efficient color e-ink display.  Before the Cataclysm, these were nifty gadgets; now, they are extremely useful tools.  Runs on conventional batteries.

usb_drive.name: USB drive
usb_drive.description: A USB thumb drive.  Useful for holding electronic data.

usb_drive_older.name: older USB drive
usb_drive_older.description: A USB thumb drive.  Maybe a decade out of date, but still useful for holding electronic data.

portable_hard_drive.name: portable hard drive
portable_hard_drive.description: A portable external hard drive, the best in affordable mass storage.  Useful for holding lots of electronic data.

memory_card.name: memory card
memory_card.description: A memory card, can be used to store data.

memory_card_older.name: older memory card
memory_card_older.description: A memory card.  Maybe a decade out of date, but can still be used to store data.

memory_card_unread.name: memory card
memory_card_unread.description: A memory card, can be used to store data.

memory_card_science.name: memory card (XEDRA)
memory_card_science.description: A memory card, can be used to store data.  This one has a label on which is written 'XEDRA' followed by a long string of numbers.

exodii_usb_stick.name: Exodii digital storage device
exodii_usb_stick.description: A bundle of electronics shielded in scrap metal.  It has an otherworldly connection for Exodii computers.

exodii_usb_stick_full.name: Exodii digital storage device (data)
exodii_usb_stick_full.description: A bundle of electronics shielded in scrap metal.  It has an otherworldly connection for Exodii computers.  This one is filled with data downloaded from an Exodii computer.

exodii_portable_tv.name: Exodii TV-radio
exodii_portable_tv.description: This looks like a travel TV from the 1970s, styled to resemble military field equipment.  The bulbous CRT is encased in a drab plastic shell with an oversized carrying handle.  The switches and chunky tuning controls look like they were salvaged from an abandoned Cold War command center.  A single camera lens is visible above the screen, slightly off center.

electrohack.name: electrohack
electrohack.description: This device has many ports attached, allowing it to connect to almost any control panel or other electronic machine (but not computers).  With a little skill, it can be used to crack passwords and more.

geiger_off.name: Geiger counter (off)
geiger_off.description: A tool for measuring radiation.  Using it will prompt you to choose whether to scan yourself or the terrain, or to turn on continuous scan, which will provide continuous feedback on ambient radiation.  It is currently off.

geiger_on.name: Geiger counter (on)
geiger_on.description: A tool for measuring radiation.  It is in continuous scan mode, and will produce quiet clicking sounds in the presence of ambient radiation.  Using it allows you to turn it off, or scan yourself or the ground.

use_action.msg: The Geiger counter's SCANNING LED turns off.

resonance_measurement_device.name: Otherworldly measuring device
resonance_measurement_device.description: This strange contraption appears to be little more than a laminated box built around a battery, a poorly backlit screen, and a wound spool of cloth netting.  The letters "X E D R A" are emblazoned on the side.  To operate the device, unfurl the netting and place it around the object to analyze.  Despite not appearing to do anything, it consumes an enormous amount of electricity and provides a brief numerical readout.

nre_recorder.name: NRE recorder
nre_recorder.description: A strange apparatus, seemingly consisting of a glass-encased microphone linked to a small thermal printer and digital screen.  The screen remains perpetually blank, save for a battery indicator on its upper right, and on its left side lies a single red button: "PRINT DATA".

hand_crank_charger.name: hand-crank charger
hand_crank_charger.description: A hand-powered battery charger.  It has an adjustable receptacle designed to accept a wide variety of rechargeable battery cells.

laptop.name: laptop computer
laptop.description: A portable computer, a ubiquitous tool both before and after the cataclysm.  While you no longer have internet access, you still can load it with books and other useful software.

laptop_screen_lit.name: laptop computer - lit screen
laptop_screen_lit.description: A portable computer, a ubiquitous tool both before and after the cataclysm.  While you no longer have internet access, you still can load it with books and other useful software.

mp3.name: mp3 player (off)
mp3.description: This battery-powered device is loaded up with someone's music collection.  Fortunately, there's lots of songs you like, and listening to it will raise your morale slightly.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.message: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.

mp3_on.name: mp3 player (on)
mp3_on.description: This mp3 player is turned on and playing some great tunes, raising your morale steadily while on your person.  It runs through batteries quickly; you can turn it off by using it.  It also obscures your hearing.

use_action.message: You stop listening to music and take your earbuds out.

noise_emitter.name: noise emitter (off)
noise_emitter.description: A device constructed by 'enhancing' a speaker with some amplifier circuits.  It has no other use besides emitting loud crackling static noise that could distract zombies.

noise_emitter_on.name: noise emitter (on)
noise_emitter_on.description: A homemade device that is emitting horrible crackles, pops, and other loud static sounds.  Quick, get away from it before it draws zombies to you!

use_action.msg: The infernal racket dies as the noise emitter turns off.

emf_detector.name: EMF detector (off)
emf_detector.description: This device detects and reads out different electromagnetic wave lengths.  It beeps with proximity and is sensitive enough you could use it to get a sense of direction.

emf_detector_on.name: EMF detector (on)
emf_detector_on.description: This device detects and reads out different wave lengths.  It is currently on, humming and beeping with proximity.  It is sensitive enough you could use it to get a sense of direction.

use_action.msg: The noise of your EMF detector slows to a halt.

portable_game.name: handheld game system
portable_game.description: A portable video game console, with a backlit screen allowing you to play in the dark.  You can use it to play a game, but this requires batteries.  Multiple game systems can be linked together for multiplayer games.

smart_phone.name: smartphone
smart_phone.description: A popular, fancy smartphone.  Capable of taking photos with its integrated camera and illuminating an area with its flashlight app, assuming it has enough charge.  The smartphone also has a clock app that includes an alarm and an app for tracking consumed calories.  Runs on a small, rechargeable power cell compatible with a Unified Power Supply.

use_action.message: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.

smartphone_music.name: smartphone - music
smartphone_music.description: This phone is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

use_action.message: You stop listening to music and take your earbuds out.

smart_phone_flashlight.name: smartphone - Flashlight
smart_phone_flashlight.description: A popular, fancy smartphone.  Capable of taking photos with its integrated camera and illuminating an area with its flashlight app, assuming it has enough charge.  The smartphone also has a clock app that includes an alarm and an app for tracking consumed calories.  Runs on a small, rechargeable power cell compatible with a Unified Power Supply.

smart_phone_locked.name: smartphone (locked)
smart_phone_locked.description: A popular, fancy smartphone.  Sadly for you, its previous user used its security features, rendering you unable to use most of its qualities.  You are still able to check the time and use a flashlight.  Runs on a small, rechargeable power cell compatible with a Unified Power Supply.

use_action.description: You can reset the smartphone to be able to use all its functions.

smart_phone_locked_flashlight.name: smartphone (locked) - Flashlight
smart_phone_locked_flashlight.description: A popular, fancy smartphone.  Sadly for you, its previous user used its security features, rendering you unable to use most of its qualities.  You are still able to check the time and use a flashlight.  Runs on a small, rechargeable power cell compatible with a Unified Power Supply.

UPS_off.name: UPS
UPS_off.description: A unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a device developed jointly by military and scientific interests for use in combat and the field.  The UPS is designed to power tools, smartphones, armor, and some guns, but drains batteries quickly.

UPS_ON.name: UPS (on)
UPS_ON.description: A unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a device developed jointly by military and scientific interests for use in combat and the field.  The UPS is designed to power tools, smartphones, armor, and some guns, but drains batteries quickly.

UPS_OFF.name: UPS (off)
UPS_OFF.description: A unified power supply, or UPS.  It is a device developed jointly by military and scientific interests for use in combat and the field.  The UPS is designed to power tools, smartphones, armor, and some guns, but drains batteries quickly.  Use it to turn it on.

methanol_fuel_cell.name: methanol fuel cell UPS
methanol_fuel_cell.description: A direct methanol fuel cell which can provide power to UPS-compatible electronic devices by oxidizing methanol supplied from a specialized fuel tank to produce electricity.

gas_charger.name: gas-powered UPS (off)
gas_charger.description: A compact thermoelectric generator.  Burns propane gas to charge UPS devices.  Use it to turn it on.

gas_charger_on.name: gas-powered UPS (on)
gas_charger_on.description: A compact thermoelectric generator.  When connected to a propane tank, it will slowly charge UPS-compatible devices.

noise_emitter_super.name: super noise emitter (off)
noise_emitter_super.description: This is a noisemaker that has been further enhanced with a series of amplifiers.  It's about as loud something can get without making you vomit from sound-induced nausea, and it's as sure to attract every zombie in town as it is to give you permanent hearing damage.

noise_emitter_super_on.name: super noise emitter (on)
noise_emitter_super_on.description: This is a noisemaker that has been further enhanced with a series of amplifiers.  It's currently making an extraordinary amount of noise - hopefully you have hearing protection.

use_action.msg: The infernal racket dies as the noise emitter turns off.

sound_message.str: Your super noise emitter produces an unholy blast of sonic chaos.

crowbar.name: crowbar
crowbar.description: A hefty prying tool.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them, or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

emergency_lockpick.name: rudimentary lockpick
emergency_lockpick.description: A pair of thin pieces of metal, one bent in an 'L' shape to push tumblers and the other acting as a torsion wrench.  These tools are almost totally inadequate for picking locks, but when you've got nothing else, it might work.

crude_picklock.name: improvised lockpick
crude_picklock.description: An improvised pick and torsion wrench made from scrap metal.  You'll need MacGyver-like skills to open locks with these as they are brittle, but they lower the chances of alarms being set off.

iceaxe.name: ice axe
iceaxe.description: An ice axe with a hammer on the other end, a multi-purpose hiking and climbing tool used by mountaineers.  It is sturdy enough to lift manhole covers.

makeshift_crowbar.name: makeshift crowbar
makeshift_crowbar.description: A pipe with both ends bent and hammered flat to resemble a crowbar.  Use it to open locked crates without destroying them, or to lift manhole covers.  It's not strong enough to pry doors or windows, though.  You could also wield it to fight with, in a pinch.

picklocks.name: locksmith kit
picklocks.description: A locksmith's set of sturdy steel lockpicks and torsion wrenches.  It is essential for silently and quickly opening locks, provided you have some lockpicking and mechanical skills.

heavy_crowbar.name: heavy crowbar
heavy_crowbar.description: A 60-inch-long construction prybar.  Essentially a long, solid steel rod with a hardened chisel tip.

c4.name: C-4 explosive
c4.description: A block of military-grade RDX composition explosive.  A label reads: "Highly explosive, use with extreme caution!" It comes with a small timer.

c4armed.name: C-4 explosive
c4armed.description: A block of military-grade RDX composition explosive.  A label reads: "Highly explosive, use with extreme caution!" It comes with a small timer, which is currently ticking down.

use_action.message: You've already activated the %s.  Get rid of it and clear out!

dynamite.name: dynamite
dynamite.description: Several sticks of explosives, bundled together with a fuse attached.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

dynamite_act.name: dynamite
dynamite_act.description: The fuse on this dynamite is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Light fuse

dynamite_bomb.name: dynamite bomb
dynamite_bomb.description: Several sticks of explosives stuffed inside a metal container and surrounded with shrapnel.  The fuse is sticking out through a small hole.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  Shortly after lighting the fuse, this item will explode, so get away!

dynamite_bomb_act.name: dynamite bomb
dynamite_bomb_act.description: The fuse on this dynamite bomb is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse.  Get rid of it and clear out!
use_action.name: Light fuse

EMPbomb.name: EMP bomb
EMPbomb.description: This substantial device is a bomb that generates an electromagnetic pulse.  When activated, the plutonium fuel cell is drained into a flux compression generator, the detonation of which creates a strong magnetic field.  When this magnetic field is fed into the antenna, it creates a strong electro-magnetic pulse.

EMPbomb_act.name: EMP bomb
EMPbomb_act.description: This EMP bomb is active and will shortly detonate, creating a large EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy, as well as a sizeable explosion.  You may not want to be holding it much longer.

use_action.message: You've already activated the %s.  Get rid of it and clear out!
use_action.name: Activate

firecracker.name: firecracker
firecracker.description: A solitary firecracker with a short fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse it will explode, so throw it quickly!

firecracker_act.name: firecracker
firecracker_act.description: A firecracker that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw it quickly before it explodes.

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Light up

firecracker_pack.name: pack of firecrackers
firecracker_pack.description: A pack of 25 firecrackers with a starter fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Of course, you will need a lighter or some matches to do so.  Shortly after you light the fuse they will begin to explode, so throw them quickly!

use_action.msg: You light the pack of firecrackers.

firecracker_pack_act.name: pack of firecrackers
firecracker_pack_act.description: A pack of 25 firecrackers that has been lit; the fuse is hissing.  Throw them quickly before they start to explode.

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Light up

flashbang.name: flashbang
flashbang.description: A military police-style flashbang.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse.  You will then have two seconds before it detonates with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening, and disorienting anyone nearby.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

flashbang_act.name: flashbang
flashbang_act.description: This flashbang is active, and will soon detonate with intense light and sound, blinding, deafening, and disorienting anyone nearby.  It may be a good idea to throw it!

use_action.message: You've already pulled the pin, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Pull pin

grenade.name: grenade
grenade.description: A military-grade fragmentation hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

grenade_act.name: grenade
grenade_act.description: This fragmentation grenade is active, and will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.message: You've already pulled the pin, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Pull pin

grenade_emp.name: EMP grenade
grenade_emp.description: A grenade that generates an electromagnetic pulse with a low-inductance capacitor bank discharged into a single-loop antenna.  It also produces a mild electric shock cloud.  Use this item to pull the pin and light the fuse, turning it into an active EMP grenade.  You will then have three seconds before it detonates, creating an EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

grenade_emp_act.name: EMP grenade
grenade_emp_act.description: This EMP grenade is active and will shortly detonate, creating a large EMP field that damages robots and drains bionic energy, as well as a mild electric shock cloud.  You may not want to be holding it much longer.

use_action.message: You've already pulled the pin, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Pull pin

grenade_inc.name: incendiary grenade
grenade_inc.description: A military-grade incendiary hand grenade.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes into a raging inferno; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

grenade_inc_act.name: incendiary grenade
grenade_inc_act.description: An active incendiary grenade, likely to burst into an inferno any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

LAW_Packed.name: packed disposable rocket launcher
LAW_Packed.description: A packed, disposable light anti-tank rocket launcher.  Once fired, it cannot be reloaded and must be disposed of.  Activate it to pop it out and make it ready to fire.

use_action.msg: You pull the activating lever, readying the LAW to fire.

mininuke.name: SADM mininuke
mininuke.description: The B54 Special Atomic Demolition Munition is an extremely powerful weapon, a portable nuclear bomb, using the smallest nuclear warhead in US inventory.  It is housed inside a extremely sturdy transit container.  Use it to activate the timer.  You guess that the explosion would be large enough to take out a small house.

mininuke_act.name: SADM mininuke
mininuke_act.description: The nuclear bomb looks no different from the outside, yet you know that the device is armed and counting down.  You should probably get far, far away from it.

use_action.message: You've already activated the %s.  Get rid of it and clear out!

molotov.name: Molotov cocktail
molotov.description: A bottle of flammable liquid with a rag inserted.  Use this item to light the rag.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  After lighting it, throw it to cause fires.

molotov_lit.name: Molotov cocktail
molotov_lit.description: A bottle of flammable liquid with a flaming rag stoppered in its neck.  Throwing it will shatter the bottle on impact and ignite a fireball.  Dropping it will set you on fire, so don't do that unless you want to burn to death.

gelled_molotov.name: gelled Molotov
gelled_molotov.description: An older brother of the generic Molotov cocktail, this wicked beverage uses thickened gasoline or straight napalm.  It, surprisingly, does not make for a fire of much higher temperature, but what it does is make the burning mixture ever more sticky.

gelled_molotov_lit.name: gelled Molotov
gelled_molotov_lit.description: An older brother of the generic Molotov cocktail, this wicked beverage uses thickened gasoline or straight napalm.  It, surprisingly, does not make for a fire of much higher temperature, but what it does is make the burning mixture ever more sticky.

tick_action.msg: Your lit gelled Molotov goes out.

scrambler.name: scrambler grenade
scrambler.description: A specialized grenade designed to scramble robots' IFF control chips.  This converts the robot to your side for a short time, before the backup systems kick in.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active scrambler grenade.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

scrambler_act.name: scrambler grenade
scrambler_act.description: This scrambler grenade is active and will soon detonate, releasing a control wave that temporarily converts robots to your side.

use_action.message: You've already pulled the pin, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Pull pin

military_explosive_small_grenade.name: military explosive small homemade grenade
military_explosive_small_grenade.description: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from parts.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows up in your face!

military_explosive_small_grenade_act.name: military explosive small homemade grenade
military_explosive_small_grenade_act.description: The fuse on this improvised grenade is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Light fuse

military_explosive_grenade.name: military explosive homemade grenade
military_explosive_grenade.description: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from parts.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have five seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows up in your face!

military_explosive_grenade_act.name: military explosive homemade grenade
military_explosive_grenade_act.description: The fuse on this improvised grenade is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Light fuse

military_explosive_pipebomb.name: military explosive pipebomb
military_explosive_pipebomb.description: A section of steel pipe filled with military explosives.  Use this item to pull the pin, giving you six seconds to get away from it before it detonates.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

military_explosive_pipebomb_act.name: military explosive pipebomb
military_explosive_pipebomb_act.description: This pipebomb's pin is pulled, and it will explode any second now.  Throw it immediately!

use_action.message: You've already pulled the pin, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Pull pin

military_explosive_bomb.name: military explosive bomb
military_explosive_bomb.description: A homemade explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with military explosives and scrap metal, equipped with a delayed fuse.  Use this item to pull the pin.  Once you do, it should explode after about 20 seconds.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

military_explosive_bomb_act.name: military explosive bomb
military_explosive_bomb_act.description: A homemade explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with military explosives and scrap metal.  Its fuse has been lit, its final countdown starting.

use_action.message: You've already activated the %s.  Get rid of it and clear out!
use_action.name: Pull pin

military_explosive_half_barrel_bomb.name: military explosive 50 L barrel bomb
military_explosive_half_barrel_bomb.description: A metal keg filled with military explosives.  Once it has been activated, it will explode after 100 seconds, raining fire and steel on everything in sight.

use_action.msg: You activate the fuse on the barrel bomb.  Clear the area!

military_explosive_half_barrel_bomb_act.name: military explosive 50 L barrel bomb
military_explosive_half_barrel_bomb_act.description: A metal keg filled with military explosives.  It has been activated and will soon explode, delivering its entire destructive power to everything in sight.

use_action.name: Activate fuse

military_explosive_full_barrel_bomb.name: military explosive 100 L barrel bomb
military_explosive_full_barrel_bomb.description: A 100 L metal barrel filled with military explosives.  Once it has been activated it will explode after 100 seconds, raining fire and steel on everything in sight.

military_explosive_full_barrel_bomb_act.name: military explosive 100 L barrel bomb
military_explosive_full_barrel_bomb_act.description: A 100 L metal barrel filled with military explosives.  It has been activated and will soon explode, delivering its entire destructive power to everything in sight.

use_action.name: Activate fuse

small_homemade_grenade.name: small homemade grenade
small_homemade_grenade.description: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from spare parts.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have 5 seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows up in your face!

small_homemade_grenade_act.name: small homemade grenade
small_homemade_grenade_act.description: The fuse on this improvised grenade is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Light fuse

homemade_grenade.name: homemade grenade
homemade_grenade.description: An improvised explosive device cobbled together from spare parts.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will then have 5 seconds before it explodes; throwing it would be a good idea.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the improvised grenade.  Throw it before it blows up in your face!

homemade_grenade_act.name: homemade grenade
homemade_grenade_act.description: The fuse on this improvised grenade is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Better throw it!

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Light fuse

pipebomb.name: pipebomb
pipebomb.description: A section of steel pipe filled with explosives.  Use this item to light the fuse, giving you six seconds to get away from it before it detonates.  You'll need a lighter or some matches to use it.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the pipe bomb.

pipebomb_act.name: pipebomb
pipebomb_act.description: This pipebomb's fuse is lit, and it will explode any second now.  Throw it immediately!

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Light fuse

homemade_bomb.name: homemade bomb
homemade_bomb.description: A homemade explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with stable explosives and scrap metal, equipped with a long fuse.  Use this item to light the fuse.  Once you do, it should explode after about 20 seconds.

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the bomb.  Get rid of it quickly!

homemade_bomb_act.name: homemade bomb
homemade_bomb_act.description: A homemade explosive device, consisting of a large plastic jug filled with stable explosives and scrap metal.  Its fuse has been lit, its final countdown starting.

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse.  Get rid of it and clear out!
use_action.name: Light fuse

homemade_demolition_charge.name: homemade demolition charge
homemade_demolition_charge.description: An improvised demolition charge.  Use this item to light the fuse.  You will, of course, need a lighter or matches in your inventory to do this.  20 seconds after lighting the fuse, it will explode, so get away!

use_action.msg: You light the fuse on the bomb.  Get rid of it quickly!

homemade_demolition_charge_act.name: homemade demolition charge
homemade_demolition_charge_act.description: The fuse on this primitive demolition charge is lit and hissing.  It'll explode any moment now.

use_action.message: You've already lit the fuse.  Get rid of it and clear out!
use_action.name: Light fuse

half_barrel_bomb.name: 50 L barrel bomb
half_barrel_bomb.description: A metal keg filled with stable explosives.  Contains a volatile explosive core, so 100 seconds after the fuse has been lit the charge will detonate completely, delivering its entire destructive power to everything in sight.

use_action.msg: You activate the fuse on the barrel bomb.  Clear the area!

half_barrel_bomb_act.name: 50 L barrel bomb
half_barrel_bomb_act.description: A metal keg filled with stable explosives.  The fuse has been lit and once it ignites the primary explosive, the bomb will detonate and rain fire and steel on everything in sight.

use_action.message: You've already activated the %s.  Get rid of it and clear out!
use_action.name: Activate fuse

full_barrel_bomb.name: 100 L barrel bomb
full_barrel_bomb.description: A 100 L metal barrel filled with military explosives.  Once it has been activated it will explode after 100 seconds, raining fire and steel on everything in sight.
