full_barrel_bomb_act.name: 100 L barrel bomb
full_barrel_bomb_act.description: A 100 L metal barrel filled with military explosives.  It has been activated and will soon explode, delivering its entire destructive power to everything in sight.

use_action.message: You've already activated the %s.  Get rid of it and clear out!
use_action.name: Activate fuse

60mm_propellant.name: 60 mm mortar propellant charge
60mm_propellant.description: Small explosive in a form of donut without a piece, this thing is designed to be attached on the mortar shell tail, to increase the projectile velocity and, therefore, its range.  Since the projectile it was connected to was already shot, you can only cut it for its content.

crude_firestarter.name: electric firestarter
crude_firestarter.description: A crudely-made electric firestarter, which can function as an inefficient lighter.

fire_drill.name: bow fire drill
fire_drill.description: A simple item for starting fires with friction between a notched plank and wooden shaft.  The shaft is spun rapidly with a sawing motion by a bowstring wrapped around it.  Very slow to acquire a usable ember.

fire_drill_large.name: pump fire drill
fire_drill_large.description: A simple item for starting fires by friction between a notched plank and wooden shaft, with a flywheel attached.  The shaft is spun rapidly with a pumping motion by a cord wrapped around it.  Slow to acquire a usable ember.

flint_steel.name: flint and steel
flint_steel.description: A piece of flint paired with a hardened high carbon steel striker.  Use it to spark a flame.

lighter.name: lighter
lighter.description: A disposable plastic lighter, capable of creating a small flame with the flick of a finger.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.

magnifying_glass.name: magnifying glass
magnifying_glass.description: A magnifying glass, for closely examining fine details.  It can also be used for starting fires if direct sunlight is available.

lens_crude.name: crude glass lens
lens_crude.description: A very low-quality focusing lens, made from non-optical-grade glass.  Useless for building most optical devices, but you can start a fire with it if sunlight is available.

fire_piston.name: fire piston
fire_piston.description: A firestarting tool of Southeast Asian origin, consisting of a thin, hollow wooden cylinder sealed at one end and open at the other, and a wooden piston forming an airtight circular seal with it, making use of rapid and adiabatic air compression to ignite a piece of tinder.  It also comes with a tinder container to keep tinder dry.  Use it to start a fire.

matches.name: matchbook
matches.description: A small book of matches with a coarse strike surface on the outside flap for lighting them.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.  Due to the matches being lightly glued to the matchbook, they can be removed, but not replaced on the book.

survival_match.name: survival match
survival_match.description: A solid strike anywhere match.  One and done.

ref_matches.name: matchbox
ref_matches.description: A small box of matches with a coarse strike surface on the side for lighting them.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.

ref_lighter.name: refillable lighter
ref_lighter.description: A stylish lighter featuring a flip-top cover and a refuelable tank, capable of creating a small flame with the flick of a finger.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.

ref_lighter_on.name: refillable lighter
ref_lighter_on.description: A stylish lighter featuring a flip-top cover and a refuelable tank.  It is lit.

ref_lighter_butane.name: refillable butane lighter
ref_lighter_butane.description: A large lighter with a trigger and a safety, reloaded by fitting a can of butane inside the base.  Allows you to use various drugs like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.

tinderbox.name: ember carrier
tinderbox.description: A small container for holding tinder, with holes punched in it to provide a controlled airflow.  It can nurture a smoldering ember for a long time, to start fires without modern tools.

use_action.need_charges_msg: The ember carrier is out of tinder.

tinderbox_on.name: ember carrier (lit)
tinderbox_on.description: A small container for holding tinder, with holes punched in it to provide a controlled airflow.  An ember is smoldering inside it, and can be used to start a campfire.

small_lighter.name: mini lighter
small_lighter.description: A miniature disposable plastic lighter, capable of creating a small flame with the flick of a finger.  Allows you to use various drugs, like cigarettes, light explosives like Molotov cocktails, or light nearby items on fire.

crash_axe.name: crash axe
crash_axe.description: A short, lightweight emergency tool with a quarter-circular blade, a short pick opposite the blade, and an insulated handle.  Used on airplanes to chop down or pry walls or cabinets to gain access in case of a fire.

extinguisher.name: large fire extinguisher
extinguisher.description: An emergency fire extinguisher containing five gallons of fire-retardant foam.  Useful for putting out adjacent fires.

fire_ax.name: fire axe
fire_ax.description: A large, two-handed pickhead axe normally used by firefighters.  It makes a powerful melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.  The pickhead is for spiking into doors and glass and is not effective at hooking limbs of opponents.

pocket_data.description: Marrying strap for a Halligan bar.

halligan.name: Halligan bar
halligan.description: A heavy, multiple-use tool commonly carried by firefighters, law enforcement, and military rescue units.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

sm_extinguisher.name: small fire extinguisher
sm_extinguisher.description: A handheld fire extinguisher containing a liter of highly compressed CO2 gas.  Useful for putting out adjacent fires.

throw_extinguisher.name: throwable fire extinguisher
throw_extinguisher.description: A fire extinguisher in grenade form.  While not as effective as a regular fire extinguisher, you can use it from a farther distance.  It has a plastic plug that can be pulled, but is primarily activated by heat, so just throw it into the flames.

use_action.msg: You pull the plug on the extinguisher grenade.

throw_extinguisher_act.name: active throwable fire extinguisher
throw_extinguisher_act.description: An active extinguisher grenade, likely to burst any second now.  Better throw it!

pike_pole.name: pike pole
pike_pole.description: A durable tool consisting of a sturdy fiberglass shaft tipped with a small steel hook.

EOD_hotstick.name: EOD hot stick
EOD_hotstick.description: A durable tool consisting of a sturdy fiberglass shaft tipped with a set of 3 hooks, one large opposed by two small.  Hot sticks are used to maintain some standoff distance when manual manipulation of explosives is necessary, and robot assistance is unavailable.

ny_hook.name: New York hook
ny_hook.description: A shaft with a pair of hooks on one end and a pry bar on the other, forged from a single piece of steel.

fish_trap.name: plastic fish trap
fish_trap.description: A makeshift fish trap made from plastic bottles.  It's simple, even primitive, but easy to use.  The principle of action: the fish swims inside to eat the bait, but can't get out.  Not humane and prohibited by law, but there are no cops left to care.

fish_trap_basket.name: basket fish trap
fish_trap_basket.description: A long wicker fish trap made from bark, reeds, cordage, or other natural materials.  It's a staple fishing tool in many pre-industrial societies.  The principle of action: the fish swims inside to eat the bait, but can't get out.

fishing_hook_bone.name: improvised fishing hook
fishing_hook_bone.description: An improvised fishing hook carved from wood or bone.

fishing_rod_basic.name: basic fishing rod
fishing_rod_basic.description: 'Fishing rod' might be a bit too charitable of a description.  In truth, this is a stick with a piece of string and a hook.

fishing_rod_professional.name: pro fishing rod
fishing_rod_professional.description: A professional fishing rod with a matching set of weights.  With this, you should be able to catch 'em all.

fishing_rod_2pc_packed.name: two-piece fishing rod (packed)
fishing_rod_2pc_packed.description: A commercial two-piece fishing rod that has been disassembled for ease of transport and storage.

use_action.msg: You put together your two-piece fishing rod.

fishing_rod_2pc.name: two-piece fishing rod
fishing_rod_2pc.description: A commercial two-piece fishing rod, assembled and ready for use.

use_action.msg: You take apart your two-piece fishing rod.

fishing_rod_tele_packed.name: telescoping fishing rod (packed)
fishing_rod_tele_packed.description: A commercial telescoping fishing rod that has been retracted for ease of transport and storage.

use_action.msg: You extend your telescoping fishing rod.

fishing_rod_tele.name: telescoping fishing rod
fishing_rod_tele.description: A commercial telescoping fishing rod, extended and ready for use.

use_action.msg: You retract your telescoping fishing rod.

plastichoboreel.name: plastic hand fishing reel
plastichoboreel.description: A commercial hand fishing reel.  It is a short rod with a section on one end with fishing line wrapped around it, with a rotating guard around that.  It is not as effective as a normal fishing pole, but is much more compact.

hoboreel.name: wooden hand fishing reel
hoboreel.description: A short wooden rod with a section on one end with fishing line wrapped around it, with a notch to put the string though to help pull in fish.  It is not as effective as a normal fishing pole, but is much more compact than them.

gasbomb.name: tear gas grenade
gasbomb.description: A canister grenade filled with noxious irritant.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active tear gas grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a highly toxic gas for some time.  This gas damages and slows those who enter it, as well as obscuring vision and scent.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

gasbomb_primed.name: tear gas grenade
gasbomb_primed.description: This tear gas grenade has had its pin removed and will shortly be expelling highly noxious gas.

use_action.message: You've already pulled the pin, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Pull pin

gasbomb_act.name: tear gas grenade
gasbomb_act.description: This tear gas grenade has had its pin removed and is expelling highly noxious gas.

use_action.message: You've already pulled the pin, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Pull pin

smokebomb.name: smoke grenade
smokebomb.description: A canister grenade filled with a variety of pyrotechnic chemicals.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active smoke bomb.  Five seconds after you do that, it will begin to expel a thick white smoke.  This smoke will obscure vision and scent, and choke out those who enter it.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

smokebomb_primed.name: smoke grenade
smokebomb_primed.description: This smoke bomb has had its pin removed and will shortly be expelling thick smoke.

use_action.message: You've already pulled the pin, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Pull pin

smokebomb_act.name: smoke grenade
smokebomb_act.description: This smoke bomb has had its pin removed and is expelling thick smoke.

insecticidalbomb.name: insecticidal gas grenade
insecticidalbomb.description: A canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a volatile gas that is highly toxic to insect life forms.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

insecticidalbomb_primed.description: This grenade has had its pin removed and will shortly be expelling highly toxic gas.

use_action.name: Pull pin

insecticidalbomb_makeshift.description: A makeshift canister grenade filled with insecticidal solution.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active insecticidal grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a volatile gas that is highly toxic to insect life forms.

gasbomb_makeshift.description: A makeshift canister grenade filled with household chemicals.  Use this item to pull the pin and start the fuse, turning it into an active toxic gas grenade.  In five seconds it will begin to expel a highly toxic gas for a short time.  This gas poisons those exposed to it, in addition to obscuring vision and scent.

tool_rocket_candy.name: rocket candy
tool_rocket_candy.description: A pear-shaped chunk of rocket candy obtained by heating saltpeter with sugar and casting the obtained liquid.  Can serve as a rocket fuel, but also as a smokescreen - if you light the narrow end, you should be able to throw it before the flame reaches the broad end.

use_action.msg: You light the rocket candy on fire.  Throw it!

tool_rocket_candy_primed.name: rocket candy
tool_rocket_candy_primed.description: A chunk of rocket candy that has been ignited and burns with a loud hiss.

use_action.message: You've already lit the rocket candy, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Light up

tool_rocket_candy_act.name: rocket candy
tool_rocket_candy_act.description: A chunk of rocket candy that burns with a loud hiss, spewing forth large amounts of smoke.

use_action.message: You've already lit the rocket candy, try throwing it instead.
use_action.name: Light up

press.name: hand press
press.description: A small hand press for hand loading firearm ammunition.  It comes with everything you need to start hand loading your own munitions.

press_dowel.name: makeshift shotshell 'press'
press_dowel.description: A collection of items improvised for field reloading of shotshells.  A plank with a hole cut in the center, a medium-sized nail, and a whittled dowel are used to seat wads, decap primers, and (carefully!) reprime hulls.  Powder and shot are measured with a cut-down shotshell hull.  The opposite side of the plank has been shaped to allow for roll-crimping of the plastic hulls.  There's no provision for resizing, so reloaded hulls will fire best in the firearm they were fired from.

puller.name: kinetic bullet puller
puller.description: A tool used for properly disassembling firearm ammunition.

arbor_press.name: arbor press
arbor_press.description: A small hand operated press, it can be used for staking, rivetting, or various other small jobs.  If you had a swage and die, you could use it to make copper jackets for handloading.

internal_gasoline_tank.name: internal gasoline tank
internal_gasoline_tank.description: The internal tank for a gasoline fuel cell bionic.

internal_ethanol_tank.name: internal ethanol tank
internal_ethanol_tank.description: The internal ethanol tank for an ethanol burner bionic.

internal_oil_tank.name: internal oil tank
internal_oil_tank.description: The internal oil tank for an oil generator bionic.

internal_battery_compartment.name: internal battery compartment
internal_battery_compartment.description: The internal compartment for holding medium sized batteries, for a battery system bionic.

toolset.name: integrated multitool
toolset.description: Integrated bionic tools implanted in your fingers.

integrated_welder.name: integrated welder
integrated_welder.description: Integrated bionic miniature welding tool implanted in your fingers.

integrated_multimeter.name: integrated multimeter
integrated_multimeter.description: Integrated bionic multimeter implanted in your fingers.

integrated_electrokit.name: integrated soldering iron
integrated_electrokit.description: Integrated soldering iron and screwdriver set.

copper_knife.name: copper knife
copper_knife.description: A knife made of crudely-worked copper with a simple handle.  Primitive, but a step above stone-age.

bronze_knife.name: bronze knife
bronze_knife.description: A cast bronze knife with a full tang, with a handle wrapped in cord and leather, lovingly work-hardened and sharpened to a fine edge.

diveknife.name: dive knife
diveknife.description: A short, sturdy knife with a serrated edge for cutting lines and straps, and a blunt tip for prying.  Used primarily by divers, this knife has been fitted with cork to slow its descent if dropped underwater, so it takes up more space than usual.

honey_scraper.name: honey scraper
honey_scraper.description: A sharp, knife-like tool used for harvesting honey from beehives.  Makes a passable melee weapon.

pockknife.name: pocket knife
pockknife.description: A small pocket knife.  It isn't great for combat, but it's better than nothing.  It's sharp enough to butcher with.

primitive_knife.name: stone knife
primitive_knife.description: A sharpened stone set into a hollowed handle.  Not nearly as usable as a proper knife, but it's better than nothing.

boxcutter.name: boxcutter knife
boxcutter.description: A small knife designed for opening boxes.  It could cause some damage, but it really should be used against inanimate objects.  It is too small to effectively butcher corpses with.

stone_chopper.name: stone chopper
stone_chopper.description: A rock with sharpened edges, produced by knapping.  Works as a crude cutting and butchering tool, if nothing else is available.

digging_stick.name: digging stick
digging_stick.description: A large stick with the end carved into a broad blade for digging.  It could be used to dig shallow pits, but not deep ones.

g_shovel.name: trowel
g_shovel.description: A small, sharp gardening shovel, perfect for digging up grubs and worms.

hoe.name: hoe
hoe.description: A farming implement.  You can use it to turn tillable land into a slow-to-cross pile of dirt, or dig a shallow pit.

bronze_hoe.name: bronze hoe
bronze_hoe.description: A farming implement made from bronze.  The added heft and durability should let you till soil for farming more easily as well.

primitive_shovel.name: wooden shovel
primitive_shovel.description: A crude shovel with a shovelhead made from wood, historically used as an alternative to metal shovels when metal was too expensive.  It works passably well, but really can't compare to a metal shovel.

rake.name: metal rake
rake.description: A sturdy metal rake, a must-have during autumn.

rake_plastic.name: plastic rake
rake_plastic.description: A cheap plastic rake.  Will break quite quickly if used for anything other than raking leaves.

scythe.name: scythe
scythe.description: An old-fashioned farming tool used to cut tall grass.  Despite being a giant blade on the end of a stick, it is incredibly awkward to use for anything but its intended purpose.

scythe_fake.name: scythe
scythe_fake.description: A dull, cheaply-made replica of an old-fashioned farming tool used to cut tall grass.

scythe_toy.name: grim reaper's scythe
scythe_toy.description: A long, crooked tool used to reap souls, with a skull engraved in its blade.  Let the harvest begin.

shovel.name: shovel
shovel.description: A digging tool.  Use it to dig pits adjacent to your location.

shovel_snow.name: snow shovel
shovel_snow.description: A sturdy metal shovel used for picking up snow and moving it somewhere else.  It was useful before the Cataclysm, but now it's useless.

shovel_snow_plastic.name: plastic snow shovel
shovel_snow_plastic.description: A cheap plastic shovel used for picking up snow and moving it somewhere else.  It was useful before the Cataclysm, but now it's useless.

sickle_stone.name: stone sickle
sickle_stone.description: A primitive tool for cutting grass.  The sharp, crescent-shaped stone at the end of the handle is barely good enough for the job.

sickle.name: sickle
sickle.description: An old-fashioned farming tool for cutting tall grass.  Despite being a massive curved blade on a handle, it is incredibly awkward to use for anything but its intended purpose.

bronze_sickle.name: bronze sickle
bronze_sickle.description: A handheld grass-cutting tool with a cast bronze blade, fastened to a wood handle wrapped with leather.

brush_handaxe.name: bill
brush_handaxe.description: A slightly curved steel blade with a nice wooden handle, not too dissimilar to a machete.

brush_axe.name: bill axe
brush_axe.description: The steel curved blade of a bill placed stoutly on top an axe handle.  It still isn't long enough to use as a spear, but it'll still cleave your enemies.

brush_pole.name: bill pole
brush_pole.description: A long, slightly curved steel blade on the end of a sturdy shaft.  Could be used to thoroughly ruin something's day, or cut branches and small trees.

bronze_brush_handaxe.name: bronze bill
bronze_brush_handaxe.description: The bronze curved blade of a bill placed stoutly atop an axe handle.  It still isn't long enough to use as a spear, but it'll still cleave your enemies.

bronze_brush_axe.name: bronze bill axe
bronze_brush_axe.description: A slightly curved bronze blade with a nice wooden handle, not too dissimilar to a machete.

bronze_brush_pole.name: bronze bill pole
bronze_brush_pole.description: A long, slightly curved and hooked bronze blade on the end of a sturdy shaft.  Could be used to thoroughly ruin something's day, or cut branches and small trees.

trimmer_off.name: hedge trimmer (off)
trimmer_off.description: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  A long line of sharp-edged teeth extends from the engine; turning the trimmer on will make them rapidly vibrate.  The poor man's chainsaw as far as the zombies are concerned.

success_message.str: With a roar, the hedge trimmer leaps to life!

failure_message.str: You yank the cord, but nothing happens.

false_effect.u_message: You yank the cord, but nothing happens.

trimmer_on.name: hedge trimmer (on)
trimmer_on.description: A cordless, double-sided, gasoline-powered hedge trimmer.  It is currently on, ready to do some zombie topiary; use this item to turn it off.

candle.name: candle
candle.description: A thick wax candle.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

candle_lit.name: burning candle
candle_lit.description: A thick wax candle.  It doesn't provide very much light, but it can burn for quite a long time.  This candle is lit.

electric_lantern.name: electric lantern (off)
electric_lantern.description: A battery-powered lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.

electric_lantern_on.name: electric lantern (on)
electric_lantern_on.description: A battery-powered lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.

flashlight.name: flashlight (off)
flashlight.description: A typical household flashlight with a plastic handle, powered by batteries.

use_action.damage_failure_msg: You press the button on your %s, but nothing happens.

flashlight_on.name: flashlight (on)
flashlight_on.description: A typical household flashlight with a plastic handle, powered by batteries.

diving_flashlight_small.name: mini diving flashlight (off)
diving_flashlight_small.description: A small waterproof flashlight with an aluminum handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods.

diving_flashlight_small_on.name: mini diving flashlight (on)
diving_flashlight_small_on.description: A small waterproof flashlight with an aluminum handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods.

diving_flashlight_small_hipower.name: high-power mini diving flashlight (off)
diving_flashlight_small_hipower.description: A small waterproof high-power flashlight with an aluminum handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods.

diving_flashlight_small_hipower_on.name: high-power mini diving flashlight (on)
diving_flashlight_small_hipower_on.description: A small waterproof high-power flashlight with an aluminum handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods.

diving_flashlight_variable.name: variable power diving flashlight (off)
diving_flashlight_variable.description: A waterproof variable power flashlight with a plastic handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods and onto a proprietary wrist mount.

diving_flashlight_variable_on_hi.name: variable power diving flashlight (on, high)
diving_flashlight_variable_on_hi.description: A waterproof variable power flashlight with a plastic handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods and onto a proprietary wrist mount.

use_action.msg: You decrease power of the flashlight.

diving_flashlight_variable_on_hi.name_plural: variable power mini diving flashlights (on, high)

diving_flashlight_variable_on_med.name: variable power diving flashlight (on, medium)
diving_flashlight_variable_on_med.description: A waterproof variable power flashlight with a plastic handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods and onto a proprietary wrist mount.

use_action.msg: You decrease power of the flashlight.

diving_flashlight_variable_on_med.name_plural: variable power mini diving flashlights (on, medium)

diving_flashlight_variable_on_low.name: variable power diving flashlight (on, low)
diving_flashlight_variable_on_low.description: A waterproof variable power flashlight with a plastic handle, powered by batteries.  Can be attached to some diving masks and hoods and onto a proprietary wrist mount.
diving_flashlight_variable_on_low.name_plural: variable power mini diving flashlights (on, low)

gasoline_lantern.name: gasoline lantern (off)
gasoline_lantern.description: A small gasoline-powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

gasoline_lantern_on.name: gasoline lantern (on)
gasoline_lantern_on.description: A small gasoline-powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  It is turned on.  Use it to turn it off.

glowstick.name: glowstick
glowstick.description: A small blue-light glowstick.  Use it to bend the plastic and break the glass cylinder inside to start the reaction.  It will produce a small amount of light.

glowstick_dead.name: dead glowstick
glowstick_dead.description: A spent glowstick.  It is essentially trash.

glowstick_lit.name: active glowstick
glowstick_lit.description: An active glowstick, currently producing light.  It will last for a few hours before burning out.

handflare.name: flare
handflare.description: A slow-burning magnesium flare.  Use it to strike the striker and light it.  It will produce a bright light for about a half hour.

use_action.msg: You strike your flare and light it.

handflare_lit.name: active flare
handflare_lit.description: A burning magnesium flare that is producing light.  It will last for about a half hour before burning out.

sigflare_lit.name: active flare
sigflare_lit.description: A bright burning flare that is producing light.  It will last for about a minute before burning out.

heavy_flashlight.name: heavy-duty flashlight (off)
heavy_flashlight.description: A heavy-duty LED flashlight with a durable polymer housing.  It's impact-resistant, chemical-resistant, waterproof and certified for use in hazardous environments.  Designed for firefighters, rescue personnel and miners but it can also be used for smacking hooligans.  It has a spring-loaded clip that can be attached to your torso.

use_action.msg: You turn the heavy-duty flashlight on.

heavy_flashlight_on.name: heavy-duty flashlight (on)
heavy_flashlight_on.description: A heavy-duty LED flashlight with a durable polymer housing.  It's impact-resistant, chemical-resistant, waterproof and certified for use in hazardous environments.  Designed for firefighters, rescue personnel and miners but it can also be used for smacking hooligans.  It has a spring-loaded clip that can be attached to your torso.

use_action.msg: You turn the heavy-duty flashlight off.

lightstrip.name: LED strip
lightstrip.description: 25 feet of colorful LED strip, that are often used as house lights or on some holidays.

lightstrip_inactive.name: LED strip (inactive)
lightstrip_inactive.description: 25 feet of colorful LED strip, that are often used as house lights or on some holidays.

oil_lamp.name: kerosene lamp (off)
oil_lamp.description: A kerosene-fueled lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

oil_lamp_on.name: kerosene lamp
oil_lamp_on.description: A kerosene-fueled lamp.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  It is turned on.  Use it to turn it off.

oil_lamp_clay.name: clay oil lamp (off)
oil_lamp_clay.description: A specialized small clay container with a wick, an ancient form of oil lamp.  Unlike newer designs, it isn't windproof, so the flame is likely to be extinguished if exposed to wind; better use it indoors.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to light it.

oil_lamp_clay_on.name: clay oil lamp
oil_lamp_clay_on.description: A specialized small clay container with a wick, an ancient form of oil lamp.  Unlike newer designs, it isn't windproof, so the flame is likely to be extinguished if exposed to wind; better use it indoors.  It does not provide much light, but lasts a long time.  It is lit, consuming oil and providing light.  Use it to extinguish the flame.

oxylamp.name: acetylene lamp (off)
oxylamp.description: An antique brass lamp designed to run from a pressurized cylinder of acetylene.  It is an efficient, if somewhat dangerous, light source.

use_action.need_charges_msg: The lamp must be attached to a welding tank to light.

oxylamp_on.name: acetylene lamp (on)
oxylamp_on.description: An antique brass lamp designed to run from a pressurized cylinder of acetylene.  It is an efficient, if somewhat dangerous, light source.

reading_light.name: reading light (off)
reading_light.description: A little clip-on LED light, meant for reading books in the dark.

reading_light_on.name: reading light (on)
reading_light_on.description: A little clip-on LED light, meant for reading books in the dark.  This one is turned on.

smart_lamp.name: smart lamp (off)
smart_lamp.description: A smart lamp that can be activated remotely.

smart_lamp_on.name: smart lamp (on)
smart_lamp_on.description: A smart lamp which can be deactivated remotely.  Currently it is turned on.

torch.name: torch
torch.description: A large stick wrapped in rags that are soaked with flammable material.  When lit, it produces a fair amount of light.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

torch_lit.name: torch
torch_lit.description: A large stick wrapped in rags that are soaked with flammable material.  It is burning, producing plenty of light.

propane_lantern.name: propane lantern (off)
propane_lantern.description: A small propane-powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  Use it to turn it on.

propane_lantern_on.name: propane lantern (on)
propane_lantern_on.description: A small propane-powered lantern.  It does not provide much light, but it lasts a long time.  It is turned on.  Use it to turn it off.

candle_small.name: small candle
candle_small.description: A thin wax candle.  It doesn't provide very much light and will burn relatively quickly.  You'll need a lighter or matches to light it.

candle_small_lit.name: burning small candle
candle_small_lit.description: A thin wax candle.  It doesn't provide very much light and will burn relatively quickly.  This candle is lit.

menorah.name: menorah
menorah.description: An eight-branched candelabra more properly called a 'hanukkiah', the menorah is used to celebrate the Jewish festival of Hanukkah.

masonrysaw_off.name: masonry saw (off)
masonrysaw_off.description: A construction tool for cutting through concrete or other surfaces.  It runs on gasoline.  Using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon or a terrible chainsaw.

success_message.str: With a roar, the <npc_name> screams to life!

failure_message.str: You yank the cord, but nothing happens.

false_effect.u_message: You yank the cord, but nothing happens.

masonrysaw_on.name: masonry saw (on)
masonrysaw_on.description: This masonry saw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

electric_masonrysaw_off.name: electric masonry saw (off)
electric_masonrysaw_off.description: A construction tool for cutting through concrete or other surfaces.  It uses electric motor with integrated battery and is compatible with a UPS.  Using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon or a terrible chainsaw.

electric_masonrysaw_on.name: electric masonry saw (on)
electric_masonrysaw_on.description: This electric masonry saw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

grinder_blade.name: grinder blade
grinder_blade.description: A 125 mm angle grinder blade.  You could make a power tool with it, or throw it.  Wielding it without sturdy gloves is a bad idea.

heavy_masonrysaw_off.name: heavy masonry saw (off)
heavy_masonrysaw_off.description: A heavy construction tool for cutting demolishing concrete.  It runs on gasoline.  Using this item will cause it to turn on, turning it into a formidable demolition tool, a terrible chainsaw, and an unwieldy melee weapon.

success_message.str: With a roar, the <npc_name> screams to life!

failure_message.str: You yank the cord, but nothing happens.

false_effect.u_message: You yank the cord, but nothing happens.

heavy_masonrysaw_on.name: heavy masonry saw (on)
heavy_masonrysaw_on.description: This masonry saw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

adhesive_bandages.name: adhesive bandage
adhesive_bandages.description: A small medical dressing made of a piece of sterile cloth and sticky tape, used for small injuries not serious enough to require a full-size bandage.

alcohol_wipes.name: alcohol wipe
alcohol_wipes.description: A wet wipe saturated with alcohol and stored in a sterile package.  Used for personal hygiene or disinfecting small wounds.

anesthetic_kit.name: anesthesia kit
anesthetic_kit.description: A kit for inducing anesthesia for surgery, containing specialized canisters with a variety of powerful hypnotic, analgesic, and stimulative drugs.  It's intended for use in specialized medical equipment, and can't be administered manually.

bandages.name: bandage
bandages.description: A sterile cloth bandage.  Used for stopping blood loss and protecting wounds from aggravation to help them heal faster.

bandages_makeshift.name: makeshift bandage
bandages_makeshift.description: A reasonably clean piece of cloth wrapped for use as a simple bandage.  Better than nothing.

bandages_makeshift_bleached.name: bleached makeshift bandage
bandages_makeshift_bleached.description: A piece of cloth treated with a bleach solution to sterilize it for use as a bandage.

bandages_makeshift_boiled.name: boiled makeshift bandage
bandages_makeshift_boiled.description: A piece of cloth boiled in water to sterilize it for use as a bandage.

cotton_ball.name: cotton balls
cotton_ball.description: Fluffy balls of clean, white cotton.  They can serve as makeshift bandages in an emergency.

disinrag.name: antiseptic soaked rag
disinrag.description: A rag soaked in antiseptic.  Useful for light wounds, probably won't help with deep bites.

disincotton_ball.name: antiseptic soaked cotton balls
disincotton_ball.description: Fluffy balls of clean white cotton.  Now that they've been soaked with antiseptic, they are somewhat useful to disinfect a wound.

inhaler.name: inhaler
inhaler.description: An albuterol inhaler.  Used in the treatment of bronchospasm, it is a lifeline for people with asthma.  A mild stimulant, it may cause anxiety or tremors.

medical_gauze.name: medical gauze
medical_gauze.description: A decent-sized piece of cotton, sterilized and sealed.  It's designed for medical purposes.

liq_bandage_spray.name: spray bottle of liquid bandage
liq_bandage_spray.description: Liquid bandage for minor cuts and scrapes, packaged in a tiny bottle with an atomizer spray for convenient application.

rx12_injector.name: RX12 jet injector
rx12_injector.description: A Rivtech RX12 jet injector, a small pistol-shaped device used to inject advanced fast-healing chemicals through the skin without using a needle.  A label on the side warns against using more than two doses per hour.

scalpel.name: scalpel
scalpel.description: A very sharp knife designed for surgical cutting.  Its small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.

smoxygen_tank.name: small oxygen delivery kit
smoxygen_tank.description: A small tank of compressed medical oxygen with a folding regulator and mask.  Commonly used in emergency situations, it provides immediate relief for asthma attacks or smoke inhalation, and can provide a brief burst of energy.

syringe.name: syringe
syringe.description: A medical syringe.  Used for administering intravenous drugs.

thermometer.name: thermometer
thermometer.description: A plastic thermometer that can read the air temperature.

oxygen_tank.name: oxygen delivery kit
oxygen_tank.description: A tank of compressed medical oxygen with a regulator and mask.  Commonly used in emergency situations, it provides immediate relief for asthma attacks or smoke inhalation, and can provide a brief burst of energy.

vacutainer.name: blood draw kit
vacutainer.description: A kit for drawing blood, including a test tube for holding the sample.  Use this tool to draw blood, either from yourself or from a corpse you are standing on.

wrapped_rad_badge.name: wrapped radiation badge
wrapped_rad_badge.description: A badge that detects radiation dosage, sealed in a radiation-blocking bag.  Use it to remove it from the bag.

use_action.msg: You remove the badge from its wrapper, exposing it to ambient radiation.

scissors_medical.name: medical scissors
scissors_medical.description: A pair of medical scissors, typically used by nurses or paramedics to cut bandages or fabric.

saline_bag_250.name: small saline infusion kit
saline_bag_250.description: A small, sealed plastic bag for liquids used in intravenous therapy, with rubber tube and cannula - all you need to perform an infusion.  Holds 250 mL of completely sterile saline, therefore it is safe to put it inside your veins, if you know how.

use_action.description: You can use it to mitigate the consequences of blood loss.  Require health care 3 and some disinfectant.

false_effect.u_message: You don't actually know how to use it properly.

saline_bag_500.name: medium saline infusion kit
saline_bag_500.description: A sealed plastic bag for liquids used in intravenous therapy, with rubber tube and cannula - all you need to perform an infusion.  Holds 500 mL of completely sterile saline, therefore it is safe to put it inside your veins, if you know how.

use_action.description: You can use it to mitigate the consequences of blood loss.  Require health care 4.

false_effect.u_message: You don't actually know how to use it properly.

saline_bag_1000.name: large saline infusion kit
saline_bag_1000.description: A large, sealed plastic bag for liquids used in intravenous therapy, with rubber tube and cannula - all you need to perform an infusion.  Holds a liter of completely sterile saline, therefore it is safe to put it inside your veins, if you know how.

use_action.description: You can use it to mitigate the consequences of blood loss.  Require health care 4.

false_effect.u_message: You don't actually know how to use it properly.

saline_bag_2000.name: huge saline infusion kit
saline_bag_2000.description: A huge, sealed plastic bag for liquids used in intravenous therapy, with rubber tube and cannula - all you need to perform an infusion.  Holds two liters of completely sterile saline, therefore it is safe to put it inside your veins, if you know how.

use_action.description: You can use it to mitigate the consequences of blood loss.  Require health care 4.

false_effect.u_message: You don't actually know how to use it properly.

dental_tools.name: dental tool set
dental_tools.description: A set of picks, hooks, and scrapers designed for cleaning teeth.

anvil.name: anvil
anvil.description: A heavy block of oddly-shaped steel complete with a pritchel hole and hardy hole.  Once installed, it can be used in most metalworking fabrication recipes.

anvil_bronze.name: bronze anvil
anvil_bronze.description: A block of oddly-shaped bronze complete with a pritchel hole and hardy hole.  Once installed, it can be used in most metalworking fabrication recipes.

anvil_heavy.name: heavy anvil
anvil_heavy.description: An absolutely enormous block of oddly-shaped steel with all the bells and whistles a blacksmith could ask for on an anvil.  Necessary for heavy-duty metalworking or dropping on roadrunners.

anvil_crude.name: small anvil
anvil_crude.description: A proper, albeit small, anvil.  Pretty handy.

anvil_scavenged.name: scavenger's anvil
anvil_scavenged.description: A portion of heavy steel machinery that has been smoothed and shaped to form a very adequate anvil.  If it were mounted onto a good solid log, it would be adequate for any task.

anvil_stump.name: makeshift stump anvil
anvil_stump.description: A heavy, thick log to which several flat steel bits have been bolted to serve as an anvil.  Not sufficient for detailed nor heavy work.

boltcutters.name: bolt cutters
boltcutters.description: A large pair of bolt cutters.  You could use them to cut padlocks or heavy gauge wire.

char_forge.name: charcoal forge
char_forge.description: A portable, charcoal-fired metalworking forge.  With the right tools, you could use this for metalworking.

char_kiln.name: portable charcoal kiln
char_kiln.description: A somewhat portable drum kiln to produce charcoal via pyrolysis: the incomplete burning of organic materials in the absence of oxygen.  Needs to be deployed before use.

chisel.name: metalworking chisel
chisel.description: A short, stout metalworking chisel.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

chisel_bronze.name: bronze chisel
chisel_bronze.description: A short, stout metalworking chisel made of bronze.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.  Bronze chisels spark less than their steel counterparts, but are less durable.

crucible.name: crucible
crucible.description: A small metalworking crucible.  Looks like a stout drink tumbler.  It's used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

crucible_clay.name: clay crucible
crucible_clay.description: A primitive metalworking crucible made of clay.  Looks like a stout drink tumbler.  You could use it for metalworking.

forge.name: electric forge
forge.description: An electric metalworking forge, powered by your electric grid.  With the right tools, you could use this for metalworking.

belt_grinder.name: belt grinder
belt_grinder.description: A power tool used for grinding and shaping metal or even wood.  It consists of a motorized abrasive belt that spins at high speeds, allowing you to quickly polish, flatten, or overall remove material from surfaces.

link_sheet.name: chainmail sheet
link_sheet.description: A sheet of riveted chainmail.  With some skill, several of these sheets could be connected to make effective armor.

lc_link_sheet.name: mild steel chainmail sheet
lc_link_sheet.description: A sheet of riveted chainmail.  With some skill, several of these sheets could be connected to make effective armor.

mc_link_sheet.name: medium steel chainmail sheet
mc_link_sheet.description: A sheet of riveted chainmail.  With some skill, several of these sheets could be connected to make effective armor.

hc_link_sheet.name: high steel chainmail sheet
hc_link_sheet.description: A sheet of riveted chainmail.  With some skill, several of these sheets could be connected to make effective armor.

ch_link_sheet.name: hardened steel chainmail sheet
ch_link_sheet.description: A sheet of riveted chainmail.  With some skill, several of these sheets could be connected to make effective armor.

qt_link_sheet.name: tempered steel chainmail sheet
qt_link_sheet.description: A sheet of riveted chainmail.  With some skill, several of these sheets could be connected to make effective armor.

swage.name: swage and die set
swage.description: A set of swages and dies for metalsmithing.  These loops and metal blocks are used in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

hotcut_bronze.name: hotcut
hotcut_bronze.description: A hardened chisel-like object for metalsmithing.  It's used to cut lengths of metal in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

hotcut.name: hotcut
hotcut.description: A hardened chisel-like object for metalsmithing.  It's used to cut lengths of metal in some metalworking fabrication recipes.

drift.name: punch & drift set
drift.description: A set of hardened spiky metal pins used to make holes in hot metal.  The punch is used to create the initial hole, and the drift is used to then enlarge and shape it. This set includes various shapes and sizes for different applications, from tapering to delicate socketing.

tongs.name: kitchen tongs
tongs.description: A pair of long, metal tongs.  They are commonly used for cooking.

metalworking_tongs_bronze.name: flatjaw bronze tongs
metalworking_tongs_bronze.description: A pair of flatjaw tongs.  They are commonly used for metalworking, fabrication, or forging recipes.

metalworking_tongs.name: flatjaw tongs
metalworking_tongs.description: A pair of flatjaw tongs.  They are commonly used for metalworking, fabrication, or forging recipes.

sandpaper.name: sandpaper
sandpaper.description: A sheet of rough paper.  It is commonly used in metalworking and carpentry.

leather_filing.name: sandleather
leather_filing.description: A patch of leather paired with a handful of sand.  Works as a substitute for sandpaper.

draw_plate.name: draw plate
draw_plate.description: A piece of metal with holes of varying size drilled into it.  Used as part of wire drawing.

casting_mold_small.name: small sandcasting mold
casting_mold_small.description: A small mold for casting molten metals into different shapes.

casting_mold_large.name: large sandcasting mold
casting_mold_large.description: A large mold for casting molten metals into different shapes.

casting_mold_long.name: long sandcasting mold
casting_mold_long.description: A large, long, mold for casting molten metals into different shapes.

casting_mold.name: sandcasting mold
casting_mold.description: A medium mold for casting molten metals into different shapes.

stone_polishing.name: polishing stone
stone_polishing.description: A large natural stone with a flat surface to grind against.

pedal_grindstone.name: pedal powered grindstone
pedal_grindstone.description: A round, pedal-powered grindstone, useful for grinding metal.

scraper_steel.name: steel scraper
scraper_steel.description: A hardened steel tool similar to a drawknife, but for metal.

gas_forge.name: gas forge
gas_forge.description: A gas-fueled metalworking forge.  With the right tools, you could use this for metalworking.

temper_block.name: tempering block set
temper_block.description: Two square blocks of steel used for tempering metal via heating the blocks and sandwiching the metal between them.

makeshift_steel_kiln.name: makeshift tempering kiln
makeshift_steel_kiln.description: A very large brick kiln with a sheet metal shell.  Used for tempering metal of all sizes.

airhorn.name: compressed air horn
airhorn.description: A small can of compressed air attached to a plastic horn.  Pressing the button on top causes it to emit a loud honking sound.

alarmclock.name: alarm clock
alarmclock.description: A wind-up alarm clock.  Though the noise it makes is unpleasant to wake up to, it's always good to get an early start to your day.  Can also be disassembled into some useful parts.

butane_can.name: can of butane
butane_can.description: A non-refillable can of butane with an adapter for refilling lighters.  It could be useful as a fuel, but also as a solvent or chemical reagent.

notched_plank.name: notched plank
notched_plank.description: A quarter of a wooden plank with notches cut into it, used with a fire drill to create embers.

notched_stick.name: notched stick
notched_stick.description: A wooden stick with notches cut into it, used with a fire drill to create embers.

clay_urn.name: clay urn
clay_urn.description: A clay container for storing cremated ashes.

cow_bell.name: cow bell
cow_bell.description: A cow bell.  You feel like you need more of it.

crystal_urn.name: crystal urn
crystal_urn.description: An exquisite, translucent container for cremated ashes, decorated with floral patterns.

e_tool.name: entrenching tool
e_tool.description: A stout, collapsible spade.  It's commonly used by military forces and favored by hikers for digging.

etched_skull.name: etched human skull
etched_skull.description: A human skull covered with strange etchings.

fur_rollmat.name: fur rollmat
fur_rollmat.description: A bedroll made of pelts which can be rolled up for transport.  It insulates you from the floor, making it easier to sleep.  Use it to unroll and place on the ground.

use_action.done_message: You unroll the fur mat and lay it on the ground.

hose_garden.name: garden hose
hose_garden.description: A flexible garden hose.  If you cut it into smaller pieces, it could be used for crafting or siphoning fuel from a vehicle.

grapnel.name: grappling hook
grapnel.description: A folding grappling hook attached to a stout, 30-foot long piece of lightweight cord.  Useful for keeping yourself safe from falls.  Can be used in place of a long rope for butchering, in a pinch.

grip_hook.name: grip hook
grip_hook.description: A simple steel meat hook with a circular steel handle.

hand_pump.name: hand pump
hand_pump.description: A hand-powered pump suitable for pumping air into inflatable objects.

leather_bellow.name: leather bellow
leather_bellow.description: A bellow is a device constructed to furnish a strong blast of air.

horn_bicycle.name: bicycle horn
horn_bicycle.description: A simple bulb horn found on many bicycles.  Activate it to honk.  Honk honk.

horn_big.name: truck horn
horn_big.description: A very loud horn, usually found on large trucks like semis.

horn_car.name: car horn
horn_car.description: A car horn meant to be attached to a car's electrical system.

large_space_heater.name: large space heater
large_space_heater.description: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees Celsius, and fills a larger volume of air than the smaller version.

large_space_heater_on.name: large space heater (on)
large_space_heater_on.description: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees Celsius, and fills a larger volume of air than the smaller version.

lifestraw.name: lifestraw
lifestraw.description: A small personal water filter.  The instructions say to set the lifestraw in suspect water, let sit for one minute then drink.  The two-part filtration system will purify the water you drink up to a certain amount.  Water taken from uncertain sources like a river may be dirty.

permanent_marker.name: permanent marker
permanent_marker.description: A King Size™ industrial-strength permanent marker, about halfway between a typical marker and a can of spray paint in size.  Activate it to write something down.  However, writing "Elbereth" probably won't help you.

pocketwatch.name: pocket watch
pocketwatch.description: An old-fashioned pocket watch.  Tells the time and looks good doing it.  Can also be disassembled into some useful parts.

porcelain_urn.name: porcelain urn
porcelain_urn.description: A container for holding the remains of a loved one.  Its prior owners must have taken good care of it, as you can see your face reflected clearly upon its surface.

rollmat.name: rollmat
rollmat.description: A sheet of foam which can be rolled tightly for storage.  It insulates you from the floor, making it easier to sleep.  Use it to unroll and place on the ground.

use_action.done_message: You unroll the mat and lay it on the ground.

safe_box.name: safe deposit box
safe_box.description: A secure combination-lock box.  Sadly, you don't know the combination.  Breaking into it would destroy anything of value.

sarcophagus_access_code.name: sarcophagus access code
sarcophagus_access_code.description: A printout displaying a string of numbers, the passcode to access the elevator in the hazardous waste sarcophagus.

small_space_heater.name: small space heater
small_space_heater.description: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees Celsius.

small_space_heater_on.name: small space heater (on)
small_space_heater_on.description: A portable electric heater that steadily emits warm air.  Raises temperature about 10 degrees Celsius.

spray_can.name: spray can
spray_can.description: An aerosol spray can filled with paint.  Activate it to make graffiti on the floor.

stepladder.name: wooden stepladder
stepladder.description: A ten-foot wooden stepladder.  Activate it to set it down.

survival_marker.name: survival marker
survival_marker.description: A sharpened piece of charcoal used as an improvised pencil.  Almost guaranteed to get your hands all covered in charcoal.  Activate it to write something down.

survivor_scope.name: retractable telescope
survivor_scope.description: A homemade collapsible telescope, perfect for a pirate.  Too large and inaccurate to use as a weapon scope, but carrying it in your inventory will double the distance that is mapped around you during your travels.

teargas_sprayer.name: tear gas sprayer
teargas_sprayer.description: A pocket sized plastic canister filled with a pressurized tear gas spray, a step above oleoresin capsicum pepper spray in terms of potency.  Most commonly used by law enforcement and bear-wary hikers, but it became more common in recent months due to anxiety over the riots.  Probably won't do much against a zombie, but should give anything still breathing a rather nasty surprise and give you time to get away.  It contains enough spray for about twenty seconds of continuous application.

c4_payload.name: C-4 payload
c4_payload.description: This is a dummy item used by c4 hacks.  You should never see it outside of debug.

tear_gas_payload.name: tear gas payload
tear_gas_payload.description: This is a dummy item used by tear gas hacks.  You should never see it outside of debug.

use_action.msg: You pull the pin on the %s.

tear_gas_payload_act.name: active tear gas payload
tear_gas_payload_act.description: This is a dummy item used by tear gas hacks that just so happens to be counting down.  You should never see it outside of debug.

teleumbrella.name: telescoping umbrella (collapsed)
teleumbrella.description: A telescoping umbrella which has been collapsed down for easy storage.  May be used to keep dry when extended and wielded.

teleumbrella-extended.name: telescoping umbrella (extended)
teleumbrella-extended.description: A telescoping umbrella currently in its extended form, useful for keeping dry when wielded.  May be collapsed down for easy storage.

toilet_travel.name: travel toilet
toilet_travel.description: A portable plastic toilet, designed to use plastic bags for waste instead of plumbing.

use_action.msg: You collapse the toilet for transport.

toilet_travel_folded.name: folded travel toilet
toilet_travel_folded.description: A portable plastic toilet.  It has been collapsed for easy transport.

testflames.name: Flaming Chunk of Steel +2
testflames.description: HOLY SHIT THIS THING IS ON FIRE!

umbrella.name: umbrella
umbrella.description: An umbrella with a pointy end, useful for keeping dry when wielded.

vortex_stone.name: vortex stone
vortex_stone.description: A stone with spirals all over it and holes around its perimeter.  Though it is fairly large, it weighs next to nothing.  Air seems to gather around it.

sandbox_kit.name: sandbox kit
sandbox_kit.description: A plastic bucket holding a small spade and rake, perfect for building sand castles!

whistle_multitool.name: whistle multitool
whistle_multitool.description: A cheap gadget combining a whistle, thermometer, magnifying glass, and compass.

aluminum_stepladder.name: aluminum stepladder
aluminum_stepladder.description: A ten-foot aluminum stepladder.  Activate it to set it down.

glass_cutter.name: handheld glass cutter
glass_cutter.description: A handheld tool used for controlled breaking of glass.  A necessity for any glass cutting projects.

air_launcher.name: novelty pneumatic launcher
air_launcher.description: A toy that uses compressed air to launch small objects for the amusement of children.  It is very tiring to reload, and completely ineffective as a weapon.  Pump sold separately.

dressage_whip.name: dressage whip
dressage_whip.description: A long, thin and flexible rod that tapers to a point, originally used to stimulate a horse and give them orders.

riding_crop.name: riding crop
riding_crop.description: A rod ending in a leather popper originally used to stimulate a horse and give them orders.

nm_teeth.name: monster teeth
nm_teeth.description: Impossibly-sharp teeth extracted from a giant corpse.  You could use them as a weapon, but you might want to wear gloves.

use_action.done_message: You carefully place the teeth on the ground, ready to be walked on by something passing by.

handcuffs_leather.name: pair of leather cuffs
handcuffs_leather.description: A pair of sturdy leather cuffs connected by a chain.  Perfect to hold prisoners in your dungeon.

gag_ball.name: ball gag
gag_ball.description: A ball gag, make sure you're not keeping a katana nearby before using it.

paddle_plastic.name: small plastic paddle
paddle_plastic.description: Using it against unfriendly cheeks would be ill advised.

tape_measure.name: tape measure
tape_measure.description: A 25' tape measure, with a bright yellow, plastic exterior.

banjo.name: banjo
banjo.description: A standard factory-made banjo.  Looks to be in working condition.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your banjo.
You play a bluegrass tune on your banjo.
You play a quick, Southern ditty on your banjo.

bone_flute.name: bone flute
bone_flute.description: A polished bone flute with five finger holes.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your flute.
You play a beautiful piece on your flute.
You play a piece on your bone flute that resembles the howling wind through Aurignacian caves.
Your bone flute wails for the fallen during the hunt.

clarinet.name: clarinet
clarinet.description: An ornate clarinet made from wood.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your clarinet.
You play a moving, orchestral piece on your clarinet.
You play an uplifting marching tune on your clarinet.

kantele.name: kantele
kantele.description: A traditional Finnish string instrument.  According to myth the first one was fashioned from a great pike's bone.  This ordinary wooden one doesn't seem quite as special.

player_descriptions: You play a riveting tune on your kantele.
You play an enchanting composition on your kantele.
You play a somber piece on your kantele.
You play a little tune on your flute.
You play a beautiful piece on your flute.
You play a piece on your flute that sounds harmonious with nature.

trumpet.name: trumpet
trumpet.description: A brass trumpet with only a few dents here and there.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your trumpet.
You play a slow, mourning piece on your trumpet.
You play a little ballad on your trumpet.

ukulele.name: ukulele
ukulele.description: A small factory-made ukulele.  Makes you wish you were on a tropical island, or somewhere over the rainbow.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your ukulele.
You play a cute little ditty on your ukulele.
You play a small jam on your ukulele.

violin.name: violin
violin.description: A cheap, factory-made violin with a built-in holder for a bow.  Still produces a nice sound.

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on your violin.
You play a beautiful orchestral piece on your violin.
You play a quick, southern ditty on your fiddle.

violin_golden.name: golden fiddle
violin_golden.description: A shiny golden fiddle, with a strange aura around it.  You feel like it once belonged to the best there's ever been.

player_descriptions: You play a quick, folksy tune on your fiddle.
As you pull the bow across its strings, it makes an evil hiss.
You play a tune so fierce, it feels like hell's broke loose.

krar_golden.name: golden krar
krar_golden.description: A shiny golden krar, similar to a harp.

player_descriptions: You play a relaxed, folksy tune on your krar.

krar.name: krar
krar.description: A wooden krar, similar to a harp.

player_descriptions: You play a relaxed, folksy tune on your krar.

drum_percussion.name: drum, percussion
drum_percussion.description: A standard factory-made percussion drum.  Looks to be in working condition.

player_descriptions: You play a beat on your drum.  Pa rum pa pum pum.
You play a fast beat on your drum.  Rat tat tat tat.
You play a march on your drums.  Brrrum brrum brrrrum.

drum_percussion_primitive.name: primitive drum, percussion
drum_percussion_primitive.description: A handmade primitive percussion drum.  Looks to be in working condition.

player_descriptions: You play a beat on your drum.  Pa rum pa pum pum.
You play a fast beat on your drum.  Rat tat tat tat.
You play a march on your drums.  Brrrum brrum brrrrum.

harmonica_holder.name: harmonica with a holder

player_descriptions: You produce a happy tune on the harmonica.
You whistle on the harmonica.
npc_descriptions: produce a happy tune on the harmonica.

harmonica_holder.description: A harmonica with a holder, so that you can play it without a free hand.

acoustic_guitar.name: acoustic guitar

player_descriptions: You strum a few chords on the guitar.
You pluck a few notes on the guitar.
You play a slow blues-y tune on the guitar.
npc_descriptions: strum a few chords on the guitar.
pluck a few notes on the guitar.
play a slow blues-y tune on the guitar.

acoustic_guitar.description: A simple wooden acoustic guitar with a strap so you can wear it around, even when not playing.

guitar_electric.name: electric guitar

player_descriptions: You plink out a shredding solo on your guitar.
You play an epic classic rock riff on your guitar.
You play a furious, muted riff on your guitar.
You play a crunchy stoner tune on your guitar.
You play an old Britpop song on your guitar.
You play a tasteful classical piece on your guitar.
You play a jangly folk ditty on your guitar.
You play a melancholy melody on your guitar.

guitar_electric.description: A standard factory-made electric guitar.  It's probably better at smashing heads than melting faces, these days.  Has a strap.

bagpipes.name: bagpipes

player_descriptions: Your pipes drone loudly as you strikes a battle hymn from the chanter.
Your pipes drone a slow and piercing dirge.
You strike a lively quick step march on your pipes.
npc_descriptions: pipes drone loudly as it strikes a battle hymn from the chanter.
pipes drone a slow and piercing dirge.
strike a lively quick step march on their pipes.

bagpipes.description: A traditional musical instrument, using enclosed reeds fed from a reservoir of air contained within a leather bag.  It has a strap so you can wear it around, even when not playing.

tuba.name: tuba

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on the tuba.
You play a ditty on the tuba.
You play a marching tune on the tuba.
npc_descriptions: play a little tune on the tuba.
play a ditty on the tuba.
play a marching tune on the tuba.

tuba.description: A big ol' tuba.  Much easier to play when you're wearing it.  Thankfully, this one has a harness attached.

saxophone.name: saxophone

player_descriptions: You play a little tune on the saxophone.
You play a soulful jazz piece on the sax.
You play a quick, energetic ditty on the sax.
npc_descriptions: play a little tune on the saxophone.
play a soulful jazz piece on the sax.
play a quick, energetic ditty on the sax.

saxophone.description: A brass alto saxophone with a neck strap, so you can wear it while playing.

chicken_cage.name: chicken cage
chicken_cage.description: A wire container made for transporting chickens, but you can use it to hold any tiny animal.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

dog_whistle.name: dog whistle
dog_whistle.description: A small whistle.  When blown into, it produces a high tone that causes nearby friendly dogs to either follow you closely and stop attacking, or start attacking enemies if they are currently docile.

shears.name: shears
shears.description: A set of shears designed to obtain wool from sheep.

forged_shears.name: forged shears
forged_shears.description: A set of heavy-duty shears designed to obtain wool from sheep.  Made of two steel blades connected by spring leaf.

bronze_shears.name: bronze shears
bronze_shears.description: A set of forged single-piece bronze shears for cutting fabrics.  Made of two painstakingly sharpened blades connected by a carefully tempered twisted bridge.

elec_shears.name: electric shears
elec_shears.description: Electric corded shears, used to quickly shear animals.

horse_tack.name: horse tack
horse_tack.description: A saddle, bridle, and associated tack that can be placed on a tamed animal that is capable of being ridden.

livestock_scale.name: livestock scale
livestock_scale.description: A giant electronic scale with a rubber mat meant for weighing a single horse, cow, or other large animal.  You could also weigh yourself with it.

pet_carrier.name: pet carrier
pet_carrier.description: A plastic container meant to hold pets for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

pet_carrier_wooden.name: wooden pet carrier
pet_carrier_wooden.description: A wooden container meant to hold pets for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

terrarium.name: glass terrarium
terrarium.description: A glass container meant to hold plants and/or insects.  They come in a variety of sizes.

firefly_terrarium.name: survivor giant firefly lamp
firefly_terrarium.description: Some enterprising survivor has decided to turn this terrarium into a light source, using what appear to be a giant firefly and triffid vegetation.

dog_whistle_wood.name: wooden dog whistle
dog_whistle_wood.description: A whistle carved out of hardwood.  When blown into, it produces a high tone that causes nearby friendly dogs to either follow you closely and stop attacking, or start attacking enemies if they are currently docile.

butchery_tree_pseudo.name: butchery tree pseudo item
butchery_tree_pseudo.description: Dummy item.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

fake_butcher_rack.name: fake butcher rack (pseudo item)
fake_butcher_rack.description: Dummy item.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

medium_surface_pseudo.name: medium surface pseudo item
medium_surface_pseudo.description: Dummy item.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

large_surface_pseudo.name: large surface pseudo item
large_surface_pseudo.description: Dummy item.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

fake_stove.name: basecamp stove
fake_stove.description: Dummy item.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

brick_oven_pseudo.name: brick oven
brick_oven_pseudo.description: Dummy item.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

butter_churn.name: pseudo butter churn
butter_churn.description: Dummy item.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

fake_solar_cooker.name: solar cooker
fake_solar_cooker.description: Dummy item.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

radiocontrol.name: RC control
radiocontrol.description: A remote control for an RC car, with a joystick to steer the car and colorful buttons that don't seem to do anything.  Perhaps they were for the deluxe model?

radio_car.name: RC car
radio_car.description: A remote-controlled car.  Fun for all ages.

radio_car_on.name: RC car (on)
radio_car_on.description: A remote-controlled toy car.  It is turned on and draining its batteries just like a real electric car!  Use a remote control to drive it around.

radio_mod.name: radio activation mod
radio_mod.description: A small electronic device that can be attached to certain items to activate them with a radio signal from an RC car controller.

radio.name: radio (off)
radio.description: A portable radio.  Using this radio turns it on.  It will pick up any nearby signals being broadcasted and play them audibly.

radio_on.name: radio (on)
radio_on.description: A portable radio that is turned on and continually draining its batteries.  It is playing the broadcast being sent from any nearby radio towers.

two_way_radio.name: two-way radio
two_way_radio.description: A radio with a transmitting unit.  You could use it to contact someone who also has one.

pat_earpiece.name: transponder earpiece (off)
pat_earpiece.description: An earpiece with an inline transponder and two small cables custom-fit for AR headsets.  If you have a compatible headset and it is switched on, Pat can keep track of you and communicate via radio.  Active it to switch it on, or to call Pat.

use_action.menu_text: Connect to Pat's system and start transmitting data

pat_earpiece_on.name: transponder earpiece (on)
pat_earpiece_on.description: An earpiece with an inline transponder and two small cables custom-fit for AR headsets.  If you have a compatible headset and it is switched on, Pat can keep track of you and communicate via radio.  It is currently active.  Active it to switch it off, or to call Pat.

use_action.menu_text: Disconnect from Pat's system and stop transmitting data

remotevehcontrol.name: remote vehicle controller
remotevehcontrol.description: A remote controller for a real car.  Can turn onboard devices on and off.  Some cars can be driven remotely.

balthazar_radio.name: modified radio
balthazar_radio.description: A modified portable radio.  A mess of metal and wires has been attached to the back and the frequency dial has been removed.

effect.u_message:
You turn the radio on.

Just static.

then.u_message:
You turn on the radio.  You hear a broadcast:
"If anyone can hear, I'm stuck in a bunker and need help.  I'm also transmitting my coordinates.  This message will repeat."
You note down the coordinates.

else.u_message:
You turn on the radio.  You hear a broadcast:
"If anyone who is listening to this broadcast is willing to do work for weapons, head to the transmitted coordinates.  This message will repeat."
You write down the coordinates.

birchbark_funnel.name: birchbark funnel
birchbark_funnel.description: A small birchbark funnel.  Place it above an outdoor container to collect rainwater.

use_action.done_message: You place the funnel, waiting to collect rain.

funnel.name: funnel
funnel.description: A plastic funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the funnel, waiting to collect rain.

leather_funnel.name: leather funnel
leather_funnel.description: A small leather funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the funnel, waiting to collect rain.

makeshift_funnel.name: makeshift funnel
makeshift_funnel.description: A small makeshift funnel used to collect rainwater.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the funnel, waiting to collect rain.

metal_funnel.name: metal funnel
metal_funnel.description: A large metal funnel used to collect rainwater.  Less portable than plastic funnels, but collects more water.  Use it outside and place a container beneath it to collect water when it rains.

use_action.done_message: You place the funnel, waiting to collect rain.

tarp_raincatcher.name: tarp raincatcher
tarp_raincatcher.description: A collection of sticks and string with a tarpaulin to set up as an improvised raincatcher.

use_action.done_message: You set up the raincatcher, waiting to collect water.

barometer.name: barometer
barometer.description: A plastic barometer that can read atmospheric pressure.

canister_goo.name: goo canister
canister_goo.description: A metal canister with a label reading: "Warning: contains highly toxic and corrosive materials.  Contents may be sentient.  Open at your own risk." You think you can feel something moving inside it.

chemistry_set.name: chemistry set
chemistry_set.description: A chemistry set stored in a box.  It includes glass containers, hoses, metal wire, a hotplate, and a pair of safety glasses.  It might be used to craft some chemistry projects if you're so inclined.

chemistry_set_basic.name: basic chemistry set
chemistry_set_basic.description: A basic chemistry set including glass containers, hoses, and a pair of safety glasses.  It might be used to craft some chemistry projects if you're so inclined, but you'll need a source of heat.

electrolysis_kit.name: electrolysis kit
electrolysis_kit.description: A set of wiring and electrodes for applying a direct current, usually to a liquid.  Useful for crafting.  Load with a storage battery or 12V vehicle battery to use.

ketene_lamp.name: ketene lamp
ketene_lamp.description: A section of glass pipe with a bulb in the middle, which contains an electrical heating element.  It is used for producing ketene via pyrolysis of acetone or 1,3-butadiene from cyclohexane, for use in other chemical reactions.  Due to the instability of ketene, it can't be stored and must be used immediately.

engineering_makerspace_kit.name: makerspace kit for STEM
engineering_makerspace_kit.description: A kit with hundreds of pieces and dozens of blueprints for small engineering projects designed for beginner learners.  Explore mechanics and hydraulics!

engineering_robotics_kit.name: robotics kit for young learners
engineering_robotics_kit.description: A complete robotics engineering system, for learning the basics of building and programming robots.  Using sensors, motors, a core controller, and hundreds of snap-together building pieces, you can follow the instructions to assemble 12 different robots.  The versatile parts also allow you to make robots according to your own designs.

engineering_engine_kit.name: Stirling engine kit
engineering_engine_kit.description: A Stirling engine kit that demonstrates the principles behind the generation of electricity through the use of hot air.

vac_oven_small.name: small vacuum oven
vac_oven_small.description: A small 0.9 cubic foot vacuum oven used to purge residual solvents out of liquids and solids.  Looks kind of like a microwave.

closed_loop_extractor_small.name: small closed loop extractor
closed_loop_extractor_small.description: A small closed loop extractor used for extracting essential oils from organic material, producing a high quality-extract.  It consists of a long metal tube clamped onto a steel "honey pot".  Organic material is packed in the tube, flushed with solvent, and essential oils gathered from the pot.  Must be powered up to operate.

closed_loop_extractor_large.name: large closed loop extractor
closed_loop_extractor_large.description: A large machine used for extracting essential oils from large batches of organic material, producing a low-quality crude oil.  It consists of three long metal tubes funneled into a large drum that's set horizontally.  A series of hoses and tubes come out of the machine going to different valves.  It needs to be powered up to operate.

oil_extractor_crude.name: makeshift essential oil extractor
oil_extractor_crude.description: A makeshift extraction system.  It's pretty much just a 55 gallon drum, a pipe to stir the solution, and a faucet at the bottom to drain the extractor.  Not the most ideal piece of equipment, but it will work.

catalytic_cracking_reactor.name: disassembled catalytic cracking reactor
catalytic_cracking_reactor.description: A makeshift extraction system, or as makeshift as you can consider something that was purpose-built in a laboratory by a group of experts.  Meticulously disassembled.  You can reassemble and plug it into your own power grid to use it.

filter_paper_qualitative.name: qualitative filter paper
filter_paper_qualitative.description: A piece of filter paper for separating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 2 microns, separating more solids out than quantitative filter paper, but the process takes longer.  It's intended to be disposable, but you could probably use it for some time before it's unusable.

filter_paper_quantitative.name: quantitative filter paper
filter_paper_quantitative.description: A piece of filter paper for separating solids from liquids.  This filter paper has a rating of 20 microns, separating less solids out than qualitative filter paper, but the process is much faster.  It's intended to be disposable, but you could probably use it for some time before it's unusable.

gasket_plastic_set.name: plastic gasket set
gasket_plastic_set.description: A set of three plastic gaskets.  They're intended to be single-use, but you could probably use it for some time before they're too worn out to use.

vac_pump.name: vacuum pump
vac_pump.description: A small belt-driven mechanical pump capable of achieving a vacuum of -29.99 hg (50 microns).

recovery_pump.name: recovery pump
recovery_pump.description: A medium-sized vacuum pump designed to recover solvent (hydrocarbons) from extracted essential oils.

electrolyzer_makeshift.name: makeshift water electrolyzer
electrolyzer_makeshift.description: A makeshift appliance which decomposes water into oxygen and hydrogen via electrolysis of sodium hydroxide solution.  Much less energy-efficient than actual industrial equipment.

ammonia_machine_reactor.name: makeshift ammonia machine reactor
ammonia_machine_reactor.description: A huge appliance built from salvaged industrial equipment, which produces ammonia via the Haber-Bosch process from hydrogen and nitrogen.  As it uses primitive catalysts for the reaction, energy efficiency is very low.  This one is powered by electricity.

ammonia_machine_pipework.name: makeshift ammonia machine pipework
ammonia_machine_pipework.description: A rather complicated system of thick-walled pipes, powerful compressors, and wiring, meant to interface with a reactor producing ammonia from nitrogen and hydrogen via Haber-Bosch process.  It also acts as a power source for all the low-powered electrical components of the system.

nitrogen_generator.name: makeshift nitrogen generator
nitrogen_generator.description: A large makeshift appliance which captures nitrogen from the air for use in chemistry projects.  It includes a standard air filter for filtering out dust and other large particles, a deliquescent dryer to remove water vapor from air, and a nitrogen membrane filter to separate nitrogen from dry air.

butane_tank.name: butane tank
butane_tank.description: A tank of compressed butane.  Aside from its practicality as fuel, it can also be used to extract essential oils from organic material.
