hydrogen_tank.name: hydrogen tank
hydrogen_tank.description: A tank of compressed hydrogen gas.  If you need to make water from scratch, or lift a Zeppelin, it could come in handy.

pressure_tank.name: pressurized tank
pressure_tank.description: A tank designed to hold high pressure gases.

hygrometer.name: hygrometer
hygrometer.description: A plastic hygrometer that can read the relative humidity in the air.

mobile_weather_station.name: mobile weather station
mobile_weather_station.description: A large yellow case filled with equipment to measure atmospheric conditions.  It is outfitted with a carrying handle, a telescoping stand, and a rechargeable battery pack.  Its small display can show the current weather.  It can also make long-term recordings, but these data are useless without specialized software to interpret them.

mws_weather_sensor_array.name: ambient weather sensor array
mws_weather_sensor_array.description: Represents the hardware and software for displaying the weather.  You should not see this item in game.

mws_advanced_weather_sensor_array.name: ambient weather sensor array
mws_advanced_weather_sensor_array.description: Represents the hardware and software for displaying the weather in a HEW system.  You should not see this item in game.

mws_HE_sensor_array.name: ambient HE sensor array
mws_HE_sensor_array.description: Represents the hardware and software to scan for nethery stuff.  You should not see this item in game.

use_action.description: Scan with the advanced sensor array.

xedra_mobile_weather_station.name: mobile hazardous environment weather station
xedra_mobile_weather_station.description: A sleek black case housing a mix of mundane and otherworldly devices that can be deployed from the top of the box.  It is also equipped with a built-in analysis computer, a small thermal printer, and a rechargeable battery.  The case itself is outfitted with back straps and a telescoping stand.  "X.E.D.R.A." and "HE weather station" are engraved on the case.

robofac_mobile_weather_station.name: mobile HEW-NRE station
robofac_mobile_weather_station.description: A brown and white case housing equipment to measure atmospheric conditions in extremely hazardous environments.  It is equipped with several deployable sensors, a Hub 01 NRE recorder, a built-in analysis computer, a thermal printer, and a rechargeable battery.  The case itself is outfitted with back straps and a telescoping stand.  The Hub 01 logo is displayed proudly on the case lid.

nitrogen_tank.name: nitrogen tank
nitrogen_tank.description: A tank of compressed nitrogen gas.  Nitrogen is useful for its lack of reactivity.  Don't try to breathe it.

oxygen_cylinder.name: oxygen tank
oxygen_cylinder.description: A large steel cylinder used for storing pressurized gas.  It is marked with a faded, but legible O2 symbol.

platinum_grille.name: platinum grille
platinum_grille.description: A metal grille with a layer of platinum plating, suitable for use as a catalyst for some chemical reactions.

portal.name: portal generator
portal.description: A rare, bizarre, and arcane device of an otherworldly nature.  It's giving you a headache just looking at it.  It is covered in alien markings.

telepad.name: teleport pad
telepad.description: A kit for a teleporter trap, consisting of a teleporter and a solar cell that is triggered when stepped upon.

use_action.done_message: You place the telepad.

teleporter.name: teleporter
teleporter.description: An experimental device that will teleport you a short distance when activated.

analytical_set_basic.name: basic laboratory analysis kit
analytical_set_basic.description: A hefty kit containing some basic things you should probably not try to do precise chemistry without: a small balance scale, a spectrophotometer, cuvettes, a melting point apparatus, a pH meter, and a set of paper for thin layer chromatography.  This makes it a lot easier to feel confident that the chemical you've made is what you think it is.

balance_small.name: small weight scale
balance_small.description: A simple scale that uses a set of steel weights on sliding bars to measure a sample's mass quite accurately.

spectrophotometer.name: spectrophotometer
spectrophotometer.description: A ubiquitous analytical chemistry tool that measures the light absorption of a liquid sample in a special tube called a cuvette.

cuvettes.name: set of spectrometry cuvettes
cuvettes.description: A small box filled with precisely-calibrated square plastic tubes for laboratory spectrometer use.

ph_meter.name: pH meter
ph_meter.description: A pair of glass probes attached to a voltmeter.  By putting one probe into a calibration solution (conveniently included) and the other in a substance, you can calculate the substance's acidity.

voltmeter.name: voltmeter
voltmeter.description: A device with two probes that let you measure the electrical potential between two points.

multimeter.name: multimeter
multimeter.description: A gadget that is a little bigger than a handheld calculator, with a digital display and two pointed probes connected by wires.  It can measure not just voltage, but current in amps, and resistance in ohms, as well as test for electrical continuity.

melting_point.name: melting point apparatus
melting_point.description: A hot plate with a metal housing attached.  The metal housing has a magnification viewport and a slot into which a capillary tube containing a crystallized sample is inserted.  The device lets you precisely measure the melting point of a crystal, a property very useful in identifying what it is and how pure it is.

vortex.name: vortex device
vortex.description: A small, hefty, boring-looking machine.  Its weighted trapezoidal frame has a single on-off switch and a speed dial, and on top of it sits a rubber receptacle.  Pressing a test tube into the receptacle would, with power, rapidly shake and mix the contents of the test tube.  It's surprisingly fun to use.

light_detector.name: light detector
light_detector.description: A photodiode on a chip, designed to convert incoming light to electrical energy for quantification.

glass_prism.name: glass prism
glass_prism.description: A high-quality crystal glass prism for separating and redirecting light.

glass_tube_small.name: small glass tube
glass_tube_small.description: A small glass tube.  Small, tube-shaped, and made of glass.

microscope.name: microscope
microscope.description: A classic tool for the ages!  This hefty, durable piece of lab equipment makes small things look bigger.  When powered, it allows the user to observe various samples on a microscopic scale.

microscope_dissecting.name: dissecting microscope
microscope_dissecting.description: This microscope has less magnification than a standard one.  It's also stereoscopic and produces a neat 3-D image of the surface.  It was typically used for performing dissections and other fine-detail work on small creatures.  It still works pretty well with an added light source, but what would you do with it?

funnel_separation.name: separation funnel
funnel_separation.description: This thing doesn't look much like a funnel.  It's a teardrop-shaped piece of glass with a stopper at the wide end and a valve at the other.  It can be used to wash one liquid with another, like water and an oil, and then draw off whichever of the two liquids contains a higher amount of whatever compound you're trying to isolate.  With a high level of skill, it can also be used to make juvenile farting noises.

burette.name: burette
burette.description: A tall glass column with a stopcock at the end.  If you're serious about chemistry, you probably have a tattoo of one of these somewhere.

rotovap.name: rotary evaporator
rotovap.description: Just looking at this thing makes you feel like a proper mad scientist.  It's a series of glass tubes and round flasks, connected to a central motor and a heating element.  The heating element warms one flask, kept rotating by the motor, evaporating the contents.  The vapor is then condensed in the tubes and collected in another flask, in case you wanted to save it for later.

still_lab.name: fractional distillation apparatus
still_lab.description: One of the classic pieces of mad science glassware, this is a small-volume still that passes vapor through a fractional distillation column and then condenses the distillate in a cooled collection column.  A grad student or a robot (is there really any difference?) collects the distillate in fractions so that specific contents can be analyzed.  Going a few milliliters at a time, it would not be very effective to try to distill whiskey in this thing.

gelbox.name: electrophoresis tray
gelbox.description: A set of plastic trays, electrodes, and a power supply designed to create an electric voltage gradient through a liquid solution containing a solid gel.  Stuff like proteins and DNA would then get separated on the gel according to electrical charge and size.  Pretty useless now for anything but salvage.

microcentrifuge.name: microcentrifuge
microcentrifuge.description: A smaller, benchtop version of the larger furniture-sized centrifuge.  Don't be fooled by its portable scale; it's still a very powerful piece of equipment that can spin stuff really quickly.  It's not a toy!

centrifuge.name: centrifuge
centrifuge.description: A centrifuge, a liquid separating device with an automated analyzer unit.

stopcock.name: plastic stopcock
stopcock.description: Stop giggling.  This is a tiny plastic valve, get your mind out of the gutter.

rack_test_tube.name: test tube rack
rack_test_tube.description: A plastic box with holes in it.  Not that exciting, unless you're desperate for a place to store a test tube.  Then it's great.

rack_test_tube_micro.name: microcentrifuge tube tray
rack_test_tube_micro.description: A plastic tray riddled with small holes, for storing microcentrifuge tubes.

stand_ring.name: ring stand
stand_ring.description: A heavy metal plate and a sturdy rod, for clamping lab stuff to.

stand_ring_clamps.name: set of ring stand clamps
stand_ring_clamps.description: A small box with a jumbled assortment of clamps for mounting on ring stands.  There seems to be some sort of rule that all of them are missing at least one wing nut for tightening; twist ties, duct tape, and other random stuff has been used to compensate.

sextant.name: sextant
sextant.description: A tool for measuring angles of distant objects.  It can be used for measuring the altitude of the sun.

effect.u_message: You have a slight feeling of being watched.
You have an intense feeling of being watched.
You feel amazing!
You feel incredibly focused!
You feel your aches and pains fade away!
You instantly feel more awake!

weather_glass.name: weather glass
weather_glass.description: Also called storm glass or 'Goethe barometer', The weather glass barometer consists of a glass container with a sealed body, half filled with water.  A narrow spout connects to the body below the water level and rises above the water level.  The difference between the sealed water level in the body and the narrow open spout determines the atmospheric pressure.  Activate to get current atmospheric pressure.

hygroscope.name: hygroscope
hygroscope.description: A small rectangular box.  Inside is a device that measures humidity by utilizing the hygroscopy of hair.  The hair's length changes with humidity as indicated on a dial.

glass_thermometer.name: glass thermometer
glass_thermometer.description: A device used to measure temperature.  This one is made entirely of glass.  Mercury is used as its temperature sensor.  You could use this to get accurate information on current air temperature.

microscope_slide.name: microscope slide
microscope_slide.description: A tiny, thin rectangle of glass, used to observe samples through microscopes.

microscope_slide_water_murky.name: microscope slide of murky water
microscope_slide_water_murky.description: A microscope slide with a sample of murky water.

microscope_slide_soil.name: microscope slide of soil
microscope_slide_soil.description: A microscope slide with a sample of soil.

damaged_shelter_kit.name: damaged shelter kit
damaged_shelter_kit.description: A disassembled small shelter made of sticks and skins.  It's been damaged and needs to be repaired before you can set it up.

large_damaged_shelter_kit.name: large damaged shelter
large_damaged_shelter_kit.description: A huge shelter made of sticks and skins, very bulky but with plenty of space.  This is broken and cannot be deployed.

large_tent_kit.name: large tent
large_tent_kit.description: A family sized tent in a storage bag.  It provides a large amount of space, but is very bulky.

shelter_kit.name: shelter kit
shelter_kit.description: A disassembled small shelter made of sticks and skins.  Activate it to set it up.

large_shelter_kit.name: large shelter kit
large_shelter_kit.description: A large disassembled shelter made of sticks and skins.  Activate it to set it up.

tent_kit.name: tent
tent_kit.description: A small personal tent in a storage bag.  It's just big enough to fit one person comfortably.

tent_pole.name: aluminum tent pole
tent_pole.description: A light, collapsible tent pole made from aluminum, perfect for pitching a tent.

advanced_ecig.name: advanced electronic cigarette
advanced_ecig.description: An advanced, rechargeable electronic cigarette.  A less harmful way to get your nicotine fix than regular cigarettes, but still addictive.  It needs batteries and nicotine liquid to function.

crackpipe.name: crack pipe
crackpipe.description: A fine glass tube with a bulb with a bowl on one end.  It's used to partake of certain illicit substances.

pipe_glass.name: glass pipe
pipe_glass.description: A hand-blown glass pipe.  It's commonly used to smoke recreational substances.

pipe_water.name: water pipe
pipe_water.description: A mass-manufactured water pipe, otherwise known as a 'bong'.  Head shops often insist these are used solely for tobacco, despite their iconic status as cannabis paraphernalia.

pipe_tobacco.name: tobacco pipe
pipe_tobacco.description: A hand-carved wooden smoking pipe.  It's designed to facilitate the consumption of fire-cured tobacco leaves.

stapler.name: stapler
stapler.description: A desk tool for fastening sheets of paper together.

office_holepunch.name: hole puncher
office_holepunch.description: A metal tool that can punch a single hole in a piece of paper.  I mean, you could do more if you wanted, but you'd have to do them one at a time.  Or, if you really wanted more holes with one punch, I suppose you could fold the paper….  This is a one-cylinder hole puncher.

office_letter_opener.name: letter opener
office_letter_opener.description: A sterling silver letter opener resembling a small dagger, with a sharp point and no cutting edge.  It's used to open mail envelopes neatly and quickly.

scissors.name: office scissors
scissors.description: A long pair of heavy-duty scissors.  You can use them to cut things such as fabric or plastic apart.

scissors_child.name: kiddie scissors
scissors_child.description: A pair of short scissors designed with kids in mind.  You can use them to cut things such as fabric or plastic apart, although they are probably subpar compared to other alternatives.

scissors_wavy.name: wavy scissors
scissors_wavy.description: A pair of wavy artistic scissors.  You can theoretically use them to cut things but you should probably not get your hopes too high.

pen.name: pen
pen.description: A fine metal pen, of much better quality than a disposable model.

pencil.name: pencil
pencil.description: A sharpened HB Number 2 graphite pencil, equipped with an eraser.

black_pen.name: black pen
black_pen.description: A disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Has the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This one is black.

blue_pen.name: blue pen
blue_pen.description: A disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Has the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This one is blue.

red_pen.name: red pen
red_pen.description: A disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Has the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This one is red.

green_pen.name: green pen
green_pen.description: A disposable ballpoint pen, offers a smooth writing experience on paper.  Has the same logo as those disposable lighters.  This one is green.

leather_journal.name: leather journal
leather_journal.description: A leather-back journal for preserving notes and maps, has a strap to keep loose pages contained.

billet_bone.name: bone billet
billet_bone.description: A thick, short bone, usually used in flintknapping for soft-hammer percussion.

billet_wood.name: wooden billet
billet_wood.description: A thick, short wooden stick, usually used in flintknapping for soft-hammer percussion.

drill_rock_primitive.name: primitive rock drill
drill_rock_primitive.description: A thick, blunted wooden stick.  Can be used to drill rough holes in rock, if water and sand are available, but the process is lengthy.

punch_bone.name: bone punch
punch_bone.description: A thick, short bone with a small, pointy tip, usually used in flintknapping for indirect percussion and pressure flaking.

punch_nail.name: nail punch
punch_nail.description: Two pieces of wood with a steel nail secured between them with some cordage.  Usually used in flintknapping for indirect percussion and pressure flaking.

awl_bone.name: bone sewing awl
awl_bone.description: A crude, sharpened bone awl, used for leatherworking before metal was discovered.  It can also serve as an improvised stabbing weapon, but will break quickly.

awl_steel.name: steel sewing awl
awl_steel.description: A steel awl with a wooden grip, usually used for leatherworking.  It can also serve as an improvised stabbing weapon, but will break quickly.

knitting_needles.name: knitting needles (pair)
knitting_needles.description: A pair of stout wooden needles with round ends, used to turn thread and yarn into cloth.

loom_frame.name: frame loom
loom_frame.description: A rather bulky and primitive wooden frame which can be used to weave cloth sheets.  The process is very slow, though.

needle_bone.name: bone needle
needle_bone.description: A sharp needle made from a bone.  Useful for making rough clothing and items.  Its low quality makes it rather unsuitable for anything requiring speed or precision.

needle_curved.name: curved needle
needle_curved.description: A curved, sharp needle made of steel.  Its rounded shape allows it to make stitches that only pierce one side of the material.  While unsuitable for most tailoring projects, it's a necessity for stitching neoprene.

needle_wood.name: wooden needle
needle_wood.description: A wooden needle whittled down to a sharp point.  It has a narrow hole carved into the head for threading.  Its low quality makes it rather unsuitable for anything requiring speed or precision, or involving tougher materials like Kevlar.

needle_steel.name: needle
needle_steel.description: A stainless steel needle.  It would be useful for making clothing and items.

sewing_kit.name: sewing kit
sewing_kit.description: A plastic kit with a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, small scissors, and a few other useful textile tools.  Use a sewing kit on an article of clothing to attempt to repair or refit if applicable.  This uses your tailoring skill.

shed_stick.name: wooden shed stick
shed_stick.description: A short, thin, flat wooden stick, used as a tool while weaving cloth with a frame loom.

tanning_hide_active.name: tanning leather hide
tanning_hide_active.description: A treated animal hide that is undergoing the chemical processes required to become leather.  The process takes about 8 hours.

tanning_pelt_active.name: tanning fur pelt
tanning_pelt_active.description: A treated animal pelt that is undergoing the chemical processes required to become fur.  The process takes about 8 hours.

tailoring_pattern_set.name: tailoring pattern set
tailoring_pattern_set.description: A large set of tailoring patterns made from paper.  They're useful for making any kind of cloth or leather items from scratch, but are necessary for more advanced projects.

kevlar_shears.name: Kevlar shears
kevlar_shears.description: A pair of heavy-duty shears suitable for cutting particularly tough materials, from polyaramid fabrics to tough plastics and thin metals.  The blades feature flat shearing edges and fine serrations.

electric_spinwheel.name: electric spinwheel
electric_spinwheel.description: A device for spinning thread or yarn from fibers.  This particular model is electrically-powered and easily portable.

tailors_kit.name: tailor's kit
tailors_kit.description: A high-quality kit consisting of a variety of needles, some plastic spools for thread, scissors and shears, and an awl.  Use a tailor's kit on an article of clothing to attempt to repair or refit if applicable.  This uses your tailoring skill.

sewing_machine.name: sewing machine
sewing_machine.description: An absolutely essential tool for any modern tailor.  It works much faster than manual tailoring tools, but it must be plugged into a power grid to function.

bathroom_scale.name: bathroom scale
bathroom_scale.description: A small bathroom scale, meant to weigh a person while naked.

brush.name: scrub brush
brush.description: A simple scrub brush for cleaning hard objects.

dish_towel.name: dish towel
dish_towel.description: A dish towel, useful for cleaning hard surfaces.

snippet_category.text: An elegant, monogrammed dish towel.  Unfortunately, they aren't your initials.
An elegant, monogrammed dish towel.  It even has your initials!
A well-used dish towel, judging by the stains.
A novelty dish towel featuring a popular children's cartoon character.
A novelty dish towel which reads "IT'S WINE O CLOCK".
A dish towel with a floral pattern.
A dish towel with a gingham pattern.
A dish towel with a cat pattern.

elec_hairtrimmer.name: electric hair trimmer
elec_hairtrimmer.description: A pocket-sized electric trimmer made for cutting hair.  You can use it to cut your hair if it's supplied with batteries.  It requires 1 unit of charge per use.

mop.name: mop
mop.description: An unwieldy mop.  Good for cleaning up spills.  Use to mop up any 'mess' you may have made.

mop_folded.name: collapsible mop
mop_folded.description: A long, unwieldy mop with a collapsible handle for convenient transportation.  You may use it to clean up any 'mess' you have made.

cotton_patchwork.name: cotton patch
cotton_patchwork.description: A 6-inch square cotton patch, suitable for repairing and tailoring clothing.

emery_board.name: emery board
emery_board.description: A slim cardboard stick coated with abrasive grit, meant for shaping fingernails.

shavingkit.name: shaving kit
shavingkit.description: A compact, lightweight shaving kit made for travelers.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.

sponge.name: sponge
sponge.description: A cleaning aid made of soft, porous material.  Typically used for cleaning hard objects.

snippet_category.text: A round smiley-face sponge.
A rectangular sponge with a green abrasive back.
A dolphin-shaped sponge.  It looks at home in the water.
A rectangular sponge.
A sponge cake-shaped sponge, the abrasive pad looks like frosting.
A sponge in the shape of a beloved character from a children's cartoon.
A cat-shaped sponge.

survivor_hairtrimmer.name: makeshift haircut kit
survivor_hairtrimmer.description: A kit containing various improvised tools for cutting hair.

survivor_shavingkit.name: makeshift shaving kit
survivor_shavingkit.description: A makeshift shaving kit.  You can use it to shave if it's supplied with soap.  It requires 1 unit of soap per use.

wash_kit.name: washing kit
wash_kit.description: A combination of a washboard and a scrubbing tool.  Everything you need to clean items after the apocalypse.

hair_dye_kit.name: hair dye kit
hair_dye_kit.description: A kit featuring all the tools needed to dye hair, including an applicator brush, combs, and plastic gloves.

makeup_kit.name: makeup kit
makeup_kit.description: A kit containing all the essential tools and products for makeup, it even includes nail polish.

beartrap.name: bear trap
beartrap.description: A spring-loaded pair of steel jaws connected to a sensitive pressure plate.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will ensnare and damage anything that steps on it.  If you are carrying a shovel, you will have the option of burying it.

use_action.done_message: You set the beartrap.

light_snare_kit.name: light snare kit
light_snare_kit.description: A simple loop snare, comprising a carefully wound loop of string, two anchor points, and a tool to hammer them in.  It is suitable for immobilizing only small animals.  It has no means of harming its target, as live meat lasts longer.

use_action.done_message: You set the snare trap.

board_trap.name: nailboard trap
board_trap.description: Several pieces of wood nailed together, with some nails sticking straight up.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on it, they'll get nails through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You set the board trap on the %s, nails facing up.

boobytrap.name: booby trap
boobytrap.description: A crude explosive device triggered by a piece of string.  Use it to set it up and wait for some poor bastard to trigger it.

use_action.done_message: You set the booby trap up and activate the grenade.

bubblewrap.name: bubble wrap
bubblewrap.description: A sheet of plastic covered with air-filled bubbles.  Use it to set it on the ground, creating a trap that will warn you with noise when something steps on it.

use_action.done_message: You set the bubble wrap on the ground, ready to be popped.

caltrops.name: loose caltrops
caltrops.description: A handful of small metal objects covered with many sharp points.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get a spine through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You scatter the caltrops on the %s.

caltrops_glass.name: loose glass caltrops
caltrops_glass.description: A handful of glass shards glued together to expose all their sharp edges.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get cut.

use_action.done_message: You scatter the glass caltrops on the %s.

crossbow_trap.name: crossbow trap
crossbow_trap.description: A simple tripwire attached to the trigger of a loaded crossbow.  When the tripwire is pulled, the crossbow fires.  Only a single bolt can be used, after which the trap is disabled.

use_action.done_message: You set the crossbow trap.

landmine.name: land mine
landmine.description: A military anti-personnel fragmentation mine that is triggered when stepped on.

use_action.done_message: You set the land mine.

shotgun_trap.name: shotgun trap
shotgun_trap.description: A simple tripwire attached to the trigger of a loaded double slam-fire shotgun.  When the tripwire is pulled, the shotgun fires.  Two shells are loaded; the first time the trigger is pulled, one or both shells may be discharged.

use_action.done_message: You set the shotgun trap.

tripwire.name: tripwire trap
tripwire.description: A length of thin string with some affixing tools on either end.  It must be placed across a doorway or other thin passage to function.  Its purpose is to trip up trespassers, causing them to stumble and possibly hurt themselves slightly.

use_action.done_message: You string up the tripwire.

caltrops_teeth.name: loose teeth caltrops
caltrops_teeth.description: A handful of small impossibly-sharp teeth glued together.  If an unsuspecting victim steps on one, they'll get a tooth through the foot.

use_action.done_message: You scatter the teeth caltrops on the %s.

folded_inflatable_boat.name: inflatable boat
folded_inflatable_boat.description: This rubber rowboat (with oars included) is deflated for storage.  Activate it with an air pump in your inventory to inflate and launch it.

ax.name: wood axe
ax.description: A large, two-handed wood axe.  It makes a good melee weapon, but is a bit slow to recover between swings.

bow_saw.name: bow saw
bow_saw.description: A saw that is more at home outdoors than inside.  It's used for trimming trees, pruning, and cutting firewood, but may be used for other rough cuts as well.

chainsaw_off.name: chainsaw (off)
chainsaw_off.description: A treecutting tool moonlighting as a weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with gas, using this item will turn it on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.

effect.u_make_sound: With a roar, the chainsaw screams to life!

effect.u_message: With a roar, the chainsaw screams to life!

false_effect.u_message: You yank the cord, but nothing happens.

chainsaw_on.name: chainsaw (on)
chainsaw_on.description: This chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

polesaw_off.name: pole saw (off)
polesaw_off.description: A lumbering tool intended for trimming hedges and tree branches at a distance.  If loaded with gas, using this item will cause it to turn on, making it into an unwieldy polearm.

use_action.msg: With a roar, the pole saw screams to life!

polesaw_on.name: pole saw (on)
polesaw_on.description: This pole saw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

circsaw_off.name: circular saw (off)
circsaw_off.description: A lightweight, handheld cordless circular saw.  Spins a circular blade fast enough to cut wood, or in an emergency, pizza.

use_action.msg: With a loud buzz, the %s roars to life!

circsaw_on.name: circular saw (on)
circsaw_on.description: A lightweight, handheld cordless circular saw.  It is currently on and the blade is spinning; use this item to turn it off.

copper_ax.name: copper hatchet
copper_ax.description: A primitive axe made from a small wedge of copper affixed to a short haft.

bronze_axe.name: bronze axe
bronze_axe.description: A socketed bronze axe with a work-hardened edge, tightly bound to the shaft with cords.

hatchet.name: hatchet
hatchet.description: A one-handed hatchet.  Makes a great melee weapon, and is useful both for chopping things and hammering them.

luthier_toolset.name: luthier toolset
luthier_toolset.description: A set of luthier tools in several sizes and types.  Guaranteed to have the right tools for creating musical instruments from wood.

elec_chainsaw_off.name: electric chainsaw (off)
elec_chainsaw_off.description: A treecutting tool moonlighting as a weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with batteries, using this item will turn it on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.

success_message.str: With a roar, the electric chainsaw screams to life!

failure_message.str: You flip the switch, but nothing happens.

false_effect.u_message: You flip the switch, but nothing happens.

elec_chainsaw_on.name: electric chainsaw (on)
elec_chainsaw_on.description: This electric chainsaw is on and making a lot of noise.  Use it to turn it off.

elec_chainsaw_cord_off.name: corded electric chainsaw (off)
elec_chainsaw_cord_off.description: A treecutting tool moonlighting as a weapon of opportunity.  It has a short electric cord, which you can connect to the generator or your home grid.  Extension cord not included.

success_message.str: With a roar, the corded electric chainsaw screams to life!

failure_message.str: You flip the switch, but nothing happens.

false_effect.u_message: You flip the switch, but nothing happens.

elec_chainsaw_cord_on.name: corded electric chainsaw (on)
elec_chainsaw_cord_on.description: A treecutting tool moonlighting as a weapon of opportunity.  If loaded with batteries, using this item will turn it on, turning it into a very powerful but unwieldy melee weapon.

hand_axe.name: stone axe head
hand_axe.description: A broad piece of stone with an edge narrow enough to roughly chop wood.

makeshift_axe.name: metal axe head
makeshift_axe.description: A chunk of steel with one edge hammered down to something resembling a cutting edge.  It works passably well, but really can't compare to a proper axe.

primitive_adze.name: stone adze
primitive_adze.description: A stone adze, a primitive tool for smoothing or scraping wood objects.

primitive_axe.name: stone axe
primitive_axe.description: A stone with a narrow edge affixed to a stick.  It can chop wood, but requires much more effort than a modern axe.

saw.name: wood saw
saw.description: A thin saw, useful for cutting through wood objects.  Activate it to turn pre-cut logs into planks.

stone_chisel.name: stone chisel
stone_chisel.description: A short, primitive chisel made from hard stone, usually used for primitive woodworking.

adobe_pallet_full_active.name: pallet of wet adobe bricks
adobe_pallet_full_active.description: A pallet full of heavy mud bricks which need to dry slowly to be usable, so it will transform after a week.

adobe_pallet_done.name: pallet of dry adobe bricks
adobe_pallet_done.description: A pallet of humble mud bricks that have dried for a week while you were out risking your life.  Disassemble it to retrieve your frame and building supplies.

acetylene_machine.name: acetylene-gas machine
acetylene_machine.description: A bulky device that turns water and calcium carbide into unpressurized acetylene.

angle_grinder.name: angle grinder
angle_grinder.description: A widespread power tool, often used for removing excess material or polishing surfaces.

grinder_cutoff_disc.name: cutoff disc
grinder_cutoff_disc.description: A manufactured disc for an angle grinder, with a thin, abrasive edge designed for cutting metal.

grinder_metal_grinding_disc.name: metal grinding disc
grinder_metal_grinding_disc.description: A manufactured disc for an angle grinder, with a thick, abrasive surface designed for grinding and shaping metal.

carding_paddles.name: carding paddles (pair)
carding_paddles.description: A pair of toothy wooden paddles used to clean fibers for use in textile production.

makeshift_vacuum_mold.name: makeshift vacuum mold
makeshift_vacuum_mold.description: A homemade vacuum-forming machine with an air pump.  It's used for creating plastic molds.

vac_mold.name: vacuum molder
vac_mold.description: A vacuum-forming machine with an air pump.  It's used for creating plastic molds.

chipper.name: paint chipper
chipper.description: A tool similar to a chisel, designed to remove paint.

clamp.name: clamp
clamp.description: A metal clamp, useful for holding things in place, especially if you have several of them.

claw_bar.name: claw bar
claw_bar.description: A small prying tool with a clawed bend at one end for pulling spikes.  Use it to open locked doors without destroying them or to lift manhole covers.  You could also wield it to bash some heads in.

con_mix_foldable.name: concrete mixer
con_mix_foldable.description: A portable concrete mixer.  It is large and heavy, but it can be operated solo.  Unfold to use.

cordless_drill.name: cordless drill
cordless_drill.description: A cordless battery-powered drill with a selection of drill bits.

corded_powerdrill.name: power drill
corded_powerdrill.description: A black power drill with a selection of bits.  Uses a power cord, so it will have to be plugged into a power grid or vehicle to function.

cordless_impact_wrench.name: cordless impact wrench
cordless_impact_wrench.description: A cordless battery-powered impact wrench, designed to deliver high torque via an internal rotating hammer.  It comes with a standard set of sockets, and makes a loud ratcheting sound when it operates.  You could use it to turn large bolts or change a vehicle wheel.

distaff_spindle.name: distaff and spindle
distaff_spindle.description: A pair of specialized wooden rods used to spin fibers into thread and yarn.

elec_jackhammer.name: electric jackhammer
elec_jackhammer.description: A construction tool for breaking horizontal surfaces.  This model has a cord compatible with a UPS.

corded_demolition_hammer.name: demolition hammer
corded_demolition_hammer.description: A power tool made for demolishing vertical constructed surfaces by hand, somewhat similar to a handheld jackhammer.  It must be plugged in for use.

hacksaw.name: hacksaw
hacksaw.description: A sturdy saw, useful for cutting through metal objects.

tin_snips.name: tin snips
tin_snips.description: A pair of tin snips, resembling a sturdy pair of scissors with beefy blades designed to cut through thin sheets of soft metal.  These cannot cut through thick metals like a hacksaw can, but are better suited to precision work and leave a cleaner edge.

hammer.name: hammer
hammer.description: A demagnetized steel claw hammer with a wooden grip.  With a hammer, nails, and planks in your inventory, you could board up adjacent doors and windows.  It has myriad other uses as well.

hammer_bronze.name: bronze hammer
hammer_bronze.description: A simple crude bronze hammer.  It is not as sophisticated or useful as its steel alternative but it does get the job of hammering in nails well enough.

hammer_peen.name: ball-peen hammer
hammer_peen.description: A hammer with two heads; one flat and the other rounded used in the peening process in metalworking.

nail_puller_bronze.name: bronze nail puller
nail_puller_bronze.description: A crude nail puller made of bronze.  Not really as good as its steel alternative but it gets job of pulling out nails good enough.

saw_bronze.name: bronze wood saw
saw_bronze.description: A simple wood saw made of bronze.  Not as great as its steel equivalent, but it's good enough.

hand_drill.name: hand drill
hand_drill.description: A primitive manual drill with a single drill bit.  It is slow to use, and will exhaust you quickly.

hose.name: rubber hose
hose.description: A flexible rubber hose.  It could be used for crafting or siphoning fuel from a vehicle.

jack.name: bottle jack
jack.description: A portable hydraulic bottle jack used for lifting vehicles.

jack_makeshift.name: makeshift jack
jack_makeshift.description: A poorly-constructed improvised scissor jack used for lifting vehicles if you're brave enough to use it.

jack_small.name: scissor jack
jack_small.description: A compact scissor jack used for lifting vehicles.

jackhammer.name: jackhammer
jackhammer.description: A construction tool for breaking horizontal surfaces.  This model runs on gasoline.

kiln.name: electric kiln
kiln.description: An electric kiln, powered by your electric grid.  It is designed for firing bricks, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.  With a little mechanical know-how, you could probably even convert it to run directly off a vehicle's power system.

large_repairkit.name: gunsmith repair kit
large_repairkit.description: A complete tool kit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires 1 charge of battery power per use.

makeshift_hammer.name: makeshift hammer
makeshift_hammer.description: A crude hammer made from a piece of metal affixed to a stick.  It functions adequately, but really can't compare to a proper hammer.

bronze_file.name: bronze fileset
bronze_file.description: A set of tools commonly used to remove small amounts of material from the surface of metal objects.

metal_file.name: metal fileset
metal_file.description: A set of tools commonly used to remove small amounts of material from the surface of metal objects.

metal_smoother.name: metallic smoother
metal_smoother.description: A tool that is most often used to smooth concrete or mortar in construction projects.

misc_repairkit.name: miscellaneous repair kit
misc_repairkit.description: A portable tool kit consisting of a small craft knife for precise carving of replacement parts from raw materials, a wood saw for more heavy-duty wood cutting, and a patch of soft material for cleaning surfaces.  If supplied with duct tape, it can be used to repair certain items.

multitool.name: multitool
multitool.description: A cleverly designed all-in-one tool which combines several smaller tools into the handles of a pair of pliers.

camping_multitool.name: camping multitool
camping_multitool.description: A 'Hideman' brand multi-tool.  This model includes extra options for outdoors use such as a firestarting rod, awl, rescue whistle and a hammering surface.

oxy_torch.name: acetylene torch
oxy_torch.description: A compact tool kit intended for welding and cutting metal, this portable oxygen-acetylene torch includes a torch handle and cutting attachment in an easy-to-carry tote.  It needs to be connected to a pressurized cylinder of an appropriate welding gas before use.  In addition to its metalworking uses, you can activate it in order to destroy metal barriers.

paint_brush.name: paint brush
paint_brush.description: A wide brush, suitable for painting walls.

pickaxe.name: pickaxe
pickaxe.description: A large steel pickaxe, suitable for breaking up hard things or (with enough skill) hard targets.  Strike the earth!

bronze_pickaxe.name: bronze pickaxe
bronze_pickaxe.description: A heavy-headed cast and worked tool with a pointed wedge on one side for breaking stone and a flat wedge on the other for prying it out.  You could mine with this.

pin_reamer.name: pin reamer
pin_reamer.description: Handheld pin reamers of this kind are used to enlarge existing holes, or remove any burs and such from them.

pliers.name: pliers
pliers.description: A basic pair of slip-joint pliers, able to handle basic mechanical work.  Anything more complex will require a wrench.

big_pliers.name: tongue-and-groove pliers
big_pliers.description: A large pair of slip-joint pliers bent at the elbow, able to handle basic mechanical work.  Anything more complex will require a wrench.

pliers_locking.name: locking pliers
pliers_locking.description: A pair of pliers with extra-hefty jaws and an adjustable mechanism to clamp them in a locked grip on whatever unfortunate object is trapped between them.  They could grip and turn a fairly large bolt head, or clamp two parts together temporarily.

polisher.name: electric polisher
polisher.description: An electric polisher, used to buff metal surfaces until they are reflective like a mirror.

primitive_hammer.name: stone hammer
primitive_hammer.description: A rock affixed to a stick in the crude facsimile of a hammer.  It functions adequately, but really can't compare to a proper hammer, and can't pull out nails either.

reciprocating_saw.name: reciprocating saw
reciprocating_saw.description: A battery-powered tool, commonly known by the generic trademark Sawzall, that uses an electric motor to push a straight sawblade back and forth to rapidly cut wood or metal.  It is useful for heavy demolition and construction work, but poorly suited to precision tasks.

robofac_gun_kit.name: Hub 01 HWP maintenance kit
robofac_gun_kit.description: A heavy-duty bag marked with the Hub 01 logo.  It contains space for barrels, adapters, and proprietary tools.  Embossed on the inside is a sketch of the Hybrid Weapons Platform.

screwdriver.name: screwdriver
screwdriver.description: A Philips-head screwdriver.  It is important for almost all electronics crafting, most mechanics crafting, and has many more uses.

screwdriver_set.name: screwdriver set
screwdriver_set.description: A set of screwdrivers in several sizes and blade types.  Guaranteed to have the right tools for more precise work.

socket_screwdriver_set.name: socket screwdriver set
socket_screwdriver_set.description: A ratcheting screwdriver with a collection of hex sockets for turning small bolts or nuts, including a couple standard screwdriver bits.

socket_wrench_set.name: socket wrench set
socket_wrench_set.description: A thick-handled ratchet wrench with an assortment of interchangeable sockets in common hex bolt sizes.  You could loosen or tighten fairly large bolts with this, and the ratchet makes a satisfying clicking sound.

small_repairkit.name: firearm repair kit
small_repairkit.description: A portable tool kit made to repair damaged firearms.  Powered by standard batteries, it is a vital tool for long-term firearms maintenance.  It requires one charge of battery power per use.

soldering_iron.name: soldering iron
soldering_iron.description: A device with a metal tip that can get very hot.  It is necessary for advanced electronics crafting.  Has a short cable that you can plug to your grid.

soldering_iron_portable.name: portable soldering iron
soldering_iron_portable.description: A device with a metal tip that can get very hot.  It is necessary for advanced electronics crafting.  This one is a portable version, and contains a slot for a battery.

lug_wrench.name: lug wrench
lug_wrench.description: A steel rod bent 90 degrees with a socket on the shorter end, made to hold the lug nuts of a car's wheels to either fasten or loosen for convenient removal and replacement.  Makes for a decent melee weapon in a pinch.

toolbox_empty.name: toolbox
toolbox_empty.description: A stout metal box for holding tools.  It has a handle on the top and a latch on the front.

toolbox_workshop_empty.name: workshop toolbox
toolbox_workshop_empty.description: A stout metal box for holding tools.  It is much bigger than a regular toolbox, and can be used to store more tools as a result.

welder.name: arc welder
welder.description: A cable-powered tool for welding metal pieces together using an electric arc.  It is an indispensable tool for construction or repair.

welder_crude.name: makeshift arc welder
welder_crude.description: A crude arc welder fashioned from a few small transformers, some wire, an improvised electrode holder, and a complete disregard for personal safety.  While it's not as efficient as a factory-made welder, it will serve in a pinch.

welding_kit.name: high-temperature welding kit
welding_kit.description: A welder combined with a fireproof insulating blanket allows for advanced welds and repairs to tempered steels.

wood_smoother.name: wooden smoother
wood_smoother.description: A large makeshift tool used in smoothing concrete or mortar in construction projects.  You could also use it as an improvised head-basher.

xacto.name: X-Acto knife
xacto.description: A small, sharp knife, designed for making precise cuts for textiles or crafts.  It could cause decent damage, but is difficult to land a solid hit with.  Its small, sharp blade allows for precision strikes in the hands of the skilled.

wrench_small.name: small adjustable wrench
wrench_small.description: A compact adjustable crescent wrench, with a short handle that fits in the palm of your hand.  It could be used for turning small hex-head nuts or bolts.

wrench.name: adjustable wrench
wrench.description: An adjustable crescent wrench.  It is used in many mechanics crafting recipes.

wrench_large.name: large adjustable wrench
wrench_large.description: An unusually large adjustable crescent wrench, with a long handle and jaws that widen over two inches.  This could easily turn most bolts, and should even work on wheel lug nuts.

wrench_48.name: heavy-duty pipe wrench
wrench_48.description: A 48in pipe wrench, normally used in oil fields and in the maintenance of public utilities.  It's much larger and heavier than you have any practical use for.

makeshift_hose.name: leather hose
makeshift_hose.description: A hose made of leather.  Watertight and flexible, it can be used to siphon fuel from a vehicle tank.  However, it's not as elastic as a rubber hose.

makeshift_hand_drill.name: makeshift hand drill
makeshift_hand_drill.description: A makeshift manual drill made with a pipe and an improvised drill bit.  Using it is very slow, and will exhaust you quickly.

wire_draw_machine.name: wire draw machine
wire_draw_machine.description: A machine designed specifically for turning metal rods into wire.

propane_torch.name: propane torch
propane_torch.description: A compact tool kit intended for heating metal, this portable propane torch includes a torch handle and accessories in an easy-to-carry tote.  It needs to be connected to a pressurized propane cylinder before use.

block_and_tackle.name: block and tackle
block_and_tackle.description: A sturdy metal housing with a number of pulleys that can be used with a thick rope or a chain to gain mechanical advantage on a lift.

block_and_tackle_wood.name: wooden block and tackle
block_and_tackle_wood.description: A wooden housing with a pair of pulleys that can be used with a thick rope or a chain to gain mechanical advantage on a lift.  Not as durable as a metal set.

welding_blanket.name: welding blanket
welding_blanket.description: A non-flammable mat used to protect surfaces from welding splatter, or to insulate a weld when repairing tempered metal.  This one is made with asbestos.

makeshift_welding_blanket.name: makeshift welding blanket
makeshift_welding_blanket.description: A makeshift mostly-non-flammable mat used to protect surfaces from welding splatter or to insulate a weld when repairing tempered metal.  This one is stitched together from oven insulation batts.

thread_cutting_set.name: thread cutting set
thread_cutting_set.description: This is a set of a external thread cutting die inserted into a manual grip and an internal thread cutting die used as a drill bit.

fanning_mill.name: fanning mill
fanning_mill.description: A machine for separating seed from chaff.  It mechanized the winnowing process, in which the grain was separated from the lighter chaff and straw by blowing a leather bellows.

bench_vise.name: bench vise
bench_vise.description: A heavy, metal vise bolted down to a work surface.  With its jaws and screw, it can tightly hold items, useful for a wide array of handiwork such as soldering, woodworking, welding, anything that can be aided by a firm grip.  Also has a small, flat metal surface, useful for light metalworking if needed.

exodii_kiln.name: Exodii kiln
exodii_kiln.description: An electric kiln, powered by your electric grid.  A bit larger than a refrigerator, this Exodii-manufactured kiln is large enough to repair the sheets of ceramic they use for armor.  It is designed for firing sheets of the Exodii's ceramic, but you could use it to fire anything made of clay.  A large and power-hungry appliance.

monkey_tool.name: monkey tool
monkey_tool.description: A small cylindrical chunk of steel with a hole in the middle, made to fit into the hand.  It's used to make rivets by inserting a small rod of steel inside then hammering the end sticking out until it forms the characteristic mushroom shape of the rivet head.

nail_header.name: nail header
nail_header.description: A square hole punched through the flat end of a metal handle.  Used to form the flat end of a nail by feeding it through the header then hammering the material sticking out of it.

nail_header_bronze.name: bronze nail header
nail_header_bronze.description: A square hole punched through the flat end of a metal handle.  Used to form the flat end of a nail by feeding it through the header then hammering the material sticking out of it.  This one is made of bronze.

razor_blade_taped.name: taped razorblade
razor_blade_taped.description: A double-edged razor blade with one side taped to allow its use as a basic tool.

dremel.name: dremel
dremel.description: A rotating tool that can be used with various bits for a large amount of applications.

arm_splint.name: arm splint
arm_splint.description: A tool to help set arm bones and hold them in place.

arm_xlsplint.name: arm splint
arm_xlsplint.description: A tool to help set arm bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Huge survivors.

arm_xs_splint.name: arm splint
arm_xs_splint.description: A tool to help set arm bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Tiny survivors.

tourniquet_upper.name: tourniquet (arm)
tourniquet_upper.description: A first aid device used to apply pressure to a limb or extremity in order to limit blood flow.  Should be employed only to manage heavy bleeding, because prolonged use will harm the limb.  It can be adjusted in size to fit different limbs.

tourniquet_upper_XL.name: tourniquet (arm)
tourniquet_upper_XL.description: A first aid device used to apply pressure to a limb or extremity in order to limit blood flow.  Should be employed only to manage heavy bleeding, because prolonged use will harm the limb.  It can be adjusted in size to fit different limbs.

tourniquet_upper_XS.name: tourniquet (arm)
tourniquet_upper_XS.description: A first aid device used to apply pressure to a limb or extremity in order to limit blood flow.  Should be employed only to manage heavy bleeding, because prolonged use will harm the limb.  It can be adjusted in size to fit different limbs.

tourniquet_lower.name: tourniquet (leg)
tourniquet_lower.description: A first aid device used to apply pressure to a limb or extremity in order to limit blood flow.  Should be employed only to manage heavy bleeding, because prolonged use will harm the limb.  It can be adjusted in size to fit different limbs.

tourniquet_lower_XL.name: tourniquet (leg)
tourniquet_lower_XL.description: A first aid device used to apply pressure to a limb or extremity in order to limit blood flow.  Should be employed only to manage heavy bleeding, because prolonged use will harm the limb.  It can be adjusted in size to fit different limbs.

tourniquet_lower_XS.name: tourniquet (leg)
tourniquet_lower_XS.description: A first aid device used to apply pressure to a limb or extremity in order to limit blood flow.  Should be employed only to manage heavy bleeding, because prolonged use will harm the limb.  It can be adjusted in size to fit different limbs.

makeshift_blindfold.name: makeshift blindfold
makeshift_blindfold.description: A crude eye covering woven from blades of grass with string attached to fasten it.  Useful for sleeping in bright areas.  Use to raise it.

makeshift_blindfold_up.name: makeshift blindfold (raised)
makeshift_blindfold_up.description: A crude eye covering woven from blades of grass with string attached to fasten it.  It's currently raised, letting you see.  Use to lower it.

blindfold.name: blindfold
blindfold.description: A simple fabric covering tied over the eyes to block sight.  Useful for sleeping in bright areas.  Use to raise it.

blindfold_up.name: blindfold (raised)
blindfold_up.description: A simple fabric covering tied over the eyes to block sight.  It's currently raised, letting you see.  Use to lower it.

blindfold_duct.name: duct tape blindfold
blindfold_duct.description: A simple covering tied over the eyes to block sight, made out of duct tape.  Useful for sleeping in bright areas.  Use to raise it.

blindfold_duct_up.name: duct tape blindfold (raised)
blindfold_duct_up.description: A simple covering tied over the eyes to block sight, made out of duct tape.  It's currently raised, letting you see.  Use to lower it.

ear_plugs.name: ear plugs (pair)
ear_plugs.description: Industrial-grade ear plugs.  They fit inside the ears.

leg_splint.name: leg splint
leg_splint.description: A tool to help set leg bones and hold them in place.

leg_xlsplint.name: leg splint
leg_xlsplint.description: A tool to help set leg bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Huge people.

leg_xs_splint.name: leg splint
leg_xs_splint.description: A tool to help set leg bones and hold them in place.  It is specifically designed to fit Tiny people.

welding_mask.name: welding mask
welding_mask.description: A plastic mask with a very dark visor, meant to protect the entire face while welding.  It also serves as somewhat good armor, but makes it hard to see.  Activate it to push it up your head.

use_action.msg: You push your welding mask up your head.

welding_mask_crude.name: crude welding mask
welding_mask_crude.description: A crude welding mask made from shaped steel.  It will keep your face safe while welding, but it's a bit less comfortable than the real deal.  Activate it to push it up your head.

use_action.msg: You push your welding mask up your head.

welding_mask_crude_raised.name: crude welding mask (raised)
welding_mask_crude_raised.description: A crude welding mask made from shaped steel.  It's less dark than a proper welding mask, and therefore less difficult to see in, but also less protective when welding.  Activate it to lower it over your face.

use_action.msg: You lower your welding mask over your face.

welding_mask_raised.name: welding mask (raised)
welding_mask_raised.description: A plastic mask with a very dark visor, meant to protect the entire face while welding.  It also serves as somewhat good armor, but makes it hard to see.  Activate it to lower it over your face.

use_action.msg: You lower your welding mask over your face.

game_watch.name: game watch
game_watch.description: A waterproof digital watch with a built-in electronic game system, powered by standard batteries.  Activate to play.

smart_watch.name: smart watch
smart_watch.description: A touchscreen watch that comes with many uses, such as a calendar, alarm, and even a fitness app, for when you want to check your health on the go!

use_action.message: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.

smart_watch_music.name: smart watch - music
smart_watch_music.description: This smart watch is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

use_action.message: You stop listening to music and take your earbuds out.

smart_watch_adv.name: advanced smart watch
smart_watch_adv.description: A touchscreen watch that comes with many uses, such as a calendar, alarm, and even a fitness app, for when you want to check your health on the go!  This is a more expensive model, featuring a shock-resistant and waterproof case and a bunch of additional sensors.

use_action.message: You put in the earbuds and start listening to music.

smart_watch_adv_music.name: advanced smart watch - music
smart_watch_adv_music.description: This advanced smart watch is playing music, steadily raising your morale.  You can't hear anything else while you're listening.

use_action.message: You stop listening to music and take your earbuds out.

fitness_band.name: fitness band
fitness_band.description: A fitness band that can track your heartbeat, exercise level, and calories, and also has a clock.  Activate to see your metrics.

flashlight_mount_wrist.name: diving flashlight wrist mount
flashlight_mount_wrist.description: A proprietary wrist mount for a flashlight.  Not very useful on its own.

pocket_data.description: Proprietary mount for a diving flashlight.

holo_cloak.name: hologram cloak
holo_cloak.description: A cloak woven with metallic fibers and covered with hexagonal sheets of reflective carbide.  When activated, it will create a holographic decoy of its wearer.

fedora.name: fedora
fedora.description: A high-crowned, wide-brimmed, sable-colored fedora.  Its brim helps keep the sun out of your eyes.  The perfect hat for treasure hunting.

thermal_socks.name: thermal electric socks (pair)
thermal_socks.description: A pair of socks with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You turn the heating elements on.

thermal_socks_on.name: thermal electric socks (on) (pair)
thermal_socks_on.description: A pair of socks with internal battery-powered heating elements.  They are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.

use_action.msg: You turn the heating elements off.

thermal_suit.name: thermal electric suit
thermal_suit.description: A full-body suit of thin thermal underwear equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You turn the heating elements on.

thermal_suit_on.name: thermal electric suit (on)
thermal_suit_on.description: A full-body suit of thin thermal underwear equipped with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn the heating elements off.

thermal_gloves.name: thermal electric gloves (pair)
thermal_gloves.description: A pair of gloves with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You turn the heating elements on.

thermal_gloves_on.name: thermal electric gloves (on) (pair)
thermal_gloves_on.description: A pair of gloves with internal battery-powered heating elements.  They are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn them off.

use_action.msg: You turn the heating elements off.

thermal_mask.name: thermal electric balaclava
thermal_mask.description: A snug cloth mask with internal battery-powered heating elements.  Use it to turn it on.

use_action.msg: You turn the heating elements on.

thermal_mask_on.name: thermal electric balaclava (on)
thermal_mask_on.description: A snug cloth mask with internal battery-powered heating elements.  It is are currently on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

use_action.msg: You turn the heating elements off.

binoculars.name: binoculars
binoculars.description: A pair of optics with a neck strap attached.  Useful for seeing long distances.  Wearing this item or carrying it in your inventory will double the distance around you that is mapped during your travels.  You could also use them to focus the sunlight.

wearable_light.name: headlamp
wearable_light.description: An LED headlamp with an adjustable strap so as to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  Use it to turn it on.

wearable_camera.name: wearable camera
wearable_camera.description: A point-and-shoot digital camera with a digital viewfinder, a backup 'iron-sight', and flash.  You can look at your photos on the digital screen, or transfer them with a memory card.  This one can be worn over your neck.

wearable_camera_pro.name: wearable professional camera
wearable_camera_pro.description: A 35 mm digital SLR (single-lens reflex) camera with optical and digital viewfinders, a zoom lens with auto-focus and stabilizer, and flash.  You can view your photos on it or transfer them with a memory card.  Before the Cataclysm, you could have taken professional-grade photos using this.  This one can be worn over your neck.

wearable_light_on.name: headlamp (on)
wearable_light_on.description: An LED headlamp with an adjustable strap so as to be comfortably worn on your head or attached to your helmet.  It is turned on, and continually draining batteries.  Use it to turn it off.

wearable_big_light_on.name: heavy-duty headlamp (on)
wearable_big_light_on.description: A heavy-duty LED headlamp with a durable polymer housing.  It's impact-resistant, chemical-resistant, waterproof and certified for use in hazardous environments.  Designed for firefighters, rescue personnel and miners.  Use it to turn it off.

wearable_big_light.name: heavy-duty headlamp
wearable_big_light.description: A heavy-duty LED headlamp with a durable polymer housing.  It's impact-resistant, chemical-resistant, waterproof and certified for use in hazardous environments.  Designed for firefighters, rescue personnel and miners.  Use it to turn it on.

ar_glasses_basic.name: basic AR glasses
ar_glasses_basic.description: A pair of compact augmented reality glasses with some basic functionality.  There is a camera on the rim, and it has an alarm clock feature.

ar_glasses_advanced.name: advanced AR glasses
ar_glasses_advanced.description: An expensive model of augmented reality glasses, with adaptive light correction and some gadgets, designed to be compatible with corrective glasses.  An augmented reality overlay allows the user to zoom their view, and it displays handy information about local topology.

ar_glasses_advanced_pat.name: modified advanced AR glasses
ar_glasses_advanced_pat.description: An expensive model of augmented reality glasses, with adaptive light correction and some gadgets, designed to be compatible with corrective glasses.  An augmented reality overlay allows the user to zoom their view, and it displays handy information about local topology.  These have been modified by your friend Pat to function on long-distance radio waves (LoRa).  A battery pack, the internal parts of a tablet PC, and a two-way radio have been combined onto a hip-strapped unit.  Activate it to utilize software, start recording and transmitting with Pat's system, or hail Pat on the radio.

use_action.menu_text: Connect to Pat's system and start transmitting data
use_action.msg: You turn the %s on and put in your earbud.

ar_glasses_advanced_pat_on.name: modified advanced AR glasses (on)
ar_glasses_advanced_pat_on.description: An expensive model of augmented reality glasses, with adaptive light correction and some gadgets, designed to be compatible with corrective glasses.  An augmented reality overlay allows the user to zoom their view, and it displays handy information about local topology.  These have been modified by your friend Pat to function on long-distance radio waves (LoRa).  A battery pack, the internal parts of a tablet PC, and a two-way radio have been combined onto a hip-strapped unit.  Activate it to utilize software, start recording and transmitting with Pat's system, or hail Pat on the radio.

use_action.menu_text: Disconnect from Pat's system and stop transmitting data
use_action.msg: You turn the %s off and remove your earbud.

ar_glasses_advanced_pat_on.name_plural: pairs of modified advanced AR glasses (on)

helmet_eod.name: EOD helmet
helmet_eod.description: An armored, electronically-shielded helmet containing a camera, a two-way radio, and a headlamp, all of which can be voice-activated for redundancy.  It is designed to protect against overpressure, fragmentation, impact, and heat.

helmet_eod_on.name: EOD helmet (on)
helmet_eod_on.description: An armored, electronically-shielded helmet containing a camera, a two-way radio, and a headlamp, all of which can be voice-activated for redundancy.  It is designed to protect against overpressure, fragmentation, impact, and heat.

dimensional_anchor.name: 5-point anchor
dimensional_anchor.description: A featureless, disc-shaped device mounted on a harness.  The words "X.E.D.R.A" and "5-point anchor" are inscribed on its front and back.

use_action.msg: An LED light in the 5-point anchor flickers on.
use_action.need_charges_msg: It seems like this device needs power.

dimensional_anchor_on.name: 5-point anchor (on)
dimensional_anchor_on.description: The harness' shoulder-mounted LED glows with a soft green hue.  There's no further indication of anything happening.

use_action.msg: An LED light in the 5-point anchor flickers off.

broken_dimensional_anchor.name: malfunctioning 5-point anchor
broken_dimensional_anchor.description: A battered, disc-shaped device mounted on a harness.  The inscriptions "X.E.D.R.A" and "5-point anchor" are barely legible on its radiation-stained front and back.

use_action.msg: The 5-point anchor emits a low-pitched clicking alarm as its mounted LED light flashes yellow.
use_action.need_charges_msg: It seems like this device needs power.

string_dimension_phase_immersion_suit.name: KÁ expedition harness
string_dimension_phase_immersion_suit.description: A protective body-suit built from layered textiles and segmented plates, all coated in a layer of gold.  The collar bares a prominent set of clasps and tube fittings.  An integrated harness is equipped with spring-loaded clips and a small electronic control apparatus stamped with "KÁ".

pocket_data.description: Clipped to the harness.
Clipped to the harness.
Clipped to the harness.
Clipped to the harness.

effect.u_message: The device emits a whispered word: "ḫuliam"

rebreather.name: rebreather mask
rebreather.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  Use it to turn it on.

rebreather_on.name: rebreather mask (on)
rebreather_on.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.

rebreather_xl.name: rebreather mask
rebreather_xl.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been expanded substantially and can accommodate exotic anatomy.  Use it to turn it on.

rebreather_xl_on.name: rebreather mask (on)
rebreather_xl_on.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been expanded substantially and can accommodate exotic anatomy.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.

rebreather_xs.name: rebreather mask
rebreather_xs.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been shrunk dramatically to fit a smaller face.  Use it to turn it on.

rebreather_xs_on.name: rebreather mask (on)
rebreather_xs_on.description: A mask worn over your mouth which, when loaded with the proper filters, recycles your exhaled breath for rebreathing while underwater.  This model has been shrunk dramatically to fit a smaller face.  It is turned on, and continually consuming its filter.  Use it to turn it off.

scuba_regulator.name: SCUBA regulator
scuba_regulator.description: A set of hoses and regulators used by SCUBA divers to breathe underwater.  Wear it, open an air tank, and activate it to prepare it for use.

scuba_regulator_scba_on.name: SCUBA regulator (on)
scuba_regulator_scba_on.description: A set of hoses and regulators used by SCUBA divers to breathe underwater.  It is currently being fed air.  Activate it to turn it off.

mask_filter.name: filter mask
mask_filter.description: A mask that straps over your mouth and nose and filters air.  Protects from smoke, dust, and other contaminants quite well.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_gas.name: gas mask
mask_gas.description: A full-face, industrial-grade respirator made from a solid black silicon and butyl rubber blend, providing decent user comfort in addition to a clear field of view and a secure fit thanks to the mask's single-element visor and 6-point head harness.  Provided that a filter canister's been screwed into the right-side filter port and the respirator's been prepared, it'll do an admirable job at preventing smoke, gas, and contaminants derived from chemical and lab work from taking up residence in your organs.

pocket_data.description: A number of external brackets arranged around the eyepiece to retain an outer attachment.
A space behind the visor designed to accommodate the installation of inserts.

mask_gas_xl.name: gas mask
mask_gas_xl.description: A full-face, industrial-grade respirator made from a solid black silicon and butyl rubber blend, providing decent user comfort in addition to a clear field of view and a secure fit thanks to the mask's single-element visor and 6-point head harness.  Provided that a filter canister's been screwed into the right-side filter port and the respirator's been prepared, it'll do an admirable job at preventing smoke, gas, and contaminants derived from chemical and lab work from taking up residence in your organs.

pocket_data.description: A number of external brackets arranged around the eyepiece to retain an outer attachment.
A space behind the visor designed to accommodate the installation of inserts.

mask_gas_xs.name: gas mask
mask_gas_xs.description: A full-face, industrial-grade respirator made from a solid black silicon and butyl rubber blend, providing decent user comfort in addition to a clear field of view and a secure fit thanks to the mask's single-element visor and 6-point head harness.  Provided that a filter canister's been screwed into the right-side filter port and the respirator's been prepared, it'll do an admirable job at preventing smoke, gas, and contaminants derived from chemical and lab work from taking up residence in your organs.

pocket_data.description: A number of external brackets arranged around the eyepiece to retain an outer attachment.
A space behind the visor designed to accommodate the installation of inserts.

mask_gas_half.name: half-face gas mask
mask_gas_half.description: A lightweight, form-fitting mask that straps over your mouth and nose, providing full protection from the inhalation of smoke, tear gas, and chemical contaminants - though safety goggles are advised!  It must be prepared before use.

mask_fsurvivor.name: handmade firemask
mask_fsurvivor.description: A custom-made leather gas mask faced with Nomex.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_fsurvivorxl.name: handmade firemask
mask_fsurvivorxl.description: A custom-made leather gas mask faced with Nomex.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_fsurvivorxs.name: handmade firemask
mask_fsurvivorxs.description: A custom-made leather gas mask faced with Nomex.  It must be prepared before use.

mask_bunker.name: firefighter respirator mask

military_papr_mask.name: military respirator mask (PAPR)
military_papr_mask.description: A black, full-face military respirator made from a silicon and butyl rubber blend, providing decent user comfort in addition to a clear field of view and a secure fit thanks to the mask's single-element visor and 6-point head harness.  This mask is configured for two modes: negative-pressure, using standard CBRN gas mask filter canisters; and positive-pressure, with built-in hardware to accommodate either a powered air-purifying respirator (PAPR) or a self-contained breathing apparatus (SCBA).  Once activated it will comfortably protect against chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear threats.  It is currently in positive-pressure PAPR mode, so will only function with a powered PAPR blower.

basic_papr_helmet_xedra_mark.name: shielded PAPR-EEG helmet
basic_papr_helmet_xedra_mark.description: A white plastic helmet fit with a transparent full-face mask.  It has been modified for some unknown purpose.  On the back of the helmet is a long tube which attaches to a powered air purifying respirator system.  Once activated it will comfortably protect against chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear threats.  Like a standard gas mask it must be prepared before use; unlike a standard gas mask it will only function when paired with an active PAPR blower unit.  A cotton cap covered in electrodes and wires, like those used to make electroencephalogram recordings, has been integrated as an underlayer, with a thick connection cable exiting a grommeted and sealed hole in the back.  A layer of shiny metallized polyethylene terephthalate has been glued to the interior of the helmet itself.  A tinfoil hat for a prepper with class.

welding_papr_helmet.name: PAPR welding helmet
welding_papr_helmet.description: A helmet fit with a welding mask over a transparent full-face mask.  On the back of the helmet is a long tube which attaches to a powered air purifying respirator system.  Once activated it will comfortably protect against chemical, biological, radiological, and nuclear threats.  Like a standard gas mask it must be prepared before use; unlike a standard gas mask, it is relatively cool and comfortable, but will only function when paired with an active PAPR blower unit.  The welding shield is separate from the PAPR mask itself, so can be raised safely without compromising its ability to filter air.  Activate it to prepare it, or to push the welding mask up onto your head.

rx11_stimpack.description: A Rivtech RX11 stimulant delivery system, a jet autoinjector system worn on the user's body.  A simple press of its activator injects powerful chemical stimulants into the bloodstream without using a needle.

military_vis_aug_system.name: military visual augmentation system
military_vis_aug_system.description: An experimental and cumbersome augmented reality headset developed for the military.  It consists of a broad eyepiece, a rugged multi-camera array, and a puck computer, all designed to be strapped over a helmet.  The lenses are equipped with adaptive light correction, light amplification and thermal imaging, and an augmented reality overlay equipped with various gadgets, including a rangefinder and adaptive targeting system, making target acquisition quicker.  Activate it to turn on all systems.

use_action.msg:
You activate your AR system.
Anduril IVASos v1.2: ONLINE.
Visual systems:      ONLINE.
Radio systems:       ONLINE.
Targeting HUD:       ONLINE.
GPS:                  ERROR.

magazine_battery_medium_mod.name: medium battery mod

magazine_battery_heavy_mod.name: tool battery mod
magazine_battery_heavy_mod.description: A battery compartment mod that allows the use of tool batteries in tools that otherwise could not.
