alternator_car.description: A standard alternator used to power vehicle electrical systems.

alternator_motorbike.name: motorbike alternator
alternator_motorbike.description: A compact, lightweight alternator used to power small vehicle electrical systems.

alternator_bicycle.name: bicycle alternator
alternator_bicycle.description: A very lightweight alternator used to power a bicycle's headlights.

alternator_truck.name: truck alternator
alternator_truck.description: A larger and more powerful alternator used to power vehicle electrical systems.

yoke_harness.name: yoke and harness
yoke_harness.description: A bar and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along.

yoke_harness_heavyduty.name: reinforced yoke and harness
yoke_harness_heavyduty.description: Heavy steel beams and harness to attach a sufficiently large creature to a wheeled vehicle, allowing them to pull it along, reinforced to withstand the rigors of the apocalypse and ill-advised off-roading.  You would still need separate armor for said creature to wear.

rebar_plate.name: rebar grate
rebar_plate.description: Several interlocked rods of rebar serving as makeshift armor, allowing for light and effective reinforcement of vehicle sections.

spring_plate.name: shock absorber
spring_plate.description: A makeshift combination of springs and scrap that protects a particular section of a vehicle from the shock of impacts.  The springs can absorb a surprising amount of damage.

battery_car.name: car battery
battery_car.description: A 12 V lead-acid battery used to power car electrical systems.  Can also be plugged into a static power grid.

battery_motorbike.name: motorbike battery
battery_motorbike.description: A 12 V lead-acid battery used to power smaller vehicles' electrical systems.

battery_motorbike_small.name: small motorbike battery
battery_motorbike_small.description: A miniature 12 V lead-acid battery used to power smaller vehicles' electrical systems.

storage_battery.name: large storage battery
storage_battery.description: A large storage battery containing many lithium-ion cells.  Could be installed into a storage battery case for easy removal from a vehicle, or just welded straight in.

large_storage_battery.name: very large storage battery
large_storage_battery.description: A huge storage battery containing many lithium-ion cells.  Holds a tremendous amount of energy.  Could be installed into a storage battery case for easy removal from a vehicle, or just welded straight in.  Can also be plugged into a static power grid.

medium_storage_battery.name: medium storage battery
medium_storage_battery.description: A medium storage battery containing multiple lithium-ion cells.  Can be plugged into a static power grid.

small_storage_battery.name: small storage battery
small_storage_battery.description: A small storage battery created with pre-Cataclysm lithium-ion technology.  Useful for crafting.  Can be plugged into a static power grid.

it_battery_mount.name: storage battery case
it_battery_mount.description: A battery case for storage batteries.  It has a charging controller chip, connecting wires, and a harness for securing a battery.  Allows quick removal or addition of a storage battery to a vehicle's power grid, if you can lift the battery.

it_handheld_battery_mount.name: tool battery mount
it_handheld_battery_mount.description: A mount for batteries usually used in handheld tools.  It has a power converter, a charging controller chip, connecting wires, and a harness for securing a battery.  Allows quick removal or addition of such batteries to a vehicle's power grid.

power_station_portable.name: portable power station
power_station_portable.description: A ready-to-deploy portable rechargeable battery unit that comes with an inverter for powering home appliances and outlet ports for your electronic devices.  Useful for camping, power outage, and surviving the apocalypse.

boat_board.name: wooden boat hull
boat_board.description: A wooden board that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

raft_board.name: raft boat hull
raft_board.description: Logs tied together to make a vehicle float.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

plastic_boat_hull.name: plastic boat hull
plastic_boat_hull.description: A rigid plastic sheet that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

carbonfiber_boat_hull.name: carbon fiber boat hull
carbonfiber_boat_hull.description: A rigid carbon fiber sheet that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

hand_paddles.name: oars
hand_paddles.description: A pair of oars for a boat.

aluminum_boat_hull.name: aluminum boat hull
aluminum_boat_hull.description: An aluminum hull that keeps the boat afloat.  Add boat hulls to a vehicle until it floats, then attach oars or a motor to get the boat to move.

basket.name: wire basket
basket.description: A large wire basket from a shopping cart.

bike_rack.name: bike rack
bike_rack.description: A collection of pipes, cams, and straps, mounted on the edge of a vehicle and used to support another vehicle for transport.  It must be mounted on a vehicle to be used.

cargo_lock.name: cargo lock set
cargo_lock.description: A set of locks designed to be installed on a vehicle.  Attached to a suitable cargo space, it will prevent other people from accessing the cargo and taking your stuff.

folding_basket.name: foldable wire basket
folding_basket.description: A large wire basket from a shopping cart, modified to be foldable.

bike_basket.name: bike basket
bike_basket.description: A simple bike basket.  It is small and foldable.

cargo_rack.name: cargo carrier
cargo_rack.description: A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo.

cargo_aisle.name: floor trunk
cargo_aisle.description: A section of flooring with a cargo space beneath and a hinged door for access.

livestock_carrier.name: livestock carrier
livestock_carrier.description: A heavy frame outfitted with tie-downs and attachment points for carrying cargo, with additional railings to keep a large animal in place.  It is meant to hold large animals for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

mounted_spare_tire.name: mounted spare tire
mounted_spare_tire.description: A spare tire mounted on a carrier rig, ready to be attached to the rear bumper of a vehicle.

animal_locker.name: animal locker
animal_locker.description: A locker used to contain animals safely during transportation if installed properly.  There is room for animal food and other animal care goods.  It is meant to hold medium or smaller animals for transport.  Use it on a suitable animal to capture, use it on an empty tile to release.

nose_plate.name: nose plate
nose_plate.description: An L-shaped aluminum plate with straps and skid runners for a hand truck.  If attached to a sturdy frame, you could use these to move furniture.

camera_control.name: security camera display
camera_control.description: A set of small monitors.  Required to view cameras' output.

omnicamera.name: security camera
omnicamera.description: A security camera you could connect to a display.  Image quality is quite low, but the field of vision is great.

omnicamera_reinforced.name: reinforced security camera
omnicamera_reinforced.description: A security camera with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.

vehicle_controls.name: vehicle controls
vehicle_controls.description: A steering wheel, accelerator, and brake pedals.

reins_tackle.name: rein and tackle
reins_tackle.description: A set of leather bindings to control a mountable creature.

vehicle_dashboard.name: dashboard
vehicle_dashboard.description: A vehicle instrument panel with various gauges and switches.

electronics_controls.name: electronics control unit
electronics_controls.description: A vehicle instrument panel with various gauges and switches.  Useful for crafting.

drive_by_wire_controls.name: drive by wire controls
drive_by_wire_controls.description: A sophisticated set of electronic controls that allow you to control the vehicle from a vehicle remote while you are not in it.
drive_by_wire_controls.name_plural: sets of drive by wire controls

robot_controls.name: robot driving unit
robot_controls.description: A set of servos, microcontrollers, and other devices, to allow a vehicle to drive itself, or you to drive it remotely using a controller.  Its AI is not functional, but it should still have some sort of maintenance mode.

turret_controls.name: turret control unit
turret_controls.description: A set of motors, cameras, and various electronic modules banded together to allow for tracking targets, friend-or-foe identification, and firing the connected turret in full automatic mode.

hand_controls.name: hand controls
hand_controls.description: A pair of adjustable rods with a simple trigger.  They easily can be easily installed on top of vehicle controls and will allow a car or similar vehicle to be driven by those who can't use their legs to do so, whether due to disability or small stature.  These are designed for automobiles and will not work on bicycle style foot pedals.

pedal_extenders.name: pedal extenders
pedal_extenders.description: These thick rubber pads can clamp securely onto a vehicle's gas and brake pedals, allowing even very short people to drive a car.

pedal_extenders_makeshift.name: makeshift pedal extenders
pedal_extenders_makeshift.description: It is probably not a great idea, but if you wanted to, you could tape these blocks to a vehicle's gas and brake pedals so that a kid or very short adult could drive.

1cyl_combustion.name: 0.05 L 1-cylinder engine
1cyl_combustion.description: A 50 cc gasoline engine, suitable for a lawnmower, golf cart or moped.

1cyl_combustion_large.name: 0.2 L large 1-cylinder engine
1cyl_combustion_large.description: A high-compression, 200 cc single-cylinder 4-stroke combustion engine, suitable for a dirt bike or scooter.

1cyl_combustion_med.name: 0.2 L medium 1-cylinder engine
1cyl_combustion_med.description: A high-compression, 150 cc single-cylinder 4-stroke combustion engine, suitable for a dirt bike, scooter or generator.

engine_1cyl_diesel_large.name: 0.2 L large 1-cylinder diesel engine
engine_1cyl_diesel_large.description: A high-compression, 200 cc single-cylinder 4-stroke diesel combustion engine, suitable for a dirt bike, scooter, or generator.

1cyl_combustion_small.name: 0.02 L small 1-cylinder engine
1cyl_combustion_small.description: A small 25 cc gasoline engine, suitable for a hedge trimmer or installing on a bicycle.

aero_engine_light.name: 5.24 L light aero-engine
aero_engine_light.description: An air-cooled, 4-cylinder, horizontally opposed internal combustion engine, rated for 150 horsepower.  Commonly used on light aircraft.

i4_combustion.name: 1.6 L I4 engine
i4_combustion.description: A 1600 cc four-cylinder gasoline engine, commonly found in small passenger cars.

i4_diesel.name: 1.6 L I4 diesel engine
i4_diesel.description: A four-cylinder diesel engine, commonly found in small passenger cars and light trucks.

i1_diesel.name: 0.5 L I1 diesel engine
i1_diesel.description: A small, diesel powered one-cylinder, four-stroke air-cooled engine.

i6_diesel.name: 6 L I6 diesel engine
i6_diesel.description: An industrial-sized 6-cylinder diesel engine, commonly called a straight-six.  About as powerful as a V6 engine but significantly larger for use in heavy equipment.

v2_combustion.name: 0.6 L V2 engine
v2_combustion.description: A 600 cc, two-cylinder, gas engine for a fast motorcycle or very small car.

v6_combustion.name: 2.8 L V6 engine
v6_combustion.description: A powerful 6-cylinder gasoline engine strong enough for a pickup truck, SUV, or full-size van.

v6_diesel.name: 2.8 L V6 diesel engine
v6_diesel.description: A powerful 6-cylinder diesel engine, typical of a bus, RV, large van, or armored personnel carrier.

v8_combustion.name: 4.5 L V8 engine
v8_combustion.description: A heavy-duty 8-cylinder gasoline engine, like you might find in a fire truck, ambulance, or tow truck.

v8_diesel.name: 4.5 L V8 diesel engine
v8_diesel.description: A large 8-cylinder diesel engine, powerful enough for a semi truck, armored car, or Humvee.

v12_combustion.name: 7 L V12 engine
v12_combustion.description: A massive and extremely powerful 12-cylinder combustion engine, usually built into high-end sports cars.

v12_diesel.name: 7 L V12 diesel engine
v12_diesel.description: A massive and extremely powerful 12-cylinder diesel engine, usually built into heavy trucks.

steam_watts_small.name: makeshift steam engine
steam_watts_small.description: A small, primitive steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed-cycle system.

steam_triple_small.name: small steam engine
steam_triple_small.description: A small steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed-cycle system.

steam_triple_medium.name: medium steam engine
steam_triple_medium.description: A medium-sized steam engine.  An integrated boiler burns coal to heat water into steam, driving a reciprocating shaft.  A condenser recaptures the water, making this a closed-cycle system.

engine_block_massive.name: massive engine block
engine_block_massive.description: The beginnings of a massive gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

engine_block_large.name: large engine block
engine_block_large.description: The beginnings of a large gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

engine_block_medium.name: medium engine block
engine_block_medium.description: The beginnings of a medium gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

engine_block_small.name: small engine block
engine_block_small.description: The beginnings of a small gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

engine_block_tiny.name: tiny engine block
engine_block_tiny.description: The beginnings of a tiny gas or diesel engine.  It's not good for much of anything on its own.

small_turbine_engine.name: 25 L 650 HP gas turbine engine
small_turbine_engine.description: A small gas turbine engine, suitable for powering a small one or two-seat helicopter.

medium_turbine_engine.name: 38 L 1,900 HP gas turbine engine
medium_turbine_engine.description: A large gas turbine engine, usually used for military helicopters.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption.

large_turbine_engine.name: 119.5 L 6,000 HP gas turbine engine
large_turbine_engine.description: A massive gas turbine engine, used to power the V-22 Osprey.  Known for its high rate of fuel consumption.

xedra_genset.name: prototype multifuel genset
xedra_genset.description: A spartan, prototype engine-generator made to burn many types of fuel in the field.  It has a small "DARPA" stamp on the casing.

cantilever_medium.name: steel boom
cantilever_medium.description: A large, rigid steel boom.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 20 metric tonnes.

cantilever_small.name: telescopic cantilever
cantilever_small.description: A small, telescoping steel cantilever.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 3.5 metric tonnes.

pallet_lifter.name: pallet lifter
pallet_lifter.description: A makeshift pallet lifter.  If attached to a frame it could be used to lift up to 0.5 metric tonnes.

v_rockwheel_item.name: rockwheel
v_rockwheel_item.description: A large, heavy, jagged metal disc for digging trenches.

v_airjack_item.name: airjack
v_airjack_item.description: An extendable metal pylon used to replace a portable jack.  If mounted to a vehicle, it could be used to lift it up.

v_motorcycle_kickstand_item.name: motorcycle kickstand
v_motorcycle_kickstand_item.description: A kickstand to keep a bike from falling over.  You could use this to lean a small vehicle forward or backward to change a tire.

v_scoop_item.name: vehicle scoop
v_scoop_item.description: An assembly of motors and sheet metal that allows a vehicle to clean the road surface by removing debris and contaminants.

v_planter_item.name: seed drill
v_planter_item.description: An assembly of tubes, spikes, and wheels that, when dragged along the ground, allows a vehicle to plant seeds automatically in suitably tilled land.

v_reaper_item.name: reaper
v_reaper_item.description: An assembly of a blade, wheels, and a small lever for engaging/disengaging, used to cut down crops prior to picking them up.

v_reaper_item_advanced.name: advanced reaper
v_reaper_item_advanced.description: An advanced electronic device used to cut down, collect, and store crops.

v_planter_item_advanced.name: advanced seed drill
v_planter_item_advanced.description: An assembly of tubes, spikes, and wheels that, when dragged along the ground, allows a vehicle to plant seeds automatically in suitably tilled land.  This one is equipped with an electronic control system and will avoid damaging itself when used on untilled land.

v_plow_item.name: plow
v_plow_item.description: A heavy assembly of wheels and steel blades that turn up the ground.

foldframe.name: foldable light frame
foldframe.description: A light metal framework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.

xlframe.name: extra-light frame
xlframe.description: A small, lightweight frame made from pipework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.

foldxlframe.name: foldable extra-light frame
foldxlframe.description: A small, lightweight frame made from pipework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.

frame.name: steel frame
frame.description: A metal framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.

hdframe.name: heavy-duty frame
hdframe.description: A large, reinforced steel frame, used in military vehicle construction.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Increased mass makes it more resistant to damage in collisions.

frame_wood.name: wooden frame
frame_wood.description: A wooden framework.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Wood and nail construction means it can be constructed and added to the vehicle without welding tools.

foldwoodframe.name: foldable wooden frame
foldwoodframe.description: A light wooden framework, designed to fold.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it.  If all the frames and components of a vehicle are foldable, the vehicle can be folding into a small package and picked up as a normal item.

frame_wood_light.name: light wooden frame
frame_wood_light.description: A small frame made of a few pieces of wood, held together by rope.  Other vehicle components can be mounted on it, and it can be attached to other frames to increase the vehicle's size.  Wood and rope constructions means it can be constructed and added to the vehicle without welding tools or nails.

frame_wood_deck.name: skateboard deck
frame_wood_deck.description: A small skateboard frame made of thin layers of wood glued together.  Other skateboard components can be mounted on it.

frame_concrete_mix.name: concrete mixer chassis
frame_concrete_mix.description: The chassis of a concrete mixer.

fuel_bunker.name: fuel bunker
fuel_bunker.description: A bin for holding solid fuel.  Contains up to 50 liters of coal or charcoal.

car_headlight.name: car headlight
car_headlight.description: A vehicle headlight to light up the way.

motorcycle_headlight.name: motorcycle headlight
motorcycle_headlight.description: A motorcycle headlight to light up the way.

car_wide_headlight.name: wide-angle car headlight
car_wide_headlight.description: A wide-angle vehicle headlight to light up the way.

headlight_reinforced.name: reinforced headlight
headlight_reinforced.description: A vehicle headlight with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.

wide_headlight_reinforced.name: reinforced wide-angle headlight
wide_headlight_reinforced.description: A wide-angle vehicle headlight with a cage built around it to protect it from damage without reducing its effectiveness.

light_emergency_red.name: emergency vehicle light (red)
light_emergency_red.description: A red light from the top of an emergency services vehicle.

light_emergency_blue.name: emergency vehicle light (blue)
light_emergency_blue.description: A blue light from the top of an emergency services vehicle.

floodlight.name: floodlight
floodlight.description: A large, heavy light designed to illuminate wide areas.

directed_floodlight.name: directed floodlight
directed_floodlight.description: A large, heavy light designed to illuminate a wide area in a half-circular cone.

hand_rims.name: set of hand rims
hand_rims.description: A set of hand rims for use on a wheelchair.

foot_crank.name: foot crank
foot_crank.description: A pedal and gear assembly from a bicycle.

wind_turbine.name: wind turbine
wind_turbine.description: A small turbine that can convert wind into electric power.

xl_wind_turbine.name: large wind turbine
xl_wind_turbine.description: A large turbine that can convert wind into electric power.

water_wheel.name: water wheel
water_wheel.description: A water wheel that will slowly recharge electrical power when built over shallow moving water.

xl_water_wheel.name: large water wheel
xl_water_wheel.description: A large water wheel with wooden supports.  It will recharge electrical power when built over shallow moving water.

motor.name: electric motor
motor.description: A medium-duty electrical motor, suitable for powering ultra-light vehicles, or as part of a hybrid gas-electric drivetrain.

motor_enhanced.name: enhanced electric motor
motor_enhanced.description: A powerful high-performance electric motor, as found in those consumer electric sports cars with ridiculous, ludicrous, or similarly hyperbolic acceleration options.  It needs a lot of battery power.

motor_super.name: super electric motor
motor_super.description: A massive and extremely powerful electric motor, delivering high torque at the cost of significant power drain, this would be well suited to an electric racing car.

motor_large.name: large electric motor
motor_large.description: A heavy-duty electrical motor, capable of propelling a full-size car or SUV through electric power alone, provided you have the battery capacity.

motor_small.name: small electric motor
motor_small.description: A light-duty electrical motor, strong enough for an electric mopeds, golf carts, and even hybrid mopeds.

motor_tiny.name: tiny electric motor
motor_tiny.description: A tiny electric motor just the right size for providing a gentle boost for a bicycle, or similarly light vehicles.

motor_train1300.name: 1,300 HP electric train engine
motor_train1300.description: A 1,300 horsepower 3-phase 60 Hz electric engine.  Normally used in trains.

muffler.name: muffler
muffler.description: A muffler from a car.  Useful in a few crafting recipes.

beeper.name: back-up beeper
beeper.description: A safety device intended to warn passersby of a vehicle moving in reverse.  Usage of it now seems terribly unwise.

stereo.name: stereo system
stereo.description: A stereo system with speakers.  It is capable of being hooked up to a vehicle.

chimes.name: chime loudspeakers
chimes.description: A stereo system with loudspeakers and a built-in set of simple melodies that it will play.  Commonly used by ice cream trucks to draw the attention of children in the days when children wanted ice cream more than brains.

wood_plate.name: wooden armor kit
wood_plate.description: A bundle of planks prepared to be used as vehicle armor.

steel_plate.name: steel plating
steel_plate.description: A piece of vehicle armor plating made of steel.

alloy_plate.name: superalloy plating
alloy_plate.description: A piece of vehicle armor plating made of sturdy superalloy.

alloy_sheet.name: superalloy sheet
alloy_sheet.description: A sheet of sturdy superalloy; incredibly hard, yet incredibly malleable.

spiked_plate.name: spiked plating
spiked_plate.description: A piece of vehicle armor plating made of steel.  It is covered with menacing spikes.

hard_plate.name: hard plating
hard_plate.description: A piece of very thick vehicle armor plating made of tempered steel.  Can be used as a makeshift anvil.

mil_plate.name: military composite plating
mil_plate.description: A thick sheet of military-grade armor; the best bullet-stopper you can stick on a vehicle.

chitin_plate.name: chitin armor kit
chitin_plate.description: A piece of light chitin plating made for a vehicle.

acidchitin_plate.name: biosilicified chitin armor kit
acidchitin_plate.description: A piece of durable silica-coated chitin plating made for a vehicle.

counterweight.name: counterweight
counterweight.description: A heavy block of steel used for balancing other heavy things.  Can be used as a makeshift anvil.

tearer.name: shredder
tearer.description: This menacing-looking attachment is meant to be powered by a vehicle's engine.  Upon doing so, the circular blades of this device will rotate rapidly; anything in front of it is likely to be ripped to shreds.  It is sturdy enough to withstand multiple impacts, and is designed to detach if it would take a hit that would break it.

forgerig.name: vehicle forge rig
forgerig.description: A forge rig made to run off a vehicle's storage battery, with integrated tool storage for metalworking equipment.

kilnrig.name: vehicle kiln
kilnrig.description: An electric kiln made to run off a vehicle's storage battery.

weldkit.name: vehicle high-temperature welding kit
weldkit.description: A welder combined with a fireproof insulating blanket, allowing for advanced welds and repairs to tempered steels.

heavy_duty_military_rotor.name: heavy-duty military rotors
heavy_duty_military_rotor.description: A set of four rotor blades from a military attack helicopter.

small_helicopter_rotor.name: small civilian helicopter rotors
small_helicopter_rotor.description: A set of four rotor blades from a civilian light helicopter.
small_helicopter_rotor.name_plural: sets of small civilian helicopter rotors

seat.name: bucket seat
seat.description: A soft car seat made from synthetic fabric.

seat_leather.name: leather bucket seat
seat_leather.description: A soft car seat covered with leather.

seat_bench.name: bench seat
seat_bench.description: A wide, flat seat like you'd find in the back of a sedan, upholstered with soft nylon.

seat_bench_leather.name: leather bench seat
seat_bench_leather.description: A wide, flat seat like you'd find in the back of a sedan, upholstered with leather.

saddle.name: saddle
saddle.description: A padded wedge that you straddle, like a bicycle or motorcycle.

solar_panel.name: vehicle solar panel
solar_panel.description: An electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  Useful for a vehicle or a static power grid.

ground_solar_panel.name: solar panel array
ground_solar_panel.description: A collection of four solar panels, ready to get to work converting solar radiation into electric power.  Install them to use them in a static power grid.

folding_solar_panel.name: small folding solar panel
folding_solar_panel.description: This "little" solar panel folds up to carry around, in case you need to charge anything on the go.  Its small size means it might take quite some time to charge, however.

folding_solar_panel_deployed.name: deployed folding solar panel
folding_solar_panel_deployed.description: This "little" solar panel folds up to carry around, in case you need to charge anything on the go.  Its small size means it might take quite some time to charge, however.

folding_solar_panel_v2.name: solar suitcase
folding_solar_panel_v2.description: A large, ready-to-deploy set of solar panels, designed for portable off-the-grid use.

folding_solar_panel_v2_deployed.name: deployed solar suitcase
folding_solar_panel_v2_deployed.description: A large, ready-to-deploy set of solar panels, designed for portable off-the-grid use.

reinforced_solar_panel.name: vehicle reinforced solar panel
reinforced_solar_panel.description: A solar panel that has been covered with a pane of reinforced glass to protect the delicate solar cells from zombies or errant baseballs.  The glass causes this panel to produce slightly less power than a normal panel.

solar_panel_v2.name: vehicle advanced solar panel
solar_panel_v2.description: An electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  This one is a high-performance type made with monocrystalline silicon cells.

ground_solar_panel_v2.name: advanced solar panel array
ground_solar_panel_v2.description: A collection of four smaller solar panels, ready to convert solar radiation into electric power.  These panels are high-performance, made with monocrystalline silicon cells.

reinforced_solar_panel_v2.name: vehicle advanced reinforced solar panel
reinforced_solar_panel_v2.description: An advanced solar panel that has been covered with a pane of reinforced glass to protect the delicate solar cells from zombies or errant baseballs.  The glass causes this panel to produce slightly less power than a normal advanced panel.

solar_cell.name: solar cell
solar_cell.description: A small electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  This one is a common, inexpensive type made of polycrystalline silicon.

solar_cell_v2.name: advanced solar cell
solar_cell_v2.description: A small electronic device that can convert solar radiation into electric power.  This one is a high-performance type made of monocrystalline silicon.

v_table.name: fancy table
v_table.description: A very fancy table for those with fancy lives.  If times were better, it might be useful for something other than firewood.

workbench.name: workbench (folded)

turret_mount.name: turret mount

pamd68rubik.name: Rubik's Exodii battle rifle
pamd68rubik.description:
The most popular gun to use the 12.3ln cartridge was, of course, the PA md. 71.  Its predecessor, the md. 68, was viewed by many as a sort of failure: although it was reliable and powerful, it was too heavy to be used as a good infantry weapon, and not really heavy enough to be a good support gun.  Enough were made, though, that during the zombie apocalypse, it gained a great deal of resurgent popularity as a light emplacement gun that used readily available ammunition.  It perfectly served the purposes of the Exodii, who had far less concern about its unwieldiness.

This particular rifle has been painted a dusty pink color and has a picture of a smiling eel twisting along the barrel.

rubik_farthing.name: shiny farthing
rubik_farthing.description: A small, shiny brass coin with a picture of a stern-looking older man on one side and the words 'For all of Angland and her children' in an arc beneath him.  On the other side is a large number '1' wreathed in what appear to be nettle leaves.

laptop_boris.name: Ash's laptop computer
laptop_boris.description: A small, somewhat worn-out laptop computer.  The flip-top is decorated with various stickers.

landough_calrisean.name: Dana's family sourdough starter
landough_calrisean.description: This crusty old jar has a glow-in-the-dark Millennium Falcon decal on the side, and a label that reads, "Landough Calrisean.  Dana's.  Do not touch on pain of death".  It's been abandoned for some time and doesn't look like it could be readily salvaged as a sourdough culture, but maybe an experienced sourdough baker could manage it.

Dana_sourdough_bread.name: Dana's sourdough bread
Dana_sourdough_bread.description: This round loaf of bread has a thick, dark crust, and smells very enticing.

ppsh.description: The Soviet-made PPSh-41 is a mass-produced selective-fire submachine gun.  It has a relatively high rate of fire.

plasma_gun.name: PPA-5
plasma_gun.description: The Portable Plasma Accelerator Model Five, developed by Lockheed Martin Corporation.  This device uses highly advanced capacitor banks to create a torus of superheated hydrogen plasma and accelerate it to incredible speed.  It was designed to take down heavy vehicles, and was expected to fully enter US Army service not long before the Cataclysm.

plasma_rifle.name: Boeing XM-P plasma rifle
plasma_rifle.description: Boeing developed this focused plasma weaponry together with DARPA.  It heats solid hydrogen to create plasma, and envelops it with polymers to reduce blooming.  While powerful, it suffers from short range.  Powered by UPS.

a180mag1.description: An unusually-shaped polymer constructed pan magazine for use with .22 caliber submachine guns.

a180mag2.name: .22 177-round magazine
a180mag2.description: An unusually-shaped pan magazine for use with .22 caliber submachine guns.

a180mag3.name: .22 220-round polymer magazine
a180mag3.description: An unusually-shaped polymer pan magazine for use with .22 caliber submachine guns.

a180mag4.name: .22 275-round polymer magazine
a180mag4.description: An unusually-shaped polymer pan magazine for use with .22 caliber submachine guns.

american_180.name: .22 caliber submachine gun
american_180.description: A dramatically uncommon automatic weapon, making use of high-capacity pan magazines and firing the low power .22 caliber cartridge: an unusual ammunition choice for a submachine gun.  With negligible recoil on account of its modest cartridge and a suppressively high rate of fire, a burst of .22 LR rounds from this little machine gun can be best likened with a swarm of hornets… an incredibly angry swarm of hornets.

raging_judge.name: Taurus Raging Judge Magnum
raging_judge.description: The Taurus Raging Judge Magnum is a 6-shot revolver chambered in .454 Casull.  It can fire .410 shotshells and .45 Colt cartridges as well.

454_speedloader6.name: .454 6-round speedloader
454_speedloader6.description: This speedloader can hold 5 rounds of .454, .45 Colt or .410 bore and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

ksg-25.name: extended bullpup shotgun
ksg-25.description: This pump-action shotgun uses a system of twin magazines to carry 24 total rounds of 12-gauge shotgun shells.  Each tube must be loaded separately, but this offers the option of loading different ammunition for different situations.  As the weapon's trigger is situated forwards of the chamber in what is termed as a 'bullpup' design, the firearm's still only as long as conventional shotguns despite having a comparatively far higher capacity.

ksg25_aux_shotgun.name: KSG-25 second magazine
ksg25_aux_shotgun.description: The integrated second tube magazine of the Kel-Tec KSG-25, which holds 12 shots.  It's irremovable.

colt_lightning.name: Colt Lightning .45 Carbine
colt_lightning.description: A modern reproduction of a Colt pump-action rifle.  Originally chambered in .44-40, modern versions most commonly use .45 Colt, complementing the Single Action Army as a Cowboy Action Shooting firearm.

af2011a1mag.name: AF2011A1 16-round double magazine
af2011a1mag.description: Two .38 Super 8-round box magazines attached to a single base plate, holding up to 16 rounds in total, used by the AF2011A1 double-barrel pistol.

af2011a1_38super.name: AF2011A1 .38 Super
af2011a1_38super.description: A double-barrel semi-automatic pistol of Italian origin, firing two bullets per shot, a derivative of the M1911 pistol.

rm614_lmg.name: caseless LMG
rm614_lmg.description: Utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, the Rivtech RM614 light machine gun was designed for durability and extreme volume of sustained fire under the worst possible circumstances.  Accepts RMXB500 box and RMGD250 drum magazines.

8x40_250_mag.name: caseless 250-round drum magazine
8x40_250_mag.description: A 250-round drum magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.  Designated as RMGD250.

8x40_500_mag.name: caseless 500-round drum magazine
8x40_500_mag.description: A 500-round drum magazine for use with Rivtech 8x40mm caseless firearms.  Designated as RMGD500.

rm88_battle_rifle.name: caseless battle rifle
rm88_battle_rifle.description: Originally produced for military use, the Rivtech RM88 battle rifle was designed for durability and extreme firepower under less than ideal circumstances, with a heavy ported barrel for maximum controllability.  Accepts box and RMGD250 drum magazines.

rm120c.name: caseless hunting shotgun
rm120c.description: Designed by Rivtech and utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, this caseless pump-action shotgun was designed for hunting big game, with durability and ease of use as priorities.

rm20.name: RM20 caseless autoshotgun
rm20.description: Designed by Rivtech and utilizing a powerful and unusual caliber, this caseless automatic combat shotgun was designed with durability and overwhelming power in mind.

rm228.name: compact caseless shotgun
rm228.description: Designed by Rivtech and designated the RM228 PDW, chambering the powerful 20x66mm caseless shotgun cartridge, this gun was designed for the civilian personal defense market with durability and ease of use as priorities.  While lauded for its small size and light weight, its hefty price tag kept it out of the reach of casual collectors.

20x66_10_mag.name: compact caseless 10-round magazine
20x66_10_mag.description: A 10-round box magazine for use with the RM228 PDW and RM121 auxiliary shotgun.  Designated as RMSA10.

20x66_20_mag.name: RM20 20-round magazine
20x66_20_mag.description: A 20-round box magazine for use with the RM20 caseless shotgun.  Designated as RMSB20.

20x66_40_mag.name: RM20 40-round magazine
20x66_40_mag.description: A 40-round box magazine for use with the RM20 caseless shotgun.  Designated as RMSB40.

20x66_beanbag.name: 20x66mm beanbag
20x66_beanbag.description: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, sublethal beanbag type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.

20x66_exp.name: 20x66mm explosive
20x66_exp.description: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, explosive projectile type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.

20x66_flare.name: 20x66mm flare
20x66_flare.description: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, signal flare type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.

20x66_frag.name: 20x66mm frag
20x66_frag.description: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, explosive fragmentation type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.

20x66_shot.name: 20x66mm buckshot
20x66_shot.description: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, loaded with 18 buffered pellets of premium plated 00 buck.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.

20x66_slug.name: 20x66mm slug
20x66_slug.description: A 20x66mm caseless shotgun round, solid projectile type.  Proprietary ammunition for Rivtech shotguns.

rm121aux.name: caseless aux shotgun
rm121aux.description: Designated the Rivtech RM121 auxiliary weapon system, this is a magazine-fed semi-automatic caseless shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  Accepts RMSA10 box magazines.

rm121aux_mod.name: modified RM121 aux shotgun
rm121aux_mod.description: The Rivtech RM121 auxiliary weapon system is a magazine-fed semi-automatic caseless shotgun, which can be mounted under the barrel of many rifles.  Accepts RMSA10 box magazines.  This one was modified and customized to mount on pretty much any weapon other than pistols, if you so want.

saiga_410.name: Saiga-410
saiga_410.description: The Saiga-410 is a semi-automatic shotgun designed on the same Kalashnikov pattern as the AK-47 rifle.  It reloads with a magazine, rather than one shell at a time like most shotguns.

saiga410mag_10rd.name: Saiga-410 10-round magazine
saiga410mag_10rd.description: A removable plastic box magazine for the Saiga-410 shotgun.  Holds 10 shells.

saiga410mag_30rd.name: Saiga-410 30-round drum magazine
saiga410mag_30rd.description: A removable plastic drum magazine for the Saiga-410 shotgun.  Holds 30 shells.

waterproof_gunmod.name: firearm waterproofing
waterproof_gunmod.description: A set of seals and gaskets that will allow a firearm to operate reliably while submerged in water.

gun_crossbow.name: rail-mounted crossbow
gun_crossbow.description: A kit to attach a pair of crossbow arms and a firing rail to the barrel of a long firearm.  It allows crossbow bolts to be fired.

makeshift_bayonet.name: makeshift bayonet
makeshift_bayonet.description: A makeshift version of a bayonet that consists of a mere spike with some string.

glock_31.name: Glock 31
glock_31.description: A full size .357 SIG Glock pistol.  It is extremely similar to the Glock 22, and could be converted to fire .40 S&W by switching the barrel.

integrated_giant_pincer.name: sclerotin right pincer
integrated_giant_pincer.description: A powerful tool for snatching fish or breaking open shells.

sourdough_young_uncovered.name: juvenile sourdough starter (obsolete)
sourdough_young_uncovered.description: A floury paste that is slowly going bad.  Someday it will be sourdough.

use_action.msg: After feeding it and caring for it for a week, your sourdough starter is finally ready for the big leagues.
use_action.not_ready_msg: You've been caring for your starter for a while, but it's going to need longer before you can do anything tasty with it.

sourdough_split_uncovered.name: freshly fed sourdough starter (obsolete)
sourdough_split_uncovered.description: A floury paste with sourdough starter mixed in.  It needs a day to recover its strength before it can be used again.

use_action.msg: The starter is now stinky and bubbly, and looks ready for cooking.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The starter isn't quite ready to go.

malting_grain.name: malting grain (obsolete)
malting_grain.description: Malting grain that can be used for brewing.

use_action.msg: After soaking the grain and waiting, it has finished malting.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The grain has not malted yet.

soaking_dandelion.name: soaking dandelion (obsolete)
soaking_dandelion.description: Soaked dandelions that can be used for brewing.

use_action.msg: After soaking the dandelions in boiling water, the juice can be used for making wine.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The dandelions need more time.

fermenting_yogurt.name: fermenting yogurt (obsolete)
fermenting_yogurt.description: Milk inoculated with lactobacillus.  It requires some time fermenting to hopefully end up as delicious yogurt.

use_action.msg: The milk has finished fermenting and turned into a slightly clumpy yogurt.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The yogurt is still fermenting.

raw_curing_fatty_meat.name: slab of raw curing porkbelly (obsolete)
raw_curing_fatty_meat.description: Porkbelly in the process of becoming fully cured with salt and sugar, capable of becoming bacon.  The flavor is slowly developing at this stage, and is significantly unpleasant due to the residual salt.  Activate it once completed to make use of the final product.

use_action.msg: You pat off a bit of extra brine from the slice; this piece of meat is now fully cured.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The meat isn't fully cured yet.

fermentable_fish_mixture.name: fermentable fish mixture (obsolete)

use_action.not_ready_msg: The overpowering smell of the fermenting fish liquid makes it clear that it is not ready for use.

fermentable_fish_mixture.description: A mixture of fish, sugars, and water.  Wait about two months for them to be fermented in an open tank.

aquarium_medium_drying.name: 50 gallon aquarium (drying) (obsolete)
aquarium_medium_drying.description: A 50-gallon glass aquarium, used for safely storing small animals for use as pets or food.  This one has been freshly made and requires time for the silicone to dry.

use_action.msg: You check that the aquarium does indeed hold water, it is ready.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The silicone hasn't dried quite yet.

aquarium_small_drying.name: 30 gallon aquarium (drying) (obsolete)
aquarium_small_drying.description: A 30-gallon glass aquarium, used for safely storing small animals for use as pets or food.  This one has been freshly made and requires time for the silicone to dry.

use_action.msg: You check that the aquarium does indeed hold water, it is ready.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The silicone hasn't dried quite yet.

aquarium_large_drying.name: 100 gallon aquarium (drying) (obsolete)
aquarium_large_drying.description: A 100-gallon glass aquarium, used for safely storing small animals for use as pets or food.  This one has been freshly made and requires time for the silicone to dry.

use_action.msg: You check that the aquarium does indeed hold water, it is ready.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The silicone hasn't dried quite yet.

milk_cream_rising.name: rising cream jar (obsolete)
milk_cream_rising.description: This jar contains raw milk separating into cream.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You examine the batch and see that the cream has risen to the top, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The cream has not risen yet.

crystallizing_sugar.name: crystallizing sugar (obsolete)
crystallizing_sugar.description: Sweet, sweet sugar in the process of crystallizing.  It needs two weeks to form solid crystals.

use_action.msg: You break up the crystallized sugar into a coarse powder.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The sugar is still crystallizing.

eggs_ferment.name: fermenting eggs jar
eggs_ferment.description: This jar contains a batch of eggs in a pickling solution.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You examine the batch and see that the pickling solution has done its job, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The eggs are not done yet.

flask_yeast.name: sealed yeast culture
flask_yeast.description: A sealed jar holding sanitized yeast wort.  You may harvest the yeast inside when it's done culturing.

use_action.msg: You open the jar and harvest the culture.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The yeast isn't done culturing yet.

pickles_ferment.name: fermenting pickle jar
pickles_ferment.description: This jar contains a batch of pickles set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You test the batch, and it tastes good, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The pickles are not done fermenting yet.

sauerkraut_ferment.name: fermenting sauerkraut jar
sauerkraut_ferment.description: This jar contains a batch of sauerkraut set to ferment.  You can seal up the jar once the process is completed.

use_action.msg: You test the batch, and it tastes good, so you seal the jar up for storage.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The sauerkraut isn't done fermenting yet.

curing_roe.name: curing roe (obsolete)
curing_roe.description: Roe in the process of becoming fully cured with salt, capable of becoming homemade caviar.  The flavor is slowly developing at this stage, and is currently significantly unpleasant due to the residual salt.  Activate it once completed to make use of the final product.

use_action.msg: You remove the roe from the brine and now have post apocalypse caviar.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The roe isn't fully cured yet.

brew_sake_koji.name: unfinished koji rice (obsolete)
brew_sake_koji.description: Some cooked rice mixed with yeast and koji mold fragments, set aside to let koji mold grow on it so that it can make a passable sake base.

use_action.msg: The koji mold seems to have overtaken all the rice; this batch is usable now.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The koji mold is still growing.

young_koji.name: growing wild koji mold (obsolete)
young_koji.description: Some cooked rice sprinkled with ash and wrapped into a corn husk.  If left alone for a while, it will most likely grow koji mold.

use_action.msg: Patches of koji mold have grown on the rice; you can now extract it.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The koji mold hasn't grown yet.

soy_wheat_dough.name: soy and wheat dough (obsolete)
soy_wheat_dough.description: Dough made from cooked and mashed soybeans and wheat flour, wrapped in wet paper.  If left to dry for some time, it'll grow koji mold, as necessary for making soy sauce.

use_action.msg: The koji mold seems to have overtaken all the dough; this batch is usable now.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The koji mold hasn't grown yet.

soft_adobe_brick.name: soft adobe brick (obsolete)
soft_adobe_brick.description: A compacted mass of soil and natural fibers, still too wet to build with.  Load it onto a pallet and leave it to dry.

use_action.msg: You test the brick, and it seems solid enough to use.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The brick is still too damp to bear weight.

adobe_pallet_full.name: pallet of wet adobe bricks (obsolete)
adobe_pallet_full.description: A pallet full of heavy mud bricks which need to dry slowly to be usable.

use_action.msg: You test the bricks, and they're solid enough to use.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The bricks are still too damp to bear weight.

bfg50.name: single-shot .50-caliber rifle
bfg50.description: Relatively trim as far as .50-caliber rifles go, this single-shot firearm was a reasonably affordable entry-level gun for civilians wishing to play with some very large, very punchy toys.  Now, at the world's Armageddon, it would be wise to make that singular round-capacity count on some high-priority craniums.

cz600.name: bolt-action trail carbine
cz600.description: Compact, svelte, and lightweight, this Leen bolt-action rifle packs the same features of larger sporting weapons into a backpack-sized package.  Possessing an adjustable buttstock, a detachable magazine-based system, and a quick-swap barrel that can be exchanged to accommodate the firing of .223 Remington or 7.62x39mm Soviet ammunition, the weapon is a commendable backpacker or prepper rifle.

retool_cz600_223rem.name: CZ .223 barrel-assembly
retool_cz600_223rem.description: This is a quick-detach .223-caliber barrel assembly and bolt-head, installable within the frame of a CZ 600 rifle, and secured with three fasteners.  With this assembly installed, a rifle is capable of feeding ammunition from standard STANAG-style magazines.

retool_cz600_762.name: CZ 7.62x39mm barrel-assembly
retool_cz600_762.description: This is a quick-detach 7.62mm barrel assembly and bolt head, installable within the frame of a CZ 600 rifle, and secured with three fasteners.  With this assembly installed, a rifle is rendered compatible with 7.62x39mm CZ Bren 2 magazines.

sw_610.name: 10mm/.40 revolver
sw_610.description: A classic six-shooter revolver chambered for 10mm and .40 rounds.

40_speedloader6.name: 10mm 6-round speedloader
40_speedloader6.description: This speedloader can hold 6 rounds of .40 S&W or 10mm Auto and quickly reload a compatible revolver.

acorns_blanching.name: blanching acorns (obsolete)
acorns_blanching.description: A mix of water and hulled acorns, slowly leaching the tannins.  It'll take about a week before they're palatable.

use_action.msg: After a week of changing water and taste-testing, the acorns are no longer bitter and ready to decant.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The acorns are still bitter.

multi_cooker.name: multi-cooker
multi_cooker.description: A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a short electric cord.  Its multitude of settings and features promise to handle any sort of cooking, from parboiling potatoes to cooking curry to popping popcorn.  There's no manual, but you're sure you can work it out.

multi_cooker_filled.name: multi-cooker - cooking
multi_cooker_filled.description: A professional-grade multi-cooker, with a battery slot for camping trips or tailgating.  There is a dish cooking inside it.

tanning_hide.name: tanning leather hide (obsolete)
tanning_hide.description: A treated animal hide that is undergoing the chemical processes required to become leather.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

use_action.msg: You carefully unfold the tanning leather hide and shake it clean.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The tanning leather hide isn't done yet.

tanning_pelt.name: tanning fur pelt (obsolete)
tanning_pelt.description: A treated animal pelt that is undergoing the chemical processes required to become fur.  You will be able to activate it to unroll and make use of it when it is done.

use_action.msg: You carefully unfold the tanning fur pelt and shake it clean.
use_action.not_ready_msg: The tanning fur pelt isn't done yet.

survnote_cabin_reverberation_hint.name: hastily-scribbled note
survnote_cabin_reverberation_hint.description: A scrap of paper.  Something's written on it, scrawled in bad handwriting.

crane_pseudo_item.name: suspending for butchering
crane_pseudo_item.description: Dummy item.  If you see this description, it is a bug.

veh_tools_kitchen.name: kitchen station
veh_tools_kitchen.description: A table rig with a faucet for water tank access, fume hood, drawers and fixtures for storing tools, low power electric connectors and valves for fuel tank connections.

veh_tools_workshop.name: workshop station
veh_tools_workshop.description: A table rig with drawers and fixtures for storing tools, wiring for high power electric connectors and valves for fuel tank connections.

door_lock.name: door lock set
door_lock.description: Some wires and gears for connecting door handles and an unlocking knob to a latching mechanism, and a sturdy lock to go on the outer surface.  If installed on a door or a hatch, this can be used to lock it.
